summary: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that its pieces were stolen from the child Gerrard.
quote: I know it to be the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes

summary: Starke reveals that the sidar's son is alive and called Volrath, and that he knows where Volrath is and how much of the Legacy he holds.
quote: I also know he is alive and now called Volrath.

summary: Starke names his price for the information: his daughter.
quote: "My daughter," Starke answered.

summary: In Benalia, Pol Cordel tells Gerrard that a Talruum has arrived aboard a flying ship, and Gerrard guesses Sisay has come for him.
quote: "You think she's come looking for me."

summary: Gerrard recalls that chasing the Legacy cost the lives of friends and is why he left the Weatherlight.
quote: chasing after the Legacy cost the lives of friends.

summary: Cordel's argument persuades Gerrard to go and see the docks.
quote: All right then. A convincing argument at last. Which docks?

summary: Maraxus corners Starke in his tent at night and threatens to kill him for betraying Volrath's secrets.
quote: "You spoke his secrets to an enemy," the figure growled.

summary: Starke offers Maraxus the woman who knows where Gerrard is, claiming she can draw Gerrard from hiding, and Maraxus orders him to bring her.
quote: "Bring her," it said suddenly.

summary: Starke lunges at Maraxus with his dagger but finds only darkness, as Maraxus has vanished.
quote: His blade only found darkness. The figure was gone.

summary: Gerrard hears Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire on the docks and runs to calm him.
quote: "Uh oh," Gerrard murmured, and broke into a run.

summary: Gerrard talks Tahngarth out of killing the missionary, and the two are reunited.
quote: "Easy, Tahngarth," he murmured, taking the Talruum's arm.

summary: Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
quote: something terrible has happened.

summary: In a flashback, Sisay tells Tahngarth she has agreed to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
quote: This servant, Volrath, is holding Starke's daughter prisoner.

summary: Sisay predicts that Gerrard will never be free of the Legacy.
quote: He'll never be free of the Legacy. He just doesn't know it yet.

summary: Gerrard decides to return to the Weatherlight the next morning, with Cordel arguing he should help his friends.
quote: Tomorrow morning I'm going back to the Weatherlight

summary: Gerrard leaves his hourglass pendant, the only part of the Legacy he kept, in Cordel's keeping.
quote: This belonged to my parents.

summary: The Weatherlight, with Gerrard aboard, sets sail from Benalia.
quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , with Gerrard aboard, set sail from Benalia.

summary: Starke betrays Sisay by opening a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag her away.
quote: She was alone with the traitor, alone against Volrath's power, directed at her by Starke.

summary: Sisay is abducted through the circle, and Starke leaves Volrath's abduction note beside her ring and flees the ship.
quote: Starke shivered as he put Volrath's abduction note on the table with Sisay's ring.

summary: The Weatherlight, without Sisay aboard, sets sail for Benalia.
quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , without Sisay aboard, set sail for Benalia.

summary: Starke lies to Crovax that he knows nothing of a letter but has seen Selenia in Rath, then tells him the letter was a trick to draw him away from his family.
quote: You were lured away from your home and from protecting your family.

summary: Starke urges Crovax to go home, and Crovax realizes he left his family alone and stumbles off, cursed.
quote: I left them alone just so I could find Selenia. I am cursed,

summary: Starke decides to seek allies after learning Gerrard is no longer aboard the Weatherlight.
quote: It's time I sought allies.

summary: Starke recalls how Maraxus forced him to help take Sisay prisoner, yet Volrath and Maraxus still refused to free him or his daughter.
quote: He had gained nothing by betraying Sisay

summary: Starke finds Crovax and begs him to hide him from the warlord sent to kill him; Crovax sends him on to his friend Alaric.
quote: I have a friend, Alaric, who will hide you.

summary: Maraxus's forces drag Starke out of Alaric's wine cellar and tear down Alaric's mansion.
quote: Maraxus's forces tore down Alaric's elegant mansion in the canyons

summary: Maraxus tells Starke that Alaric is dead and that Volrath is not through with him, and orders him taken to camp.
quote: "Your friend who hides you is dead," Maraxus said simply.

summary: Gerrard, Tahngarth and Crovax, who rescued Starke from Maraxus's camp, walk through a canyon and Tahngarth carries the weakened Starke.
quote: since the trio had rescued Starke from Maraxus of Keld's camp

summary: Starke whispers to Gerrard that Maraxus has a secret that might kill him.
quote: "A secret that might kill him."

summary: Maraxus and his ogre platoon find the sleeping group at dawn and attack, demanding Starke.
quote: "Give me the traitor," Maraxus demanded of Gerrard

summary: The Weatherlight drops from above into the ogres, scattering them and killing most of them, leaving only Maraxus.
quote: And then the Weatherlight fell from above, dropping amidst the ogres, scattering them like leaves on the breeze.

summary: Gerrard sends Tahngarth, Crovax and Starke to the ship to leave him alone against Maraxus, whose strength depends on those around him.
quote: that you draw your strength from whatever's around you, whoever's near. Look around. You're alone.

summary: Gerrard duels Maraxus and wounds him, and Maraxus's strength drains away.
quote: Gerrard landed a clean cut across the warlord's sword arm.

summary: Starke, hiding behind a boulder, stabs Maraxus in the back of the neck, and Maraxus falls dead.
quote: searching blindly for the dagger buried at the base of his neck

summary: Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, and offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom.
quote: I can lead you to Rath,

summary: Gerrard says he has no reason to trust Starke but needs him to reach Rath, and will watch him constantly.
quote: I have no reason at all to trust you, Starke.

summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

summary: Gideon's tracking of Chandra dead-ends at a barren pass in Akoum.
quote: Chandra's trail dead-ended at a barren mountain pass in Akoum

summary: Gideon is admitted into Fort Keff after dark.
quote: "Welcome to Fort Keff, the safest haven in Akoum."

summary: Tafre shares his fire and tells Gideon strange stories, then describes waking in a field of flesh and burning yellow dust.
quote: And then I remember nothing ... until I awoke in a field of flesh.

summary: Gideon is woken by soldiers beating and netting a surrakar that washed up in Keff.
quote: Beating it with cudgels until it collapsed, the soldiers threw a weighted net over it as it screeched in an unfamiliar tongue.

summary: The caged surrakar grips Gideon's arm and warns that the gods are coming, asking to be killed.
quote: "The gods are coming," it hissed. "Kill me now."

summary: Refugees pour into Fort Keff, fleeing demon insects, and the captain refuses to heed Gideon's warnings about the surrakar.
quote: Refugees had been arriving at the already-crowded haven all morning.

summary: Gideon learns from the surrakar that the gods come from a void without color, time and boundaries and will devour all existence.
quote: They had been ripped from a void without color, without time, and without boundaries.

summary: Gideon offers to help defend the fort, and the captain agrees.
quote: "Now we're speaking the same language."

summary: A cloud of yellow dust sweeps over Fort Keff, and the Eldrazi spawn arrive at the gates.
quote: When the worst had past, Gideon struggled to his feet and saw that enemy was already at the gates.

summary: The creatures crash into the rampart, arrows prove useless, and Gideon draws his sural and leaps into the fray.
quote: Then he jumped into the fray.

summary: Gideon draws all the creatures' attention to himself and whirls his sural until the attackers lie dead and Fort Keff is saved.
quote: Fort Keff had been saved.

summary: A 150-foot-tall Eldrazi Titan appears on the horizon, draining color and life from the land.
quote: Mind-numbing, phantasmal, 150 feet tall ... a thing of madness.

summary: Gideon accepts that he cannot defeat the Titan and believes the surrakar spoke the truth about the Blind Eternities made corporeal.
quote: This was the chaos of the Blind Eternities made corporeal.

summary: Gideon orders the surrakar released to lead everyone out along the underground river and to flee.
quote: "Release the surrakar. He'll lead you out along the underground river. Take everyone and flee!"

summary: Gideon vows to return and planeswalks to Ravnica to find the planeswalkers' organization.
quote: Gideon whispered a vow to return and planeswalked away.

summary: Javy leads Relov to a tenement where he sees Zivan's corpse, words carved into every inch of his skin.
quote: Words had been magically imprinted over every inch of the dead man's body.

summary: Javy asks about Zivan; Relov recounts that he was a respected Arbiter who squandered his talent in Rakdos pleasure houses.
quote: But he squandered it in Rakdos pleasure houses and hasn't been one of us for quite some time.

summary: Javy shows Relov an old Mass Arrest Order for the Golgari Undercity sweep and points out that everyone who signed it is dead except him.
quote: "They're all dead," she said. "Except for you."

summary: Javy explains that someone is slaughtering Azorius in the manner in which they lived their lives, and warns Relov.
quote: Someone is... slaughtering people in the manner in which they lived their lives,

summary: Relov files an Application for Constant Protection on returning to New Prahv.
quote: As soon as Relov got back to New Prahv, he filled out an Application for Constant Protection.

summary: Branko One-Ear, a former guard in the Golgari raid, is found dead behind his tenement with his brain in his lap.
quote: A tenant found him propped up against the cornerstone in the filthy alley behind his tenement.

summary: Javy visits Relov's townhouse at midnight and confronts him about signing the order for the Golgari raid.
quote: "You ordered it," Javy reminded him.

summary: Javy tells Relov she has found a new teacher who holds the truth about life and death, and that those who disturb the cycle must experience a profound death.
quote: I have found a new teacher, and she eclipses my work with the Boros,

summary: Vraska enters, and Javy warns Relov not to look at her face as the gorgon sweeps into the room.
quote: "Don't look her in the face," Javy ordered Relov as the gorgon swept into the room.

summary: Vraska tells Relov she was cast into a dark tomb just before a guard would have killed her, and resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.
quote: I resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.

summary: Vraska lets Javy choose Relov's death, and Javy names inaction.
quote: Javy didn't hesitate. "Inaction," she said.

summary: Relov is turned to stone, and his statue is installed near the main gate and mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
quote: No one looked long enough to see the uncanny resemblance to the missing Relov or the terror in his unblinking eyes.

summary: Odric reflects in Thraben that Avacyn's return has ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
quote: The phases of the moon were no longer predictors of life and death now that Avacyn had returned and cleansed the world.

summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

summary: Grete reports that the mayor's son in Torbach died after fleeing a werewolf; Odric, doubting in his heart, orders the regiment roused.
quote: "Rouse our regiment," he told Grete.

summary: The grieving mayor of Torbach rants at Odric and Grete, blaming the Church for a werewolf that slaughtered the widow of Bitterheart Hill.
quote: "It slaughtered the widow of Bitterheart Hill!" the mayor interrupted.

summary: Odric promises the mayor to find and kill the monster that killed his son.
quote: "We will find the monster that killed your son and put its head on a pike,"

summary: Odric decides that something about the widow attracted the monster and plans a trap near her cottage.
quote: Something about her attracted the monster. We'll set a trap near there.

summary: At midnight Odric and Grete lie in wait by a witchbane's orb baited with the widow's blood, and Odric recalls that her corpse showed no sign of werewolf violence.
quote: There was no evidence she'd been killed by a werewolf attack

summary: A tall shadow enters the clearing, and cathars drop a heavy net on the creature.
quote: Odric shouted to the cathars in the treetops, who cast down the heavy net

summary: Grete stops Odric from striking and he sees a human arm, human eyes and a face crisscrossed with black veins.
quote: Then he saw the arm—a human arm—a hand, and human eyes

summary: The creature identifies itself as Garruk Wildspeaker, weakened and cursed.
quote: "I'm weakened, cursed, and no threat to you," it said.

summary: Enraged, Odric smashes the pommel of his sword against Garruk's temple, dropping him.
quote: Odric bashed the blunt end of his sword against the monster's temple

summary: Grete pleads that the creature is not a werewolf and proposes bringing it alive to Thraben.
quote: "Let us bring it to Thraben—alive. Leave the days of slaughter behind us.

summary: Odric lets go of Garruk, sheathes his sword and orders him drugged and tied for the road to Thraben.
quote: "Drug him and tie him down.

summary: Sentos sits alone in a monk's cottage, holding a flask of poison and ring from the day he ended the war on Fleet Rock, resolving to drink to oblivion.
quote: But I'll drink to oblivion.

summary: Sentos wakes after the wind slams the door, finds the poison flask empty and shattered, and sees a statue of a frightened monk outside.
quote: But the stonecutter had carved fear into the monk's elderly features.

summary: A woman holds a blade to Sentos's throat and demands to know whether he is Sentos the Merciful.
quote: "Are you Sentos the Merciful?"

summary: The woman stabs Sentos in the back and makes him recount what happened on Fleet Rock, and he says the silver-haired man was the false king.
quote: "No one told me he was the false king."

summary: Sentos lies that he spared the false king out of mercy, concealing that he accepted the ring for his wife.
quote: I did it out of mercy." It was a lie he'd told many times before

summary: The woman reveals she is cursed and that a demon demands the eyes of a righteous man.
quote: A demon requires payment. He demands the eyes of a righteous man.

summary: She pushes back her hood and reveals herself as a gorgon of Xathrid whose gaze petrifies.
quote: A gorgon, a monster of Xathrid, with the power to petrify a man with her gaze.

summary: Sentos grabs a shard of the broken flask and stabs the gorgon in the heart, releasing a flood of black snakes.
quote: Sentos grabbed a shard of glass, whirled around, and plunged into her heart.

summary: The snakes bite Sentos and petrify when they meet the gorgon's gaze; she pins him with her foot.
quote: The gorgon's foot slammed into the back of his neck, pinning him down in the nest of petrified snakes.

summary: The gorgon cuts off Sentos's finger and takes the ring, which grants ceaseless life.
quote: With her blade, she sliced off his finger, taking the ring for her own.

summary: Without the ring, the venom kills Sentos; he looks the gorgon in the face and is turned to stone, and her blade strikes stone.
quote: But he heard the tip of her blade meet the stone of his face.

summary: Bazzle wakes to a cry of alarm and realizes that his clockwork creation has escaped again.
quote: It got out again. My creation continues to defy my wishes!

summary: Bazzle recalls how he built his greatest creation, and finds strange objects and keys left in his shop.
quote: Mostly, he found strange keys, hundreds of them, filling small burlap sacks and stacked near the door.

summary: Bazzle finds a crude brass clockwork arm on his workbench and realizes it is made of melted keys.
quote: Keys. This is made of melted keys.

summary: Bazzle realizes the creature has learned its creator's trade and effectively become his apprentice.
quote: Now, it seemed, he finally had an apprentice.

summary: Bazzle tries to dislodge the creature's chest key, but the creature winds itself and strikes him in the face.
quote: Before Bazzle could do anything, the hand swung back and struck him squarely in the face.

summary: On the second morning Bazzle finds a severed clockwork head made from the guard's helmet, his own reading crystals and the stirrups and teeth.
quote: This was a clockwork head.

summary: As Bazzle crawls to the key, the creature strikes the back of his neck and slides the key into place.
quote: just as the thing's arm connected with the back of his neck.

summary: On the third morning Bazzle finds his good arm severed and the metal arm attached in its place.
quote: his formerly good arm lay severed on the floor near his bed

summary: Bazzle realizes the creature never wanted a companion or army, only to stop sharing a body with him.
quote: It had merely decided it would no longer share a body with a rotting old clockmaker.

summary: The creature takes a cleaver and beheads Bazzle, setting its own head in his place and completing itself.
quote: The last thing he saw was his shop spinning roof-over-floor around him.

summary: Mr. Taz meets Krenko in a smoky pub and hires him for a Boros heist, giving him a glowing shiv.
quote: Here is a special tool to help you in your endeavor."

summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

summary: A fistfight breaks out among the soldiers, and Krenko enjoys the tension.
quote: Such undisciplined hot-headedness seemed very un-Boros.

summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

summary: Krenko sets fires and bombs through the floors of Sunhome to create chaos and slips unnoticed into Vinrenn's chambers.
quote: Chaos is the best cover, and Krenko went about setting fires and kicking down doors.

summary: Krenko finds an angel in stasis inside a detention sphere and smashes it open with the shiv's handle.
quote: With another good smash, the sphere dissipated, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

summary: Krenko plucks two feathers from the angel and falsely screams that she attacked him, and guards seize her.
quote: "She tried to escape! She's free. She attacked me!"

summary: As Krenko leaves, a large explosion rocks Sunhome.
quote: a large explosion rocked Sunhome.

summary: Krenko delivers the angel's feather to Taz on the Millennial and receives an Orzhov safebox key holding Feather's money.
quote: Taz handed him a silver key with the Orzhov symbol carved into the shaft.

summary: Taz hints at a further job in the Orzhova after calling Krenko the boss of something grand.
quote: I can see you as the boss of something grand.

summary: During the Slaughter of the Arches, the doll is pierced in the belly by a golden blade and wonders whether it was made to suffer.
quote: a golden blade pierced my belly.

summary: The doll seeks answers from mages, monks and philosophers, none of whom help except to try to use it.
quote: None had answers for a doll in the midst of an existential crisis

summary: The doll is kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker, whose stuffed-bear minion dies in battle with villagers, leaving the doll on the street.
quote: I was kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker.

summary: A nomad caravan seizes the doll from the roadside and puts it in a shaman's pack.
quote: As I was plucked from the roadside and shoved into a shaman's pack

summary: The doll, now a follower of the nomad shaman, watches her battle a legion of knights and a famous crusader while a meteor approaches.
quote: Tonight, we're locked in battle with a legion of knights, as she pits herself against a famous crusader.

summary: The doll accepts its fate as the meteor bears down and the battle is about to be over for the crusader.
quote: Over for the crusader anyway.

summary: An inquisitor demands that the wounded Brenalt explain how he survived, suspecting a deal with a demon.
quote: I believe you made a deal for your life, and the seed of darkness is now within you.

summary: In a flashback, Brenalt barricades a ruined shrine and mourns his dead friends Tomas, Edrick and Stanton.
quote: Tomas, Edrick, and Stanton were dead. His best friends.

summary: Mattias dies after urging Brenalt to run and tell their families.
quote: Mattias's eyes shut and did not open again.

summary: Brenalt prays wordlessly at the altar and an angel appears in warmth and light.
quote: This was a creature from a different world, as alien in thought and mind as she was familiar in form.

summary: Brenalt asks the angel for help, and she nods, granting him strength in a pact.
quote: A pact had been reached.

summary: The inquisitor, softened, tells Brenalt she believes him.
quote: I believe you, soldier.

summary: Brenalt rises rapidly through the ranks to general, rumored to be blessed by the angels.
quote: General Brenalt had been blessed by the angels, and no matter how bad it got, Brenalt managed to emerge victorious.

summary: At a council of war Brenalt tells his fellow commanders that angels are alien and cannot be relied on, not even for hope.
quote: The angels answered my call once, and whatever they are, I still believe that they might come to our aid.

summary: A scout reports that the Fourth Legion is lost and River's Glen overrun, and Brenalt reveals it was his home.
quote: The Fourth Legion is lost. The dead have overrun both Greenfield and River's Glen.

summary: Brenalt, now crippled and leading a few dozen survivors, sees a necromancer directing the dead below.
quote: The necromancer was real, after all.

summary: Brenalt screams at the heavens that he gave everything and will die fighting, honoring his promise.
quote: I will die fighting. I will die honoring my promise to you.

summary: Brenalt bows his head with the praying refugees and raises his staff for one last charge as the wind changes.
quote: He raised his staff toward the enemy, girding himself for one last charge.

summary: Kalyntri kills and eats a baloth, then roars triumph so that Talrand will hear.
quote: Kalyntri paused from eating to roar his triumph to the sky and sea.

summary: Kalyntri recalls how Talrand had appeared in one of his lairs a year ago and escaped a blast of flame, and that Talrand now has drake servants.
quote: Talrand was merely gone, and only the problem of him, and his drakes, remained.

summary: Kalyntri spots Talrand standing on the open water beneath a lone dark storm cloud and swoops to kill him.
quote: He swooped low, eagerly, not wanting to lose Talrand again like he did the first time they met.

summary: Talrand says he did not want to kill Kalyntri but found no path to keep him alive.
quote: I didn't want to have to kill you.

summary: Kalyntri attacks with flame while Talrand uses fog, geysers and water walls to evade him.
quote: Kalyntri roared, an incandescent rush of rage that transmuted into scalding flame

summary: Kalyntri bludgeons Talrand with his tail and body, sending him skipping onto an island beach.
quote: The impact of the blow sent Talrand sprawling across the water once more before skipping onto the beach of one of the nearby islands.

summary: Talrand announces he brings the dragon rain, and dozens of drakes fall on Kalyntri from the storm cloud.
quote: Drakes. The echoes.

summary: Kalyntri realizes he is losing as the drakes bite him and a geyser slams him onto the beach.
quote: It suddenly occurred to Kalyntri that he was losing.

summary: Talrand gives Kalyntri to a large drake as promised, and the drake bites through the dragon's neck, killing him.
quote: Service to me means an end to the tyranny of dragons. He is yours.

summary: Nira, a nacatl Sunstriker, introduces herself to Lia and explains that a demon is harvesting bones for a ritual.
quote: He's killing countless creatures just to give himself more power,

summary: Nira tells Lia that the demon has taken her village and family to the ruins.
quote: Your family is at the ruins, too.

summary: Nira reveals that Lia is a stonekiller whom she needs to destroy the dragon skeleton's keystone.
quote: "You are," she replied. "I watched you by the river.

summary: Nira explains the keystone and gives Lia the warrior name Kaa-lia.
quote: You are now the warrior, Kaa-lia.

summary: Kaalia and Nira watch from a ridge as black-clad servants gather in the arena.
quote: a line of black-clad people shuffled silently into the arena.

summary: Nira and Kaalia sneak into the arena and begin climbing a rib as the ritual shakes the ground.
quote: the ground bucked violently.

summary: The servants' palms split open and blood rains upward as the ritual advances.
quote: Droplets of blood began to cascade upward into the sky.

summary: The bald man reaches the walkway and fights Nira, nearly knocking her off.
quote: For a leathery scrap of a man, he was unnaturally strong.

summary: Kaalia, imagining herself by the river on Bant, destroys the keystone.
quote: When Kaalia opened her eyes, the keystone was gone and a gaping hole nearly bisected the spine.

summary: The bald man grabs Kaalia and throws her off the walkway, and Nira leaps after her.
quote: And he threw her off the side.

summary: Nira cushions Kaalia's fall as the spine snaps and the skeleton falls, killing the bald man.
quote: Nira twisted her body so she cushioned Kaalia's fall.

summary: Nira tells Kaalia to flee, saying the rest of the Sunstrikers are lost.
quote: Now flee from here. The rest of us are lost.

summary: A blast splits the arena and the demon rises from the rift and slaughters the survivors.
quote: He arose from the rift that now cut across the floor.

summary: Kaalia awakes to devastation, learns the demon escaped, and vows revenge.
quote: I'll kill the demon.

summary: Branko guards kneeling Golgari prisoners in the basement corridor of the Detention Compound while the first floor is lost to a revolt.
quote: some of the Golgari overwhelmed their captors and gained control of the first floor.

summary: Gebris taunts a Golgari prisoner and presses his boot to the man's face, provoking the prisoners to hiss and growl.
quote: Gebris took the toe of his boot and shoved it against the man's face

summary: Gebris blames the Golgari for planning the raid, and Branko agrees to move the prisoners through the sunlit exercise yard to the South Block pens.
quote: "Let's take them through the exercise yard," Gebris urged.

summary: The prisoners surround Branko and free the gorgon to use her as a weapon.
quote: They were going to use her as a weapon.

summary: Branko fights off the prisoners, then closes his eyes and drags the gorgon into the sunlit yard.
quote: Closing his eyes, he charged at the gorgon.

summary: The gorgon tears at Branko's ear, the prisoners run free, and the guards lose control.
quote: Prisoners were running freely through the yard. They'd lost control.

summary: Light engulfs the injured gorgon, and she vanishes, leaving only an imprint in the sand.
quote: The gorgon was gone.

summary: Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and approving a new statue of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
quote: Learn to spell, Mr. Lapt, and stop wasting my precious time.

summary: Relov signs an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations when he sees the bribe amount.
quote: The request violated twelve statutes, but when Relov saw the pale pink number printed at the bottom, he signed without hesitation.

summary: Relov receives a cryptic letter from Javy asking him to come, after a year of silence since she and her partner were attacked.
quote: What is the culmination of a life of words? Buckets of blood. Come now.

summary: A young elf falls with her wolf from a training beam during her first lesson, and Ruzi asks her to say what she did wrong.
quote: "Tell me what you did wrong," Ruzi said to his two-legged student.

summary: Ruzi and his wolf Kuma cross the high beam without hesitation to teach his students to trust their wolves.
quote: But Ruzi urged his wolf forward without hesitation.

summary: The dryad Mazena confronts Ruzi after class with a message from Guildmaster Trostani.
quote: We have an important message from Guildmaster Trostani, and you kept us standing for ages,

summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

summary: Mazena makes clear that Ruzi must find his sister Cecilee, and he cannot say no.
quote: You want me to find my sister.

summary: Ruzi recalls Cecilee's departure for the Rubblebelt and her silence, and that she adopted a Gruul child named for him.
quote: He'd heard that she'd adopted an abandoned Gruul child to raise as her own.

summary: Ruzi and Kuma reach the edge of the Rubblebelt before dawn and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.
quote: Hours later, Ruzi and Kuma had reached the last roof at the edge of the Rubblebelt.

summary: Cecilee, mute from childhood, suddenly speaks in a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya at Vitu-Ghazi, and the dryads call her a conduit to the Worldsoul.
quote: And then one day Cecilee did speak.

summary: Feeling called to establish a settlement in the Rubblebelt, Cecilee ignores Ruzi's warnings and leads twenty followers there.
quote: And so she went, leading twenty followers, to the wildest place any of them could imagine.

summary: Cecilee adopts an abandoned infant with a Gruul tattoo and names him Ruzi, calling him Zi.
quote: Cecilee named the child after her brother, Ruzi, and took him into her home to raise as her own son.

summary: A Gruul shaman from Nikya's clan comes to take Zi back, but Cecilee refuses, and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
quote: After Cecilee adopted Zi, the Gruul sent a woman to take him back.

summary: Before sunrise, an ogre breaks through the gate followed by Massacre Girl and her men, who are not Gruul.
quote: Just before sunrise, their gate flew off the hinges and splintered on the ground.

summary: Massacre Girl strikes Cecilee and tears the young guild tree from the ground.
quote: The woman ripped the young guild tree out of the ground and hurled it across the courtyard

summary: Massacre Girl cuts off Cecilee's hair while Cecilee freezes.
quote: The woman took out her rusty blade and chopped the blonde hair from Cecilee's head.

summary: Cecilee's followers lie dead, and Cecilee, mute again and cut off from the Worldsoul, has her throat cut.
quote: There was just the woman and her rusty blade cutting Cecilee's throat

summary: Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate into the settlement, surprising Massacre Girl and her men.
quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.

summary: Ruzi gutted the first cultist to attack and is surrounded, weakened by the fear that Cecilee is among the dead.
quote: Cecilee's body would be among the dead, and that knowledge made Ruzi weak.

summary: Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her, taunts Ruzi, and leaves with her cultists, throwing confetti.
quote: Tossing it up into the air, she did a twisted bow and sashayed for the gate.

summary: Ruzi and Kuma dodge the ogre's chains and Kuma kills him by the throat.
quote: but the wolf's teeth closed around its throat before the ogre could raise its meaty arms to defend itself.

summary: Ruzi beheads the fallen ogre in a murderous rage.
quote: Feeling murderous, Ruzi sliced off the ogre's head while the it still lay blubbering on the ground.

summary: Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister, without looking at her.
quote: he couldn't bear to look at his sister—not even as he placed her body into the mass grave

summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

summary: Ruzi finds baby Zi alive in a hidden cradle and reasons the Rakdos were hired by someone from the city proper.
quote: Whoever hired Massacre Girl was someone from the city proper, someone who had coin to waste on murder.

summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.
quote: "They killed your infant!" Ruzi said.

summary: Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

summary: Ruzi rejoins Kuma, who guards the baby Zi, and vows to tear down the city.
quote: "And then we'll tear it down."

summary: Perisophia opens a lesson in Meletis by asking her students what identity is, using the example of a leonin cub raised by wolves.
quote: "What is identity? What makes us who we are?"

summary: Perisophia urges her students to dwell in the mystery rather than hastily answering.
quote: Dwell in the mystery for a bit and see what arises.

summary: Melia cites Phelos, and Perisophia presses whether identity can be an object of knowledge.
quote: Can you know yourself? Can your identity be an object of knowledge, or is it something entirely different?

summary: Samia asks about the Returned and eidolons, and Perisophia explains that they lack the capacity for an identity.
quote: It would appear that the Returned and the eidolons lack the capacity for an identity.

summary: Salis raises the story of Matatios, and Perisophia warns that Matatios only met himself and did not become aware of himself.
quote: Matatios did not become aware of himself, he only met himself.

summary: Perisophia ends the lesson by saying that identity lives in the moment and that each person is the architect of it.
quote: Identity is not in the past, nor does it dwell in the future. It lives in the moment.

summary: In a dream-vision in a void of stars, Ephara asks Perisophia about Meletis and warns that war is coming and a tyrant tears at the threshold of the world.
quote: War is coming. A tyrant tears at the threshold of our world and yours

summary: Perisophia vows to speak only words that uplift the human mind and soul with her dying breath.
quote: With my dying breath I will speak only words that uplift the human mind and soul.

summary: The narrator's mother marries Vinack when the narrator is ten, after the narrator was beaten by farmhands' sons.
quote: When I was ten when my mother married him and, at the time, I didn't hate him.

summary: The narrator confronts Vinack after seeing his mother's bruised face, and Vinack strikes him.
quote: He told me to know my place and struck me in the head.

summary: The narrator tells Vinack he is a selfish beast, and Vinack beats him until the mother and farmhands throw him out.
quote: My mother threw him out.

summary: The narrator's mother dies of failing health when he is seventeen, leaving him in charge of the farmland.
quote: My mother passed away when I was seventeen and I was then in charge of our farmland.

summary: The scholar Zerili argues for a treaty with the minotaurs and is found murdered and mutilated that week.
quote: the young man's mutilated corpse was found later that week

summary: Vinack returns after ten years asking for help against the minotaurs, and the narrator strikes him.
quote: I would not have struck him if he hadn't said, "I need your help, Son."

summary: The narrator agrees to help and Vinack proposes striking down the minotaur oracle.
quote: Vinack's plan was to go into their territory and strike down their oracle.

summary: The narrator searches Zerili's home and ledger and concludes that the village secretly pays human tribute and that Vinack means him to die.
quote: Vinack meant for me to die.

summary: At the minotaur camp the narrator presses a dagger to Vinack's back, and Vinack reveals the sacrifice will be himself.
quote: "No, Son," he said, shaking his head. "The sacrifice will be me."

summary: Vinack offers himself as sacrifice to the oracle, who crushes and snaps his body, and a blood mist fills the minotaurs while the narrator thinks he sees Mogis.
quote: Without ceremony, the shaman slammed his fist downwards on Vinack's head, pushing it down into his body.

summary: The narrator returns to the village praised as the hero who stopped the minotaur menace, and concludes he hates himself.
quote: I let that man walk to his death.

summary: Adrasteia prepares to cut a snarl in the tapestry where a blue and a gold thread have intertwined.
quote: Two threads, one blue, the other gold, which had begun their journey through the tapestry in parallel, had now become intertwined.

summary: Pavios lies awake thinking of Thanasis, knowing his father plans to send him back to Meletis to marry an official's daughter in two days.
quote: Just two days hence, Pavios's father planned to send him back to Meletis to marry the daughter of a prominent official

summary: Pavios hides a note for Thanasis telling him to search the coal pile for a gift.
quote: Pavios rolled up the note and placed it beneath a stone near the door to Thanasis's house.

summary: In flashback, Thanasis tells Pavios his dream of becoming a Lukos and shares stories of Akros at the emonberry outcropping.
quote: "I want to be a Lukos," Thanasis had told him

summary: Thanasis wraps his rabbit-fur cloak around Pavios on a cold day and lets him keep it.
quote: "You may keep it," he said.

summary: Thanasis shares the story of his mother's death, and Pavios embraces and kisses his cheek, but Thanasis stiffens.
quote: Pavios pulled him close, embracing him, and kissed his cheek.

summary: Their fathers quarrel and the meetings end, and Pavios's father announces they will return to Meletis for the wedding.
quote: The following day, the disagreement between their fathers erupted

summary: Thanasis speaks to Pavios through a crack in the wall at night and asks to meet at midday, thanking him for the gift.
quote: "I will wait for you," Thanasis said.

summary: Pavios resolves not to return to Meletis and goes to the outcropping with a pack, hoping Thanasis will run away with him.
quote: He would not return to Meletis.

summary: A white-maned beast kills and devours a rabbit, notices Pavios, and he flees down the switchback into a cave.
quote: Panicked, Pavios bolted in the opposite direction

summary: Pavios returns at dusk to find Thanasis dying against the emonberry tree with the short sword in his chest and the torn cloak across his lap.
quote: In his chest was thrust the short sword Pavios had given him.

summary: Thanasis dies after saying he thought the beast had killed Pavios; Pavios realizes Thanasis mistook the blood for his.
quote: Thanasis's weak breaths ceased.

summary: Pavios prays to Erebos, who permits him to join Thanasis in death, and Pavios falls on the sword.
quote: the blade drove into Pavios's heart.

summary: Adrasteia's shears take the snarl and the tip of her thumb, and a drop of her blood stains the tapestry.
quote: The shears took the snarl, and along with it the very tip of her thumb.

summary: Kiora, unable to return to Zendikar without a weapon against the Eldrazi, continues her search and planeswalks through the Blind Eternities.
quote: Not without a weapon to fight the monstrosities called the Eldrazi.

summary: Kiora arrives in a new ocean and tastes a new world.
quote: Kiora swam, and tasted a new world.

summary: Kiora casts a massive upwelling spell to draw out the titans of the deep, sending a wave toward shore, but nothing answers.
quote: Immense and sluggish currents flowed together directly below her

summary: Kiora summons a leviathan from another world and rides it toward shore.
quote: The leviathan rose beneath her and she clung to its spines.

summary: Kiora meets native tritons and learns she is on Theros near Meletis, where they take her for Thassa.
quote: "You are on Theros ," he said. "You are in the mortal world."

summary: The tritons explain the Silence, saying the gods retreated into Nyx after Kruphix spoke and blaming the Sun's Champion for slaying Nylea's hydra.
quote: The Sun's Champion slew Nylea's pet hydra.

summary: Kiora lets the tritons believe she is a god and privately questions Kalemnos about whether he believes she is Thassa.
quote: "And do you believe I am Thassa?"

summary: Kalemnos guesses Kiora is Thassa's emissary and agrees to help her find the sea's mightiest children.
quote: I believe you may be her emissary, sent to guide us while she is absent.

summary: Kiora declares a quest from Thassa and leads the tritons out to the open sea on the leviathan to hunt krakens.
quote: "Then consider this a quest from Thassa," said Kiora.

summary: Soldiers in Meletis note that a third child has vanished this month and no one knows what happened.
quote: "That makes three so far this month."

summary: The phalanx leader reports to Perisophia and the council that the Weeping Woman is no longer alone and leads three masked children.
quote: We have again seen the Weeping Woman. And... she is no longer alone.

summary: The captain admits he could not strike down the children, and Perisophia comforts him, saying tenderness stayed his hand.
quote: Tenderness, not weakness, stayed your hand.

summary: Perisophia deduces that the Weeping Woman has lured the missing children away and decides the children must be laid to rest.
quote: In her endless search for her dead, the Weeping Woman has lured away the living.

summary: Perisophia orders the children to sleep, and priests gather to prepare a blood-rite.
quote: "Let the children sleep."

summary: At the salt marsh the priests chant while the young widower pours the lekythos into the water, drawing the Weeping Woman and children from the mist.
quote: Then, out of the mists, she came.

summary: The priests lay blood-wet palms on the golden masks, and the four masked figures slip below the surface of the fen.
quote: And with a sigh, four masked figures slipped below the surface.

summary: Misty child spirits play through the agora at dawn and vanish into the walls, and Perisophia declares the children at rest.
quote: "The children are at rest.

summary: Ten soldiers of the Alamon wait at the Horns for Eumalos's squad, and Captain Kyrillos sends Bardas and Borias to climb the stones.
quote: Bardas, Borias—climb the Horns and see what you can see.

summary: A wounded cyclops attacks the squad; Pallas is backhanded, and the squad kills it with Mnesos's sling and Nikasios's spear.
quote: There was a crack as Mnesos's stone met the cyclops's skull, and the creature roared.

summary: Nikasios notices the cyclops's other leg was mauled rather than cut, and Kyrillos decides to investigate One-Eyed Pass since Eumalos's squad missed the rendezvous.
quote: there's something besides our soldiers in One-Eyed Pass that can drive off a cyclops. We're going to check it out.

summary: At night Leandros asks Mnesos why the gods have abandoned them and whether they will return; Mnesos says the gods have retreated into Nyx before.
quote: The historians tell us that this is not the first time the gods have retreated into Nyx

summary: The squad finds nine beheaded, butchered Akroans in the pass, including Captain Eumalos, and Xanthos identifies minotaur tracks.
quote: There were nine Akroans lying on the ground, their bodies already bloating in the heat.

summary: Leandros prays to Athreos for the dead as the squad moves on without burying them.
quote: Leandros muttered a prayer to Athreos, who ferried souls to the Underworld

summary: Boulders fall behind the squad, sealing the canyon, and a minotaur horde led by a huge sword-wielding brute charges them.
quote: From ahead of them came the sound of savage cries and thundering hooves, and then the first minotaurs rounded the corner.

summary: Xanthos is split from shoulder to thigh by a minotaur's axe while protecting Haemon.
quote: The axe fell, and split him from shoulder to thigh.

summary: Mnesos is gutted by a minotaur and is lost behind the horde; Leandros finds his trampled body later.
quote: Mnesos fell to the ground, moaning, blood seeping from his stomach.

summary: The minotaur leader joins the fight, severs Nikasios's leg and hurls Haemon against the canyon wall with a sickening crack.
quote: Nikasios lurched to one side, but the minotaur struck his leg, severing it.

summary: Kyrillos rams his sword into the minotaur leader's gut, is slammed down and stomped, and the leader is beheaded by Pallas and Leandros, its body falling on Kyrillos, who dies.
quote: Pallas's sword made a great arc and severed the minotaur's head.

summary: The surviving minotaurs scatter after their leader falls.
quote: they had seen their leader fall, and they were scattering.

summary: Borias dies beside Bardas, telling Leandros about their bet over who would live longer.
quote: He shuddered, and his eyes went glassy.

summary: Diocles realizes the minotaurs lured and trapped the squad deliberately and says Akros must be warned.
quote: The minotaurs are hunting the Alamon, deliberately.

summary: Pallas, injured, and the wounded Diocles and Nikasios stay to hold off more minotaurs while Leandros climbs out to warn Akros.
quote: Then more minotaurs poured into the canyon, and Leandros turned to climb the tumbled boulders.

summary: Leandros runs for a day and more past fallen Alamon squads and minotaur bands and reaches Akros at night.
quote: Occasionally he came upon squads of fallen Alamon

summary: Leandros discovers the minotaurs have built a wall around Akros to keep the Alamon out while besieging the city.
quote: A wall. Someone— minotaurs —had built a wall around Akros

summary: Iroas and Mogis appear as stars above Akros and grapple, absorbed in their own conflict and not helping mortals.
quote: The twins were interested in each other, not mortals.

summary: Leandros falls to his knees, too late to prevent the siege of Akros, which begins.
quote: The siege of Akros had begun.

summary: Aesrias recalls killing a stuporous giant, a hydra, and a flock of harpies, taking the harpy heads to Tynthal.
quote: In the end, I killed them all, of course.

summary: Aesrias delivers the harpy heads to Governor Pilun in the civic temple, who is crowned and flanked by soldiers.
quote: I gave the harpy heads to a young attendant

summary: Pilun accuses Aesrias of stealing from a merchant, and a man in rags falsely testifies; Pilun orders the guards to seize him.
quote: Guards, it seems we have our criminal.

summary: Aesrias, tired and suspecting a plot, lets himself be shackled without a fight.
quote: I let them shackle me and did not fight.

summary: Aesrias is taken to a coliseum holding pen and realizes he is meant for illegal arena killing.
quote: I would be sent to kill or die in an arena.

summary: Aesrias meets the star-skinned nyxborn in the next cell, who knew his mother.
quote: I've heard your name and I know your mother.

summary: The nyxborn explains that it was sent to serve the governor but that Pilun no longer serves the true king, and it cannot free itself.
quote: this governor seems to no longer serve the true king.

summary: The nyxborn blesses Aesrias with Iroas's power, healing him and strengthening him before he faces sirens; Aesrias asks for candle wax for his ears.
quote: He touched my shoulders. And I felt better. My wounds healed. I was no longer tired.

summary: Aesrias is led into the coliseum, where Pilun and a few spectators watch as nine chained sirens are released.
quote: They all counted together, then released the sirens and ran to the arena's edge.

summary: Wax-deafened to their songs and protected by the blessing, Aesrias kills several sirens using their own chains.
quote: When the first siren tried to fly away in a panic, she choked her sister to death.

summary: Aesrias breaks the chain loop and is carried out of the coliseum and into the countryside by the remaining four sirens.
quote: I was able to easily break the links and held fast to the sirens.

summary: When the sirens tire and drop, Aesrias kills them; the nyxborn's blessing fades and he resolves to inform the king of Pilun's secession.
quote: The journey to the Kolophon to inform the king of Pilun's secession and my encounter with a nyxborn will be dangerous.

summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

summary: Jace rules that the minotaurs must file a proper complaint with Lavinia, and the lead minotaur sheathes his axe.
quote: You will file a proper complaint with Deputy Lavinia

summary: Lavinia shows Jace that victims of petrification were found in Rozlad Square arranged to spell his name.
quote: They spell out your name.

summary: Jace recognizes that the victims' names match planes, realizes a planeswalker is targeting him, and insists on going alone to Rozlad Square.
quote: Clear out all your officers and mages from Rozlad Square. I'm going alone.

summary: Jace meets a hooded woman with a dagger in the square; she is petrified before he can read her mind.
quote: She became a stone statue before his eyes, a lifeless object.

summary: Vraska reveals herself as a gorgon and planeswalker and says she wants Jace to prove he will be an ally of Ravnica.
quote: Before him was a gorgon.

summary: Jace deduces that Vraska wants to rule Ravnica, and she declares she is ready to kill him; the Jace she looks at is only an illusion.
quote: Instead of turning to stone, Jace melted away into nothingness.

summary: The real Jace emerges and has Vraska send her four assassins away; he deduces she wants to control him as Guildpact.
quote: So you want to leave me in the office of the Guildpact, and manipulate me.

summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

summary: Vraska strangles Jace with her tendrils; he reads her mind and conjures illusions of himself that attack her.
quote: Jace felt the gorgon's grip loosen as he sent image after image of himself at her.

summary: Vraska petrifies the illusions, which become a cage around her, and the statues speak in Jace's voice and trick her into explaining her plan to take over Ravnica.
quote: Then, one by one, I will assassinate the guild leaders.

summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

summary: Vraska crushes what she thinks is Jace's neck but it is her own petrified assassin; the statues close in and she blasts them away and planeswalks off.
quote: Then she took a breath, closed her eyes, and planeswalked away.

summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

summary: Iris refuses to hide, but Perisophia and the Twelve decide she must be moved to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents have infiltrated Meletis.
quote: We have conferred with the Temple and agreed that you will be moved to the garrison at Soli

summary: Alexio is presented as Iris's bodyguard; when she touches him she has a vision that he will fall in love with her and be taken from her, and resolves to prevent it.
quote: He was in love with her.

summary: Iris and Alexio leave Meletis at dawn on the overland route south through the forest.
quote: Perisophia let go of Iris's hand as Alexio led her horse away

summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

summary: Pursuers find the dead ambushers and the horse and track the Oracle and the Skyguard.
quote: Men, we will be home with our captive and the head of a Skyguard before the moon is full.

summary: Alexio brings a friendly pegasus as a mount, and Iris and Alexio fly toward the mountains.
quote: Hold fast, but know that he will not let you fall.

summary: A storm forces them to land and shelter in a mountain cave.
quote: Alexio led them into a cave on the side of the mountain.

summary: The commander scries their location in a golden goblet and plans to ambush them in the cave with the help of a spider of the upper forest.
quote: We will ambush them in the cave.

summary: Iris and Alexio become lovers in the cave, Iris deciding that she may be able to change his fate by loving him back.
quote: Before she could control herself, she felt his lips touch hers.

summary: Ambushers attack the cave; Alexio finds the back entrance blocked by a spider web and is shot while clearing it.
quote: Another arrow twanged through the cavern, this time finding its mark.

summary: Alexio sends Iris away on the pegasus and stays to fight, telling her he loves her; Iris senses he will die.
quote: She knew he would never make it out of that cave, his mighty body and heavenly wings doomed.

summary: Iris blames herself for Alexio's death and flies west toward freedom instead of to Soli or Meletis.
quote: The Oracle of Ephara flew blindly through the rain toward freedom, unseeing and alone, as she had always truly been.

summary: Caught stealing from a magister's study, the narrator is forced to choose between joining the Akroan soldiers and execution.
quote: I could join the noble Akroan soldiers, or I could be executed.

summary: The narrator recalls the legends of heroes such as Vinack, Aesrias, Solon and Kedarick VI that inspired her as an orphan thief.
quote: Even as a young thief outside of the academies, you learned about the great heroes.

summary: As an orphan on the streets the narrator resolves to become a legend greater than Kytheon Iora.
quote: I would be greater than Kytheon.

summary: As a soldier the narrator proves an excellent fighter and is soon to become an officer with her own contingent.
quote: In a few months, I was to become an officer with a contingent of my own.

summary: Word comes that the Nyxborn are attacking, and the narrator rushes with her company to the gate.
quote: The Nyxborn were attacking.

summary: The Nyxborn force of mixed creatures with night-sky skin approaches the bridge, and the narrator realizes they are agents of the gods.
quote: These were agents of the gods sent to do their bidding.

summary: The narrator realizes she has rushed into battle with only seven other soldiers against an army of unknown size.
quote: I had rushed into a fight against an army of unknown size and strength with only seven other soldiers.

summary: The soldiers hold the bridge in a phalanx, knocking Nyxborn off the edge, until weak reinforcements arrive and the gates are sealed behind them.
quote: Reinforcements arrived and the guards sealed the gates behind them

summary: A Nyxborn grabs and stabs the narrator six times and throws her against the sealed gates.
quote: thrown like a child's toy against the gates that didn't open.

summary: The Nyxborn retreat after the last soldier falls, and the gates reopen.
quote: And then, as the last soldier fell, the Nyxborn retreated.

summary: Clerics rescue the narrator, relieving her collapsed lung with a hollow reed, healing her with magic and taking her to a Pharikan temple.
quote: Suddenly, I could breathe again.

summary: The narrator concludes that the battle was pointless and that maybe true heroes let their names fade away.
quote: Maybe true heroes just let their names fade away.

summary: In a dream, Euneas watches the Meletian plaza crushed beneath endless replacement columns until the city swallows him whole; he wakes screaming.
quote: The city had claimed him whole, another piece of sediment for the streets future inhabitants would trod upon in their brief doomed hours.

summary: In a dream, Pollio ties twine to his family, customers and friends until the ropes grow tight and the crowd's flesh knits into a single mass; he wakes screaming.
quote: Then, Pollio was part of one amorphous mass of stinking flesh and burning rope

summary: In a dream, Melantha dines with her dead mentor Xenocrates, who drinks wine from a poisoned goblet and coughs up blood as he voices blasphemous theories; she wakes screaming.
quote: I did not... I did not kill you, Xenocrates.

summary: Xenocrates argues that gods are the patterns mortals recognize, personified through the power of Nyx, and that mortals are responsible for their gods; Melantha forbids it as blasphemy.
quote: Through the power of Nyx, we are responsible for our gods.

summary: In a city's dream, small hairy creatures overrun a content, resting city, which is driven to awaken by a voice.
quote: Every avenue and structure of the city was covered with the hairy pests

summary: The city awakens as Cacophony, god of cities, and begins crushing the ape-like humans clinging to its body.
quote: Cacophony, the god of cities, arose.

summary: Ephara appears, calls Cacophony a monstrosity and plunges her hands into it, draining its life; the god of cities never wakes again.
quote: Cacophony, the god of cities dark, never woke again.

summary: Ashiok, whose concealment from Phenax's boon fades, reveals that they sculpted the dreams to create the god Cacophony as a display, hiding in an abandoned Ephara temple.
quote: The earth's rumbles faded to stillness as the last remnant of Phenax's glamour dissolved around Ashiok.

summary: Ashiok recalls repaying a favor to Phenax with a boon to hide from the gods, and Phenax's warning not to use it to harm a god.
quote: The boon was a temporary one, and Phenax had been very explicit about Ashiok's fate if Ashiok used the boon to attempt to injure or murder a god.

summary: Ashiok reflects that turning an idea into a god is easy compared to Xenagos's feat, and that Cacophony could rise again.
quote: But turning an idea into a god was much easier.

summary: Raissa gives birth to her horned, kicking son, assisted by a midwife who thanks the gods.
quote: That anger gave her strength, which she used to finally expel him, howling, from her body.

summary: During her pregnancy Raissa consults the starfish in a tidal pool, which shows her twins, then the boy crowding out the girl until only one child remains.
quote: feeling only the presence of one child within her.

summary: Raissa's flashback vision shows her son fully grown with horns, destined to be a king, with worlds beyond Theros spinning around him.
quote: Her son would be a king!

summary: Raissa decides not to abandon her child to Setessa as most satyr women would, believing he is special and needs her.
quote: This child was special, and he would need her to fulfill the destiny she had witnessed.

summary: Years later, Raissa escapes a burning house with her six-year-old son, who set her bed alight; they have been cast out of Setessa after he pushed a council member's son to his death.
quote: He had caused them to be cast out of Setessa when he shoved the son of one of the Karametra temple's ruling council to his death from a high rope bridge among the trees.

summary: Raissa, walking without destination, wonders whether she is punished for not paying tribute to the gods, and her son strikes her head with a stick.
quote: The boy struck her in the side of her head with his stick.

summary: Raissa returns with her son to the tidal pools and finds the starfish again.
quote: Together, Raissa and her son floated into the dream.

summary: In the vision the constellations of Nyx turn on Raissa's son with outrage and lightning, and he rises to meet them on a cloud of red and green power with a gleaming staff.
quote: outrage flared in their eyes

summary: The vision ends with Raissa's son laughing, holding aloft his stick with the impaled body of the starfish on it.
quote: At the end of the stick writhed the impaled gray body of the starfish.

summary: Zosimos, walking by the woods, is overtaken by worry that he will never gain the glory and favor of the gods like other heroes.
quote: What if he died having never gained the favor of the gods?

summary: A satyr springs onto the path, tells Zosimos his mind's garden is full of weeds, and says worry is Phenax's creation that spurns Iroas.
quote: When you worry, you're actually worshipping Phenax.

summary: The satyr tells of the Underworld's coinsmiths who mint ostraka from funerary masks, and explains that Erebos equalizes everyone and forbids a return except as one of the Returned.
quote: Erebos cares little for what you were in life. He only cares that you once existed.

summary: The satyr teaches that a true hero is concerned with what he leaves behind, the flowering of goodness, rather than titles or a death mask.
quote: A hero is not concerned with a death mask or a fancy title or property, a hero is concerned with the flowering of goodness in all its forms.

summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a taste of nectarvine sap and tells him the world is good, and that a hero brings awareness of it and defends people from harm.
quote: The world is good, my boy.

summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a dull, rusty knife and warns that darkness will try to snuff out an awakened hero's light, then skips off into the woods.
quote: When a hero is awakened, all manner of things come from the darkness to snuff out the hero's light.

summary: Transformed, Zosimos leaves the path to Meletis and follows a pull toward the eastern mountains, abandoning thoughts he calls the seeds of Phenax.
quote: Now he followed his destiny.

summary: The satyr's dagger bursts into heat and light, becoming a shining sword forged by the gods.
quote: the satyr's dagger had become a shining sword forged by the gods.

summary: At a private dinner, Selvala tells the withered King Brago that he is no longer the king she remembers and that she begged him to refuse the Custodi's treatments.
quote: I begged you not to let the Custodi begin their treatments.

summary: Flashback: young Count Brago sees the potential of the City and recognizes he cannot walk the path to it alone.
quote: And he could not walk it alone.

summary: Flashback: Brago and Selvala work inseparably, build a coalition, and together draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
quote: Together, they drafted the Charter.

summary: Flashback: three years into his reign, Brago is diagnosed with an incurable hereditary illness, and he and Selvala reluctantly agree to the priests' magical preservation treatments.
quote: The Custodi were formed, and the king lived.

summary: Selvala accuses Brago of valuing his own life above those he served and says she would call any other man who spoke so a tyrant.
quote: if I heard those words from any other man's lips, I would know him to be a tyrant.

summary: Brago reveals there will be no more treatments because they have gone too far, and begs Selvala to kill him.
quote: I cannot die naturally. But I think I must die.

summary: Selvala forgives Brago and stabs him through the heart; his body crumbles to dust as he whispers that she will not, and she is escorted from the room.
quote: His ancient body began to crumble almost immediately

summary: The Custodi gather in the throne room to plan how to retain power after the king's death.
quote: The King is dead.

summary: Brago's spirit appears in a blue mist and orders the Custodi to announce that the king has risen and that their work is complete; they hail him as King Eternal.
quote: All hail Brago, King Eternal.

summary: Marchesa entertains her longtime business partner Ervos Trax at dinner in her mansion in Paliano.
quote: Marchesa was entertaining a guest and business partner from the lowlands, Ervos Trax.

summary: Ervos announces over dinner that he is going to have Marchesa killed, because his network is moving into the High City and she is his only obstacle.
quote: I think I am going to have you killed

summary: Ervos walks Marchesa through why a direct attack or poisoning would fail, noting her zombie guards, escape routes and food precautions.
quote: So, killing you through your food would be out of the question.

summary: Ervos explains the plan to corrupt a trusted lieutenant such as Pietro Lokosh, and Marchesa names him before Ervos does.
quote: Pietro Lokosh?

summary: Ervos, coughing blood, reveals that he has poisoned himself because one of them would have to die.
quote: So instead of letting you kill me, I would poison myself

summary: Marchesa admits she planned to have Ervos killed in two nights and that she will now be blamed; she praises his play.
quote: I had planned to have you killed at your secret penthouse in your sleep two nights from now.

summary: Ervos dies slumped into his plate, and Marchesa leaves to summon her butler, who has already dug a hole for the body.
quote: then slumped forward, face into his plate, dead.

summary: The Board of Senior Advisors rejects Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor after Alendis retires and elects Tulando instead.
quote: To elect Professor Tulando vice chancellor once Alendis retires.

summary: Tulando and Grinaldi discuss rumors that Muzzio serves the Black Rose, sponsors Sydri and killed Daretti.
quote: He most certainly killed Daretti.

summary: Muzzio, upset at losing the vice chancellor vote, summons his apprentice Irie to his workshop to accelerate his training.
quote: he had summoned for his apprentice, Irie.

summary: Muzzio reveals his hidden workshop containing an army of constructs and a scale model of Paliano, and Irie pretends to see it for the first time.
quote: The centerpiece of the room, surrounded by whirring noises of various machines and the iron army, was a scale model of Paliano

summary: Muzzio denies ever having killed anyone and reveals that his constructs record everything people say onto wax cylinders.
quote: Within each of the constructs is a series of needles that transcribes all that they hear onto wax cylinders

summary: Muzzio explains his grand design to mitigate human variables and says the vice chancellorship would have given him the autonomy for the next phase; Brago's death and seeming ascension made the board cautious.
quote: But the death of Brago and his seeming ascension, which I couldn't foresee, caused them to vote more cautiously.

summary: Muzzio's constructs erase Professor Emralla's money and registration of her estate, leaving her facing eviction.
quote: Professor Emralla found that the bank no longer had record of her money.

summary: Tulando finds forged papers framing him for embezzlement and dealings with Ervos Trax on his breakfast table, and resigns within the hour.
quote: He resigned less than an hour later.

summary: A construct records Chancellor Grinaldi's affair and an envelope exposing it is left for his wife, forcing him to leave his position.
quote: The chancellor was forced to leave his position to fix his personal life.

summary: With the others gone, the board carries Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor once Alendis becomes chancellor.
quote: Resolved: motion carried

summary: Diantha brings the Oracle of Kruphix her meal in Meletis and the oracle says Kruphix once spirited her away to his true temple.
quote: When I was in danger, Kruphix spirited me away to his temple.

summary: Flashback: from Kruphix's Temple, Kydele watches Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, use Godsend to cut him from the sky.
quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.

summary: Flashback: Heliod snatches Godsend from Elspeth and murders her with it, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.
quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

summary: Kydele feels dead inside and finds that Kruphix, who had spoken to her constantly, has fallen silent since Heliod's betrayal.
quote: But since Heliod's act of betrayal, the voice of her god had fallen silent.

summary: Kruphix speaks to Kydele, who asks whether what happened was good and why it feels wrong.
quote: does it all feel so wrong?

summary: Kruphix tells Kydele that the gods are beliefs that took form in Nyx, that Heliod was not always the sun god and that gods depend on mortals believing they are unchanging.
quote: The gods are beliefs that took form within the fabric of Nyx.

summary: Kruphix warns her that knowledge is cruel; Kydele insists she wants to know, and they walk to the edge of the world.
quote: they came to the edge of the world itself

summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

summary: Kruphix explains that Xenagos traveled to godless worlds and tried to show everyone the gods were a lie, but people saw only chaos and he threatened nothing.
quote: decided everyone on Theros should know the gods were a lie.

summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

summary: Back in Meletis, the oracle tells Diantha she learned nothing to share, and gazes into the distance.
quote: There is nothing. Nothing at all.

summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

summary: Nissa wakes in a tent, where Hamadi tells her the Joraga are no more.
quote: I'm sorry, but from what we saw, the Joraga are no more.

summary: Hamadi calls Nissa 'Shaya' as they climb a mountain together.
quote: I think highly of your will, Shaya,

summary: Hamadi tells Nissa how his people of Graypelt were destroyed by the Eldrazi, and Nissa, overcome by guilt, apologizes.
quote: She was responsible for all of it, all his loss and all of Zendikar's devastation.

summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

summary: Nissa frees herself and rides vines down to the ground to fight the Pathrazer, which crushes several travelers.
quote: Before anyone could act, the Pathrazer had grabbed several of the expedition and crushed them in its tentacled hand.

summary: Khali and Sha'heel snare the Pathrazer with ropes while Nissa pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
quote: the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

summary: Hamadi tells Nissa that Zendikar has chosen her and that Shaya means Worldwaker.
quote: It means 'Worldwaker.'

summary: Liliana arrives on Shandalar, tormented by the Chain Veil's voices, and heads for the Onakke catacomb she has visited before.
quote: all she could hear was the veil.

summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, and her earlier ill-fated visit to learn of the Onakke.
quote: Instead of bringing it back to him like a good little retriever, she'd used its power to kill him.

summary: Liliana recalls her first visit, when she killed her horse's attacker and used the veil to infect Garruk with shadow, after which he hunted her to Innistrad.
quote: She'd used it to infect him with shadow, polluting his nature magic with the touch of death.

summary: At the catacomb Liliana kills a guarding angel, who warns her of the Onakke and that she is a vessel.
quote: She punctuated her words with a killing wave of raw necromantic power that flayed flesh from the angel's bones

summary: Liliana's tattoos bleed as the Onakke voices fall silent, and she sees a vision of the Onakke city in which a purplish cloud obliterates the ogres.
quote: A cascade of meteors streaked across the sky as the Onakke were utterly obliterated before her eyes.

summary: Liliana tries to return the Chain Veil to its altar but cannot let go of it.
quote: She tried to open her hand, to let the thing drop, but her fingers wouldn't obey her will.

summary: Liliana raises an Onakke skeleton to take the veil, but it will not leave and she destroys it; the veil ends up hanging from her arm.
quote: She stared at the veil in horror as bones clattered to the floor all around her.

summary: An Onakke spirit calls her vessel and tells her the root planted when she killed her brother will bloom into destruction; it also says she acts to avoid following Josu into the void.
quote: Everything you've done has been to avoid following Josu into the void.

summary: Liliana drains the Chain Veil's power to extinguish the Onakke spirit at great pain but still cannot drop the veil.
quote: And like a snuffed candle flame, the spirit vanished.

summary: Liliana leaves Shandalar, still carrying the veil and its whispers, fearing she has taken into herself the thing she spent her life avoiding.
quote: she wondered if she had taken into herself the one thing she had spent her whole life trying to avoid.

summary: Jalira and Yisan, both trying to rob a rambling Thunian man warning of the skep, compete over their mark in the market of Lesh.
quote: The soothsayer, however, was so enamored by the coin that he failed to see his audience was in contention.

summary: Guard commander Dexros tries to arrest Jalira and Yisan; Yisan spooks the guards' horses with a hummed tune and Jalira turns the thrown guards into frogs, and they flee.
quote: The guards transformed into tiny blue frogs, their empty clothes falling around them.

summary: Outside the city, Yisan reads the stolen book, the journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, revealing a sliver hive with abandoned treasure; Jalira decides to go.
quote: But contained within the notes were reports of dead merchants and travelers in the deepest parts of the sliver network

summary: Yisan and Jalira journey through the Kalonian Forest, fending off corrupted beasts and avoiding Talrand's aerial patrols.
quote: Neither counted the drake summoner as a friend for a variety of differing reasons

summary: They find the sliver cave and Jalira, over Yisan's objections, uses blue smoke on them.
quote: Blue smoke began to flow from Jalira's fingertips.

summary: Jalira and Yisan, transformed into slivers, fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum and will of the hivelord.
quote: They lose each other, forgetting who they are.

summary: They reach the central chamber where the hivelord drops their sliver forms, and, naked, take clothing and treasure while the hivelord does nothing.
quote: slowly procured as many coins and treasures as they and their pilfered clothes could carry

summary: Yisan decides to stay and study the slivers' music while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
quote: I think I'm going to stay here for a while,

summary: Vronos shoots a woman in a village and orders the villagers' corpses burned, saving the children.
quote: Vronos issued his orders: some to heap the corpses in the village square

summary: Flashback: Vronos remembers his sister burned to purify her soul, after which the Order of the Silver Heron raised him in the cathedral crèche.
quote: They had taken him to the crèche within the cathedral where the children of the cleansed were raised by the Order of the Silver Heron.

summary: That night wolf-like child werewolves ambush Vronos's camp and kill his troops; he realizes the village children were not innocent.
quote: There were no innocents.

summary: Vronos is swarmed by the werewolves and the world goes dark; he next stands in an unknown place.
quote: The world went dark.

summary: Vronos finds himself among the Ethersworn vedalken, who first judge him imperfect and then value him as a new planeswalker.
quote: This one might be of value.

summary: Vronos studies etherium and the Twenty-Three Texts with the Ethersworn, repairs his face with an etherium infix and mask, and learns to planeswalk and track other planeswalkers.
quote: he honed his planeswalking skill and discovered how to track others like himself by the faint trails they left in the Æther.

summary: Vronos returns as a penitent and Avacyn forgives him, accepting his renewed pledge.
quote: She kissed her maimed servant's brow and spoke words of forgiveness and understanding.

summary: Vronos becomes the Gray Fencer, first of the masked cathars, and accepts that the hunter cannot pity.
quote: Combatting evil meant hardening the heart. The hunter cannot pity.

summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

summary: Vronos confronts the corrupted Garruk and is overwhelmed by his beasts, then wounded in the shoulder by his thrown axe.
quote: Garruk had simply hurled his weapon.

summary: Vronos flees by planeswalking to a cave and treats his wound with a poultice.
quote: He fled into the void, his enemy howling curses behind him.

summary: Vronos kills a doe for sustenance; Garruk finds him and swings his axe as Vronos bows his head.
quote: The axe whistled down. Vronos bowed his head.
