summary: Flashback: An unnamed Planeswalker watches from the Boros garrison, overhears Ral and Jace's plan, and learns that the Living Guildpact is a Planeswalker.
quote: The Living Guildpact was a Planeswalker. That much was certain.

summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

summary: Nissa wakes from a vision of a black knot choking a stream of living light, in her bed at home.
quote: Nissa awoke with a start, screaming and gasping for breath.

summary: Nissa overhears Numa tell her mother he must send them away because of her visions.
quote: "I have no choice, Meroe. I cannot risk Zendikar's retribution. I'm sorry. Truly, I am."

summary: Nissa slips away from camp at night, hiding her trail so the horror will find only her.
quote: she would not lead the horror to those she loved.

summary: A shimmering stream like the one in her vision appears and wraps around Nissa like a cocoon; she connects with Zendikar's soul.
quote: Nissa Revane connected with Zendikar.

summary: Nissa's vision shows a glowing version of herself facing the dark knot in a mountain before a bright light consumes all.
quote: a bright light blasted through the whole vision

summary: Mazik finds Nissa and reveals he followed her with her mother's knowledge; Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain and wants her help.
quote: Zendikar isn't after me.

summary: Nissa and Mazik follow the stream out of the forest and across the canyons, running short of water.
quote: Together, they followed the stream of glowing light deeper into the forest.

summary: Vampires attack in the bog and Nissa leads Mazik to flight along the stream, but Mazik is separated and trapped in a tree.
quote: Five vampiric horrors loped after them.

summary: Nissa unexpectedly summons a huge land elemental, controls it, and kills the vampire leader with vines.
quote: they pierced the vampire straight through his heart.

summary: Nissa practices her new powers while crossing the foothills of Akoum.
quote: Mazik encouraged Nissa to practice using her new powers.

summary: The glowing stream vanishes and the Roil strikes, shaking the land violently.
quote: "The Roil! It's happening!"

summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

summary: Zendikar forms an elemental from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the dark knot.
quote: a fully formed elemental stepped out of the earth.

summary: At the ring of floating hedrons around the highest peak, Mazik falls ill and Nissa must go on alone.
quote: "I want you to go. I'll be okay. We'll be okay."

summary: Nissa channels Zendikar's power in a massive blast at the mountain but it has no effect.
quote: it was as though her spell had done nothing.

summary: The dark knot's madness shows Nissa the monster inside, and her spark ignites, hurling her from Zendikar.
quote: something inside her cracked, like an egg breaking open

summary: Nissa lands on Lorwyn and sees the coming blight in a vision.
quote: Lorwyn, it called itself.

summary: Nissa is found by the elves of the blight hunt led by Dwynen and joins the hunt.
quote: Take up your blade and prove yourself.

summary: Galed kills boggarts despite Nissa's pleas, and Nissa feels one die.
quote: And then she felt it die.

summary: Nissa turns her blade on Galed and Dwynen turns on her, just as Shadowmoor arrives.
quote: How dare you come to my forest and tell me what I can do?

summary: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor sweeps over Lorwyn and transforms Dwynen as she is about to shoot Nissa.
quote: Dwynen was paralyzed, caught in the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor.

summary: Nissa resists a voice tempting her to stay and, chanting Zendikar, steps through the void and follows a thread home.
quote: It pulled her with great force through the tear in the fabric of Lorwyn and out into the void.

summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
quote: Hedron connected with boney faceplate.

summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

summary: Flashback: Gideon and Dars watch Foundry Street burn in a goblin gang war that began with Dargig's murder.
quote: It was the Shattergang way of declaring war.

summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

summary: A canister lands in the garrison with a note from the Shattergang Brothers threatening Boros territory unless Krenko is handed over.
quote: Turn him over to us, or we will reduce Boros territory to rubble.

summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

summary: Gideon storms the Shattergang hideout, fights Rikkig and survives his bomb; Rikkig escapes while Gideon and Dars free prisoners.
quote: "The Boros didn't take Krenko. I did. Just like I got your brother. And now I'm here for you."

summary: The Eldrazi overwhelm Sea Gate and pin Gideon under a beam until he frees himself.
quote: the Eldrazi swept in from both sides of the sea wall.

summary: Gideon meets the merfolk Jori En carrying her dead companion Kendrin, who had been on the brink of a discovery about leylines and the Eye.
quote: Kendrin was on the brink of a discovery.

summary: Gideon concludes Sea Gate is lost and that Kendrin's leylines puzzle is a possible answer, and he needs another expert.
quote: Fighting to avoid something was not the same as fighting for something.

summary: Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall into the sea, then planeswalks to Ravnica.
quote: In a tangle of tendrils, Gideon fell with it.

summary: Gideon arrives in Ravnica at the Chamber of the Guildpact, intending to ask Jace for help, and collapses on the steps.
quote: Gideon ascended the first step, tried for another, but gravity had him, and he collapsed.

summary: Jace finishes a day of tedious petitions as the Living Guildpact and returns to his secret apartments.
quote: "Guildpact," said Lavinia. He turned. "Get some rest."

summary: Jace is surprised to see Liliana knocking at his secret door via the teleportal, and uses an illusion to greet her.
quote: Jace hadn't seen Liliana Vess since the day he'd realized she was playing him

summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."

summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

summary: Liliana admits she hoped they could start over, and Jace plays along, agreeing to dinner.
quote: I guess I was hoping we could … start over.

summary: Jace and Liliana dine at Milena's, where she shows him the Chain Veil and he cannot take it.
quote: you can't take it, even if I wanted you to.

summary: Gideon, bloodied from battle, interrupts dinner and asks Jace for help with Zendikar.
quote: "Jace Beleren," he said. "I need your help."

summary: Gideon tells Jace Sea Gate has fallen and asks him to solve the puzzle of leylines.
quote: "Sea Gate has fallen."

summary: Jace admits to himself he inadvertently released the Eldrazi.
quote: Inadvertently released them from millennia of imprisonment to terrorize Zendikar

summary: Liliana storms out when Jace agrees to go with Gideon, refusing his invitation to come along.
quote: "You're out of your mind," she said. "I've got demons to kill."

summary: Jace agrees to help Gideon, insisting he rest first, and takes him to a healer.
quote: "Fine," Gideon said at last. "Take me to this healer."

summary: Liliana walks Ravnica's Second District, hearing the Onakke voices and brooding that Jace chose to help Gideon instead of her.
quote: But he hadn't. Instead, he had agreed to help Gideon.

summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand and being unable to leave it behind.
quote: It was bound to her, and her to it.

summary: Liliana is drawn into a courtyard of ravens and confronts the Raven Man.
quote: the Raven Man stepped forward from their midst

summary: The Raven Man warns Liliana that death is coming for her, citing the demons, the Veil, Garruk and even Jace.
quote: But death is coming for you, Lili.

summary: Liliana blasts the Raven Man in a flare of magic, then raises the dead ravens as zombies that tear his reformed flock apart and drive him away.
quote: The bird in her hand squirmed and wriggled free, now a tiny zombie bound to her will.

summary: Liliana sees blood where her demonic contract lines fade, realizes she is trapped, and planeswalks away.
quote: she pulled open a door between worlds.

summary: Chandra and the fire monks chant and dance in a lava field, but Serenok scolds her for not joining the spell properly.
quote: "The spell will fail if you don't participate."

summary: A hellion bursts from the lava field and attacks the monks.
quote: Something gigantic burst forth from the lava bed.

summary: Chandra climbs the hellion, tricks it into biting its own armor, and has the monks unleash their fire at her, weaving it into a spike that drives the hellion off.
quote: she wove the strands of fire together into a needle-sharp streak of blindingly hot fire.

summary: Serenok tells Chandra she is ready and that she is Jaya.
quote: You're ready. You're her .

summary: Mother Luti wakes Chandra to tell her Serenok is dead.
quote: "Chandra. Serenok is dead."

summary: Serenok's memorial is held outside Keral Keep and Chandra, grieving, walks into the mountains.
quote: She walked away from the Keep, deeper into the mountains.

summary: Luti presents Serenok's mantle and reveals the monks have chosen Chandra as the new abbot.
quote: "I'm here to tell you we've already chosen one."

summary: Chandra initially refuses to be abbot, then wavers when Luti repeats Serenok's phrase about the perfect challenge.
quote: Then, as Serenok was fond of saying, this will be the perfect challenge for you,

summary: Gideon and Jace burst into the chamber as Chandra considers accepting the mantle.
quote: "It's good to see you, Chandra," said Gideon Jura. "We need your help."

summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to join them against the Eldrazi, and Jace reminds her of her responsibility for Zendikar's state.
quote: You have a hand in Zendikar's current state.

summary: Chandra tells them to go, saying she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise.
quote: "I belong here. I've made a promise."

summary: Gideon and Jace planeswalk away, and Chandra walks up the steps toward Mother Luti and the mantle.
quote: Chandra nodded to Mother Luti, and walked up the steps toward her.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

summary: Nissa names the elemental Ashaya, the Awoken World, after Hamadi's name for her.
quote: "Okay then, Ashaya it is," Nissa said.

summary: Nissa questions why Zendikar chose her again after she failed the first time, and Ashaya repeats its confusing gesture.
quote: I failed. Last time you chose me, I failed.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya hear screams and see Eldrazi attacking a small encampment.
quote: "There!" Nissa pointed.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya crush the first Eldrazi, fight the tentacled one and cripple it, but the third carries off the kor, who is consumed.
quote: the Eldrazi consumed the kor's life, turning her still, pale body into dust.

summary: A vampire consoles Nissa, reveals he knows her name and her spark, and tells her the world is ending.
quote: "That is fair considering your history with vampires, Nissa."

summary: The vampire offers four seeds from Anowon, including the last bloodbriar of Bala Ged, asking Nissa to take them to another plane.
quote: "Kolya, red mangrove, jaddi, bloodbriar."

summary: Nissa takes the seeds as the vampire argues no effort can beat the titans; Ashaya watches, and the vampire vanishes.
quote: She took the seeds.

summary: Mimicking Ashaya's gesture, Nissa sees glowing leylines stream from her fingers and understands Zendikar did not choose her but she is one with it.
quote: These were the leylines

summary: Nissa realizes she was never chosen or alone but one with Zendikar and cries 'For Zendikar!', charging into the forest bonded to the land.
quote: "For Zendikar!" she cried

summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the one-tentacled Eldrazi with a spear of land and a punch from Ashaya.
quote: The horror let out a final deflating chitter as it collapsed.

summary: Nissa rides Ashaya and calls an army of baloth-sized elementals as they hunt an Eldrazi titan.
quote: an army of baloth-sized elementals took shape.

summary: Gideon and Jace arrive at Vorik's camp and find slaughter and Eldrazi corruption everywhere.
quote: They stepped into carnage.

summary: Gideon defends Jace from a pack of Eldrazi spawn and arms him with a sword.
quote: Gideon leaped between the Eldrazi and Jace.

summary: Gideon charges through hundreds of Eldrazi to reach a barricade of survivors and gets Jace over the wall.
quote: Gideon bellowed, "Zendikar!" and charged.

summary: Jace's telekinesis saves him from Eldrazi spawn.
quote: knocked back by what must have been a telekinetic blow.

summary: Gideon learns from a kor soldier that only a few dozen survive under Commander Vorik.
quote: The woman shook her head. "A few dozen."

summary: Gideon sends Jace with the soldiers to find Jori En and holds the wall alone.
quote: look for a merfolk named Jori En.

summary: Gideon kills a huge Ulamog-like Eldrazi with two heads by punching the smaller head and severing both.
quote: the Eldrazi fell dead to the ground.

summary: Gideon collapses the walls of a gap to block the Eldrazi and rejoins the survivors.
quote: he had created a defensive wall.

summary: Jace reports that Jori En never reached the camp and may be trapped in Sea Gate.
quote: He thinks Jori En was among them

summary: Gideon meets Tazri and the wounded Vorik, who says the survivors have nowhere to run.
quote: "Yes," Vorik said flatly. "We could have used you."

summary: Gideon proposes moving the survivors up onto the floating hedrons, and Vorik agrees.
quote: "Fine," Vorik said. "Lead the way."

summary: Gideon, Tazri and the kor lead the wounded survivors up ropes onto the hedrons.
quote: They made the ascent with no complaints, no missteps, and no further injuries.

summary: Gideon sees Sea Gate's corruption from the hedron and resolves to go look for Jori En, leaving Jace to study the hedrons.
quote: And I'll find Jori En and bring her back here.

summary: Jace admits he trusts Gideon, and Gideon climbs down toward Sea Gate.
quote: "I have to do this," he told himself, gripping the rope.

summary: Ashaya relays a distress call from Fartree Hamlet, and Nissa and Ashaya rush to help, finding three Eldrazi instead of two.
quote: But the chatter was wrong; there were three Eldrazi, not two.

summary: Nissa chooses to attack the twin Eldrazi at the hamlet first, planning to reach the heart trees after.
quote: "We have to give the most help we can give,"

summary: Nissa and Ashaya rescue the humans from the treehouses by bending a tree and shielding them with a wall of land.
quote: Nissa pulled on the tree, urging it to bend to her.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the first twin Eldrazi by snapping the tree into its faceplate and gutting it.
quote: Its limbs went limp, and then the monstrous thing teetered back and crashed to the forest floor.

summary: Nissa rips the second twin apart with root tentacles and saves the humans from its falling body.
quote: carried the people back and away as the Eldrazi struck the ground.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya arrive too late at the thicket, where the Eldrazi has killed all but two heart trees, and then kill it.
quote: The monster was both killed and buried in the same stroke.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya promise the last heart tree that Zendikar will fight on, and they press on in pursuit of the titan.
quote: Zendikar would fight back.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya are struck by terrible pain as the connection to Zendikar is torn away, and Ashaya collapses and shatters.
quote: Nissa watched as Ashaya's branches snapped and shattered on the ground.

summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

summary: A wounded merfolk saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi.
quote: It was a merfolk, one clad in thick, sharp armor made of seashells.

summary: Nissa carries Jori En and fights with her sword, but without Zendikar's help she is pinned by an Eldrazi.
quote: She pulled on her arm with her all, but the tentacle was too heavy.

summary: Kor on a floating rock rescue Nissa and Jori with hooked ropes.
quote: The next moment the tentacle was pulled off of her

summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

summary: Gideon and Jori reunite, and he leads the survivors across floating rocks to a nearby encampment.
quote: "Jori En!" The Planeswalker cried out

summary: Nissa tells Gideon her connection to Zendikar was ripped away, but Gideon says his power is unchanged.
quote: "Mine is gone. It was ripped away.

summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.
quote: Zendikar was empty.

summary: Jace meets Jori En, who offers her knowledge of the hedron research, and Jace reads her mind instead.
quote: "I have a better idea, if you're amenable."

summary: Jace sees Jori's memories of Kendrin's team and her death to the Eldrazi.
quote: She had died to the Eldrazi slaughter before she could pass on enough of what she knew.

summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

summary: Jace and Jori set out for the Eye without Gideon and discuss whether Jace changed her mind or Gideon's.
quote: They rode out from the encampment—without Gideon.

summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

summary: The kor woman Ayli rescues them, killing the hurda as bait, and leads them into a chasm.
quote: sliced through the hurda's neck with one of the sharp hooks.

summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

summary: Jace uses an illusion to make the Pilgrims believe they are on fire, and he and Jori escape.
quote: "Stop," said Jace, and the man burst into flames.

summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

summary: Jace alters Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, and she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him.
quote: "God damn it, Jace."

summary: Gideon and Abeena haul a floating waterfall over Sky Rock to give the survivors fresh water.
quote: A final yank heaved the waterfall straight over Sky Rock.

summary: Tazri accuses Gideon of wasting time and of waiting for Jace, and Gideon admits he is not from Zendikar.
quote: "You're right. I'm not from this world."

summary: Seble flies Gideon to intercept a flying Eldrazi pursuing a party of refugees, and Gideon kills it after being thrown from the manta.
quote: he drove the Eldrazi straight into the ground

summary: Gideon concludes the people cannot survive an evacuation to Zulaport and must stay.
quote: They had to stay. If they wanted to survive, they had to stay here.

summary: A group of refugees insists that Sea Gate is Zendikar's only hope, and Tazri tells them it is gone.
quote: "Sea Gate is Zendikar's only hope."

summary: Gideon argues before the dying Vorik for retaking Sea Gate instead of evacuating to Zulaport.
quote: "I would have us go back to Sea Gate."

summary: Vorik names Gideon Commander-General of the Zendikari and tells Tazri to support him.
quote: You will reclaim Sea Gate, Commander-General Jura.

summary: Vorik dies, entrusting Zendikar to Gideon.
quote: "I leave Zendikar to you, Gideon."

summary: At Vorik's funeral Gideon rallies the survivors to fight back and retake Sea Gate rather than flee.
quote: We can choose to fight back.

summary: Tazri pledges to fight beside Gideon, and the crowd cries 'For Zendikar!'
quote: "For Zendikar, Commander, I will battle too."

summary: Drana surveys her refugees fleeing the Eldrazi host across Guul Draz.
quote: There in the midst of the host was the enormous Eldrazi sire

summary: A hundred kor on kitesails arrive from Tazeem, and Drana decides to welcome them.
quote: "Welcome. They come to join us at the end of the world. We will be accommodating."

summary: Enkindi, sent by Gideon, invites Drana's army to join Gideon's stand at Sea Gate.
quote: "Win. We can win. Many of you are still strong. We know what you can do in battle. Join us."

summary: Drana shows Enkindi the Orphans' Brigade of children and proposes he fight with her first before she goes to Sea Gate.
quote: I'll leave with you to fight with Gideon at Sea Gate, if you and your warriors fight with me first.

summary: The vampires, mortals and kor battle the three Eldrazi hosts, with the sire as the key target.
quote: Mortal and vampire alike met the initial onslaught with a fierce savagery.

summary: Drana orders the Orphans' Brigade toward the sire as bait; Enkindi calls her a monster but leads his kor at the sire.
quote: The children will serve as necessary bait to lure the sire where we need it to be.

summary: Enkindi is killed by the Eldrazi sire and the kor are slaughtered.
quote: Enkindi's headless corpse, still attached to its broken kitesail, plummeted uselessly to the ground.

summary: Drana bores into the sire's heart and drinks its energy, recovering memories of her origin as a creature of Ulamog.
quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

summary: The Eldrazi energy overwhelms Drana, but she reasserts herself with 'I serve no one' and consumes the energy.
quote: I serve no one! I will be free!

summary: Drana releases the Eldrazi energy as a magenta sun that heals her army and destroys the Eldrazi, then collapses.
quote: I belong to no one . . . but they belong to me.

summary: Drana orders her survivors to cross to Tazeem to Sea Gate, having learned the Eldrazi have somewhere to go back to.
quote: "Make preparations to cross to Tazeem. We are going to Sea Gate."

summary: Nissa keeps vigil each twilight at the bluff where Zendikar was torn from her, finding only emptiness.
quote: She kept vigil there, returning each day to ground herself

summary: Nissa recalls that Gideon and Jace did not understand her account of Zendikar's lost soul.
quote: She had told them that something horrible had happened to Zendikar's soul.

summary: A fleeing goblin warns Nissa of a swarm of Eldrazi, and Nissa fights them with only her sword to protect the clearing.
quote: She stepped forward to stand between the precious piece of land and the monsters.

summary: Nissa nearly planeswalks away from the swarm but refuses because it would mean it was over.
quote: But leaving would mean that it was over.

summary: Munda arrives and helps kill the swarm, and Nissa joins him in tracking the goblin.
quote: a hook on a chain rushed past her and plunged into one of the Eldrazi

summary: Munda tells Nissa about Gideon's army and his plan to retake Sea Gate; Nissa silently disagrees with 'taking back' Zendikar.
quote: As one, we'll reclaim Sea Gate.

summary: Nissa and Munda find Pili at a hidden cave where a group of goblins is trapped, and free them; Leek is dead.
quote: Three bodies were lined up against the wall.

summary: Pili grieves for Leek, and Nissa comforts her.
quote: Nissa had never hugged a goblin before.

summary: Pili's insistence that she knew inspires Nissa to realize Zendikar's soul may have retreated to Khalni Heart.
quote: If something had happened, if the titan had threatened the world's soul, that's where it would have run to.

summary: Nissa slips away from the goblins and planeswalks to Bala Ged to find Zendikar.
quote: Nissa planeswalked away—back home, back to Bala Ged, to find Zendikar.

summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

summary: Kiora planeswalks to Zendikar still clutching Thassa's bident, which dries to coral.
quote: There, still clutched tightly in both hands, was the weapon of a god.

summary: Kiora finds a beach of grey Eldrazi dust and senses dead places across the sea.
quote: Eldrazi in the oceans!

summary: Kiora finds an altar to the Three in a cave and spits in Ula's face before sleeping beneath Cosi's statue.
quote: And she spit in Ula's blank, stupid face.

summary: Kiora uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees.
quote: A vortex formed near one of the Eldrazi, sending it tumbling.

summary: Kiora reunites with her sister Turi, who tells her Kozilek and Emrakul have not been seen for months and that Ulamog is at Sea Gate.
quote: "No one's seen him in months," she said.

summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

summary: Kiora tells a Cosi story about a mortal who steals Ula's spear, calling a wave that parts around the merfolk.
quote: A great wave broke over and around her

summary: Kiora promises Turi she will return, and half a dozen of Cosi's devotees follow her on a serpent toward Sea Gate.
quote: And half a dozen of the merfolk quietly came and stood beside her.

summary: Nissa arrives on Bala Ged and finds it entirely consumed by white corruption.
quote: The land wasn't ruined—it had been entirely consumed.

summary: Nissa walks to the site of her old village and is overwhelmed by memories of her past self and her departure.
quote: She wouldn't be that elf again, she couldn't be.

summary: Nissa instinctively kills a gomazoa-like Eldrazi and realizes it must have fed on life, leading her toward Khalni Heart.
quote: She quartered the monstrosity so quickly

summary: Following the Eldrazi's trail to a surrakar cave, Nissa finds a moss-lined tunnel.
quote: she saw the first sign of life.

summary: Nissa finds a ring of hedrons imprisoning the wilted Khalni Heart and realizes someone uprooted Zendikar's soul.
quote: someone had uprooted the land's soul and trapped it here to die.

summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
quote: "Was it Nahiri?"

summary: Nissa unleashes her wild essence to reflect the demon's life-draining blast.
quote: Suddenly, the full force of Nissa's essence came rushing back to her

summary: The demon reveals he plans to seize Khalni Heart's power, and Nissa breaks a hedron to open the prison.
quote: the massive rock shattered.

summary: Nissa touches Khalni Heart but the demon traps her and tells her to planeswalk away.
quote: "If you want to live, now is the time to planeswalk away."

summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

summary: Nissa drives a fist of land into the demon and rises with Ashaya, who returns as her friend.
quote: Nissa rose up, and so too did the world's soul, her friend.

summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

summary: Jace climbs a cliff in Akoum in search of the Tuktuk goblins and hauls himself over the lip straight into an Eldrazi.
quote: —and straight into an Eldrazi.

summary: Jace's illusion fails against the Eldrazi, but Zada kills it with a blow from her pestle after a flash of blue light.
quote: just as a heavy club came down on its blank white head.

summary: Zada reveals she ground up a hedron to fuel her spell and tells Jace that hedrons hold magic.
quote: A hedron holds magic for a thousand years,

summary: Zada says Tuktuk is dead because she ate him, as goblins eat magic rocks to grow stronger.
quote: "I ate him," said Zada.

summary: Zada agrees to lead Jace to the Eye of Ugin, noting the hedron network has no center now.
quote: But I suppose I'll show you the way, if you think it's important,

summary: Zada leaves Jace at a cave entrance, warning that nobody goes in.
quote: Nobody goes in there. Bad magic. Certain death. Good luck!

summary: Jace descends into the ruined Eye of Ugin and sees a glow ahead and the stones growing orderly.
quote: the stones around him became more orderly

summary: A dragon unfolds from the shadows; Jace fears it is Bolas, but it introduces itself as Ugin, builder of the Eye.
quote: My name is Ugin. I helped build this place, long ago.

summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

summary: Jace and Ugin argue over whether the hedrons can be relied on again, and Ugin insists the earlier release was orchestrated.
quote: It was not an accident,

summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
quote: The hedron network as it stands,

summary: Jace counters Ugin's illusion with scenes of Sea Gate and of Zendikar's suffering people, insisting Zendikar is somebody's home.
quote: Zendikar isn't a puzzle to be solved,

summary: Jace understands a circular glyph with three points that the leylines could be coaxed into forming.
quote: A glyph—circular, with three points at equal intervals around the circumference.

summary: Ugin says he is here to save the Multiverse, not the people of Zendikar.
quote: With the Eldrazi at large, the entire Multiverse is at risk.

summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

summary: Jace privately realizes the hedrons might pull the Eldrazi fully into the physical realm so they could be killed, and keeps the idea to himself.
quote: You could pull him into the pond.

summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi brood are connected to the titans like cells or organs, so killing them achieves nothing.
quote: More like cells,

summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

summary: Jace agrees but privately resolves to proceed his own way, and leaves the Eye with a plan.
quote: He had a plan. He had a destination. He was ready.

summary: Noyan Dar leads his initiates at Coralhelm in a deliberately dissonant litany meant to teach them to heighten the Roil.
quote: "Balance is death!"

summary: A kitesailer's harness shears off in an updraft and his passenger falls hundreds of feet.
quote: his passenger plummeted to the ground hundreds of feet below.

summary: The falling man survives the impact in a flash of golden light and introduces himself as Gideon Jura, looking for Noyan.
quote: I'm Gideon Jura. I'm looking for the roilmage, Noyan Dar.

summary: Gideon asks for the roilmages' help at Sea Gate; Noyan objects that they are not elementalists and are in training.
quote: We need your help at Sea Gate.

summary: Noyan explains through the story of Ula and the sneeze that the Roil is the world's natural defense against the Eldrazi.
quote: The Roil built up over time as a natural defense against the presence of the Eldrazi.

summary: Llura leads the full litany, and Gideon, doubting the roilmages, is moved to say this may not have been a good idea.
quote: Maybe . . . maybe this was not a good idea,

summary: Angered, Noyan insists on a practical demonstration, and the group travels to Tazeem to find an Eldrazi herd.
quote: "A practical demonstration is in order," Noyan said. "I insist."

summary: The Eldrazi swarm toward Gideon and Noyan while the initiates spread in a wide circle.
quote: The Eldrazi slowly began swarming in the direction of Gideon and Noyan

summary: The initiates work the circle while Noyan gathers irritation into the Roil as Gideon holds the Eldrazi at bay.
quote: the large circle of earth surrounding Gideon and Noyan began to rotate in one direction and then the other.

summary: Noyan unleashes the Roil, collapsing the ground into a chasm that kills the Eldrazi horde and drops Gideon with it.
quote: Noyan cast his spell.

summary: Gideon survives the fall, apologizes for his doubt and asks the roilmages to join the defense of Sea Gate.
quote: I am sorry, Noyan, for any doubt. That display was amazing.

summary: Noyan agrees that the roilmages will come to Sea Gate the next day.
quote: We will be there.

summary: Noyan realizes Gideon's last question about Cosi and Ula was a hint that he had been manipulated by his own pride.
quote: Noyan Dar's elation turned into a very flat stare.

summary: The army descends from the hedrons of Emeria, and Gideon leads its first march on Sea Gate with a shout of "For Zendikar!"
quote: He shouted, "For Zendikar!" and a deafening roar came in answer.

summary: Gideon leads a headlong charge against Eldrazi spawn and larger Eldrazi near Sea Gate, while many soldiers die.
quote: The spawn fell quickly under the initial charge

summary: Gideon recalls losing his Irregulars on Theros and fears he is again leading people to their deaths.
quote: So many of the Zendikari were dying.

summary: Cut off from his army, Gideon joins Munda, who tells him the army cannot win that day.
quote: "We're not going to win this," Munda said. "Not today."

summary: Gideon orders a retreat, which turns into a rout as the army dissolves, leaving Gideon, Munda and a few soldiers to hold off the Eldrazi.
quote: The ordered retreat turned into a rout.

summary: Tazri sounds a horn to rally the survivors, and the army regroups at camp as the sun sets.
quote: As the sun touched the horizon, the army of Zendikar was coming back together.

summary: Tazri tells Gideon the battle was a disaster because he led from the front and gave his army no plan or strategy.
quote: They need to know how they fit into the army and the overall plan of attack.

summary: Gideon realizes he has failed his commanders as well as his army and takes Tazri and Munda to work out a plan.
quote: "Walk with me, Tazri," he said.

summary: Over several days Gideon meets with the commanders and builds a plan that gives every contingent a role.
quote: Over the next few days, a plan came together.

summary: The army marches again in organized ranks to the beat of a conch-shell drum, with Noyan Dar's roilmages held back.
quote: They marched.

summary: A scout reports a fleet of sea monsters swimming toward Sea Gate and leaving Eldrazi remains behind them, and Gideon takes them for allies.
quote: "Allies, then," Gideon said. "At least for now."

summary: At dusk the army retreats in a planned maneuver and Drana's vampires take the front ranks, fighting through the night.
quote: But the maneuver went off without incident.

summary: Kiora appears on the tentacle of an enormous octopus and introduces herself, claiming command of her own army and the city.
quote: "I am Kiora," the merfolk said.

summary: Kiora summons a wave and her sea creatures tear into the Eldrazi, announcing the battle of Sea Gate has begun.
quote: The ocean churned as sharks and whales, serpents and krakens, tore into the Eldrazi.

summary: On the fourth day the army reaches the outer wall and then surges through it into Sea Gate.
quote: the army of Zendikar surged through the wall and entered Sea Gate.

summary: In the streets of the city the army's elves, goblins, kitesailers and eel-riders each play their role against the Eldrazi.
quote: That meant it was time to let other forces do what they did best.

summary: Elementals of tree and stone march through Sea Gate crushing the Eldrazi, and Gideon sees that Nissa has returned bringing Zendikar with her.
quote: Nissa had returned. And she had indeed brought Zendikar with her.

summary: The tide turns, and the Zendikari drive the Eldrazi out of the city.
quote: And the Zendikari had the upper hand. They were going to win!

summary: Fighting stops and Gideon sees from the lighthouse that the army has reclaimed Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
quote: But Sea Gate was theirs.

summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

summary: Meren, an apprentice shaman, is anointed by the Circle of Nel Toth with the Dreamfire Draught for her trial to become a full shaman.
quote: We of the Circle of Nel Toth anoint you, Meren, child of stone and blood and bone, with the Dreamfire Draught.

summary: Meren drinks the vial and the poison begins to burn through her.
quote: She tilted the vial against her lips and drained it of its contents.

summary: In the present, Meren finishes unearthing an ancient weapon from the bog and names it Skaal Kesh, binding it to her with the thought of vengeance.
quote: You are Skaal Kesh . Unearthed and bound to me.

summary: In the trial, a massive elemental forms from the earth and the Circle chants as Meren must bind it while poison racks her body.
quote: Before her, coalescing from the earth, a massive elemental reared up.

summary: Meren ambushes a Nel Toth hunting party, killing two warriors and the shaman and raising them as the Borrowed.
quote: The shaman rose from the ground and stood haltingly.

summary: Meren forces the dead shaman to point the way to the clan's new convening caves and sets her Borrowed party marching.
quote: Where are the new convening caves of the Circle.

summary: Flashback: the elemental recoils from Meren's greeting, breaks her arm and ribs, and she shelters in a stone dome as it rages.
quote: As soon as she made contact, the elemental recoiled with a roar

summary: Flashback: dying, Meren hears the silence between the pulses of life magic and reaches into the darkness.
quote: She reached into the darkness, and pulled.

summary: Flashback: green death fire erupts from Meren's shelter and annihilates the avalanche elemental before the astonished Circle, and she collapses.
quote: Nothing remained but a heap of broken rocks.

summary: Flashback: the Circle debates her fate and Kael declares she is no shaman and must be killed.
quote: We must kill her now.

summary: Flashback: the elder shaman stops the killing, ruling the trial continues until the draught is purged or she dies, and the Circle leaves her to die.
quote: Let her conclude the trial alone.

summary: Flashback: Kael tells Meren to die quietly and alone, and abandons her.
quote: Die, Meren. Die quiet and alone.

summary: Meren survives by drawing on the void to quench the poison, heals, and leaves Jund's clans behind following the call of darkness.
quote: She did not die, for on that day, she wielded death itself.

summary: Meren spends years in the deadlands of Grixis, learning from necromancers and discovering how to Borrow the dead.
quote: she learned to revitalize the deceased

summary: Meren leads her Borrowed Ones into the Nel Toth camp, killing a young sentry and raising fallen shamans in a bloodbath.
quote: The result was a bloodbath.

summary: Kael and two elders burn her ranks with fire and Kael challenges her as a death mage, not recognizing her until she lowers her shadow.
quote: Your rampage ends here, death mage!

summary: Meren kills the two elders, who shift into a bear and a thrinax, with fire and corruption, then reanimates them.
quote: Finally, it collapsed in a smoking heap at her feet.

summary: Kael tells Meren she should have died, then calls three avalanche elementals against her, naming her Meren Deathbender.
quote: Return to the earth, Meren Deathbender.

summary: Meren calls down Skaal Kesh, which destroys the elementals and impales Kael.
quote: An enormous, shadowy dragon crouched in his place, holding the broken form of Kael impaled on its claws.

summary: Meren has Skaal Kesh devour Kael, completing her vengeance.
quote: Vengeance served.

summary: Meren, last of Clan Nel Toth, vows to topple all the cairns of Jund.
quote: And she would not stop until all of the cairns of Jund were toppled.

summary: Teysa returns from another day of being yelled at by the Orzhov Ghost Council and reads her old mail by the fire.
quote: Teysa Karlov had spent another full day being yelled at by the dead.

summary: Teysa recalls weeks earlier badgering the Living Guildpact into affirming twenty minor laws until he threw her out.
quote: After asking him to confirm no less than twenty minor laws and legal requirements

summary: Teysa resolves to use a loophole created by the Guildpact's new body to challenge the Obzedat's monopoly.
quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

summary: Her ghostly grandfather Karlov appears and lectures her to think of her blood, and she is forced to kiss his ring.
quote: subserviently kissed the outline of the Councilman's gossamer ring.

summary: Karlov offers her a coin, and Teysa uses it to buy a knife.
quote: Teysa used that coin to buy a knife.

summary: Disguised and shackled, Teysa is led by Tajic through Orzhova to a Boros outpost prison.
quote: There was a Boros outpost prison near the edge of the main church building.

summary: In a basement cell Tajic reveals the secret tunnel he carved to the Obzedat's record room, and Teysa explains her law-magic plan.
quote: All I need to do is directly reference a law affirmed by him and it must be made manifest.

summary: Teysa recites guild law to open a hidden wall with a warrant and to expose a web of security threads in the records library.
quote: Small threads appeared in the air, reflecting a web of silvery shimmers in the light of the torch.

summary: Teysa uses her blood and an article of the Orzhovniha to open the gem-encrusted door of the Obzedat's sanctum.
quote: The blood was quickly absorbed as a lock deep within the structure released.

summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
quote: Hello, Uncle,

summary: Teysa pulls up a jeweled chest of records and finds an old Orzhov logbook that Tajic judges to be proof of financial corruption.
quote: My gut says this is probably the proof you're looking for.

summary: Teysa invokes the law of exposure, but the logbook becomes immovable and Tajic cannot lift it.
quote: No matter how hard he tried, he could not pick it up.

summary: Teysa discovers the Guildpact's law can be broken in the chamber when Tajic easily takes her knife.
quote: The law can be broken in this room,

summary: Karlov reveals himself and summons the Obzedat, who rise from the floor.
quote: Tajic yelled with surprise as dozens of ghosts swiftly rose from beneath the floor.

summary: Karlov has a thrull take Tajic to the Obzedat dungeon.
quote: Summon a thrull to escort the Boros to our dungeon,

summary: The Obzedat revoke Teysa's title of advokist and forbid her the practice of law.
quote: By order of the Obzedat, your title of advokist is hereby revoked .

summary: Karlov tells her to come to the tower to discuss her remaining title as Grand Envoy and leaves.
quote: Don't keep me waiting,

summary: Alone, Teysa realizes the title of Grand Envoy was only a way to keep her in debt, takes Tajic's sword as a cane and walks toward the stairs.
quote: The title of Grand Envoy was never a gift. It was a way to keep her bound.

summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
quote: Ulamog is coming!

summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

summary: Gideon assigns Nissa to lead land forces and Kiora to coordinate a sea attack.
quote: you will coordinate a sea attack.

summary: Ebi brings Jace to the lighthouse, and Gideon embraces his friend.
quote: Gideon closed the distance and embraced the smaller man

summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
quote: One hedron alone isn't enough

summary: Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

summary: The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

summary: Nissa shares Jace's mind and illusion, and they locate the tilted hedron; Nissa leaps to it.
quote: The hedron was tilted; it must have shifted sometime after being carefully locked into place.

summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

summary: The Zendikari cheer that Ulamog is trapped.
quote: They had done it. Ulamog was trapped.

summary: A demon lands before the sentry Ebi, strangles him and leaves him unconscious.
quote: Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise.

summary: Ob Nixilis wakes buried alive after Nissa took Khalni Heart and collapsed the cavern on him.
quote: She left me alive.

summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

summary: Ob Nixilis weighs his options and decides he must save Zendikar to buy time to rebuild his work.
quote: I was going to have to save Zendikar.

summary: He digs himself out over days, finding Bala Ged stripped of life so there is nothing to drain.
quote: The entire process of escape took days.

summary: He recovers the keystone hedron of his network and uses it to sense where the last stand will be.
quote: Sea Gate, if memory served. A lovely place for a slaughter.

summary: Ob Nixilis flies to Tazeem and Sea Gate.
quote: I unfurled my wings.

summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

summary: He flies above the battle and locks his keystone hedron above the ring's center, tapping the network's energy.
quote: I willed it into place, locked it into a harmonic point above the ring's precise center.

summary: Ob Nixilis's spark returns and he feels the Multiverse again.
quote: My spark returned.

summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

summary: Ob Nixilis reaches out to an awakening power deep beneath the surface to the south and calls it to rise.
quote: Awakened it fully with the sheer force of my will.

summary: Chandra, abbot of Keral Keep, cannot write her Mount Keralia Address and struggles to keep her promise to stay on Regatha.
quote: She had made a promise.

summary: Chandra planeswalks to Zendikar for just one peek and lands near Sea Gate.
quote: She pressed her will against the whereness around her, forcing it to change.

summary: Chandra watches Gideon direct the placement of a hedron into the ring over the water.
quote: One of the larger hedrons, hovering over the water, was moving .

summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

summary: Back on Regatha, Mother Luti summons Chandra to the Address, and Chandra burns her speech.
quote: The pages burst into flames, burning up in a flash.

summary: Chandra gives a clumsy address, then tells the monks to trust themselves and find their own purposes.
quote: trust yourself. Trust your gift.

summary: Chandra announces she is leaving for Zendikar and Mother Luti forbids it, invoking her promise.
quote: I forbid you to leave.

summary: Mother Luti reveals it was a test, blesses Chandra's departure and takes back the abbot's robe.
quote: Go and save worlds.

summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
quote: Ulamog was trapped.

summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
quote: The circle was breaking.

summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

summary: Gideon arrives on Zendikar, defends the Zendikari, faces a titan and leaves to seek reinforcements on Ravnica.
quote: Vowing to return, he left in search of aid at the center of Planeswalker activity: the city-world of Ravnica.

summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

summary: Gideon and Jace find Sea Gate overrun and hold off the Eldrazi so survivors can flee.
quote: the two were able to hold off the Eldrazi to allow survivors to flee to safety.

summary: Nissa loses her connection to Zendikar's soul and agrees to meet the others outside Sea Gate.
quote: But her connection to Zendikar's elemental soul had suddenly vanished

summary: Nissa finds the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged, restores her connection to Zendikar and defeats Ob Nixilis.
quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis , removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and left the demon seething underground.

summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

summary: Ob Nixilis arrives and knocks the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his spark.
quote: Ob Nixilis knocked the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his Planeswalker spark.

summary: Chandra leaves Keral Keep for Zendikar and finds Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.
quote: she left the Keep for Zendikar...only to find Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.

summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

summary: Kiora descends from Sea Gate on an octopus tentacle to rejoin her own army of tricksters and sea monsters after the other planeswalkers dismiss her.
quote: five of Cosi's own tricksters and a legion of sea monsters.

summary: Kiora tells the tricksters Ulamog is coming and that the other planeswalkers plan to trap him, while she plans to kill or drive him away.
quote: Our plan is to kill him if we can, and drive him off if we can't,

summary: Kiora leaves three tricksters at Sea Gate and swims out to open water with Shen, Yesha and half her armada.
quote: Kiora turned and swam away from Sea Gate, out into the open ocean.

summary: Kiora channels the bident through the sea and reaches to Murasa to wake Lorthos.
quote: The bident was calling. He would answer.

summary: Kiora summons Lorthos, who appears as a vast darkness, and she pleads with him to fight the interlopers.
quote: She summoned, and he came!

summary: Riding Lorthos, Kiora and the tricksters converge on Sea Gate.
quote: Slowly but inexorably, Lorthos and Ula converged on Sea Gate.

summary: Kiora sees Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring, then the hedrons fall and he is freed.
quote: Whatever the cause, the effect was clear: Ula was free of his prison.

summary: Kozilek rises from the bay and rips open the sea wall, letting the Halimar Sea pour through.
quote: Another and he stood before Sea Gate.

summary: Kiora realizes Cosi always won and that she has been tricked, as Kozilek turns toward her.
quote: Cosi always won.

summary: Kozilek takes control of Shen, who lunges at Kiora, and she kills him with the bident.
quote: She raised the bident, and its twin points buried themselves in Shen's chest.

summary: Kozilek cleaves Lorthos in two, and Kiora falls into the water and drops the bident.
quote: Lorthos's body shuddered and split

summary: Kiora realizes Kozilek never saw her and that she has killed her followers, then loses consciousness.
quote: She hit the water, and blackness claimed her.

summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

summary: Nissa calls on Ashaya, but Ashaya cracks and crumbles and the world shakes.
quote: Then something broke.

summary: The seawall heaves, the hedron ring shakes, and a stray hedron with dark power breaks a leyline.
quote: The circle was broken.

summary: Nissa tries to complete the broken circle with her own body but is struck down by Ulamog's tentacle.
quote: Nissa only saw the thick, pink tentacle after it had struck her.

summary: The rest of the ring collapses and Ulamog, free again, moves toward Sea Gate.
quote: Ulamog, free of his bonds, was moving toward Sea Gate once more.

summary: Nissa recognizes the demon from Bala Ged as the cause of the collapse as he casts a great spell.
quote: He was the cause of all of this.

summary: Ob Nixilis calls a second titan, Kozilek, up from the ground.
quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

summary: Nissa surrenders to rage and runs at the demon through Kozilek's distortion and the toppling lighthouse.
quote: Kozilek's flailing arm had smashed into the seawall

summary: Nissa tackles Ob Nixilis with her blade at his neck, but he escapes and drains her with essence magic.
quote: sending a tide of his essence-draining magic down at Nissa.

summary: Ob Nixilis uses spawn of Kozilek to cut Nissa off from Zendikar and the leylines.
quote: She was cut off from Zendikar. Powerless.

summary: Ob Nixilis senses a telepath in his head and strikes down Jace, breaking his cheekbone.
quote: my fist broke his cheekbone instead of taking his head off as I'd intended.

summary: Gideon tears Ob Nixilis's wing and confronts him, declaring the people under his protection.
quote: These people are under my protection, demon.

summary: Gideon and Ob Nixilis fight, and Ob Nixilis breaks the telepath's confidence in Gideon and kills six stragglers.
quote: Six dead.

summary: Gideon breaks Ob Nixilis's knee with a joint lock, but the demon pins him.
quote: The knee cracked and a sickening jolt pulsed through my body.

summary: Ob Nixilis drowns Gideon in muddy water, and Gideon's body goes limp.
quote: Invulnerability proved no match for three inches of dirty water.

summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

summary: A shimmering wave from Kozilek crashes over the fleeing army, killing Romoe, Magain and Debins horribly.
quote: Time slowed. Insanity blossomed.

summary: The wave hits Tazri and her angel's halo glows as her past and future flicker through her mind.
quote: Time, previously slowed, now stretched .

summary: Flashback: young caravan captain Tazri halts Mahir's caravan on Tazeem because something feels wrong.
quote: "Halt!" Tazri raised her hand

summary: Flashback: Tazri and Romoe find six dead vampires and a dying angel who begs to be killed.
quote: Please. Help me. End. Me.

summary: Flashback: Tazri kills the angel despite warnings of a curse and takes her halo, losing something unnamed in herself.
quote: She reached down to take the dull gray halo from the angel's eyes.

summary: Flashback: years later, fired by caravan merchants and unable to dream, Tazri asks Vorik for a militia job and he hires her.
quote: I could use a fighter like you.

summary: Flashback: Vorik, dying, names Gideon Jura his successor, and Tazri feels betrayed.
quote: when I am gone, you will lead these people.

summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

summary: Vision of the future: after Kozilek leaves, Tazri spends ten thousand years trying to recreate Zendikar, and then billions of years in sleep waiting for him.
quote: For the first ten thousand years after Kozilek's disappearance, Tazri had used her new powers to attempt the reconstruction.

summary: Vision of the future: Tazri tells herself the story of the day Gideon died through the dead cosmos.
quote: This is the story of the day Gideon died.

summary: The halo shields Tazri's mind, and she meets the angel she killed in a white void outside time.
quote: We are outside of time, Tazri.

summary: Tazri refuses to be healed, saying the sacrifice was hers, and the angel tells her she is forgiven and that Zendikar can win.
quote: You can win. You will win. There is no other option.

summary: Tazri returns to find her soldiers dead and Kozilek far away, and sees Noyan Dar's roilmages obliterated by reflected fire and earth.
quote: Tazri didn't have time to shout a warning as the fire and earth swept through the roilmages, obliterating them.

summary: Drana rescues Noyan Dar in mid-air, and Drana's and Munda's troops turn the tide briefly.
quote: The arrival of Drana's and Munda's troops had temporarily turned the tide of battle.

summary: Tazri assumes command, tells Noyan Dar to open a rift and orders Munda to prepare the troops to flee, leaving the dying behind.
quote: Munda, prepare the troops. We are getting out of here.

summary: Tazri persuades Drana to follow her as general and to feed energy to Noyan Dar.
quote: As you command, General Tazri,

summary: Tazri decides the battle for Zendikar is just beginning.
quote: The battle for Zendikar was now truly beginning.

summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
quote: Too many to take on by herself.

summary: Chandra finds Gideon's dented buckler in the mud and recalls her parents' deaths on Kaladesh.
quote: It was a large buckler shield, wedged in a depression of mud.

summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
quote: The demon took him, and two others.

summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

summary: Chandra reaches the cavern, sees visions of her parents in the crust, and smashes the barrier.
quote: The crust exploded.

summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
quote: I'm inviting myself,

summary: The demon overpowers Chandra, drains her fire and mimics her parents' voices to make her give up.
quote: You've failed them, Chandra. Just like you failed us .

summary: Jace tells Chandra by telepathy to burn the Eldrazi drones, and she rallies and does so, freeing her friends.
quote: slamming into the Eldrazi drones that lurked near her friends.

summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

summary: Chandra's fire cyclone blasts the demon, who promises revenge across the planes and vanishes.
quote: The air folded in on itself, swallowing the demon, and he was gone.

summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

summary: Jori En wakes in the murky water beneath Sea Gate amid the carcasses of the sea's creatures, including a dead horned rift octopus.
quote: And it was dead.

summary: Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

summary: Jori hears a cry for help and finds Kiora with a compound leg fracture, who says Cosi won and the bident is gone.
quote: Cosi won,

summary: Jori sets and splints Kiora's leg, and green energy heals the wound.
quote: a cluster of green motes fluttered to life around the wound.

summary: Kiora asks Jori's help to recover the bident, which she calls their only hope, and Jori agrees to show her the way.
quote: Now we just need to recover the bident.

summary: Following a strange current, Jori and Kiora swim into a cliff and are dragged through a rift, a Kozilek spawn guarding the way until the crevasse collapses on it.
quote: All at once, the crevasse collapsed in on itself and the Eldrazi

summary: In Kozilek's reshaped caves, Kiora senses the bident beyond a ravine.
quote: The bident is that way,

summary: Jori guides a panicking Kiora through a very narrow tunnel as the bident moves ahead.
quote: Keep your eyes on me, Kiora.

summary: Jori finds a chamber piled with dead Kozilek spawn and a shaft leading up.
quote: But the Eldrazi were not moving. They were all dead.

summary: Eyeless goblins attack Jori; she kills one and stuns the others by amplifying sound.
quote: They saw with sound.

summary: Jori chases the goblin carrying the bident, falls with it into a chasm, breaking ribs, and takes the bident.
quote: And Jori had Kiora's bident.

summary: Kiora reclaims the bident and uses it to flood the caves, carrying both merfolk out on a torrent.
quote: Kiora had compelled the ocean to strip the land away.

summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
quote: His army was gone.

summary: Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
quote: I'm not going anywhere,

summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
quote: But maybe four of us can,

summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

summary: Nissa swears the oath to keep watch.
quote: for the life of every plane, I will keep watch.

summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
quote: We're going to kill them.

summary: Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

summary: Nissa shares her mind and memories with Jace, showing how the hedron network contained the titans and how the Roil was the world fighting back.
quote: She'd thought her world was angry. She hadn't realized it was fighting for its life.

summary: Nissa and Jace conceive a plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines without hedrons, so the plane can devour them.
quote: So this world can do to them what they 've been trying to do to it.

summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

summary: Gideon tells Jace he trusts him despite the demon's warning about telepaths.
quote: I trust you,

summary: Jace rallies the rear guard troops with Nissa, telling them they are the most important people on the battlefield.
quote: She'll be binding the titans, and ultimately she'll be the one who kills them.

summary: Gideon wakes before dawn and runs unarmored around the Sky Rock encampment, reflecting on Jace, Nissa and Chandra as the Gatewatch.
quote: This was his ritual, if it could be called that after only three days

summary: Tazri, now Commander-General, runs with Gideon and tells him she is addressing departing volunteers.
quote: The burden of command. It was now hers—Commander-General Tazri.

summary: Gideon says he is hers to command until he must go elsewhere to face new threats.
quote: he had pledged to the Gatewatch to intervene where others couldn't.

summary: Chandra serves breakfast heated with her hands, and Nissa brings blankets for her to warm.
quote: the blankets warmed.

summary: Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

summary: Jace reflects that the Gatewatch has no plan for the third titan, Sorin, Nahiri or other threats like the Chain Veil.
quote: these were threats that could only be handled by Planeswalkers.

summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
quote: What have you done?

summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

summary: Chandra talks Nissa into leaving Zendikar with the Gatewatch, saying Nissa can still protect it by standing with them.
quote: No one else can do it,

summary: Nissa visits the glyph at night and plants four seeds, including a Jaddi tree and a bloodbriar, at its center.
quote: One by one she planted them in the holes she had dug.

summary: Nissa promises Zendikar's soul she will see it again and moves toward the others, agreeing to show Jace what she knows of Sorin.
quote: I will see you again,

summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

summary: Kiora realizes the titan Kozilek is a distortion phenomenon from the Blind Eternities, not a god.
quote: Not a trickster, but a trick.

summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

summary: Chandra wants to burn the titans but Jace forbids it, since damage would collapse the glyph.
quote: Any damage to the titans or to Nissa will snap the leylines and collapse the glyph spell.

summary: Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with the titans and demands Nissa let them go; Jace insists they must be destroyed here.
quote: Zendikar will perish if they do.

summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
quote: I'm certain

summary: Kiora empties the Halimar Sea and hurls it at Nissa, but Jace splits it into mist.
quote: But the sea split in two, and each half split in two

summary: Chandra's spell fails to be enough as Gideon blocks a falling landmass with his own body.
quote: Gideon leaping from the outcropping, blocking the landmass with his own body

summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

summary: The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

summary: At a council meeting in Gatstaf, Farmer Warin and his wife claim a possessed cow ate another and blame Lady Evelin's failed wards.
quote: One of our cattle is possessed!

summary: Halana and Alena suspect lycanthropes have grown brazen and are working their way to the town after having killed several in the Ulvenwald.
quote: they would not let its dark horrors leak out to harm the innocent.

summary: The innkeepers burst in claiming Mrs. Palter has been murdered, accusing her husband.
quote: She's dead!

summary: Halana and Alena recall rescuing the Palters in the Ulvenwald and receiving a protective token from the cathar.
quote: Hal and Alena had found the cathar and his wife themselves no more than a week ago

summary: Halana and Alena slip out and reason that the killer was in a locked room with no forced entry.
quote: With no mention of a broken window or forced entry,

summary: In the Palters' room they find blood, a torn bit of lace, a silver button and a closet chair with shredded restraints.
quote: It was the leather straps and belts that hung from the chair

summary: Halana and Alena escape through a window as townsfolk enter the room.
quote: Hal and Alena climbed down into the alley without any of the townsfolk being the wiser.

summary: Armed with silver, they track Cathar Palter's trail, finding boot prints that become paw prints and a split trail at a crossroads.
quote: the next they were tracking the paw prints of a beast

summary: Elsa announces the bell-ringer Orwell is dead, and the trackers find the bodies of Orwell, Lady Evelin and Elder Somlon arranged in the woods.
quote: the same that had been done to the bell-ringer had been done to the ward-maker, Lady Evelin

summary: They realize the lace belongs to Elder Somlon and that the lycanthrope may be Mrs. Palter.
quote: Then what of Mrs. Palter?

summary: Halana and Alena find Mrs. Palter chanting Ormendahl over her husband on a makeshift altar and tackle her.
quote: This woman was in contract with a horror.

summary: Alena explains the cathar hid his wife's killings; he begs for her life and blames himself for the mausoleum.
quote: Three bodies, Mr. Palter. She killed three innocents.
