summary: Mrs. Palter breaks free and stabs her husband in the chest, killing him.
quote: in one motion tackled and stabbed her husband through the chest.

summary: Demonically empowered, Mrs. Palter throws Halana and Alena aside and beats them.
quote: called upon the enormous amount of demonic power she had summoned and threw them off her.

summary: A lycanthrope strikes Mrs. Palter down, and Halana and Alena stab her dead.
quote: Together they plunged their blades into Mrs. Palter's raging, bloody form.

summary: A pack of werewolves surrounds them, but the leader changes into a human woman and sends the pack away.
quote: Suddenly the beast was a human woman

summary: The woman, who says she tracked Mrs. Palter, warns them to stop killing her pack and leave the Ulvenwald, since something worse is coming.
quote: I have seen enough, and so have you, to know that whatever is out there is worse than werewolves.

summary: The woman resumes wolf form and leaves; Arlinn Kord reflects she cannot have friends.
quote: in this life, Arlinn could not have friends.

summary: Avacyn, hearing a mother's panicked prayer, leaves her mountain retreat and flies toward Gavony.
quote: Avacyn focused on the prayer, on the woman sending it to her, and saw an image of the woman running and sobbing in the middle of a large meadow.

summary: Avacyn finds the lost boy Maeli huddled in the crook of a tree after lighting up the forest and calling for him.
quote: Avacyn fixed the location of the child in her mind, and swooped over and down to a spot in the forest a few minutes away.

summary: Avacyn returns Maeli to his mother Kelse, and feels satisfied that this is why she exists.
quote: It took only moments for her to find the mother on the outskirts of the trees and give her the child.

summary: A violent shimmer racks Avacyn, doubling her vision and leaving a constant buzzing in her ears.
quote: A violent shimmer wracked her body, shaking her vision.

summary: Avacyn sees Kelse turn angry at Maeli and a thought comes to her that mortals are rotten, turning her view of the child from innocence to disgust.
quote: The seeds of men are rotten.

summary: Avacyn flees the scene, her mind consumed by the buzzing and the same words repeating.
quote: Avacyn fled, seeking refuge from her own mind.

summary: Macher, troubled by doubts about whether Avacyn is worthy of worship, prays for her to exist.
quote: Avacyn, please exist. Please be true.

summary: Avacyn descends into the church courtyard before Macher.
quote: Macher whirled, his mouth agape, and saw an angel descend.

summary: Avacyn accuses Macher of doubting, mocks his claim to be pure, and asks whether she has lost faith in him.
quote: You prayed to me because you doubted.

summary: Terrified, Macher collapses; Avacyn whispers 'Soon' and vanishes, leaving him certain of the true nature of his god.
quote: He lay there huddled through the night, cloaked in terrifying certainty about the nature of his god.

summary: Liont, cured of lycanthropy by the Cursemute, wakes to an ordinary-seeming day while his wife and children repeat a warning not to open the door when it is knocked.
quote: Liont. When the door is knocked, do not open it.

summary: Liont opens the door in his mind and sees his house as it truly is, bloody, with Hilde dead on the bed.
quote: He looked at the body of Hilde, her face frozen in terror as she lay unmoving on the bed.

summary: Liont realizes he is the one who did this, despite believing he was free of the curse, and prays to Avacyn.
quote: Who had done this? He knew who had done this.

summary: A winged figure, perhaps Avacyn, blasts the roof off and strikes Liont with a lance of energy.
quote: She pointed her spear at him, and the tip grew bright, brighter, brighter than the sun overhead, and a lancing energy struck him in the chest, burning away clothes and skin.

summary: Refusing his plea for mercy, the angel kills Liont.
quote: and then he died.

summary: Sigarda, uneasy at a storm of lightning without thunder, is joined in her solar by her sisters Bruna and Gisela, who are armed and behave strangely.
quote: Tall Gisela, cloaked in the red and white of her Goldnight flight, her twin blades already out of their sheaths.

summary: Avacyn lands in Sigarda's solar, her speech slurred, her spear twisted and her eyes flashing black.
quote: As the thunder subsided, Avacyn landed in the solar.

summary: Avacyn announces that the great work is soon to begin.
quote: The great work is soon to be underway.

summary: Sigarda recalls how, a thousand years ago, Avacyn destroyed their heretic sister and her entire flight after the sister allied with a demon lord.
quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed their sister and her entire small flight

summary: Avacyn argues that humans are as guilty as the monsters angels fight and must be punished.
quote: For their crimes we have sought to punish and kill.

summary: Avacyn says Bruna and Gisela have come around to her view, and the two echo her words.
quote: It took Bruna and Gisela some time to understand as well.

summary: Avacyn obliterates the stone roof of the solar with a surge of power and departs with Bruna and Gisela.
quote: A surge of power leapt from the spear, and the roof...vanished.

summary: Sigarda resolves to fight Avacyn, even alone.
quote: This time I fight.

summary: Kelse searches for Maeli, who has run off again, and recalls how Avacyn saved him months ago.
quote: Kelse tried hard not to think of a few months ago, when he had run off.

summary: Angels appear over Kelse's village and begin killing villagers with spears, swords and fire.
quote: Then one of the angels pointed her glowing spear downward at the village.

summary: Kelse orders Maeli to run into the forest and not look back.
quote: Run! Run now, the fastest you have ever run! To the forest!

summary: Kelse prays to Avacyn for help and finds that Avacyn herself, dressed in black with blood-red wings, is leading the destruction.
quote: You do not need to pray your lies to me, creature. I'm right here in front of you.

summary: Avacyn declares the great work has begun and says she will find Maeli eventually.
quote: I will find the small creature eventually.

summary: Avacyn kills Kelse with her spear and watches her ashes blow away.
quote: Avacyn watched as the remains of the mortal creature blew away, the ashes scattering and swirling for a moment of flight before falling to the ground.

summary: Avacyn hears the sky, rivers, trees and moon whisper a single truth and believes she now listens to truth, not liars.
quote: All whispered glorious truth.

summary: Jace rides toward Stensia with a silent guide, complaining about Liliana and about needing her help.
quote: The jagged mountains of the province called Stensia loomed ahead of them

summary: Jace's guide transforms into a werewolf.
quote: His guide turned to him, accompanied by the stomach-churning sounds of bones cracking and clothes tearing.

summary: The werewolf kills its horse as Jace flees; howls answer from the woods.
quote: Behind him, the horse's scream was cut short with a wet crunch.

summary: A pack of werewolves chases Jace toward the manor.
quote: There were at least three of them bounding after him, hideous amalgamations of human and wolf.

summary: Jace conjures a solid illusory bear that tackles one werewolf.
quote: A hulking bear made of shining blue light took form behind him

summary: Jace takes control of his guide's mind briefly, making it attack the pack's alpha, so the wolves fight each other.
quote: At last, the connection was complete. Jace was in control.

summary: A werewolf kills Jace's horse at the manor gate and Jace rolls clear.
quote: He was within shouting distance of the gate when the werewolf struck.

summary: Jace picks the lock on the manor gate with telekinesis and slips inside, and the werewolf leaves.
quote: Invisible mental fingers felt around inside the lock, found the tumblers, and quickly twirled them into place.

summary: Mindless zombies surround Jace in the yard, then part to let him pass into the house.
quote: In the darkness of the manor's yard, he could just barely make out a dozen figures standing silently around him.

summary: Jace is led to Liliana, who greets him and flicks his nose to check he came in person.
quote: She reached up to his face...and flicked the tip of his nose.

summary: Liliana disdainfully says there is worse than werewolves out there: angels.
quote: "Angels," she said with disgust.

summary: Jace claims he came to apologize for leaving Ravnica with unfinished business.
quote: I'm here to apologize.

summary: Jace tells Liliana he and Gideon saved a plane and took an oath to keep fighting interplanar threats.
quote: We even took an oath, to...to keep doing this.

summary: Liliana sees through Jace and refuses his freely given aid, forcing him to admit he needs something.
quote: I refuse your freely given aid, Jace Beleren.

summary: Jace reveals he is looking for Sorin Markov, surprising Liliana.
quote: I'm looking for Sorin Markov,

summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

summary: Liliana warns Jace not to seek Sorin, saying he is ancient, ruthless and powerful.
quote: And I am telling you, don't go.

summary: Liliana warns that Markov Manor is even worse, but Jace insists it is his best lead.
quote: Markov Manor is the best lead I have.

summary: Liliana sets her zombie servants on Jace to make a point.
quote: Her zombie servants lurched forward.

summary: Jace's illusions and spells fail against the mindless dead and he is held helpless against the wall.
quote: Jace was helpless.

summary: Liliana tells Jace the world is dangerous, then releases him and tells him to go home.
quote: Undead hands released him, and he rose, rubbing his throat.

summary: Liliana tells Jace to stay the night rather than leave, then teases him that indifference would not quicken his heartbeat.
quote: doesn't make your heartbeat quicken or your face flush.

summary: Mia and Wilbur argue about whether the Gitrog is real; Wilbur lashes out about Mia's absent father, then they reconcile.
quote: Is that what your father told you when he left you behind? That you don't matter?

summary: Mia finds her sheep pen broken and a sheep missing.
quote: A quick count showed that one sheep was missing.

summary: Elder Kalim announces that he has seen the Gitrog and that fishing on the lake is suspended; he has written to the Church and suggests Mia write her father.
quote: The Elders convened last night, and we decree that fishing on the lake is suspended until further notice.

summary: Mia confesses she plans to join the Skiltfolk when she turns fifteen and shows Wilbur her silver crossbow; she agrees to take the threat seriously.
quote: I may not be a slayer yet, but I turn fifteen in just two months.

summary: Mia writes to her father for help, but receives no reply.
quote: Mia broke down and wrote her father, scrapping a dozen drafts before settling on a brief and formal missive asking for aid.

summary: The postal rider stops coming, and the rumor spreads that the Gitrog devoured the mail carrier.
quote: Within two days, accounts of the Gitrog devouring the mail carrier transformed from rumor to story to fact.

summary: More of Mia's sheep go missing, with the fence broken in different places each time.
quote: By first snowfall, three more sheep had gone missing.

summary: Armed hooded patrols begin walking the village streets as winter deepens.
quote: As winter deepened, armed men and women began patrolling the streets

summary: Mia and Wilbur quarrel bitterly; Wilbur accuses her of being afraid to leave for the Skiltfolk test, and she throws him out.
quote: You're scared. Scared you're all memorized rules and bluster.

summary: Mia spends a cold, lonely fifteenth birthday as snow falls, still estranged from Wilbur.
quote: What a perfect end to a cold and miserable birthday.

summary: Mia finds her entire flock slaughtered and her pen in tatters.
quote: Not one sheep remained.

summary: Mia finds huge webbed prints and drag marks leading toward the lake and takes them for the Gitrog.
quote: The imprint looked like a large, webbed foot, with three talon-like divots at one end.

summary: Mia decides to track the monster herself as her first step toward becoming a slayer.
quote: This was it. Her first step toward becoming a slayer.

summary: Mia discovers the tracks are faked by someone and follows human footprints to the lake.
quote: Someone had gone to the trouble of faking an attack, of making false prints, then sweeping away their tracks.

summary: Mia watches hooded villagers load sheep carcasses onto Lehren's ship and sees Wilbur among them.
quote: Wilbur gave one last lingering gaze into the woods before turning to board.

summary: Mia leaps onto the departing ship and clings to its stern ladder as it sails onto the fog-bound lake.
quote: hanging on the small ladder on the stern

summary: Kalim announces that the sheep of the slayer's daughter are being sacrificed to the Gitrog.
quote: Tonight we gift the Gitrog with the sheep of the slayer's daughter.

summary: Mia knocks out Lehren with her crossbow and confronts the hooded villagers as they toss carcasses overboard.
quote: dropped like a sack of potatoes

summary: Mia accuses the villagers of having killed her sheep a few at a time; Kalim insists everyone has seen the Gitrog and must feed it.
quote: There is no Gitrog! You destroyed my pen and slaughtered my herd!

summary: Mia demands that Kalim show her the Gitrog, and the villagers throw the carcasses into the lake.
quote: Show me your Gitrog.

summary: The Gitrog surfaces beside the boat and Mia sees it for the first time.
quote: As the water settled, she saw it. The monster. The Gitrog.

summary: The Gitrog's tongue hurls Veryl off the ship and he disappears into the water.
quote: Veryl went flying backward off the ship, screaming through the air, and disappeared with a splash into the water.

summary: Villagers, led by Sarah, turn on Mia and demand she be sacrificed to the Gitrog.
quote: Kill her! A sacrifice to the Gitrog!

summary: Mia fights off hooded attackers, including Kyle and Terrance, shooting one assailant in the stomach.
quote: The grip loosened and she turned around and fired blindly into the stomach of her assailant.

summary: Wilbur knocks out Terrance, apologizes that things got out of hand, and says he has only ever seen bubbles.
quote: I'm so sorry. Everything got out of hand.

summary: Kalim declares the only answer is sacrifice and tries to cut Mia's throat; Wilbur tackles him.
quote: Kalim lunged forward, fishing knife suddenly drawn and in his hand, swinging straight for Mia's throat.

summary: The Gitrog climbs aboard and devours Kalim just as he offers Mia in sacrifice.
quote: Mia watched in horror as Kalim's head disappeared into its gullet

summary: Mia sets the ship afire and dives into the icy lake with Wilbur, swimming back to shore.
quote: She turned forward and without a pause dove into the icy water, dragging Wilbur with her.

summary: The Gitrog follows them ashore and Mia falls into its gaze, seeing what she takes for truth.
quote: She saw truth in its blackest form, the clarity of a thousand lifetimes compressed into one moment.

summary: Mia, smiling, stabs Wilbur with her dagger as an offering.
quote: smiled as she slid her dagger out of its sheath and through his rib cage in one smooth motion.

summary: Mia bows to the Gitrog, declaring all is sacrifice, and it eats Wilbur's body.
quote: a monstrous tongue lapped out, grasping the body of the broken boy beside her.

summary: In spring a young postal apprentice arrives and Mia invites him to stay the night and offers to take him onto the lake.
quote: her eyes lit up when he mentioned the lake, and she invited him in to stay for the night

summary: Jace arrives at the shattered Markov Manor, hanging apart over a chasm with a broken bridge of stepping stones.
quote: Jace stood at the end of a long arched bridge that jutted out from the mountainside.

summary: Jace is briefly shown a vision of the manor as it once was; he cannot detect any mind causing it.
quote: Suddenly, he saw the place as it must have once been

summary: Jace uses telekinesis and balance to cross the floating stones to the entrance.
quote: He stepped off the edge of the bridge and planted his foot on a stone that hung in the air.

summary: Jace enters the manor's archway, carved with monsters and a giant vampire.
quote: He stepped into the archway and the stone walls enfolded him.

summary: A voice breaks the silence in the entry hall, asking Jace why he came; he cannot find its source.
quote: "Why did you come here?" A voice breaks the silence.

summary: Jace sees a memory of another living man in the hall and learns he is not the first living person there recently.
quote: I'm not the first living man to set foot in this hall recently.

summary: Jace finds a great hall of floating rubble with dozens of petrified vampires embedded in the stone.
quote: Dozens and dozens of them, trapped and petrified and encased in the stone.

summary: Jace experiences the dead man's memory of vampires grabbing him, with Edgar Markov approaching.
quote: I step back and suddenly there are hands all around me, clutching at me.

summary: Jace finds the dead man's stone face and the journal he clutches to his chest.
quote: It's wrapped in blue leather, held shut with a red and green strap of silk.

summary: Jace realizes the journal was written by a moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa and that Jenrik took it over and was sent to the manor to die.
quote: after she entrusted the journal to him and sent him here.

summary: Jace witnesses a vision of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
quote: The knife slashes and glowing silver blood erupts from the angel's neck.

summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
quote: Sorin made her.

summary: Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

summary: Jace resolves that the journal will help him find Sorin through the angels.
quote: This will help me find Sorin.

summary: Jace deduces that Jenrik brought the journal, was about to be caught by the vampires, and that someone tore the castle apart and trapped them all in the walls.
quote: Jenrik came to the castle carrying the journal

summary: Jace leaves Markov Manor with the journal.
quote: I turn my back on the darkness, pass through the soaring entryway, and leave Markov Manor.

summary: Jace reaches the Gavony moors in the rain, relieved from the delusions of Markov Manor, and starts reading the journal.
quote: It was still evening when he reached Gavony.

summary: Journal entry 433: the author dissects a large werewolf specimen sent by Jenrik.
quote: With great effort, the rib cage was separated, the specimen split from clavicle to pelvis, its contents exposed to air.

summary: The author finds the specimen's interior filled with sinew and almost nothing human, with a large cluster growing on the liver.
quote: This one, though. This one was...new.

summary: Jace finds a twisted monolith on the moor matching those at Markov Manor and in the journal.
quote: The monolith was unmistakably the same as those he had seen at Markov Manor, the same as he had seen in the journal.

summary: A spark jumps from the monolith to Jace's hand, and he senses something bright and bell-clear.
quote: there was a POP and a spark jumped from the end of the monolith to his hand.

summary: Journal entry 643: the cryptoliths warp mana flow, with potentially severe effects on angels.
quote: The disruptive properties of the stones appear to also extend to an ability to warp the flow of mana through the region

summary: Journal entry 735 traces the stones and tidal distortion to a large reef off the Nephalian coast.
quote: a large reef off the coast of Nephalia

summary: On the Nephalian cliffs a vacant-eyed fisherwoman tells Jace that a 'she' has arrived with feathered ones from the sky.
quote: Brought her feathered ones from the sky, tide came up right on with them!

summary: Jace bridges minds with the fisherwoman and finds himself trapped in a featureless dome inside her mind.
quote: His form was somehow trapped in someone else's mind.

summary: A blind spot at the dome's center swells into a huge Object, and illusory duplicates of Jace appear around him.
quote: The blind spot in his vision had swelled to become an Object far larger than Jace himself

summary: The dome shatters, revealing a latticed wall of eyes; Jace awakens on the path while the fisherwoman flees.
quote: His eyes snapped open to find his hands clapped over his head, his body curled up on the ground.

summary: Jace sees the Drownyard, a huge ring of jagged stones in the ocean, and realizes all the cryptoliths point to it.
quote: All the cryptoliths point here!

summary: The journal proposes that an eldritch moon of great mass is nearing Innistrad.
quote: an eldritch moon of sufficient size as to provide a gravitational pull

summary: A procession of zombie sailors wades through the shoulder-deep water around the ring.
quote: a long procession of shambling humanoids waded through the frigid, shoulder-deep ocean water below.

summary: Jace is zapped by a stone again and perceives the Object hovering above the circle, the nexus of Innistrad's redirected leylines.
quote: A blind spot, the Object, loomed in his vision, hovering just above the circle of stones in the distance.

summary: One of Jace's duplicates takes the form of the soratami author of the journal and recites its words.
quote: The pale duplicate had reformed completely into a soratami—one of the moonfolk of Kamigawa.

summary: A swarm of angels descends over the Drownyard, dropping feathers.
quote: Huge winged things. Angels.

summary: The hooded duplicate walks into the sea and drowns, muttering questions.
quote: It continued moving doggedly forward as the waters closed over its head, entombing it below the surface.

summary: The violet-eyed duplicate reshapes itself into Liliana Vess.
quote: slowly it rearranged itself to a familiar form: Liliana Vess.

summary: Jace accuses Liliana of redirecting the stones to herd and twist the angels, and she mocks him before vanishing.
quote: You're the one who redirected the stones to herd the angels here and twist their minds!

summary: The Liliana illusion dissipates into the night air.
quote: it suddenly dissipated into the cold night air.

summary: The Object disappears from above the ring.
quote: The Object had disappeared.

summary: A dull buzzing voice tells Jace to stop asking questions and put away the journal, and he decides what he has to do.
quote: You don't need the book and its bottomless well of mysteries.

summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

summary: Sorin cuts down five of Olivia's vampires and blasts the last, a duelist, to ash with a clenched fist.
quote: his assailant's body burst apart in a scattering of ashes

summary: Sorin tells Olivia he has come for her help.
quote: I have come for your help.

summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

summary: Flashback: Sorin, still weakened from creating Avacyn, is pulled from his restoration by the arrival of another planeswalker.
quote: Something had pulled him prematurely from his restoration.

summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
quote: Soon, Avacyn was in retreat.

summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

summary: Sorin asks Olivia to summon her bloodline to join the Markov remnants against the threat.
quote: Summon the might of your bloodline, Olivia.

summary: Olivia agrees to help Sorin, on the condition that he first helps her.
quote: I will help you. But first you will help me.

summary: Liliana broods in her manor during a storm, recalling how she made demonic pacts and used the Chain Veil to kill demons and take Thraben.
quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

summary: Liliana can no longer bear to wear the Chain Veil, but cannot get rid of it without unbearable pain.
quote: But when she tried to get rid of it, the pain was unbearable.

summary: The Raven Man appears beside Liliana as a second voice speaks into her mind.
quote: He had appeared to her in her youth, taunted her, taught her.

summary: Liliana realizes the intruding voice is Jace, who is invading her mind.
quote: Are you insane? I almost killed you!

summary: Jace binds Liliana's zombies with ropes of light so they cannot reach him.
quote: ropes of light bound their arms and legs, sent them toppling to the ground.

summary: Liliana's death magic passes through a Jace illusion, which pops.
quote: The bolt of purple light slid right through him, and his image popped like a soap bubble.

summary: Jace accuses Liliana of helping the angels at the Drownyard.
quote: And you're helping them. Admit it!

summary: Liliana realizes Jace can see the Raven Man, and strikes the real Jace with a bolt of magic.
quote: She let loose a bolt of magic at Jace, the real Jace, that left him doubled over in pain.

summary: The Chain Veil amplifies her magic and backlash racks Liliana as Jace presses his mental assault.
quote: The backlash started, agony suffusing Liliana as the Chain Veil took its toll.

summary: Liliana tells Jace she does not want to hurt him; the pounding stops and the Raven Man vanishes in disgust.
quote: The Raven Man sighed in disgust and disappeared in a rustle of feathers.

summary: Jace, disoriented, tells Liliana about Markov Manor, the moonfolk journal and the stones pointing to a drownyard in Nephalia.
quote: A drownyard, on the coast.

summary: Jace theorizes that Liliana is redirecting mana to the Drownyard to be rid of the Chain Veil.
quote: These stone things are redirecting all this mana, and it's all going to this drownyard henge

summary: Liliana insists she had nothing to do with it, and Jace slumps in relief.
quote: I really didn't.

summary: Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
quote: I have to go to Thraben,

summary: Liliana charges her hand with necromancy, and Jace grabs her wrist and aims it at his chest, daring her to kill him.
quote: and pointed her glowing palm at his chest.

summary: Liliana tells Jace through a story of a pet that she would be sad when he dies but would get over it.
quote: Because that's how I'll feel when you're dead, you idiot,

summary: Jace leaves for Thraben, expecting to die there.
quote: Jace turned and walked away.

summary: Gared tells Liliana that his master bids her come to the tower with the Object.
quote: The Master bids you come to the tower,

summary: Liliana follows Gared up the tower stairs with the Chain Veil, while a raven watches and vanishes.
quote: Liliana walked upward, into darkness.

summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
quote: I am in need of a mentor

summary: Grete's prison caravan carrying Gisa is attacked by misshapen skaabs and Gisa escapes in the chaos.
quote: we were overcome by a sudden attack of ghastly, violent, misshapen skaabs.

summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she has broken out of prison.
quote: GUESS WHO JUST BROKE OUT OF PRISON!

summary: Gisa describes escaping her carriage and returning to the old family home in Nephalia.
quote: I swept my feet over my chains and rammed the door, escaping into the fog

summary: Gisa raises her dead parents to apologize for the fire that destroyed the house.
quote: I raised Mummy and Father to apologize for what we did to the house.

summary: Geralf scolds Gisa for raising their parents and tells her not to contact him again.
quote: You are being incredibly irresponsible.

summary: Ludevic offers to take Geralf under his wing, sending alchemical texts.
quote: If you are amenable, I am more than happy to take you under my proverbial wing.

summary: Geralf thanks Ludevic but declares he is sick of games.
quote: I am absolutely sick of games.

summary: Grete tracks Gisa to the remains of an old manor in Nephalia.
quote: I have caught up with Gisa in Nephalia.

summary: Grete observes ghouls calmly walking toward Gisa's whistled summons along the Nephalian coast.
quote: They simply walk toward their conductor.

summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

summary: Odric orders Grete to withdraw because too many undead and a strange structure are on the coast.
quote: pull out NOW

summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

summary: Grete withdraws toward Thraben as Gisa erupts in a violent rage.
quote: Departing immediately.

summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

summary: Thalia rides to Thraben Cathedral, furious after witnessing atrocities at Elgaud.
quote: The ride from the Elgaud Grounds in Nephalia to Thraben Cathedral had taken days

summary: Thalia confronts Odric, demanding he stop the inquisition's burning of children at Elgaud.
quote: We're burning children now.

summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

summary: Thalia declares she can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.
quote: I can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.

summary: Odric urges Thalia to leave Thraben and has Grete escort her beyond the wall.
quote: Will you please escort Thalia beyond the outer wall?

summary: Thalia tells Grete she will fight, even against the angels if she must.
quote: I'm going to fight,

summary: Weeks later Thalia bursts into the Lunarch Council, where Odric tells her the council has removed her title; she realizes he informed the council of her heresy.
quote: The council has removed it from you.

summary: Thalia accuses Bishop Jerren of communion with Ormendahl and of leading the Skirsdag.
quote: I bring evidence that you have been in communion with the demon Ormendahl, called the Profane Prince, and you are now the leader of the Skirsdag.

summary: Thalia recounts finding a witch eating a messenger's heart in Wittal parish and killing her (recounted).
quote: Rushing inside, we found the witch lifting the quivering heart from the corpse of a messenger

summary: Thalia presents a bloodstained letter bearing Jerren's seal giving instructions to the witch in the Profane Prince's name.
quote: The letter bears the seal and signature of none other than Bishop Jerren, giving instructions to this witch in the name of the Profane Prince!

summary: Several bishops refuse the letter until Carlin takes it and pales as she reads.
quote: Three bishops refused her as the council sat in stony silence, before Bishop Carlin took it with a quivering hand.

summary: The council calls for Thalia's execution and cathars seize her on Jerren's signal.
quote: Cathars came and seized Thalia's arms before she could draw it, looking to Jerren for direction.

summary: Odric, shaken by the council's cruelty, goes to Thalia's cell and tells the guard to open it, planning to leave with her.
quote: We are leaving here, together.

summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

summary: Odric disarms and wounds Dougan, and Grete kills Marta in the fight against the eight cathars.
quote: Marta, fighting on despite the wound in her shoulder, fell under Grete's heavy sword.

summary: Odric kills Haral, leaving all eight cathars bleeding or dying on the cathedral floor.
quote: The inevitable opening came, and Odric took it without thinking, slashing the man's throat open.

summary: The three escape the cathedral and leave Thraben on horseback.
quote: And they left the cathedral, then left Thraben, left their old lives far behind.

summary: Thalia welcomes Grete to the Order of Saint Traft in a small Nearheath chapel.
quote: Welcome to the Order of Saint Traft,

summary: The holy geist of Saint Traft appears beside Thalia.
quote: radiant but insubstantial, a holy geist.

summary: Grete kneels and pledges to follow Thalia.
quote: Wherever you lead.

summary: Tamiyo drifts through Thraben Cathedral's chantry, investigating why Innistrad is off its axis.
quote: Despite the fact that her feet never touched the stone floor, Tamiyo thought about tiptoeing as she slowly drifted through the chantry of Thraben Cathedral.

summary: Tamiyo has come to the cathedral to study the oldest histories of Avacyn.
quote: Her latest line of research had brought her to the cathedral, where the humans of Innistrad housed their oldest histories of Avacyn.

summary: Tamiyo invokes the story He Who Frightens the Sun to blend in unseen among the cathars.
quote: The story invoked, its magic became real, and Tamiyo faded from view.

summary: Tamiyo finds a young planeswalker holding her field notes standing over a collapsed librarian.
quote: And standing over him...a Planeswalker.

summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

summary: Jace's eyes grow calm and he recovers his senses.
quote: The young human's eyes closed, and he took several deep, slow breaths.

summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
quote: he didn't survive it.

summary: Tamiyo tells Jace to leave, warning that a mad telepath is a danger across planes.
quote: You need to leave, Jace.

summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

summary: Tamiyo agrees to anchor Jace's mind if they link minds, and Jace accepts.
quote: But...in theory, I could anchor you.

summary: Tamiyo and Jace link minds, each learning the other's past and burdens.
quote: In an instant, he knew her.

summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

summary: Avacyn brands Tamiyo an intruder and impure and attacks.
quote: Intruder. Invader. Rotmonger. Impure! IMPURE!

summary: Tamiyo fights Avacyn with the story Winter's Howl, freezing parts of her wings.
quote: Tamiyo let loose precisely targeted blasts of icy gale

summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
quote: And then she froze.

summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

summary: Tamiyo tells the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
quote: Sometimes, our stories have to end.

summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

summary: Avacyn blasts Tamiyo back against the wall with her light.
quote: I push toward her with my hand, and my light blasts the demon back.

summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
quote: I am your creator

summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
quote: He is the reason I exist.

summary: Avacyn sees images of burning villages and slain innocents and realizes she herself set the fires.
quote: I have set those fires. I have slain those innocents.

summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn's angels one by one, draining one.
quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
quote: The plane has lost its protector

summary: A tremor shakes the cathedral, shattering stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face.
quote: The world rumbled again, this time under Jace's feet.

summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

summary: Corsairs attack Boldt's passage ship with cannon fire.
quote: The cannonball missed him by inches.

summary: Boldt's attempted spell against a corsair fizzles.
quote: But as quickly as the spell sprang to life, it fizzled, uselessly impotent against the hull of the corsair.

summary: The corsairs' chained cannonballs cleave the mainmast, killing most of the crew.
quote: Mast, rigging, and crew came crashing down into the sterncastle and through the deck, bringing several screams to a sickening halt.

summary: Enthril emerges from below deck and uses a wave to spin one corsair into the other.
quote: The sea sprang to respond, following the motion and rippling with energy similar to Boldt's, but more powerful, confident.

summary: Enthril tells Boldt that they are all the crew that is left.
quote: We're the crew now. All that's left.

summary: Boldt and Enthril repair the hull below deck, Enthril telling him to use the mallet.
quote: Below deck, the pungent smell of hemp fiber and pine tar filled Boldt's nostrils.

summary: Enthril reveals he graduated top of his class from the academy Boldt is bound for.
quote: Graduated top honors.

summary: Enthril tells Boldt that control is an illusion and that he has learned to be a custodian of magic.
quote: Control is the illusion.

summary: Four pirate ships close in as the drifting sail pulls the ship east; Enthril gives Boldt a scimitar to cut the lines.
quote: Four sails on the water

summary: Enthril deflects mastcutters with an invisible barrier but collapses, depleted.
quote: With a thunderous clang, the heavy irons struck an unseen force at a shallow breadth before the bow.

summary: Boldt cuts the lines freeing the mainsail, and Enthril welcomes him to the real academy.
quote: Boldt cut through weathered ropes and rigging, bringing the blade down again and again until the tattered sail pulled itself free.

summary: Enthril stops Boldt from using his focus and tells him to ask rather than command.
quote: Don't speak. Don't command. Ask .

summary: A direct hit prompts Boldt to lunge, unleashing a surge of force that knocks the lead pirate ship broadside.
quote: A voltaic surge of force lashed across fathoms of ocean to catch the vanguard upright, knocking it violently broadside to port.

summary: The ship drifts toward the Perimeter, and Enthril names the Dire Waves as the worse problem.
quote: The Dire Waves. This is what worse looks like.

summary: The buoys blaze with light, the skeletons shriek, and a giant tentacle splits the ship across its keel.
quote: The appendage crashed through the middle of the ship, splitting it across the keel to send the mages airborne

summary: The wreckage lifts on the back of an immense shelled leviathan.
quote: Beneath them, the barnacled surface of an immense shell

summary: Boldt's calculating inner voice stops, and he finally sees how to let magic flow through him.
quote: And then the voice in his head, the voice of control, suddenly, inexplicably stopped.

summary: Enthril's blazing light engulfs the mages, the wreckage, the creature and the sea.
quote: The light exploded forth—engulfing the mages, the floating scraps of ship, the creature, the sea, the world.

summary: Boldt wakes alone aboard a strange skyship floating above the Dire Waves with Enthril gone.
quote: He was on a skyship of some kind, the make of which he could only have imagined.

summary: Boldt finds Enthril's signet ring, puts it on, and lets the winds carry him away from the Tolarian Academy.
quote: He put on Enthril's ring, as a reminder.

summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, races toward the besieged town of Lambholt smelling angel's blood.
quote: The aroma met Arlinn's wide wolf nostrils as she raced up the sheer incline of a gorge toward the town of Lambholt under siege.

summary: Arlinn witnessed a mad angel's descent on Lambholt, which left cathars and civilians slain.
quote: She had witnessed the mad angel's descent on Lambholt from afar

summary: Flashback: Arlinn, secretly a lycanthrope, is presented the Mantle of Goldnight and made an archmage in the Elgaud chapel.
quote: At the correct moment, Arlinn bowed her head, and Reeves slipped the chain around her neck.

summary: Flashback: Arlinn hopes the blessing will repress her curse, since a lycanthrope cannot be an archmage.
quote: A lycanthrope could not be an archmage of Goldnight, and Arlinn had to become an archmage of Goldnight.

summary: Flashback: Cathar Leighton interrupts the ceremony with news of a devil attack on Havengul.
quote: Devils in Havengul! Hordes of them!

summary: Flashback: Rembert declares Arlinn an archmage and one of the Goldnight despite the unfinished ceremony.
quote: You are one of the Goldnight, Arlinn Kord, bound by the sacrament that holds us together

summary: Flashback: The Goldnight find Havengul ablaze with devils.
quote: They found the town of Havengul ablaze.

summary: Flashback: The angel Freydalia blesses a small church as a sanctuary for the injured.
quote: An angel, Freydalia, blessed a small church, casting a spell of protection over it

summary: Flashback: Arlinn prays to Avacyn and pulls a boy from under a collapsing carriage with divine strength.
quote: As the boy's hand touched hers, Arlinn yanked him out from under the carriage with a divine might that sent them both rolling across the ground just as the carriage collapsed.

summary: Flashback: Devils swarm Olaylie, cutting her and making her bleed.
quote: Olaylie was lurching through the sky with a devil on her back.

summary: Arlinn finds a mad angel bound in a clearing, surrounded by cathars.
quote: The angel was bound with rope, an arrow protruding from her gut, wings bloodied.

summary: Arlinn sees Rembert, whose three long scars shine in the moonlight.
quote: Though Rembert's face was red from effort and crusted in dirt, the three long, white scars that ran across his cheek and down his jaw shone in the moonlight.

summary: A branch snaps and the mad angel points out Arlinn the werewolf to the cathars.
quote: There in the trees! A monster!

summary: Distracted cathars step back, and the mad angel breaks her ropes and takes flight.
quote: In a display of mad strength, she spread her wings with enough force to cast off the ropes that bound her.

summary: The mad angel hurls an arrow that kills the youngest cathar.
quote: she tore the arrow from her gut and hurled it down at the youngest of the cathars.

summary: Rembert attacks Arlinn with a branch and orders the cathars to kill the monster.
quote: Rembert was wielding the branch as a weapon, against her.

summary: Flashback: Arlinn hands the rescued boy to Rembert and races back to fight the devils attacking Olaylie.
quote: Archmage Arlinn Kord thrust the small child into Rembert's outstretched arms.

summary: Flashback: Devils yank on Olaylie's wings, bringing her crashing to the ground.
quote: In unison, they heaved back, yanking on the angel's wings, sending Olaylie plummeting to the ground.

summary: Flashback: Devils pin Arlinn as she prays to Avacyn and receives no answer.
quote: She waited, opening herself to the power of the protector; she needed power to save the angel.

summary: Flashback: Olaylie's agonized cry makes Arlinn lose herself and transform into a werewolf.
quote: Arlinn felt the power of the pain in Olaylie's cry, and just like the night, she came apart.

summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears into the devils.
quote: The werewolf surged at the devils.

summary: Flashback: The werewolf pulls Olaylie down and attacks her.
quote: The werewolf pulled the angel back to the ground and laid into its flesh with teeth.

summary: Flashback: The werewolf kills the cathars who try to stop her, one by one.
quote: One after another. They all fell at the werewolf's mercy.

summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears the wings off Olaylie and kills her.
quote: Tore it full off the angel's body.

summary: Flashback: Rembert recognizes Arlinn, and she sees the bodies of Leighton, Reeves and the other cathars.
quote: Fallen cathars. Too many of them.

summary: Flashback: The werewolf slashes Rembert's cheek, leaving his scars, as he prepares to strike her down.
quote: her claws digging trenches into his cheek

summary: Flashback: As Rembert's sword falls, Arlinn planeswalks away to another world.
quote: she had planeswalked that day, so long ago, when her mind had cleaved.

summary: On another world Arlinn lives as a werewolf with a human mind and learns that she must trust herself to be whole.
quote: She had to trust herself to be whole.

summary: Arlinn returns to Innistrad, visits graves and confesses in churches and to angels.
quote: she had visited the graves, Reeves's, Leighton's, all of them.

summary: Arlinn tries to seek Rembert's forgiveness; he calls her a monster and orders her away from Elgaud Grounds.
quote: Leave these grounds, and never come back.

summary: Cornered at the gorge by Rembert and the cathars, Arlinn braces for blows.
quote: She was surrounded, backed against the edge of the gorge, cathars on all sides and Rembert before her

summary: The mad angel seizes Rembert and carries him into the air.
quote: The angel shrieked as it closed its bloody fingers around Rembert's arms and pulled him, gasping and wide-eyed, into the air.

summary: Arlinn leaps up, pulls the angel to the ground and kills her, freeing Rembert.
quote: The mad angel was dead in the matter of moments.

summary: Rembert is wounded, lying on a dead tree trunk in the gorge, and Arlinn climbs out to reach him.
quote: Rembert was wounded, lying on a twisted trunk of a dead tree

summary: Arlinn transforms to human form and offers Rembert her hand; he admits she lied and killed the others, yet takes it.
quote: Arlinn closed her eyes and welcomed the transformation to her human form

summary: Arlinn tells Rembert that Avacyn is gone and they must find strength in each other.
quote: We must find strength in each other.

summary: After resealing the Eldrazi, Nahiri travels through the Blind Eternities to find Sorin.
quote: Nahiri cast herself through the chaos of the Blind Eternities, the space between worlds.

summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
quote: You broke my arm!

summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
quote: You risked my plane, and more.

summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

summary: Nahiri sinks into the earth to escape the light and reconsider.
quote: She dug her hands into the soil, extending her will not out, but down, and dove into the earth itself.

summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
quote: The other half,

summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

summary: Nahiri holds on to sanity by building a mental model of Zendikar.
quote: Her memories of Zendikar became her lantern in the dark.

summary: The Helvault is slowly populated by demons and horrors, and Nahiri understands its purpose.
quote: Slowly, over countless years, the Helvault was populated.

summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

summary: Nahiri finds her body wounded and mortal-like, no longer an extension of her will.
quote: Her body was no longer an extension of her sense of self.

summary: Nahiri planeswalks home to Zendikar.
quote: Her feet found the rocky earth of Zendikar, and for the first time since her imprisonment began, she stood on solid ground.

summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

summary: Nahiri finds Bala Ged turned to lifeless gray dust.
quote: What stretched before her was a seemingly endless expanse of chalky gray dust

summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

summary: Innistrad's final ward falls and the plane is left naked and vulnerable.
quote: Innistrad's final ward had fallen.

summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

summary: Nahiri sees the temple she constructed for the god no longer empty.
quote: To the temple she had constructed for the god. It was no longer empty.

summary: Maeli, guarded by cathars, remembers fleeing his burning village as his mother ordered.
quote: He had run into the forest like his mother had told him, and he had not gone back to the village.

summary: Ms. Sadie's chest bursts open into many arms at dinner and she chases Maeli.
quote: the same writhing arms that had burst out of Ms. Sadie's chest that very night while they ate their dinner

summary: The cathars slice off Ms. Sadie's grasping arms.
quote: The cathars shifted in the tall grass, slicing off one arm after another.

summary: Maeli prays to Avacyn, who is dead, for help.
quote: PLEASE, AVACYN! HELP ME!

summary: A mad angel announces that Emrakul is rising and dives at Maeli.
quote: She dove down, her blade slicing through the air ahead of her.

summary: Edith, in a crowd of cultists, begs to be chosen as Emrakul rises.
quote: Choose me! Me! Me'mrakul.

summary: Emrakul rises from the sea at the Drownyard.
quote: And then Emrakul rose.

summary: Emrakul looks upon Edith, who feels chosen.
quote: She looked down at Edith with one enormous, glowing magenta eye.

summary: Hal and Alena stand back to back in a nightmarish grove of the Ulvenwald, surrounded by corrupted townsfolk.
quote: They were in a grove in the Ulvenwald, but the Ulvenwald was not the woods they had known.

summary: Hal recognizes one monster as Elder Kolman.
quote: Elder Kolman. May the angel save him.

summary: Alena's touch pulls Hal back as she nearly succumbs to the chanting.
quote: It was Alena's touch, her sweating fingers gripping Hal's wrist, that yanked Hal away from the suffocating embrace.

summary: Hal and Alena together kill the transformed Elder Kolman.
quote: Hal swung again, beheading the once-holy man.

summary: Hal and Alena flee the grove, running until they can no longer hear the chanting.
quote: They ran until they could no longer hear the chanting, until they could no longer feel the pressure in their heads.

summary: Bruna and Gisela are gone, becoming one fused angel that proclaims Emrakul.
quote: Emrakul's angel parted four wings, reached out with two arms, and cried with a single voice that sprang from two mouths

summary: Emrakul's angel leads the faithful below in a chorus of We are Emrakul.
quote: Emrakul's angel led all below in following Her radiant form.

summary: Jace, shielding his mind with Tamiyo's teaching, is distracted by the warped angel overhead.
quote: This time it had been the sight of the warped angel in the sky overhead that had distracted Jace.

summary: Jace recalls Gideon told him to return to Zendikar if he heard of a titan.
quote: Gideon himself had told Jace to come back to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

summary: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace, saying that is not her path.
quote: No, Jace. That's not my path.

summary: Tamiyo shields Jace's mind so that he can planeswalk away.
quote: I will protect your mind so you can planeswalk

summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

summary: Liliana, Dierk and Gared try to tame the Chain Veil by channeling lightning and geists through a witchbane orb.
quote: Liliana's teeth clenched involuntarily as the surge came.

summary: The geist circuit fails to draw off any backlash, and the Veil's pain overwhelms Liliana.
quote: The geist circuit had not drawn off any of the backlash.

summary: The equipment is ruined and Liliana cries out; she dismisses Dierk, who takes the orb to Olivia.
quote: You may see yourself out. Deliver the orb back to its owner.

summary: Liliana wants Jace to owe her, then hears a scream and finds werewolves overrunning her throne room.
quote: Werewolves. Liliana's entire throne room was overrun.

summary: The warped werewolves kill Dierk, raking his chest open.
quote: Dierk lay on the floor, his chest raked open.

summary: Liliana, Gared and the reanimated Dierk reach the door of Lurenbraum Fortress.
quote: Finally, Liliana, Gared, and—haltingly—Dierk, arrived at the monumental door.

summary: A vampire priest turns Liliana away until Olivia appears and welcomes her.
quote: Oh Liliana, my dear one!

summary: Olivia rejoices that Avacyn is dead, a smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.
quote: A smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.

summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
quote: set loose more than just the archangel

summary: Liliana privately recalls that she broke the Helvault open and slew the demon Griselbrand.
quote: She had slain the demon Griselbrand

summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

summary: Sorin threatens Liliana, and she answers that death is hers.
quote: Innistrad may be your domain, Sorin,

summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

summary: Liliana sees the vengeful cloud mass from Nephalia tipping toward Thraben.
quote: the atmospheric mass shifted slowly from its origin over the Nephalia coast, tipping toward Gavony province and the brightly lit High City.

summary: Sorin says the world is ruined and that Jace will die at Thraben.
quote: This world is ruined,

summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

summary: Liliana walks toward Thraben and raises the dead from cemeteries along the road.
quote: Corpses crawled up out of the earth.

summary: Liliana, with a growing horde of zombies, declares she is this world's last hope.
quote: A dozen more zombies lurched out of the ground, compelled to follow in her wake of necromantic power.

summary: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at Markov Manor for Sorin.
quote: They called her the Harbinger.

summary: Sorin's vampire army arrives with banners and knights opposite the manor.
quote: The first of Sorin's forces to arrive were the banners, ancient cloths that hung from black wooden poles

summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

summary: Nahiri kills a white-armored vampire and many others in the melee in the great hall.
quote: the vampire fell silent when a marble corbel smashed into her mouth, pulverizing those grotesque teeth.

summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

summary: Nahiri forges four more stone blades from white-hot stones.
quote: four blades, identical to the one she wielded, each one pulsing with energy of their stone forge.

summary: Nahiri rotates the hall and opens a wall, releasing scores of Emrakul-touched monsters.
quote: Scores of monsters, bulbous and contorted, with only vague hints at the people and animals they had once been.

summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

summary: Thalia recalls being forced to kill her scout Halmig, who rejoined the march changed and squirming.
quote: She had been forced to kill him, or whatever he had become

summary: Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear and confirms she is dead.
quote: Even with its tip broken in a jagged line, Avacyn's spear was unmistakable.

summary: Thalia's hand is burned by holy light when she tries to touch the spear.
quote: A flare of holy light erupted where her hand touched the metal haft

summary: With Saint Traft's power, Thalia lifts the spear and mounts it on her saddle as the order's banner.
quote: We ride under this banner now,

summary: Thalia shows her army the spear and tells them Avacyn is gone, urging them to be their own light.
quote: For the memory of Avacyn, of the light and goodness that have fled from the world, we fight!

summary: A monster fused from a horse and rider attacks Thalia, numbing her face before her gryff and cathars kill it.
quote: But then she strayed too close to a shambling thing the size of a large horse, and it wheeled on her.

summary: Dennias is overtaken by magenta tendrils from his body and Thalia kills him mercifully.
quote: Her blade took his life quickly

summary: Olivia Voldaren parleys with Thalia in midair, offering common cause against the horrors.
quote: I'm Olivia Voldaren, lady of Lurenbraum and progenitor of the Voldaren line.

summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

summary: Flashback: Thalia meets the geist of Saint Traft in an ancient chapel and takes him in.
quote: Will you take me in?

summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

summary: Thalia declines to force possession on those who cannot accept the spirits.
quote: I can't make that choice for them.

summary: Thalia's army passes through Thraben's Outer Wall and fights alongside vampires through the streets.
quote: They were fighting shoulder to shoulder with vampires now, making their way through the streets of the city.

summary: Olivia stabs Seeta, chief of the Sinpurged, from behind.
quote: Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

summary: A huge fused angel of flesh, tentacles and feathered wings looms before Thraben Cathedral.
quote: Drifting in the air in front of the cathedral was a huge abomination formed of twisted flesh, writhing tentacles...and feathered wings.

summary: Thalia attacks the angel-thing on her gryff and is slashed down, her gryff killed.
quote: In response, the angel brought its other arm up and slashed a half-dozen finger-claws down her side and across her gryff's flank

summary: Sigarda arrives and disowns her fused sisters.
quote: You are no longer my sisters,

summary: Sigarda slashes her sisters with her scythe but is snatched and being absorbed into the angel-thing.
quote: But one of those huge, strangely bifurcated arms snatched Sigarda out of the air.

summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

summary: Thalia drives Avacyn's spear through the angel-thing's back and into its spine.
quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine

summary: Sigarda bursts from the dying angel-thing's chest, and the creature falls dead, calling her sister.
quote: And it followed Sigarda to the hard stone of the plaza below, curling like a dead spider on the ground.

summary: A vast tentacled thing approaches Thraben as a tidal wave of corrupted monsters smashes into the plaza.
quote: As it approached, a tidal wave of corrupted monstrosities crested before it, smashing into the plaza and turning the tide once more toward annihilation.

summary: Jace arrives on Innistrad, finds the sky tearing apart, and stands on a hill above burning Thraben.
quote: He could see the city now, and half of it was ablaze.

summary: Jace overloads the minds of three mad werewolves; two die and the third mutates into something unrecognizable.
quote: Whatever he had done had triggered some sort of reflexive mutation.

summary: Gideon arrives and slays the mutated creature as it corners Jace.
quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

summary: Nissa warns the plan will fail because the leylines have been redirected into the cryptolith network at Thraben, and after listening she agrees she can do it.
quote: "It's not going to work. The leylines have already been redirected. Into that."

summary: Liliana watches the Gatewatch head into Thraben from above, with Gared and her raised army.
quote: Those must be Jace's little friends.

summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

summary: Nissa pulls up three spectral vines to tap the leylines; the third, darker vine strangles her.
quote: it had managed to wrap itself around her neck

summary: Nissa cries out and collapses; the glyph goes dark and the plan fails as the horde keeps coming.
quote: The glyph went instantly dark.

summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

summary: Liliana's zombie army pours into the square and forms a defensive perimeter around the planeswalkers.
quote: they parted, formed a defensive perimeter around them, and started pushing outward.

summary: Liliana appears with the Chain Veil and wipes out the mutated creatures with necromantic energy, rescuing the Gatewatch.
quote: Liliana floated forth, arms spread wide, the Chain Veil hovering just beyond her fingertips.

summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

summary: Jace refuses Liliana's demand to planeswalk away, insisting they can finish the job with her help.
quote: We need to finish this. We're so close.

summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

summary: The Raven Man and the Chain Veil both urge Liliana to flee, frightened of Emrakul.
quote: Whatever Emrakul was, the Chain Veil wanted no part of it.

summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

summary: Jace finds himself at the top of a spiral staircase in a copy of his Ravnica sanctum while Emrakul tears the tower apart.
quote: He was at the top of a long, grand spiraling staircase

summary: A voice in Jace's own voice commands him to go downstairs and he descends into the depths of the tower.
quote: He descended into the depths of the tower.

summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

summary: Liliana refuses to be a vessel, silences the Veil and the Raven Man, and prepares to fight Emrakul.
quote: She shut down the voices of the Veil and the Raven Man both, silencing them abruptly.

summary: Jace sees in a window Gideon, addressed as Kytheon Iora, questioned by the celestial Erebos, who threatens to kill his friends unless he says what he most desires.
quote: It is not an offer, mortal.

summary: Jace watches in a window as Emrakul's lattices cover Tamiyo's eyes, mouth and hands, erasing her ability to see, speak and write.
quote: She is being erased.

summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

summary: Jace sees a vision of child Chandra surrounded by guards who say they killed her parents, and she burns them all.
quote: I can make the whole world burn.

summary: Jace sees Nissa mutated by Emrakul, ranting that growth is the answer, and she tells him she can do anything she wants.
quote: I can do anything I want. Anything at all.

summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

summary: The Raven Man tells Liliana her death is now the best possible outcome and she becomes afraid.
quote: You have doomed us both.

summary: Through a door at the stairway's end Jace meets an angel he recognizes as Emeria from Zendikar statues and wonders whether she is Emrakul.
quote: I know this angel.

summary: Emeria offers Jace a game of chess: if he wins, all stops and she will give him answers.
quote: If you win, this all stops. I will give you all the answers you want.

summary: Jace realizes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmates her.
quote: He put his hand on his queen, moved it into position.

summary: Jace's chess pieces mutate and kill each other, and the angel says they were always her pieces and she no longer wants to play.
quote: They are all my pieces, Jace Beleren.

summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

summary: Jace meets a copy of himself that makes him answer a riddle to prove he is Jace.
quote: No bigger than a pebble but my closing covers the entire world, what am I?

summary: Jace realizes he is not in a tower but is the tower, a mind spell he cast reflexively to shield everyone from Emrakul.
quote: I'm not in a tower. I am the tower.

summary: The copy explains it was a contingency Jace made to stay separate from himself and work out how to stop Emrakul.
quote: So I made a contingency plan to keep me separate from me

summary: The two Jaces merge; learning Liliana is about to die, Jace dissolves the spell and returns to reality.
quote: Jace dissolved the spell.

summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
