quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

summary: Tamiyo proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon and linking it to Emrakul.
quote: I have a binding spell. A powerful one. I can attune it to the moon.

summary: Nissa agrees to power the spell because Jace freed her mind from Emrakul's darkness.
quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren. I will try.

summary: Tamiyo begins reading her scroll and Jace fastens a glyph on the moon to Emrakul.
quote: A glyph flashed onto the moon

summary: Nissa collapses having drained the leylines, and the spell is about to fail.
quote: It was not going to be enough.

summary: Tamiyo, cut off from Jace's mind, reads a second iron-banded scroll, and a flood of mana pours into the spell.
quote: Tamiyo pulled out another scroll, a long scroll, a scroll with iron bands

summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
quote: May you rot there forever.

summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
quote: My very own Gatewatch.

summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
quote: It...she...took me over.

summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

summary: Tamiyo asks if they really won and flies off into the dark sky with no parting words.
quote: Eventually she rose and flew into the dark sky.

summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

summary: Kaya waits at the Wasp's Nest and her contact, a soldier in disguise wearing an iris brooch, arrives.
quote: when her contact walked in

summary: The soldier leads Kaya upstairs to meet his grace.
quote: His grace will see you now,

summary: Revari tells Kaya his late mother's manor is haunted, the workers refuse to enter, and he wants the ghost gone.
quote: there is no doubt in my mind: the place is haunted

summary: Kaya accepts the job despite taking an immediate dislike to Revari.
quote: I'll take the job.

summary: Revari pays Kaya half down and hands over the building plans.
quote: Half down, as I said in my letter.

summary: Kaya receives an unmarked envelope bearing only the Black Rose symbol, signalling that her big job has begun.
quote: just a symbol. The Black Rose.

summary: Kaya enters the manor at night and plugs her ears with wax.
quote: then withdrew the wax plugs from her pockets and worked them into her ears.

summary: Kaya taunts the spirit and the ghost appears in the east wing hallway, a clawed old woman, and shrieks at her.
quote: A spectral form appeared most of the way down the hallway

summary: Kaya phases through the wall to dodge the ghost and pins its shawl to the wall with a dagger.
quote: She lit up one of her daggers and pinned the shawl to the wall.

summary: Kaya stabs the ghost through the palm and wounds it, and it flees through the ceiling.
quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.

summary: Kaya runs into a bedroom with no floor, a secret not on the plans, and falls over the edge.
quote: The bedroom had no floor.

summary: Kaya grabs the ghost's spectral shawl to catch a ride out of the pit.
quote: closed spectral hands around the spectral shawl

summary: Kaya pries up floorboards in the wrecked tea room and finds the withered corpse of an old woman resembling the ghost.
quote: There, in the crawlspace, was the withered corpse of an old woman.

summary: Among the debris Kaya finds Revari's signet ring and realizes the truth about his mother.
quote: A signet ring. A familiar signet ring.

summary: Kaya tells Revari the ghost is dealt with, and he insists on inspecting the manor before paying.
quote: I can't be faulted for wishing to inspect your work before remitting payment.

summary: Kaya leads Revari into the east wing room and quietly closes the door behind him.
quote: Very quietly, Kaya closed the door behind him.

summary: Kaya confronts Revari, calling him kinslayer, as his mother's ghost appears behind him.
quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

summary: Kaya refuses Revari's plea for help and says she is defaulting on the job with cause.
quote: I'm defaulting, with cause,

summary: The ghost falls on Revari with teeth and claws as Kaya walks through the door and leaves him screaming.
quote: Then his mother's wailing ghost was upon him with those needle teeth and those dagger claws.

summary: Adriana stands guard as King Brago, now a paranoid ghost, meets with two Custodi ghosts in the great dining hall.
quote: King Brago sat at the head of his dining room table before a clean plate and sparkling silverware

summary: Adriana recalls being ordered to dismantle the Academy and purge invention from the city.
quote: To dismantle the Academy, to purge the pursuit of invention and innovation from the city.

summary: The Custodi bless Adriana with a formal goodbye before leaving.
quote: Adriana received the blessing willingly

summary: Adriana finds a servant girl throwing out the crown's plates because Her Ladyship dislikes them, hinting at a coming queen.
quote: Boss told us that Her Ladyship didn't like the plates,

summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

summary: Kaya says she was paid to hit only one mark and will not kill Adriana.
quote: I was paid to hit only one mark. I'm not going to kill you,

summary: Kaya tells Adriana that as long as tyrants die, freedom lives, and Adriana is struck by guilt.
quote: As long as tyrants die, the chance for freedom lives.

summary: Kaya sinks through the floor and escapes.
quote: The stranger straightened her jacket smartly and dropped into the floor.

summary: Adriana takes up Brago's sword, deciding it is safest in her hands.
quote: Adriana's fingers grazed the hilt of Brago's sword.

summary: The Custodi crown Marchesa as Queen of Paliano the next day.
quote: The Custodi crowned Queen Marchesa, the First of her Name, the following day.

summary: Adriana finds her guard shares her confusion and rage about the coup.
quote: Adriana was relieved to find all of them as deep in the dark as she was.

summary: Adriana realizes the coup took bribes to the Custodi, payment to the staff and to the assassin.
quote: Bribes to pay off the Custodi.

summary: Adriana confronts Marchesa about right of succession, and Marchesa says the Custodi accepted a legal will naming her heir.
quote: But the Custodi was very willing to accept properly filed legal documents.

summary: Marchesa reveals she dealt with Brago's descendants so that her name was next in succession.
quote: I dealt with them a while ago, however, and it just so happened that my name was next in the line of succession.

summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

summary: Marchesa offers Adriana a black-rose breastplate; Adriana refuses.
quote: You already know I'm not putting that on.

summary: Marchesa says that if the people call her a tyrant she will be tyrannical.
quote: Then I will be tyrannical

summary: Adriana spits in Marchesa's face and leaves with the breastplate.
quote: Adriana spat in the Queen's face.

summary: Adriana rides through the city dragging the rose breastplate behind her horse.
quote: tied the dreadful rose-adorned breastplate to a rope

summary: Marchesa publicly announces that the former captain has retired with a pension.
quote: The former captain has retired, with thanks from our fair city

summary: Adriana speaks to the crowd in the Thieves' Quarter, calling Marchesa's rule illegitimate and urging the people not to bow to her flag.
quote: Marchesa would have you stand with her, in service to a true crown resting upon a false head

summary: Members of Brago's guard secretly break their oaths to patrol the streets and protect citizens.
quote: Those who served in Brago's guard broke their oaths to the crown under cover of darkness

summary: Months later Adriana visits the elven explorer Selvala at her home.
quote: The elven explorer Selvala stood on the other side of the door

summary: Adriana proposes that Selvala serve as senator to halt Paliano's murderous monarchy.
quote: the finest nominee for a senator I can think of.

summary: Adriana asks Selvala to help build the Republic of Paliano.
quote: Will you help us build the Republic of Paliano?

summary: Marchesa announces to the people that King Brago is no more and has passed beyond the veil.
quote: Brago, King of Paliano, is no more.

summary: Marchesa declares herself Brago's designated heir, recognized by the Custodi, and vows to uphold the laws of Paliano.
quote: As his designated heir, recognized by the sacred order of Custodi as his one true successor

summary: Marchesa disbands the post of Captain of the Guard and puts the soldiers under her own command.
quote: the post of Captain of the Guard is disbanded.

summary: Marchesa warns would-be rebels that treason will be met with the harshest punishments.
quote: treason will be answered, as it always has been, with the harshest punishments

summary: Adriana tells the citizens they awoke as unwitting traitors under the banner of a usurper queen, Marchesa.
quote: You awoke as unwitting traitors beneath the bloodstained banner of a usurper queen

summary: Adriana accuses Marchesa of murdering King Brago and forging his will and of commanding the Custodi.
quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago

summary: Adriana notes that the City Troops' banners have changed and that Marchesa avoids the city's symbol.
quote: But the banners of the City Troops have already changed.

summary: Adriana declares she carries Brago's sword and, though stripped of her title, will not relinquish her duty to defend the city from the usurper.
quote: I know this because I now carry that sword

summary: Adriana urges the citizens to stand with her and Brago and disobey the pretender.
quote: stand with me, and with Brago, and show your loyalty to your city through your disobedience to the pretender.

summary: Paliano celebrates the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace while a lone sentry guards Fimarell's house.
quote: In the distance, the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace raged.

summary: A mob of goblins pelts the sentry with vegetables and a firebomb to draw him from his post.
quote: Weapon raised, he raced for them.

summary: Grenzo smashes in the villa door with his staff, grumbling that Marchesa locked him out of his dungeons.
quote: One sharp thump from his staff and the villa door crashed to the ground.

summary: Grenzo's goblins flood into the villa's foyer and start looting.
quote: The crowd of goblins flooded into the foyer

summary: Upstairs, Fimarell lies awake and recalls his former glory at the Academy, built on one invention and a lot of handshaking, until it all came crashing down (flashback).
quote: He was never a genius, he knew that

summary: Goblins have overpowered and tied up three city guards beneath a toppled bookshelf.
quote: Three city guards lay unconscious on the floor, pinned under a toppled bookshelf.

summary: Grenzo smashes Fimarell's desk and says the papers of praise are fuel.
quote: This is fuel.

summary: Daretti finds blueprints for one of the first cogwork sentries bearing the Academy seal.
quote: It's the blueprints for a cogwork sentry.

summary: Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

summary: Daretti, stirred, tells Grenzo to burn everything.
quote: Burn it. Burn it all. Burn the ashes.

summary: Daretti finds yellowed parchment among the papers that tells him it is time for fresher prey.
quote: He withdrew some yellowed parchment.

summary: At the top of the stairs Daretti forgets his speech and Grenzo prompts him through it.
quote: I've forgotten it.

summary: Fimarell spots the goblins in the hallway, yells thieves and slams his bedroom door.
quote: "Thieves!" Fimarell yelled and slammed the door.

summary: Daretti delivers his speech accusing Fimarell of falsehood and deception.
quote: And it is the burden of the honest to bring lies to bear and carry the falsifier to justice.

summary: Daretti's chair extends mechanical legs and raises him like a spider over Fimarell.
quote: Daretti's chair extended its mechanical legs

summary: Daretti reveals that Fimarell criticized his words and then took them as his own.
quote: You built your career on the back of my words.

summary: Daretti gags Fimarell with a page of the stolen manuscript.
quote: He balled up the top page of the manuscript and shoved it into Fimarell's mouth.

summary: Daretti heaves Fimarell through the window; he falls two stories to the street.
quote: Daretti reached under Fimarell's legs and heaved him up and through the window.

summary: Grenzo burns the manuscript in a pot and drops burning refuse onto the street.
quote: Grenzo dropped the torch after them.

summary: Grenzo's minions smash the furniture, pile it with papers and pour oil on it.
quote: One poured oil over the pile.

summary: Grenzo and Daretti bicker over who is whose protege while the fire takes hold of the villa.
quote: The flames caught quickly and the fire crackled, crawling up the walls.

summary: Daretti names Alendis, who apparently joined the Custodi, as his next target; Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa.
quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.

summary: Grenzo muses that Marchesa once ran in shadows but now locks every door, and proposes crashing all their parties.
quote: Now she's got her comfy chair and locks every door at night.

summary: Leovold notes that on the day of her ascension Marchesa decorated the throne room, guards and capital with Black Rose emblems, doubting her claim of Brago's will.
quote: the throne room is immediately decorated in Black Rose tapestries

summary: Leovold relays rumors that an assassin infiltrated the palace, possibly walking through walls, to kill Brago, and that the queen's crown now glows with his energy.
quote: an assassin infiltrated the palace, by some accounts walking through stone walls, in order to reach Brago's chambers.

summary: Leovold recounts that Selvala once drafted the Charter with Brago and was repaid with betrayal and imprisonment (backstory).
quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

summary: Leovold meets Selvala at a cafe, suggests a capable caretaker should rule, and promises her Trestian cousins' support.
quote: her cousins back in Trest would be extremely interested in supporting her in any of her future endeavors

summary: Leovold observes that Adriana barely survived the queen's ascension and expects emissaries to keep pressing her.
quote: She has only narrowly survived the queen's ascension

summary: Adriana rejects Leovold's overture; his messenger returns with a broken nose.
quote: the messenger returned with a broken nose and a completely ruined shirt.

summary: Leovold concludes that Marchesa's persona as mother of assassins was a distraction and the throne was always her target.
quote: The throne was always her target.

summary: Marchesa issues policies and proclamations drafted long before to consolidate power.
quote: Within hours of taking the throne, there have been proclamations and policies, clearly drafted weeks and months before.

summary: Leovold makes an official outreach to Marchesa on Trest's behalf.
quote: I have made an official outreach on Trest's behalf.

summary: Grenzo infiltrates Adriana's gatherings and turns peaceful demonstrations into violent mobs.
quote: He has twice now taken advantage of large gatherings assembled by Captain Adriana

summary: One of Leovold's attaches intercepts a dead drop containing the queen's dossier on Leovold.
quote: one of my diplomatic attachés interrupted a dead drop from one of the new queen's agents

summary: Lucia Covi reports to Marchesa on Leovold, his parties and the embassy's possible spying.
quote: I have gathered the following information regarding the recently appointed ambassador from the city-state of Trest.

summary: Leovold reports that Marchesa has replaced the city guard with loyal spies and assassins as she prepares to confront Adriana.
quote: The city guard has been largely thrown over in favor of troops loyal only to Marchesa

summary: Adriana stages prison breaks to bring her former guards back to her side while Grenzo abdicates his post.
quote: Adriana has managed to stage some rather daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side

summary: Leovold notes that Selvala and others look to exploit the unrest against the nobility.
quote: Some, including the illustrious and storied Selvala, are looking to take advantage of the unrest

summary: Liliana wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
quote: Morning, Liliana

summary: Liliana guesses Chandra spent the night at the Izzet air races.
quote: You went to see the Izzet air races.

summary: Shadowblayde learns through Mihir's bird that Pashiri was spotted at the Dhund.
quote: Pashiri was spotted twenty minutes ago.

summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

summary: Ajani asks Shadowblayde to prepare a fast, secret escape route while he goes in alone.
quote: Can you find us a means of escape? Something fast. Secret.

summary: Shadowblayde gives Ajani a mechanical bird to lead him to a Dhund entrance.
quote: When you're close to a Dhund entrance, he'll fly to it.

summary: Ajani shows his face to Shadowblayde, who tells him her real name, Vatti.
quote: That's my mundane name. Vatti.

summary: Following the mechanical bird, Ajani enters the Dhund and knocks out a guard.
quote: He backhanded the guard into the wall and winced at the sudden scent of blood.

summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
quote: To find the man who killed your family.

summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
quote: Elspeth is dead.

summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
quote: another monster struck her down

summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
quote: It should have been me. Not her.

summary: Ajani vaults the rail, sheds Grandmother's cloak and gauntlets and attacks the guards at the poison chamber.
quote: They unclasped and fell away.

summary: Ajani swings for a guard's throat but reads his soul and decides he is just a man.
quote: Not a Planeswalker. Not a villain.

summary: Ajani smashes the guard's chestplate without killing him and sends the other fleeing.
quote: It smashed across the guard's chestplate, scattering twisted metal shards across the marble floor.

summary: Ajani pries open the poison container door with his axe.
quote: he peeled the screeching machine open.

summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

summary: Ajani heals Grandmother Pashiri's poisoned blood.
quote: burning away the black, filling her blood with clean air

summary: Ajani heals Chandra's poisoned blood and lungs.
quote: Silver tendrils of healing magic raced through her, cleansing the impurities

summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
quote: We have a ride,

summary: Ajani lets the guard he struck go home, repeating that he does not kill anymore.
quote: Go home to your family,

summary: Ral Zarek privately meets Jace at a Rakdos show to tell him about an irregular planeswalk.
quote: An irregular planeswalk.

summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

summary: Ral reveals he can still detect when Jace leaves Ravnica, and chides him for leaving the Guildpact.
quote: First to Zendikar, then off to Innistrad, was it?

summary: Ral warns Jace that others would love his position and to make more effort.
quote: Just remember there are those who'd love to be in the position you've blundered your way into.

summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

summary: Liliana demands that Jace come to Kaladesh and bring the muscle, then planeswalks away.
quote: Come to Kaladesh. Bring the muscle.

summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

summary: Chandra decides to face Tezzeret's challenge despite the risk of another trap.
quote: He's calling me out,

summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
quote: What's a Gatewatch?

summary: A thopter photographs the group and delivers the images to Consul Kambal aboard the Skysovereign.
quote: one that showed the target, Nalaar, daughter of Renegade Prime

summary: Kambal tells the courier to inform Inspector Baan that the bait is set and the confiscation can be prepared.
quote: Alert Inspector Baan. The bait is set. Prepare the confiscation.

summary: Pia, manacled backstage at the same arena where Chandra was almost executed, hopes her daughter stays away.
quote: This was the place where Chandra had searched the stands for her mother before being torn out of the world.

summary: Baral taunts Pia, telling her Chandra's rescue attempt went awry in the wrong place.
quote: They came looking for you. In the entirely wrong place, sadly.

summary: The announcer declares Rashmi top prize winner of the Fair and prizewinning inventions are quietly taken by guards.
quote: An announcer was proclaiming that Rashmi had won top prize at the Fair

summary: The duel starts with Pia and Tezzeret each given a container of basic parts.
quote: Let the showdown...begin!

summary: Pia's booby-trapped servo destroys the legs of Tezzeret's crawler.
quote: The servo burst in a small sphere of smoke and pieces, and blew the legs off the crawler.

summary: Tezzeret's devices devour her parts, kill her thopter and he summons an army of automatons around her.
quote: Bands of metal curved unnaturally at his will, coiling in on themselves to become a small squad of other sharp-legged automatons.

summary: Tezzeret declares he will mete out justice and sets his automaton to kill Pia.
quote: I will mete out proper justice for yours.

summary: A bolt of fire from the audience fells the attacking automaton; Chandra has intervened.
quote: The bolt of fire had streaked out of the audience

summary: Chandra leaps into the arena, refusing her mother's order to leave and declaring she will not lose her again.
quote: And I'm not losing you again!

summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

summary: Jace warns that Tezzeret's blocked mind means he was prepared and they have made a mistake.
quote: if he knew to block his mind, it means he was prepared for this.

summary: Chandra compresses a blinding point of fire to kill Tezzeret as Liliana urges her on.
quote: Chandra's fist closed, compressing fire into a tiny point of blinding, seething heat.

summary: The Skysovereign eclipses the arena with its turret ready to fire.
quote: A stark shadow passed over the arena

summary: Tezzeret announces the end of the Inventors' Fair and rises into the airship, retreating.
quote: And this concludes the Inventors' Fair, everyone.

summary: Nissa tells Chandra it is over, and Chandra runs into her mother's arms.
quote: Her mother held her arms open. Chandra ran and fell into them.

summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
quote: He's building something

summary: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers seize inventions across the fairgrounds, provoking panic and anger among the inventors.
quote: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers were seizing inventions in their characteristically clumsy fashion

summary: Baan advises an enforcer how to disable a lifecraft elephant by cutting its exposed cable.
quote: All that is required is to sever the cable, and the entire automaton will collapse.

summary: Baan orders the elven lifecrafter taken into custody for the disturbance.
quote: Take the elf into custody to answer for this disturbance.

summary: Baan touches Tezzeret's arm and realizes the metal claw is a replacement limb he had not noticed before.
quote: he realized it was part of the arm

summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

summary: Tezzeret claims the confiscations are safeguarding the inventions from renegade attack.
quote: It's not as though we're stealing their inventions. We're safeguarding them.

summary: Tezzeret snarls that there is no time, then sheds his rage, which Baan notices.
quote: There's no time

summary: Tezzeret offers Baan the job of leading Consulate exploration of the confiscated inventions.
quote: And who better than you to lead that effort?

summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

summary: Tezzeret orders Baan to fix the situation, secure an inquirium for himself and keep the Bastion on alert.
quote: You need to fix this, Baan.

summary: Tezzeret reveals that Rashmi's work has staggering implications larger than Kaladesh and will be his focus.
quote: Rashmi's work for the fair had staggering implications.

summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

summary: Baan soothes an angry inventor whose thopter fabricator is being confiscated, assuring him the Consulate is grateful.
quote: The Consulate is grateful.

summary: Baan reaches the storage facility where scientists catalog the confiscated inventions, which he now oversees.
quote: Top scientists and inventors from every Consulate inquirium in the city had been sent here

summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.
quote: Increased Bastion presence. Curfews, perhaps.

summary: Kynaios and Tiro rise together to challenge the tyrant Agnomakhos and rally the people.
quote: Kynaios and Tiro, joined by their love for one another and for freedom, rose to challenge him.

summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire with Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
quote: The polis of Meletis was founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom and enlightenment

summary: Ludevic becomes the most prolific builder of monsters from animated dead tissue in Nephalia.
quote: From his remote laboratory in Nephalia, Ludevic has established himself as the most prolific practitioner of a terrifying tradition

summary: Ludevic spends nearly a decade trying to replicate Kraum, which terrorizes Selhoff.
quote: Since creating Kraum, the necro-alchemist Ludevic has spent almost a decade trying to replicate that singular work of genius.

summary: Sidar Kondo is killed by his own son Vuel, consumed by envy.
quote: Kondo died by his own son's hands.

summary: Knights from Bant drive Yidris into the Maelstrom, which stabilizes his mutations.
quote: Knights from Bant drove Yidris into the Maelstrom, a volatile storm of raw mana at the plane's center.

summary: Kruphix reveals to Kydele the nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse.
quote: Kruphix himself revealed to Kydele the true nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse, a sight she can never unsee.

summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

summary: Vial Smasher spends a lifetime handling and smashing vials of dragonfire in the Kolaghan clan.
quote: she has spent a lifetime handling—and smashing—vials of this dangerous substance

summary: Saskia survives a massacre, builds a stone monument alone for years, then leads thousands to war on her enemies.
quote: Saskia was the sole survivor of a massacre conducted against her village by an invading army from across the sea.

summary: A chariot accident blinds Tymna and ends her career among the Battlewise of Meletis.
quote: A career filled with victories was cut short by a chariot accident, leaving her blind.

summary: Ravos strikes a deal with Athreos to guide the dead in exchange for yearly visits with his lover.
quote: Ravos swore to help Athreos guide the dead to the Underworld in exchange for seeing his dead lover once each year.

summary: Saprolings take in the abandoned child Tana and she grows into a feral hunter.
quote: a pod of fungal saprolings took her in and protected her from the wild

summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.
quote: Ikra Shidiqi, his naga advisor, betrayed him to the dragonlord Silumgar.

summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to the dragon Dromoka, rallies the Abzan as their final khan, and dies in the khanfall.
quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

summary: Ishai gains autonomy and authority as Ojutai's attendant.
quote: Ishai's word carries the full authority of Ojutai

summary: Breya discovers carmot in Jund and replaces most of her body with etherium she created herself.
quote: To prove her achievement, Breya replaced the majority of her organic body with etherium she created herself.

summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

summary: Bruse Tarl organizes a nomad resistance against the Eldrazi on Akoum.
quote: Bruse organized a resistance force of nomads.

summary: Silas Renn rises in the Seekers of Carmot and receives the first etherium heart.
quote: he was honored with the first etherium heart ever produced

summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

summary: The Consulate announces the Inventors' Fair, to be held for a month across downtown Ghirapur.
quote: For a full month, the fairgrounds will span the whole of downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh.

summary: Head Judge Tezzeret calls for theoretical breakthroughs in the Aether Science category.
quote: Head Judge Tezzeret himself has put out the call for any and all theoretical breakthroughs

summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

summary: Chandra hears from Dovin Baan that Kaladesh is threatened and returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.
quote: She returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.

summary: Nissa follows her friend Chandra to Kaladesh to help.
quote: Nissa follows to help.

summary: Chandra and Liliana arrive at the Inventors' Fair and pursue a suspicious cloaked figure.
quote: they pursue the person through the Fair.

summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

summary: Yahenni, minutes from death, stumbles through the curfew-empty Weldfast looking for someone to be with them.
quote: It is dark and I am the only person shambling under the eaves of the Weldfast.

summary: Yahenni realizes they will die alone and panics, then smells a familiar friend.
quote: I'm going to die alone.

summary: Yahenni finds Nived painting the renegade leaking spire over torn Consulate banners at the Museum of Invention.
quote: From across the street I can make out a human figure putting the final touches on their graffiti.

summary: Yahenni apologizes to Nived for canceling his catering of their Penultimate Party at the last moment.
quote: "I'm sorry...I canceled...less than a day prior to when my party was scheduled..."

summary: A Consulate enforcer and an armament automaton arrest Nived for vandalism and shock him unconscious with an energy device.
quote: Nived screams, seizes, and topples to the ground.

summary: The enforcer repeatedly shocks and kicks the unconscious Nived while demanding what Yahenni knows about six renegade sympathizers, including Pia Nalaar's daughter.
quote: I'm looking for six individuals that are sympathetic to the renegades' cause.

summary: Yahenni drains the enforcer's essence, killing them, feeling their death, and restoring their own body for twelve days.
quote: I claw my right hand and pull from the enforcer's neck.

summary: Yahenni realizes they have killed a person and are a murderer, but rationalizes that they may live by killing bad people.
quote: ...I am a murderer.

summary: Yahenni hides Nived behind a stall and decides to find the renegades and the criminal's daughter, then seek Gonti's help.
quote: I need to find the renegades.

summary: Yahenni gets Nived home and reaches Gonti's palace-like hideout, where Gonti is bathing in aether attar, a metal lump visible on their chest.
quote: Gonti sits submerged, their face covered with a gilded mask.

summary: Yahenni blackmails Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, asking where Chandra and Pia Nalaar are hiding.
quote: "If you tell me where they are hiding, I will keep the secret of your manufactured heart to myself.

summary: Gonti realizes Yahenni is an essence drainer and reveals having employed two before.
quote: "Essence drainers are rare," Gonti replies, "I've only ever had two in my employment.

summary: Gonti reveals the renegades' safe house in the Statuary Garden and tasks Yahenni with warning them that the Consulate is coming, to force them into acting.
quote: You'll find the younger Nalaar and her associates in a safe house within the Statuary Garden.

summary: Yahenni goes to the Statuary Garden and climbs a ladder up a Vedalken inventor's statue where they sense the hidden renegades.
quote: I walk casually toward the statue and start to climb a ladder around the back.

summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
quote: My penthouse is safe.

summary: Yahenni, descending the ladder, sees a Consulate cruiser speeding toward the statue and leaps onto its hood, draining the enforcer driver to death.
quote: And I jump down.

summary: The enforcer's cruiser crashes into another statue; Yahenni's life is extended to twenty-two days.
quote: I now have twenty-two days left to live.

summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

summary: Nissa comforts Yahenni with a current of land energy, telling them they are her friend; Yahenni resolves to do good with their remaining days.
quote: "Because you are my friend," she says delicately.

summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

summary: A thopter signals Gideon that Pia has news, and he returns to Yahenni's penthouse.
quote: Gideon sighed. Pia had news.

summary: On the roof, Gideon tells Chandra the Gatewatch came for her, not to topple the Consulate; Chandra accuses him of silence.
quote: "We came for you."

summary: Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

summary: Gideon confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces; she argues death is a tool and they had to.
quote: "We don't kill."

summary: Liliana says there is just one person she wants to kill on this plane and tells Gideon Tezzeret destroyed something that was hers.
quote: "He hurt something important to me. Destroyed something that was mine."

summary: Gideon withstands a charging Consulate charger in Bomat and shields its driver.
quote: The charger smashed into Gideon.

summary: A Consulate automaton knocks Gideon through a wall.
quote: a massive metallic fist slammed into Gideon, sending him flying and crashing through the wall of a nearby building.

summary: Saheeli reassembles scrap into replica automatons and uses a golden automaton to destroy the Consulate automaton.
quote: Saheeli pumped a fist in triumph.

summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
quote: "We all heard the commotion."

summary: Saheeli reveals she has found where Tezzeret is hiding, in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire, where he holds the winning inventor.
quote: He has locked himself away in a private workshop, hidden in the central Aether Spire.

summary: Nissa and Yahenni confirm an unusual flux of aether is being diverted from the Aether Hub to the Spire's reservoir.
quote: Miss Nissa and I have recently determined an unusual flux of aether being diverted to that particular reservoir from the Aether Hub.

summary: Liliana volunteers to infiltrate with Saheeli; Gideon reluctantly agrees and tells her to do what is right.
quote: "Fine. Liliana will go."

summary: Pia proposes the renegades capture the Aether Hub to cut power to the Spire, and reveals they have a big invention only needing aether.
quote: "We take the Aether Hub."

summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

summary: Gideon persuades Chandra to lead by example for the renegades instead of joining the diversion.
quote: "Lead by example. Lead by your strength."

summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

summary: Rashmi works alone in the Spire Inquirium, missing her assistant Mitul whom the functionaries refuse to bring.
quote: It had been four weeks since she'd asked for Mitul to be brought on

summary: Rashmi notices that aerowright Sana's workstation was emptied after Tezzeret's first progress check.
quote: The sight of aerowright Sana's empty workstation dissolved any spirit of comradery

summary: Tezzeret arrives for a progress check and bends Bhavin's automaton's arm, then throws Bhavin out and takes his invention.
quote: "You've failed. Get out."

summary: Tezzeret tells the inventors that anything made in the Inquirium belongs to the Consulate.
quote: "Anything made in this Inquirium belongs to the Consulate."

summary: Rashmi presents the scaled-up transporter and works out the answer to Tezzeret's nonlinear-transport question.
quote: If I insert an attenuator into the aether-loop

summary: Tezzeret has a functionary dismissed for objecting to rerouting aether and threatens to terminate Rashmi if she cannot move Bhavin's automaton by the next check.
quote: "If you don't, you will be terminated."

summary: Four weeks later, the other inventors have been moved out, and Rashmi, pushed to exhaustion, finishes the transporter on the morning of the progress check.
quote: "It's finished."

summary: Setting the target, Rashmi's mind is pulled through the phantom dimensions and she glimpses many other worlds before Tezzeret's footsteps pull her back.
quote: And then she was Rashmi, the elf, kneeling on the floor in the Inquirium

summary: Rashmi tells Tezzeret of the phantom dimensions; he laughs at her, declares the transporter his, and dismisses her.
quote: "This beautiful creation is now mine. And thus I am done with you."

summary: Tezzeret threatens to kill Rashmi and then bring Mitul to complete the transporter and kill him too, and sends functionaries to fetch Mitul.
quote: I will bring your little friend—Mitul, I believe was his name—to complete the transporter

summary: Rashmi chooses to save Mitul over the dimensions she has seen.
quote: And she would choose Mitul.

summary: Rashmi secretly sends a warning note to Mitul through the old transporter ring while distracting Tezzeret.
quote: dropping the ball of paper through the ring. It disappeared.

summary: Rashmi rigs the transporter so the demonstration backfires; Tezzeret's test sends the automaton onto a box, crushing the desk and shattering the window.
quote: Too big to fit, Bhavin's masterpiece crushed the box

summary: Rashmi leaps out of the window on a harness cable and escapes Tezzeret above Ghirapur.
quote: she sprinted to the gaping hole and leapt out into the swirling aether beyond.

summary: Saheeli rescues Rashmi in her construct and tells her Mitul is safe.
quote: "He's safe," Saheeli said.

summary: Rashmi realizes Saheeli knew the transporter's implications and senses the planeswalker nature in her; Saheeli welcomes her to the renegade movement.
quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend. I have much to tell you."

summary: Pia brings Chandra to an aetherborn club protected by Gonti where sympathetic inventors gather, asking Chandra to give the speech to spark rebellion.
quote: Chandra, I want you to do it.

summary: Chandra speaks about losing her father Kiran, but the speech falls apart and she leaves the stage.
quote: "Hi. I'm, well, I guess you know who I am. Chandra Nalaar. Pia's daughter."

summary: The crowd erupts into angry complaints about what the Consulate took from them, nearly becoming a riot.
quote: The spark had caught quickly, and within minutes; the club threatened to become a riot

summary: An aetherborn emissary calms the crowd and leads Pia, Chandra and others down a secret tunnel to meet Gonti.
quote: revealing a tunnel and a descending set of stairs.

summary: Chandra accuses Gonti of betraying them, but Gonti says he pushed them to act and offers the contents of his storeroom for the insurrection.
quote: I believe I have what you'll need for your little insurrection.

summary: Junctions at the Aether Hub malfunction as Sram is called to investigate by a Consulate escort.
quote: That was the fourth junction that had "malfunctioned" this evening

summary: Consul Kambal demands Sram carry out Tezzeret's order to divert the city's aether to the Spire; Sram demands it in writing.
quote: "You have your orders, Senior Edificer," said Kambal.

summary: Explosions at the Hub interrupt the dispute and Kambal flees by airship.
quote: "Explosion at junction nine!" said an edificer.

summary: Sram orders a full lockdown and then shuts down the pumps, guessing the renegades jammed the shutoffs open.
quote: "Kill the pumps. Now!"

summary: The renegades storm the Hub by gondola and breach the security doors, killing Kailash and defeating her troops.
quote: Kailash and her troops went down fighting.

summary: Pia confronts Sram, who yields the Aether Hub to the renegades.
quote: "Then I yield," said Sram. "The Aether Hub is yours."

summary: Rashmi and Mitul finish the skyship while renegades are away, Rashmi planning to leave and stop inventing afterward.
quote: This was the last thing she would make that would be used for harm.

summary: The renegades return victorious; Pia announces the Hub is won and calls on them to bring down Tezzeret.
quote: "We've won the day!" Pia cried to more cheers.

summary: Rashmi finds the initials K.N. on the skyship and feels Kiran's spirit and love of invention through the filigree.
quote: Two letters, carefully carved by an artistic hand: K.N.

summary: Rashmi realizes the revolution is about the spirit of invention and decides to stay.
quote: There was more to this skyship, more to this revolution, than she had allowed herself to see.

summary: Rashmi dedicates the skyship as the Heart of Kiran, and Mitul and Rashmi remain to pursue temporal aether research.
quote: So I dedicate this skyship the Heart of Kiran,
