quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

summary: Through a cascade of nightmares, Nissa hears an inner voice telling her to stop, and realizes she is trapped in the trial's illusion.
quote: There had been one nightmare after another, each one cascading into the next.

summary: Nissa studies the leyline structure of the trap, finds a tiny gap with her eyes shut, widens it and steps through.
quote: In the weavings of magic surrounding her, there was a tiny gap.

summary: Seeing through the illusions, Nissa witnesses a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, starting with Amonkhet.
quote: For what I require, I would drain every world.

summary: Nissa sees a vision of eight stars, three of which go dark, leaving a pattern like horns.
quote: Their new outline suggested a pair of horns.

summary: Visions show mummies mining blue ore, three children swallowed by the sands, a line of darkness stretching through thousands of worlds, and a golden sun disc crumbling.
quote: she saw an unbroken line of darkness from Amonkhet all the way back to the beginning of the line.

summary: The illusory angel appears, asks if Nissa is pawn or queen, and tells her to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.
quote: Stop being a piece, Nissa. Be the hand that moves.

summary: Kefnet appears and furiously demands who mocks his trial.
quote: It was the god himself, Kefnet.

summary: Kefnet plucks Nissa's thoughts and tells her knowledge is earned, offering dissolution as kindness to the unworthy.
quote: Dissolution is my kindness for you.

summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

summary: Kefnet declares she has passed her trial and flies away.
quote: You have passed your trial.

summary: Nissa resolves to stop being a pawn, notes the pattern she left in Kefnet, dispels the illusions, and leaves the temple.
quote: She was tired of being a pawn, constantly reacting to nightmares and failures, never ahead.

summary: Gideon follows Oketra through Naktamun and watches her warm, kind interactions with the people.
quote: There was no groveling, no fear from the masses before an almighty presence.

summary: Gideon, wearing a cartouche Oketra gave him, comes to a celebration square where initiates feast before the Trial of Ambition.
quote: I noticed all these initiates had cartouches with three segments.

summary: Oketra tells Gideon this is where the Trials begin, then leaves him with the initiate Djeru, who greets him as a friend.
quote: I am Djeru of the Tah crop.

summary: Djeru spars with Gideon and wins, then introduces him to the crop.
quote: You're good. You could be better. Come.

summary: Gideon learns that crops lose members through the Trials, and Djeru's crop is replacing one lost the day before.
quote: Many other crops are culled significantly from Trial to Trial, and reformed with others.

summary: Meris names the lost dissenter Samut, angering Djeru, who explains she chose heresy and was removed; Gideon recalls seeing a woman shouting that the gods lie.
quote: She is a dissenter ,

summary: Bontu stalks into the square and asks who deserves to compete in her Trial; Gideon boldly asks whether even the gods are born strong.
quote: Not even the gods?

summary: Bontu laughs at Gideon's brazenness and names him and the twenty members of the Tah crop as the next to face her Trial.
quote: You shall be next to face my Trial

summary: Viziers lead the crop into Bontu's monument and arm them for the Trial.
quote: Bontu has no patience for dawdling supplicants,

summary: Dedi wades into a filth pool to turn a crank that raises a bridge, but acid filth floods the chamber and dissolves him as the crop flees; one initiate is lost.
quote: skin and flesh sloughed off his forearm, revealing bone.

summary: Djeru and Tausret insist the crop press on, calling Dedi's death glorious, which disturbs Gideon.
quote: Dedi died a glorious death.

summary: An ammit attacks the crop in the second chamber and kills an initiate.
quote: with one powerful bite, the ammit had caught an initiate in its jaws.

summary: Gideon charges the ammit and finds his sural cannot cut it; his golden shield holds but cannot free him from its grip.
quote: Golden ripples of light danced across my body as I focused my magic

summary: Hepthys drives the ammit off Gideon with wind magic and is caught in the air and devoured.
quote: swallowing its prize in two snapping bites.

summary: Djeru rebukes Gideon for treating each glorious death as a tragedy and sends the crop through a corridor of bladed pendulums in order of speed.
quote: What is wrong with you?

summary: The ammit chases the last runners into the corridor and a blade kills Setha.
quote: a rogue blade reduced Setha to a black and red smear of viscera.

summary: Gideon uses his golden shield to smash through the swinging blades, disabling the trap, and Djeru grows suspicious of his abilities.
quote: The first one smashed into me, shattering and launching me into the wall

summary: Four initiates volunteer to stand on pillars to open the door while holding the ammit and monsters; Djeru swaps Masika for Tausret and the four are left behind.
quote: Masika. I need you to switch with Tausret.

summary: Gideon is rebuked for wanting to stay and the crop leaves the four to die.
quote: Where is your ambition?

summary: The nine survivors reach Bontu's summit chamber, having lost Imi to scarabs, and Bontu displays a scale at a bridge across serpent-filled water.
quote: We were now nine.

summary: Bontu announces her toll of one heart from each, saying the initiates' numbers are too great.
quote: Pay the toll, or fall short and perish.

summary: The initiates turn on each other for hearts: Neit kills an initiate, Kamat fights Neit, and Nassor kills Tarik.
quote: Neit was charging across toward the scales

summary: Meris and Djeru choose not to fight; Djeru embraces Meris and then drowns him in the serpent pool, cutting out his heart for the toll.
quote: Then he shoved him into the water.

summary: Bontu drains Gideon's strength with her gaze and commands him to watch while Djeru finishes the killing.
quote: Watch, Kytheon Iora. Quiet your judgment, and learn.

summary: Gideon furiously denounces the slaughter and dives across to confront Bontu, who calls him brazen and ignorant of her world.
quote: What mockery of faith and divinity is this madness?

summary: Bontu rebukes Gideon as shallow and selfish for judging instead of understanding, and tells him doubt is the shadow of faith.
quote: You look only for what satisfies your sense of justice.

summary: Bontu commands Gideon to leave her temple, and he exits and realizes the anointed are the remnants of fallen initiates.
quote: The anointed are the remnants of initiates fallen in battle.

summary: Gideon tears the cartouche from his neck, resolving to strike down Bolas.
quote: I tore the cartouche from my neck, dropping it on the ground before me.

summary: On the eve of their Harvest, Samut finds Nakht by the river and the friends play-fight, joined by Djeru.
quote: Samut gave him a playful shove, sending him stumbling back into the water

summary: Nakht confesses his fears that the three will be separated and that his faith may falter; Samut says that questions are part of faith.
quote: What if my faith falters?

summary: The trio sneaks out of the Children's Quarters at night, and Nakht reveals he can command water.
quote: a small gush of water swirled sprang from the fountain and danced around his fingertips.

summary: Samut leads her friends to an old mural of Hazoret and strange fighting forms, which she performs.
quote: Samut assumed the first stance on the mural

summary: Nakht wonders aloud whether there was a time before the gods, unsettling his friends.
quote: if there ever was a time before the gods.

summary: Djeru shows his secret, a hole in the Hekma, and Nakht persuades the others to go out and look for themselves.
quote: working his way through the near-invisible hole in the Hekma

summary: The three children crawl through the barrier into the desert wastes.
quote: then dropped to her belly and began crawling through to the other side.

summary: In the desert they find a half-buried statue and ruins, and a gigantic limbed thing in the distance sends them fleeing.
quote: a looming . . . thing shuffled across the sand.

summary: In a ruined shrine they find the word Trespasser freshly carved beneath the God-Pharaoh's symbol.
quote: Trespasser.

summary: Rotting corpses rise from the oasis and swarm the shrine, which Djeru calls dissenters returned by the curse of wandering.
quote: From the stagnant water and the surrounding sands, rotting corpses started to rise.

summary: Nakht draws the risen away and conjures a whirlpool to hold them while Samut and Djeru escape.
quote: The stagnant waters beneath him swirled into a whirlpool

summary: A shadowy horror freezes Nakht in flight, appears before him, and consumes him.
quote: Then the darkness consumed him.

summary: Samut sees Nakht wither to a lifeless husk, and Djeru tackles her out of sight; they flee back to the city at dawn.
quote: She heard his soul-rending screech as he instantly withered and decayed

summary: Years later, the loss hardens Djeru's faith while Samut takes up doubt and searches the ancient parts of Naktamun.
quote: took up the mantle of doubt and questions

summary: Samut finds a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument and sees the God-Pharaoh named Trespasser.
quote: The walls of the shadowed chamber spoke of the God-Pharaoh's first arrival on Amonkhet

summary: Samut realizes that the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the calamity rather than saving the plane, and resolves to warn everyone.
quote: He caused it.

summary: As Samut sprints from the chamber, dark magic flickers to life across the runes.
quote: a dark magic slowly flickered to life across the runes.

summary: Samut hides in an old embalming chamber after fleeing viziers and the anointed, and meets Djeru, who came disguised as a mummy.
quote: The wholesome face of her friend Djeru emerged

summary: Samut begs Djeru not to enter the final Trial, claiming the God-Pharaoh is a lie, but he refuses and walks out.
quote: Don't go to the final Trial.

summary: Samut mentions Nakht, and Djeru angrily says Nakht died unworthy because of their foolish trespass.
quote: Nakht died unworthy , out there in the dunes, because of our stupidity.

summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

summary: Samut enters Hazoret's monument and requests an audience with the god.
quote: I request an audience, mighty Hazoret.

summary: Samut asks Hazoret not to take Djeru's life, and Hazoret questions her right to cage his heart.
quote: I have come to plead for Djeru's survival.

summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

summary: Hazoret curses Samut and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
quote: Seize the dissenter.

summary: Samut is imprisoned in a sarcophagus among other dissenters, who tell her dissenters are the monsters of the Trial of Zeal.
quote: The monsters initiates face in the final Trial are the dissenters themselves.

summary: Samut explains that she needs to save Djeru, believing he could convince a god they were lied to.
quote: If anyone could convince a god they'd been lied to, it's him.

summary: Gideon and Chandra free Samut from the sarcophagus, telling her they came to rescue her.
quote: He explained that they saw her days ago evading capture and came to rescue her.

summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
quote: My third demon is here.

summary: Samut forces the group to focus on rescuing Djeru, and Gideon swears to help.
quote: I swear to help you save the life of your friend.

summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
quote: Your time has come

summary: The dissidents awake in the arena with cartouches of control, and Nissa learns to move against the cartouche by treating it like a leyline.
quote: They work like leylines

summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

summary: The battle magic fades, and Djeru surrenders his khopesh and prays for Samut's glorified death.
quote: Djeru concluded with his khopesh on the ground, a formal surrender.

summary: Hazoret asks Djeru to claim his place, and he accepts, but Samut declines Hazoret's gift.
quote: Without hesitation, she shook her head.

summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

summary: Djeru, enraged that his chance at a glorious death is gone, beats on Gideon and weeps that he wants to exist.
quote: Because I want to exist!

summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

summary: Gideon, left behind, recalls Hazoret whispering to him that she sees his death and that he is no god.
quote: for I see your death, Kytheon Iora.

summary: Sobeslav, Jarad's assistant, reads letters in the Guildhall and finds one from Mazirek of the kraul inviting Jarad.
quote: From Mazirek of the kraul.

summary: Sobeslav laughs and tosses the invitation in the rot pit, then decides to investigate and orders fifteen guards assembled.
quote: Assemble fifteen members of the guard,

summary: Sobeslav uses a spell on the mushroom to find the meeting place and leads the guards on a three-day descent below the Undercity.
quote: On their third morning of journeying, Sobeslav called his guards to a halt.

summary: Sobeslav and his guards squeeze through a crevice into a cavern with a carved slab and discover hundreds of kraul clinging to the ceiling.
quote: There, clinging to the ceiling, waiting for their arrival, were the kraul.

summary: Mazirek drops from the ceiling and mocks Sobeslav as Jarad's lapdog; the kraul laugh and begin killing the Golgari by mind-attack.
quote: I invited Jarad vod Savo, and I received his lapdog instead.

summary: Mazirek asks what the Golgari think of the kraul, and Sobeslav answers that they are laborers who must pay their dues.
quote: The kraul are . . . laborers. Workers.

summary: Guards collapse one by one as Mazirek kills them with the kraul's laughter, one piece of brain at a time, saving Sobeslav for last.
quote: I've been killing you and your guards for the last three minutes, one piece of your brain at a time.

summary: Mazirek says he needs a death to open the door.
quote: I need a death to open the door.

summary: In a memory, Mazirek and Vraska share tea and talk of leadership and pride.
quote: If I am to be met with disrespect, then I must first love myself with a fierceness no fool can take away.

summary: Mazirek recalls meeting Vraska while consulting the Ochran assassins, and their friendship since.
quote: Mazirek trusted Vraska with his life.

summary: The kraul chant as Mazirek harvests the souls of the dying guards and channels their power into his staff.
quote: Mazirek reached out and caught the power that resonated with each deceased soul

summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

summary: The dying Sobeslav says a kraul cannot lead the Golgari, and Mazirek replies that he will not, but knows who will.
quote: But I know who will.

summary: Mazirek kills Sobeslav, drawing the elf's strength into his staff.
quote: Sobeslav's eyes went wide as his brain stem suddenly decomposed.

summary: With the power of sixteen souls, Mazirek shoves aside the stone slab and opens a mausoleum full of hundreds of stone coffins.
quote: He gripped either side of the stone slab and shoved it to the side.

summary: The coffins open and the undead rise of their own accord, as Vraska had told him they would.
quote: the undead began to rise of their own accord, just as Vraska had told him they would.

summary: Mazirek names the mausoleum Umerilek, the salvation of the kraul and key to a Golgari empire.
quote: Umerilek, Mausoleum of the Erstwhile, the salvation of the kraul and the key to the creation of the Golgari empire.

summary: Sixty years earlier, the dragon arrives from another world with only days of magic left to put his plan in motion.
quote: He had days.

summary: The gods of Amonkhet fight the dragon outside the Hekma, and Oketra's arrows fail to harm him.
quote: The arrow hit the dragon's side, and he laughed.

summary: The dragon fractures Kefnet's mind in two, and Kefnet falls.
quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

summary: With Kefnet down, the Hekma wavers and the dragon bursts through it.
quote: the hole widened enough for the dragon to burst through.

summary: The dragon, protected by shifting half a step from reality, lands on the tallest tower and channels a spell.
quote: The dragon landed atop the tallest tower, closed his eyes, and began to channel a spell.

summary: The dragon dissipates every mortal old enough to walk, leaving only infants and the gods in shock.
quote: every mortal old enough to walk dissipated into the sky.

summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

summary: The dragon takes three gods for himself and corrupts the leylines of the remaining gods to bind them to him and to forget their origins.
quote: he returned to the surface and took three of the gods for his own.

summary: The dragon raises the enchanted dead as caretakers and repurposes an elite sacrificial ceremony into the endless Trials, setting the second sun to move on his schedule.
quote: He spelled the second sun to move as he was ready

summary: The dragon builds a throne and a horned monument, and plants a promise of his return in the gods and the people.
quote: he made a promise to return

summary: Decades later, the second sun settles between the horns and the dragon comes to collect his hoard.
quote: The time had come for the dragon to return to collect his hoard.

summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

summary: Samut asks Djeru to promise to protect their gods and each other.
quote: No matter what happens, we protect our gods. We protect each other.

summary: The second sun reaches its final point and the Gate cracks open, then swings wide to reveal endless wastes instead of paradise.
quote: What lay beyond the Gate were endless, empty wastes.

summary: Samut asks Hazoret if that is paradise, and the god does not answer.
quote: Is that paradise?

summary: A winged demon flies through the Gate and perches on an obelisk, and Samut recognizes it.
quote: Demons were rare on Amonkhet.

summary: The demon spills its own blood into the Luxa, turning the river to blood and killing the creatures in it.
quote: The demon had turned the river into blood.

summary: Samut asks Djeru whether he still believes the God-Pharaoh is benevolent, and Djeru's doubt grows.
quote: Do you still believe this is the act of a benevolent God-Pharaoh?

summary: The demon calls out for Liliana Vess, saying she cannot hide.
quote: I know you are here, Liliana Vess. You cannot hide from me.

summary: Liliana waits at the bloody Luxa and contacts Jace in her mind as Razaketh calls out for her.
quote: Jace? Can you hear me?

summary: Razaketh scans the crowd and Liliana finds her hand moving involuntarily.
quote: The movement of her hand had been . . . involuntary.

summary: Razaketh spots Liliana and the Gatewatch arrive, bruised from the arena.
quote: Liliana saw the rest of the Gatewatch arrive.

summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

summary: Liliana is forced beneath the surface of the blood river, and the Raven Man tells her she can only survive if she kills the demon.
quote: You are only free if you kill each of your demons, Liliana.

summary: Liliana's body swims itself across to the Necropolis bank, where Razaketh stands smugly above her.
quote: She had crossed the river and crawled onto the opposite bank.

summary: Razaketh toys with Liliana, making her kneel, nod and bark, and tells her he has fulfilled a friend's assignment.
quote: I love a dog who comes when she is called.

summary: Liliana regains her speech and tells Razaketh he has five minutes to live, then counts down to stall until her allies arrive.
quote: You have five more minutes to live,

summary: Chandra engulfs Razaketh in fire at Liliana's signal, and he rams her into the Necropolis wall.
quote: a jet of fire engulfed the demon.

summary: Razaketh dislocates Liliana's shoulder and silences her until Nissa's elemental breaks his concentration.
quote: A massive elemental emerged, its body forming from the banks of the river.

summary: Razaketh stops Liliana's breathing and paralyzes her as Chandra takes aim at him.
quote: She tried to suck in air, but her diaphragm was completely still.

summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

summary: Jace breaks Razaketh's control over Liliana's mind.
quote: Got him, move fast,

summary: Liliana draws the Chain Veil but puts it away, choosing to defeat Razaketh with her own power.
quote: Let the demon witness what terror she could wield all on her own.

summary: Liliana raises the dead animals of the river against Razaketh and blasts him down.
quote: a menagerie of death spilled up and out of the river of blood.

summary: Liliana possesses two dozen dead crocodiles and devours Razaketh, killing him.
quote: her two dozen selves consumed the last of the demon Razaketh.

summary: Jace is horrified as Liliana laughs and relishes the killing, and he tells her to stop.
quote: Liliana, that's enough

summary: Liliana releases the crocodiles, which swim away reanimated by the Curse of Wandering.
quote: The Curse of Wandering had taken hold.

summary: Liliana tells Jace she ate Razaketh and that only one demon remains; Jace does not answer.
quote: And now there's just one more.

summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

summary: Jace tells Liliana he will not stand by if she loses control like that again.
quote: I'm not going to stand by if you lose it like that again.

summary: The story recounts the God-Pharaoh's creation myth, in which he forged five gods and set the Trials and the second sun.
quote: And so the great God-Pharaoh forged the gods.

summary: Rhonas, convinced of the myth, welcomes the Hours and goes to the Gate to greet the God-Pharaoh.
quote: Rhonas rejoiced, emerging from his temple and his Trial.

summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

summary: The Luxa drains through the opened Gate as the demon's spell unravels old magics.
quote: all that remained of the mighty Luxa was a few rivulets of red

summary: Three sarcophagi along the Necropolis crack open and three insect-headed gods awaken.
quote: three enormous figures stepped forward from their slumber, awakened by the demon's spell.

summary: Rhonas challenges the scorpion god, which charges him in silence.
quote: Without warning, the scorpion god charged toward Rhonas

summary: Rhonas hurls the scorpion god across the gate with a spell of vigor but it rises unharmed.
quote: the immortal went flying across the expanse

summary: Rhonas imbues his staff with poison and fells the scorpion god, which drops to its knees.
quote: venom powerful enough to slay most living things

summary: The scorpion god grapples Rhonas from behind and pierces his skull with its tail sting.
quote: the scorpion tail, arched over the god, piercing his own skull.

summary: As the poison unbinds Bolas's magic, Rhonas remembers the true history of the dragon, the corrupted gods, and the original eight.
quote: The great lie of the God-Pharaoh.

summary: Rhonas names Nicol Bolas with his dying breath and recognizes the scorpion god as one of his corrupted brothers.
quote: This god was once one of the original eight

summary: Rhonas dies.
quote: as Rhonas stumbled and fell to the earth, body convulsing, then lay still.

summary: With his last strength, Rhonas curses the God-Pharaoh and hurls his staff, which his final spell turns into a serpent that wrestles the scorpion god.
quote: his final spell transforming the weapon into a living monstrous serpent

summary: Oketra rallies the stunned gods, and Hazoret is disturbed that Rhonas blasphemed the God-Pharaoh.
quote: doubt nibbled at the edges of her heart

summary: The locust god releases a swarm that begins eating the Hekma, and Oketra recalls the prophecy and declares the Hour of Promise has begun.
quote: a swarm of locusts poured forth from its hands.

summary: The scorpion god tears the serpent in two and advances while the other two gods enter Naktamun.
quote: the other two gods crossed the threshold of the gate into the city of Naktamun.

summary: Hapatra and the other viziers anxiously await word of the new gods on the steps of the Temple of Strength.
quote: We should have news of the new gods' intentions by now,

summary: All the viziers feel a sudden agonizing pain in their chests as Hapatra sees Kefnet take to the air and locusts gather.
quote: A sudden, jarring pain burst in Hapatra's chest

summary: Iput returns in tears and announces that the scorpion god killed Rhonas and means to kill them all.
quote: The scorpion god killed him. It means to kill them all.

summary: Hapatra sees the locust god direct swarms that devour the Hekma and tells the viziers to arm themselves.
quote: The locusts were eating away at the Hekma itself.

summary: A quarter of the Hekma vanishes and marauding mummies pour into Naktamun while Kefnet tries in vain to repair the barrier.
quote: a wave of marauding mummies poured into the city from the wastes beyond.

summary: Hapatra arms herself with poisons and summons her basilisk Tuya.
quote: The two shared a magical bond

summary: Hapatra leads the beasts of the Holding out against the mummies and locusts, cutting down the dead with her poisoned scimitar.
quote: With every swipe of her blade, another mummy halted, hunched over, and fell to the earth

summary: Hapatra concludes it is the absent God-Pharaoh's fault and saves two children from mummies.
quote: The God-Pharaoh who was not here.

summary: Hapatra takes Samut and Djeru onto Tuya as they seek to protect Oketra.
quote: The two former initiates gracefully climbed atop Tuya

summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

summary: Hapatra finds Kefnet and Oketra confronting the scorpion god, and Oketra tells her the gods are there to protect the mortals.
quote: We are here to protect you

summary: Kefnet and Oketra fight the scorpion god in tandem, and it grazes Kefnet's wing.
quote: They moved in tandem with one another

summary: Oketra's arrow of white light blasts through the scorpion god's head and it crumbles to dust.
quote: The scorpion god's pursuit was halted by Oketra's arrow of white light exploding through his head.

summary: The scorpion god reconstitutes itself from dust and stabs Kefnet through the forehead, killing him.
quote: the beautiful and brilliant Kefnet, God of Knowledge, was dead before he hit the ground.

summary: Oketra leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger while Gideon cries out.
quote: the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.

summary: Hapatra weeps for her gods, then tells Gideon the source of the hell is his responsibility to kill.
quote: Then he is your responsibility to kill.

summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

summary: Hazoret feels a third god die and kneels in despair, knowing only she and Bontu remain.
quote: Bontu and I are all that remain.

summary: Hazoret lets go into her battle frenzy, cutting through mummies, saving a child and burning a hellion.
quote: Hazoret let go of any shreds of doubt and uncertainty

summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

summary: Samut asks who will protect Hazoret, who tells her to fight and says she will endure.
quote: Who will protect you , Hazoret?

summary: Hazoret burns locusts from the God-Pharaoh's throne and prays for his return.
quote: She prayed to the God-Pharaoh for his return.

summary: A rift in the sky above the throne tears open and Nicol Bolas, the golden God-Pharaoh, emerges.
quote: The God-Pharaoh had arrived.

summary: The God-Pharaoh smiles at the destruction and unleashes black flames that consume the cheering mortals.
quote: a deluge of black flames streaked down, consuming everything it touched.

summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
quote: Kill your sister.

summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

summary: Bontu explains she chose survival by joining Bolas, and the sisters duel.
quote: I chose to join with his power instead. I chose survival.

summary: Bontu bites Hazoret's arm, Hazoret burns her way free, and Bontu summons horrors that bind Hazoret in tar.
quote: their shadowy forms coalescing into a binding morass, restraining her.

summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

summary: Bontu bursts free, slays the undead, frees Hazoret, and dies, severing her ties to the world.
quote: Bontu fell, the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.

summary: Hazoret alone remains as the last pillar of Amonkhet.
quote: And Hazoret alone remained, the last pillar of Amonkhet.

summary: Nylah, once indifferent to faith, finally believes as the city is destroyed and the gods die, and welcomes the horror as her Trial.
quote: This was her Trial.

summary: Angels announce the Eternals come and the gates of the central mausoleum open.
quote: The Eternals come!

summary: The scarab god leads thousands of blue-glazed Eternals, including past champions, out of the mausoleum.
quote: in the wake of his implacable dark divinity, came an army.

summary: Nylah is swarmed by the Eternals and gladly killed, crying that she now believes.
quote: Each blade sunk into her flesh with a cold kiss

summary: Asenue holds off two Eternals to give others time to escape, though she knows she will lose.
quote: Every moment she stayed alive, that was another person not dying

summary: Asenue falters in mid-breath, implying her death.
quote: One more breath. One more breath. One. More. Brea —

summary: Genub and Makare flee together from the Eternals, but Genub loses her in the chaos.
quote: When next he stopped to breathe, Makare was not there.

summary: Genub finds Makare, now an Eternal with glowing blue eyes, who cuts him down as he reaches for her.
quote: Hers was not the only blade that punctured his flesh, but it was the first.

summary: Kawit, enraged at Oketra's death, takes one of her arrows as a spear and destroys a minotaur Eternal.
quote: There was a flash of white light as the minotaur disintegrated

summary: Kawit sees the dragon God-Pharaoh and realizes he is no impostor but the being they served.
quote: This dragon is not an impostor. This dragon is our God-Pharaoh.

summary: Kawit hurls Oketra's spear at the dragon, but he freezes it and it snaps; he calls her useful only in a different world and walks away.
quote: you might have been useful.

summary: Kawit's shield fails and the Eternals close in on her.
quote: The Eternals closed in, and Kawit did not have strength enough left to scream.

summary: Amenakhte, mortally wounded after shielding a child with his body, begs a human woman to save the child and dies.
quote: all that Amenakhte had time to do was put himself between the falling blades and the child

summary: The woman promises Amenakhte that she will save the child as he dies.
quote: I will . . . save the child.

summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

summary: Nicol Bolas emerges from a void in the sky and rains black fire on the city and its cheering mortals.
quote: That was when the dragon raised his hands, and black fire fell from the skies.

summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

summary: The survivors all feel the pain of a fourth god dying, and Samut tells them four gods are now dead.
quote: Four of our gods are now dead.

summary: Djeru publicly declares he stands with Samut against the God-Pharaoh.
quote: I have seen more than I needed to realize she speaks truth.

summary: Samut resolves to go back into the city to protect Hazoret, and Djeru and other warriors join her while Hapatra stays to guide the survivors into the sands.
quote: I am Rhonas's broken fang, and I know where to strike to stop the undead and the monstrosities in their tracks.

summary: Samut and Djeru fight the Eternal Neheb the Worthy and are beaten back.
quote: Neheb swung his spear forward, sending a wave of flame at Samut.

summary: Gideon blocks Neheb's spear and the Gatewatch destroy the Eternals; Samut stabs Neheb and kills him.
quote: She sprinted toward the Eternal minotaur and stabbed him in the back with both khopeshes

summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

summary: Djeru persuades Samut to stand down and find the last god while the Gatewatch fight Bolas.
quote: Find the last god of Amonkhet, protect her, and protect the people of our city.

summary: Samut and Djeru, guided by the young vizier Haq, find Rhonas's body and Samut rallies the survivors.
quote: We will embody the strength Rhonas taught us

summary: A sandstorm sweeps in as an injured Hazoret emerges pursued by the scorpion god.
quote: A scorpion's tail pierced through the haze

summary: Hazoret traps the scorpion god in a pillar of flame, but it keeps coming and poisons her arm, which she cauterizes and severs.
quote: Hazoret crouched, panting hard, blood seeping from the wound that had saved her life.

summary: Samut leaps onto the scorpion god and cuts through its softened carapace while the survivors fight it.
quote: She smashed into the scorpion god's side, and her blades pierced its carapace

summary: A khenra warrior wields Rhonas's reforged staff to knock the scorpion god back toward Djeru's trap.
quote: A lone khenra stood, hoisting Rhonas's staff into the air

summary: Djeru trips the scorpion god and Samut redirects its fall so an obelisk pierces its chest.
quote: an earth-shattering crunch echoed across the battlefield as the obelisk pierced the scorpion god's chest.

summary: Hazoret finishes the scorpion god with her spear, freeing him as her brother from his dark form.
quote: the god reduced to cinders and ash.

summary: Hazoret thanks Samut, and Samut's planeswalker spark ignites; she is carried to another plane and returns to Amonkhet.
quote: she was falling, falling through space, through flashing waves of aether

summary: Samut realizes she is a walker between worlds and returns to Amonkhet, then collapses and is caught by Hazoret.
quote: I am a walker between worlds.

summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

summary: Bolas flies toward the five waiting planeswalkers and reflects on his decades of preparation on Amonkhet.
quote: At the edges of the plaza, five planeswalkers stood arrayed against him

summary: Bolas lands and roars, judging the Gatewatch's simple kill-the-dragon plan.
quote: They had chosen kill the dragon .

summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

summary: Bolas swats Gideon against a wall with his tail while ignoring the other attacks.
quote: Gideon sailed into a thick brick wall lining one side of the plaza.

summary: Jace attacks Bolas's mind but is lured into a trap and the dragon squeezes his mind.
quote: The obsidian shield disappeared, and Jace fell unexpectedly into Nicol Bolas's mind.

summary: Facing mind-death, Jace blindly planeswalks away across the Blind Eternities.
quote: Without conscious thought, he began planeswalking away blindly, not knowing or caring where.

summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

summary: Liliana vanishes into the void as Chandra screams at her betrayal.
quote: She surrounded herself in a glowing nimbus of dark energy and vanished into the void

summary: Chandra drives Bolas back with white fire for the first time, but he dismisses her as a child.
quote: he was forced backward for the first time in the fight

summary: Nissa raises spurs and a giant earth elemental against Bolas, but he crushes Chandra in his claw and shatters her defenses.
quote: He swooped in and grabbed her in a huge claw.

summary: Bolas strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, and she tells Chandra to flee; Chandra planeswalks away injured.
quote: She planeswalked away in a fiery blaze

summary: Bolas corrupts the leylines Nissa controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.
quote: She used Gideon's interruption to flee from this dead husk of a world.

summary: Bolas grabs Gideon and pierces his shield and shoulder with a talon, then offers him the choice to stay and die or leave and live.
quote: the shield parted like melted butter

summary: Haunted by memories of lost friends, Gideon chooses to leave and live and planeswalks away.
quote: He willed his body through the Blind Eternities

summary: Tezzeret arrives late, and Bolas sends him to fetch Ral Zarek, saying the battle was better than blood.
quote: Go and tell Ral Zarek to come to me.

summary: Bolas roars, declaring the planar bridge his and the army ready, and steps openly out of the shadows.
quote: was finally taking his first steps, visibly and openly.

summary: Jace wakes in a bamboo grove on an island with no memory of how he arrived or of his own name.
quote: He did not know how he had gotten here. He did not know his own name.

summary: Jace instinctively tries to planeswalk away, but a massive force yanks him back and a circle-and-triangle sigil appears above him.
quote: only to feel himself yanked backward, pulled by some massive force back through whatever metaphysical door he had begun to walk through

summary: Jace finds deliberate, surgical scars on his right forearm and back.
quote: A scar ran in a perfect line down his right forearm.

summary: A fire Jace wills into being gives no heat and vanishes in blue light; he concludes he has gone insane.
quote: The man solemnly concluded that he had gone insane.

summary: Jace sees visions of people from his forgotten past, among them a woman in violet who makes him anxious.
quote: he would sometimes see a woman in violet on the edge of his field of vision

summary: Jace realizes his visions are illusions he casts himself and that he is a mage.
quote: I'm not hallucinating—I've been creating illusions!

summary: An illusion of a raven-haired woman in violet tells Jace he was never a leader or a detective, only a frightened child playing pretend.
quote: you were a frightened child playing pretend

summary: Jace takes control of his magic, ending his involuntary illusions, and resolves to become whoever he wants to be.
quote: Whoever I was is irrelevant, for I will become whoever I want to become.

summary: Jace builds a raft and sails away from Useless Island.
quote: Useless Island disappeared over the horizon, and infinite azure stretched out in front of him.

summary: A storm wrecks Jace's raft and he washes up on a barren rock covered in seabirds.
quote: Exhausted and defeated, the man kicked himself over toward his new home.

summary: Descending into his own mind, Jace finds his spark, the one part of himself his memory loss did not take.
quote: a shining light embedded in the well of his mind

summary: Jace tries to planeswalk again and is pulled back once more by the same sigil.
quote: Once again, he felt himself violently tugged backward

summary: The ship the Belligerent finds Jace; its gorgon captain, Vraska, threatens him, then sees the state he is in and recognizes him by name.
quote: Jace, what the hell happened to you?

summary: Huatli and Inti return to Pachatupa with a captured Legion of Dusk sword after a final victory on the Sun Coast.
quote: Huatli and Inti were returning from the Sun Empire's last major campaign on the Sun Coast.

summary: Huatli advises the young Wayta that poetry should be honest rather than merely good.
quote: Try to make it honest .

summary: At the homecoming ceremony Huatli rides before the crowd, presents the sword to Emperor Apatzec and delivers an oration.
quote: Huatli turned and presented the Legion of Dusk sword to the crowd below.

summary: The emperor announces the next stage of expansion to reclaim the south but does not yet name Huatli warrior-poet.
quote: we are ready to reclaim the south,

summary: Apatzec privately tells Huatli she will not fight in the south but will guard the eastern coast against a possible Brazen Coalition and Legion attack.
quote: I am not sending you to fight in the south.

summary: A month later Huatli and Inti ride to a Brazen Coalition camp on the coast and burn its supplies.
quote: Sparks flew onto the dry wood of the crates, and almost instantly they caught flame.

summary: Angrath ambushes Huatli, kills her dinosaur with chains, and demands the location of the Immortal Sun.
quote: I am the dread pirate Angrath,

summary: Huatli fights Angrath and wounds him, but he overpowers her and Inti with his searing chains.
quote: she sliced a clean line across his chest with her blade.

summary: Huatli's planeswalker spark ignites; she glimpses a golden city before being pulled back, with the planeswalker sigil appearing above her.
quote: It was a city that shone with the warmth of gold.

summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as another planeswalker and offers to help each other leave, but she wounds him and flees with Inti.
quote: You're one too!

summary: Huatli tells Inti she believes she saw Orazca.
quote: I think I saw Orazca.

summary: Huatli tells Emperor Apatzec what she saw, and he declares it proof of her worthiness.
quote: What you saw is proof of your worthiness to hold that mantle.

summary: The emperor promises Huatli the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, and she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun.
quote: The title of warrior-poet is yours if you can locate the Golden City of Orazca.

summary: Inti offers to accompany Huatli with Teyeuh, and Huatli admits she wants to find the city.
quote: I want to find the city.

summary: Vraska finds an enchanted invitation from a dragon in her book and planeswalks to the Meditation Plane.
quote: she planeswalked through a dark slice in the air.

summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
quote: I accept your terms,

summary: Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
quote: It is the thaumatic compass,

summary: Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
quote: Set course due south,

summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
quote: It was Jace Beleren.

summary: Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

summary: Jace tells Vraska he does not remember anything before waking on an island, and she concludes it is not an illusion.
quote: I don't remember anything from before I woke up on the first island.

summary: Vraska decides not to kill the harmless Jace and tells him he can stay until the next harbor.
quote: We'll prepare a hammock for you in the forecastle,

summary: Jace accidentally touches Vraska, who flinches because she has not been touched in years.
quote: She had not physically touched anyone in years.

summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

summary: Vraska invites Jace to stay with her crew, and he accepts.
quote: I would love to.

summary: Kopala meditates in the Primal Wellspring with Tishana and feels the pulse of Orazca skip a beat.
quote: The pulse skips a beat.

summary: Tishana tells Kopala the disturbance involves Orazca.
quote: And what involves Orazca involves the whole world,

summary: Kumena arrives at the Wellspring with twenty River Heralds and a captured Sun Empire soldier.
quote: A soldier of the Sun Empire, bedraggled but whole, bound with a tangle of vines.

summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

summary: Kumena argues that the River Heralds must wield the Immortal Sun themselves, while Tishana insists it must be kept unused.
quote: We must wield the power of the Immortal Sun ourselves

summary: Tishana says the Last Guardian entrusted them to keep it hidden and unused, and Kumena appeals to Kopala to break the tie.
quote: He entrusted us to keep it hidden,

summary: Kopala sides with Tishana, saying no one should claim the Golden City, including the Heralds.
quote: We must do everything in our power to prevent anyone from claiming the Golden City.

summary: Kumena drowns the captive soldier, warns that Tishana's strategy will fail, and rushes off in a wave of water and roots as vessels approach the coast.
quote: and then he is gone from the glade

summary: Tishana departs to pursue Kumena and tells Kopala to rally the people, admitting the city may not stay hidden.
quote: I do not think we can keep the Golden City hidden any longer.

summary: Kopala buries the soldier's body beneath the pool to nourish the trees.
quote: It is not the end he would have hoped for, but it is the best I can do.

summary: Tishana catches up with Kumena on the coast, where he conjures storms against approaching ships, and she overpowers his spell.
quote: I subsume his spell with magic of mine own.

summary: Tishana rams a ship into a sea stack and exchanges barbs with Kumena before he punches her and knocks her out.
quote: I look over my shoulder just in time to see Kumena's fist hit my face.

summary: Jace spends days learning sailing and honing his illusions among the crew as the ship sails.
quote: He set about making a place for himself among the crew and relished learning new tasks and techniques.

summary: The Belligerent lands at High and Dry, where the crew disembarks for revelry.
quote: the crew landed at High and Dry with no need for expensive supplies.

summary: Malcolm takes Jace and Vraska to the Boatswain's Rear for a private briefing.
quote: He opened the door (an old galley table with a knife still stuck in it)

summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

summary: Malcolm explains the history of the Immortal Sun, stolen from Torrezon and carried west.
quote: a winged being descended from the sky. It took the Immortal Sun

summary: Vraska tells Jace he is something else entirely.
quote: You're something else entirely.

summary: Jace asks if he can read minds, and Vraska confirms telepathically; he learns to silence the voices.
quote: Yeah, you can.

summary: Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
quote: Yes. This is Ravnica.

summary: Jace half-remembers a winged lion with a man's face and worries about the minds he may have broken.
quote: I wonder how many minds I have broken before,

summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

summary: Jace encourages Vraska that she is meant to be a great leader, and each realizes neither wants to hurt the other.
quote: Both of them realized at the exact same moment that neither of them wanted to hurt the other.

summary: Jace disassembles and repairs the thaumatic compass, then triggers his planeswalker spark and sees the needle point at him.
quote: And felt his body break apart and away and slam back together, with the familiar triangle appearing above his head once more.

summary: Jace theorizes the compass points to a specific kind of magical expression and that Orazca must be a massive hub of such energy.
quote: the Golden City would have to be a massive hub of magical energy

summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

summary: A starving, crazed Mavren Fein stumbles up to Fort Adanto, proclaiming his faith in Saint Elenda.
quote: I have conquered the waves and death itself, praise Saint Elenda!

summary: Mavren Fein throws down his ruined navigational tools, claiming faith alone brought him to land.
quote: a crushed sextant, a broken compass, and a menagerie of other ruined navigational tools

summary: Mardia recognizes Mavren Fein and has the guards open the gate to let him in.
quote: Hierophant Mavren Fein?

summary: Smelling blood, Mavren Fein scales the fort wall and attacks a guard but cannot pierce his armor; the guards kick him off and Mardia pins him.
quote: He began to claw his way up the sides of Fort Adanto

summary: Mardia has Mavren Fein led to the holding cells and tells him prisoner Manuel will break his fast at dusk.
quote: Manuel killed a compatriot in a fight over a game of cards

summary: Mavren Fein tells Manuel the legend of Saint Elenda, the nun who guarded the Immortal Sun and became the first vampire.
quote: She was born mortal, a warrior nun charged with her brothers and sisters of faith to guard the Immortal Sun in the mountains of Torrezon.

summary: In the telling, Pedron the Wicked kills the guardians of the Immortal Sun and a winged beast steals the Sun from him.
quote: Pedron the Wicked killed them all.

summary: Mavren Fein breaks through the cell wall and feeds on Manuel, ending his Blood Fast.
quote: A breath later, his teeth were at the neck of the criminal, and the coppery scent of blood filled the air.

summary: Clear-minded again, Mavren Fein reveals his crew is dead and says he will continue the mission regardless.
quote: But I intend to continue our mission all the same.

summary: Vona's backstory: she relished the Apostasine Wars and her second birth as a vampire, and secretly still loves bloodshed.
quote: the day of her second birth, spent kneeling in a church, working the spell that would bind her life to serve the crown and church in perpetuity

summary: Bored in peacetime, Vona killed all her human serfs in a week-long game and abandoned her estate (flashback).
quote: over the course of one happy week killed each of them as part of a pleasant game

summary: Vona volunteers to lead the first ship in Queen Miralda's fleet searching for Saint Elenda.
quote: Vona had volunteered to lead the first ship that left port.

summary: Vona's ship closes on the Belligerent, hoping to board and feed on its crew.
quote: Boarding the pirate ship was ironic, but necessary to keep her sated.

summary: A conjured storm tosses Vona's ship, which rams into a sea stack and wrecks on the shore.
quote: just as her ship rammed into the side of the sea stack

summary: Vona kills and drinks from an injured pirate, declaring him guilty of deceit.
quote: I find you guilty of deceit, and a criminal in the eyes of the Church.

summary: Vona marches into the jungle alone, intent on taking the Immortal Sun.
quote: She was the Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun was hers for the taking.

summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

summary: Jace puts a charging vampire to sleep with his mind magic.
quote: The vampire in front of him stumbled in the sand and collapsed to the ground, snoring.

summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
quote: We lost Edgar

summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

summary: Vraska orders the crew to leave the locals alone but kill every vampire.
quote: kill every vampire you find.

summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
quote: We're Planeswalkers.

summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

summary: Huatli and her riders search the beach for a River Herald who could guide her to the Golden City.
quote: This is where she would find her guide to lead her to the Golden City.

summary: Huatli glimpses Vraska among the wrecked ships.
quote: Her skin was emerald green, more reptilian than anything else

summary: Huatli finds the unconscious Tishana on a rock and wakes her.
quote: There, lying on the rock overlooking the vast, unending ocean, was an unconscious female merfolk.

summary: Tishana tells Huatli that a River Herald, Kumena, has betrayed her cause and is heading to Orazca.
quote: A River Herald has betrayed my cause and is traveling there now.

summary: Huatli kneels and swears she means no claim on Orazca, and Tishana agrees to guide her, warning she will kill her if she tries to claim it.
quote: We are not each other's enemy.

summary: Tishana senses that Huatli really did see the city and gives her the terms of the alliance.
quote: If you say you saw a city when you skimmed the edges of our world, then I believe you.

summary: Tishana animates a jade totem into an elemental mount.
quote: began to form the shape of an elemental

summary: Huatli sends Inti and Teyeuh after a fleeing vampire.
quote: Inti, tail them!

summary: Tishana spots an illusion on the river water, which she judges beyond the vampires' mastery.
quote: Someone is casting an illusion there, on the water.

summary: Tishana and Huatli resolve to take the compass from the illusionist's boat, and Tishana admits even the River Heralds do not know where Orazca is.
quote: We need their compass more than we need them dead

summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

summary: Jace conjures a glowing illusory draft horse as a beacon for Malcolm and the crew.
quote: A large draft horse materialized above them, glowing a delicate blue against the night sky, and ran upward into the canopy.

summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

summary: Vraska decides she can trust Jace, possibly wants more than friendship, and resolves to petrify whoever stole his memories.
quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

summary: Vraska resolves to petrify whoever stole Jace's memories.
quote: Vraska couldn't wait to petrify whoever had stolen his memories.

summary: They abandon the boat and hack through the jungle, finding a dinosaur-made path.

summary: Jodah paralyzes Thom.

quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

summary: Shanna notes the Blackblade is locked in the Stronghold.
quote: It's also locked up in the Stronghold,

quote: That's how he lost his Planeswalker spark.

quote: I discovered some time ago that my friend Urza had left behind a series of devices and magical artifacts that could be of some help in repairing a time rift.

summary: Teferi says Urza hid the artifact from him.
quote: No. From me.

summary: Teferi tells Liliana mistakes can eventually be balanced.
quote: It isn't possible to erase them, but with effort you can eventually balance your account.

summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

summary: Liliana detects trapped spirits that factor into the puzzle.
quote: Aha, there are spirits here.

summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

summary: Teferi retrieves the crystal orb Urza hid.

summary: The monument begins to collapse.
quote: I think this place is collapsing!

summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
quote: The plateau is sinking.

summary: The monument sinks entirely into the earth.
quote: the last of the plateau sank into the earth

summary: Teferi agrees to join Jhoira in saving the world again.
quote: I think I will.

summary: Niambi is dropped home and blesses her father's return to adventuring.
quote: This is what you were born to do.

summary: Jhoira reveals she holds Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone and must convince him to take it back.
quote: It held Teferi's Planeswalker spark.

summary: Teferi, living quietly as a scholar, goes to the beach at dawn to see Zhalfir's ghostly coastline.
quote: Teferi walked out to the beach before dawn, to where he could see Zhalfir reflected in the sunrise.

summary: Teferi recalls wandering Dominaria since the Mending, unsettled by his guilt over Zhalfir.
quote: He had been wandering for the past several years, since the Mending

summary: Teferi questions whether his decision to hide Zhalfir was self-serving.
quote: Teferi wasn't sure why Zhalfir had been so much on his mind since he'd given up his spark.

quote: They say in the market that you're called Teferi.

summary: Subira reveals a man named Maket who was coming to see Teferi is dead.
quote: He's dead.

summary: Kwende says Maket's body shows no sign of rot after two days.
quote: Because it's been two days and his body is not showing any sign of rot.

summary: Teferi examines Maket and finds an unnatural death spell disguised as time magic.
quote: You and your physician were right, this isn't a natural death.

summary: Teferi tells them he did not kill Maket.
quote: Luckily for our burgeoning friendship, I did not.

summary: Subira guesses he is the Teferi who destroyed Zhalfir, and accepts it.
quote: I think you're not just a Teferi, but the Teferi.

summary: Teferi admits to Subira he questions his decision every day.
quote: When I created the Zhalfir rift, I was so certain I was right

summary: A giant sandstorm rolls toward the caravan and Sewa.
quote: Rolling toward them out of the desert flats was a sandstorm.

summary: Teferi stretches a time bubble to deflect the storm, exhausting his powers.
quote: He cast the spell to stop time for a bubble of air ten feet in front of him.

summary: The bubble collapses and Teferi survives the weakened storm.
quote: Then he hit the ground and the bubble collapsed.

summary: A drover reports magistrates are coming to accuse Teferi of raising the storm.
quote: They say someone here brought the storm.

summary: Teferi realizes Kwende framed him and sent the storm.
quote: It was clear as glass now.

summary: Kwende ambushes Teferi with a sword, which Teferi rusts with accelerated time.
quote: The sword swing came out of nowhere and Teferi flung himself sideways.

summary: Kwende confesses he hired a mage to cause the storm and the poison.
quote: I hired a mage to make the spells that stirred the winds, and to make the death magic poison

summary: Kwende reveals he is descended from Mageta the Lion.
quote: My ancestor was Mageta the Lion.

summary: Subira lashes Kwende's arm with her whip and calls him the murderer.
quote: You are the murderer!

summary: Teferi tells Kwende Zhalfir is not destroyed and he would restore it if he could.
quote: Zhalfir is not destroyed!

summary: Subira dares Kwende to kill her to stop her from taking Teferi away.
quote: Then kill me. That's the only way you'll stop me.

summary: Kwende backs away and Subira drives Teferi off in her wagon.
quote: Kwende stared at her as the moment stretched, then he slowly stepped back.

summary: Teferi agrees to travel with Subira's caravan for a while.
quote: For a while,

quote: A few years ago, Subira had found someone else to run her caravan, and she had settled down with Teferi

summary: Teferi freezes Niambi mid-fall by instinct.
quote: Teferi cast the spell out of pure instinct and Niambi froze in mid-air.

summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

summary: Teferi releases the spell and catches Niambi.
quote: As time moved around her again, she landed in her father's arms and laughed with delight.

quote: Chandra walked across the planes to Regatha.

quote: Just after Nissa disappeared, Chandra had noticed fresh traces of a powerful pyromancer's aether trail on Dominaria.

summary: Chandra takes Jaya's goggles from the monastery's relics and is caught by Luti.
quote: Chandra, what are you doing?

summary: Chandra explains she needs more power to fight Nicol Bolas.
quote: I need more power to fight Nicol Bolas.

summary: Chandra rejects Luti's advice and leaves for Dominaria.

quote: This place was Argivia, the capital city of New Argive

quote: it's the kobolds of the Kher Ridges again, and that horrible god-dragon of theirs, Prossh.

summary: Chandra finds a dead Argivian scout on the road.
quote: realized it was a dead body.

summary: Chandra sees kobolds building an ambush barricade in the name of Prossh.
quote: They were building a barricade across the road

summary: Chandra fights off kobolds that discover her.
quote: Chandra sent a fireball into the first kobold's chest and he tumbled back down the hill, screeching.

summary: Chandra blasts through the barricade to clear the way for the Argivians.
quote: She sent the burst of fire streaking toward the logs.

summary: Chandra loses control and fries half a dozen kobolds with a wild blast.
quote: The carefully targeted stream of fire turned into a wild blast that fried the half dozen kobolds in its path.

summary: The Argivian troop routs the kobolds.
quote: but it quickly turned into a rout.

summary: Baird tells Chandra the pyromancer Jaya Ballard left the force.
quote: Yes, that is her, but she left our force in the ridges.

summary: Baird says Jaya came looking for a friend and went toward Yavimaya.
quote: To the Yavimaya forest, I believe.

summary: Chandra reaches the coast across from Yavimaya.
quote: This had to be Yavimaya.

summary: Chandra sees trees trembling and hears fighting in Yavimaya.
quote: Suddenly a whole section of huge trees on an inland hillside rippled and trembled

quote: They were each around twenty feet high, with scoops for hands and big blocky heads.

summary: Animated trees attack and tear apart an automaton.
quote: It leapt on the nearest automaton and ripped it apart.

summary: A small automaton warns Chandra that the trees attack any movement.
quote: Take care. They will attack any movement.

summary: The automaton says Multani animated the trees.
quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.

summary: Chandra burns a row of attacking trees.
quote: She reached a spot of higher ground where she had a better angle and sent a stream of fire down the whole row of trees.

summary: Karn explains Multani is injured and acts out of instinct.
quote: Multani is an elemental, and has been in a semiconscious state

summary: Karn reveals he is the friend who has been gone a long time.
quote: I'm Karn. And I am someone who has been gone for a long time.

summary: Mother Luti appears in Yavimaya and claims the goggles, revealing herself as Jaya.
quote: I believe those are mine.

quote: Two hundred years later, I went back and found they'd started a religion based on me.

summary: Chandra offers Jaya her goggles and asks for the secret to being a more powerful pyromancer, and Jaya flatly refuses.
quote: Jaya took the goggles, and her expression turned hard as stone. "Absolutely not."

quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians. I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

summary: Chandra tries again to change Jaya's mind, and Jaya says there is no secret and that Chandra does not know what she wants.
quote: There's no secret. To master your power, you need to know what you want, know your true self.

summary: Karn uncovers the Sylex beneath a broken slab in the pit.
quote: "He's found the Sylex." Jaya let her breath out, but she didn't look relieved.

summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.

quote: The angry gold light from his eyes and mouth faded to a deep blue, and she was sure she saw awareness there.

summary: Karn promises Multani he will take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and never harm Dominaria.
quote: It will never harm Dominaria, I swear it.

summary: Chandra apologizes to Jaya for how she treated her, and Jaya says Chandra has potential and invites her aboard.
quote: what you did with Multani shows me you have potential.

quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

quote: "The Mana Rig." She held it out to him. "Will you take it back?"

summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.

summary: Teferi decides to take back his spark, and Jhoira drops the pendant into his palm.

summary: Gideon and Teferi wave off the thallids as someone else's problem.

summary: Slimefoot converses with the spirits of Urborg, who say Yavimaya is woven into the ground and came to fight the demon.

summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.

summary: Gideon and Chandra climb the gate and cross traps past still guards.

summary: Gideon and Chandra enter the first hall, then Chandra chains Gideon as her prisoner when the time spell ends.

summary: Liliana's panther liches pledge to follow the Weatherlight into battle.

summary: Liliana saves Jhoira from falling from the tilting deck.

quote: Yargle still gripped the bow, and now its gigantic maw was opening.

summary: Gideon falls into the pit, kills a maddened attacker, and takes a sword while the prisoners fight under dementia magic.

summary: Gideon joins a back-to-back group led by the warrior Radha.

summary: Slimefoot asks the Urborg spirits for help and they promise to call something that can help.

summary: Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental, rises behind Yargle and seizes it.
quote: It's Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental!

quote: "Then I'll come with you." Radha turned to the others.

summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.

summary: Urgoros rises from the volcano on a dragon-like mount to attack the Weatherlight.

summary: Gideon draws the Blackblade and confronts Belzenlok outside the Stronghold.

summary: Naiva kills a goblin that ambushes her among a pack of avalanche-crushed goblins.

summary: Dragons melt the snow with fire and flood the valley, and Naiva worries what she will do if Grandmother is dead.
quote: People who wouldn't just turn her twin over to Atarka once they discovered she was a shaman.

summary: The twins find the hunting party alive on a hill above the flood, and Yasova asks Baishya to report what happened.
quote: Grandmother was tending to several injured people.

summary: Baishya addresses her grandmother as Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, and slips into a whisper trance.
quote: Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.

summary: In the vision, a blind great shadow beats its wings and drops egg-stones from which dragons wake, as Arcades Sabboth, Chromium Rhuell and Palladia-Mors name themselves.
quote: By naming itself it takes control of its own destiny.

summary: Two large egg-stones crack into the ground without waking, and Palladia-Mors dismisses them as weak and goes hunting.
quote: These two were too weak to wake up. Good riddance.

summary: Merrevia Sal crashes into a clearing and demands meat from a party of hunters.
quote: I am Merrevia Sal. Give me the meat, or I will kill you.

summary: The last egg-stone unfurls into twin dragons, Nicol and Ugin, who crash through the canopy; Nicol is pinned by a tree trunk.
quote: You're Nicol, aren't you? That's your name.

summary: Hunters work together to net and kill Merrevia Sal while Nicol, pinned, wants to help but Ugin holds him back.
quote: Yet still she struggles, still she fights because she is a dragon, and dragons never bow before lesser creatures.

summary: Ugin clamps Nicol's muzzle to hush him as Merrevia is hunted into the trees and dies.
quote: Ugin clamps talons over his muzzle, smothering him.

summary: Nicol is freed and finds the clearing too late; he wants revenge but Ugin urges finding their siblings first.
quote: We must find the others first. Safety in numbers, as the hunters had.

summary: Nicol rips off a dog's head and flies awkwardly to the peak with Ugin.
quote: He leaps forward onto the lead dog and rips its head off with a single bite.

summary: From the peak Nicol sees the bodies of weak dragons and decides being the hunter is better, while Ugin stares at the sky and asks where they came from.
quote: Dying isn't wonderful. It's bad. But being the hunter: that's a better thing.

summary: In the vision Ugin calls Yasova Dragonclaw to come to him.
quote: Someone is looking for you, Yasova Dragonclaw. Come to me.

summary: Three of Atarka's broodlings land at the camp demanding the clan surrender its shamans.
quote: We smell magic in the air. Surrender your shamans to us, or we will kill you all.

summary: Yasova lies that the camp stood on the hill and distracts the broodlings with the goblin corpses.
quote: For your trouble, and out of respect, we have gathered a little snack for you.

summary: Baishya explains the vision came from Ugin and they must go to his grave.
quote: That's why we have to go to Ugin's grave.

summary: Yasova's party sees an Ojutai dragon hunting on the high plateau, and Yasova decides to avoid it on the way to Ugin's grave.
quote: I want to reach Ugin's grave without tangling with that dragon.

summary: Yasova praises Naiva and sends her and Baishya to scout a ring of stones where vultures are perched.
quote: If the vultures are not afraid, then we need not be.

summary: Naiva is attacked in the rock ring by a wounded stranger; she disarms him and he faints after asking for Yasova Dragonclaw.
quote: You are of the Temur clan. I seek Yasova Dragonclaw.

summary: Yasova suspects a trap by Ojutai's broodling but Naiva and Baishya insist she heal him.
quote: This could be a trap on the part of Ojutai to find me.

summary: Tae Jin explains his master's dream and that Ojutai destroyed records but the Spirit Dragon's story survives by oral tradition.
quote: He wants to destroy our memory of the past, and of our ancestors

summary: Yasova heals Tae Jin's wound with magic and tells him to prove his words.
quote: She pulled off her glove and placed a bare hand, fingers spread, atop the wound.

summary: Tae Jin recites the words of Ugin, who says the one he loved best in all the worlds is the one who killed him.
quote: The one I loved best in all the worlds is the one who killed me.

summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: he and Nicol learn that no creature is safe after witnessing their sister's death and set out to find their siblings.
quote: We witnessed the death of a sister, and in this way, we learned that no creature is safe.

summary: Flashback: Nicol insists they should have interfered to stop the hunters and wants to learn how to destroy them.
quote: I want to know who those hunters are, and where they come from, and how we can destroy them.

summary: Flashback: the twins meet Chromium Rhuell by a lake, who dismisses them and sends them to Palladia-Mors.
quote: But for now, go away, little ones.

summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors scorns the twins as runts and flings a corpse at them.
quote: You're so small, the two of you. Little runts.

summary: Flashback: Ugin sees nothing wasted in the cycle of life and death, while Nicol wants to kill something.
quote: I want to kill something,

summary: Flashback: the twins spend years perfecting tandem hunting, and meet Vaevictis Asmadi's territory.
quote: We spent years, as you Jeskai would measure the span of days, perfecting various techniques for hunting in tandem.

summary: Flashback: the twins find Arcades Sabboth ruling a human settlement.
quote: To our surprise our sibling Arcades Sabboth had taken up residence inside the great ring wall.

summary: Flashback: Nicol burns a tower and soldiers when humans shoot at the twins, and Arcades slams into him.
quote: His blast of fire breath scorched along the highest tower and its adjoining wall walk.

summary: Flashback: Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas and the twins are admitted to the colony as Arcades's guests.
quote: I am Nicol Bolas,
