summary: Flashback: the twins live for years in the colony, Ugin befriending the holy elder Te Ju Ki.
quote: I poked my snout into everything, and made particular friends with an old holy elder named Te Ju Ki

summary: Flashback: Te Ju Ki shows Ugin globes of light she calls planes and teaches that death is part of endless cycles.
quote: She called each one a "plane," although I did not know what she meant by the word at that time.

summary: Flashback: one man stabs his brother in a sudden quarrel after years of peace, and Nicol watches with satisfaction.
quote: Nicol lounged there, stretched along the ridgeline, watching the scene with an avid gaze.

summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin he has found a better way to avenge their sister and flies off without farewells.
quote: I have discovered a better way to get revenge.

summary: Flashback: Arcades dismisses Ugin's concerns, and Ugin leaves Te Ju Ki to follow Nicol.
quote: I know where he's going. I must follow him.

summary: An Ojutai broodling appears and its aven interpreter sentences Tae Jin to die by ice for sacrilege.
quote: Tae Jin, by the command of the Great Teacher, you are accused of the crime of sacrilege and sentenced to die by ice.

summary: As the Ojutai broodling prepares to kill Tae Jin, Yasova secretly signals the hunters to kill.
quote: Keeping her hand hidden from the aven on the rock, Grandmother gestured Kill .

summary: Baishya rolls a boulder to block the broodling's ice breath, and Naiva and Yasova kill the aven interpreter with spears.
quote: Grandmother cast her own spear, and the weapon struck the aven's head for the death blow.

summary: The broodling shoves aside the boulder as it looms over the twins, but an Atarka broodling slams into it.
quote: The two beasts went tumbling over the grass, grappling and clawing.

summary: Baishya admits she did not know she could move a rock like that.
quote: I didn't either,

summary: Yasova decides to go on to Ugin's grave, accepting the portent of Tae Jin's arrival and the windfolk's vision.
quote: We will go on to Ugin's grave.

summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to continue Ugin's story, especially about Bolas.
quote: Tell me more about Ugin. And about Bolas.

summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: Ugin flies alone back across the land toward the birth mountain, finding solitude difficult and learning that all things breathe.
quote: But slowly as I flew and hunted my way back across the wide, wild land, I began to hear how all things breathe.

summary: Flashback: Ugin finds Vaevictis Asmadi and his siblings chasing Nicol while burning human settlements.
quote: They were chasing a dragon.

summary: Flashback: Ugin frightens Vaevictis off with spun globes of light so Nicol can escape.
quote: So, I reached into my tiny arsenal of magical tricks and spun a pair of transparent, feather-light globes out of the nexus of colors and into the air.

summary: Flashback: Nicol reunites with Ugin and mocks Te Ju Ki, claiming no human can be as wise as the youngest dragon.
quote: No human, however old, can ever be as wise as the youngest dragon

summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin of other lands across the ocean and refuses to consider that other dragons may be older.
quote: We are the first, after all, and thus the most powerful.

summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors steals the twins' kills and warns them that humans near the birth mountain think they are dragon hunters.
quote: Those humans have gotten above themselves and think they are dragon hunters.

summary: Flashback: the twins reach the birth mountain and find human settlements with dragon skulls and carved gates showing dragons being killed.
quote: They have turned our sister into an ornament!

summary: Flashback: humans fire poisoned bolts, wounding Ugin, and fight to bathe in his fallen blood.
quote: Although Nicol twisted out of their way, my left rear claw was cut by a glancing blow.

summary: Flashback: Ugin lands on the mountain's rim and Nicol vows to avenge their sister, claiming a cunning plan that needs no killing.
quote: I have a plan, a very cunning plan, because I have taught myself to do something no one else can do.

summary: Yasova's party camps; at dusk Naiva tells Tae Jin that Yasova brings children to Ugin's grave to wake their magic early.
quote: Atarka hates magic. She fears it.

summary: Tae Jin says his master believes some essence of Ugin endures and reached out, which is why he was sent.
quote: The tempests that birth dragons have increased in strength since Ugin's death.

summary: The wounded Atarka broodling carries the dead Ojutai dragon to the camp and attacks, calling them traitors.
quote: Come out! My cousin tells me truth before she dies. Traitor! Dragon killer!

summary: Tae Jin conjures a ghostly blade and slashes open the broodling's belly.
quote: the white sparks elongated to become a long ghostly blade that shimmered, bright yet without physical substance

summary: Naiva kills the broodling by driving her spear through its eye.
quote: Naiva thrust the obsidian point of her spear into the dragon's unblinking eye

summary: Yasova identifies Tae Jin's dragon mark as that of a ghostfire warrior and demands to know how he exists.
quote: You wear the dragon mark of a ghostfire warrior.

summary: Yasova demands the truth from Tae Jin after finding he is a ghostfire warrior, threatening to kill him.
quote: All our lives are forfeit if the dragons discover we have sheltered a ghostfire warrior.

summary: Tae Jin explains that his mother was a scribe of Shu Yun who survived Ojutai's purge and that his master taught him the ghostfire blade.
quote: She survived Ojutai's purge and dedicated herself to saving what she could of the history and knowledge of the Jeskai Way.

summary: Fec warns of an approaching dragon tempest, and the party shelters in a rock chamber.
quote: It's a dragon tempest, and it's moving in fast,

summary: Naiva tends Tae Jin's wound and learns he left his mother at twelve; she reveals Atarka killed her own mother for being a whisperer.
quote: Our mother is dead. Atarka killed her for being a whisperer.

summary: Tae Jin argues that keeping the old ways alive defies the dragons, and Naiva realizes she was wrong.
quote: By keeping them alive, we defy the dragons rather than accept defeat.

summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to resume his story of Ugin and Nicol.
quote: There is more to your story. I'll listen.

summary: Flashback: Ugin and Nicol wait on the birth mountain overnight and see a lone traveler who proves to be Chromium Rhuell in human form.
quote: who appeared outwardly as a pregnant human except for the way his eyes shone like sapphires

summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell describes the dragon-killing chief and his heirs and proposes destroying them; Nicol twists his words.
quote: My recommendation is that we destroy the chief, his heirs, and his acolytes, burn all the temples, and salt the fields.

summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell, enraged by Nicol's twisting of words, reveals his true dragon form, belittles Nicol as the least of them, and flies away.
quote: You are the least of us, last fallen, not even a whole dragon but only half of one, bound as you are to Ugin.

summary: Flashback: The twins watch the chief's procession and temple; Ugin hears whispers about the heirs' rivalry.
quote: She intends to outlast you and have you throttled when he dies.

summary: Flashback: Nicol identifies the chief's attendants as two of his four heirs and says it will be easy.
quote: Those two who attend him so assiduously are two of his heirs.

summary: Flashback: Nicol kills a young messenger to stop word reaching the other heirs.
quote: he swooped down, caught up the youth in his claws and, as the young human screamed and struggled, bit off his head.

summary: Flashback: Nicol whispers into the mind of the chief's son at a lakeside settlement, persuading him to march against the other heirs and kill his father.
quote: It could be your measure. If you march against the other heirs.

summary: Flashback: Nicol marks the longhouse ridge and the son's warriors march off; Nicol explains humans are easy to manipulate through hate, envy and fear.
quote: Humans are riddled with hate and envy and fear and greed.

summary: Flashback: The chief's son seizes the central settlement, Nicol lures the other two heirs into a battle and burns the temple.
quote: Nicol flew down to the unguarded temple and burned it and its acolytes to the ground.

summary: Flashback: Nicol deposits the old chief in the courtyard of his second wife, who has been whispered into rebellion; she kills him.
quote: She stabbed him once, twice, and thrice, and had his bloody, bloated body thrown into the stinking refuse of a latrine.

summary: Flashback: The son and the second wife are wed, then kill each other in a blood oath, and Nicol proclaims himself the humans' true leader.
quote: I rule you now. I am your true leader. Bow before me.

summary: Flashback: Ugin realizes Nicol caused the earlier murder and plans to manipulate his mind too, and he feels his twin's betrayal.
quote: He wanted to use me for his own ends, because he had never truly cared for me at all.

summary: Flashback: Ugin is torn into the space between planes and then lands on Tarkir.
quote: being torn from the only place I had never known and flung into the space between the planes.

summary: Tae Jin ends his story, and Yasova says she witnessed Ugin's death eighteen years ago and another dragon who vanished in golden light.
quote: Eighteen years ago, I witnessed a battle in the sky that ended with the death of Ugin.

summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

summary: A dragon tempest breaks and Mattak asks Yasova to come see something.
quote: First Mother, you'd best come see.

summary: A dragon tempest passes over the camp; Atarka arrives, finds her dead broodling, and drives the newborn dragons back into the storm.
quote: Slashing and raging, she drove the fledglings deeper into the night.

summary: A flash of golden light briefly shines as the tempest ends, and Naiva thinks she saw a shape falling through the stars.
quote: A flash of golden light flared like the sun rising at zenith

summary: Naiva walks point with Fec and learns he was cast out by the Kolaghan for his limp, and they argue about the old ways.
quote: In the Kolaghan clan those who cannot keep up are left behind.

summary: Atarka lands between the hunting band and the shelter, seizes Darka, and eats him.
quote: She bit off Darka's head before tossing his body in a high arc.

summary: Yasova tells Atarka that Ojutai's kin killed her broodling and that the hunters have killed the outsider as a feast for her.
quote: One of Ojutai's kin killed your broodling and fed on its innards.

summary: Atarka forces the party to follow her to the corpse and spots Tae Jin as an outsider smelling of Ojutai.
quote: He smells of Ojutai, that pompous, ice-breathing windbag.

summary: Yasova claims Tae Jin has come to serve Atarka and stops him from raising his ghostfire blade.
quote: Do not begin that which you cannot end.

summary: Atarka agrees to hear a story while she eats the Ojutai dragon before deciding Tae Jin's fate.
quote: Tell a story while I feast. Then I decide.

summary: Tae Jin begins a story but it twists, and he mutters that it isn't the story he meant to tell.
quote: That isn't the story I meant to tell. Let me try again.

summary: In the story, the young dragon king Nicol sets the human heirs against each other, loses his brother Ugin to a blast of sorcery, and rules as a just king.
quote: In the course of the war, his brother was swept away into nothingness by a blast of human sorcery

summary: Flashback: Dragons descended from Vaevictis raid the kingdom's settlements, and the king resolves to fight them with his army and venom-laced weapons.
quote: We are the descendants of Vaevictis Asmadi and may raid where we wish!

summary: Flashback: The king's army slaughters seven of Vaevictis's descendants with ballistae and sorcery but one escapes.
quote: It was a rout. A slaughter.

summary: Flashback: The king pursues the survivor across the plains and meets Vaevictis, Lividus, Ravus and Rubra, who drop the dead dragon onto the army.
quote: The corpse hit hard, instantly crushing an entire company of slingers.

summary: Flashback: The king's ballistae wound Rubra with a venom bolt, but the army is routed by Vaevictis's fire.
quote: Rubra took a bolt to the eye.

summary: Flashback: The king retreats into a canyon with a third of his army and plans a trap, thinking of Ugin and his search for a disintegration spell.
quote: For generations he had toiled in concert with his academy of sorcerers to recover or devise a magic that could replicate Ugin's disappearance.

summary: Flashback: The sorcerers' disintegration spell kills Ravus, and Lividus destroys the ballistae.
quote: Ravus splintered like rock heated until it explodes.

summary: Flashback: Nicol uses mind touch on Lividus to turn him against Vaevictis and sets the two brothers against each other.
quote: He pressed the venom-tipped spear of his sharp mind deep into Lividus's simmering rancor.

summary: Flashback: Vaevictis and Lividus fight each other as Nicol retreats and kills his own witnesses.
quote: Traitor! Backstabber!

summary: Flashback: Nicol spreads lies among the descendants of Vaevictis's brothers and Palladia-Mors, igniting clan wars among the dragons.
quote: The ease with which the gullible could be turned to his purpose was surprisingly pleasurable.

summary: Flashback: Dragons fight across the world and Arcades Sabboth joins the war after hearing whispers of wisdom.
quote: threw his might into the great war as he listened to the whispers of wisdom that brushed through his mind

summary: Atarka declares there is only one law, to eat, and spares Tae Jin before flying off.
quote: There is only one law: to eat. This was a good feast. You may keep the outsider.

summary: Tae Jin says the story came to him in a whisper, and Yasova warns that once before a whispering voice altered Tarkir and that she listened to it.
quote: Once before, a whispering voice sought to alter the events on Tarkir.

summary: The hunters honor Darka in the ainok manner and set out for Ugin's grave.
quote: His spirit walks ahead of us into the unwritten now,

summary: Yasova's party reaches the gateway to Ugin's grave, where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones, and Yasova calls for the group that camps there.
quote: Grandmother calls them hedrons. They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

summary: Receiving no answer, Yasova sends Fec ahead to the cave and orders others to guard Tae Jin against possible Ojutai trickery.
quote: It might be. I want you to guard Tae Jin from attack by any of his Ojutai brethren

summary: Yasova leads the twins through a secret tunnel into a warm hidden sanctuary and then a cavern of whisperer headpieces and carvings.
quote: They are the garb of a whisperer, as you are meant to be.

summary: Yasova tells the girls they must become guardians of the carved memories of the ancestors.
quote: It's past time for you girls to become guardians of this knowledge, so you can pass it on after I am gone.

summary: Baishya hears the headpieces whisper to her, while Naiva feels excluded.
quote: I hear you,

summary: From a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who resembles Mevra and claims an illness killed the camp.
quote: An illness ate away their lives and brought them death. I am all that is left.

summary: Yasova tells the twins she suspects the speaker is not Mevra, orders them to stay hidden, and says to return to Ayagor after a month if she does not come back.
quote: After a month, return to Ayagor and tell Gerrak he is now First Father of the tribe.

summary: Baishya, saying Ugin is calling her, slips through a narrow cleft and Naiva follows, resisting a whisper telling her to abandon her twin.
quote: No. Death is more complicated than that. If you won't come, I'm going alone.

summary: Naiva resists a whispered temptation to abandon Baishya and crawls into the hedron after her.
quote: But duty and love rooted her feet.

summary: Naiva and Baishya fall into Ugin's memories by touching hands inside the hedron.
quote: The magic of the hedrons opened a gate mind to mind.

summary: In the vision, Ugin hovers above still waters between planes, realizing he has walked between worlds, then arrives on Tarkir.
quote: This must be one of the planes of which Te Ju Ki speaks.

summary: In the vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there.
quote: He recognizes the shape of the curved horns.

summary: In the vision, Ugin travels among many planes, then decides to find Nicol again, having mastered planeswalking.
quote: By now, he has mastered planeswalking.

summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

summary: Nicol, thinking Ugin dead, blasts him with fire before Ugin convinces him; Nicol leaves his army to take Ugin to his domain.
quote: It will be. Come see what I have accomplished. Come, Ugin.

summary: In the vision, Ugin confronts Nicol atop the birth mountain about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests.
quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

summary: Ugin reveals he is a planeswalker, and Nicol asks to be taught.
quote: I am a Planeswalker now.

summary: Ugin cannot explain the spark; Nicol calls him a liar and a coward, and Ugin leaves in fury and grief.
quote: You can't tell me, can you?

summary: Naiva wakes inside the hedron, and Yasova arrives and says Ugin is not dead but trying to communicate through dreams.
quote: It seems Ugin is not dead after all. But not awake either.

summary: Yasova crawls into the hedron to reach Ugin through Baishya, after warning Naiva that Mevra and the others are probably dead.
quote: She crawled in through the tiny opening, disappearing inside the hedron structure.

summary: Naiva sees the false Mevra gliding down the path with feet off the ground and calls her out.
quote: You aren't Mevra. You're no kin of mine.

summary: The false Mevra turns inside out and reveals herself as a gigantic horned dragon, Nicol Bolas.
quote: A dragon unfolded out of the illusion, so magnificent a creature that the memory of Atarka's might seemed paltry in comparison.

summary: Bolas says he wants Ugin, admits he killed him once before, and tries to enlist Naiva to destroy him for all eternity.
quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.

summary: Bolas offers Naiva rule of the world if she tells him where Ugin is, and Naiva asks why he hates his twin.
quote: Why do you hate Ugin? He's your twin.

summary: Bolas denies that Ugin is his twin, calling it a story Ugin spread to share his glory.
quote: That's just a story he put about, trying to grab for a share of my glory and my triumph.

summary: Naiva realizes Bolas does not know where Ugin's body lies and tries to keep him distracted to protect Baishya.
quote: Somehow, amazingly, this powerful dragon did not know Ugin's body lay concealed beneath the hedrons.

summary: Naiva challenges Bolas that he was born together with Ugin, and he roars in anger and asks who told her.
quote: Of course that's not right! Who told you that?

summary: Bolas begins his account, claiming he woke first and woke Ugin, who flew only because he taught him.
quote: In this way he discovered flight or, I should say, I taught him that flight is what we dragons are made for.

summary: Naiva interrupts to say there were eight dragons, and Bolas swats a foreclaw down to knock her over.
quote: Do not interrupt me again!

summary: Bolas claims he alone dared to land on the ground and named the world Dominaria.
quote: So, I named our home Dominaria, because I claimed its song for myself.

summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

summary: Bolas says a spark of rage ignited him and he became a planeswalker, arriving at a mirror sea.
quote: With my next breath, I comprehended the whole: I had become a Planeswalker.

summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

summary: Bolas visits Arcades's kingdom, hears he last saw Ugin long ago, and plants doubts in his mind about his subjects.
quote: I insinuated a worm of doubt in his haughty mind

summary: Bolas claims he found Ugin floating in the Meditation Realm and that Ugin attacked him, leading to a long struggle across the planes.
quote: He attacked, viciously and without warning, all raw fury and malignant resentment.

summary: Bolas claims he killed Ugin in the Meditation Realm in self-defense, and the shockwaves hurled him back to Dominaria on Madara.
quote: There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

summary: Bolas threatens Naiva, tells her Ugin plagued him later with a plan to trap him on Ixalan, and learns she says Ugin's bones lie beneath the hedrons.
quote: He has plagued me ever since, most recently with a misbegotten plan to trap me on Ixalan by means of a magical artifact.

summary: Bolas preys on Naiva's resentments toward Baishya and offers to make her the great hunter and leader.
quote: You could finally become the great hunter and leader you deserve to be.

summary: Bolas threatens to destroy Tarkir unless Naiva brings Yasova to him, and promises to clear her enemies.
quote: All you need do is bring me Yasova. Now.

summary: Naiva tells Bolas that Yasova is hiding right there.
quote: She's here. Right here. Hiding.

summary: Naiva crawls into the hedron, finds Baishya and Yasova, and presses her knife to Baishya's throat.
quote: Pulling her knife from its sheath, she pressed the blade against Baishya's vulnerable throat.

summary: Naiva, her mind twisted by Bolas, holds a knife to Baishya's throat, then snaps out of it as the hedron's essence reaches her and Yasova disarms her.
quote: Why was she holding a blade against her sister's throat?

summary: Yasova explains that Bolas killed Ugin and uses mind touch, and that she will be taken because he threatened Tarkir.
quote: The dragon who killed Ugin has returned.

summary: Yasova confesses she helped Bolas track Ugin and cast a spell that turned fledgling dragons against him, after being promised an end to dragons.
quote: I helped Bolas track down Ugin because he promised me an end to dragons on Tarkir.

summary: Yasova argues that destroying the hedrons would destroy Ugin's essence, the soul of Tarkir, so they must resist Bolas.
quote: I do not believe Bolas can destroy the hedrons.

summary: Naiva takes Baishya's hand and enters Ugin's memories in the Meditation Realm.
quote: After a decisive nod at Grandmother, she took hold of Baishya's hand.

summary: Memory: Ugin, in the Meditation Realm, regrets that Nicol was not overjoyed at his return and wonders whether his departure was his fault.
quote: Nicol had succumbed to the worst in himself

summary: Memory: Bolas attacks Ugin in the Meditation Realm, accusing him of hoarding the planes' knowledge and abandoning him.
quote: You hoarded the knowledge of the planes to yourself.

summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

summary: Memory: Ugin realizes Nicol will never stop unless he thinks him dead, and accepts death in the Meditation Realm.
quote: With a sigh, Ugin accepts his death. He lets go.

summary: Memory: Bolas kills Ugin, who falls into the waters; the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
quote: With a mighty splash, Ugin falls into the still waters.

summary: Memory: The realm refills and a dragon, reborn from the waters, resolves to protect the planes and departs.
quote: Ugin has a lot to do if he means to protect the planes.

summary: Memory: Bolas, as god-emperor, sets two curved horns over the Meditation Realm to mark his triumph.
quote: Here, he erects two gigantic curved horns so they emerge from the waters

summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.
quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

summary: Naiva and Baishya wake from the memories and tell Yasova what they saw; Yasova decides to surrender herself to Bolas as a desperate gamble.
quote: The Spirit Dragon has not forgotten Tarkir. We have a chance to deflect Bolas.

summary: Yasova has Baishya wear Naiva's mantle and necklace to meet Bolas in Naiva's place.
quote: Baishya will wear your mantle and go out in your place.

summary: Yasova and Baishya face Bolas, taunting him that he came back to confirm Ugin was dead.
quote: You came back to see if he was really dead.

summary: Bolas threatens to devastate Tarkir and orders Naiva to kill Yasova, but Naiva resists in the hedron.
quote: Do it, Naiva. I command you! Kill her, and I will grant you all that you desire

summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

summary: Naiva emerges to find the dragon gone and discovers Yasova and Baishya alive, shielded by Baishya's earth magic.
quote: A big boulder shifted with a great, grinding rumble.

summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

summary: The rest of the party arrives; Tae Jin tells Naiva he would never mistake her for her sister again.
quote: I wouldn't mistake you for your sister ever again.

summary: Yasova tells the girls they must safeguard memory and asks Tae Jin to stay to recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
quote: I would like you to recite Ugin's story once again to Fec so it can be carved and preserved in more than one place.

summary: Yasova closes by telling the girls that even the greatest of dragons can die and that anything may come to pass in the unwritten now.
quote: Even the greatest of dragons can die.

summary: Vivien, aboard Frederic's ship, refuses to stow the Arkbow and expresses concern over the brontodon captive.
quote: There will be medical attention waiting for the brontodon, I hope?

summary: At the pier Vivien pins a human pickpocket who offers blood as penance, and Frederic offers her a dirk to take it.
quote: This is the currency of Luneau, mademoiselle.

summary: Vivien refuses the blood and frees the pickpocket, accusing Luneau of being a glorified abattoir.
quote: I'd say you were bullying this boy into accepting his lot as livestock

summary: Frederic claims Luneau preserves species, and Vivien tours the marble city with disgust.
quote: Preservation, mademoiselle. You never know when a species might go extinct.

summary: Frederic touches Vivien's wrist and asks about her home, and she recalls Skalla's destruction by fire.
quote: She tried not to think of fire.

summary: In the Hall of Treasures Vivien sees hundreds of taxidermied extinct species and wants to see it all gone, understanding Bolas for a moment.
quote: For one terrible moment, the Planeswalker could understand Nicol Bolas, the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.

summary: In the Perfumed Court, Frederic tells Vivien that the Baron of Vernot believes there are giants among the lizards, and the Arkbow urges Vivien to destroy Luneau, though she decides to wait.
quote: The Arkbow loathed this place.

summary: King Lucard and Queen Salazar enter and the court bows, but Vivien stays unbowed.
quote: Alone of them, Vivien stood unbowed, chin tipped up.

summary: The Baron of Vernot, Marcois Jean-Jaquent, enters and calls his special guests.
quote: We are ready for you.

summary: At the Tourdion, performers torture lizards, bears, raptors and cranes, and Vivien protests.
quote: This is cruelty,

summary: The baron presents a new monstrosaur, tortured and with its largest teeth plucked.
quote: Someone, Vivien realized with a pang of horror, had plucked the largest teeth from its head.

summary: Vivien fires the Arkbow, summoning a spectral hydra that kills nobles and disrupts the gala.
quote: the seething, glimmering green outline of a hydra wrenched itself from the arrowhead and howled its hunger for the world to see.

summary: The wounded monstrosaur, forgotten amid the chaos, crushes a guard in triumph.
quote: And as it did, it screamed and this time, there was triumph in the noise.

summary: Vivien summons a Pelakka wurm that devours guards and a spectral stag that throws a guard into a wall.
quote: The Pelakka wurm launched itself forward, all mouth and sinuous body, glowing green.

summary: The Baron of Vernot confronts Vivien surrounded by crossbowmen, and Vivien calls the place an abomination.
quote: This place is an abomination.

summary: Vivien vows to make Luneau pay and summons a swarm of giant wasps.
quote: I will see Luneau pay for what it has done to this world.

summary: Vivien stabs the baron with her daggers but he is unharmed, and he backhands her.
quote: But the baron's placid expression did not change.

summary: Vivien kicks and clubs the baron, but his minions drag her away; she knocks out two guards before losing consciousness.
quote: It was, she decided as awareness bled from her, at least a decent last stand.

summary: Vivien wakes, bloodied and suspended in manacles, as the Baron of Vernot tells her he has taken her Arkbow.
quote: We took your bow.

summary: The baron describes his failed attempts to use the Arkbow and questions what Vivien is, speculating she is a Planeswalker.
quote: I wonder if you are a Planeswalker.

summary: Vivien demands the Arkbow back; the baron refuses and presses her on how it works, and she mentions Skalla.
quote: Return the Arkbow.

summary: The baron tortures Vivien repeatedly with boiling-blood magic and blades, and nuns heal her each time; Vivien resists, having already been scarred by Bolas's destruction of Skalla.
quote: Each time he asked his questions, the baron's magic reached out, found the blood coursing through Vivien's body, and brought it to boil.

summary: The nuns bathe Vivien, dress her in a penitent's gown, chain her and lead her through the underground corridors toward the baron's luxurious quarters.
quote: But she said nothing, silent as the nuns laced her wrists with filigree chains

summary: Vivien is locked in a lavish cell with a table of fruit, trapped again.
quote: She was trapped, again.

summary: Left alone, Vivien relives the death of Skalla and Nicol Bolas rising into the burning sky, even in her dreams.
quote: When Vivien slumbered, she dreamed Skalla.

summary: A guard fetches Vivien, saying the baron has something to ask her, and she accepts rather than endure more stillness.
quote: Death, at that moment, appealed more than the continued ennui.

summary: Vivien is brought to a ballroom where the baron vivisects a living monstrosaur before King Lucard and his courtiers.
quote: He was, Vivien realized with a dazed start, not performing an autopsy, but a vivisection.

summary: The baron reveals he has deduced Skalla is dead and Vivien is its last living relic, and offers her glories and a queen's place if she teaches him to use the Arkbow.
quote: Teach me how to make use of the weapon and we will garland you with glories, ensure that you are never with an unfulfilled desire.

summary: Vivien feigns capitulation, agreeing to show the baron the Arkbow's mechanism but insisting she needs the weapon and that only she can perform the ritual.
quote: You can try all you want, but it won't work unless I'm performing the ritual.

summary: Vivien needles the baron until his composure cracks, declares she does not fear him but he fears her, and signals King Lucard, whose lady-in-waiting begins to bring a drink.
quote: But I think I scare you.

summary: Vivien reflects that her description of how the Arkbow works was true, and that she is the last of Skalla who can perform the ritual.
quote: But now Vivien was the last of Skalla.

summary: The baron's minions assemble a containment contraption around the dying monstrosaur and the nuns conjure a barrier; Vivien steps inside.
quote: More of the nuns were called to the room, and humming a couplet of chords, they conjured a shimmering barrier.

summary: Vivien demands anesthetics for the monstrosaur, and the nuns numb it into a deep sleep at the baron's order.
quote: The nuns complied.

summary: Vivien performs the ritual: the Arkbow opens and she draws the monstrosaur's spirit into it.
quote: The monstrosaur did not resist.

summary: The baron makes a guard try the Arkbow; it bursts his body, proving it obeys only Vivien, and the baron refuses to accept it.
quote: A minute spasm of those meaty digits, and his body burst outward.

summary: Vivien grows a spider from the guard's pocket with her magic and it leaps at King Lucard, causing chaos and loosening the nuns' hold on her prison.
quote: Alarmed by its growth, the arachnid turned and launched itself at the king.

summary: Vivien looses an arrow that summons the monstrosaur whole and vengeful, and it rampages through the ballroom, tearing through the ceiling.
quote: The arrow buried itself in the wall, and the ethereal monstrosaur tore itself loose, roaring

summary: The monstrosaur bites the Baron of Vernot in half, killing him.
quote: the two halves of what was once the Baron of Vernot fell quietly, messily to the ground

summary: Vivien follows the monstrosaur through the palace and enlarges and frees the animals of the Royal Menagerie, who attack their handlers.
quote: Vivien ran her magic through a family of wildebeests, stoking their cells until the creatures grew large enough to smash through their confinement.

summary: In a gallery of nobles, Vivien declares the end of Luneau and enlarges a vampire girl's pet raptor, which devours its owner.
quote: Then, without any reservation, it twitched forward and shut its jaws around the vampire's skull, teeth crunching through the vertebrae.

summary: The freed menagerie stampedes through the gallery and the Royal Palace collapses.
quote: Soon enough, the Royal Palace fell, dust pluming into the air.

summary: In a cafe in the cultural district, two officers grumble that the baron is studying the Arkbow and could make them redundant, just before the stampede arrives.
quote: If he succeeds at deciphering that stupid artifact, we'd be out of a job.

summary: Enormous dinosaurs and beasts flood Luneau's streets, wrecking buildings, as Vivien rides a monstrosaur's head.
quote: these creatures weren't just unexpectedly everywhere, they were each three times their usual sizes, too massive to be plausible.

summary: Vivien surveys the anarchy she unleashed and resolves to secure the Arkbow against theft and find larger prey to hunt.
quote: Vivien wouldn't tolerate an encore.

summary: Vivien decides to harness dragons to learn the secret of destroying Nicol Bolas, and settles on luring a Shivan dragon.
quote: Nicol Bolas wasn't the only dragon in the Multiverse.

summary: Vivien planeswalks from Ixalan to Shiv.
quote: before she flashed into the next plane and felt the hard, hot air of Shiv on her skin

summary: Merret, working the docks as a Dimir agent, nearly pockets a bottle of expensive whiskey from a crate before his boss approaches and he hides it.
quote: Sloppy, Merret, sloppy.

summary: Grimbly Wothis orders Merret to clear the fog from the harbor for an investor, threatening to dock his pay.
quote: How's this for confidence . . . you don't clear it and you don't get your pay for today?

summary: Merret barely thins the fog and reveals a Simic schooner cloaking itself, which Wothis uses as a selling point to the investor.
quote: Fog swirls, barely, clearing about halfway to the other side of the river

summary: Merret returns to his cramped home in Keyhole Village, where Tashi demands he find real food for the hungry baby.
quote: Get the food, Merret. I don't care how.

summary: Failing to steal from a posh grocer, Merret breaks into Grimbly Wothis's apartment through an unlocked window.
quote: I round the building, make a quick hop to the balcony, and sure enough, find an unlocked window.

summary: Merret takes a loaf of bread and drinks drops of an Elixir of Focus from Wothis's kitchen.
quote: Just one more, for good measure.

summary: Wothis's wife enters the kitchen, and the elixir sharpens Merret's magic enough to make himself invisible to her.
quote: I draw on magic, and her mind opens up to me like a map.

summary: Empowered, Merret clears the whole harbor, then in a show-off moment casts a nightmare on the crane operator Yantis, dropping a crate of whiskey toward Wothis and the investor.
quote: Yantis screams, fighting all the terrifying nothings in front of him.

summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

summary: Merret's baby, healthy after gnawing elixir-stained bread, sneezes and every candle in the apartment ignites.
quote: Then baby sneezes, and every single candle in our apartment bursts into flame.

summary: Wothis breaks into the apartment, beats Merret and demands the child, saying he saw the candle trick through the window.
quote: I saw what that child did through the window, the trick with the candles.

summary: Merret weaves a nightmare in Wothis's mind but loses focus when Wothis nears Soche, and Wothis seizes the baby.
quote: And like that, my baby is in Grimbly Wothis's arms

summary: Wothis kicks Merret in the mouth and throws Tashi into a cabinet, breaking her ribs.
quote: With a hard shake, he flings her off.

summary: The baby gets magically gripped, vanishes from Wothis's arms and reappears on the floor holding a strange purple star-shaped fruit.
quote: My son arches his back again, throws his arms up, and suddenly, he's gone.

summary: Merret notices Lazav sitting in the armchair, and the baby takes his first steps into Lazav's arms.
quote: Could this be Lazav? Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?

summary: Lazav orders Wothis to stay away from the family, and magically bends his will.
quote: Any outstanding debts Merret owes you will be paid in full by the close of business tomorrow

summary: Lazav offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend, and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, who stays with the family.
quote: we would like to ask that we send a tutor to your home to oversee his learning

summary: Lazav's laugh scrambles the family's memories so that Great Aunt Bea seems to be staying with them.
quote: Lazav laughs a raspy laugh, like stones scratching against rib bone.

summary: Leighbet, moonlighting as an analyst, follows the Golgari troll Kel'teth through the Tenth District sewers to find what is making fatbergs immune to electricity.
quote: No time for gawking, I'm afraid,

summary: Kel'teth saves Leighbet from a sewer siren by throwing cement at it.
quote: Rabid as all get-out, but they can't attack you unless you put your hand in their mouth.

summary: Leighbet scans a fatberg and detects a powerful, unrecognized arcane trace, then leaves the sleeping Kel'teth to follow it.
quote: whatever's causing this sizzle is powerful.

summary: Leighbet opens a grate with stored mana, finds a spatial rift ringed by plants, and survives an eel shock after her canister explodes.
quote: For a long, long moment, my entire body seizes up and my world goes white.

summary: Leighbet deduces that contact with the rift made the plants, and over time the fatbergs, immune to electricity and takes samples.
quote: Contact with the rift must have imbued them with immunity to electrical magic.

summary: Leighbet demands a promotion from Master Dax, is fired and loses her access and title, and starts an unsanctioned lab in the boilerpit beneath her apartment.
quote: that just leaves you standing at the front steps of the Lightning Rod, a box full of your desk belongings in your arms.

summary: Leighbet hires Tamsyn Sweene as a blastseeker, who claims past experience and passes a practical test.
quote: Tamsyn Sweene. Call me Tammy, and we've got a problem.

summary: Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity.
quote: It's completely impervious to electricity.

summary: Tamsyn tells a false story of her chemister's death and talks Leighbet into hiring her by promising to get the lab approved without sanctions.
quote: I can get your lab declared an Innovative Niche Workshop.

summary: Tamsyn gets the lab officially recognized by the Izmundi and recruits five paid test subjects, and the serum protects all of them from electric shocks.
quote: The other four tests go exactly the same, successes all around.

summary: Tamsyn convinces Leighbet that the test subjects must be silenced and poisons all five with a lethal sleep elixir, and Leighbet goes along with it.
quote: I already gave them all a hyper-concentrated dose of sleep elixir laced with an ethereal death accelerant.

summary: Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, then flees into the sewers.
quote: my teeth are reshuffling, becoming jagged and ragged like a mouthful of fangs.

summary: Tamsyn finds Leighbet in the sewers and reveals she is a shapeshifting Dimir spy who never was a blastseeker.
quote: There was no chemister, Leighbet. I never was a blastseeker.

summary: Tamsyn attacks Leighbet with electricity and declares the serum a Dimir discovery; an arc drake's electric breath hits them in the water.
quote: your serum is a Dimir discovery now. Goodbye, Leighbet.

summary: Leighbet builds a makeshift ballast from sewer junk, stuns Tamsyn with a thrown welding jar and redirects her own blast back at her.
quote: When the next blast orb comes, I meet it with my makeshift ballast.

summary: Leighbet's Simic transformation wears off, and she kills Tamsyn by snapping her spine to keep the discovery from Dimir.
quote: as Tamsyn's vertebrae snap, I take comfort that she doesn't know pain for long.

summary: Sergeant Skormak promotes Ossett to Wojek, giving her a red cord and a sealed letter.
quote: My first accolade.

summary: Ossett realizes her invitation to a reception is a coded briefing for her first counterintelligence assignment and decodes a meeting at a bunker near the Rubblebelt.
quote: This isn't an invitation. It's the briefing for my first assignment as a Wojek counterintelligence agent.

summary: Aresaan snoops over Ossett's shoulder and mocks her promotion.
quote: It's a fine accomplishment for someone with such weak convictions.

summary: In the Gruul market, Ossett catches a child thieving but pays the merchant and lets her go.
quote: I sigh, then let the child go.

summary: Ossett enters the bunker and meets her informant Brazer, who insists on playing Clans & Legions first.
quote: I do," he says, the weariness obvious in his raspy voice. "But first, let's play.

summary: Brazer reveals there is a spy in Boros Legion and demands that the prisoner Baas Solvar be freed from Wargate in exchange for the name.
quote: There's a spy in the Boros Legion.

summary: Ossett bribes Skormak's assistant to slip a release form into his signature pile, then discovers the prisoner is related to the raider Govan Radley.
quote: Baas Solvar isn't her full name. Baas Solvar Radley.

summary: Aresaan taunts Ossett while she works and Ossett decides to ignore the truth about the prisoner.
quote: I just need to go on ignoring the truth.

summary: Baas Solvar is freed. Ossett waits for Brazer at the market, and Kahti steals her coin purse while hugging her.
quote: Then I notice my coin purse is gone.

summary: Ossett returns to the bunker and finds Brazer dead with his throat slit and the angel piece of the game missing.
quote: Only what I find is Brazer's dead body, sitting where I'd left him, slit across his neck.

summary: Aresaan intercepts Ossett outside Sunhome and goes in with her to report the murder.
quote: I know we haven't been the most cordial of co-workers, but I'll come with you if you want

summary: Guards arrest Ossett for the poisonings of Skormak, Sidian and Atalay and find the poison-filled angel piece in her coin purse.
quote: You're suspected in the acute poisonings of Sergeant Embrel Skormak, Second Lieutenant Devin Sidian, and Guildmage Rook Atalay.

summary: Ossett deduces that Skormak, the only survivor, poisoned himself to gain a promotion and that the minotaur guard killed Brazer, and exposes the dust on her uniform.
quote: Skormak is behind this and he poisoned himself to escape the blame.

summary: Aresaan's fire exposes the dragon-bone Rubblebelt dust on the minotaur, who throws down the poison and flees.
quote: When we regain our composure, the spy is gone.

summary: Aresaan unbinds her wings and carries Ossett to Skormak's desk at Annex Four.
quote: Razor wire crumbles as she flexes her wings against it

summary: Skormak admits his motive, resentment that flame-kin are denied high rank, and accuses the Legion of injustice.
quote: Three out of thousands . Just because we were cast instead of born doesn't mean we aren't capable of performing in high ranks.

summary: Ossett rams Skormak into a wall and Aresaan douses him with a water elemental, extinguishing him into wet ashes.
quote: He smolders like a pinched wick, then dissipates into a pile of wet ashes and charred armor.

summary: Bozak, harvesting rare mushrooms on the family farmstead, hears the undercity news that a new lich seeks an apprentice skilled at mushroom identification.
quote: the lich is seeking an apprentice with a proficiency in mushroom identification and a keen interest in necromancy.

summary: Bozak explains why he wants to be a necromancer and sneaks away from his siblings and Mother's carapace to enter the contest.
quote: I pack my maps, my journals, my vials, and my harvester's satchel and sneak away while my siblings lie dreaming.

summary: The lich starts a contest for twenty-six competitors to retrieve four of the most dangerous mushrooms in Ravnica, handing out maps.
quote: Only one of you will be deemed skillful enough to serve as my apprentice,

summary: Zegodonis bumps Bozak and tears his map; Bozak then spots woodwraiths in the mangrove and warns a few others, who escape while the rest are killed.
quote: We hear the creaking of old branches and the suck of roots pulling up from waterlogged soil.

summary: Bozak meets the kraul Limin and the gorgon Kata, collects zombie fungus, and makes a temporary truce with Limin.
quote: If we share information and resources, we can all but guarantee a kraul will win.

summary: An elf competitor punctures his zombie fungus, is overtaken by spores and climbs a tree to die as a host.
quote: The elf chooses a tree and scales it like his body had been built for this sole purpose.

summary: Bozak collects devouring angel mushrooms from a mossdog den while Limin spreads his scent; Limin throws a rock and wakes the dogs and flies off.
quote: tossing a rock into the mossdog den

summary: Bozak and Kata team up against the mossdogs; Kata petrifies them but also kills nearly a hundred of Bozak's locusts.
quote: The third mossdog turns into a statue, and with it, nearly a hundred locusts.

summary: Kata tries to petrify Bozak, and he stabs her in the stomach with his staff carved from Mother's leg.
quote: I move fast, thrust the staff forward. It catches the gorgon in the stomach.

summary: Riding a deadbridge goliath, Bozak races back while the surviving Zegodonis ambushes Limin and steals his satchel; Bozak reaches the lich first.
quote: He batters Limin as he passes, breaking off two legs and part of a wing.

summary: The lich declares both Bozak and Zegodonis his apprentices, though he favors Zegodonis.
quote: And both of you shall serve under me.

summary: Months later Bozak tends zombies and learns that Boros officers have been exposed to zombie fungus, and Vraska fears Boros will use it to infiltrate the undercity.
quote: Three high-ranking Boros officers were exposed to the same type of zombie fungus we had been asked to gather.

summary: Alone in the lich's sanctum, Bozak tries a death spell for the first time on a rat corpse.
quote: I practice the movements I've seen the lich do

summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

summary: The lich reveals he hopes Boros will back a Devkarin successor as guildmaster, and the soldiers hint Zegodonis is their pick.
quote: they take into consideration the help I've been to you today.

summary: Bozak reanimates the rat for the first time and uses it to bite the lich, creating a distraction so he can flee to warn Vraska.
quote: then takes a chomp on the lich's ankle.

summary: Bozak reaches the Hanging Keep and consumes zombie fungus to lose his fear and climb seven stories to Vraska.
quote: I pull a zombie fungus sample from my satchel and place it on my tongue.

summary: Mazirek orders Bozak thrown out; Bozak tears his own arm free, swallows the devouring angel mushroom from Vraska's gown and leaps from the Keep.
quote: I grab the devouring angel mushroom on her gown and swallow it whole.

summary: Bozak survives the fall but wakes controlled by the fungus, with Mazirek tending him, and willingly submits to serve him.
quote: ready and willing to serve him as best I can

summary: Ambrellin tells Terrik to forgive himself, and he hides a wurm under his bed while telling her the neighbors' wurm sightings are over-meditation.
quote: do you really think I'd be able to fit a half-grown wurm under my bed?

summary: Terrik uses bramble seeds to stop an Orzhov thug trying to sell him insurance, then reaches the orphanage near the ruined basilica.
quote: thorny vines erupt from the sidewalk, entangling my pursuer in their scratchy embrace.

summary: Children at the orphanage recognize Terrik as the wurmcaller who destroyed the basilica, and Bazda defends him with a hairpin.
quote: Bazda pulls a six-inch hairpin from her right bun and jabs it at the punk

summary: Bazda shows Terrik an ancient crescent artifact her father found at the basilica, and Terrik promises to have Ambrellin look at it.
quote: My father gave me this a couple days before he died.

summary: Bazda steals Terrik's shears and follows him home to the Selesnyan cooperative.
quote: It's only fair I hold something valuable of yours.

summary: Ambrellin identifies Bazda's artifact as ancient Izzet technology and calls it priceless.
quote: I've seen them before on ancient Izzet machinery

summary: Savaryn announces his promotion and that he and Kellim will move away, upsetting Terrik.
quote: We're not commuting,

summary: Terrik proposes one last adventure and reveals his young wurm is his bed; the friends reluctantly agree to explore beneath the basilica.
quote: Not quite. The wurm is the bed.

summary: Terrik's wurm tunnels them to the catacombs beneath the basilica, where a trap statue pulls Ambrellin into a passage; the wurm bolts and the floor collapses.
quote: Then the entire floor gives out, and there's nowhere for us to go but down.

summary: Stuck, Ambrellin finally admits she is angry and tells Terrik his friends are leaving because of his behavior; Terrik walks away alone.
quote: Okay I'm angry with you, are you happy?

summary: Terrik finds an Orzhov pontiff using abused wurms and spirits to dig for a missing piece of an Izzet coin machine.
quote: Faster! It's got to be buried around here somewhere,

summary: A rat startles Savaryn, waking the gargoyles, and the pontiff captures Terrik and Savaryn, forcing them to sign indenture contracts.
quote: Sign it or become wurm food.

summary: Terrik learns the machine mints gold from copper and meets Bazda's mother among the spirits, bound by contract.
quote: You're Bazda's mother?

summary: Terrik and Savaryn tear up the pontiff's contract book, but the pontiff restores it and questions Terrik under a verity spell.
quote: Then the pontiff reaches down into the mist and pulls back a perfectly bound book, pages all intact.

summary: Bazda secretly passes her artifact to Terrik as the pontiff searches the prisoners.
quote: Her quick thieving hands had planted it on me without me even noticing.

summary: A captive wurm collapses from the pontiff's pain magic, and Terrik, recognizing it as one of his own, plans revenge with Bazda's mother's help.
quote: He's one of mine, I know it.

summary: Disguised as a statue and with Bazda's mother's help, Terrik hurls the pontiff into the pit and tears up the contracts; the thrull jumps in after him.
quote: I pitch him into the hole.

summary: Ambrellin repairs the coin mill with Bazda's artifact and Savaryn pushes it, producing gold to pay off everyone's debts.
quote: The first gold coin tumbles out the chute, and I catch it in my hands.

summary: The pontiff returns with the thrull fused to his leg, but Terrik pays off the debts and the contracts release, freeing the spirits.
quote: I'm paying off all of our debts. We are no longer bound to your contracts.

summary: The group escapes on the wurm through molten rock with weaving healing spells, and Bazda is reunited with her parents.
quote: Mama? Papa?

summary: Terrik returns Bazda's artifact via Ambrellin and the friends find Terrik's wurm asleep in the neighbors' bed.
quote: Looks like she found her way back home, give or take a floor.

summary: Kodolaag goes into Zita's effigy shop, is heckled by an Azorius elocutor outside, and clumsily tries to chat her up.
quote: I'd like to buy these.

summary: Kodolaag finally introduces himself as Kodolaag and learns Zita's rule that effigy spells on Azorius senators are now punishable by imprisonment.
quote: New laws in the skies last week. Effigy spells used upon members of the Azorius Senate are punishable by imprisonment.

summary: Kodolaag uses blight parchment to drive the Azorius elocutor away, and Zita fears arrest.
quote: He grabs his head with both hands, screaming at the top of his lungs.

summary: Kodolaag persuades Olrich to host Zita's effigy sales at the Mockturne by promising him an audience at Rix Maadi.
quote: I'll call in a favor. I'll get you an audience at Rix Maadi!

summary: Kodolaag performs poetry and a comedy set mocking Azorius and Dovin Baan, which falls flat when an arrester appears.
quote: I finish my set anyway—twenty-three minutes of pure torture.

summary: On the way home Zita fixes graffiti insulting Dovin Baan, and an Azorius arrester arrests her for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, with Kodolaag's statement logged against her.
quote: defacing a public building," he continues, "Plus Azorius code 6342-P, slandering a Grand Arbiter," the arrester says, binding Zita up

summary: Kodolaag and Olrich visit the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them a box and instructions for freeing Zita.
quote: Visit Udzec tomorrow morning. Get in line behind the minotaur with a curly red mane.

summary: At Udzec, Olrich dresses as a baby and swallows the bloodfray amulet, and Kodolaag frames the minotaur Jitka Wothis by hiding a whiskey bottle in her cape to distract the nullmages.
quote: Carefully, carefully I rest the bottle inside, hoping it's light enough not to pull the fabric.

summary: Kodolaag finds Zita under an Azorius spell that makes prisoners praise their imprisonment and realizes everything is not fine.
quote: The guards must be forcing the prisoners to speak fondly about their internment—or else.

summary: Zita brings a guard's drawing in a coloring book to life, and Kodolaag draws every guard on blight parchment and tears the pages, incapacitating them.
quote: Electric magic ignites the paper, and the guards wail out in unison as if they're being burned alive.

summary: Olrich impersonates Dovin Baan to hold off a soldier, and the trio walks out among exiting visitors.
quote: Citizens! Behold! It is I, your highly esteemed Grand Arbiter, Protector of Justice, Purveyor of Protocols!

summary: Jitka Wothis and a vampire identify Kodolaag and Olrich, who are bound by magic; Zita escapes into the crowd.
quote: Before we can deny it, Olrich and I are bound up in magic.

summary: Kodolaag and Olrich are put to forced labor at the Exner prison site.
quote: As soon as we're given our uniforms, we're put to work with the rest of the non-violent offenders and pre-offenders.

summary: Kodolaag has Olrich cough up the amulet and scales the Exner scaffolding, shattering the bloodfray stone and triggering a massive riot as archons close in.
quote: The amulet cracks and unleashes a swarm of black tendrils, pressing the light back and turning day to night.

summary: Kodolaag joins the riot, and thousands of prisoners escape.
quote: The madness spreads.

summary: Lucinka tells Zita, Olrich and Kodolaag they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity to hunt dangerous escapees.
quote: You'll have to set up new lives in the undercity,

summary: Arrus gathers ingredients for his magical tattoo ink, tampering with the recipe because the maaka scat is poor.
quote: so I desperately add more scat to the mix until finally the ink brightens.

summary: At the ruined battlefront the Ghor Clan builds rubble tributes and Rage spreads through the crowd, but Arrus can only pretend to feel it.
quote: And just like that, Rage ignites.

summary: Arrus tattoos Jiri and learns Dryzek may challenge Ruric and Thar for chieftain.
quote: I think he's going to challenge Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain,

summary: Dryzek tells Arrus that Rage speaks differently to different people, hinting he knows Arrus's heart is cold, and Arrus starts tattooing his arm.
quote: I know Rage when I see it, and that ain't it. But it'll find you.

summary: Dryzek kneels and offers a roasted drake to Ruric and Thar as a token of loyalty, sealing a blood kinship instead of a coup.
quote: The deal is sealed with a blood kinship, and all the walls between factions come crashing down.

summary: The ink Arrus made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, and Ruric and Thar cast Arrus out of the clan.
quote: Your services are no longer needed here,

summary: Clanless, Arrus notices the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food are all failing and tries to warn Jiri, who refuses to listen.
quote: Something's been sucking the life out of the Rubblebelt these last couple months.

summary: Arrus tries to steal the ink of the ogre shaman, who beats him up, and Selesnyan vine magic from spilled ink heals him.
quote: Slowly, but surely, I feel my broken bones mend.

summary: Arrus follows the ogre to a hydra cave where she steals an egg using a goblin skull lure, and they flee together.
quote: The ground erupts, spewing rock and stone as a steep ramp forms ahead of us.

summary: Arrus recognizes the ogre as Baas Radley, the shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams.
quote: Wait. You're Baas Radley. The shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams?

summary: Baas teaches Arrus to face down a charging battleboar herd and offers to send him to Burning Tree Clan and teach him her ink recipe.
quote: You're too good to toss to the Wilds.

summary: Baas reveals she was arrested at Tin Street Market and abandoned by Daeska, and why she avoids the front line.
quote: I got arrested. Daeska got away.

summary: Arrus discovers that trees on the Selesnyan border are only five years old, planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt.
quote: Selesnya had planted thousands and thousands of saplings, and then accelerated their growth until they had the perfect impenetrable barrier.

summary: Arrus challenges Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain and is beaten, repeatedly defying them.
quote: Ruric pounds his huge fist on the top of my head, and I crumple to the ground

summary: Arrus finally finds his Rage, rooted in anger at his people's lost stories, and rises from the beating.
quote: There's no more pain, only Rage.

summary: Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames.
quote: He stands behind me, and my flames all but leap for him.

summary: Ruric and Thar accept Arrus's challenge, set themselves alight and declare war on Selesnya.
quote: If Selesnya wants a war, we'll give them a war,

summary: Medge shows her students a motionless elder monk, and Kaszira calculates how long he has meditated from the plankton on him.
quote: Seven weeks. That's how long the elder monk has been meditating.

summary: Ptero Zallik shows off his crustacean mutation and tells Medge that Guardian Project reinforcements have cut the open protectorate spots to sixty-two.
quote: The Guardian Project has decided to send in some reinforcements. They're taking eighteen spots.

summary: Medge takes her eight students beyond the safe waters to watch a krasis in action, where they witness a krasis kill a resplendent benthid.
quote: A stinger erupts from the tip of the krasis's tail and strikes a killing blow on the beast's soft underbelly.

summary: A voice rasping 'passage' draws Medge, Kaszira and Miko into a wreck, where they find a ghost.
quote: The human locks eyes with Miko.

summary: The ghost Andrik introduces himself as a sailor who fell through a zonot and asks to be taken home with his crew's bodies.
quote: I am seaman Andrik, most unfortunate sole survivor of the Heckless

summary: Medge agrees to help the ghost reach the surface, and the students lighten and refloat the ship with a benthid vocal sac for buoyancy.
quote: We spend nearly an hour and a half of constant blowing, but the ship starts to shift in the ocean bed.

summary: The students sail the wreck toward Zonot Five using concealment spells and hide it from a passing krasis.
quote: The old wreck fades into a rippling blue haze, like the water itself.

summary: At the zonot, Andrik panics, reveals himself as a pirate in opulent robes and unleashes a storm, and the trunk's contents prove to be stolen Simic treasure.
quote: You stole these," I say. "Your crew wasn't pontificating! You were pirating!

summary: Chessa and Kaszira rip up the medallion binding the ghost, and Chessa lures a krasis into swallowing it, dragging the ghost into the beast.
quote: Let's see how you like your new master,

summary: The class brings the Simic artifacts to the guardians, who recognize Momir Vig's stolen keyrune, and the museum puts it on display.
quote: this is Momir Vig's keyrune. Stolen nearly a century ago.

summary: Kaszira decides to study in the zonots to find ways to help creatures survive krasis; Medge praises her.
quote: You will make the Combine proud. You already make me proud.

summary: Miko's fin knocks the cytoplast from its pedestal and it mutates Medge, giving her tentacles tipped with eyes.
quote: Those things at my tentacle tips, they're eyes.

summary: Guardians confront Medge for destroying a priceless artifact and a scuffle sends her and her students to the zonot's brig.
quote: my class and I are tossed into the zonot's brig.

summary: Speaker Zegana bans Kaszira and her friends from the zonots, but Medge pleads that Kaszira be allowed to study.
quote: You and your friends are to return to merfolk territory immediately and are hereby banned from the zonots.

summary: At the showing, every student except Miko and Kaszira is placed in the protectorate, and Kaszira appears as a Simic biomancer student.
quote: I see her in the audience . . . dressed in Simic biomancer robes.

summary: Medge and Ptero reconcile and agree to tend their clutches together next year.
quote: Maybe next year we can team up,

summary: Miri's first refusal as a tithe taker: a citizen refuses the thirty-percent tithe, curses the Obzedat and attacks her, and she subdues him.
quote: I dealt him a forearm to the temple and then used my staff to sweep his feet from underneath him.

summary: Miri gives her father the money she skimmed from tithes, and it is revealed the family fortune was lost with the Ghost Council.
quote: He'd returned home with the truth: there was no family fortune.

summary: Miri reveals she secretly works for a fleshmage making thrulls and gives half her pay to help citizens short on tithes.
quote: So I got a second job assisting a fleshmage.

summary: Miri's father comes home with a thrull-replaced leg after a failed scheme involving an Izzet machine and wurms, and curses Selesnya.
quote: Father cursed the Selesnya Conclave

summary: Miri overhears a woman begging Jarek for her life with information on a Vitu-Ghazi vulnerability, and Jarek flays her and binds her spirit to a tome.
quote: He flayed the borrower from head to toe

summary: Miri steals the dead spy's Selesnyan robes.
quote: I shoved the robes into my satchel.

summary: Miri's father catches her in the Selesnyan robes, and she lies that she is going undercover to exploit the vulnerability at Vitu-Ghazi.
quote: I'm going undercover to see if I can find it

summary: Miri joins the Selesnyan initiates and befriends Danika, Caz and Vasil.
quote: Danika, Caz, and Vasil are in my assigned developmental pod.

summary: Miri spends a day bartering for new robes and attends a long Collective Blessing, where Danika lends her a shawl.
quote: Danika saw my frustration and leant me a shawl

summary: Miri's growth spell fails, and Danika swaps pots with her and takes the elder's punishment.
quote: at the last possible second, she switched her pot with mine.

summary: At Vitu-Ghazi a mysterious artifact appears in Miri's pocket and reveals that the world tree is fragile and could be toppled.
quote: One well-targeted attack could bring the whole structure down, this time for good.

summary: Miri's mother secretly gives her the Crown of Convergence to give her father in place of the vulnerability, and Miri gives it to him.
quote: The Crown of Convergence? Miri, this is worth thousands!

summary: Miri returns to work after the tithing revolt ends at eighteen percent and presents her father with a secret enchanted money tree.
quote: It's an enchanted money tree,

summary: Reza visits the Old Laws Library, where Tagan tells him the Senate adored his law rune and that Baan called it brilliant.
quote: They adored it. So intricate. So comprehensive.

summary: Tagan urges Reza to visit the Historical Archives in person to follow up with a new law, and he agrees despite his fear of flying.
quote: You should visit the Historical Archives yourself, while your rune is still new in the sky.

summary: Reza flies a griffin over Ravnica, passing his own law rune in the sky, and then is thrown when lightning shoots a thopter.
quote: I try to compensate so I can steady it, but my efforts make things worse, and I lose my grip.

summary: Reza falls into a pile of trash in the Thinktank and is helped by Hendrik, who explains a mad genius has been shooting down thopters.
quote: That was a mighty fall you took. You're lucky to be alive.

summary: Reza follows Hendrik home and meets Janin, who cleans his robes and offers vedalken cleansing oils.
quote: I'm Janin. I keep the gears from falling off in this little hovel.

summary: A vedalken mugger steals one of Reza's satchels, and when Reza seeks help at the edge of the Thinktank, Azorius arresters suspect him instead.
quote: He swipes at the strap of one of my satchels. It comes free, and then he's running off with my precious reference texts.

summary: Missing his identity rune, Reza throws a vial of cleansing oil at the arresters and flees, fearing arrest under his own new law.
quote: I retrieve it from the satchel, then throw it down at the arrester's feet.

summary: Hendrik and Janin rescue Reza in a thopter vehicle assembled from stolen Azorius parts, and Reza realizes Hendrik is the thopter shooter.
quote: You're the 'mad genius' who's been shooting down thopters!

summary: A huge electrical elemental emerges from a rift over the Thinktank workshop, and Azorius archons cannot act because of the jurisdiction dispute.
quote: More lightning lashes out of the rift as the elemental starts to take on a distinct form

summary: Reza invokes emergency law to name Hendrik Grand Arbiter pro tem and grants the Thinktank sovereignty so it can request Azorius help.
quote: By the prerogative writ of emergency, and by a unanimous vote, I hereby declare Hendrik Azmerak Grand Arbiter pro tem of the Thinktank Enclave.

summary: Azorius archons and nullmages subdue the elemental after Reza's law rune brings help.
quote: They work together to cast a blue dome of magic over the elemental

summary: After months of negotiation, Reza has solved the Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy with a fifty-seven page proposal.
quote: I'd solved the Fallacy. For real this time.

summary: Tagan tells Reza she can no longer be his mentor because it is time he becomes a mentor himself.
quote: I can't be your mentor anymore, because I think it's time you become a mentor yourself.

summary: Rat meets her friend Hekara on the Transguild Promenade and reports on tailing Ral Zarek to Nivix, where he and Niv-Mizzet had an exploding experiment.
quote: Something about a beacon being their only chance now.

summary: Hekara receives Zarek's summons to activate the beacon and tells Rat to take the night off.
quote: It's now-or-never time.

summary: Hekara leaves, calling Rat by her full name, and Rat wanders the city until dawn when Hekara does not show.
quote: She wasn't there. I waited, but she didn't come.

summary: Teyo materializes on the Promenade covered in sand, and Rat adopts him.
quote: And as a sand-covered boy materialized right in front of me.

summary: Rat learns Teyo is from Gobakhan and an acolyte of the Shieldmage Order and explains that he has planeswalked to Ravnica.
quote: Teyo, I've a feeling you're not on Gobakhan anymore.

summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

summary: Rat and Teyo arrive at Tenth District Plaza and find a new obelisk and pyramid crowned with dragon statues.
quote: Sometime—sometime very recently—it had risen out of the ground, displacing buildings and gardens and whatever else used to be there.

summary: A giant portal opens and splits the Embassy of the Guildpact, killing bystanders, and Bolas gloats from his pyramid.
quote: A gigantic portal—easily fifty yards tall—had opened up behind us, instantly decimating the Embassy of the Guildpact, sheering it right in half.

summary: A raven-haired woman puts on a golden veil, her skin glows with purple tattoos, and she commands the marching Eternal army to slaughter the crowd.
quote: the army stopped as one and turned to look her way

summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
quote: Mistress Kaya said, "Run."

summary: Teyo shields Kaya from a mineralized minotaur while Rat stabs it, and Zarek electrocutes it.
quote: He stood over Mistress Kaya, erecting a triangular shield of light to protect her and himself from the creature.

summary: Zarek's goggles identify Teyo as a Planeswalker, and Kaya asks if there are others.
quote: You're a Planeswalker.

summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

summary: Kaya tells Rat that Hekara is dead, devastating Rat.
quote: Hekara's dead,

summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
quote: Never heard of 'Gatewatch' before today.

summary: Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

summary: Teyo expands his shield across the alley to hold the Eternals while Rat picks the lock of Krumnen's.
quote: I'll buy the time,

summary: Gruul warriors led by Domri Rade charge the Eternals from behind and save the trio.
quote: attacked the Eternals from behind, axes chopping through lazotep.

summary: Teyo and Kaya save Gan Shokta from a dying Eternal, and Rat reveals Gan is her father.
quote: That's Gan Shokta. My father.

summary: The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.
quote: You are free, Eknet.

summary: Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

summary: Four God-Eternals emerge from the portal over Tenth District Plaza, and Samut identifies them as her plane's gods, now Bolas's servants.
quote: They are our gods,

summary: The God-Eternals tear apart Vitu-Ghazi, and Domri cheers and announces the Gruul will join the dragon.
quote: We're joining the dragon!

summary: Gan Shokta refuses to follow Domri and goes back to Borborygmos, and Domri leads others to the plaza.
quote: I'm going back to Borborygmos.

summary: A viashino planeswalker is killed by an Eternal that drains his life force, and the fire shoots toward Bolas.
quote: Then that fire rocketed into the air, shooting like a comet toward Tenth District Plaza and the dragon.

summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

summary: Kaya reaches Orzhova and asks her chief servitor to rally the Orzhov against Bolas.
quote: In an attempt to rally the Orzhov to fight Bolas and his Eternals

summary: Kaya meets the Orzhov Triumvirate, who refuse to commit forces and only offer an honor guard to the Senate.
quote: If our new guildmaster would lead the charge, I'm sure the church executioners would be pleased to provide her with an honor guard

summary: Chief Enforcer Bilagru offers his enforcers and the Syndicate's military to protect Orzhov investments from the Eternals, and Kaya threatens to forgive all debts.
quote: I can render all debt collection moot, by forgiving every single debt this instant.

summary: At the Senate House summit, Rat notes that most guilds are absent, and Rakdos blames the leaders for Hekara's death.
quote: Lord Rakdos blamed Master Zarek, Mistress Kaya, Miss Lavinia, and Mistress Vraska

summary: Rat learns Domri Rade is dead after his Spark was harvested and that Niv-Mizzet is dead.
quote: Turns out he was a Planeswalker and got his Spark harvested by an Eternal.

summary: Zarek and Maree discuss Operation Desperation, requiring all ten guilds.
quote: you'll need cooperation from ten of ten guilds. There can be no exceptions.

summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
quote: Vraska's vengeance was well earned!

summary: Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

summary: Jace identifies Liliana Vess as controlling the Eternals for Bolas and says she must be stopped forever, to Gideon's silence.
quote: Liliana Vess. She's clearly controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

summary: Gideon adds a sixth problem, protecting ordinary Ravnicans, and Zarek adds a seventh, reconstituting the Guildpact.
quote: We need to reconstitute the Guildpact by uniting all ten guilds.

summary: Attendees argue about surrender or hiding, and Vorel blames planeswalkers while the archer and Samut insist Bolas is never sated.
quote: There is literally nothing left of my world, Skalla, thanks to him.

summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

summary: An Izzet goblin warns that a God-Eternal with an army is approaching; Jace calls for volunteers for six missions while Zarek asks Kaya to help with Operation Desperation.
quote: one a' them God-Eternals approaches, at the head of a small army of those undead creepies!

summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

summary: Teyo shields the group while Nissa asks an old birch tree to kill a crop of Eternals.
quote: Teyo put up a shield, and from behind it, Miss Revane asked permission of an old birch tree
