summary: The group finds the Selesnya Conclave fortified and hostile, with Nissa blamed for awakening Vitu-Ghazi.
quote: We found the Conclave well and truly fortified. And unwelcoming.

summary: Rat slips inside and meets her godfather Boruvo, who is moved to help.
quote: my godfather, Keeper of my Life Pledge, the Selesnyan spearmaster Boruvo

summary: Boruvo carries Rat to her friends and through the Ledev line, and demands that Nissa be sent away; Nissa leaves to join Gideon.
quote: I've never been very good at talking. You two go with the centaur. I'll join Gideon.

summary: Kaya realizes Rat is invisible to Nissa and nearly everyone, and Rat explains that she is insignificant by birth magic.
quote: I'm not invisible. I'm insignificant . A rat.

summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

summary: Kaya tells Emmara the plan is called Operation Desperation and argues Bolas must be defeated.
quote: Operation Desperation.

summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

summary: Ral succeeds in shutting down the Beacon, which Kaya and Teyo sense.
quote: Ral must have succeeded in shutting down the Beacon.

summary: Rat leads Kaya and Teyo through the sewers, picking a lock, to Skarrg, where Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting.
quote: Gan Shokta was fighting with the cyclops Borborygmos

summary: Rat fetches her mother Ari Shokta and tells her Hekara is dead.
quote: But Ari . . . Hekara's dead.

summary: Gan Shokta and Ari show Gan that Rat is present and Rat urges them and Borborygmos to unite the Clans.
quote: You must unite the Clans and help the other guilds.

summary: Rat whispers to Borborygmos and kisses his cheek, winning the Gruul over.
quote: I cupped my hands and whispered again. Then I kissed his cheek.

summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

summary: Azdomas says Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator revealed by Vraska and has paid the ultimate price.
quote: Mazirek was another Bolas collaborator, revealed by Queen Vraska before her departure.

summary: Vraska planeswalks in to claim her throne and the Golgari leaders bow to her without challenge.
quote: Madame Storrev, Mister Azdomas, Mister Varolz, and Miss Cevraya all bowed immediately, saying in unison, "No, my queen."

summary: Zarek mocks Vraska's pirate look, and Kaya and Zarek challenge her about returning to Ravnica.
quote: What are you supposed to be, a pirate?

summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.

summary: Ajani and Vraska introduce themselves; Vraska promises the Golgari will keep the civilians safe.
quote: Welcome to Golgari territory, Ajani Goldmane. You are safe here.

summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

summary: Vraska turns three pursuing Eternals to stone, sealing the hole behind the last evacuees.
quote: Queen Vraska locked eyes with each of them in turn, transforming all three to stone.

summary: Vraska reports that the Golgari are opening pathways to safety across the city, winning back a little of Zarek's trust.
quote: We are fighting Bolas's army and preserving life.

summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

summary: Vraska senses that the Immortal Sun has been shut down; the group chooses to stay and finish the work.
quote: It's down. The Immortal Sun has been shut down.

summary: Rat dreads entering Rix Maadi without Hekara.
quote: I dreaded going down there, into Rix Maadi.

summary: Kaya insists Vraska come without her Golgari defenders so she can explain Hekara's death to the Cult.
quote: If the Cultists wanted an explanation (or demanded vengeance) for the death of Emissary Hekara

summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

summary: Dame Exava appears in a burst of smoke and the guildmasters beg an audience with the Defiler.
quote: We honor you, Exava, as a blood witch of rare talent, and we beg an audience with your master, the Defiler.

summary: Rakdos's voice booms through the cavern demanding to know where his emissary is.
quote: WHERE IS OUR EMISSARY?

summary: Tomik Vrona arrives with an Orzhov thrull carrying Hekara's corpse and returns her to her people.
quote: I have brought Hekara back to her people.

summary: Exava and six blood witches dress Hekara's body in rags and bells and send it with the thrull into the Jester's Crypt, where the thrull is killed.
quote: Have your thrull take Hekara into the Jester's Crypt.

summary: Vrona reveals he serves Kaya as the true Orzhov guildmaster and that he sent the giant Bilagru to rally Orzhov troops.
quote: I am executive assistant to the true guildmaster of the Orzhov.

quote: Thura would not escape death that day, for only death draws the attention of the Valkyries

summary: Birgi joins Niko and Kjell, who explains Fynn's dream that the Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim.
quote: The Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and the first thing it swallows will be the light.

summary: Birgi leads Niko and Kjell outside; Omenseekers mock Fynn and the Kannah, and a brawl erupts.
quote: the insult died between a Kannah forehead and an Omenseeker face

summary: Niko realizes Birgi provoked the fight and fends off attackers with mirror traps to protect Kjell.
quote: Niko grabbed a shard in each hand, stretching each into a dagger

summary: Niko spots two Valkyries watching to see if they will finish the sailor and traps the black-winged one in a mirror shard.
quote: The trap hit home right between his wings, shattered the illusion of his body into a thousand mirrored shards

summary: Niko takes the shard to Fynn and Orhaft on the ship and asks them to stop the fight.
quote: They're all fighting—blades out, blood on the snow—some woman goaded them on.

summary: Orhaft warns that Niko's presence brings destruction, and Niko offers to be sent to Starnheim with a warning.
quote: If you're convinced that destruction follows me, then send me to Starnheim with a warning so they're prepared.

summary: Orhaft agrees to give Niko what they ask for, after Niko says they never miss.
quote: Return to the ship once you've said your farewells. I will give you what you ask for.

summary: Niko shoves Birgi, who reveals she is a goddess and says she did this so Niko may know them.
quote: I did this so you may know us. Our joy, our rage—how little lies between.

summary: Kjell reveals Fynn ordered him to watch Niko but he chose to spare them, and he urges Niko to do something crazy.
quote: Fynn saw you. Said you were a threat. Commanded me to keep you close.

summary: Niko boards the Omenseeker ship; Orhaft names the trapped Valkyrie Avtyr and vows to release him after Niko passes through.
quote: the black-haired, black-winged Valkyrie's name was Avtyr and that those with dark wings are called reapers

summary: Through an Omenpath guided by Orhaft and the Valkyrie's magic, Niko leaps onto a skiff and arrives at the docks of Starnheim.
quote: The skiff bumped against a vast network of docks that disappeared into the kind of light that sings of home.

summary: Kaya rides Cosima's longship through the Cosmos and learns from Inga about Omenpaths and Doomskars.
quote: It was the Doomskars people feared, though—celestial collisions that seemed invariably to lead to calamity.

summary: The longship lands Kaya on a muddy bank in an ancient forest in the Gnottvold, then departs.
quote: the boat lurched back into the waves as if it had been pushed

summary: Kaya finds a crowd of trolls and a hooded man on a stone block calling himself Valki, the God of Lies.
quote: All know me as Valki, and my first gift to you, the gift of languages, is free.

summary: Tibalt, as Valki, urges the troll clans to attack first against invaders from other worlds.
quote: the clans of the Gnottvold must attack first!

summary: Kaya blows away Valki's illusion, revealing the devil planeswalker Tibalt.
quote: in place of the God of Lies stood a red-skinned man with two prominent horns

summary: Tibalt orders his trolls to kill Kaya; she incapacitates two with phasing, and the others flee.
quote: The second jabbed at her with a rusty, ancient-looking sword.

summary: Kaya chases Tibalt and corners him; he says chaos is its own reward and denies knowledge of the monster.
quote: Chaos is its own reward, and nothing puts a smile on my face like a bit of mayhem.

summary: Tibalt whistles and wakes six Torga trolls from beneath the hills.
quote: One after another, they pulled free of the earth, showering the clearing with clumps of black dirt.

summary: Tibalt opens a portal to a fiery realm with a glass sword and leaves Kaya with the trolls.
quote: With that, he stepped through the portal.

summary: Kaya fights the Torga trolls, her dagger breaking and another lodging in a troll's spine.
quote: she watched the dagger she'd had since Tolvada break in two

summary: Tyvar Kell arrives and turns all six Torga trolls to stone with a touch.
quote: He dodged another blow, turned another troll to stone, and another.

summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

summary: Kaya identifies the portal's destination as Immersturm, realm of demons, and links the plan to the Doomskar.
quote: Immersturm," said Tyvar.

summary: Tyvar opens a doorway into the Cosmos, and Kaya spots his Zendikari charm and realizes he is a planeswalker.
quote: Holy ancients. You're a planeswalker.

summary: Niko arrives at Starnheim's docks, enters its warm, welcoming hall, and senses it is home.
quote: Starnheim was home.

summary: Niko joins the feasting dead, meeting Thura Sail-Rend, Gæller No-breath and Vígniút and telling of defying destiny.
quote: Niko Aris, they of Meletis,

summary: Following a cat, Niko enters a hall of Valkyries who dismiss them as a lost visitor.
quote: You should return to the feast.

summary: Niko delivers the warning that the Cosmos Serpent is coming, and the Valkyries refuse to believe Starnheim can be attacked.
quote: the Cosmos Serpent is coming for you.

summary: Avtyr arrives and accuses Niko of interrupting a Valkyrie judgement, but Niko reveals the limits of the mirror trap and the Valkyries accept it.
quote: You were never in danger from me.

summary: Koma tears into the sky above Starnheim from the Cosmos and the Valkyries panic.
quote: The creature solidified into a massive, armored eel, born from the interstices of the Cosmos itself.

summary: Niko proposes luring Koma like a cat chasing toys back out through an Omenpath; Avtyr and Rytva agree.
quote: Fly in close, right side or left side—make it chase you the way cats chase toys.

summary: Forty Valkyries take to the air, and Niko lands on Koma's neck to anchor a javelin at its skull.
quote: They slid down the last few feet of neck to bury their spear between the scales of Koma's skull.

summary: Valkyries bait Koma while Niko's mirror traps hide their bodies, steering Koma along.
quote: The serpent's jaws clamped down on nothing but clouds.

summary: Niko spots the right Omenpath, an open portal of flame and battle, and directs the last Valkyrie squad to draw Koma toward it.
quote: THERE!" Niko shouted, raising their left fist.

summary: Koma crashes through the hole and falls out of Starnheim, and Niko is nearly pulled in.
quote: Koma's weight and momentum carried it the rest of the way down through the hole

summary: Niko lets go, but Avtyr catches them and flies down with them into the battle as Valkyries follow.
quote: Avtyr's hand clamped around their wrist.

summary: Tibalt, narrating, boasts that his plotting will set Kaldheim ablaze, and tells the saga of a planeswalker named Tibalt.
quote: all of Kaldheim would be improved with a touch more fire, a dash of anarchy

summary: The Horrible Beast poisons Tibalt with a seed and forces him to cause a distraction, though Tibalt had already planned to stir up trouble.
quote: the Horrible Beast snuck up on him one day and stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison

summary: Tibalt tricks Valki, the God of Lies, to use him as a disguise.
quote: It happened that this God of Lies, this Prince of Tricksters, was foolish enough to get lied to and tricked himself.

summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

summary: Tibalt, as Valki, convinces King Harald of Skemfar that the gods plan terrible things and that the elves must strike first.
quote: The only choice, if the elves were to survive, was clear: strike first.

summary: Tibalt stirs trouble in Surtland and Bretagard, warning frost giants of trolls and promising the Skelle the return of Varragoth.
quote: Tibalt sowed the seeds of war and chaos

summary: With the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt cuts open a doorway to Starnheim and unleashes Koma on the Valkyries.
quote: he cut open a doorway to the home of the Valkyries, where the Cosmos Serpent could make up for lost time

summary: Tibalt leaves a trail with the sword through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
quote: he was leaving a trail, dragging the tip through the black basalt surface of Immersturm

summary: Tibalt foretells that he will kill the planeswalker and Kaldheim will burn.
quote: Tibalt kills the planeswalker.

summary: Njala and Alajn come to watch a skirmish between Skelle raiders and a small Tuskeri war party above the Feltmark.
quote: so she and Alajn, shepherd and reaper, had come to watch, and to judge

summary: Alajn points out Arni Brokenbrow as the Tuskeri's new leader.
quote: That's their new leader. Arni Brokenbrow, they call him.

summary: Arni draws his sword and grins as though straight at the unseen Njala.
quote: Then he grinned. In fact, he seemed to be grinning right at her.

summary: The Tuskeri charge the Skelle line with Arni at the front.
quote: the Tuskeri broke into a sudden charge, straight at the middle of the Skelle line

summary: Arni leaps over the Skelle spears and shields and kills a raider in the front row.
quote: the new leader of the Tuskeri leaped into the air

summary: The Tuskeri break the Skelle, who flee, and Arni sits laughing on a pile of the dead while Alajn finds her duties unneeded.
quote: Soon the Skelle were broken, fleeing across the open plains.

summary: Njala seeks out the skald Hormgart in Starnheim to learn about Arni.
quote: She found Hormgart deep into his cups

summary: Hormgart begins the tale of how Arni, once called Goatleaper, got his new name (a story told in flashback).
quote: He was called Goatleaper, once,

summary: In Hormgart's tale, word of murderous trolls on the Red Ridge spreads and Arni's small band begins hunting them (flashback).
quote: word spread of a scourge of murderous trolls, terrorizing villages all along the Red Ridge

summary: Njala and Alajn watch Arni court death again, this time facing a hellkite in the Tusk mountains.
quote: it was a dragon

summary: Arni lassoes the hellkite's horn and is flung toward a stone spire, landing on it feet first.
quote: he flung the lasso straight into the path of the hellkite's head

summary: Arni rides the hellkite and kills it by driving his blade between its horns while his Tuskeri watch.
quote: all the Tuskeri gaped, wide-eyed, as their leader drove the blade between the creature's horns

summary: In Hormgart's tale, Arni's band finds a whole warren of trolls in a cave and decides not to leave for reinforcements (flashback).
quote: Creeping closer, Arni found far more than just a couple stone-eaters.

summary: Arni steps out and proposes a headbutting contest to the trolls, the loser to leave the mountains forever (flashback).
quote: Loser packs up and leaves these mountains forever.

summary: Tover Giants-Blood and the Kannah warriors emerge from the Aldergard treeline to face Arni in an honor duel.
quote: Tover Giants-Blood was the biggest human Njala had ever seen.

summary: Giants-Blood offers Arni a last chance to grovel and repent for desecrating his family's resting place, and Arni refuses.
quote: I'll give you one last chance to repent.

summary: Giants-Blood feints and hits Arni in the jaw with the axe haft.
quote: Suddenly, Tover brought up the haft of the axe in a sharp jab, cracking into Arni's jaw and sending him flying.

summary: Arni steps inside the swing and chops through the axe haft with his sword.
quote: chopped down at the wooden haft with his sword

summary: Giants-Blood catches Arni in a crushing bear hug and lifts him off the ground.
quote: Giants-Blood cinched him tight in a bear hug, pinning his arms to his side and lifting him off the ground

summary: Njala realizes she does not want Arni to die and decides she will not allow it.
quote: And yet, Njala found that she didn't want Arni to be crushed to death by this bear of a man.

summary: Alajn blocks Njala from intervening, since it is an honor duel and Valkyries do not meddle in mortal affairs.
quote: Njala, it's an honor duel.

summary: Njala sees Arni grinning in the bear hug and remembers how Hormgart's story ended as he draws his head back.
quote: Arni drew his head back, back, back

summary: In the headbutting contest with the troll, the frightened troll decides to cheat (flashback).
quote: he decided to cheat

summary: Arni breaks the troll's tusk with his skull, leaving bone embedded in his forehead and losing the name Goatleaper (flashback).
quote: the troll lay flat on his back, one of his tusks snapped off at the root

summary: Kaya and Tyvar step out of Tyvar's Omenpath into the hot, lava-filled demons' realm.
quote: On the other side of Tyvar's Omenpath, a blast of hot, noxious air had greeted her.

summary: Tyvar explains the gods sealed the realm long ago and that Tibalt must have damaged the wards.
quote: But Tibalt must have somehow damaged the wards.

summary: They find an orange molten arrow carved into the basalt, left for them by Tibalt.
quote: an orange molten arrow

summary: Tyvar unexpectedly grows a bridge of stone across the magma.
quote: tendrils of rock twining together, knitting themselves into a bridge

summary: Kaya tells Tyvar about the planes and planeswalkers; he declines to become one.
quote: But I think I'll pass.

summary: Kaya insists Tyvar needs a code; he refuses her schooling and stalks off down the path.
quote: With that, he stormed off, down the path of black rock.

summary: Demons on a ship hurl harpoons at Tyvar, and Kaya phases him to save him.
quote: Kaya reached him just in time, turning his torso to ghostly light

summary: A spiked demon longship drives toward them across the magma lake.
quote: Spikes ringed the outer edge, cruel and narrow

summary: Kaya turns a harpoon immaterial and throws it through the mace-armed demon's breastplate.
quote: It punched clean through the demon's hammered breastplate and out the other side.

summary: Kaya's hand-spear strike fails to kill the big demon jarl, but she phases the path from under him and drops him into the lava.
quote: she sent him flailing backwards into the molten rock and allowed the path to rematerialize over him

summary: Tyvar beheads the last demon with his heated blade.
quote: his next slash passed through its neck

summary: Tyvar grows two iron hand-axes from the demon jarl's hammer metal and gives them to the unarmed Kaya.
quote: Two, actually. Grown from the ground, like stalks of wheat.

summary: They take the demon longship across the lava toward the Bloodcrag.
quote: once the demon ship built up speed, it smashed through the plates of cooled magma

summary: They see the Bloodcrag, where the light of the gods mirrors the light from Tibalt's portal.
quote: That's the Bloodcrag!

summary: Partway up the Bloodcrag, they see hundreds of demon ships on the lava lake, an army.
quote: The ship we ran across must have been part of their vanguard.

summary: Kaya realizes Tibalt's sword opens portals and means to start a Doomskar; Tibalt answers that he already has.
quote: Kid, he's going to start a Doomskar!

summary: Tibalt attacks from above with flame, and Kaya charges at him and hurls an axe.
quote: It clipped his shoulder, sent him sprawling

summary: Tibalt breathes out a torrent of burning smoke that fills Kaya's mind with despair and doubt.
quote: The smoke poured from his mouth in a great and sudden torrent

summary: Tyvar, immune to the doubt magic, blocks Tibalt's killing blow and introduces himself.
quote: He'd caught that shimmering god-light sword on the dagger fixed to his bracer.

summary: Tyvar flips Tibalt over his shoulder and holds a blade to his neck.
quote: Tyvar grabbed him by his collar and flipped him over one shoulder

summary: Tibalt tells them to go see for himself, then dissolves into cinders and planeswalks away.
quote: Like burning paper, his body dissolved into a mass of orange cinders

summary: From the peak they see a vast tear in the sky showing a kaleidoscope of other planes.
quote: they had a clear view of the tear in the sky

summary: Varragoth and thousands of demons rise from the lava lake and head for the hole in the sky.
quote: There must have been thousands of them, all headed for that hole in the sky.

summary: Tyvar accuses planeswalkers of fleeing when things get hard, and opens an Omenpath to leave.
quote: You and that Tibalt aren't so different in the end.

summary: Kaya, despite her code, follows Tyvar through the Omenpath.
quote: Kaya swore, took a deep breath, and stepped in after him.

summary: Ranar wakes as a spirit on an endless tundra with arrows in his chest and realizes he is dead.
quote: Ranar opened his eyes to find himself in an inglorious place.

summary: Ranar remembers dying in battle against demon raiders after seeing the last of his children to safety (flashback).
quote: A pile of demonic dead, and Ranar's duty complete.

summary: Ranar realizes the Valkyries have judged him to Istfell instead of Starnheim and resolves to prove his worth there.
quote: Without horror, he realized he was in an afterlife unexpected: Istfell.

summary: Ranar throws his axe to choose his direction and sets off walking.
quote: The haft pointed the way.

summary: Ranar sees the wolf at the end of the world, decides not to fight it, and salutes it as it leaves.
quote: Ranar raised his axe above his head in quiet salute

summary: A withered spirit warns Ranar of the cairn-eaters, who tear down a monument built as tribute to Egon.
quote: I realized for EGON this tribute, and my reward was the hatred of these most lost souls

summary: Ranar finds demons guarding a river of marching spirits and refuses their order to move on.
quote: These were not spirits but demons of some kind.

summary: Ranar kills both demon guards with his axe.
quote: The strength of Ranar's swing threw the demon away from the column, where it landed with a heavy thud on the ground, dead.

summary: The river of freed spirits tells Ranar they are free and then dissolves into mist.
quote: the entirety of it began to drift into mist

summary: Ranar reaches the gates and bridge of Istfell and waits there for centuries as guardian.
quote: He had followed his axe and could go no farther.

summary: A living-looking youth appears on the bridge and introduces himself as Bjorn of Beskir, asking Ranar's help on a quest.
quote: My name is Bjorn of Beskir, and I am not supposed to be here

summary: Ranar accepts the quest and feels life begin to return to him.
quote: Life, distant, nevertheless had begun to fill him like liquid fills a vessel.

summary: Bjorn reveals he means to climb a tower built by his ancestors and cut open a passage to Starnheim, and orders Ranar to follow.
quote: Now I will climb it, and with this sword cut open a passage to Starnheim.

summary: Ranar and Bjorn cut through the Elk King's guard and Bjorn kills the Elk King, taking his crown.
quote: He plunged his dagger into the spirit's neck and levered him to the floor.

summary: Bjorn explains that he must slay three kings, the crow next and the bear last, to open Starnheim.
quote: We take the crow next, and last the bear, and then Starnheim opens to me.

summary: Ranar's hands become whole and flesh-colored as the kills restore life to him.
quote: His hands, once the faded green of spiritflesh, were made whole.

summary: The wolf at the end of the world returns and watches the two leave the Elk King's keep.
quote: The wolf at the end of the world had returned from its wandering.

summary: Ranar and Bjorn fight the Feather Guard at the Crow King's perch and Ranar cuts the Crow King down.
quote: before Ranar landed a mortal blow with his axe, sending the Crow King to the ground

summary: Bjorn stabs the wounded Crow King, and the city's people vanish.
quote: Bjorn plunged his sword into the Crow King's belly.

summary: Ranar finds the city empty and begins to suspect Bjorn's quest is wrong.
quote: The city below was empty.

summary: Ranar realizes Bjorn killed his own kin and came to Istfell on purpose; Bjorn replies that he makes his own fate.
quote: You did this on purpose, didn't you?

summary: At the foot of the Bear King's tower they find a mummified body speared with a banner reading CLIMB.
quote: Unraveled, it had a single word painted upon it: CLIMB.

summary: Ranar and Bjorn reach the roof and face the Bear King and his Ursan Guard, who say they guard Istfell from threats within and without.
quote: Ranar and Bjorn stood before the Bear King and his final Ursan Guard.

summary: Together they slay the Ursan Guard.
quote: Together they slew the Ursan Guard.

summary: Bjorn lets the Bear King's swing land on Ranar, breaking his axe and wounding him.
quote: Bjorn slid under the king's opening swing, leaving Ranar to take the blow.

summary: Bjorn cuts the Bear King's leg and drives his sword into the king's chest.
quote: Bjorn drove his sword up through a layer of the Bear King's mail and into his chest.

summary: Bjorn sheds his disguise and is revealed as Egon, god of the dead.
quote: In his place stood the very lord of Istfell himself, Egon, god of the dead

summary: Egon beheads the Bear King with his scythe.
quote: Egon pressed the king forward into the blade of his scythe.

summary: Egon opens a rent into Starnheim, showing the golden realm.
quote: Starnheim was open before them.

summary: The Valkyrie Firja arrives and seals the rent, refusing Egon entry.
quote: The light of Starnheim vanished, the rent in the cosmos sealed shut.

summary: Firja tells Egon he must remain in Istfell.
quote: You will remain in Istfell.

summary: Ranar offers Firja his broken axe and asks to keep guarding; she grants it and the axe is repaired with Valkyrie metal.
quote: Ranar stood, marveling as his axe repaired itself in his hands.

summary: At Firja's command, Ranar strikes down Egon with one blow.
quote: he swung his axe, striking down the God of Death in a single blow.

summary: Firja explains Egon will return to his throne in time and that Ranar has played this part in a cycle many times.
quote: You are an integral part of this cycle.

summary: Firja tells Ranar to serve the realm well and flies into Starnheim's light.
quote: Serve this realm and its people well, Ranar of Istfell.

summary: Ranar returns to spirit form, throws his repaired axe, and sets off to guard Istfell.
quote: Alone, the guardian of Istfell pulled his axe free and set off toward the far horizon.

summary: A raven flies over Bretagard, seeing fire giants, gathering Skelle, and a great fleet, to the Beskir Stronghold.
quote: the greatest fleet of the age riding the wind westward

summary: Arni and Fynn arrive at the Beskir Stronghold, where Inga Rune-Eyes and Sigrid await with strangers Tyvar and Kaya.
quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers, had already arrived, and this fortress belonged to Sigrid, God-Favored.

summary: Fynn refuses to accept an elf prince as a friend, and Sigrid reminds him she called him to plan survival.
quote: I didn't invite you into my hold to insult my guests, Fynn.

summary: Sigrid lists the threats of trolls, demons, giants and the draugr of the Dread Marn.
quote: which means the Dread Marn, Karfell's dead army, has returned

summary: Kaya lays the Sword of the Realms on the table, and they learn Koll finished it but died with the secret of wielding it.
quote: But he took the secrets of how to wield it to the grave.

summary: Alrund steps from the shadows and says only Halvar, God of Battle, can wield the sword.
quote: The god for whom the sword was meant. Halvar, God of Battle.

summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

summary: From the air they see a rift to Karfell spilling draugr and undead trolls toward a bridge.
quote: from the edge of the opening thin, rotting figures dragged themselves hand over hand into the human realm

summary: They see Halvar alone on the bridge before a heap of destroyed draugr.
quote: Before him, on the near side of the bridge, was a mound of destroyed draugr nearly waist-high.

summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

summary: The elves of Skemfar march into view, and Tyvar leaves to stop his brother's army.
quote: the elves of Skemfar, marching to war

summary: Cosima leaps from the river as a dolphin and sweeps a wall of water over an undead troll and draugr.
quote: It swept over the undead Torga and a handful of draugr.

summary: Cosima joins Kaya to reach Halvar, sent by Alrund.
quote: Alrund did not send me to visit.

summary: Varragoth lands on the ground between them and the bridge.
quote: He beat his wings once, then settled on the ground.

summary: Kaya and Cosima fight Varragoth; Kaya's axes wound him but he is barely slowed.
quote: The second axe, this one in Kaya's hand, drove into his knee.

summary: Harald's elves arrive and form a pike wall against the demons.
quote: A line of pike-bearers set their hafts against the ground, forming a wall between Kaya and the demons.

summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

summary: Tyvar thickens the elves' armor as demons press the line.
quote: He put his hands on the backs of their armor

summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

summary: Harald carries Kaya on his reindeer through the battle to the bridge.
quote: He pulled her onto the reindeer.

summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

summary: Halvar asks them to hold the bridge while he sits and channels the sword.
quote: Hold the bridge until I can separate the realms once more.

summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

summary: Koma dives into the Karfell rift, and Valkyries pour out of its own rift to attack the demons.
quote: They slammed into the demons from above, feathered wings tangling with leather membrane

summary: Kaya meets the Valkyries' companion Niko Aris after saving them from a draugr.
quote: Niko. Niko Aris.

summary: Varragoth, wounded with Tyvar clinging to his back, is bound by Harald's snakes and tears free.
quote: They wrapped round Varragoth's legs, binding him

summary: Kaya kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe while he is distracted by Tyvar.
quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

summary: Halvar's sword light sweeps over the rift and it closes, ending the flow of draugr.
quote: Slowly, like a healing wound, the rift began to shrink and close.

summary: Demons flee and Halvar seals the holes in the world as a child watches from the village.
quote: as the god of battle sealed up the holes in the world

summary: Tyvar tells Kaya he wants to see the Multiverse.
quote: I'd like to see what there is to see, out in your Multiverse.

summary: At the crossroads, the leaders review losses and the draugr and demons that escaped.
quote: We broke the draugr lines and drove off their main body

summary: Harald announces the elves will return to Skemfar.
quote: The elves will return to Skemfar, to care for our own

summary: Niko asks Kaya whether a plane called Theros exists.
quote: These planes. Is there one called Theros?

summary: In the World Tree's sanctum, a monster has mortally wounded the goddess Esika.
quote: Esika was dying.

summary: The monster tells Esika she lacks the hunger and fear to survive and drops her.
quote: Not enough hunger in you. Not enough fear to survive. Soon, though.

summary: The monster takes a sample of the World Tree's sap and prepares to return.
quote: I am ready to return.

summary: A red portal opens and a voice welcomes Vorinclex back.
quote: We step ever closer to perfection.

summary: Lathril emerges from her crucible changed, taking on the mantle of godhood.
quote: She was taking on the mantle of godhood.

summary: Lathril discovers the price of godhood: her sight has narrowed to a blur.
quote: Instead of seeing the world as she had always seen it, her focus had narrowed.

summary: Lathril wakes to find a copper wolf in her bed, evidently sent by Sarulf.
quote: she found herself face-to-face with a pair of turquoise eyes, set in the face of a beautiful copper wolf

summary: The wolf leads Lathril to the door where a harness hangs, and Lathril follows her out into the village.
quote: But the wolf led her to the tall green door that led out into the village.

summary: Yadira meets Lathril and tells her she and the wolf are summoned to deal with a problem between worlds.
quote: you've been summoned to deal with a problem.

quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

summary: Arlinn tells Teferi the nights on Innistrad are growing longer and something is coming, and Chandra leaps down the stairs to greet her.
quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest."

summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
quote: They'll come. They'll help.

summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
quote: "Adeline's fine.

summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

summary: Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move, while the festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope but more people go missing.
quote: Leinore found the dead snake mixed in the ashes of a campfire gone cold hours ago.

summary: At an abandoned tent of a missing family, Sinnia finds a scale-crusted golden mask and tries it on over Leinore's objections.
quote: Sinnia took off her fox mask and tried on the new one, causing Leinore to flinch.

summary: At the Celestus Leinore sees that the witches are binding human teeth into necklaces for the festivalgoers, and Katilda calls them werewolf teeth.
quote: "They are teeth," she said plainly. "Werewolf teeth."

summary: Jagger accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers and the crowd turns angry.
quote: "Did you steal those from the missing villagers?"

summary: Sinnia, wearing the mask, calms the crowd with a speech and the villagers shout to bring back the light and gather around her.
quote: "Bring back the light."

summary: That night Sinnia, still masked, tells Leinore that the Coiled One has spoken to her and is surfacing.
quote: The Coiled One has spoken to me today, sister.

summary: Over the next days Sinnia replaces Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide and makes villagers cough up small snakes while the crowd rejoices.
quote: Sinnia had replaced Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide in the eyes of the festivalgoers.

summary: Katilda offers Sinnia a coven headpiece in exchange for the mask, and Sinnia laughs in her face.
quote: But Sinnia laughed in Katilda's face and turned away.

summary: Leinore pretends to sleep and then follows Sinnia into the forest at night.
quote: Leinore followed Sinnia into the night.

summary: Leinore sees Sinnia drag an unconscious man to a giant egg that opens and swallows him, and notices a woman watching from the shadows.
quote: To Leinore's horror, she watched her sister push the unconscious man into it.

summary: Katilda grabs Leinore and aims her staff at Sinnia, but Leinore bites her hand and ruins the shot.
quote: Without thinking, Leinore bit down on Katilda's hand.

summary: Katilda reveals that the woman is Saryth, whose power lies in the mask, and that Sinnia is consumed by it.
quote: "Saryth isn't the one wearing the mask," Katilda said, picking up her staff.

summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
quote: "It is time!" Saryth screamed.

summary: Katilda urges Leinore to destroy Sinnia, but Leinore insists on trying to take the mask off and Katilda agrees to distract Saryth.
quote: "Don't you dare touch my sister. I'll get the mask off her."

summary: Katilda fights Saryth with shale and a razor wind of leaves, and Saryth falls into the chasm and is swallowed.
quote: And in an instant, Saryth was gone—swallowed by the chasm.

summary: Sinnia whispers for help and Leinore tears the fused mask off her face as the Coiled One bends to swallow them.
quote: Without thinking she started to pull as hard as she could.

summary: With the mask gone the Coiled One bellows and retreats into the earth, pulling the eggs down with it.
quote: With one last hiss, the Coiled One dragged its body to the depths of the earth

summary: Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement, where freed festivalgoers wander dazed and remember nothing, though many remain missing.
quote: Soon, they found people stumbling around, wondering among themselves how they got there and which day of the festival it was.

summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

summary: Kaya's research turns up a book showing the Betzolds being handed a box by a witch, and Arlinn recognizes Worrin Betzold's name as an old bishop.
quote: The caption labeled them the Betzolds, from Gavony.

summary: Adeline spots Worrin preaching to a congregation of zombies in the nave, and Arlinn confirms it is him.
quote: To Arlinn's horror, he seems to be preaching to a gathered crowd.

summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

summary: Arlinn questions the undead Worrin about the key, but he only answers with Dennick's name, and she puts him to rest.
quote: Arlinn gives Worrin the only rest she can

summary: In Gavony an old woman tells the group that Dennick, Worrin's son, holed up in the old family mansion.
quote: "He holed up in the old family mansion.

summary: Kaya enters the haunted Betzold mansion alone and dispatches the ghosts at speed.
quote: Kaya's putting them down at an incredible rate.

summary: Adeline breaks down the upstairs door and Kaya presents the ghost of Dennick Betzold.
quote: "Here's your man," she says.

summary: Arlinn tells Dennick his father is dead and asks about the key; he says his great-grandfather gave it to a vampire of the Markovs for safekeeping.
quote: My great-grandfather gave it over to one of the vampires for safekeeping.

summary: Dennick names Sorin Markov as the prince who took the key, and Arlinn stays behind to listen to him.
quote: "It's the Markovs.

summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

summary: Arlinn forces open the throne room doors and finds Sorin Markov reading on his broken throne.
quote: Sorin Markov sits with one leg slung over the broken throne of his house.

summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
quote: Sorin snaps the book shut. "No."

summary: Arlinn brings up Avacyn and Sorin slashes her arm with his sword, forbidding her to speak of her.
quote: She's not through the name before the sword's swinging through the air.

summary: Sigarda arrives in golden light and blocks Sorin's blow with her heron-headed scythe.
quote: A feather falls between them, gold and glowing

summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
quote: Arlinn takes the key.

summary: Vadrik arrives at Lambholt at night, called for help, and is nearly shot by a nervous guard.
quote: a crossbow bolt flew past his head and sunk halfway to its fletching into a nearby alder

summary: Vadrik meets the council of crones and mothers and the inquisitor Rem Karolus, who was hired by Dein Salvasi, and they agree to work together.
quote: "Then I suppose we'll be working together."

summary: The council explains the disappearances of Arinos and travelers and the death of Lakil; Malynn says that Old Stickfingers has come out of rhyme and story.
quote: "It was Old Stickfingers, it was," Malynn said.

summary: A man bursts in to report another murder.
quote: "Murder," he finally got out. "Murder."

summary: Vadrik examines three bodies in a pasture, one a werewolf reverted on death, all pierced as if by arrows.
quote: Well, two dead people and one dead werewolf

summary: Vadrik casts a tracking spell with star dust and, annoyed at Rem calling him a hound, makes Rem's mouth vanish briefly.
quote: His mouth, more importantly, was gone, disappeared by Vadrik's magic.

summary: The two follow the tracks to an aspen grove where Old Stickfingers appears behind Vadrik.
quote: Old Stickfingers lived up to his name.

summary: Rem stabs Stickfingers and Vadrik blasts him with ice; Rem drives his blade through the creature's face and it vanishes.
quote: Rem stood up and drove his blade through the beast's chin, up through his face.

summary: In the morning Vadrik meets Ariosa, Arinos's daughter, and sets out to investigate the Salvasi manor.
quote: "Vadrik, meet Ariosa. Daughter of Arinos."

summary: At the Salvasi manor Vadrik and Rem find a broken door, an empty house, signs of violence and a message in ash, and Vadrik finds black goat fur.
quote: Instead of a warm welcome and food, the pair found a door broken open, hanging from one hinge.

summary: At Arinos's farm Vadrik finds a twig mobile and deduces that Arinos summoned Stickfingers to get rid of Salvasi.
quote: "Arinos summoned Stickfingers to dispose of Salvasi and save his farm," Vadrik said.

summary: Vadrik crushes the mobile with Stickfingers's blood on it, thinking this will unsummon him, and a keening comes from the alders.
quote: He then raised one boot and slammed it down, crushing the thing underfoot.

summary: The village bell tolls: Stickfingers is inside the walls, and Ariosa says that Vadrik and Rem set him free.
quote: "Just came from home," she said to Malynn, then she looked daggers at the pair of men. "They set him free."

summary: Malynn explains that Stickfingers is a hearth spirit of this place and cannot be sent away; Vadrik realizes he was summoned to protect, not to kill.
quote: "So he was summoned, not to kill, but to protect?"

summary: Vadrik works out that Arinos did not finish the summoning, so Stickfingers killed intruders on the old estate's land; Rem holds the monster back and Vadrik heals him.
quote: Killed Arinos as an intruder on his own land.

summary: Ariosa repairs the mobile and sings the binding, offering a goat; Stickfingers appears, accepts the goat and walks off peacefully as guardian of her home.
quote: Stickfingers barked, and the white goat ambled over to him.

summary: Vadrik declines Rem's offer to team up and rides home, but wonders why the second bed was made and why Ariosa survived unscathed.
quote: How odd it was that Ariosa had survived, unscathed.

summary: Feuer wakes Olivia Voldaren to report that the humans are holding a festival to restore the balance of day and night.
quote: They're up to something. Trying to restore the balance of day and night, I believe.

summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

summary: Olivia decides to let the festival proceed, saying never to interrupt someone doing your work for you.
quote: Never interrupt someone when they're doing your work for you.

summary: At the festival under the Celestus, witch Deidamia carves pumpkin suns for children while the witches wait for the key.
quote: A sun and moon engrave themselves on the spot the girl picks

summary: The heroes arrive to cheers, but a ward falls and howling begins.
quote: Deidamia feels the too-sharp pain of a ward going down.

summary: Howlpack shamans and hundreds of wolves attack the barriers while the witches usher the festivalgoers toward the center of the Celestus.
quote: doesn't see them beating against the barriers until the shaman-wolves are already upon them

summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

summary: The magical barrier shatters and the wall of werewolves crashes into the festivalgoers.
quote: Overhead, the magic shatters like stained glass

summary: Teferi plants his staff and slows time to hold back the sunset, calling on the witches to start the ritual.
quote: "Witches of the Dawnheart Coven!" he bellows, "Let's get this ritual started!"

summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

summary: Arlinn smashes a dire's knee with a mace and the cathars finish him, and the dire names her Tovolar's favorite.
quote: "You. Tovolar's favorite ."

summary: Arlinn remembers that after two years under Tovolar's tutelage she left him scarred and bleeding and ran away in the night.
quote: she left him scarred and bleeding then ran away in the middle of the night

summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar and demands he call off the raid; he refuses.
quote: He smirks, shakes his head. "No."

summary: Arlinn attacks Tovolar with a mace, which he catches and tears from her hands.
quote: Tovolar catches the head of the mace.

summary: Arlinn punches Tovolar and offers to let him take the nights back if he spares the humans, but he rejects it.
quote: Take the nights back, hunt what you can, but leave the humans out of this.

summary: Tovolar transforms and presses her; Arlinn takes a sword from a fallen guard and Tovolar claws her cheek.
quote: his claws tear open her cheek.

summary: Arlinn recalls the night she challenged Tovolar for the alpha position and the scar she gave him.
quote: And then she'd be the alpha of the howlpack.

summary: Her wolves close in and Patience begs Arlinn to join the hunt; Arlinn says she cannot, and Boulder bowls her over.
quote: True to his name, when he throws his weight against her, she's bowled over

summary: Tovolar pins Arlinn and demands she show him the real Arlinn; the sun sets and Arlinn changes into a wolf.
quote: The sun sinks below the horizon. Day changes to night.

summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
quote: Do not contact me again.

summary: Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
quote: The plate shattered against the wall

summary: Wilhelt, a risen ghoul with his own army, marches toward Thraben to win Gisa's love.
quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
quote: I knew you were my inferior.

summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

summary: Gisa spots an army of the dead led by a rider approaching Thraben and runs to meet it, delighted to have something to do.
quote: Someone was riding along the road to Thraben.

summary: Wilhelt reaches the gates and declares himself to Gisa, who does not remember him and tries to whistle him into thralldom.
quote: Finally, tilting her head to the side, she asked, "Do I know you?"

summary: Gisa's whistle tries to bind Wilhelt, but he resists and breaks her hold; Gisa retreats behind the gates.
quote: breaking the tie between them as Gisa's whistle died, choked off in her throat

summary: Wilhelt breaks through the gates and his army is attacked by swarms of undead birds, then by the dead who surge out of the shops.
quote: They were halfway down the avenue when the dead surged out of the buildings to either side

summary: Gisa urges Wilhelt to surrender; he refuses, so she leaves her soldiers to overwhelm his.
quote: Then she flounced away down the walk, not looking back

summary: Wilhelt sends a ghoul with a love letter to Gisa, but she seizes the ghoul's mind and reads it.
quote: A single ghoul ran into the square

summary: Gisa reads Wilhelt's letter, is offended that he implies she could get his name wrong, and resolves to destroy him.
quote: She resolved to destroy him.

summary: Gisa screams and all the bats in Thraben descend on Wilhelt's army, forcing him to flee.
quote: Then Gisa screamed, and all the bats in Thraben descended.

summary: Wilhelt vanishes from the battlefield, and Gisa decides to go to her brother.
quote: Wilham himself was gone.

summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

summary: Arlinn remembers returning home years ago to find her family's forge burned to a husk.
quote: A husk meets her: blackened foundations jutting from the earth.

summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, attacks Tovolar at the festival and he throws her to the ground.
quote: Forward. Powerful legs send her flying through the air

summary: Tovolar slams Arlinn into a split tree trunk, and she tears out a piece of wood and drives it through his leg.
quote: she has pierced him all the way through

summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder pin Arlinn down, and she is stunned by a blow to the head.
quote: there is Streak with his jaws firmly locked on her already wounded shoulder

summary: Tovolar urges Arlinn to join the hunt and says that the Church hates part of her but the pack does not.
quote: "Join the hunt," he says.

summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar she is home so he lets her up, then drives her claws into his sternum.
quote: She drives her claws deep into his sternum.

summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar Innistrad is home, and he calls her a liar.
quote: "You lied," he rasps.

summary: Tovolar agrees to call off the attack, and the wolves howl a retreat.
quote: The howl goes up soon after that, a call for retreat only the wolves understand.

summary: Arlinn surveys the aftermath, which survivors call the Harvesttide Massacre, and resolves that the ritual must be completed.
quote: the word has already been formed: massacre .

summary: Chandra and Adeline pick up the wounded Arlinn and take her to the Celestus.
quote: Shifting to her human form, Arlinn takes Chandra's hand.

summary: The Dawnhart Coven, Katilda holding the key and Kaya waiting beside her, performs the chanting ritual at the central platform.
quote: Katilda, her mask shading much of her face, the Moonsilver Key held in her hands like something sacred and pure

summary: The witches call Arlinn as the Child of Blood and Fang and ask whether she will spill blood for the day; she agrees.
quote: "Child of Blood and Fang. You stand on the line of Dawn, where Night and Day meet."

summary: Arlinn anoints the bowl of the Sungold Lock with her blood and a bitter herb, and the Celestus stirs to life.
quote: So, too, does the Celestus.

summary: Katilda offers a root and her soul to the bowl; her soul streams out of her eyes and mouth and her body goes limp.
quote: a silver glow comes over them, then streams out

summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

summary: The witches say the ritual had to be done by Katilda, so Arlinn throws the key to Olivia.
quote: Arlinn hurls the key with her good arm.

summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

summary: With the key gone, the Celestus falls silent and night settles on Innistrad for eternity.
quote: It is night on Innistrad.

summary: Algli's husband and sons die in a ghoul attack on the family tannery, and she survives by setting the tannery aflame.
quote: Her husband and her youngest son threw themselves between her and the ghouls, and she set the tannery aflame.

summary: A ghoulcaller raises Algli's dead family; she meets Olutio and together they slay him, and Olutio first speaks to her of the Buried Lord.
quote: Standing over their fresh graves, Olutio first spoke to her of the Buried Lord.

summary: The three cultists perform the last ritual in the clearing with a goat, but nothing seems to happen.
quote: A goat, hooves and horns, in the image of a demon.

summary: Sruta calls Olutio and Algli fools and leaves, and Olutio follows, leaving Algli alone with her despair.
quote: "You were always a fool, Olutio," she said.

summary: Algli finds a wounded angel behind her who says she is compelled to answer the call and that the Buried Lord is hungry.
quote: "But the Buried Lord has never been one to protect. He is here, and he is hungry."

summary: Algli bandages Liesa's wound and tells her about the Travails and the fall of the angels.
quote: Algli bandaged the angel's ribs firmly

summary: Liesa introduces herself as an archangel who once led the Flight of Dusk and asks Algli to help her rebury the Buried Lord.
quote: "I am Liesa, archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk.

summary: Liesa and Algli find Olutio's gutted body.
quote: They found the gutted remains of Olutio first

summary: The Buried Lord devours Sruta in front of them and greets Liesa as an old friend.
quote: On the last word his teeth sunk into Sruta, snuffing her screams with a gruesome tear.

summary: The Buried Lord offers Liesa an alliance if she hands over Algli, and she refuses.
quote: "Give me the third, and she will be my last."

summary: Liesa drives her spear into the Buried Lord's spine and he vanishes, but then he erupts from the ground and seizes Algli.
quote: Liesa drove the spear deep into the demon's spine.

summary: Algli chants the old rites and feeds the Buried Lord's strength; Liesa orders her to fall silent.
quote: As the cultist chanted, the darkness soaked into the demon.

summary: Algli offers her life and thrusts her torch into the Buried Lord's mouth, and Liesa channels the fire and hope through her spear to behead him.
quote: With both hands, Algli thrust her torch into the roof of the Buried Lord's gaping maw.

summary: Liesa beheads the Buried Lord, but his body does not crumble, and she feels they are still bound.
quote: Liesa yanked her spear free with a twist

summary: Algli offers to forge the Buried Lord's remains into Liesa's armor and to serve her; Liesa asks for an alliance instead and Algli swears to be her ally.
quote: "As I breathe and hope, my lady Liesa.

summary: Weeks after the Harvesttide Massacre, Grigori draws blood from his sleeping mother to meet Olivia Voldaren's tithe decree.
quote: Grigori presses the knife to his mother's wrist.

summary: Olivia's decree demands one bowl of blood from every resident each night until the festivities.
quote: one bowl of blood from each resident, once a night until the festivities

summary: Bats carry away the bowls of blood and ornate black envelopes, and Grigori chooses not to fight them.
quote: Two head straight for him, each stopping before the bowls.

summary: Adeline kills a vampire and Chandra burns his body; the two share a moment of respite.
quote: As she drives her sword through the vampire's heart

summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

summary: Arlinn tells the group they cannot keep fighting like this, and Teferi says he cannot hold the moon in place with Innistrad's ancient magic.
quote: "There's no song and dance about it," she says. "We can't keep this up."

summary: Arlinn argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
quote: "The endless night doesn't just affect humans."

summary: Adeline agrees to go to Sorin, hoping a trace of Avacyn remains in him, and comforts the boy from Karo.
quote: "I'll go. If there's a trace of Avacyn left in him, he'll listen."

summary: In a flashback to six millennia earlier, Sorin tells his grandfather Edgar that vampires will drink Innistrad dry and Edgar dismisses it.
quote: "Sorin. Do you truly believe I've never had the same thought?"

summary: Sorin recalls that after six millennia he gave humans a protector, saving Innistrad, and reflects that defeat found him.
quote: Humans needed a protector. He gave them one.

summary: Sorin goes into the family archives to wake his grandfather Edgar and ask for a plan.
quote: His grandfather had been slumbering for long enough.

summary: Sorin discovers that Edgar's mausoleum and coffin have been stolen.
quote: the coffin itself is missing

summary: Sorin crushes a bat carrying an envelope addressed to him and recognizes the handwriting.
quote: He crushes it without a second thought.

summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
quote: All in his library, in his family archives

summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

summary: Arlinn reads the invitation and declares the group will crash the wedding.
quote: "Looks like we've got a wedding to crash."

summary: Jacob Hauken meets Lord Nellick and Detective Wicker in Selhoff to discuss a horde of geists killing the morally bankrupt across Nephalia.
quote: "Thank you for your punctuality, Mr. Hauken."

summary: Wicker questions Nellick about why geists would target him, and Jacob advises him to stay inside and get wards.
quote: "Stay inside, Lord Nellick, though I'm sure I don't have to tell you that nowadays.

summary: Wicker shakes Nellick's hand, goes still, and then hurriedly leads Jacob away, telling him to call her Eloise.
quote: "You can call me Eloise," she says

summary: Eloise tells Jacob about a vacant tower and a necro-alchemist's misfired geistbomb.
quote: A geistbomb misfired. Killed a bunch of people.

summary: A swarm of geists forms into a screaming woman who throws Eloise against a wall until Jacob banishes her.
quote: The gale slams into Eloise, knocking her backward against the alley wall.

summary: In an inn, a strangely hypnotic Eloise draws out Jacob's backstory and suggests he jump into the bay.
quote: "There's a whole bay out there.

summary: Eloise touches Jacob's face and thanks him for his story, and he feels something oily try to slide beneath his skin.
quote: She touches cold fingertips to his face.

summary: A physician examines Eloise and speaks oddly to Jacob; later Eloise says she remembers nothing after the merchant's cold hands.
quote: "I remember . . . the merchant in the tower.

summary: The geist returns, and Jacob uses his own blood to draw a seal that lets her speak; she names herself Millicent and says a man used her community's spirits.
quote: "Millicent. That was my name.

summary: Millicent's account and Eloise's lack of memory lead Jacob to realize that the necro-alchemist is possessing people.
quote: Once again, she looks at Eloise. And Jacob understands.

summary: Jacob visits Nellick, asks about Cyril Rav, feels possession begin and pushes the necro-alchemist out.
quote: "Have you ever possessed a geistmage before? I promise you won't like it."

summary: Rav, in Nellick's body, admits he hired Jacob, that the geistbomb misfired and that the mayor was a stolen body he discarded.
quote: "Of course. I would much rather my geistbomb succeed than fail.

summary: Rav offers Jacob a partnership, promising protection or help finding his friend's killers.
quote: "I think we should go into business together."

summary: Jacob, worn down, admits he is just tired, and Rav says he knows; the page leaves his answer open.
quote: Jacob closes his eyes. "I'm just tired."

summary: Eloise and Millicent go to Nellick's mansion and find two unconscious servants and Nellick's body but no Jacob.
quote: She finds two unconscious servants in the kitchen, and a body in the parlor: Lord Nellick.

summary: Eloise offers to work for Millicent and tells her to keep the seal.
quote: "I've never worked for a geist before, but my rates are very reasonable."

summary: Cordelia and Relio attend Olivia Voldaren's wedding at the Voldaren Estate, where Nusfar duels end in killings.
quote: a boy who looks all of ten drives his hand into a man's chest

summary: Henrika Domnathi kills Relio with blood magic and menaces Cordelia.
quote: Relio's next nonsense dies the moment he does

summary: Olivia Voldaren makes a grand entrance, announces the wedding and has thralls carry in a coffin for the groom.
quote: an elaborate stone coffin: marble inlaid with gold, crowned by Markovian rays

summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

summary: Chandra remembers the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key; Sorin agrees to enter alone.
quote: "I've been alone for centuries," he says. "This will be no different."

summary: Sorin walks through the estate escorted by guards and reflects that Olivia chose a political marriage with his grandfather.
quote: It was only natural that someone so nakedly ambitious would hit on the idea of a political marriage.

summary: Sorin is announced in the ballroom and sees his grandfather's coffin on the dais.
quote: There's no mistaking it: that is his grandfather's coffin.

summary: Olivia cuts her arm to let her blood drip into Edgar's coffin to wake him.
quote: Old blood, potent blood, blood dark as the night around them, drips onto Edgar Markov's coffin.

summary: Kaito steals the Reality Chip from its stand.
quote: So Kaito reached out, grabbed the Reality Chip from its stand, and shoved it in his pocket.

summary: Kaito encounters the monster who murdered Tameshi, who names himself Jin-Gitaxias and calls ninjas.
quote: The existence of a second Jin-Gitaxias on this plane is highly improbable

summary: Kaito fights the Undercity ninjas and escapes the lab with a smoke bomb.
quote: Black smoke exploded through the crowd

summary: Cornered by a dragon-shaped mech, Kaito chooses not to planeswalk with the chip.
quote: Leaving right now was too great a risk.

summary: The Reality Chip stirs, and a swordswoman cuts down the mech: the emperor, who is the Wanderer.
quote: The Wanderer.

summary: Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

summary: The emperor tells Kaito she heard of his search across the planes and nearly met him many times.
quote: "Sometimes I was only a step behind you.

summary: Light-Paws and Eiko arrive and bow to the emperor, who orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers.
quote: We must prepare our forces at once."

summary: Tamiyo urges destroying the Reality Chip, but Kaito objects and proposes destroying Tameshi's lab with Imperial detonators.
quote: "I'll destroy Tameshi's compound."

summary: The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

summary: Kaito promises the emperor to free any captive kami before setting off the charge.
quote: "You have my word," Kaito replied.

summary: Kaito and Tamiyo return to Otawara and find the lab unlocked and the kami gone, their beds covered in metallic ash.
quote: The only evidence of a kami dematerializing.

summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

summary: Kaito and Tamiyo realize it was a trap and that the experiments are about planeswalkers, and the henchmen close in.
quote: It was a trap—and Kaito and Tamiyo had walked right into it.

summary: Tezzeret restrains Tamiyo with the lab's equipment and holds star-blades to Kaito's throat.
quote: a strip of metal equipment tore from the ceiling and wrapped itself around her hand like a monstrous restraint.

summary: Kaito throws a detonator at the machine room, but Tezzeret catches it and breaks it apart; Kaito is knocked unconscious.
quote: the detonator broke apart piece by piece, until it became nothing more than a pile of useless metal and microchips.

summary: The Wanderer has a vision of the ambush and decides to planeswalk into the compound, with Eiko encouraging her to save Kaito.
quote: "They were ambushed by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias."

summary: Using her bond with Kyodai to stabilize her spark, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound.
quote: the Wanderer planeswalked out of Eiganjo and into Tameshi's compound with a flash of light.

summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

summary: Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo.
quote: Risona has brought an army.

summary: Kaito knocks Tezzeret out with two crates.
quote: The impact knocked Tezzeret out cold.

summary: Tamiyo removes the chip from the Wanderer's hand and then places it on her own hand to pilot a surveillance mech to Eiganjo.
quote: Tamiyo lifted the Reality Chip to the back of her own hand and pressed the panel to her flesh.

summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

summary: The Uprisers have breached Eiganjo's gates as the mech arrives.
quote: Risona and the Asari Uprisers had indeed come to Eiganjo—and they'd already breached the gates.

summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

summary: Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand, opens a portal and drags her away.
quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.

summary: The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and offers her surrender.
quote: "Drop your blade. There is no need for you to die this way."

summary: Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock and she is bound, ending the battle.
quote: something flew across the room and cracked against the side of her skull, knocking her unconscious.

summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

summary: The emperor's spark takes hold and she vanishes from Kamigawa again.
quote: The spark took hold of her, and the emperor once again vanished from Kamigawa.

summary: Light-Paws grows a new tail and Kaito and Eiko bow to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
quote: Kaito and his sister bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.

summary: Kaito says goodbye to Eiko, promising someday to try to reconcile with Light-Paws, and leaves to master planeswalking and find Tamiyo and the emperor.
quote: He would search the Multiverse for Tamiyo.

summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
quote: Phyrexia was her new home.

summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

summary: Chishiro watches townsfolk worshipping a shrine in Far Corner despite his orders and tells Ayari to send them indoors.
quote: "Tell them to get back inside before they make any more mistakes."

summary: Chishiro warns the shrine's sleeping kami not to trouble the townsfolk further.
quote: "Don't trouble them more than you already have."

summary: Chishiro recalls letting a captured Futurist go into Jukai, as he used to do while bonded to Kaima.
quote: So, Chishiro let her go, stripped of all her technology and gear, into the depths of the forest she had sought to ravage.

summary: The Mukotai threaten Far Corner after their scout was killed by roots, nailing Jenzo's hand to the gate and giving a week's deadline.
quote: The Mukotai had signified their intent to retaliate with a hand nailed to the gate of Far Corner.

summary: Chishiro trains the townsfolk and plans a trap using disruptors to drive the Mukotai toward Jukai.
quote: the plan was to lure the Mukotai down to the Jukai end of Far Corner's main street.

summary: The Mukotai arrive on the moonless night of the deadline with a mech and a toad-riding leader.
quote: The Mukotai had arrived.

summary: Chishiro recognizes Tatsunari as the man who betrayed him and leaps from the roof, killing Mukotai fighters.
quote: He launched himself from the roof with the vicious totality of his bulk.

summary: In a flashback, a boy poisons Chishiro's order at their haven and demands that Kaima bond with him.
quote: "Well? You know what I want. Bond with me, and I'll have no need to kill him."

summary: In the flashback, Chishiro lets Kaima go, the blade shatters, and Kaima tramples the boy and vanishes with the bond broken.
quote: The root in Chishiro's mind snapped, and the blade in the boy's hand shattered.

summary: Chishiro burns the bodies of his friends and the villagers and thereafter becomes a sellsword.
quote: In the end, he burned the bodies of his friends, and of every villager he could find.

summary: The disruptors trigger and the fight turns chaotic, with a Mukotai mech crushing a disruptor.
quote: A minuscule squeeze; the disruptor shattered.

summary: Chishiro climbs the mech and plants a jade disruptor in the pilot's hands, destroying it.
quote: He threw himself from the mech moments before the disruptor sang out

summary: Tatsunari reaches the shrine holding Chishiro's old blade and Chishiro realizes Tatsunari hates kami.
quote: "You hate them," he said, "the kami."

summary: Tatsunari stabs Chishiro through the gut, and the shrine's kami awakens, its roots healing Chishiro and attacking the Mukotai.
quote: The kami of Far Corner's shrine had awoken, and it said this to Chishiro

summary: Chishiro retakes the blade, leaps from the roots and kills Tatsunari's toad, leaving Tatsunari with a broken leg.
quote: Chishiro cleaved into the toad.

summary: Chishiro realizes the awakened kami is Kaima, who intends to destroy everyone, and a Mukotai bruiser rescues Tatsunari.
quote: the majesty that had once been Kaima.

summary: Chishiro has Ayari and Jenzo evacuate the townsfolk, then confronts Kaima over killing those who love him.
quote: Chishiro advanced toward his old friend—blade in hand and root in chest.

summary: Chishiro and Kaima realize their rage has poisoned each other and stand down.
quote: We already have.

summary: Chishiro offers Kaima peace, and Kaima asks him to bond again; Chishiro raises the blade and a light is reborn.
quote: they revealed a light reborn.

summary: Katsumasa shows Kotori the Epoch Engine, a prototype mech, and asks her to pilot it in secret.
quote: I call this prime iteration the Epoch Engine—and I want you to be its pilot.

summary: Kotori syncs with the mech and feels a flicker of something beneath, then hears the name Shorikai.
quote: Shorikai.

summary: Katsumasa brushes aside Kotori's question about the new technology and orders her into daily training.
quote: I expect you to be combat ready by the end of the month, understand?"

summary: Kotori meets her friend Arima in a coffee house; Arima warns that people say Katsumasa's research is unnatural.
quote: They say his research is unnatural."

summary: While training at night, Kotori bonds with Shorikai and glimpses a vision of herself killing Katsumasa.
quote: Sliding the blade soundlessly into his jugular.

summary: Katsumasa assigns Kotori to a supposed Reckoner raid in Boseiju District with Veilshapers and an Imperial samurai.
quote: "Imperial-led mission—their samurai will brief you.

summary: The team breaks into the building and finds it is a Jukai hideout, not a Reckoner safehouse.
quote: "This place isn't Reckoner,"

summary: Jukai acolytes burst out with disruptors, and Kotori messages Katsumasa for clarification but receives no reply.
quote: No reply.

summary: Kotori-Shorikai disable the Jukai fighters, then kill the last Jukai woman by crushing her throat.
quote: The woman crumpled to the floor, gurgling blood.

summary: A Veilshaper strikes at the river kami and the mech fires a dart without Kotori's command, killing him.
quote: The Veilshaper slumped to the floor, a steel dart protruding from a weak spot in his armor, just under his chin.

summary: Kotori realizes there is a kami inside the mech.
