quote: There was a kami inside the mech.

summary: Katsumasa, controlling a Veilshaper remotely, tells Kotori to override Shorikai and seize control; she instead lets go.
quote: And she withdrew, letting go.

summary: Shorikai reveals his true bound form and slays the remaining Veilshapers and the samurai.
quote: It took only a few more seconds to silence the others, including the injured samurai

summary: The river kami escapes through a warped merge left in the wall.
quote: Then, the river kami floated into the distorted wall and disappeared.

summary: Shorikai speaks to Kotori and proposes they take their own path; Kotori agrees.
quote: Take our own path.

summary: Kotori-Shorikai leave the hideout under occlusion veil, fleeing Katsumasa.
quote: Kotori-Shorikai left the Jukai hideout and walked into the darkness.

summary: As children, Norika and Heiko sneak to the tea garden to see a merge, and a faceless kami emerges and attacks.
quote: Something is shouldering its way through the gap.

summary: Norika throws herself between the kami and Heiko and is struck by a beam of pain, leaving her paralyzed for years.
quote: She leaps, but never lands.

summary: Ten years later, Heiko arrives alone in Sokenzanshi, having fled her family on her eighteenth birthday.
quote: Serves her right for fleeing her family the moment her eighteenth birthday arrived.

summary: Heiko meets Chiye at a soup line, and Imperial mechs break up the unauthorized assembly as Uprisers hurl snowballs.
quote: "Unauthorized food distribution.

summary: Chiye brings Heiko to Risona, who agrees to accept her with Chiye's sponsorship.
quote: She meets Risona's eyes. "Yes."

summary: Norika's recovery and rise, from the Imperial medics to chief handler of the merge in Eiganjo, culminating in Naomi sending her to command in Sokenzanshi.
quote: "The bandit problem in Sokenzanshi has gotten out of hand. I need you to take command there."

summary: Heiko and Chiye rob an Imperial provisions train and are caught by enforcers.
quote: Two Imperial enforcers pull them out of the car and throw them to the ground

summary: Heiko recognizes the commander as her cousin Norika from her secret finger-tapping signal.
quote: Almost imperceptibly, the commander is tapping the backs of two fingers against her armored leg.

summary: Norika dismisses the enforcers, frees the prisoners and proposes an opportunity to fix the food crisis.
quote: "I'm here to fix this.

summary: Heiko confesses she loves Chiye as she sends them to warn Risona.
quote: "I love you, now get out of here .

summary: Heiko and Norika fight on the tracks and Norika reveals she came to forgive her.
quote: "I didn't come here to make you pay. I came here to forgive you."

summary: Heiko shows Norika the Uprisers' charity work as she pretends to be Norika's prisoner.
quote: The Uprisers keep them heated, manage water and power.

summary: Risona holds an axe to Norika's throat, and Norika agrees to leave the storehouse contents and stop the taxes.
quote: "I will honor these agreements."

summary: Heiko and Norika part, unsure if they are allies, and clasp hands.
quote: "But I don't yet know if we're allies."

summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

summary: Ajani carries the dying Elspeth to Theros, then leaves to find help as she sees a flash of light cleaving the heavens.
quote: The last thing she saw was a flash of light, cleaving the heavens in two.

summary: Xander measures Anhelo for a new outfit and shares worries about Halo supply.
quote: "The balance of power in this town is shifting."

summary: Xander orders Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply in the Mezzio.
quote: gather the information on what this source is by whatever means necessary.

summary: Xander retreats to a hidden room of ancient texts on New Capenna's founding.
quote: Statues of winged angels were locked in stony prayer

summary: Jinnie and Jetmir plan the Crescendo and discuss the Adversary and the Font.
quote: "Besides, the moment the Font is revealed, everything in New Capenna will change and the Cabaretti will be on top."

summary: Jinnie tells Giada and Kitt that they are going to change the plane.
quote: "Good, because in no time at all, we're going to change the plane."

summary: Vivien explores New Capenna's lower levels and finds a synthetic city out of balance.
quote: Nature might exist here, but it wasn't real.

summary: Ziatora addresses an assembly of workers, attacking the Cabaretti, Brokers and Obscura.
quote: "The Cabaretti demand too much for this Crescendo without spreading its benefits.

summary: Vivien recognizes a stranger as a planeswalker, who leads her out of the hall.
quote: He was also a planeswalker.

summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien that others like them are present and that his employer is acquiring Halo with other goals, and invites her to meet Urabrask.
quote: "Good, come along then. Urabrask will be eager to meet you."

summary: Vivien confronts Tezzeret, recalling that they fought on opposite sides in the War of the Spark, and refuses his orders.
quote: They'd fought on opposite sides during the War of the Spark

summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

summary: Perrie enters a Mezzio lounge to find Krent and is confronted by two Cabaretti bouncers.
quote: "If you weren't hassling me, there'd be nothing to disturb your customers about,"

summary: The bouncers taunt Perrie as a contract breaker, and he beats both of them.
quote: "Good kitty," he says softly to the bouncer on his right with a wink.

summary: Rigo finds Perrie in the alley and tells him to stand down and takes him to Nido Sanctuary by teleport.
quote: a flash of white light envelops them as Rigo teleports them off to their headquarters.

summary: Falco, still undecided on Perrie's contract breaking over a child, gives him a job to retrieve stolen plans.
quote: "I haven't made a judgement on the case, yet,"

summary: Falco orders Perrie and Kros to retrieve the Halo storage plans from a Riveteer and to leave her alive.
quote: Get the plans back. Leave the Riveteer alive.

summary: Kros leads Perrie through a manhole and down a ladder to the old country outside New Capenna.
quote: "Welcome to the old country."

summary: Twenty feral raccoonfolk attack Perrie and Kros, and Perrie beats them back.
quote: Twenty furred, snarling, and clearly starving raccoonfolk attack.

summary: A wall collapses on Kros and demolition magic cracks the road beneath Perrie.
quote: the entire wall he's been using as cover slumps down onto him with a horrifying groan.

summary: Perrie corners Jolene in the ruins, and Kros appears alive and reveals she is under an Obscura spell.
quote: "Obscura spell," Kros wheezes.

summary: Kros learns from Jolene's mind that the Obscura abducted her and set a trap to start a war between the Brokers and Riveteers.
quote: "This is all a trap, she's the bait."

summary: Perrie decides to report to Falco empty-handed rather than start a war with the Riveteers.
quote: "How many lives will I save if I do?"

summary: Falco reveals war is coming and offers Perrie a step up into leadership if he abandons his defiance over the boy.
quote: "No one can break a contract."

summary: Perrie refuses to harm a child, and Falco instead sends him to see that the boy is protected.
quote: I still need you to go see that boy for me.

summary: Perrie delivers the boy to wardens who wipe his memory and school him in secret.
quote: "He won't remember a thing before today," the warden says.

summary: Perrie heads off to a street fight with the Obscura, carrying the boy's cap.
quote: Perrie looks down at the cap in his hand thoughtfully.

summary: Elspeth survives by taking odd jobs in New Capenna, still feeling the hollow left by Godsend.
quote: She kept her head down and took odd jobs throughout the city as she could find them.

summary: A leonin bumps into Elspeth, triggering a memory of her reunion with Ajani on Dominaria.
quote: "You're alive!" Ajani raced to her.

summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

summary: Ajani tells Elspeth that home is a feeling, not a place; she bristles and walks away.
quote: "Elspeth, home is not a place; it is a feeling.

summary: Elspeth hears the shopkeeper being beaten over a debt and intervenes against four Maestro enforcers.
quote: "Anyone who finds sadistic pleasure in beating up an unarmed man makes themselves my business."

summary: Elspeth leads the Maestro enforcers on a chase through the Mezzio and ends up cornered at a half-built bridge.
quote: The road she'd been running down ended abruptly, a half-finished bridge extending out into empty air.

summary: Elspeth grabs a steel rod and knocks out all four enforcers without killing them.
quote: rendered him unconscious with a thud

summary: Anhelo applauds, offers Elspeth work with the Maestros and mentions Halo.
quote: Why don't you start with the Maestros?

summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

summary: In the memory, Ajani reveals he found her home, New Capenna, and asks her to learn how it survived a past Phyrexian incursion.
quote: "There are rumors of a past incursion there, and since New Capenna is still standing, that means they defeated the previous threat."

summary: Elspeth planeswalks to New Capenna after Ajani's farewell.
quote: She didn't look back as she planeswalked away, headed for what she hoped was home.

summary: Elspeth reluctantly accepts the Maestros' offer to gain information on the Phyrexians.
quote: "All right," Elspeth reluctantly agreed.

summary: The Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane at the Crescendo.
quote: "Here's to taking over the plane."

summary: Tivit is gripped by a prophecy of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae, gold in the water and halos, as Kamiz and Queza visit.
quote: "The kitten hiding the cream . . . Corvidae, flitting and pecking . . . Gold in the water . . . Hiding the cream, the kitten!"

summary: Seers across New Capenna report the same vision at the same time.
quote: All reporting the same thing.

summary: Raffine summons Kamiz to the Cloud Spire and tells her someone attacked the visionaries; Kamiz must find who sent the vision.
quote: "Someone attacked the visionaries of New Capenna. Unacceptable."

summary: Kamiz takes Queza's angel talisman, lecturing her to question everything and believe nothing without proof.
quote: "We are the Obscura spymasters, Queza. We question everything and believe nothing without proof.

summary: Kamiz and Queza trace a warehouse explosion in the Mezzio to a reporter, Lacey Lanine, and call Oskar.
quote: There. An explosion in the Mezzio.

summary: Denry Klin tells Kamiz and Queza that Lacey is probably out with Lagrella the Magpie.
quote: "One of those straightlaced Brokers. Lagrita or something."

summary: Echo Readers show a four-person spellcasting team, with Lacey bringing them Halo, before a spell devoured the warehouse.
quote: Something stuck, and it devoured the room.

summary: Lacey is found in a dumpster with her mind wiped.
quote: Found her sitting in a dumpster in a stupor. Mind wiped."

summary: Tivit's shop is set aflame and its balcony collapses; Kamiz rescues Tivit but Queza appears crushed before emerging unharmed.
quote: Kamiz projected her magic forward, gripping Tivit's thick fur and Queza's long coat

summary: Kamiz foils a Broker agent's contract on Tivit with a mirror and learns the Riveteers smashed a new halo stained glass.
quote: The binding magic reflected to the agent and fizzled.

summary: Queza finds halos in the buildings where visions occurred and says it is a message from the angels; Kamiz scolds her and removes her from the case.
quote: "You're off this case."

summary: Kamiz tells Raffine the visions were not seen by Raffine herself, since the Cloud Spire has no halos.
quote: "Because you didn't see any vision at all."

summary: Kamiz confronts Lagrella in an illusory Mergino Fountain, and Lagrella reveals the Prophecy and that the Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
quote: The Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.

summary: Queza and Kamiz trap Lagrella with a mirror, forcing her to nullify Lacey's contract, which restores Lacey's memory.
quote: Lagrella's signature cracked the paper in two.

summary: Kamiz admits Queza was right and returns her talisman and sigils, saying maybe she does not know everything.
quote: "Ridiculous. But maybe . . . maybe I don't know everything."

summary: Elspeth works as a museum recruit, cataloguing artwork that hints at Phyrexians, and decides the curator Xander knows more.
quote: The leader of the Maestros wasn't collecting all these relics by chance.

summary: Xander tells Elspeth that to learn more she must work for it, and she agrees to take jobs that make her a true member of the family.
quote: She met his eyes. "I'm ready."

summary: Elspeth delivers a sealed package to an Obscura door in the Mezzio.
quote: Elspeth placed the package in her palm and promptly left.

summary: Xander tells Elspeth that New Capenna was founded by a deal between archangels and demonlords against an unknown enemy, and that he is one of the original signers.
quote: "Yes, I am, indeed, one of those original signers and have willingly become part demon

summary: Elspeth tails a Maestros informant across rooftops to a door in a shadowed alcove.
quote: The vampire knocked on the door and waited.

summary: Raccoonfolk ambush Elspeth in an alley and she bowls them over.
quote: she spun and used him like a battering ram to bowl over the others.

summary: Xander gives Elspeth Halo to drink, describing it as the last gift of the angels.
quote: "Halo was the last gift of the angels."

summary: At a Park Heights drop-off, Elspeth meets the planeswalker Vivien, who promises information on a looming threat.
quote: "One most certainly is, and we share motivations. I'm Vivien, by the way."

summary: Elspeth declines to leave with Vivien, wanting to learn how New Capennans beat the threat; Vivien agrees to contact her later.
quote: "I'll look further into these matters also and contact you when I have more information."

summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

summary: Xander names Elspeth an officer of the Maestros and gives her a knife; she demands full access to his archives in return for this last job.
quote: "Do this for me, and all the knowledge in my archives will be yours."

summary: Dressed in Xander's tailored outfit, Elspeth visits a Cabaretti cabaret looking for work and is rebuffed by the bartender Rocco.
quote: Rocco gave her a look that said, Who do you think you are? and promptly walked away.

summary: Kitt Kanto takes Elspeth to Jinnie, who agrees to give her a few small jobs for the Crescendo.
quote: "Then I think I have a few small jobs for you.

summary: Vivien follows Tezzeret down through the girders beneath New Capenna, wary of him but trusting her gut.
quote: Vivien trusted her gut and followed him deeper into the underbelly of this strange, new plane.

summary: At the bottom of the city Vivien notices the ruins of the first Capenna, with claw marks gouged into the stone.
quote: These ruins must have been the first Capenna.

summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

summary: Tezzeret admits he is playing both sides: he needs what Norn promised but does not want life destroyed or himself transformed, and Vivien relaxes.
quote: He was playing both sides.

summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
quote: "You have a deal."

summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

summary: Vivien meets her Obscura contact Navy in the Mezzio, trading information about the Font and the Adversary's lounge while hiding what she knows.
quote: "Not yet, but I'll find out," Vivien lied.

summary: Navy gives Vivien a lead that a woman named Elspeth is taking odd jobs in the Mezzio.
quote: "Oh, I got a lead on your Elspeth character, however."

summary: Vivien sees a woman fight off Maestro enforcers in the street and then watches her give her name to the vampire Anhelo.
quote: The woman ignored the gesture, continuing to walk before she said, "Elspeth."

summary: Anhelo takes Elspeth to the Maestros' museum after she agrees to join the family.
quote: Anhelo had taken her right to the Maestros' museum after Elspeth had agreed to join the family

summary: Vivien goes to the Adversary's lounge hoping Elspeth will arrive as a Maestro, refuses to drink Halo, and sneaks some into a vial.
quote: Vivien could sneak some of the Halo out of the lounge and back to Urabrask without arousing suspicion.

summary: Vivien spots Navy slipping out the back and overhears her as a double agent arranging with a Maestro for the Crescendo.
quote: Navy was a double agent.

summary: Vivien hears a deep, vaguely familiar chuckle from a hidden room revealed in the lounge.
quote: She heard a deep chuckle echo from the back somewhere.

summary: Navy ambushes Vivien outside the lounge with a dagger, saying the boss does not like people sniffing near his doorstep.
quote: "And the boss doesn't like people sniffing this close to his doorstep."

summary: Vivien stabs Navy in the gut, tells her to seek the Obscura for help, and takes her notebook.
quote: with one hand she caught Navy by her forearm.

summary: Using the notebook's note, Vivien waits at a Halo drop-off point in a park for the Maestro collector.
quote: This was the drop off point for Halo, and the bag was waiting just as the memo said it would be.

summary: Vivien intercepts Elspeth at the drop-off and catches her wrist; Elspeth admits she is learning the plane's history and is there on Ajani's behalf.
quote: "Ajani sent me."

summary: Elspeth says New Capenna might be her home and that she wants to learn how its people beat a threat before.
quote: "It might be my home."

summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
quote: "She is the key to our success."

summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

summary: On the eve of the Crescendo, Xander walks the museum one last time, names Anhelo his heir and orders him to go to the Crescendo in his place.
quote: "But someday soon, you will be."

summary: Xander sends Anhelo out the receiving door, sensing enemies are close, and then confronts the Adversary in the shadows.
quote: "Have you finally come to kill me, Adversary?"

summary: Elspeth works the floor at the Crescendo, where Jinnie, Kitt and Giada approach her.
quote: Elspeth stood on the dance floor of the Vantoleone with a platter in hand.

summary: Jinnie leads Giada onstage as Maestros begin to move through the crowd, and Elspeth senses something wrong.
quote: Something was wrong.

summary: Giada touches an enormous empty bottle and it fills with Halo, which Jinnie presents as the Font, Halo made from nothing.
quote: we have made Halo from nothing .

summary: Elspeth realizes the cost: the Cabaretti's new era will cost the exhausted, trapped Giada her life.
quote: Their "new era" would come at the cost of Giada's life.

summary: Xander's former assassins turn on him in the museum and he kills several with his cane-blade before retreating.
quote: Xander grabbed it, slashing through the air and sending a spray of ash across the room.

summary: Xander flees to the viewing deck and duels the Adversary, who lands behind him.
quote: "Did you really think you could escape me?"

summary: The Adversary blasts Xander with magic and Xander falls from Park Heights into the clouds below.
quote: His foot met open air, and he plummeted into the clouds below.

summary: The Adversary's infiltrators reveal themselves at the Crescendo; revelers throw off their family signets and draw weapons, and the Halo bottle is dropped.
quote: No family was exempt from infiltration by the Adversary.

summary: Jinnie abandons Giada on stage to rush to Jetmir, who is cornered and outnumbered.
quote: Jinnie leapt into the fray, weapons drawn, leaving Giada behind.

summary: Elspeth fights through the chaos, defeats the Adversary's loyalists on stage and offers to take Giada away.
quote: "Would you like me to take you from here?"

summary: Elspeth and Giada flee through the wings and a back door, killing pursuers along the way.
quote: when her dagger sank into a man's gut with a gurgle, she knew she was right.

summary: In the alley, Vivien appears and kills the Adversary's goons with spectral wolves; Elspeth vouches for her to Giada.
quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.
quote: "Bring Giada to me."

summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

summary: Ob Nixilis revels over Xander's mutilated body, and a Maestro informs him that the Font escaped the Crescendo.
quote: "The Font escaped."

summary: Ob Nixilis learns another unaccounted person aided the escape, realizes Xander played him, and vows to find the Font.
quote: Even from beyond the grave, Xander had played him.

summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee across the Mezzio; Elspeth decides to retrieve a better weapon from the Maestros' museum.
quote: "I need a better weapon than a knife.

summary: Elspeth finds the museum overrun, overhears that she is the Adversary's target number one, and takes a sword from the armory.
quote: "The Adversary has deemed her as target number one

summary: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, Anhelo takes Errant to a rundown neighborhood to buy information from Toluz.
quote: "Art's everywhere, if you know where to look,"

summary: Toluz agrees to tell Anhelo about the woman in white only if he kills Fiero Vespin, who has attacked her daughter Parnesse, by tomorrow's wedding.
quote: "If you want information for your Family, you have to do a little work for ours. Bump him off, and we'll talk,"

summary: Toluz reveals Fiero plans to use twenty goons to ruin the wedding, and Anhelo accepts the job.
quote: "Real considerate of you," he said.

summary: Anhelo sends Fiero an invitation to a private museum tour and asks Evelyn for a favor, agreeing to owe her.
quote: "All right," he said. "Name your price."

summary: Anhelo gives Fiero a private tour of the museum, flattering him through the exhibits to the Old Capenna exhibit.
quote: "Welcome to the Old Capenna exhibit."

summary: Anhelo tricks Fiero into standing in a spot where he cuts a wire and the Old Capennan Warrior's axe beheads him, leaving a warning in blood: death to traitors.
quote: Fiero's head came clean off.

summary: Running late to the wedding, Anhelo takes a cab driven by a man who locks the doors and takes him on a reckless drive.
quote: the locks clamped down on the doors.

summary: The driver reveals he is Severo, whose father Anhelo killed on his birthday three years ago, and drives into oncoming traffic.
quote: "It's Severo. And three years ago, you killed my father on my birthday,"

summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

summary: Riveteers who own the Halo in the trunk surround the battered Anhelo, who resolves to fight his way to the wedding.
quote: "You want to dance?" he slurred.

summary: Toluz appears with the shadow generator's darkness and wipes out the Riveteers, saving Anhelo.
quote: When it was all over, she was the only one left standing

summary: Toluz calls Anhelo family and has a healer and a new suit waiting for him in her limo.
quote: "You're family, Anhelo."

summary: Anhelo and Toluz arrive at Grand Capenna Hall, where Toluz offers him information free in the future and he declines.
quote: We can leave business for some other day."

summary: Anhelo dismisses a lackey reporting lost men at the Caldaia, saying the only family he cares about is in the bridal suite.
quote: the only family I care about is in that room.

summary: Anhelo reaches the bridal suite in time and is reunited with Errant on her wedding day.
quote: "Daddy! Daddy, you're here!"

summary: Kitt sings to the pigeons in a subway station when Jetmir stops to listen.
quote: this bigwig had halted right in front of her.

summary: Jetmir offers Kitt the warm-up slot at the Red Room tonight if she delivers a bag of Halo to a Cabaretti agent in Park Heights.
quote: "The warm-up slot at the Red Room tonight is yours, little songstress.

summary: Kitt boards a third-class train up Cloudponte Bridge, carrying Halo vials in her jacket and a gown in the bag.
quote: So that was how she found herself on a Cloudponte Bridge train for the first time in her entire sorry life

summary: The train stops and Riveteers blow up the rails, then the viashino Ognis tells the passengers she is looking for Henzie's goods.
quote: "There's somethin' our old pal Henzie owes us, and he knows it

summary: Kitt starts a brawl among the passengers and escapes through the window onto the tracks.
quote: Kitt jumped up onto the bench and, with a heave of her shoulders and a burst of adrenalin, popped open the window.

summary: Kitt flees across the Mezzio rooftops pursued by Ognis and two male viashino.
quote: the roof shuddered under the shocking weight of the viashino

summary: Cornered, Kitt drops the gown bag over the edge to fool Ognis and leaps into the chasm singing.
quote: Opening her hand, she let go of the bag.

summary: The pigeons swarm and carry Kitt up to the lowest rim of Park Heights.
quote: They caught her amid their hundreds of glittering wings and lifted her up and up and up

summary: Kitt reaches Henzie's candy shop and delivers the vials, receiving a ticket back.
quote: "I have what you want."

summary: Pigeons distract Riveteer lookouts and Kitt catches a train down to the Mezzio.
quote: A flock of pigeons circled down in a squawking mass

summary: Kitt arrives at the Vantoleone with six minutes to spare and gives her name as Kitt Kanto.
quote: "It's Kitt, if you please," she said with dignity. "Kitt Kanto."

summary: Kitt performs at the Red Room, spotting Ognis and the Riveteers in the audience, and pledges loyalty to the Cabaretti with a song mocking them.
quote: Pack those vials one by one, up to Park Heights, on the run, bye, bye, boiler

summary: Jetmir praises Kitt on stage and promises her a higher billing tomorrow night, having tested her.
quote: "We'll see Miss Kitt Kanto again tomorrow night, with a higher billing and a few more songs."

summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada shelter in an abandoned warehouse, where Giada confesses her fear that her magic is not enough and Elspeth vows to keep her safe.
quote: "And I will personally ensure you are safe to take the time you need to do so, however long that is."

summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

summary: Jinnie leads them to an Obscura hideout where Kamiz welcomes them, and a wounded Jetmir is being treated.
quote: "I see you were successful." Jetmir was settled in a lower bunk

summary: Giada makes Halo to heal Jetmir, but Riveteers and Maestro assassins burst in, and Elspeth and Vivien break free of their shackles.
quote: With a thought, her magic cracked open the locks

summary: Elspeth is mortally wounded in the brawl, seeing Erebos's cold approach, until Giada feeds her Halo that heals her.
quote: It smashed into her ribs as Elspeth had been straining to hoist her sword

summary: Giada's Halo mends Elspeth's bones; Elspeth sees Giada's glow.
quote: Wounds mended.

summary: Kamiz leads the group through Obscura tunnels toward the Cloud Spire; Giada drops a tracking bracelet and Elspeth destroys it.
quote: Elspeth ground the bracelet under her boot.

summary: Obscura enforcers ambush them in the park; Kamiz's trap is revealed and Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee as Jinnie fights.
quote: This had all been a setup.

summary: In the cathedral Elspeth and Giada hear the angels' statues sing; Giada says it is her family and that she is home, and Elspeth realizes home is purpose.
quote: "My family. I'm home,"

summary: Ob Nixilis arrives at the cathedral with enforcers; Vivien fires on him and Elspeth fights him but is thrown back.
quote: "Good of you to show yourself, Ob Nixilis."

summary: Giada transforms into the radiant magic of Halo, blasting Ob Nixilis away and giving Elspeth strength.
quote: Giada was transformed into the radiant magic of Halo.

summary: Elspeth's broadsword is transformed into a Halo-pommeled blade and she vows to defend New Capenna.
quote: The pommel wasn't a practical steel guard but an orb of Halo

summary: Elspeth wounds Ob Nixilis's neck with the new sword, and he planeswalks away.
quote: In a blink, he was gone, having planeswalked away.

summary: Anhelo gives Elspeth and Vivien Xander's letter naming him successor and granting Elspeth access to the archives.
quote: The Maestros are now in your hands

summary: Elspeth and Vivien read the archives and learn the Phyrexians once attacked Capenna and the Demon Lords betrayed the angels to make Halo.
quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

summary: Vivien tells Elspeth of Urabrask's planned revolution on New Phyrexia, and they decide to take the Halo and the news to Dominaria.
quote: "Dominaria." Elspeth turned away from the city skyline of New Capenna.

summary: Huatli sees a note on the Traveler's Noticeboard seeking raw copper and starts a correspondence with its author, R.
quote: Not one to leave a stranger in want, Huatli rises on her tiptoes to snag an old piece of paper

summary: Huatli leaves a lump of Sun Empire copper in a warded box with a note asking if R is a spy.
quote: Huatli places a medium-sized lump of Sun Empire copper inside

summary: R replies that she is no spy but a lady, and that the copper is for a project for a friend; she asks what brings Huatli to the plane.
quote: I'm a lady, not a liar.

summary: Huatli writes that she is studying the guilds' executive structure to bring lessons home and asks whether it is naive to seek utopia.
quote: I've spent the last two months on this plane studying the executive structure of the guilds.

summary: R answers that her mentor's inability to be impressed has made her a creator who never stops, and says she thinks Huatli's wish is beautiful.
quote: My mentor's inability to be impressed has led me to be the kind of creator who can't ever put down my tools and call it a day.

summary: R invites Huatli to meet on Dominaria; Huatli agrees, and R later proposes a drink.
quote: Want to meet up for a drink?

summary: Huatli proposes meeting at Iveta's Tavern at moonrise, and R accepts and suggests dancing afterward in New Capenna.
quote: We can meet at Iveta's for round one and planeswalk from there?

summary: On her way to the tavern, Huatli runs into Saheeli, whom she met on Kaladesh on her first planeswalk, and rushes off without confessing her feelings.
quote: "I have to go," Huatli adds, interrupting whatever Saheeli was about to say.

summary: At Iveta's Tavern, Huatli and Saheeli discover that H is Huatli and R is Rai, each the stranger the other has been writing to.
quote: "R is for Rai."

summary: The two women share coffee, leave together, and kiss under Ravnica's sky before planeswalking to another plane.
quote: their lips gently and tentatively meet under the indigo reach of Ravnica's sky

summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.
quote: "Soon, this wretched human will be released from the burden of fear.

summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.

summary: Norn slays the Mirran with a blade of her porcelain armor and tells the crowd she was too corrupt to save, hiding her own unease.
quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

summary: Norn returns to the courtyard and finds an organic weed sprouting through the flagstones, which turns out to be a human forearm.
quote: Instead, a human forearm dangled, disproportionately large, half-rotten

summary: More body-part weeds grow all over the courtyard, and Norn begins to doubt that she herself might be the flaw.
quote: Was she somehow intrinsically corrupt?

summary: Norn realizes the world is a dream-like illusion and names the planeswalker Ashiok.
quote: Scowling, she whispered, "Ashiok."

summary: Ashiok appears, admits to creating the nightmare as art and testing whether a Phyrexian mind can be afraid.
quote: I was not certain Phyrexians would be suitable for my art.

summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

summary: Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
quote: "We are one," Norn said.

summary: The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

summary: Ashiok shapes a nightmare Elspeth in the mirror of Norn's form, which frightens Norn before she slays it.
quote: she flung it into the nightmare version of Elspeth Tirel

summary: Ashiok flees, the nightmare dissolves and Norn is left shaken by the pity in the false Elspeth's eyes.
quote: She looked at Norn with such human pity

summary: Norn resolves to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
quote: she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

summary: Karn repairs a broken excavator in the Caves of Koilos and recalls Jhoira doubting that the Phyrexians are on Dominaria.
quote: Karn placed his hand on the excavator.

summary: The excavator opens a sealed Thran workshop, and Karn finds a diagram of the sylex and a clay tablet with matching symbols.
quote: a diagram of the sylex painted on parchment

summary: Karn returns to camp, where Jhoira's unanswered letters lie, and examines the sylex, which shocks him.
quote: The sylex sent a jolt through him.

summary: Karn recalls Urza teaching him about pain and the loss of Mirrodin, which he believes was his fault.
quote: The Phyrexians had taken it from him.

summary: Digging near the workshop, Karn finds living Phyrexian cables embedded in the rock and tears one free, causing a cave-in that destroys the workshop and blocks his way back.
quote: The other cables contracted within the wall—and the ceiling to the ancient workshop thundered to the ground.

summary: Karn follows the Phyrexian tunnel and defeats two Society of Mishra acolytes, who warn him that Sheoldred welcomes him and that others are coming.
quote: Sheoldred welcomes you!

summary: Karn finds the Phyrexian staging ground, where acolytes compleat humans and Sheoldred hangs suspended.
quote: He'd found the staging ground of the Phyrexian invasion.

summary: An acolyte raises an alarm, the Phyrexians begin evacuating, and Rona attacks Karn with a glaive.
quote: The shrill sound prompted action.

summary: Karn fights through Sheoldred's worshippers on a bridge and reaches the praetor.
quote: Karn pushed himself to his feet and charged down the narrow stone bridge.

summary: Karn defeats Rona, breaking her mechanical eye, but refuses to kill her, saying he is not a weapon.
quote: "I am not a weapon."

summary: When Karn touches Sheoldred, she whispers to him and he learns Phyrexian sleeper agents are hidden in every land of Dominaria.
quote: Phyrexian sleeper agents lurked in every land in Dominaria

summary: As Karn plants an incendiary device inside Sheoldred, Rona's magic paralyzes him.
quote: But his hand did not move.

summary: Rona tells Karn the forces have evacuated to secondary staging areas, and Sheoldred splits into spider-like pieces that scatter over him.
quote: Sheoldred split apart, dividing herself up in pieces.

summary: Rona taunts Karn about Memnarch and collapses the cavern onto him.
quote: Tons of rock poured onto him.

summary: Buried, Karn cannot planeswalk because of interference and is trapped, the only one who knows Sheoldred is on Dominaria.
quote: He was trapped.

summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

summary: Karn and Ajani return to Karn's camp, and Karn tells Ajani what he saw of Sheoldred.
quote: Karn set the box aside. He faced Ajani and related all he had seen.

summary: Ajani proposes speaking to the leaders at the Keldon-Benalish peace summit, and the two planeswalk to Oyster Bay.
quote: there is a peace summit between the Keldons and the Benalish.

summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

summary: Jodah and Jaya refuse to halt negotiations without a location for the Phyrexians but promise to help afterward.
quote: "We will go with you, Karn," said Jaya.

summary: Karn builds a scrying device and finds he cannot scry Sheoldred; Ajani gives him a copy of the amulet to summon the Weatherlight.
quote: They must have protections in place to prevent us from scrying them.

summary: Radha and Aron are about to sign the peace when Teferi arrives with news that the Phyrexians were on Kamigawa.
quote: "It's the Phyrexians—they were on Kamigawa."

summary: The news of the Phyrexian threat unsettles the summit, and the signing of the peace is left uncertain.
quote: Radha and Aron had not signed—and this made it seem like they wouldn't.

summary: Teferi tells Karn and Ajani that the Phyrexians have taken Tamiyo.
quote: "but they took Tamiyo.

summary: Karn secretly moves the sylex from his room to Jhoira's workshop on the Mana Rig.
quote: He stowed the sylex and its case on the lowest shelf behind lengths of pipe

summary: Stenn meets Karn on a hill, telling him King Darien tasked him with finding Phyrexian agents and that New Argive will mobilize.
quote: New Argive will mobilize.

summary: Karn seizes a thrush that is a Phyrexian spy, which attacks him with corrosive cables, and the group traps it in a cage.
quote: Karn seized the bird. "I know what you are."

summary: Karn presents the caged Phyrexian bird to the negotiators; three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters and break the table.
quote: Three of the Benalish knights exploded outward from their armor.

summary: A Phyrexian knight seizes Aron Capashen and bounds away with Ajani in pursuit.
quote: It rolled its body around Aron and bounded onto a neighboring balcony.

summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

summary: Jodah opens a portal to New Argive's watchtower; Karn, Teferi, Stenn and Jodah escape while Jaya burns the room.
quote: Jaya grinned in triumph as she raised her hands in a blaze of fire and set the whole room alight.

summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.
quote: Stenn handed Karn the key.

summary: Locked in the watchtower, Karn refuses to reveal the sylex's location or his plan until the group captures the Phyrexian spy and is sure of its members.
quote: "I have a plan to find and defeat Sheoldred," Karn said.

summary: The group splits up to search the tower, Karn and Teferi taking the lower floors and Stenn the basement.
quote: "Jaya and I can take the upper floors," Jodah said.

summary: Karn and Teferi find signs of the creature in the storage room and overhear Jodah and Jaya arguing through a vent.
quote: A throbbing chunk of meat had attached itself, barnacle-like, to the copper.

summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for how Urza treated him; Karn tells Teferi he hid the sylex in a sea cave by Tolaria West.
quote: I have hidden it in a sea cave by Tolaria West.

summary: Jodah and Jaya fight the squid-like Phyrexian, which splits into pieces and escapes through the stone.
quote: The creature split again, this time into four small chittering beasts

summary: Jodah makes locators from samples of the Phyrexian flesh, and Karn watches Ajani in a scryer.
quote: Ajani seemed to be fighting.

summary: Karn tells Jodah the sylex is in a warehouse in Estark; the locators then point in every direction as creatures swarm Karn and Jodah.
quote: Creatures flung themselves at Karn and Jodah, cables outstretched and mouths seeking.

summary: Jaya saves Jodah and Karn with a blast of fire, which seems to sterilize the creatures.
quote: Flame roared throughout the room.

summary: Karn tells Jaya the sylex is hidden in Suq'Ata.
quote: "Yes," Karn said. "It is hidden in Suq'Ata."

summary: Karn and Jaya find Teferi pinned and gutted by a Phyrexian monstrosity; Karn kills it and Jaya burns dozens more.
quote: They found Teferi pinned to floor by a Phyrexian monstrosity

summary: The group goes to the powerstone chamber, where Karn tells Stenn the sylex is in the ruins of Trokair on Sarpadia.
quote: "I concealed it in the ruins of Trokair, on Sarpadia."

summary: Stenn is revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent who transforms himself into an antenna and transmits the false location to Sheoldred.
quote: He had converted his entire body into an antenna, Karn realized

summary: Stenn's cables ensnare Jaya, and Karn dismembers him as Jaya burns him; the tower's lockdown is lifted.
quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.
quote: "You're in luck—we're not far.

summary: Liliana, a professor at Strixhaven, is visited in a dream by the Raven Man, who calls her to come home.
quote: "Come home , my Lili.

summary: Hallucination or not, Liliana researches the Raven Man in the Biblioplex, where he appears again and urges her to search deeper.
quote: "You aren't going far enough back," he said.

summary: Liliana finds a name in A History of Terisiare, concludes the Raven Man is real, and resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake.
quote: She could cleanse this tiny bit of evil from the Multiverse, for Gideon's sake.

summary: Liliana takes leave and planeswalks to Dominaria.
quote: "All right, you bastard," she said. "I'm coming home."

summary: Liliana arrives at the ruined Vess estate and falls asleep under the oak in the graveyard, where the Raven Man appears in a dream.
quote: the Raven Man stood before her

summary: Liliana names him Lim-Dûl and learns he wants her as Dominaria's weapon against a threat; he warns her to save herself.
quote: I called you to be Dominaria's weapon.

summary: Exploring the swamp, Liliana senses an alien taint and is confronted by Elas il-Kor, a kor Phyrexian, and a team of patchwork soldiers.
quote: "You have entered our gathering grounds, and you are thus forfeit."

summary: Elas il-Kor says her team is excavating to find an object anchoring the spirit; Liliana decides not to flee and to stop them.
quote: "The spirit we pursue is anchored to an object somewhere in this place,"

summary: Liliana raises the swamp's dead against the Phyrexians and retreats to her family graveyard.
quote: Liliana had the dead of an entire biome.

summary: Liliana blasts the Phyrexians with rotting light; Elas throws a javelin that wounds Liliana's shoulder.
quote: it struck Liliana in the shoulder.

summary: Reaching into the ring's power, Liliana sees the history of the Raven Man's necromancer lineage and that she was meant to be the next vessel, but refuses.
quote: She had been intended as one more link in a line stretching back to that first, now-nameless mage

summary: Liliana raises the dead Phyrexians against Elas il-Kor, who flees.
quote: Then, choosing survival over her soldiers' fate, she fled.

summary: Liliana buries the ring deeper beneath Dominaria to deny the Phyrexians and planeswalks back to Arcavios.
quote: she pushed the artifact downward, commanding the ancient dead to hide the object away

summary: The Raven Man watches her leave, content that he manipulated her into protecting him.
quote: She had protected him, in the end.

summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

summary: Jaya meets Ajani and Danitha Capashen, who is searching for her kidnapped father, and joins them to attack the Phyrexian cave.
quote: "Well, one sure way to get someone out of a cave is smoke."

summary: Jodah meets Meria in Yavimaya, who declines to commit her troops to Shiv.
quote: But travel to Shiv? No, I think not.

summary: Jaya, Ajani and Danitha's forces attack the cave, burning the guards, but are overwhelmed when more Phyrexians pour out.
quote: The Benalish were being overwhelmed.

summary: Ertai emerges from the cave with Aron Capashen, now compleated.
quote: And Aron Capashen stepped from the cave's mouth.

summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

summary: Ertai orders Aron to attack Danitha, and Danitha beheads her father.
quote: separating his head from his shoulders.

summary: Ertai summons a Phyrexian dreadnought from the mountain.
quote: A Phyrexian monstrosity broke free from the mountain in front of them

summary: A Phyrexian dragon engine driven by Rona attacks Yavimaya, uprooting the Magnigoths.
quote: a dragon engine reared into Yavimaya's vacant blue skies.

summary: Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, and Danitha stops the fight.
quote: "If you don't give yourselves up to me," Ertai said

summary: Meria finds a Thran artifact in the mud; Jodah portals them away and it creates a vacuum that kills the dragon engine's organic parts.
quote: The Thran weapon had created a spherical vacuum.

summary: Rona flees from the dragon engine, and Meria decides her people must fight.
quote: "Then there's only one path for us. And it doesn't lie in Yavimaya."

summary: The Golden Argosy arrives; Radha and her Keldon warriors board the dreadnought and kill it.
quote: Hundreds of Keldon warriors leapt from the ship

summary: Ertai threatens that Sheoldred will hear of this, and the dreadnought collapses.
quote: Ertai bellowed, "Sheoldred will hear of this!"

summary: Karn and Jhoira reconcile in her workshop and she plans a self-destruct mechanism for the Mana Rig.
quote: "Ah, I missed you." Jhoira laughed and embraced him.

summary: Jodah calls Karn to say Meria recruited neighboring groups and warns that there is a spy in the New Coalition.
quote: "There is a spy in the New Coalition."

summary: Docent Thranegeld tests Ulf, finds he is no Phyrexian, and sets him to research Corondor secretly.
quote: "Corondor," Thranegeld growled.

summary: After weeks of searching, Ulf finds a mildewed book about Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor, and Dihada's curse.
quote: Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor.

summary: Ulf shows the book to Silas Brotten, who wants him to leave it with him, but Ulf refuses.
quote: Ulf hesitated, then shook his head. "I don't think I can, sir."

summary: Thranegeld tells Ulf to hide the book and share it only when they know who their friends are.
quote: "When the time's ripe and when we're sure of who our friends are, we'll share it."

summary: Ulf hides the book in the stables and returns to find his three roommates murdered.
quote: He had been dismembered, the pieces of him piled in a careful stack near the wall.

summary: Ulf finds Thranegeld dead in his chambers.
quote: the dwarf tilted and slid from the chair and onto the floor.

summary: Brotten's face splits, revealing a Phyrexian, and he demands the book as Ulf flees.
quote: A Phyrexian , Ulf realized with horror.

summary: Brotten and an infected student chase Ulf through the academy, killing students, until Ulf is cornered at a dead end.
quote: He tried to turn back, but it was too late.

summary: A viashino bursts through the wall to save Ulf and holds Brotten back.
quote: "Run!" he said to Ulf. "Find him!

summary: A grizzled swordsman beheads the infected student who finds Ulf hiding in the library, and removes a tracker from Ulf.
quote: Standing over the body of the student was a grizzled man.

summary: The man kills five Phyrexian sleeper agents waiting outside the library with flame.
quote: "Yes, let's," said a deep voice behind them.

summary: Jared finds the dead viashino who had saved Ulf and swears his sacrifice will not be in vain.
quote: "You fought honorably, old friend," he murmured

summary: Brotten confronts the pair in the vestibule, names Jared Carthalion, and says Jared was always the prize.
quote: You were always the prize, Carthalion.

summary: Jared kills Brotten, who says Dihada is waiting for him.
quote: "She's waiting for you, Jared. Return to her."

summary: Jared sends Ulf with the book to Corondor while he returns to the academy.
quote: "You will take the book to safety. Bring it to Corondor.

summary: The archmage reveals himself to be a gray-skinned tentacled woman, pleased that Jared found the book.
quote: "How lucky you found the book, Jared.

summary: After a week without deaths, Squee learns from Bulp that goblin Rarp was crushed by a boulder.
quote: Like most goblins at any given moment, Rarp was standing in the wrong place at the wrong time and was crushed.

summary: Rarp, still alive, leaks black oil from his eyes, revealing himself as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
quote: Rarp's eyes shot open, and Squee's stomach dropped as a thick black oil began leaking from them.

summary: Squee sends Bulp through a secret tunnel to warn a town that the Phyrexians are back and burns Rarp's body.
quote: "No, Bulp. You gotta tell them that the Phyrexians are back."

summary: Squee announces a celebration, planning to have the mana lamps turned off so torchlight will reveal gold-eyed sleeper agents.
quote: Squee hoped that a sudden influx of torchlight would allow him to see exactly how many gold-eyed sleeper agents he was dealing with.

summary: Spurna reveals herself as a sleeper agent, impales Squee and throws him off the platform, killing him.
quote: Spurna's arm had twisted and reformed into a heated metallic spike.

summary: Squee revives, sees the whole clan with gold-ringed eyes, and a rotting spell kills him again; the disguised Bulp is revealed to be Ertai.
quote: Ertai's spiked Phyrexian armor gleamed in the torchlight as the rot reached Squee's chest.

summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

summary: Compleated goblins restrain Squee and sedate him on a table made of their fused bodies.
quote: One of the goblins had become a table, and Squee was shifted onto it.

summary: Squee awakens compleated, Ertai plans to deliver him to New Phyrexia for study, and Squee shows his new weapons.
quote: "You won't be a king in New Phyrexia.

summary: Squee declares himself compleat; his arm blade severs the rope holding boulders, which crush him and set off a chain explosion of mana lamps that destroys the mountain.
quote: there was a smoldering crater of stone.

summary: In the afterlife, Salvation, taking Sisay's form, explains that it protected Squee's soul and offers him a choice of returning or passing on.
quote: Or you can walk through this threshold, and your soul will finally be returned to the aether.

summary: Squee chooses to return to life for one more chance, and Bulp, back from his errand, finds his king alive.
quote: "I wanna go back, Sally, but I only want one more.

summary: Squee and Bulp resolve to fight the Phyrexians together.
quote: "If Phyrexia's back, then it's up to smart goblins like us to kick their butts and settle the score."

summary: Niambi examines Pallar, who asks why she risks the magistrate's displeasure by helping the Efravan, and Niambi tells her a dream of birds and a diseased tree.
quote: I saw a flock of birds searching for a home over a vast ocean.

summary: Niambi recalls protesting the decree against aiding the Efravan before the Council of Voices.
quote: Three days prior, Niambi held audience with him and the Council of Voices in the Great Chamber

summary: Awateh and the councilors claim the Efravan may be Phyrexian sleeper agents, and Teshunda sides with them.
quote: "There are Phyrexians out there, hiding in plain sight behind the wall!"

summary: Teshunda has Niambi escorted out of the Great Chamber and refuses to help the Efravan.
quote: "Out!" Teshunda shouted, driving Niambi back on her heels.

summary: Zar reports a tunnel to the abandoned mine is complete, and the Efravan plan to flee that night; Niambi insists on one more attempt with the magistrate.
quote: "When night falls and the first stars shine, we will move."

summary: Niambi uses her glowing hands and a dream story to persuade guards to let her into the magistrate's estate.
quote: Touched by her words and the sun magic running through them, the guards allowed her through.

summary: Niambi learns the magistrate has not slept and finds him at the Great Chamber, where she asks about his dreams.
quote: to find the magistrate seated upon a fountain in the courtyard.

summary: Teshunda tells Niambi he dreamed the tree was himself and refused the little bird's help; she offers to take him to meet the bird.
quote: "To meet your bird."

summary: Niambi drives away with the magistrate in a carriage as Awateh, Gbega and Jabras try to stop them.
quote: "You'll kill us all!" screamed Awateh

summary: At the mine, Pallar has given birth to Lark; Niambi reunites with her husband and daughter and brings Teshunda to see the Efravan.
quote: Pallar had had her child.

summary: Teshunda recognizes Zar as a descendant of Jaeger and Jedit and decides the Efravan will stay in Femeref.
quote: You will stay here with us."

summary: Teshunda silences the councilors and welcomes the Efravan to Femeref.
quote: "Welcome to Femeref."

summary: Tiana warns Shanna that the Phyrexian disguise is damaging the Weatherlight, then a screech signals an attack.
quote: A screech like nothing Shanna had heard sliced through the air

summary: A skeletal dragon attacks the Weatherlight, injuring Botono, and a lance tears a hole in the starboard wing.
quote: one of the lances from tearing a hole in the starboard wing

summary: Velena's powerbolts sever the dragon's wing and it falls, but the Weatherlight must land.
quote: The dragon howled and plummeted out of the sky.

summary: The crew finds the Weatherlight grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, and Raff proposes seeking magic in the mountains.
quote: "I think that dragon was guarding something," Raff said.

summary: Shanna, Raff and Tiana find a smoky, magic-eating barrier, and Braids appears and offers help if they kill her shard-self.
quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

summary: Braids opens four corridors in the barrier, and each of the three walks through alone.
quote: Four gaps had opened in the barrier, smooth sided and narrow.

summary: Shanna confronts a nightmare Sisay who mocks her legacy and shows her visions of her friends dying; Shanna destroys it.
quote: There was no artistry to Shanna's assault, only brutality.

summary: The three emerge on the other side at different times and find the Phyrexian war construct sunk in a crater.
quote: the half-sunken hulk of a Phyrexian war machine

summary: Shard-Braids attacks the crew, Braids returns, and together they defeat the shard, which Braids absorbs.
quote: like an avalanche that buried the shard whole.

summary: Braids reveals she was holding the shard back, and Tiana starts gathering parts from the war construct.
quote: I think . . . I need to start gathering parts."

summary: On the way back, Velena, Arvad and Elmegraun arrive and the corrupted Weatherlight rains powerbolts, killing Velena and Elmegraun.
quote: Velena and Elmegraun weren't so lucky and melted into puddles

summary: The Weatherlight has become a Phyrexian monstrosity, and Shanna and Tiana enter to recover the powerstone.
quote: a glance was enough to know it wasn't the Weatherlight anymore.

summary: Inside, Shanna destroys tentacles wearing the heads of Botono, Ulaten and Anyxni and frees Slimefoot and the powerstone.
quote: One thrust, and Botono's death was final

summary: Shanna, Tiana and Slimefoot escape the ship, which flies away in its transformed state.
quote: Tiana squeezed Shanna and Slimefoot close and leapt out of the hatch.

summary: Teferi brings Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur that was in the food stores; Karn burns it in a crucible.
quote: It's the second saboteur I've found.

summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for treating him as a thing, and Karn accepts.
quote: For what it's worth, Karn, I apologize for how I treated you in the past.

summary: A klaxon sounds as a vast Phyrexian army rises from the desert and begins to climb the Mana Rig.
quote: The first wave of Phyrexians scaled the Mana Rig's sides.

summary: Jhoira's cannons fire twice and bring down a Phyrexian dreadnought.
quote: It collapsed onto its own troops, crushing them.

summary: Karn sees that the Weatherlight has been compleated and is dropping Phyrexian horrors onto the deck.
quote: The Phyrexians had compleated the Weatherlight .

summary: Ertai, now a Phyrexian with doubled arms, leaps onto the Mana Rig and confronts Karn.
quote: It's been quite some time, old friend.

summary: Darigaaz and the dragons dive at the Weatherlight and rake its cables.
quote: Darigaaz threw himself at the Weatherlight 's hull

summary: Ertai's spell freezes Karn's joints, lifts him and begins to crush and pull him apart limb by limb.
quote: He was pulling Karn apart, limb by limb, like a cruel child torturing an insect.

summary: Believing he will die, Karn generates a titanium and carbon casing around the distant sylex to protect it.
quote: He spun the densest carbon filaments he could from the aether and encased the sylex in its lockbox in titanium.

summary: Ajani arrives on the Golden Argosy and knocks Ertai off the Mana Rig, freeing Karn.
quote: The Phyrexian mage stumbled backwards, concentration broken—and with a scream, tumbled over the side of the Mana Rig.

summary: Jaya, Danitha, Radha and the Keldon and Benalish warriors pour from the Argosy; Jaya burns Phyrexians with fire and lightning.
quote: Keldon warriors and Benalish knights poured from the Argosy onto the Mana Rig's decks.

summary: Sheoldred rises on a dragon-engine body and demands the sylex from Karn, showing his plan to draw her out had worked.
quote: You have the sylex for me.

summary: Sheoldred rams the Mana Rig and her army swarms up her body onto the upper deck.
quote: slammed her chest into the Mana Rig's bow section like a battering ram.

summary: Jhoira wakes the Mana Rig, which stands and tears free, strides across the desert and floods the Phyrexians with lava.
quote: The Mana Rig was free.

summary: Magnigoths and Yavimayan elves arrive and drive the Phyrexians back; Jodah and Meria land on the deck on a kavu and Jodah shields the cannons.
quote: rank upon rank of Magnigoths marched forward, darkening Shiv's deserts with their cool shadows and verdant foliage.

summary: Ajani's Phyrexian musculature bursts out and he is revealed as the compleated spy and traitor.
quote: Ajani had been compleated. He was the spy, the traitor.

summary: Compleated Ajani drives his axe into Jaya, and wounds Karn with it.
quote: He swept up his axe and drove into her body.

summary: Jaya burns Ajani's fur away to reveal wires, and he hurls her off the Mana Rig; she dies.
quote: With a thrust of his ruined hand, he hurled Jaya over the edge of the Mana Rig.

summary: Ajani crumples the sylex in his hand, destroying it.
quote: he lifted the sylex—and crumpled it in his hand, as if the ancient artifact were made of nothing more than paper.

summary: Sheoldred slams into the Mana Rig again, splits from her host body, reveals a stolen face and tells Karn the next step in evolution will be compleated.
quote: The next step in evolution will be compleated.

summary: Jhoira triggers the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism and orders Jodah to portal everyone out.
quote: Jhoira had triggered the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism.

summary: Jodah portals Danitha, Radha, Meria and the troops to safety and steps through his final portal.
quote: Jodah pulled up a portal and threw Danitha, Radha, and Meria into it

summary: A scarlet Planar Bridge opens and carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from Dominaria.
quote: it . . . stole him away.

summary: Teferi and Jhoira organize the survivors, and Jodah, holding Karn's necklace and a lock of Jaya's hair, mourns her.
quote: I can't let go of her. I just got her back again.

summary: Teferi, Jodah and Jhoira build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert; Teferi leaves an empty pyramid for Karn.
quote: Jodah, Teferi, and Jhoira had remained to build this: a monument for Jaya.

summary: Saheeli leads Teferi to her device in Urza's tower, where he resolves to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
quote: Teferi would do the one thing he had vowed never to do: cross time itself.

summary: Karn arrives in a Phyrexian cavern and is welcomed by Elesh Norn, who calls him Father.
quote: Welcome, Father.

summary: Elesh Norn shows the helpless Karn a small oil-beaded sapling and calls it the beginning of everything.
quote: It is the beginning of great things, Father.

summary: Five years after the cataclysm, Kayla sits alone in Penregon's council chambers reviewing grim grain reports and an empty map of the Visceral Sea.
quote: Kayla bin-Kroog sat alone in the council chambers of Penregon's government house

summary: Tawnos, frostbitten and aged, arrives for a private meeting and Kayla tells him she thought he was dead.
quote: I thought you were dead.

summary: Tawnos says Urza stopped a demon from taking the world after his brother was turned and fused with a machine.
quote: Turned by that creature. Fused with a machine.

summary: Kayla confronts Tawnos about the death of her son Harbin and says she will never forgive him.
quote: I will never forgive you for convincing me to allow my son to go off and die in my husband's war.

summary: Tawnos shows Urza's and his own designs, says he recovered powerstones and knows where Argive's buried stockpile lies, and offers to build tools to rebuild Penregon.
quote: I was able to recover a clutch of powerstones and know where we can find more.

summary: Kayla refuses to remember Urza as he wished and says she is glad he is gone.
quote: I will remember him as he was.

summary: Tawnos reveals that Urza is not dead but has become something else.
quote: Urza is not dead, ma'am.

summary: Kayla sends Tawnos to Urza's old factories with Myrel so he can begin building.
quote: Tomorrow, I will have Myrel, my scout captain, take you to the warehouses so you can begin.

summary: Months later Myrel reports a ten-thousand-strong ragged march approaching, flying black banners and carrying machine remains and Ashnod's transmogrants; Tawnos says his civils can be armed.
quote: My best assumption is ten thousand

summary: The vast march arrives outside Penregon, and five black-clad emissaries ride toward the gates.
quote: They pointed toward a small clutch of black-clad riders that had broken away and begun riding for Penregon's gates.

summary: Kayla offers the emissaries entry on three conditions, and Raddic announces a crusade of penitents against machines.
quote: We are the living of Terisiare, who seek to clean this land of machine filth.

summary: Raddic says the crusade is bound for the Iron Tower, and Kayla describes where it is hidden.
quote: It is well hidden in the mountains somewhere to the west or southwest.

summary: Kayla declines to join the crusade but allows refugees into the city with no weapons or soldiers.
quote: Your people are free to seek refuge in our city, but we ask that no soldiers enter.

summary: Talites in the market attack one of Tawnos's civils; two pilgrims die in the guards' response, a guard is wounded and the rest are arrested.
quote: Two of the pilgrims are dead and one of our guards was wounded.

summary: Myrel reports the marchers arming and Raddic approaching the gates, and Kayla refuses to hide.
quote: This is my city, captain. I will not hide when Penregon is threatened.

summary: Kayla orders Tawnos to arm the civils and Myrel to levy the militia.
quote: Tawnos, arm the civils,

summary: Kayla remembers fleeing the fall of Kroog while pregnant.
quote: She fled the city, pregnant with her son.

summary: Raddic accuses Penregon of harboring machine demons and reveals that Talites living in the city told him of Tawnos and the civils.
quote: Many of the faithful arrived here years ago

summary: Raddic gives Penregon an ultimatum to drive out the machines and tear down the tower by dawn, and throws a spear at Kayla's feet.
quote: Choose: die with it or live with us!

summary: Kayla tells Myrel to save the archers' arrows for the next day.
quote: Save our arrows,

summary: In his factory, Tawnos realizes his civils were built from Urza's war machines and that Penregon's powerstones will run out, making war inevitable.
quote: Tawnos realized that Penregon's stockpile would dry out in the coming years.

summary: Tawnos tears pages of his toy designs from his own notebook and sets fire to his office.
quote: No one on the factory floor saw the fire until it was too late.

summary: Talite crusaders fail to take Penregon from outside while hidden cultists inside set the city ablaze; the defenders drive both back.
quote: Alley by alley, street by street, Penregon's civils and militia drove the Talites back to their safehouses.

summary: Kayla spends the siege in a command post with Jarsyl, deciding what to do with captured Talites.
quote: Kayla had spent the brutal day in a well-defended post with the commanders of the city guard and militia.

summary: Kayla and Myrel survey the burned factory and conclude that Tawnos set the fire himself and vanished.
quote: Tawnos did this,

summary: Ten years later, silent summers, the frozen harbor and a stream of settlers westward mark Penregon's decline.
quote: Penregon's harbor suffered its first solid freeze.

summary: Scouts report green lands in the west, and Kayla proclaims that Penregon's salvation lies there; thousands set out in caravans.
quote: proclaimed to the people of Penregon that their salvation lay in the distant west.

summary: Scouts return from the north with news of glaciers and a frozen ocean, saying the world is ending.
quote: the scouts told Kayla that the world was ending.

summary: Alone in her manor on a winter night, Kayla screams her grief until fire bursts from her hands, her first magic.
quote: Fire coursed up from some deep knot in her gut

summary: Kayla studies Hurkyl's writings and learns to control her magic through a stone from Kroog.
quote: Kayla's new nightly practice followed the precepts of Hurkyl's meditative techniques as laid out in the book.

summary: Kayla orders the guildmasters and grain-lords to provision the migration and sends Myrel and the scouts west.
quote: Myrel went with them; Kayla saw them off

summary: The Talites return in a blizzard, learn that Raddic died after the Iron Tower and Mishra's forge, and march west.
quote: Many of the faithful died, Raddic among them.

summary: Kayla hears a story of a flying man in the western sky and leads a final caravan west out of Penregon.
quote: She prepared a final caravan of her people and went west with them

summary: The caravan crosses the Khers, losing a quarter of its number, and reaches the western lands along the Mardun.
quote: losing a quarter of their number to the cold, the dark, and the desperate creatures there.

summary: Kayla reaches New Yotia, lingers there, and resolves to cross the continent to learn the truth about Harbin.
quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth.

summary: Kayla secretly displays her magic by snuffing and relighting the lamps.
quote: As one, the oil lamps Kayla had left burning snuffed out, then reignited.

summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

summary: Kayla leaves New Yotia on a riverboat down the Mardun toward Kroog with Talite mercenaries aboard.
quote: So she did not protest when a detachment of dark-clad soldiers filed onto her riverboat.

summary: Fask, the Tyrant of Kroog, rigs his chamber with strings of noisy objects because an oracle's curse haunts him.
quote: This was Fask's trap, his system to prove he was not mad but perceptive.

summary: Fask sees a half-formed spirit at the foot of his bed and screams.
quote: Fask screamed.

summary: Teferi, whispering from the shadows, asks Kaya to pull him out because the Temporal Anchor undershot its target.
quote: The Temporal Anchor isn't calibrated correctly, Kaya, and I think we undershot our target

summary: Many centuries later, an old man tells his grandchildren the story of the tyrant and the ghost during the Ice Age.
quote: The Ice Age was upon Dominaria

summary: Teferi climbs the stairs of Urza's Tower, remembering his mentor and his late wife Subira.
quote: Teferi reached the top of the stairs, where he paused to catch his breath

summary: Jodah gives Teferi Kjeldoran biscuits made by Saheeli's construct, and Teferi asks him to lead while he is away on the time machine.
quote: I'd like you to consider being that person.

summary: Elspeth asks where Ajani is and Teferi tells her; she reacts with grief and silence.
quote: Where is Ajani?

summary: Kaya briefs the group on the plan: the other planes are mobilizing and the Coalition will join Koth's Mirrans in assaulting the Phyrexian core.
quote: Without a head, the body will fail.

summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
quote: That's a death sentence,

summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

summary: Kaya suspects the Phyrexians have repurposed the World Tree of Kaldheim, which could join every plane.
quote: This is the World Tree of Kaldheim.

summary: Vivien names Tezzeret as the intermediary who arranged her audience, and Kaya objects strongly.
quote: You know what he did on Ravnica!

summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

summary: Saheeli gives Teferi a clockwork peafowl and says the Anchor will be ready that night.
quote: The Anchor will be ready to use tonight.

summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

summary: Wrenn tells Teferi she is not here to absolve him.
quote: I am not here to provide you absolution, mage.

summary: Elspeth apologizes to Teferi, and he tells her about Ajani's compleation.
quote: I was there with him when it happened—when the compleation took hold.

summary: Teferi shares mitab fruit with Elspeth and tells her that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
quote: Everything I'm doing is about saving her .

summary: Elspeth offers to stay and defend them, and Teferi welcomes her.
quote: If you'll have me.

summary: Elspeth's sword glows and Teferi recalls his father's story of the wattle-eyes, choosing to believe.
quote: This time, Teferi chose to believe.

summary: Kroog is attacked at dawn, and Sanwell and four other cadets stand in the orniary yard facing refurbished avengers, with Sanwell sick with nerves.
quote: Kroog died on a crimson morning.

summary: Llora calls the five cadets up to crew avengers and asks whether Sanwell is ready to fight for Kroog.
quote: Training is over. Today's the day you save Kroog.

summary: Sanwell is given a command rod and paired with the new prototype avenger, Sword One, and puts it through its commands.
quote: Sword One," Llora said.

summary: Tawnos promotes the five cadets to full pilots and briefs them on the Mardun crossing and Mishra's dragon engines.
quote: The first waves of Mishra's force have crossed the Mardun; they control the River Wards.

summary: Tawnos orders the avengers to take down the dragon engines and tells the pilots to run if in danger, heading to Hench.
quote: We need you and your avengers to take down the dragon engines,

summary: A huge explosion and a dragon engine appear over the city as Tawnos hurries away.
quote: Roiling crimson smoke leapt into the sky.

summary: The pilots and their avengers push through burning streets, past bodies, to a plaza held by Yotian soldiers under Lieutenant Markos.
quote: Hold here, pilots!

summary: Fallaji troops attack the plaza barricade, and Llora orders Sanwell, Rica and Carlo to flank the dragon engine.
quote: Find a way to flank the engine and bring it down, pilot!

summary: The dragon engine's blast destroys the plaza, killing Llora, Markos, the other pilots and the soldiers.
quote: Llora and the other pilots, Lieutenant Markos and their soldiers—gone in a breath.

summary: Sanwell and Rica drag a screaming Carlo away and reach a crossroads plaza, wondering where to run.
quote: Like Tawnos told us—if we're in danger, we run.

summary: A column of Fallaji brasscaps appears and Sanwell sends Sword One and Sword Two to attack.
quote: Sword One," Sanwell cried.

summary: The two avengers slaughter the Fallaji front ranks, but Sword Two loses an arm and the Fallaji overrun Sword Two and Sword Three.
quote: The Fallaji brasscaps advanced, driven by their officers behind

summary: The Fallaji explode Sword Two's powerstone, burning Carlo and wounding Sanwell and Rica.
quote: The brasscaps detonated their bomb lances and killed Sword Two.

summary: Fallaji crossbowmen kill the crawling Carlo as Sanwell and Rica hide.
quote: A flurry of crossbow bolts thudded into Carlo's back, killing him.

summary: Sanwell orders Sword One to kill, and the wounded avenger rises from the dark as Sanwell throws down his rod and flees with Rica.
quote: Together, the two boys ran.

summary: Aiman, a wounded Fallaji soldier pierced by three arrows, lies among the dead of Kroog crying for water.
quote: Three arrows. He'd been hit.

summary: At night Aiman sees a glowing blue ghost he takes for Death, which says it is too early and that it does not happen here, then vanishes.
quote: We're too early,

summary: Two weeks later Aiman's fever breaks; he has lost an eye but survives.
quote: He had lost an eye

summary: Kaya extends her ghostform over the coffin while Saheeli powers up the Temporal Anchor in a test, but the circuitry fails in a shower of sparks.
quote: A shower of sparks poured out from a bank of circuitry

summary: Saheeli finds the wiring torn apart, and Kaya shields her from an explosion, with both sensing a melancholy presence hovering nearby.
quote: extending her ghostform to protect them both from the explosion

summary: Kaya identifies a black crystal orb from Teferi as the cause and wants to know why it creates ghosts.
quote: a black crystal orb encased in a cage of silver

summary: Flashback: Saheeli wakes tied to a chair in a room of stolen art as Gonti, who knows everything about her family, addresses her.
quote: she woke up tied to a chair in this place.

summary: Flashback: Gonti reveals their cracked-stone chest and failing aether heart and demands Saheeli repair it.
quote: It has begun to fail.

summary: Flashback: Gonti threatens to have Saheeli's family executed, starting with her mother, and shows her mother's bracelet.
quote: If I don't send word in the allotted time, their instructions are to execute everyone.

summary: Saheeli and Kaya find Jodah speaking with Jhoira, who asks if Teferi is still bent on going back in time.
quote: He's still bent on going back?

summary: Kaya explains the orb is strengthening a lingering spirit through a silver cord of psychic energy.
