quote: I saw a silver cord extending from the orb to the spirit.

summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

summary: Jodah reveals Thran script in the orb's cage reading, Go back to the beginning and greet me properly.
quote: It's the written language of the Thran, an ancient civilization on this plane,

summary: Flashback: Saheeli repairs Gonti's cracked silver filament, learning Gonti is immortal, and Gonti reveals the threat was a test of faith.
quote: A small fracture in the filament had developed over time

summary: Saheeli and Kaya spring a trap that gives the spirit a semblance of solidity using the rhythm of Gonti's heart.
quote: Saheeli's trap worked!

summary: The spirit shoves Saheeli aside, hacks the anchor with a ghostly blade and flees; Kaya pursues.
quote: The blade struck the anchor, gouging a deep gash into its side.

summary: Saheeli and Jodah find Kaya facing the spirit, who gives his name as Sharaman, the leader of Urza's armies.
quote: General Sharaman,

summary: Sharaman says he acts to prevent Urza's war machine restarting and recounts losing his nephews to Mishra's dragon engines and the sacking of Sardia.
quote: I will not let anyone repeat the mistakes I made.

summary: Kaya lunges at Sharaman in her ghostform and kills him, then kneels shaken; he asked if he would see his family again and she said he would.
quote: she activated her ghostform and lunged at the spirit

summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

summary: Epilogue: Jodah casts a shock spell at the Starfield Orb and is pulled into a pocket dimension resembling Urza's cabin.
quote: In a blue flash, the world vanished

summary: Jodah meets constructs of Xantcha and Mishra, who accept him as a descendant of Urza.
quote: My name is Jodah, friend of Teferi's and descendant of Urza,

summary: Jodah realizes the place is Urza's failsafe, the Legacy, and plans to tell Teferi; Mishra relays Urza's final words about ending conflicts.
quote: This whole place—it's Urza's failsafe in case he perished before he could deploy it against the Phyrexians.

summary: Farid cooks stew in a frozen trench ten miles from Tomakul with his sick friend Karrak.
quote: So, Farid cleaned his spear, kept his boots patched, rotated his socks, and cooked.

summary: A sergeant gives Farid a golden coin as her regiment shuffles through the trench to make room for replacements.
quote: Replacements due in this afternoon.

summary: Human replacements, including Assad, Aiman and Ehsan, arrive and are assigned to Farid's section.
quote: These are yours, spearman.

summary: Farid shows Assad a bone from the trench wall and lectures the replacements to take their cloaks and boots and run if the line breaks.
quote: There's always another trench.

summary: Aiman introduces himself as a veteran who lost his eye at the Siege of Kroog.
quote: I lost my eye at the Siege of Kroog,

summary: Officers distribute polish, silk and extra rations, signaling an attack, while Assad urges the others to cover themselves in glory.
quote: Our qadir means to set us on the attack again.

summary: Farid, Karrak and Aiman plan a covert patrol that night and choose Ehsan as the fourth.
quote: The attack is certainly coming by the end of the week.

summary: Soldiers gather to watch a column of chained transmogrants being marched to the front.
quote: Hideous, piteous things that were once human, now a rotting amalgam of flesh and machine.

summary: Farid gets an order chit and satchels from Sergeant Usman, who demands a full satchel in return, and leads the patrol over the top.
quote: One full satchel,

summary: The four shelter in a downed thopter in no-man's-land and hang a white cloth flag.
quote: Farid, quickly, hung the strip of cloth on the outside of the crashed thopter

summary: Four Argivians led by Laria arrive, and the two groups share spirits and goods, Aiman and Laria speaking Argivian.
quote: Four Argivians clambered into the wreck of the bomber.

summary: Farid betrays the Fallaji attack plan, telling Laria about the transmogrants, replacements and extra rations.
quote: Our generals have moved in a whole regiment of transmogrants

summary: Laria tells Aiman that Tawnos has brought a dozen units of Clay Soldiers, so the Argivians know the attack is coming.
quote: Laria said they know our attack is coming.

summary: The four agree to keep their secret, and the order to attack comes two days later.
quote: The order to attack came two days later.

summary: After a bombardment, the Fallaji wave charges across no-man's-land with transmogrants and finds the Argivian trench empty.
quote: They reached the Argivian trench and found it empty.

summary: Karrak finds a packet containing chocolate and a note of gratitude from the Argivians, and the front moves on.
quote: revealing a small piece of chocolate and a note.

summary: Teferi's spirit appears on a corpse-strewn battlefield while searching for the Last Battle with the anchor.
quote: Teferi appeared at night in a place very much like hell.

summary: An augmented scavenger notices Teferi and calls out to its brothers; Teferi realizes this is not the Last Battle and leaves.
quote: Brothers," the scavenger screamed.

summary: Karn lies bound on a slab as Suture Bishops dissect him, offering no resistance, while Tezzeret watches.
quote: But Karn gave no resistance to the team of aspirants as they bound him into place

summary: Ajani, compleated, quotes Elesh Norn's scripture over Karn as the priests dismantle him.
quote: Only in her grace are we saved,

summary: An angel blocks Tezzeret from leaving and orders him to carry the pieces of Karn to Elesh Norn for his reward.
quote: you will bring the pieces of Father to our Mother.

summary: Ajani gives Tezzeret his cloak, once worn by Elspeth, and Tezzeret suspects the true Ajani remains suppressed within.
quote: it was the same cloak once worn by Elspeth Tirel.

summary: Tezzeret feigns obedience and sets out through the Fair Basilica toward the core pushing Karn's pieces.
quote: As our Mother wishes,

summary: Tezzeret suspects a trap, kills the Phyrexian guide with a thrust and heads into the Mycosynth alone.
quote: with a single well-placed thrust, ran it through.

summary: Tezzeret reaches Memnarch's restored darksteel Panopticon and cannot open its door.
quote: darksteel, as a matter of fact

summary: Karn speaks, explaining he is tethered to the plane and offering to open the tower, since it was once his realm.
quote: I can take you inside. This was my realm once, after all.

summary: Tezzeret detaches Karn's head and Karn uses it to open the darksteel door.
quote: Karn's efforts caused the door to slide open.

summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

summary: Tezzeret and Karn argue over Karn's responsibility for New Phyrexia and Bolas's threat, and Tezzeret reveals he suggested eliminating the plane to Bolas.
quote: His first act as god-emperor would have been to obliterate New Phyrexia from existence.

summary: Karn admits he hears the same oil voices as Tezzeret, and Tezzeret threatens him but relents, fearing compleation.
quote: The same voices I heard when the oil had command of my heart.

summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
quote: We welcome you to our great work.

summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

summary: Tezzeret enters Shiv's cave complex and brutally forces Rona to give a status report.
quote: I've been told that unprotected flesh takes a few seconds to vaporize in the Blind Eternities.

summary: Rona reports the Phyrexians' losses and that the Planeswalkers have been tracked to New Argive.
quote: But we have been able to track them back to New Argive.

summary: Elspeth, unable to sleep, drills in the tower's grand hall and admits her skills feel sluggish after New Capenna.
quote: But after all her experiences on New Capenna, her movements had felt sluggish, her sword arm shaky.

summary: Wrenn tells Elspeth she lives two melodies, one in light and one in shadow, and Elspeth angrily denies it.
quote: It is as if you live two separate lives. One in light, one in shadow.

summary: Wrenn senses visitors, and Elspeth confronts two figures glowing green in the rain.
quote: Are you Elspeth?

summary: Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

summary: At a watchtower, Elspeth sets up one of Saheeli's cylinder turrets and tries to pray, remembering that Ajani is compleated.
quote: Elspeth pulled a steel-clad cylinder from her sack

summary: Elspeth speaks quietly to Giada about her hatred for the Phyrexians and her failures.
quote: And I hate them so much for what they did to Ajani.

summary: Chandra and Jodah, drinking in the hall, toast and reminisce about the dead Jaya.
quote: Let me have one turn on Saheeli's time machine, and I'd go back

summary: Elspeth joins them and speaks of Venser; Jodah reveals he is four thousand years old, and Chandra vows to save Ajani and burn the Phyrexians.
quote: We're going to save him.

summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

summary: Elspeth wakes the mechanical garrison and clay brutes and sets them in defense arcs.
quote: All at once, the hundred or so mechanical soldiers stomped to life

summary: Jodah unveils a staked trench and fire to impale the Phyrexian vanguard, and Elspeth and Jodah charge with powerstone lances that unleash scything bands of energy.
quote: Jodah unwove the phantasmal terrain spell he'd cast the previous day

summary: Elspeth fights through the horde with her sword and Halo, then orders the mechanical legion to charge.
quote: Upon hearing the command word, the metal legion defending the keep turned into aggressors

summary: The skyship unfolds into a giant legged behemoth heading for the tower.
quote: Several more gargantuan legs sprouted from the bottom of the skyship's hull

summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

summary: Ashiok's letter recounts how Elspeth and a prisoner called Boy tried to hide among corpses in a Phyrexian asylum on New Capenna; Boy was caught and Phyrexianized.
quote: Thanks to your Planeswalker spark, you escaped, but Boy wasn't as fortunate.

summary: Rona appears, blasts Elspeth and Jodah with lightning, and stabs Jodah in the gut as revenge for Yavimaya.
quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

summary: Elspeth wounds Rona with her sword, though her arm is run through by the glaive.
quote: burying her sword deep into Rona's shoulder.

summary: Tezzeret arrives, spares Elspeth, tells her to disappear before the tower falls, and carries off Rona.
quote: I suggest you take this opportunity to find somewhere remote and disappear.

summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

summary: Kaya explains the Phyrexians' World Tree plan and says they need the sylex to destroy it.
quote: If the Phyrexians have created their own tree, we'll need something powerful to destroy it,

summary: Chandra says no cost is too high to destroy the Phyrexians, clashing with Nissa and Saheeli.
quote: My point is that destroying the Phyrexians is the most important thing. No cost is too high.

summary: Teferi appears and says he is ready, and Chandra later admits she wants all Phyrexians to die.
quote: I want them all to die. All of them.

summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

summary: A second army of white-armored Phyrexians led by a flying winged general advances from the east.
quote: Out of the haze emerged a battalion of knights, more than a hundred strong

summary: Nissa commands the mechanical soldiers to meet the army, but nature spirits refuse her call and leylines are tangled.
quote: They recoiled at her presence.

summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

summary: Nissa lends Wrenn and Seven her strength and Seven hurls her at the flying Phyrexian general, whom she stabs repeatedly with a seed-bearing sword.
quote: With each stab, she'd implanted a seed within the Phyrexian

summary: Nissa and the general fall, Seven catches her, but she is dragged down by Phyrexians and reaches into the ground for the Worldsoul, Gaea.
quote: Help! Help us! she called out

summary: Gaea's nature spirits call Nissa a meddler, then judge her and grant her power, filling her with the wrath of Gaea.
quote: Gaea has judged you

summary: Gaea's will transmutes fallen constructs and Phyrexians into heartwood warriors that pour onto the battlefield and push back the Phyrexians.
quote: Gaea's would-be destroyers now reassembled themselves

summary: Nissa kills the crippled Phyrexian general with vines, after Wrenn urges her to stop, deciding she must be decisive when the time comes.
quote: The vines obeyed her command.

summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

summary: Jodah and Elspeth stagger in alive; Elspeth announces she will go to New Phyrexia and Jodah will stay to free Teferi.
quote: Then I'm coming with you.

summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

summary: Jace links the strike team telepathically, and Nissa finds a tiny artifact bird, resolving to keep watch for every plane.
quote: For the life of every plane,

summary: Teferi wakes whole on a beach, cut off from Kaya and the Anchor, and starts to walk inland.
quote: He was no longer a spirit.

summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

summary: Teferi, Kaya and Saheeli plan how to find the true sylex's activation, and Teferi picks The Antiquities War as the key text, aiming for the Last Battle on Argoth.
quote: We go here—the last battle of the Brothers' War.

summary: Teferi recalls his wound from a Phyrexian creature and that the Phyrexians are at the chamber doors.
quote: the Phyrexian creature had wounded him deep

summary: Teferi explains Saheeli's insight: send only a spirit back, since silver travel would be like dousing oneself in lamp oil.
quote: By extracting one's spirit and casting that back, one would be unable to interact with the past while remaining able to observe

summary: Teferi's spirit visits Kroog in 85 AR and sees a warlord scream about ghosts, then moves on.
quote: There, he watched a brutal man go mad and scream about ghosts and assassins.

summary: Teferi visits Kroog in 28 AR during the attack, and a dying Fallaji boy calls him Father.
quote: Father," the boy gasped. The boy died.

summary: Teferi walks a charnel trench valley near Tomakul in 44 AR and is seen by a scavenger.
quote: until one of them saw him.

summary: Back in the present, Teferi tells Kaya and Saheeli he has found blotted time, while the anchor may not survive another trip.
quote: I saw it, like a scar. Part of the tapestry blotted out, like ink spilled on a page.

summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

summary: Teferi returns sick and tells the others he almost has it, then goes back for one last attempt as Kaya warns it is brutal.
quote: Last one,

summary: Teferi finds the Last Battle on Argoth moments before the sylex detonates.
quote: Argoth. The Last Battle. Moments before the end of the world, again.

summary: Teferi freezes time at the moment of detonation, finds nothing, then takes a reckless risk and stops holding back time; the Multiverse tears open.
quote: The Multiverse tore open.

summary: In a void at the sylex's blast, Teferi tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker and the Phyrexians.
quote: I need to tell you some things about the future,

summary: Urza is remade as a planeswalker as Teferi explains the Phyrexians' return and asks about activating the sylex.
quote: Urza was being remade. Stitched together into something else.

summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

summary: The void cracks and breaks and the dark rushes in as Urza starts to ask Teferi's name.
quote: The void broke.

summary: Urza opens Tawnos's coffin on the wrecked coast, says the war is over and his brother is dead, and sends Tawnos west to teach.
quote: Tell them what happened here. Tell them what we did, and what we failed to do.

summary: Urza reveals his gem eyes and fades away, quoting Kayla's message to remember him as he tried to be; Tawnos walks inland as snow begins to fall.
quote: As you were, but as you tried to be,

summary: Ixhel flies up the Basilica's shaft from the Dross Pits, killing skitterlings on the way, to report her success.
quote: as you separate their heads from their bodies with a sweep of your spear

summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to seek out and kill the traitor Geth, a Steel Thane of the Dross Pits.
quote: I want you to seek him out, Ixhel. I want you to end him.

summary: Atraxa tells Ixhel she is her most perfect creation, and Ixhel feels a flare of something beyond loyalty.
quote: You are my most perfect creation.

summary: Ixhel treks across the Dross Pits and finds a rock gate with sound plates in front of Geth's fortress.
quote: Stepping into the shadow of the rock face, you see the outline of a gate.

summary: Ixhel pins a stammering aspirant who says he is Belaxis and has a contract with Lord Geth, whom he calls the Thane of Contracts.
quote: Lord Geth makes deals. That's why they call him the Thane of Contracts!

summary: Belaxis helps Ixhel crack the sound puzzle to open the gate and she gives him her name.
quote: The door flashes with a thin blue light, and the gate grinds open.

summary: Ixhel walks through Geth's holding, noting the many aspirants and incompleat creatures, and reaches his fortress and empty throne.
quote: you do see more aspirants than you have in a long time.

summary: Geth ambushes Ixhel, whom he mocks as a foot soldier, and speaks of loyalty that can be bought.
quote: The only true loyalty is that which can be bought.

summary: Geth asks what Ixhel will have beyond her orthodoxy and the love of her mother, and chokes her.
quote: What about you, little emissary?

summary: Ixhel opens her own throat on Geth's blade to break free and beheads him.
quote: you bring down your blade in a single stroke, parting his head from his body.

summary: Ixhel decides to help Geth's head and carries it to the Dominus of Pain.
quote: Maybe, in this, you can help him.

summary: Ixhel impales Belaxis on a spike of the Dominus of Pain, saying she is grateful.
quote: A piercing wail rings out across the wastes as you pin the writhing body in your arms down onto a razor-tipped spoke

summary: Ixhel uses the Surgical Bay to create a new being from the parts she took, and brings it to Atraxa.
quote: Except this time, you have made something.

summary: Atraxa reacts with disdain, and Ixhel admits she wanted to make something, and names her creation Vishgraz.
quote: His name is Vishgraz.

summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to get rid of it and leaves.
quote: Get rid of it,

summary: Ixhel realizes the new being carries Geth's head and her own wings, and tells him she wanted to save him.
quote: I wanted to save you,

summary: Ixhel brings Vishgraz to the Dross Pits shaft and tells him to go, and he urges her to come; she refuses and calls him her first defiance.
quote: You are my first defiance. Now go.

summary: Ixhel stays at the base of the shaft, feeling an ache to follow him, but does not.
quote: Deep in the center of you is an ache that wishes to follow him.

summary: Neyali takes stock of her weary cell on the edge of the Quiet Furnace, recalling how she searched alone with Otharri before gathering them.
quote: Now, people depended on her. Trusted her.

summary: Otharri screams a warning and Neyali realizes Reyana, the rear guard, is missing and races back.
quote: Neyali launched into motion before any of her cohorts could answer

summary: Neyali finds Reyana cornered by a compleated Auriok aspirant who offers to make her perfect; Reyana is distraught and has dropped her weapons.
quote: You are finally ready to be made perfect,

summary: Neyali and Otharri attack the aspirant and Neyali throws it over the ledge.
quote: The Phyrexian fell without so much as a cry.

summary: Reyana reveals the aspirant was her mother.
quote: Neyali, she was my mother.

summary: In the rookery, Reyana finds her clutch dead and confesses she once wished her mother dead and asks, what if Phyrexia is right?
quote: What if Phyrexia is right?

summary: Neyali promises to stay by Reyana's side, but Reyana does not complete their usual call and response.
quote: Reyana had not spoken her half of their usual call and response

summary: Reyana is gone in the morning, leaving only a note to meet at the Salvage Complex.
quote: Meet me at the Salvage Complex.

summary: Neyali, Elham, Saheena and her sons set off for the Salvage Complex, finding Mirran camps where loved ones vanished with no sign of force.
quote: that loved ones had gone missing, with no signs that they'd been taken by force.

summary: They find Reyana shackled in the Salvage Complex's pit among rows of kneeling dead Phyrexians, apparently unguarded.
quote: it was Reyana, shackled and prone.

summary: Neyali descends with Saheena and her sons, and Reyana frees herself from her chains and is revealed as a willing traitor.
quote: Reyana, no longer bound, sat up placidly

summary: Reyana says she wants the perfect peace her mother was given, and Slobad appears with an aspirant who is the father of Saheena's son.
quote: And you will be,

summary: Slobad offers to spare the other Mirrans if the four give themselves up, and Neyali bargains for her companions' release.
quote: I offer you a choice. You four,

summary: Neyali orders Saheena and her sons to go, and Slobad lets them leave, keeping Neyali.
quote: True to his word, Slobad and his minions did nothing

summary: Neyali is caged above as Slobad himself prepares to compleate Reyana.
quote: To Neyali's surprise, it was not a priest who came to begin Reyana's transformation but Slobad himself.

summary: Otharri returns and burns the cage bars, freeing Neyali and the other captured Mirrans while an alarm sounds.
quote: the firebird's flames incinerated the bars

summary: Neyali rallies the freed Mirrans and offers Reyana a hand, but Reyana turns away as Neyali leads her people out.
quote: Reyana turned away.

summary: Kaito, hit by a wall of electrostatic wind on entering New Phyrexia, lies hypnotized on the metal beach, sure it is paradise.
quote: New Phyrexia wasn't a peril, it was a paradise, and he should just relax and let it wash over him

summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

summary: Nahiri kills a Phyrexian construct by summoning the metal sand against it and driving her blade through it.
quote: She twisted once, and the shape beneath the mounded sand was still.

summary: Nahiri explains that a planar shield scattered the team on arrival, and that she shook off the sand's hypnosis because it is made of metal.
quote: we slammed into some sort of planar shield when we breached New Phyrexia

summary: Nahiri reveals a scratch on her neck and shows her blood still runs red, assuring Kaito she is fine.
quote: My blood's still red. No oil. I'll be fine.

summary: The group sets off across the metal desert toward the next landing zone, Nahiri warning that nothing Phyrexian can be trusted.
quote: You can't trust anything Phyrexian.

summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

summary: The freed statue reverts to flesh and introduces himself as Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.
quote: I am Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.

summary: The Wanderer finally flickers away, unable to stay on the plane, having seen Kaito out of the first danger.
quote: He turned to the Wanderer, intending to say something to boost her spirits and bolster her strength.

summary: The group reaches a Mirran camp where the healer Melira greets them, explaining that Koth told them the planeswalkers were coming.
quote: You're the ones Koth told us were coming. I'm Melira.

summary: Melira explains the Monumental Facade, the shell Phyrexia built around Mirrodin, and that the rest of the team should gather in the Furnace Layer.
quote: This is the Monumental Facade,

summary: Melira collapses a section of the Facade with explosive charges, dropping the group down to Mirrodin.
quote: the ground dropped out from under their feet

summary: Nahiri catches the falling earth with her magic and slows their descent to the ground.
quote: the lithomancer caught hold of them and slowed their descent

summary: Melira tells them she is immune to compleation and that is why the Resistance lets her roam unguarded.
quote: I'm immune. It's why the Resistance lets me move around without a guard

summary: The group leaps into the lacuna to descend toward the Furnace Layer.
quote: Nahiri leapt without hesitation, and Kaito jumped after her.

summary: Nahiri discovers the wound on her neck has become a slick Phyrexian protrusion and realizes she is infected, but decides to conceal it.
quote: She pulled her hand away with a hiss of dismay

summary: Nahiri resolves to hide the infection and get her companions as far as she can before she succumbs.
quote: it was best to get them as far as she possibly could before she succumbed

summary: The Wanderer returns to the razed camp too late and finds her companions gone.
quote: She had returned from the Blind Eternities too late, and they were lost.

summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

summary: Elspeth and Kaya descend through the lacuna with Kaya carrying a stray tanuki-shaped robot.
quote: From there, they had continued toward the white lacuna

summary: Elspeth and Kaya emerge from the lacuna into the Furnace Layer and spot the Mirran camp.
quote: True to its name, the Furnace Layer burned .

summary: Elspeth is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead.
quote: Koth, I thought you were dead!

summary: Kaya reunites with Tyvar and Jace, who explains the barrier broke the mindlink and the strike force is scattered.
quote: The barrier broke that link, along with so many other things.

summary: Jace says Nissa was shunted away by a trap, as if forced to planeswalk again.
quote: a trap shunted her away

summary: Kaya returns Kaito's sword to him and the tanuki drone leaps back to his shoulder.
quote: untying the blade and slapping the hilt into Kaito's palm

summary: Jace states that the plan stays the same: get the sylex to the base of the World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities.
quote: If we don't get the sylex to the base of their World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities, all the planes will share Mirrodin's fate.

summary: Melira reveals Elesh Norn calls the tree her Realmbreaker.
quote: Elesh Norn calls it her Realmbreaker.

summary: Elspeth, hearing Karn and Ajani are missing, notes that both know too much about the sylex.
quote: Ajani destroyed the last one.

summary: Melira demands honesty about what the sylex will do to Mirrodin, arguing her people have already survived the end of their plane.
quote: Your plane doesn't matter so much more than ours that I'm going to help you sacrifice what little we have left.

summary: Using Nahiri's stone shaping, Melira builds a model of Mirrodin's nested layers, showing the Seedcore at its center.
quote: This is the Seedcore,

summary: Melira explains the Mycosynth Gardens fungus and how Phyrexia took Mirrodin, and the Fair Basilica as Elesh Norn's stronghold.
quote: They seeded the center of our plane with fungus that pumped Phyrexian contamination into the air

summary: Koth explains the route down through the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay to land in the Dross Pits above the Fair Basilica.
quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.

summary: Koth describes the Mirrans' dire survival and resolve; Elspeth apologizes for leaving.
quote: As long as one of us is breathing, we'll keep fighting back.

summary: Jace admits he is not sure the plane will survive the sylex but says there is no time for a new plan.
quote: No. No, I'm not.

summary: Jace confesses the plan is to set off a bomb in the center of the plane, and Melira agrees to help provided they do not lie about the risk.
quote: We're setting off a bomb in the center of the plane.

summary: Koth introduces hexgold, a Mirran metal that protects somewhat against phyresis, and offers it for the team's gear.
quote: Our gear has been treated with a substance we call hexgold.

summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

summary: Kaito and Tyvar prepare their weapons with hexgold.
quote: breaking his sword into its individual throwing stars

summary: Koth announces he will join the descent with a demolition team as a backup if the sylex fails.
quote: I have a demolition team standing by to do what needs to be done if your sylex fails.

summary: Nahiri removes her bandage and reveals the Phyrexian spike growing from her neck; Melira, who suspected, confronts her.
quote: revealing the blunt, hardened spike growing there

summary: Nahiri cuts the spike open and tries hexgold powder, which fails to cure her.
quote: It didn't work,

summary: Melira offers to heal Nahiri but warns it would sideline her for days; Nahiri chooses to fight on, with Melira to heal her later.
quote: So we fight now, and I heal you later.

summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

summary: The carts plunge down the tunnel and Elspeth chats with the Mirran operators about the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay the team is bypassing.
quote: Vorinclex transported the worst of it beneath the surface during the great transformation

summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

summary: Koth explains the thanes of the Dross Pits, four of whom support Urabrask's rebellion, so the team can use the chaos for cover.
quote: Seven thanes rule the Dross Pits, but they've never been united.

summary: Elspeth distributes Halo, and Jace collapses after drinking his dose.
quote: the bottle slipping from his fingers before he collapsed backward onto the cart behind him

summary: Jace wakes and tries to run off, saying Vraska is in pain and calling to him.
quote: She made it down here, and she's alone and she's scared.

summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

summary: Jace uses illusions so that Phyrexians locked in civil war cannot see the group as they cross the battlefield.
quote: When they look at us, they see nothing at all,

summary: Koth identifies Sheoldred's Coliseum and reveals that he once escaped it.
quote: No one exits the coliseum alive and unchanged. I escaped. Mostly.

summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

summary: The group finds Vraska, gravely wounded and surrounded by Phyrexians.
quote: bleeding profusely from a dozen terrible wounds, stood Vraska.

summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

summary: Vraska tells Jace she is already infected and begs him to flee, saying she loves him.
quote: Run, Jace Beleren, and don't look back.

summary: Nahiri slices Jace's pack straps and Kaya snatches the sylex; the group leaves Jace and Vraska behind.
quote: Nahiri snapped her fingers.

summary: Jace casts an illusion of a sunny Ravnican avenue so that he and Vraska can spend one more day together.
quote: The coliseum was gone, replaced by a sundrenched Ravnican avenue

summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

summary: Vraska reveals Jace is also infected and kisses him as the illusion ends.
quote: You're as doomed as I am.

summary: Vraska, now loyal to Phyrexia, stabs Jace's hand with a scorpion-like tail dosing him with oil, and Jace flees.
quote: For the glory of Phyrexia,

summary: Nahiri exposes her infected neck and declares she will move the mission forward by force.
quote: The mission only goes forward if we move on .

summary: Nahiri, her infection spreading, cleaves the layer and drops the coliseum into the Fair Basilica.
quote: And then, with a vast and terrible shattering, she did precisely that, and everything fell into darkness.

summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

summary: Atraxa appears fighting Phyrexian invaders above the Fair Basilica.
quote: the gleaming, wide-winged form of Atraxa

summary: Jace, burned by Vraska's venom, asks for the sylex back, and Melira cannot heal him here.
quote: I'm not going to survive this as it stands, I may as well be the one to trigger the blast.

summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

summary: Lukka arrives in the wrong location on New Phyrexia, separated from the strike team, and recalls why he joined the mission.
quote: He wasn't with the rest of the strike team.

summary: Lukka decides to climb a tree in the Hunter Maze rather than planeswalk, hoping to dominate a creature to chart a route.
quote: No, he'd go high, try to make it back to the others.

summary: Lukka follows an angry cry and finds Nissa and the Wanderer fighting a Phyrexian construct on a bough.
quote: Lukka had seen them before: Nissa, and the woman was called . . . the Wanderer.

summary: Lukka uses the eludha to freeze a second Phyrexian creeping above them, saving Nissa and the Wanderer from an ambush.
quote: Lukka reached out with the eludha, the bond he could forge between himself and another creature.

summary: The Wanderer decapitates the first creature, then vanishes with a flicker of light.
quote: Then, with a strange flicker of light, the Wanderer vanished.

summary: Lukka proposes using the dominated Phyrexian as a guide and Nissa reluctantly agrees after he promises to kill it at any sign of trouble.
quote: if I get so much as a stomachache, I'll end the creature.

summary: Lukka and Nissa ride the centaur hulk up a tree, with Lukka irritated by Nissa's heels and recalling a childhood beating.
quote: Five to one.

summary: The Wanderer warns them of a Phyrexian monstrosity that attacks Nissa; the centaur hulk wraps wires around Lukka's spine and he kills the attacker with his harpoon.
quote: Veiny wires sprouted from its torso, plunging through his skin and wiggling through his gut to wrap around his spine.

summary: Intrusive thoughts begin whispering power and strength to Lukka as they climb higher through the canopy.
quote: You deserve power. You are strong. Here, strength is rewarded. The weak are culled.

summary: Lukka discovers Phyrexian rootlets still inside him, and instead of fear feels healthier and stronger.
quote: He felt healthier, stronger, more confident

summary: The group is attacked by leech-like creatures and a mother-beast; Lukka frees his Phyrexian by slicing through the mother-monstrosity with his now-metallic hands.
quote: He pulled apart a lip of flesh and freed his Phyrexian.

summary: Lukka notices a maggot-like wriggling and metal under a scab on his arm and feels no pain.
quote: A bone-deep wound, he marveled, and it didn't even hurt.

summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

summary: At the center of the maze they find Vorinclex sparring joyfully with Glissa.
quote: Vorinclex fought a Phyrexian elf beneath the monstrous skulls that hung from the ceiling.

summary: Lukka charges in against Glissa while Nissa fights Vorinclex.
quote: Without another word, Lukka charged in.

summary: Lukka merges with the Phyrexian centaur hulk, gaining a second set of arms and compleating.
quote: The Phyrexian flowed into him.

summary: Nissa, horrified, backs away as Lukka advances on her, and the Wanderer flickers in to shield her and tells her to run.
quote: Nissa, run!

summary: Glissa takes command of Lukka, ordering him to find but not kill Nissa, and Lukka sets out hunting.
quote: Find the elf, Lukka. But do not kill her.

summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

summary: Melira reveals Nahiri had asked for help at the Furnace, and that curing phyresis would have sidelined her for days.
quote: Repairing her body from the damage already done would have left her incapacitated for days.

summary: Jace says through telepathy that he will not risk the mission to save his own life.
quote: I'm not risking us all to save my own life, not when we've already lost Vraska.

summary: Kaito says he hopes Nahiri is dead rather than turned against them.
quote: I just hope she's dead,

summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

summary: Tyvar and Melira discuss how the corrupted World Tree should have split the plane, and Melira says Karn is imprisoned beneath it.
quote: Norn's tree is planted below in the Seedcore, where she imprisoned Karn.

summary: The group enters Elesh Norn's altar and finds it eerily unguarded, with Kaya suspecting a trap because Ajani may be helping the Phyrexians.
quote: He knows too much about us.

summary: The team descends into the Mycosynth Gardens, where Melira warns them not to touch the mycosynth.
quote: This is how Phyrexia took us in the first place.

summary: Melira leads them to the infectious gateway into the Seedcore.
quote: The gateway into the Seedcore. It infects anything it touches.

summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

summary: They emerge in the Seedcore and see Realmbreaker, the corrupted World Tree, for the first time.
quote: Kaya turned and beheld the Phyrexian World Tree. Realmbreaker.

summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

summary: Jace collapses and Tyvar carries him into the tree's root cavity.
quote: scooped the other man into his arms

summary: The group finds Karn vivisected and bound at the center of the root chamber.
quote: The great silver golem had been broken open, vivisected, and spread across the platform.

summary: Karn tells them the invasion is still young and that they must detonate the sylex at the root source.
quote: You will need to get to the root source and detonate it.

summary: Jace volunteers to take the sylex, saying it is too late for him too, and heads for the doorway with Tyvar and Kaya.
quote: Let me take the Multiverse from them.

summary: Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn while Elspeth goes on, refusing to run any more.
quote: No more running.

summary: The team sees the invasion ships being prepared and Phyrexians massing along gangways connected to the World Tree.
quote: Phyrexians shuffled along the gangways, readying their assault on the Multiverse.

summary: Compleated Ajani and Tibalt approach on the bridge, with Ajani urging Elspeth to join Phyrexia.
quote: came Ajani and Tibalt, but not as they had known them.

summary: Elspeth refuses to join Ajani, who invokes Phyrexia's promise of unity.
quote: All will be One.

summary: Tyvar confronts Tibalt and tells Kaito to take the others on to the root source.
quote: Elspeth and I will handle the vermin.

summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
quote: and the battle was joined.

summary: Jace, Kaito and Kaya descend through the miniature citadel in the Seedcore, with Jace visibly being overtaken by wires.
quote: Jace didn't look good.

summary: Kaito and Kaya remark on the eerily sterile absence of spirits in Phyrexia.
quote: Phyrexia didn't release its victims, not even in death.

summary: Through a skylight they see the invasion ships filling with Phyrexian warriors.
quote: endless ranks of Phyrexian warriors in the red and white of Elesh Norn's faction filing into the increasingly gravid holds

summary: Kaito finds a hole leading to a disk near Realmbreaker's trunk, and they drop down to the point nearest the root.
quote: This was as close as they were going to come to the core root of the tree.

summary: Jace unpacks the sylex for the first time in Phyrexian air.
quote: He moved to unpack the sylex, revealing it to the Phyrexian air for the first time.

summary: Kaya urges Jace to wait, warning the blast could travel through the Omenpaths to every connected plane.
quote: We could blow up the Blind Eternities.

summary: Jace refuses to wait, saying Vraska is dead and he is dying and that the sylex must be detonated.
quote: Vraska is dead, and I am dying,

summary: Kaya grabs Jace's wrist and, with Kaito, draws a weapon against him to stop him.
quote: She pulled a dagger from her belt.

summary: On the bridge, Ajani urges Elspeth to join Phyrexia, then attacks her with his axe.
quote: You do not need to be alive to join Phyrexia.

summary: Tibalt taunts Tyvar as they fight with Tibalt's twin barbed tails.
quote: How does it feel to be the last prince of Kaldheim?

summary: Tibalt's doubt overwhelms Elspeth, who is disarmed by Ajani and backs away.
quote: Ajani's next blow knocked the weapon from her hands

summary: Kaya discovers that the Jace she attacked is an illusion and that two of three Jaces are fakes.
quote: two of the Jaces didn't have spirits.

summary: Kaito hits Jace's arm with shuriken, dispelling the false images; Kaya moves on the sylex.
quote: Producing a handful of shuriken from inside his shirt, he flung them at the true Jace

summary: Elspeth's will returns, she blocks Ajani's blow, and Tyvar's magic suppresses Tibalt and the doubt he spreads.
quote: Your doubt can't touch what it can't reach.

summary: Elspeth blasts Ajani back with white light and knocks him unconscious.
quote: driving him to the ground

summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by driving his own tail barbs through his chest and throwing him from the bridge, as Elspeth runs to find the others.
quote: Tyvar driving the twin barbs of Tibalt's tail into the space that should have held the Phyrexian's heart.

summary: Kaya grabs what she thinks is the sylex, but it dissolves like mist because it was another of Jace's illusions.
quote: only for the sylex to dissolve in her hands like mist.

summary: Hidden by illusion, Jace pours his grief, Mirrodin's agony and his love for Vraska into the sylex and speaks the words to activate it.
quote: Wipe the land clear. Bring the ending,

summary: Elspeth drops through the ceiling and runs Jace through with her sword, taking the sylex.
quote: she drove her blade through Jace and shoved him aside

summary: Elspeth vanishes with the activated sylex, bound for a point beyond the Blind Eternities.
quote: The sylex went with her, bound for some unknown destination, some point beyond the Blind Eternities.

summary: Realmbreaker pulses and its branches wink out, carrying Phyrexian invaders through the Omenpaths to other planes.
quote: Each branch, with its heavy burden of Phyrexian invaders, had reached for another plane

summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
quote: and the invasion began.

summary: Tezzeret arrives at the Fair Basilica through the Planar Bridge carrying Rona's remains and demands to see Elesh Norn.
quote: I must see Mother,

summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

summary: Elesh Norn questions Tezzeret's love for her, while Tezzeret restrains his urge to kill her.
quote: One well-placed thrust of his sharpened arm could impale her head or take it right off.

summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

summary: Tezzeret asks for his promised darksteel body and collapses, and Norn declares a promise is a promise.
quote: A promise is a promise.

summary: Tezzeret wakes bound in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory, where Tamiyo was compleated.
quote: So it was happening. His reward, finally here.

summary: Jin-Gitaxias melts Tezzeret's etherium arm to bond his spine to the darksteel body.
quote: Tezzeret watched as the embodiment of his own exceptionalism melted into slag.

summary: Tezzeret's head and spine are transferred into the darksteel body and he has a vision of a clock and an island of metal.
quote: Then his head and spine were separated from his body

summary: Tezzeret awakens in his new body but cannot planeswalk because the slab is inlaid with silver.
quote: Tezzeret had fallen into the same trap.

summary: Jin-Gitaxias reveals a new Reality Chip and says he knows of Urabrask and the Mirran attacks and will let them unfold.
quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

summary: Tezzeret uses a telemin bond to take control of a captive scrapchief in a tank.
quote: Give me control , Phyrexian , thought Tezzeret.

summary: Tezzeret smashes the tank and the slab through the scrapchief, but Jin-Gitaxias kills it, so Tezzeret planeswalks away.
quote: Tezzeret planeswalked away.

summary: Tezzeret arrives in Tidehollow, the slum where he grew up, and laughs.
quote: For Tezzeret, there was only one word associated with Tidehollow that truly resonated.

summary: Tezzeret drives off a gang of children by animating a knife into its owner's hand, leaving the boy Estel behind.
quote: he turned, stood, and cast a spell to animate the knife in the leader's hand

summary: Tezzeret retrieves his mother's box of etherium from the ruins of his childhood home.
quote: This was his mother's handiwork, the last remnant of the hobby that gave her solace amid the squalor.

summary: Phyrexians break through the cave ceiling, invading Tidehollow.
quote: Bone-white metal. The Phyrexians had arrived.

summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.

summary: Tezzeret leaves for the Blind Eternities in his father's cloak as Tidehollow is slaughtered.
quote: A fitting goodbye

summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

summary: Nashi shoots Tezzeret in Towashi's undercity and demands to know where Tamiyo is.
quote: Tell me where she is.

summary: Tezzeret turns on Nashi's gang and crushes their motorbikes.
quote: lifting the bikes into the air and then slamming them together with a gruesome crunch

summary: Tezzeret tells the wounded Nashi that his mother still lives and will come for him.
quote: Your mother still lives.

summary: Tezzeret finds Baltrice's safehouse behind a gaming parlor and gathers supplies.
quote: Inside, he found exactly what he was looking for.

summary: Tezzeret travels to the ruins of his tower and resolves to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.
quote: Then—and only then—would he make his move.

summary: Teferi wakes on a beach after a dreamlike conversation with Urza, with only memories of Urza saying their time was up.
quote: I think our time is up,

summary: Teferi realizes he is no longer connected to Kaya and cannot planeswalk.
quote: summoned up the familiar movement of a planeswalk and found nothing

summary: Teferi sleeps and dreams of Kroog, Argoth, and the Phyrexian stabbing him, and of Subira no longer wandering.
quote: The cold pressure when the Phyrexian stabbed him.

summary: Teferi uses time magic on the path and sees the beach decline from joyful to fearful and then empty, realizing he is in Zhalfir.
quote: reached into time, pulling history from the dust

summary: Teferi realizes he is back in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years earlier.
quote: Nearly four hundred years later, he was back in Zhalfir.

summary: Teferi steps out in front of a caravan and is held at spearpoint by its guards.
quote: had Teferi surrounded and at spearpoint within the minute

summary: Teferi lies to the guard leader that he was attacked by bandits.
quote: I was attacked by bandits

summary: Eshe introduces herself and Teferi gives a false name.
quote: I am Eshe.

summary: Teferi reads Eshe's memory of the dead comrades, learning that the guards are themselves bandits who killed ten.
quote: he channeled a subtle spell and pulled the answer from Eshe's memory

summary: A frightened caravanner warns Teferi that the guards are bandits, and Eshe realizes who he is.
quote: She knew who he was.

summary: Eshe speaks of Zhalfir's generations of war and loss and accuses a snake among them.
quote: Every one of us here is linked in grief,

summary: Eshe names Teferi as the snake who escaped Zhalfir's suffering.
quote: Here is Teferi, the snake.

summary: Eshe thrusts her spear at Teferi's heart and he freezes time.
quote: She lifted her spear, coiled her strength, and thrust for his heart.

summary: In frozen time, Teferi tells the slowed Eshe about Subira and his guilt for sending Zhalfir away.
quote: I loved a caravanner once,

summary: Teferi vows to see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.
quote: I will see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.

summary: Teferi demonstrates blue mana and resumes time, and Eshe tells him to go away.
quote: summoning up a fearsome blue light

summary: Teferi leaves the caravan alone, and Eshe departs in the opposite direction.
quote: Teferi went away, hurrying down the road, alone.

summary: Months later, Teferi works with villagers hauling a fishing net and speaks with Oyana, who calls him the father of Zhalfir.
quote: You are the father of Zhalfir.

summary: Teferi says no one can stop the Phyrexians, and Oyana withdraws.
quote: No one can stop them. Not even the brave.

summary: Teferi tries to reach Kaya through the creedhall's mana well and gets no answer.
quote: Can you hear me?

summary: Adia tells Teferi that soldiers from Kipamu are looking for him because of the war.
quote: Soldiers from Kipamu came looking for you.

summary: Teferi is reunited with the general Jabari, who has come to bring him to the queen.
quote: I am just Teferi Akosa now, Jabari,

summary: Jabari reveals another outsider has come to Zhalfir and asked for Teferi.
quote: You are not the only one from outside to come here.

summary: Teferi recognizes the described woman and her hat as the Wanderer.
quote: Not just any wanderer: the Wanderer.

summary: Adia gives Teferi mended robes and confesses she fears that return to the world means war will truly begin.
quote: I'm not so sure that Zhalfir returning to the world is a good thing

summary: Teferi recalls freezing his daughter Niambi in time and then catching her, deciding to stand with Zhalfir rather than stop the fall.
quote: he had frozen her in time, arresting her mid-fall

summary: Teferi tells Adia that Zhalfir is not just war and cannot stop what is coming but can control what follows.
quote: We are not bound by fate,

summary: Teferi, Jabari and the recruits reach Aku and learn Kaervek has escaped and General Mageta is wounded.
quote: Kaervek has escaped,

summary: Teferi sees the warding pendulum snapped and the floor shattered in the central dome of the Amber Tombs.
quote: With horror, Teferi saw that the pendulum had snapped

summary: Queen Wezna confronts Teferi and demands why she should not carry out his sentence; he answers that if she kills him, they will win.
quote: they will win.

summary: Queen Wezna orders Jabari to lead the army while General Mageta recovers.
quote: You will lead the army until he recovers.

summary: Queen Wezna tosses Teferi an amber prison holding the frozen Wanderer.
quote: Small, frozen in time, likely moments after planeswalking, a warrior mid-strike.

summary: A creed leader breaks the amber prison and the Wanderer is freed.
quote: the prison snapped, bursting open with a sharp report

summary: The Wanderer learns she has been in Zhalfir a month, and Teferi reasons the anchor failed.
quote: The anchor failed,

summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
quote: New Phyrexia's invasion is upon us,

summary: Teferi resolves that it is not too late and vows to show the Phyrexians that the sun rises in Zhalfir.
quote: It's not too late,

summary: Norn confronts three captive planeswalkers, Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar, who defy her offer.
quote: Behold the glory of New Phyrexia.

summary: Norn summons portals to five planes where Realmbreaker's limbs anchor and release pods of Phyrexian forces.
quote: Realmbreaker's massive, barb-tipped limbs burst forth, anchoring themselves wherever they please.

summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

summary: Norn has Nahiri encase the three planeswalkers in stone and tells them to be her prophets.
quote: You shall be the prophets of our coming,

summary: Norn orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred for craving power over unity, and he beheads her.
quote: Sheoldred's head bounces to a stop at her feet

summary: Norn lets the captive planeswalkers escape deliberately so they can spread her gospel.
quote: Elesh Norn counts on them escaping.

summary: Norn announces the evangels will unite their homelands and asks Nahiri where she was born.
quote: we have decided to grant you the honor of uniting your homelands.

summary: Norn has Nissa show Zendikar's forests and a Skyclave, and Nahiri vows to wake the weapon.
quote: I can wake it once more to enact our will.

summary: Nahiri departs for Zendikar.
quote: In three steps, she winks out of existence

summary: Norn sends Lukka to Ikoria to add its monsters to Phyrexian ranks, warning him of the price of failure.
quote: Go to Ikoria. Add these monsters to our ranks.

summary: Tamiyo and Atraxa discuss Lukka's likely fate and Norn's strategy.
quote: Either way Phyrexia is served.

summary: Norn shows Tamiyo the night-lit city of Kamigawa and asks whether she still loves it and her family.
quote: Do you still care for your family?

summary: Realmbreaker pierces Kamigawa's city as Tamiyo watches a mother save her children, and a man in black deflects falling tiles.
quote: Realmbreaker pierces the earth.

summary: Tamiyo falters when told to welcome the old into the new, and Atraxa reprimands her.
quote: Insolence isn't tolerated here. You were given a command.

summary: Norn commands Tamiyo to return with Kamigawa under her control or be recycled.
quote: Return with Kamigawa under your control or be recycled into something that serves better.

summary: Ajani correctly guesses Theros is his destination, a first-wave target.
quote: You want to see Theros.

summary: Phyrexian forces rain onto Theros, devouring livestock and humans.
quote: It starts the same as it did on Kamigawa

summary: Norn orders Ajani to bring a guardian god of Theros within Phyrexia's embrace and to bring priests and the Argent Etchings.
quote: Bring priests with you,

summary: Ajani departs for Theros while Norn hides her real reason for sending him.
quote: he did not discover the real reason she'd sent him to Theros.

summary: Norn tells Atraxa about the Phyrexian ship sealed away by angels on New Capenna and shows her the city.
quote: Angels. False prophets bound to stone for their insolence,

summary: Norn orders Atraxa to harvest New Capenna and destroy the wellspring of Halo.
quote: You will harvest them all.

summary: Norn reveals a danger to New Phyrexia exists on New Capenna and Theros, which Atraxa and Ajani must seal.
quote: In killing New Capenna, we strike at her heart.

summary: Left alone, Norn calls attendants to recite her teachings to drive away her nightmares of the woman in white.
quote: Elesh Norn forgets her nightmares

summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.
quote: For two weeks they'll wait here in one of Liliana's cabins on Dominaria.

summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
quote: Jaya's dead, Ajani killed her

summary: Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

summary: Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar report that Phyrexia has corrupted the World Tree and is using it to invade the planes.
quote: They're using it to invade the other planes.

summary: Kaya tells Chandra that the Phyrexians got Nissa.
quote: They got Nissa.

summary: The survivors reveal Jace did not return, having become one of them, and Nahiri was taken.
quote: He became one of them,

summary: Kaya explains that Elspeth ran Jace through and took the sylex into the Blind Eternities.
quote: Elspeth ran him through, picked up the sylex and planeswalked into the Blind Eternities.

summary: Liliana leaves to send word to Strixhaven, rejecting the story of noble sacrifice.
quote: I'm going to send word to Strixhaven.

summary: Chandra proposes returning to New Phyrexia to take down the World Tree, and Kaya, Vivien, Tyvar and Kaito refuse.
quote: There must be some other way to take the World Tree down.

summary: Kaya forbids Chandra from going, warning she would be compleated.
quote: I can't let you go back.

summary: Chandra erupts in anger when told to abandon people stuck on New Phyrexia and leaves.
quote: I'm not leaving our friends behind.

summary: Chandra confronts Liliana, who says she knows funeral bells and leaves in a blink of inky vapor.
quote: I just know funeral bells when I hear them.

summary: Chandra walks into the marsh and weeps, afraid to planeswalk alone to New Phyrexia.
quote: Going to New Phyrexia is the right thing to do.

summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven leave to head for New Phyrexia while unseen watchers observe them.
quote: Let's head out.

summary: Unseen watchers declare they are there to witness the beginning of the end.
quote: We are here to witness the beginning of the end.

summary: Tamiyo hovers over Towashi, removing the iron ring from the scroll she wrote and reading it as the Phyrexian assault begins.
quote: Hovering over the neon skies of Towashi, she holds the scroll in hand.

summary: Tamiyo reads the story of Urza, Karn and Memnarch, and her words shake Towashi, collapsing buildings and etching Phyrexian symbols.
quote: Each syllable she reads booms and reverberates, shaking the skyscrapers of Towashi.

summary: Boseiju bursts apart and oil pours from it, killing and dissolving the kami.
quote: Boseiju, the tree that once held this plane together, bursts apart.

summary: The scroll turns to oil in Tamiyo's hands as the story ends with Phyrexia's victory.
quote: This is how the story ends, and how it has always ended: with Phyrexia's victory.

summary: Kaya helps Kaito defend Kamigawa and phases through a wall to find a trapped boy and his dog.
quote: A young boy and his dog quiver in the corner on the other side.

summary: Kaya pulls the boy and dog free and leaps with them from a collapsing building, but the balcony falls away.
quote: Kaya, the boy, and the dog plummet.

summary: Kaito saves Kaya and the boy by slowing their fall with telekinesis.
quote: His telekinesis is barely holding them up

summary: Kaito tells Kaya that Tamiyo has opened the scroll and is destroying Boseiju.
quote: And worse, Tamiyo did it. Opened a scroll.

summary: Kaito starts to climb Boseiju to confront Tamiyo and meets Nashi, who asks to try to reach his mother.
quote: That's my mom up there.

summary: Kaito gives Nashi a repulsor and they climb Boseiju together toward Tamiyo.
quote: Walk in the direction you want to go.

summary: Nashi calls to Tamiyo, who answers with his name before her body snaps around and she attacks.
quote: A shard of metal shoots toward them

summary: Tamiyo urges Nashi to join Phyrexia, and Kaito tells him to retreat as they fight.
quote: In the light of New Phyrexia, all are one.

summary: Tamiyo overpowers Kaito with scrolls and hangs him above Towashi, offering him surrender.
quote: Kaito flips feet over head before he knows what's happened, dangling far above Towashi.

summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
quote: it's the emperor.

summary: The Wanderer confronts Tamiyo, who holds Nashi and takes out the scroll bound by an iron band.
quote: Tamiyo reaches for a scroll at her waist, one bound with an iron band.

summary: Empowered by Kyodai, the Wanderer cuts Tamiyo down.
quote: Tamiyo falls.

summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

summary: Tamiyo's memory, a being of floating characters, speaks and reveals she was sealed in the scroll for such a death.
quote: I am what remains of Tamiyo—her story unending.

summary: The Wanderer explains that Tamiyo's last act was a request that her missed shards and mouthed words showed, so the memory is true.
quote: Tamiyo was making a request, in the only way she could.

summary: Imperial forces with giant mechs gather to counter the Phyrexian assault as Kaito reflects that Tamiyo fell but Nashi lived.
quote: Tamiyo fell—but Nashi lived.

summary: Tyvar returns to Skemfar to find it under Phyrexian attack, with a serpent strangling the World Tree and pods raining down.
quote: he knows he is too late

summary: Tyvar tells his brother Harald that the enemies are Phyrexians who will oil and transform the elves, and that Kaldheim cannot be saved by elves alone.
quote: This isn't an enemy the elves can vanquish alone.

summary: The Cosmos opens a doomskar, swallowing Phyrexians and elves, and Tyvar shapes a rock platform amid the water.
quote: torrents of water emerge

summary: Longships of all Kaldheim's peoples arrive and Harald rallies the elves to join them.
quote: The elves will lead it!

summary: Tyvar and Harald board a longship, and Harald addresses the united warriors with an oath of old grudges.
quote: Our grudges are ancient.

summary: The fleet passes through the Cosmos and flies toward the Invasion Tree with valkyries.
quote: Valkyries fly alongside them toward the sharp barbs of the Invasion Tree

summary: A Phyrexian serpent rises from the sea, snapping longships, and Tyvar leaps into its mouth.
quote: Tyvar leaps from the ship.

summary: Pia recalls Saheeli's warning of an invasion and the Phyrexian eye symbol appearing everywhere.
quote: We have to be ready for an invasion,

summary: Pia and Saheeli address the consulate and prepare Ghirapur, evacuating citizens and arming skyships.
quote: If Pia allocated the resources to fight, then fight they would.

summary: The portals open and the invasion spines descend onto Kaladesh.
quote: the great spines of invasion descended from the holes they tore in reality

summary: A branch wraps around Ghirapur's flagship and destroys it.
quote: She watches as the branch wraps around the ship

summary: Saheeli's Operation Golden Scales deploys bronze lizards that clash with Phyrexian soldiers, and she rescues Pia.
quote: Deployment chambers spring up from hatches all along the street

summary: Saheeli and Pia race to the reservoir, noting the Phyrexians are heading there and that converted guards cannot yet be saved.
quote: We can't do anything to save them,

summary: Saheeli evades telling Pia what happened to Chandra.
quote: Pia's been around politicians long enough to know when she isn't getting the whole story.

summary: Baji offers his skimmer and Pia boards it, but a Phyrexian quill kills him and the skimmer plummets with Pia at the controls.
quote: a javelin punches through the window and impales him through the chest to his seat

summary: Atraxa begins scouring New Capenna, destroying its inhabitants with swarms and gas.
quote: A single thought from Atraxa summons swarms of flying servitors.

summary: Atraxa searches the minds of compleated Maestros and learns the word beautiful and museum.
quote: Searching their minds provides another answer: museum .

summary: Atraxa destroys the museum and its art, enraged at the idea of beauty.
quote: she obliterates everything within it

summary: Atraxa beheads stone angel statues outside the cathedral despite the pain of Halo.
quote: In a blur of white, she strikes the heads from the statues.

summary: The angel statues, with an unseen visitor, choose not to stop Atraxa, saying it is not yet time.
quote: It is not yet time.

summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

summary: Quint summons the spirit of Dean Herrian the Second from a statue, who reveals they are directly under the Biblioplex.
quote: How can you be lost when you're under the Biblioplex?

summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

summary: A dwarf student calls for help and is dragged away by a compleated figure, and Quint's cry draws Dean Shaile's attention.
quote: Dean Shaile's head abruptly swiveled around.

summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

summary: Dean Shaile seizes Killian, demanding the whereabouts of his father.
quote: Where is your father?

summary: Dean Embrose Lu arrives in a storm of ink that melts compleated professors and rescues Killian.
quote: Dean Embrose Lu landed beside them.

summary: Embrose flings the students out of the fight so they can find the invocation, and Killian sends him supportive words.
quote: And without warning lashes of black whipped around the students' torsos

summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
quote: No talking in the library!

summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

summary: The ritual's overload turns the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree that smashes through the ceiling.
quote: and kept growing , boughs forming a perfect helix of steps

summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

summary: Dean Nassari shatters Rootha's ice wall and attacks her, making her petal go dark and the invocation fail.
quote: The invocation was failing

summary: Quint grabs Rootha's petal and pours his life into the invocation to complete it.
quote: he powered the invocation with his life alone

summary: A light erupts from Quint, wrecking the Biblioplex and Dean Nassari, closing the portals and swallowing Quint.
quote: Dean Nassari was flung from the rooftop

summary: The students emerge from the dormitory to ruin, with Liliana directing survivors and tending the wounded.
quote: but ruin

summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
quote: but alive, and himself.

summary: Dina reports that Quint vanished in a burst of light, and Liliana wonders if he sparked.
quote: If Quint's spark ignited, he could still be alive

summary: Liliana raises an undead army to hold the ruins against the returning Phyrexian portals.
quote: Skeletons and zombies erupted from the ground

summary: Jirina leads Drannith's survivors along the terror road toward Lavabrink while Colonel Bryd urges sending soldiers ahead.
quote: Perhaps it would be wise to send a detachment of soldiers ahead, to prepare Lavabrink for our arrival.

summary: Bryd questions trusting Vivien, and Jirina rejects his suspicion; then an attack on the column begins.
quote: I won't have you discarding one of our strongest on baseless paranoia!

summary: Vivien and Chevill's hunters prepare an ambush with buried explosives in a canyon, expecting Lukka.
quote: she and Chevill were the only thing standing between those people and their doom.

summary: A vantasaur flees the canyon, is dragged back and consumed by something unseen.
quote: before all thirty tons were dragged violently backward out of sight

summary: Phyrexian Lukka emerges from the canyon, a titan of absorbed flesh with Lukka embedded at its center.
quote: At its center protruded—not a man, anymore, not quite, but Lukka.

summary: Vivien recalls she persuaded Lukka to go to New Phyrexia and that the titan absorbs creatures through his twisted eludha.
quote: it was Vivien who had convinced him to go to New Phyrexia with the strike team.

summary: The titan triggers buried mines and plunges its leg into lava, and Chevill's hunters attack with poisoned arrows and spears.
quote: They loosed a stinging cloud of arrows, peppering the Lukka-thing's flank

summary: Vivien's first arrow is blocked by bone, and the titan tears free of the hunters' ropes and kills many of them.
quote: with a sweep of one misshapen arm, the giant cleared them from the scrubland

summary: Vivien summons a spectral dreadmaw through her arkbow, but the titan destroys it and escapes the lava.
quote: The dreadmaw simply dissolved

summary: Chevill refuses to follow, saying they have lost, but Vivien holds him back and fires an arrow into the sky as a signal of failure.
quote: before twisting her body and shooting it straight into the sky

summary: Phyrexian cats attack Jirina's Coppercoats and Jirina kills one with her sword.
quote: almost severing the head entirely

summary: A tigorilla and Haldan save Jirina from a second cat, and the tigorilla's crystals burn off Phyrexian oil.
quote: the Phyrexian oil bubbled and hissed, turning to a sickly black smoke

summary: Jirina sees Vivien's green signals and knows the ambush failed and Lukka is still coming.
quote: That was the signal. They had failed. Lukka was still coming.

summary: Jirina deliberately changes the column's course to a path that does not lead to Lavabrink, silencing Haldan's warning about whose territory it is.
quote: If you want to make it to nightfall alive, you'll say nothing.

summary: The refugees enter a basin of volcanic glass with no exit, realizing they are not at Lavabrink.
quote: there seemed to be no other road or pass out.

summary: Phyrexian Lukka climbs into the basin and announces in a thousand voices that Drannith's prodigal son has returned to offer Phyrexian unity.
quote: DRANNITH! TRAITOR-CITY! YOUR PRODIGAL SON HAS RETURNED FOR YOU.

summary: Vivien climbs a cliff and sees Vadrok swoop down to attack the titan, revealing the basin as Vadrok's nest.
quote: We're in its nest.

summary: Vadrok burns away much of the titan with blue flame and pulls Lukka out of it.
quote: Struggling now in Vadrok's jaws was Lukka .

summary: Vivien shoots Lukka in the chest with several arrows as he hangs in Vadrok's jaws, killing him.
quote: She pulled back one more spectral arrow and put it in the center of his chest.

summary: Jirina watches Vadrok toss Lukka's corpse aside and burn what remains of the titan.
quote: So passes the captain of the Specials

summary: Vivien steps in front of the survivors to keep Vadrok from attacking them, and Vadrok flies away.
quote: Then it was aloft again

summary: Haldan and the crowd accuse Jirina of using them as bait, and Jirina defends that she had no other way.
quote: In war, there are no certainties,

summary: Vivien tells the survivors to survive what is coming, as another Phyrexian branch descends behind the mountains.
quote: A branch, Vivien had called them

summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
quote: Urabrask serves no one.

summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

summary: Chandra realizes the platform belongs to Nissa and agrees to the plan.
quote: Let's do it,

summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

summary: Chandra lands hard on the tree and Wrenn prepares to bond while centurions form around them.
quote: Plates along the tree shift and reform.

summary: Centurions speak with one woman's voice and spears pin Chandra to the tree while Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn.
quote: Green magic crackles around her metallic body, her four arms all acting as conduits.

summary: Chandra recognizes the Phyrexian figure as Nissa.
quote: Even with two new arms grafted onto her body

summary: Nissa tears Seven apart and drops Wrenn, saying she no longer feels pain.
quote: I no longer feel any pain.

summary: Nissa reveals the Mother of Machines sent her to stop Chandra, whose plan has already failed.
quote: The Mother of Machines sent me to stop you.

summary: Nissa offers to save Chandra by joining Phyrexia, and Chandra sees a vast Phyrexian army across the bridge.
quote: There is an army on the other side of the bridge.

summary: Chandra realizes Norn knew about the resistance all along and that it was a trap.
quote: The whole time they'd been here, she knew what was going on.
