summary: Nissa has copper branches seize Wrenn, whom she calls a fine guardian for Realmbreaker.
quote: You will make a fine guardian for Realmbreaker,

summary: Wrenn signals Chandra as flames glow within her, unnoticed by Norn.
quote: Flames flicker within her pale body.

summary: In Nissa's own voice, she tells Chandra she misses her and begs her to come, and Chandra is tempted.
quote: Please, come with us. I miss you.

summary: Chandra refuses, and Nissa's face turns to rage.
quote: I miss you so much. But I can't. I'm sorry.

summary: Chandra drives her fiery fist into the branch, blowing the platform apart and flinging herself and Nissa away while Wrenn clings to the tree.
quote: Chandra ducks below Nissa's slicing arm and drives her fiery fist into the branch itself.

summary: Huatli waits atop the Winged Temple while Orazca burns and Ixalan is wreathed in fire.
quote: Huatli, alone, stood atop the Winged Temple of Orazca

summary: Hours before, Huatli's company and the auxiliaries shelter in a barricaded hall, and Inti urges them to go.
quote: I'm not confident the barricade or this hall will hold.

summary: Huatli tells Mavren the trap was part of her plan, since bait is necessary when hunting a great beast.
quote: Bait is necessary.

summary: The Sun Empire storms Fortress Leor, taking ships it will copy for an invasion of Torrezon.
quote: The empire moved in, taking Leor and splitting the Legion forces of Queen's Bay in half.

summary: A branch of Realmbreaker splits the sky over the Sun Coast and Phyrexians invade Ixalan.
quote: revealing a hideous, colossal metal branch of Realmbreaker, the Invasion Tree

summary: The Phyrexians end the emperor's war and the Threefold Sun does not rise again.
quote: The Phyrexians came to Ixalan and ended the emperor's war in its cradle.

summary: In the imperial war room, the emperor learns his fleet of ten thousand is lost and Caparocti warns of unnatural storms.
quote: Where is my navy,

summary: Commanders report the collapse of the empire's defenses as Phyrexians ring Pachatupa.
quote: This was not a war: it was a collapse, seeking its end point.

summary: Huatli proposes calling the elder dinosaurs to Orazca to draw the Phyrexians from Pachatupa.
quote: I will call the elder dinosaurs to Orazca,

summary: The emperor silences Caparocti's objections and approves Huatli's gambit.
quote: Your desire to protect the heart of our empire is admirable, but be silent.

summary: Huatli's company and released vampire auxiliaries leave Pachatupa along the river while the army stages a diversion.
quote: A diversion, a furious barrage and single attempt at breaking the Phyrexian encirclement.

summary: Mavren demands freedom as a reward, and Huatli says they never made a bargain.
quote: We never made a bargain,

summary: At Orazca, scouts report a route to the temple and Temilo, a garrisoned soldier, joins them.
quote: We have a route to the temple.

summary: Etali, an elder dinosaur turned by Phyrexia, appears on the horizon with a roar and a storm.
quote: On the horizon opposite them, at the lip of the bowl in which Orazca was built, stood Etali, one of the elder dinosaurs.

summary: Huatli sees that nothing of Ixalan is left in Etali and flees with the company to Temilo's garrison.
quote: Etali was the storm. The Phyrexians had turned the elder dinosaur

summary: Huatli rejects the idea of being mere survivors and resolves to fight to the top of the Winged Temple to call the elders.
quote: Then we will fight to the top and call upon the elders.

summary: Inti, Mavren and the company hold the temple gate as Huatli climbs three hundred steps to the recitation chamber.
quote: We'll hold the gate,

summary: A flood of Phyrexians climbs the temple's steps toward the line.
quote: In ones and twos, they started up the lowest steps of the temple

summary: In a memory, Huatli tells Saheeli the story of the warrior-poet Yolotzin and tells her it will be alright.
quote: What we face is no different than what she faced

summary: Huatli recites to the hurricane and the powers of Ixalan, asking them to stand against the end.
quote: Huatli spoke to the hurricane.

summary: Etali's storm falters and the company's line holds against the Phyrexians.
quote: The storm faltered.

summary: Zetalpa, elder of dawn, pierces Etali's hurricane and slams into him, banishing the night.
quote: the titanic silhouette of Zetalpa, the elder of dawn, pierced Etali's hurricane

summary: Tetzimoc, Ghalta and Nezahal answer Huatli's call and tear through the Phyrexians in the streets.
quote: Nezahal wrapped the giant up from legs to wrists

summary: Huatli finds Inti wounded and Mavren having carried him from the line.
quote: A blood-slick and oil-stained Mavren limped toward Huatli, dragging a wounded Inti with him.

summary: Zacama, the last and greatest elder, arrives and her roar disintegrates the Phyrexian front ranks.
quote: Zacama, the final and greatest of the elders, loomed up from the shadows

summary: Zacama kills the turned Etali by tearing off his head.
quote: Zacama tore his head from his body, then flung it into the city below.

summary: Zacama acknowledges Huatli before departing, and the sun breaks through over Orazca.
quote: Dawn had arrived: the day, though not yet won, was here.

summary: Rankle's fellow faeries pretend to crown him, then trap him in a net and tell him nobody wants him there.
quote: "Nobody wants you here," Mags said.

summary: Rankle tries to attack when released; the faeries beat him and Mags pins and tears his wing, leaving him unable to fly.
quote: Rankle's wing was in tatters.

summary: Rankle is expelled from the glade and resolves to rob the first human he sees.
quote: He vowed to rob the first human that he saw.

summary: Chulane warns the villagers about the bruise-like sky and signs of evil, and they mock him and throw stones.
quote: "Something terrible is about to befall us!"

summary: Rankle follows Chulane and sees floating Locthwain Castle and Queen Ayara's procession.
quote: this was his first glimpse of the floating castle

summary: Chulane begs Queen Ayara for a word, and she invites him into her carriage to tell her everything.
quote: "Well, come inside and tell me everything."

summary: Rankle glimpses Ayara's face, is smitten, and decides he must become her next husband.
quote: He must become Ayara's next husband.

summary: Rankle goes to the charm shop in Edgewall, smashes potions and demands a love potion from the hidden witch.
quote: Rankle smashed the bottle on the floor.

summary: The witch freezes Rankle in mid-air, says she is leaving to join forces against the coming doom, and offers him a choice; he chooses the quest for a love flower.
quote: "We're joining forces to fight the doom that's coming."

summary: Rankle finds no flowers in the murky forest and heads back, nearly trampled by fleeing elk.
quote: a herd of elk burst out of the thicket and nearly trampled him

summary: A Phyrexian dog attacks Rankle and Torbran kills it with his axe.
quote: he opened his eyes and saw the beast in two halves and a red-bearded dwarf yanking his axe out of the carnage

summary: Torbran tells Rankle the courts have fallen and that they must stand at Locthwain; Rankle sees this as a chance to reach Ayara.
quote: "The courts have fallen," the dwarf said in a quivery voice.

summary: Rankle transforms Torbran's ring into a caterpillar and steals it while he sleeps.
quote: The ring had transformed into a caterpillar.

summary: Rankle uses the ring to wish for a basket of cookies and then a love potion, refusing to return it.
quote: "I wish for a love potion!" Rankle interrupted.

summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

summary: Rankle hands over the ring but wishes the love potion to rain down, and a chasm opens as the pink rain falls on the horde.
quote: Instantly, the skies opened, and drops of pink rain began to fall.

summary: Lovestruck by the rain, the Phyrexian legions chase Rankle and pour over the edge into the chasm.
quote: Wave after wave followed him, pouring over the edge like lovestruck lemmings.

summary: A spell of many voices puts everyone in the chasm to sleep, and Rankle drifts down onto a throne of his fallen admirers.
quote: Rankle could see that everyone in the chasm had fallen into an unnatural sleep.

summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

summary: Bored at the Engelturm, Gisa watches Phyrexians shamble out of the Silburlind River.
quote: A small group of bipedal figures shambled out of the Silburlind River

summary: A Phyrexian cuts one of Gisa's ghouls in two with an oil-slick sword, and Gisa sends her dead to attack them.
quote: All around her, the dead she had risen for her own amusement turned toward the cluster on the shore.

summary: Gisa's ghouls destroy the group, but a Phyrexian corpse she raises collapses lifeless the moment her attention wanders; this has never happened to her before.
quote: This had never happened to her before.

summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

summary: Geralf sends his grotesque creations, including exploding winged turtles, to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.
quote: A wave of terrible creations swarmed over the walls of Havengul to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.

summary: Gisa draws in the death of Innistrad and calls a moondrake and ghouls from the estuary muck.
quote: the undead moondrake she had called from the muck rose, majestic, into the sky.

summary: A Phyrexian moondrake rises, and Gisa's moondrake kills it in the air and on the ground, spoiling a Phyrexian plan.
quote: her drake ripped the other's head clean off

summary: A second Phyrexian force approaches overland past the Engelturm, and Gisa complains it is cheating.
quote: "I said three-way, not four-way,"

summary: Geralf stitches skaabs at frantic speed in his hidden laboratory as Havengul falls, and his skaabs bring in a massive beast.
quote: a group of the skaabs he'd set to gathering raw materials entered, half-carrying and half-dragging a massive beast.

summary: Geralf's antlered behemoth steps over the city wall and tramples Phyrexians.
quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

summary: Not to be outdone, Gisa sings up a colossal chitinous beast from the bottom of the estuary, and it wades into the Phyrexians.
quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

summary: Geralf asks Gisa to give up her broken sea-beast so his skaabs can retrieve both monsters, and Gisa, after a tantrum, agrees on condition he owes her.
quote: If your creations can drag it back to your lab, I'll let it go. But you'll owe me!

summary: Geralf stitches the behemoth and sea-beast together in a city square, believing it will be his masterpiece.
quote: Grabbing the drill he would need to create seams through the beast's chitinous armor, he grinned to himself and set to work.

summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

summary: The siblings burn dead Phyrexians in a bonfire and bicker over who won the game; Geralf notes the fused beast has collapsed.
quote: "Neither of us won," Gisa snapped.

summary: Elspeth wakes inside a memory in her childhood dungeon and kills a Phyrexian-like beast to save the girl, her younger self, standing over her slain mother.
quote: This time, she does what the girl could only dream of doing. This time, she has a sword.

summary: The girl speaks with an adult voice and warns that a splicer is coming; Elspeth realizes the girl is her younger self and is told to wake up.
quote: "Elspeth, it's time to wake up."

summary: Elspeth is told by the voice, now in her mother's likeness, that she must make one more choice about where to intervene as the planes burn.
quote: You must choose where to intervene,

summary: Elspeth is shown the Phyrexian assault on New Capenna led by the corrupted angel Atraxa.
quote: "They call her Atraxa."

summary: Elspeth finds she cannot affect events as an observer, even as Phyrexian beasts slaughter citizens.
quote: She tries to save the man only for her hands to fade through him.

summary: Riveteers fight back in Park Heights, and Elspeth decides New Capenna has its defenders and is not the place to intervene.
quote: "This isn't the place," she says.

summary: Elspeth falls to Theros and is welcomed by Daxos's voice; she sees Meletis in ruins.
quote: "So you've not forgotten me, even with the new station,"

summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
quote: He's already changed three of them.

summary: Heroes of Theros shoot at Ajani, and he has a captured youth killed before the faithful.
quote: "Behold, one who turns away from the pack! One who plots against us!"

summary: Elspeth weighs saving Theros against the larger war, and concludes the choice is not meant to be about her own wants.
quote: But this isn't meant to be about her own wants and needs.

summary: Elspeth falls through other planes and lands at the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, which Jin-Gitaxias's army fills.
quote: The Invasion Tree stands as proud testament to the unending triumphs of Elesh Norn.

summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

summary: Norn tells the Mirrans that they will be freed of their skin's treachery; Elspeth reaches for her sword.
quote: Elspeth reaches for her sword.

summary: The voice tells Elspeth that killing Norn will not end the threat, and recounts the tale of the woman in white who made a world of angels.
quote: Killing her will not end this.

summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

summary: Norn orders Jin-Gitaxias to harvest what is left of Koth's rebellion and he steps toward the prisoners.
quote: Jin-Gitaxias. Come harvest what is left of Koth's little rebellion.

summary: Time stops; Serra appears among the prisoners and reveals the choice is whether Elspeth keeps Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.
quote: It's to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.

summary: Elspeth tells Serra she is afraid, and Serra embraces her, tells her fear is last to leave and remakes her.
quote: "Fear is always the last thing to leave,"

summary: Elspeth is reborn with wings and returns to time as Jin-Gitaxias attacks, meeting his claws with her sword.
quote: She is Elspeth, and she is not.

summary: In a flashback, Karn recalls leaving word not to follow him when he first tried to solve Mirrodin's Phyrexian problem, and being saved by Venser's sacrifice.
quote: If it wasn't for Venser sacrificing his spark, Karn would be dead.

summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

summary: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and demands he answer Phyrexia; Jin-Gitaxias raises his claws to strike Karn.
quote: Jin-Gitaxias raises an arm to strike.

summary: Elspeth arrives as an angel in golden armor, blocking Jin-Gitaxias's strike and sending his legions into the abyss.
quote: An angel in gleaming armor, a golden blade now raised to counter Jin-Gitaxias's strike.

summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

summary: Phyrexian ranks falter and Koth, healed, calls magma and rallies the Mirrans.
quote: "Mirrodin!" says Koth. "With me!"

summary: Norn grabs Jin-Gitaxias by the throat when he suggests retreating, then orders him and Nissa to deal with the prisoners.
quote: "Dissent is a blasphemy, praetor .

summary: Wrenn, who can no longer walk, asks Chandra to carry her toward the Invasion Tree.
quote: She scoops Wrenn up.

summary: Melira frees Karn's platform and Koth uses stone to bring Karn along with the fleeing group.
quote: Karn's slab flies out to meet them.

summary: Nissa pursues the fleeing group, flinging bodies at them and threatening to kill Chandra unless she drops Wrenn.
quote: "Drop the dryad and there's still hope for you, Chandra.

summary: Norn pulls Elspeth from the air and builds new armor from fallen Phyrexians, while Elspeth burns it with a beam from Godsend.
quote: A little focus is all it takes to send a searing beam of light at Norn.

summary: Norn raises walls to block Elspeth and tries to persuade her that her wings make her a Phyrexian.
quote: What does this form offer you that Phyrexia cannot?

summary: Elspeth is tempted by Norn's vision of unity with friends such as Ajani and Daxos, but denies they are alike.
quote: And though she is loath to admit it, there is truth to what Norn is saying.

summary: Norn tears off Jin-Gitaxias's arm for suggesting she compleat Elspeth, and Elspeth stabs Norn's shoulder, making her bleed and escaping her grip.
quote: She drives her sword into Norn's wounded shoulder

summary: Melira is struck down by Phyrexian spears on the bridge as Koth screams.
quote: That person crumpling to the ground—is that Melira?

summary: Elspeth argues that Norn wants worship for herself, not Phyrexia, enraging Norn who hurls blades.
quote: Power's the only thing you care about.

summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

summary: Carried by Chandra toward the Invasion Tree, Wrenn fears she cannot do what everyone relies on her to do, as the tree does not answer her.
quote: That is what truly frightens Wrenn: the possibility that she may not be able to do what everyone is relying upon her to do.

summary: Koth shields the group from a rain of needles as Chandra, struggling, carries Wrenn.
quote: Koth levitates the metal beneath their feet to a shield over their heads.

summary: Nissa's barbed vine goes through Melira's stomach and attacks Chandra and Wrenn.
quote: the other end of the tendril's gone clean through Melira's stomach.

summary: Koth creates a metal barricade to stop Nissa, who strides over the bridge on cable-like roots.
quote: Metal groans up and grows, forming a barrier to stop Nissa's approach.

summary: Nissa catches Chandra by the ankle and hoists her up; Wrenn falls and the Mirrans pass her hand to hand toward the tree.
quote: Nissa lifting her by the ankle with a long and brassy root.

summary: Nissa strangles Chandra with vines while Melira helps Wrenn up to the observation platform.
quote: Vines wrap about Chandra's throat.

summary: Melira places Wrenn against the tree and lends her strength before collapsing against it.
quote: magic ebbs from Melira's hand, glowing a faint white.

summary: Wrenn melds into Realmbreaker, who rejects her; oil floods her senses and she begins to sing in defiance.
quote: Wrenn begins to sing.

summary: Wrenn's fire flares and burns Realmbreaker's voices and herself.
quote: A flare within her belly, the smell of burning oak.

summary: A golden angel strikes Nissa with light, forcing her to drop Chandra, whom the angel sets on the platform.
quote: the angel catches Chandra and sets her on the platform.

summary: Chandra recalls their talk on Dominaria and pulls Wrenn's fire into herself so Wrenn can shape it.
quote: Fire's going to burn, no matter what you do, but you can shape it if you try.

summary: In a vision, Wrenn sings to find a lonely sapling in a lake of black oil and shields him with flaming trees.
quote: Flaming trees grow to the size of mountains

summary: Eight grows tall, and Wrenn names him Eight and resolves to bring him to Teferi.
quote: Hello, Eight , she says. Let's introduce you to Teferi.

summary: Wrenn and Eight tear holes across planes and see the Phyrexian invasion everywhere.
quote: Fires churning in his belly, Eight reaches for new planes.

summary: Wrenn and Eight get lost deliberately, tracing Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time and finding him at a gathering of peaceful people.
quote: Among them—standing at the queen's side—is Teferi.

summary: Wrenn calls to Teferi, who vouches for her to the queen and asks how he can help.
quote: "She's a friend of mine."

summary: Wrenn asks Teferi to come to New Phyrexia to help the losing fight.
quote: "We need you on New Phyrexia.

summary: Wrenn realizes she can push planes together to bring Zhalfir into New Phyrexia, at the cost of herself and Eight, and asks Teferi to bring his friends.
quote: "Wait," she says. "Don't come alone. Bring your friends."

summary: Wrenn and Teferi say a farewell as thousands answer his call.
quote: "Whatever remains of me will always remember my friend, Wrenn,"

summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

summary: Zhalfir's warriors cross the portal led by Teferi, ready for war after many years.
quote: It has been many years since they were called to war—but Zhalfir stands ready.

summary: Vraska narrates being compleated: her throat and tendrils turn to metal, she petrifies Phyrexian agents until she is overwhelmed, and her self retreats into a hidden corner of her mind.
quote: I writhed and arched my back as Phyrexian oil rushed past my teeth.

summary: Vraska rides a Realmbreaker branch down over Ravnica as general for Elesh Norn and has it plunge through the Azorius Senate.
quote: I choose the simplest one and order a branch to dive straight through its center.

summary: Vraska's forces land at the prison where she was held, triggering a memory of her imprisonment at seventeen.
quote: It is the prison I was held in, the prison I tried, and succeeded, in escaping

summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.

summary: Vraska recalls singing with Jace on a boat on Ixalan.
quote: It is night on Ixalan, and I sing to the vast and buzzing jungle.

summary: Vraska's forces transform her subjects and defeat Selesnyan warriors in the undercity.
quote: a cohort of Selesnyan warriors tear through a hole in the maze

summary: Vraska enters her old apartment and finds the thaumatic compass, recalling the days before the War of the Spark when she reopened her memories of Jace.
quote: It is the weeks before the War of the Spark

summary: Vraska sees Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona flying over Ravnica and feels jealousy.
quote: Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona approach, flying close on the back of a gargoyle.

summary: Vraska orders her compleated Golgari to spill oil and blind the populace, leaving citizens collapsed in terror in the streets.
quote: "Spill as much glistening oil on the streets as you can,"

summary: Vraska's forces destroy the roof of the Chamber of the Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet's seat.
quote: delighting in crushing Niv-Mizzet's seat

summary: Vraska welcomes curious Simic and Izzet volunteers while others flee in terror.
quote: I motion to welcome them.

summary: Ral Zarek fights through Phyrexian ranks to reach Vraska, and hits her sternum with a cylindrical device attuned to Phyrexian oil.
quote: in one boxer's punch he plants it right on my sternum and hits a button.

summary: Vraska collapses, her broken body is deserted by her forces, and Ral walks away apologizing.
quote: My forces do not stay long enough for me to argue my case

summary: Vraska lies dying beneath rubble, half-flesh and half-metal, awaiting death.
quote: Now, I close my eyes and wait for the death Phyrexia promised I would never face alone.

summary: In her mind Vraska meets Jace at a café, remembers luring and betraying him, and tells him she deserves to die; he lets her share her memory.
quote: I betrayed him. I transformed him.

summary: Jace forgives Vraska and tells her the part that led the invasion was not her, entering the corner of her mind he made.
quote: "The you that kissed me wasn't you.

summary: Vraska and Jace share a kiss on a dreamed beach, a do-over, and Jace tells her he loves her too before a white light erupts.
quote: "I love you, too, captain."

summary: Two days after the invasion, Ral learns that an officer found no sign of Vraska's body after his haemalectric switch worked.
quote: "There's no sign of her body, sir."

summary: In a dream-memory of her wedding, Errant and Parnesse dance among the Maestros until Phyrexian oil transforms the guests, including her father Anhelo, and Atraxa tears off the roof.
quote: the roof of the Maestro's museum was ripped clean off

summary: Errant wakes in an abandoned station when a converter beast crashes through the wall, hunting her and Parnesse.
quote: The crash of a Phyrexian converter beast plunging through the wall had shattered their brief reprieve.

summary: Errant and Parnesse flee over rails and ledges with stolen Riveteer explosives, using tagger's scrawl to find safe paths.
quote: The two heavy satchels that were laden with the explosives they had stolen from an old Riveteer's stash in the Mezzio clanked against her hips

summary: Cornered by two converter beasts, Errant and Parnesse choose to blow themselves up rather than be converted.
quote: "I love you until every canvas is filled."

summary: Errant wakes in the resistance hideout and learns Della healed them with Halo.
quote: Luckily, I was present to mend your wounds instantly

summary: Della says Halo cannot cure Phyrexianization but can prevent conversion.
quote: Halo can act as preventative against the conversion, but not a cure.

summary: The team debates, and Henzie reveals the Riveteers found the city's core and plans to bring down Park Heights.
quote: There's a core to the city—think like a main support beam

summary: Errant agrees to place the charges after Parnesse insists on the choice, and the team explains Operation Falling Star.
quote: "The final stage: Operation Falling Star,"

summary: The team plans to lure Atraxa to the Nido sanctuary with Falco's trouble and angels, with Della to signal.
quote: "Then the lead cockroach herself might go to the Nido sanctuary to put an end to it,"

summary: The families rally; Falco's Brokers take position, Della rallies angels, and Parnesse shepherds citizens while Errant heads for the core.
quote: But, at last, they had worked out the final details.

summary: Converter beasts chase the escaping citizens, and Errant uses Halo paint jars and her sprayer to defeat them.
quote: Paint sprayed out, swirling with the iridescent rainbows of the Halo with which it was infused.

summary: Errant places the charges in the city's core and finds her Phyrexianized father Anhelo blocking her way.
quote: Her father stood before her.

summary: Anhelo tries to persuade Errant to join New Phyrexia, and she argues beauty is mess and experimentation.
quote: "Beauty isn't found by coloring in the lines.

summary: Della's Halo signal shows Atraxa is in position; Errant says goodbye to her father and detonates the core, collapsing Park Heights.
quote: The core above her burst with orange flame and smoke.

summary: Della catches Errant as she falls from a missed jump and glides her to safety.
quote: Then, two sturdy arms wrapped themselves around her.

summary: The Invasion Tree's branches shrivel as angels with Halo are unleashed into the Multiverse through the portals.
quote: "The angels are being unleashed into the Multiverse, bringing the power of Halo with them."

summary: Errant reunites with Parnesse and her allies at the safe zone as the angels depart.
quote: "Parnesse!" Errant opened her arms just in time for Parnesse to throw herself into them.

summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

summary: Linvala reports that the lithomancer has returned, though not as an ally.
quote: "She has not returned as an ally."

summary: Erem is speared, dragged into a seedpod and transformed, laughing mechanically, as Tazri fails to save him.
quote: two invaders drag him into the nearest seedpod and seal him within.

summary: Linvala carries Tazri away as Sea Gate falls to the Phyrexians.
quote: From above, Tazri watches in horror as her home is, again, consumed by creatures not from this plane.

summary: Nahiri smothers the Roil's attacks, reducing the landscape to bedrock.
quote: Eventually the earth quiets.

summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

summary: Nahiri fuses herself into the Skyclave's heart as its keystone, pouring in her essence.
quote: becoming its keystone, the heart that binds her work here together.

summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
quote: Zendikar is lost.

summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

summary: The keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles out of the stone; the Skyclave begins to collapse.
quote: the keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles from her stone and metal embrace.

summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

summary: On Kamigawa, a boy returns home to his father with his mother, now a spirit of glowing characters.
quote: A spirit that hovers before him, holding his son's hand.

summary: On Kaldheim, Harald counts the minutes until his brother Tyvar bursts from the sea clinging to a serpent's head.
quote: On the count of three hundred thirteen, Tyvar Kell bursts from the water clinging to the serpent's engorged head.

summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

summary: The Zhalfirins celebrate with drums that Phyrexia is defeated while Teferi mourns at a grassy hill.
quote: Phyrexia lies broken and defeated beyond the reach of time.

summary: Teferi plants an acorn on a grassy hill as a tribute to Wrenn and speaks to the mound.
quote: He lays the acorn in the little clearing he has made, then fills it in.

summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

summary: Kaya shares news of the other planes, including that Liliana, Vivien and Tyvar are well and that Jace and Vraska are still missing.
quote: Still no sign of Jace, or Vraska

summary: Melira proposes a plan to heal Nissa and Ajani that will cost her life and Karn's spark.
quote: "I think I have an idea for fixing the two of them."

summary: Koth seeks advice from Elspeth about Melira's plan and whether Ajani and Nissa deserve mercy.
quote: "It's going to kill her, doing that," Koth says.

summary: Elspeth tells Koth that Melira chooses her end freely and urges him to make Zhalfir home, then flies him to the ward.
quote: "You will try to make this place home. It will welcome you, if you let it."

summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

summary: Karn pulls out Nissa's and Ajani's sparks and gives up Venser's spark to filter them while Melira cleans them.
quote: "Together, Venser," he says

summary: Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
quote: "She's gone."

summary: Nissa wakes and reunites with Chandra, giving the survivors hope.
quote: "I'm right here," Chandra says.

summary: Atraxa, a corrupted angel, cuts through New Capenna's defenses while the angels, demons and devils fight her armies.
quote: She cuts her way through the city's defenses as a farmer threshing wheat.

summary: Riveteers hidden in the rafters sever the tower's supports with flame, unseen by Atraxa.
quote: Tools used to forge connections are now used to sever them violently in gouts of flame.

summary: The tower of New Capenna collapses on Atraxa and kills her.
quote: it is the city itself. The gleaming glass and steel tower of New Capenna collapses atop her

summary: With Atraxa dead, the Invasion Tree's barbs retract and the angels see portals open to Theros and decide to go help.
quote: Atraxa's death has changed New Phyrexia

summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

summary: Giada leads the angels' charge across the Multiverse and speaks with Elspeth on New Phyrexia, promising help.
quote: That's just what I wanted to tell you. Some of us are coming to help.

summary: The Zhalfirins charge the Phyrexians and Teferi tells Koth the planes are swapping, with Zhalfir coming home.
quote: "The two planes are swapping places

summary: Koth rallies the Mirrans and the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army.
quote: After only minutes on the field, the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army's forces

summary: Vorinclex tears Teferi's mount apart and attacks him, but an Askari named Shella beheads the praetor.
quote: A blazing sword severs Vorinclex's head from his body.

summary: Elspeth tells Teferi to leave Nissa to her and to hold off Jin-Gitaxias and Norn.
quote: "Leave Nissa to me.

summary: The sanctum cracks apart as Zhalfir takes New Phyrexia's place, and Norn rails that Phyrexia will never die while her army turns on her.
quote: "Why aren't any of you protecting me!? I am Phyrexia!"

summary: Jin-Gitaxias's legions attack Norn, and Ajani defends her, until Zhalfirin warriors capture him alive on Teferi's order.
quote: "Wait! Take that one alive!"

summary: Teferi stops Jin-Gitaxias's war machine blades and a Zhalfirin warrior shatters the vat, dropping Jin-Gitaxias to be eaten by his own creations.
quote: Even smaller when his own creations start eating him.

summary: Teferi calls the retreat and the Zhalfirins fend off Phyrexians as the Mirrans pass through the portal.
quote: "Clear a path for the Mirrans!"

summary: Teferi finds an acorn hidden in the ashen remains of Wrenn and takes it.
quote: an acorn hidden within the ash.

summary: Nissa attacks Chandra and Koth, and Elspeth knocks her out of her armor and sky; Chandra catches her.
quote: The elf drops like a stone out of her armor, and out of the sky.

summary: Karn builds a new body and Norn crawls skinless toward the portal as her army tears her apart.
quote: Crawling toward them is a skinless abomination.

summary: Karn kills Elesh Norn himself and walks through the portal as Teferi resumes time.
quote: Karn lays a hand on what remains of Norn's head.

summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

summary: Nissa tries to feel Zhalfir but the plane does not answer, and she feels cut off from the Multiverse as the others settle in the new village.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: But Zhalfir still never spoke to her.

summary: Chandra helps Nissa melt her Phyrexian carapace and bury it, and reveals she will leave the next day to find Ajani.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: "Tomorrow, I'm leaving to find Ajani."

summary: Nissa asks what kind of love Chandra has for her and, hurt by her answer, tells her to go; Chandra leaves.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: "Then be clear—exactly what kind of love do you have for me?"

summary: Nissa tries to meditate beside the sprout of Wrenn but her connection to the Multiverse is smothered by the voices of those who touched her mind, and she collapses in pain.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: She screams for real.

summary: A blue rift tears open and a lightning-veined beast bursts out, forcing Nissa to fight it alone and without her magic or leylines.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: The beast is like nothing she has seen before

summary: Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast; Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: She sees Teferi, staff outstretched, his radiant, blue spell holding the beast in place.

summary: The group studies the portal; Nissa hears faint Zendikar in it and the others advise caution and a hunt for the creature first.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: it sounds like Zendikar.

summary: The beast returns and ransacks the village; Nissa leads it away with roots.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Slowly, vine by vine, swing by swing, Nissa leads the creature out of the village.

summary: Chandra arrives and fights the beast with fire, but her fireballs boil a baobab and make it grow colossal, forcing them into a pit.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Chandra pushes Nissa out of the way of its snapping jaws

summary: Trapped, Nissa confronts Chandra about her broken promise, and Chandra apologizes, saying she still wants to know her.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: "But I still want to know you."

summary: Chandra tells Nissa that her connections are changing her voice into something more powerful; Nissa calls to Zhalfir in a chorus and the plane forgives her.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: The plane answers.

summary: Nissa realizes the creature is a storm elemental from another plane and channels Zhalfir's power into Chandra to heat it into steam and rain.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Chandra pours heat and energy into the creature.

summary: Floating in the flood, Chandra explains her love and promises to give Nissa room; they kiss.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Nissa pulls Chandra into a kiss.

summary: After celebrating, Nissa and Chandra step through the portal together, hoping to find Zendikar.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Hand in hand, Chandra and Nissa step through the portal into just one of infinite possibilities.

summary: Nahiri, now without her spark and awake after the invasion, tears Phyrexian metal from her own body and then from the Skyclave, piling it in a cairn.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Nahiri ripped the taint of Phyrexia from her plane.

summary: Nahiri recalls a blast of Halo and realizes she is alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: The core of her power, her spark, no longer a part of her.

summary: A metal claw nearly stabs her and Phyrexian memories surge before she rejects them.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: That was the ghost of Phyrexia. It was not her.

summary: Nahiri reaches the chamber where she fused herself into the Skyclave and finds a hidden hedron containing her spark inside the wall.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: It was her Planeswalker spark.

summary: Filled with hope, Nahiri tears a stairway through the Skyclave's roof and climbs out into sunlight.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Sunlight dripped into the darkness.

summary: Nahiri sees the extent of Phyrexia's wreckage of Zendikar and concedes it is her fault.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: This was her fault.

summary: Nahiri resolves to restore her spark and seek help from Kesenya.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Which meant, first things first, finding a way to restore her spark.

summary: Ajani appears, restored and still a planeswalker, saying he came looking for her and reporting the deaths and survivors among the former evangels.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: "Hello, Nahiri," Ajani said.

summary: Ajani proposes that he and Nahiri work together to make amends for what they did, and she refuses.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: "Someone needs to make amends for what we've done.

summary: Nahiri suspects Ajani has come to kill her as one of the former evangels.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: What if he was here to kill her?

summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

summary: Nahiri flings stone to make a wall and the Skyclave dome collapses under her, dropping her onto her cairn.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: and then the dome of the Skyclave collapsed beneath her feet.

summary: Nahiri finds the hedron cracked and her spark gone, her last hope of regaining her power destroyed.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: Her last hope at regaining her power—at becoming a Planeswalker once more—was gone.

summary: Nahiri blames Planeswalkers for Zendikar's ruin and vows that none will set foot on Zendikar again.
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quote: No Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar ever again.

summary: Will and Rowan meet the rebel knight Imodane, who calls herself queen and mocks Will as pathetic.
quote: "The only reason I agreed to this little meeting was to see if you were as pathetic as I'd heard."

summary: Will proposes a duel: if Imodane loses she kneels; if she wins Will will surrender the crown of Eldraine to her.
quote: "I'll surrender the crown of Eldraine. You will be High Queen in name and deed."

summary: Will freezes the ground and Imodane slips, but she melts the ice and knocks Will to the ground with her hammer.
quote: Flame bursts from the head of her hammer.

summary: As Imodane raises her hammer over Will, Rowan unleashes a huge lightning bolt that splits the mountainside.
quote: Rowan's cut a massive rift into the side of the nearest peak.

summary: Terrified, Imodane drops her hammer and flees into the woods, while Will stares at Rowan in fear.
quote: Imodane drops the hammer, turns tail, and runs.

summary: Imodane stumbles through the woods into the throne room of the Faerie Lord, who says she was summoned and asks if she is pure of heart.
quote: " Are you pure of heart?"

summary: Kellan comes home bloodied by the Cotter boys, who asked whether his real father was a faerie.
quote: They asked if it was true my real dad was a faerie.

summary: Kellan's mother and stepfather say he belongs with them, but he feels longing when he looks to the woods.
quote: When he looks to the woods, all he feels is longing.

summary: Rowan tells Will she is leaving to find a magical cure for the Wicked Slumber; they argue about his unearned title and her outburst.
quote: You just decided to call yourself High King because you thought it suited you

summary: Rowan tries to planeswalk but cannot feel her spark, and says she is leaving anyway.
quote: She can't clear her mind enough to planeswalk.

summary: On a new-moon night Kellan races Hex to the willow tree and sees a translucent archway to the faerie realm.
quote: Ahead of him there is an archway made of ethereal, translucent stone.

summary: Kellan passes through the archway before his mother can stop him.
quote: Kellan passes through the archway.

summary: Kellan meets Talion, who asks if he is true of heart and says he will answer questions in return for service.
quote: "Tell me, brave hero ... Are you true of heart?"

summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

summary: Kellan accepts the quest hoping to learn the truth about his father.
quote: "I'll do it. I'll go."

summary: Rowan stays with Royse the weaver, who reveals her true eight-eyed form and directs her to an ancient castle.
quote: revealing eight eyes, two chittering mandibles, eight arms hidden beneath her stole.

summary: Rowan finds the castle's library empty and collapses in rage and tears.
quote: Alone in the abandoned castle, Rowan Kenrith becomes a storm.

summary: Rowan dreams of a feast where her parents give her their crown and tell her to come to Castle Ardenvale; she wakes resolved to go.
quote: "Come to Castle Ardenvale. Your blood awaits you there."

summary: Kellan asks around Edgewall for witches and is warned by Ruby not to touch a sleeper because of the Wicked Slumber.
quote: "The Wicked Slumber spreads, though no one's really sure how,"

summary: Ruby agrees to guide Kellan to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter, after he vaguely names his fae liege.
quote: "All right. I guess someone's got to look out for you, and it might as well be me."

summary: On the way they pass Phyrexian remnants and Ruby throws an apple at a laughing pixie.
quote: Ruby picks up an apple from her basket and flings it hard as a giant flinging a boulder

summary: A wolf-armored archer attacks, and Kellan and Ruby flee.
quote: The Wolf Knight strides toward them.

summary: Ruby leads Kellan through a pack of witchstalkers, who then chase off the Wolf Knight.
quote: The Wolf Knight runs into the woods as the witchstalkers give chase.

summary: They find a witch's thorny cabin and overhear her song about eating a knight.
quote: "When I was hungry a knight wandered in, wild at heart and covered in tin ..."

summary: Kellan sneaks in and charges the witch, knocking her into her cauldron.
quote: he hears her scream as she falls into the cauldron

summary: The Wolf Knight arrives, but when Ruby calls him Peter he removes his helm; it is her brother who was enchanted by the witch.
quote: "Peter!" Ruby shouts.

summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

summary: Ruby learns Kellan's liege is the fae king and decides to keep helping him.
quote: "You helped me find my brother, so I'll help.

summary: Rowan receives a letter from Will asking her to come home but refuses to return, sending him a blank page.
quote: "Give him this, and tell him to come find me if he's serious."

summary: Rowan blasts through Castle Ardenvale's gates and fights her way up the stairs through slumbering knights who attack her, including Saxon and Joshua.
quote: Aiming at his feet and Saxon's, she channels another blast.

summary: Rowan is swept into a waltz of slumbering knights and met by Ashiok in the Court of the Ardent Queen.
quote: "Welcome to the Court of the Ardent Queen, Rowan Kenrith."

summary: Ashiok leads Rowan to Eriette, who says she brought her there because she admires Rowan's fire.
quote: "Dear Rowan, I brought you here because I admire the fire within you."

summary: Eriette explains she created the Wicked Slumber to protect her people from the invaders, and Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents.
quote: When she opens her eyes again her parents are standing at the woman's side.

summary: Eriette is revealed to be Rowan's aunt, sister of the mother who tried to drink Rowan's blood, and tells her she can redeem their line.
quote: "Your mother was the cruelest of us.

summary: Eriette offers Rowan power and tells her the Slumber grants dreamers their wishes while their bodies serve her will.
quote: "I want power ," says the woman.

summary: Ashiok says Rowan's spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir; Rowan accepts her embrace.
quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."

summary: Kellan and Ruby climb a beanstalk with the guide Troyan, who gives them frog potions for the leap to the clouds.
quote: "Pretty cool, huh? Don't worry, it's only temporary," Troyan says.

summary: Kellan and Ruby leap to Stormkeld, the giants' castle, and slip inside while the giants waltz.
quote: "We're really here, huh?" she says. "Stormkeld."

summary: The giant Beluna's goose chases them and Beluna seizes Kellan, accusing them of trying to steal the mirror at her birthday party.
quote: "What are you doing at my party?"

summary: Lord Yorvo, apparently the Giant King, makes Kellan and his friends his guests and persuades Beluna to show them the mirror.
quote: "Consider you and yours my guests at this party."

summary: Troyan tells the mirror something new, and it shows an ice castle at Loch Larent where Hylda lies.
quote: Beneath the condensation, he sees a castle of ice, faceted and glittering

summary: Kellan and Ruby return to Edgewall to find the Slumber's violet threads spreading across the town.
quote: Now, with a sinking heart, Kellan realizes that the victims are beyond counting.

summary: Peter agrees to take them to Loch Larent, warning them to turn back if they cannot feel their noses, and Ruby promises.
quote: "You must wear my thickest cloak, and when you can no longer feel your nose, you must turn back.

summary: Peter shows them a puppet show of a girl in a red hood defeating a witch, moving Ruby.
quote: All watch in perfect stillness as two puppets triumph over all manner of trouble to defeat an evil, man-eating witch.

summary: Peter leaves them to camp as Kellan and Ruby approach Hylda's ice castle at Loch Larent.
quote: They bid farewell to Peter.

summary: Hylda's voice warns them to turn back and summons frost warriors, one pinning Kellan's cloak and another seizing Ruby.
quote: Another warrior's formed, and this one's got her in its clutches.

summary: Kellan pleads to his father and his hilts become a blade of light that cuts down the warriors' arms; he frees Ruby.
quote: his newfound sword cuts straight through the frost warrior's arm.

summary: Kellan collapses from the cold and sleepiness, and Ruby catches him.
quote: Kellan falls.

summary: Ruby carries Kellan toward the castle over Hylda's taunts, then crawls across the drawbridge past frozen bodies, refusing to abandon him.
quote: She shifts Kellan onto her back, throws her hands out ahead.

summary: Hylda appears kneeling beside Ruby and Kellan, extends a hand, clears the weather, and puts them to sleep to keep them safe.
quote: "Be welcome in Winter's Home."

summary: They wake in the ice castle where Hylda hands over her crown as proof of defeat, and the castle begins to melt.
quote: "Take that to the Kindly Lord, as proof of my defeat."

summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

summary: Kellan storms out and goes through Talion's portal with Ruby to confront him, throwing the crown at his feet.
quote: Kellan throws the crown at Talion's feet.

summary: Talion defends himself, says fae do not lie, and tells Kellan to defeat Eriette at Castle Ardenvale to learn of his father.
quote: "You shall find Eriette at Castle Ardenvale.

summary: Back outside Hylda's castle Kellan weeps.
quote: Kellan begins to weep.

summary: Kellan and Ruby ride to Castle Ardenvale on ponies and use the second frog potion to jump over its gates.
quote: They're in the air seconds later.

summary: Inside they find Rowan in the throne room studying curse notes; Kellan reads her note about attempting to put people to sleep before she knocks him out with sparks.
quote: Kellan's vision goes white.

summary: Kellan wakes in a cell, freed by Ruby, who says Rowan knocked them out and was trying to work dream magic on him when Will's army arrived.
quote: "Syr Rowan knocked us both out.

summary: Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

summary: Rowan and Will confront each other; he pleads for her to come home but she attacks him with her sword.
quote: "Home is gone, Will!"

summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

summary: Ashiok returns and takes control of the sleepers, turning the battle against Will's knights.
quote: Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.

summary: Kellan lashes Ashiok in place with his golden whip so Will can strike them with a bolt of ice, which makes Ashiok vanish.
quote: Ashiok lets out a howl of pain as the ice spreads through their body.

summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

summary: Rowan blasts the floor and rises into the air, vowing one day to bring the blessed slumber to all of Eldraine, and escapes.
quote: A boom louder than the fall of a giant.

summary: Will thanks Kellan and Ruby and invites them to the palace; Kellan slips away to the Fae World.
quote: Outside of Castle Ardenvale he steps into the Fae World.

summary: Kellan returns home to Orrinshire and is reunited with Hex, Ronald and his mother, who gives him an enchanted coat.
quote: yes, after all of that, he is finally home.

summary: Kellan's mother tells him about his father, Oko, a shapeshifting being from another Realm she met while training and who wanted to raze the town after it shunned her.
quote: He told me his name was Oko

summary: Hex leads Kellan to a swirling portal in the woods and Kellan steps through, hoping to find his father.
quote: Kellan pets Hex, and steps through the portal.

summary: Ashiok frees Eriette from her cell, promising her new land far away, and she vanishes.
quote: "Opportunity calls us in a new direction.

summary: Quint planeswalks to Ixalan.
quote: As Quint planeswalked from a dimly lit stone corridor into leaf-dappled sunshine, the heat slapped him like a moist towel.

summary: Three dinosaurs corner Quint in the jungle.
quote: He looked up and found himself dangerously close to an open mouth full of curved pointy teeth.

summary: Wayta calls off the dinosaurs, rescuing Quint, and introduces herself.
quote: With the flick of a hand, she dismissed the others as if they were trained pets, and they disappeared into the jungle.

summary: Wayta leads Quint to a view of the golden city of Orazca.
quote: saw the full, blinding brilliance of the golden city in the valley below

summary: Quint meets Saheeli and Huatli in a chamber of tablets and a huge golden door.
quote: This is my partner, Huatli.

summary: Huatli explains that the translated glyphs suggest the door leads to the birthplace of humanity and home of the gods.
quote: I believe they're the key to opening this.

summary: Inti arrives and is introduced as Huatli's cousin and a hero of the war against the Phyrexians.
quote: Seneschal of the sun, dinosaur rider, hero of the war against the Phyrexians.

summary: Inti relays that the emperor is growing impatient and wants the door opened by other means; Huatli asks for more time.
quote: The emperor grows more impatient

summary: Saheeli reveals the emperor is keenly interested in her fire-breathing constructs, and Huatli confesses she fears more war.
quote: I made the mistake of wondering aloud if I could make them breathe fire.

summary: Malcolm examines a fungus-ridden corpse near Sunray Bay.
quote: The body slumped in a pile of half-rotted leaves in the jungle, close enough to Sunray Bay that Malcolm could have walked instead of flying.

summary: Malcolm identifies the dead man as Lank, a Downtown miner.
quote: I think this is Lank

summary: The note found on Lank, signed by mayor Xavier Sal, reveals Downtown is under attack.
quote: Downtown under attack , it read.

summary: Amalia has a vision of sand, fire and a golden door, and a voice calls her; Clavileño wakes her before she falls from her saddle.
quote: Amalia bolted upright in her saddle, her arm aching as if she'd been pushed.

summary: Amalia notes the expedition's goal of finding a Temple of Aclazotz and a door that may end the Church of Dusk's schism.
quote: A Temple of Aclazotz supposedly awaited them in the depths of this continent.

summary: Huatli finishes translating the tablets' poem about the Komon and the imprisoned god Chimil.
quote: The translation was finished.

summary: Huatli realizes the door's glyphs match the tablets symbolically and slots them in correctly; the golden door cracks open.
quote: A whisper of magic touched her fingers, and the space around each tablet glowed softly.

summary: Beyond the door, Huatli's party finds glowing, linen-wrapped warrior corpses and the armored remains of a massive horned creature.
quote: The remains of a massive humanoid creature dominated the opposite corner of the room

summary: Huatli orders word sent to Inti and Caparocti that the expedition leaves as soon as the pack dinosaurs are ready.
quote: Tell them we leave as soon as the pack dinosaurs are ready.

summary: Huatli tells Saheeli the way is open and they will part soon.
quote: I need to take my fill of you before we part.

summary: Malcolm and his companions find Downtown completely empty and abandoned.
quote: The lamps were dark, and as far as Malcolm could tell, Downtown was entirely empty

summary: Malcolm finds the word DOWN painted in ichor beside the one lowered elevator and sends a companion back to Sunray Bay.
quote: One word, the letters thick and blocky.

summary: Vito shows the expedition Tarrian's lance and journal.
quote: was wielded by Venerable Tarrian, in whose footsteps we follow.

summary: Vito announces the door leads to the resting place of Aclazotz and promises to return him to Torrezon.
quote: is a door that leads to the resting place of our ancient god and sire, Aclazotz, creator of the first vampires.

summary: The expedition reaches a golden door in the catacombs, but Amalia sees it is not the door from her visions.
quote: To Amalia's surprise, this was not the door in her visions.

summary: Bartolomé protests that Vito corrupts the blood rites, but backs down.
quote: You corrupt the sacred blood rites

summary: Vito sacrifices a porter on the obsidian altar.
quote: With a single swipe, Vito cut the victim's throat.

summary: The sacrifice opens the golden door and Vito praises Aclazotz.
quote: The door groaned open.

summary: Flashback: Wayta recalls fighting the Phyrexian invasion, sailing with the Brazen Coalition and finally returning to the Sun Empire to join Huatli's expedition.
quote: She'd left the pirates and returned to the Sun Empire a year older

summary: Quint tastes a fragment from a pile of broken pottery and identifies it as bone.
quote: He picked something up with his trunk and touched it to his tongue.

summary: The expedition finds a chasm of glowing green fog crossed by glyph-marked stones.
quote: Caparocti dropped a pebble into the fog.

summary: Wayta deduces the stone path from the poem and sets out across the chasm.
quote: Let me try, Warrior-Poet.

summary: Wayta steps on a wrong stone, it falls, and the platforms begin to rearrange.
quote: Without warning, it fell into the fog.

summary: Caparocti hauls Wayta to safety and crosses with her.
quote: Strong hands grabbed her arms and hauled her up.

summary: Wayta touches the glyph panel in the poem's order, and the platforms form a solid bridge.
quote: The platforms slid together, forming a solid bridge, much easier to cross.

summary: Caparocti tells Wayta he is sure war with the Dusk Legion is coming and that the colonizers must be eliminated.
quote: The colonizers must be eliminated, or they will never stop trying to rule us.

summary: Malcolm and his crew descend elevator after elevator in the Downtown cenote, finding tracks of the missing residents all leading downward.
quote: each showed signs of its workers joining the mass exodus, ever downward.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches find a trail of abandoned tools and smeared greenish-black marks leading into a tunnel.
quote: A haphazard trail of tools seemed to lead into one of the tunnels rather than out, though it was hard to tell the difference.

summary: In a fungus-lit cavern they find stripped, mold-covered bones and see shapes moving in the dark.
quote: A pile of bones stripped clean of flesh and half-covered in black mold.

summary: A fungus-ridden living raptor corpse attacks, releasing spores, and more like it follow; Malcolm flees with Breeches.
quote: A horror emerged from the passage beside them.

summary: Vito sees a mosaic of Aclazotz and reflects on Bartolomé and Amalia, whom he suspects of hearing Aclazotz's call.
quote: Was she, too, hearing Aclazotz calling to her?

summary: Vito resolves that he alone is Aclazotz's instrument and will bring the god to Alta Torrezon.
quote: He would prove himself worthy by bringing Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon, ending the tiresome theological debates that plagued his people.

summary: Vito sacrifices another servant on an altar to open a second door.
quote: Clavileño and another soldier held the servant down as Vito cut his throat

summary: The door opens onto a vast underground desert of treacherous sand.
quote: now instead Vito faced a massive underground desert

summary: A scout is swallowed by the sand and vanishes.
quote: Without warning, too fast to make a sound, he vanished.

summary: Clavileño flies over the desert marking solid ground and the soldiers build a makeshift plank bridge.
quote: Clavileño's legs dissolved into smoke as he rose into the air.

summary: Mantis-spider creatures attack the column, seizing and devouring a porter and a prisoner.
quote: Their arms snapped out, snagging a porter and a prisoner, dragging them away as they screamed and flailed.

summary: Vito orders the vampires to purge the creatures; Amalia freezes one with magic and Bartolomé beheads another with his whip.
quote: Bartolomé unfurled a whip and lashed out, wrapping it around the monster's neck.

summary: The expedition tallies its losses on reaching the far side of the desert.
quote: They reported that beyond the two taken by the monsters, a porter, a soldier, two prisoners, and a horse had fallen into the sand.

summary: Vito privately resolves to eliminate Bartolomé if he hinders the mission.
quote: If Bartolomé tried to hinder the mission, he would be eliminated.

summary: Quint beholds a huge underground fungus-covered stone city, reminiscent of Zantafar.
quote: Before him stretched a cavern many miles across, from edge to edge filled with stone buildings and narrow streets.

summary: Quint finds a purple-pink poncho and beads in a plaza and uses the spell The Rousing on it.
quote: Quint finally found a pile of cloth and beads, surprisingly well preserved.

summary: The spell summons the ghost of an old man who has forgotten his name.
quote: The poncho rose, hovering in the air.

summary: The ghost cries that it must warn Oteclan of a mycoid infestation and that the door must be closed, then runs off.
quote: I must warn Oteclan of the mycoid infestation. It's too late. The door must be closed!

summary: Malcolm sings to enthrall the fungus-ridden dinosaurs and his crew, and cuts the creatures apart.
quote: Malcolm began to sing.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches regroup, then notice black fungal veins spreading from the crew's wounds, though everyone says they feel fine.
quote: Black marks like scabs had replaced slices and gouges

summary: Amalia and the expedition reach a cavern with a lava waterfall and a deserted-looking settlement.
quote: a thunderous fall of lava cascaded down the side of a wall, bright enough to light the entire space

summary: A strange swordsman runs toward the vampires, pursued by pale goblin-like creatures.
quote: Someone emerged from a nearby building, chased by a half-dozen smaller figures.

summary: Amalia alters her map with her enchanted quill, removing part of the bridge so the pursuers fall.
quote: With a delicate scratch of her quill, Amalia changed the map, and changed the world.

summary: The rescued man introduces himself as Kellan, from Eldraine.
quote: I'm Kellan

summary: Vito refuses to help Kellan, but Amalia takes responsibility for him and Vito grudgingly accepts.
quote: I'll take responsibility for him.

summary: Bartolomé warns Amalia not to defy Vito openly again.
quote: Do not openly defy him again

summary: Abuelo cries 'Titan!' and vanishes as Wayta and Quint chase him by an underground river.
quote: then vanished in a swirl of purple-pink energy

summary: A huge mushroom-headed titan appears and charges Wayta and Quint.
quote: Ahead, a hulking figure loomed, easily twice her height.

summary: The titan hurls a chunk of wall at Wayta, who dodges and fights it alone.
quote: The titan grabbed half of a crumbling wall and threw it at Wayta.

summary: Huatli, Inti, Caparocti and the other warriors arrive and attack the titan.
quote: Huatli, Inti, Caparocti, and the other warriors had arrived while Wayta was fighting

summary: The titan heals its wounds with fungus, kills warriors and spits corrosive black fluid; one warrior dies despite Wayta's attempt to help.
quote: the sight of bloody bone through the remains of the man's flesh told her she was too late.

summary: A dozen smaller mushroom creatures surround the Sun Empire party.
quote: A dozen new creatures surrounded them

summary: River Heralds burst out of the river and join the battle, offering to take the party to safety.
quote: A wave lashed out of the underground river, knocking two of the creatures away.

summary: Quint summons an ancient weapon with a spell and impales a mushroom creature.
quote: An ancient weapon rose from the ground as if wielded by a spirit

summary: A Herald casts a breathing spell on Wayta and shoves her into the river.
quote: Swift travels, little sister

summary: On the elevator, spore-infected pirates shove uninjured crewmates into a spore cloud and turn them.
quote: those pirates lunged at two of the uninjured ones and shoved them into the glowing spore cloud.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches cut the cables, sending the elevator with the infected pirates falling into the dark.
quote: with a terrible silence, the elevator fell away into the dark.

summary: Bartolomé reveals Queen Miralda secretly assigned him to learn Vito's true intentions and loyalties.
quote: When Queen Miralda assigned Bartolomé to join this expedition, he was told to play along and discover Vito's true intentions and loyalties.

summary: Two dozen catlike Malamet warriors surround the Legion.
quote: Two dozen warriors surrounded them, taller than the vampires, broader, with faces like great cats and spotted fur to match.

summary: Kutzil introduces herself and demands the Legion come with her.
quote: I am Kutzil, champion of the Malamet

summary: Vito quietly warns Bartolomé not to undermine him again.
quote: Do not undermine me again

summary: Kutzil shows the Legion the Malamet city of Ban Koj.
quote: You are the first strangers to see Ban Koj since the time of the Oltec.

summary: The Legion is brought before Sovereign Okinec Ahau on his throne.
quote: This, presumably, was Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

summary: Okinec Ahau rejects Vito's claim of a god and has his mythweaver Poq test their words.
quote: There are no gods here but me

summary: Poq's magic shows a vision of a snarling, fanged face attacking him, exposing the vampires as a threat.
quote: A snarling face, its fangs bared and growing long.

summary: Okinec Ahau sentences the Legion to be given to the sand.
quote: I sentence these trespassers to be given to the sand.

summary: Malamet glyph magic binds the Legion in chains and forces them to kneel.
quote: The magic lashed out and wrapped around the Legion members like chains, forcing them to kneel.

summary: The Malamet throw the Legion, one by one, into a basin of sand that drains into a hole.
quote: Bartolomé watched as the Malamet threw his comrades into the basin of sand

summary: Amalia tells Kellan to hold his breath just before sinking.
quote: Hold your breath.

summary: Wayta surfaces in an underground freshwater sea beside Quint.
quote: Wayta kicked her way to the surface, searching for the others

summary: Nicanzil welcomes the party to the River Heralds' city.
quote: I am Nicanzil

summary: Huatli wonders if the corroded door atop the temple is Matzalantli.
quote: Could this be Matzalantli?

summary: Wayta objects to Quint's plan to excavate and write up Ixalan's history for outsiders.
quote: You shouldn't be telling our stories for us.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches rest in an abandoned tunnel as the only survivors of Malcolm's party.
quote: of the eight people he'd brought down here with him, only he and Breeches had survived.

summary: Fungus on the shaft wall spells out the words SAFE and DOWN, suggesting the force behind Downtown's fate is sentient.
quote: SAFE, the first word read. Then, DOWN.

summary: Trapped in the sand, Amalia has new visions of the round glyph door, a map-like sky and a burning sphere ringed with purple-pink debris.
quote: The mysterious door, round and covered in glyphs, clearer than before.

summary: The Legion falls out of the sand into the same freshwater sea.
quote: Without warning, she hit water, her eyes flying open.

summary: River Heralds surround and capture the Legion in the water.
quote: River Heralds, dozens, all armed with their strange jade weapons and elemental magics.

summary: Nicanzil summons the Sun Empire group to the convocation.
quote: The convocation begins

summary: The Sun Empire party reaches the top of the building facing the golden door and meets the vampires, provoking hostility.
quote: The other warriors mirrored her disgust, some reaching for weapons.

summary: Pashona questions Quint and Huatli about their intentions.
quote: Who are you, stranger?

summary: Inti and Caparocti call for the vampires to be imprisoned or killed, and Pashona threatens to return them to the sea.
quote: These invaders should be imprisoned

summary: Bartolomé warns that Torrezon and Queen Miralda would be displeased if the Legion is harmed.
quote: Torrezon as well. Queen Miralda would be most displeased.

summary: Huatli proposes that the Sun Empire and River Heralds cooperate to open the door.
quote: Shaper, your people and mine seek to open this door. I propose we work together.

summary: Huatli appeals to shared struggle against the Phyrexians to ease tensions over Orazca and the Immortal Sun.
quote: We all fought against the Phyrexians to defend our homes.

summary: Bartolomé says Queen Miralda might negotiate, and Vito silences him until Pashona allows the work to proceed.
quote: Queen Miralda might be open to such negotiations, depending on what we find.

summary: Quint summons Abuelo's Echo using the poncho.
quote: He pulled the poncho from his pack and once again cast the spell to summon Abuelo.

summary: Abuelo recognizes Matzalantli and says they must warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant.
quote: We must get inside and warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant.

summary: Abuelo uses Abuela's khipu to find the key to the golden door.
quote: Here! The golden door.

summary: Huatli recognizes the pattern as a key, arranges the cosmium beads, and the door unseals and swings open.
quote: Light burst through a crack at the seam of the now unsealed portal, which swung open with a rush of surprisingly cold, fresh air.

summary: Beyond the door, the party reaches a well-like opening showing a circle of sky deep underground.
quote: They stood before a circle of sky dotted with clouds.

summary: Figures above the well notice that the seal has been opened and call for Anim Pakal.
quote: Someone has opened the seal.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches fly and climb down the cenote and find the damaged elevator.
quote: They eventually found the elevator, damaged but mostly intact

summary: A glowing tunnel seems to guide or herd them onward.
quote: A tunnel to the left lit up while the glow around them faded, as if they were being guided.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches enter a vast fungal forest full of ruins.
quote: A fungal forest spread out before them, hauntingly beautiful, littered with crumbling ruins.

summary: Downtown's infected residents emerge, led by mayor Xavier Sal with button mushrooms for eyes.
quote: One of the humans stepped forward, his movements stilted, eyes replaced by glowing button mushrooms.

summary: Xavier announces that they are the Mycotyrant, and the giant fungal creature is revealed.
quote: We are the Mycotyrant.

summary: Xavier says Malcolm's companions and Downtown's residents have been incorporated into the colony.
quote: They have been incorporated into our colony, as have the ones who once resided in the place you call Downtown.

summary: When Malcolm asks what it wants, the Mycotyrant laughs with spores and answers 'Everything.'
quote: The Mycotyrant emitted a cloud of spores like a silent laugh.

summary: Amalia and Kellan step through the golden door into the Core, a hollow world matching her visions.
quote: A sprawling panorama spread before, above, and around her as she stepped through the portal.

summary: Amalia sees the central sun ringed by metal shards, as in her vision.
quote: At the center of it all, a strange sun hovered

summary: Anim Pakal arrives on a bat and demands to know how the seal was opened.
quote: I am called Anim Pakal

summary: Abuelo explains the plan to isolate and defeat the Mycotyrant has failed.
quote: The plan to isolate and defeat it has failed.

summary: Anim accuses the visitors of bringing ruin by opening the door.
quote: You have brought ruin to us.

summary: Anim explains that the Komon were Oltec ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.
quote: The Komon are our ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.

summary: When a soldier announces the Legion are vampires, Anim orders them imprisoned as worshippers of the Great Betrayer.
quote: Worshippers of the Great Betrayer are not welcome here

summary: Vito goes into a trance and says all proceeds according to Aclazotz's will.
quote: All proceeds according to his will

summary: Akal Pakal receives the Sun Empire group and raises the presence of vampires.
quote: I have heard some of your story from my sister Anim

summary: Inti and Caparocti urge the Oltec to help strike Torrezon while Huatli argues for peace.
quote: Now is the perfect time to strike.
