summary: Abuelo tells Quint the khipu was Abuela's and Quint proposes bringing her back as an Echo.
quote: Perhaps we can bring her back, as I helped you come back.

summary: The Mycotyrant explains that its colony found the miners and wanted to know more of them.
quote: You dug through stone and ore and veins of shining crystal until one of your kind found us.

summary: Xavier says the Mycotyrant does not kill but changes and spreads.
quote: We do not kill. We change. We spread.

summary: The Mycotyrant reveals it wants the sun above and Malcolm realizes it could consume Sunray Bay and Ixalan.
quote: You have another sun above, and we will have it.

summary: The Legion is locked in empty detention rooms, weapons confiscated.
quote: Even so, the Legion vampires and their few remaining servants were locked up in empty rooms, weapons confiscated, and left to await their fates.

summary: Kellan questions the vampires, and Amalia defends the church's blood rites, then doubts.
quote: We only feed from criminals, evil people, and we use the power of blood to help others.

summary: Kellan reveals he is searching for the father he has never met.
quote: I'm searching for my father

summary: Vito conjures a thick magical fog over the building.
quote: A magical fog covered the building, so thick her hand would disappear if she thrust it through the opening.

summary: Amalia smells blood as the starving Legion soldiers feed on their own servants.
quote: When the scent of blood reached her, Amalia feared the worst.

summary: Bartolomé makes Amalia promise to return to Queen Miralda and tell her everything if he dies.
quote: if something happens to me, you must return to Queen Miralda. Tell her everything.

summary: Clavileño tears off the door and Vito enters, bloodstained.
quote: A crimson handprint was smeared down the front of his armor

summary: Vito demands Kellan's blood as a sacrifice to Aclazotz.
quote: The blood of the outsider will suffice

summary: Bartolomé attacks Vito to block the doorway while Kellan summons his swords.
quote: Bartolomé leaped at Vito, hands curled into claws, fangs bared.

summary: Vito breaks Bartolomé's neck and kills him.
quote: Vito locked an arm around Bartolomé's head and twisted, the terrible snap echoing in the small room.

summary: Amalia erases the wall from her map; mist rolls in and she and Kellan flee.
quote: The wall behind her vanished.

summary: Quint watches Sun Empire warriors and Oltec riders prepare for a coming-of-age flight.
quote: He watched the Sun Empire warriors don special harnesses, supervised by members of the Thousand Moons.

summary: The bat riders fly toward the cosmium reef to claim cosmium.
quote: Huatli and the others would try to claim a piece of that cosmium for themselves.

summary: Akal tells Quint that stories are the memory of the plane and mentions the Night War.
quote: Stories are the memory of the plane, and to forget is to succumb to darkness.

summary: Huatli returns with a fragment of cosmium.
quote: I found a fragment!

summary: Wayta reports that the vampires have summoned a bigger cloud of cursed fog.
quote: The vampires have summoned a cloud of their cursed fog, bigger than usual.

summary: Anim brings in two prisoners, Amalia and Kellan.
quote: We found these two running from the garrison

summary: Amalia says the other vampires killed their servants and the queen's emissary and are seeking Aclazotz.
quote: They killed our human servants and the queen's emissary, then escaped. They're looking for Aclazotz.

summary: Anim and Akal react with fear, saying Aclazotz has been imprisoned for ages and some Oltec may still worship him.
quote: If the vampires find these allies, they may at last be powerful enough to release the bat god from his prison.

summary: The Mycotyrant announces it will assimilate Malcolm and Breeches and ascend to the surface.
quote: We will assimilate you, and we will ascend to the surface and its sun.

summary: Malcolm sings to stun the colony and leads Breeches toward a water tunnel.
quote: Taking a deep breath, Malcolm began to sing.

summary: The Mycotyrant breaks free of the song with a scream and the colony chases them.
quote: A hideous, many-mouthed scream echoed behind them.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches burst out above a vast ocean and the River Heralds' city.
quote: Without warning, the tunnel ended in a short cliff.

summary: The Mycotyrant's forces, including infected Downtown residents, dinosaurs and bats, erupt after them.
quote: The Mycotyrant's forces erupted from the tunnel.

summary: Merfolk defend their city against the fungal invasion with elementals.
quote: Merfolk drew weapons, activated the enchantments in their armor, pulled out jade totems and summoned huge elemental creatures to repel the fungal invasion.

summary: Nicanzil confronts Malcolm and Breeches, then agrees the Core must be warned.
quote: I am Nicanzil. What evil have you brought to our shores?

summary: Malcolm and Breeches head through the golden door to warn the Core.
quote: Our people beyond the golden door must be warned that it is closer than they knew.

summary: Vito reflects that he has taken revenge on Bartolomé and leads the vampires through the fog.
quote: Despite Bartolomé thwarting his intended sacrifice, he'd finally had his revenge on that thorn of the Black Rose.

summary: Clavileño and the soldiers hunt and feed on Oltec in the fog.
quote: Clavileño and the other soldiers found and silenced some, gorging themselves in an ecstasy of blood.

summary: A red-lit guide offers to lead Vito to Aclazotz.
quote: I have been sent to guide you to Aclazotz.

summary: Vito learns that Aclazotz is a prisoner and feels doubt, then pride.
quote: Vito faltered at the mention of imprisonment.

summary: Vito places the pink crystal key into the door, enduring pain, and the door opens.
quote: Crimson light spread to the glyphs around the door, and it rolled sideways with a deep rumbling sound.

summary: Vito enters an amphitheater of worshippers.
quote: a thousand pale faces turned to watch Vito enter.

summary: Vito sees Aclazotz chained with golden chains inlaid with cosmium crystals.
quote: The bat god crouched on the floor, shrouded by his wings and wrapped in loops of thick golden chains inlaid with hundreds of pink crystals.

summary: Aclazotz announces the end of the Fifth Age and demands sacrifices.
quote: The end of the Fifth Age is upon us

summary: The prisoners are fed to Aclazotz, and his eye brightens with each death.
quote: One by one, the prisoners were delivered unto the bat god, who feasted on their essences as Vito respectfully averted his gaze.

summary: Aclazotz breaks his golden chains.
quote: A concussive burst of magic struck everyone in the room as the gold links snapped in a dozen places.

summary: Aclazotz bites Vito and blesses the others, transforming them into bat creatures.
quote: In a flash, he sank them deep into Vito's neck and torso.

summary: The transformed vampires stand as bat-like monsters.
quote: Where once vampires had knelt, new creatures stood, their forms echoing their master's.

summary: Aclazotz leads the legion out and vows to imprison Chimil and end the Fifth Age.
quote: I will end the Fifth Age at last, and my children will bring the Sixth Age to the plane.

summary: Aclazotz reforms the shattered sphere around the sun to imprison Chimil.
quote: Aclazotz wielded his power to reform a shattered sphere that would soon imprison Chimil.

summary: The prison's shadow darkens the Core.
quote: The shadow of that prison fell across the land, enshrouding it in a darkness deeper than any night in Torrezon.

summary: Aclazotz demands more sacrifices and Vito shrieks the order to the Legion.
quote: I require more sacrifices. You will bring them to me.

summary: Wayta panics at the darkening sun and is reminded of the Phyrexian war.
quote: The sun darkened, and Wayta fought the urge to panic, cold sweat pooling in the small of her back.

summary: Wayta sees Aclazotz and the transformed vampires fly to the cosmium reef.
quote: led by a bat as large as three or four people standing end to end: Aclazotz.

summary: Chara warns that Chimil's prison is being remade.
quote: We must stop the betrayer Aclazotz, or Chimil will be sealed inside again.

summary: The Sun Empire and Oltec rally with Huatli's poem and cry 'For the Threefold Sun!'
quote: For the Threefold Sun!

summary: The vampire abominations attack the Oltec bat riders and the great battle begins.
quote: The vampire abominations flew toward the Oltec force.

summary: Wayta wounds a vampire-bat in air combat.
quote: Her blade tore a deep gash in her enemy's wing, and with a scream, he spun toward the earth.

summary: Wayta sees a siren fleeing from the door and a flood of fungal creatures behind him.
quote: A rush of greenish blackness poured through the portal behind him.

summary: Malcolm flies into the Core and finds a battle already underway.
quote: there appeared to be another battle already in progress.

summary: Malcolm and Wayta meet in the air and exchange news of the mushroom horde and the bat monsters.
quote: The vampires have transformed into bat monsters and their god imprisoned the sun.

summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

summary: Akal says Anim is mobilizing the Thousand Moons, but forces will be stretched thin by two threats.
quote: My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense, but between this and Aclazotz, our forces will be spread thin.

summary: Vito impales an Oltec bat rider, who is then dragged away as a sacrifice.
quote: Vito dodged a wave of magic from an Oltec bat rider, then speared her through the midsection with his lance.

summary: Vito engages Inti in aerial combat.
quote: This one he remembered from the introductions among the River Heralds: Inti, seneschal of the sun.

summary: Clavileño grabs Inti while he is tethered to his falling bat.
quote: Clavileño circled behind him and gripped Inti's head in one massive claw.

summary: Clavileño kills Inti by snapping his neck.
quote: Clavileño snapped Inti's neck and both human and bat bodies fell into darkness.

summary: Huatli screams and dives after her fallen comrade, and Vito follows her.
quote: She, too, would make an excellent sacrifice.

summary: Huatli cradles Inti's dead body as battle rages above.
quote: Huatli cradled the broken body of her cousin, kneeling in the blood-spattered soil of a land far from home.

summary: Transformed Vito arrives to capture Huatli for Aclazotz.
quote: Aclazotz will be pleased when I deliver you to him

summary: Vito boasts of making himself a saint and of ruling at Aclazotz's side with Vona.
quote: Together, Vona and I will rule at our master's side

summary: Huatli calls on the land's magic as she fights Vito.
quote: She called to the mountains and forests, the fields and valleys.

summary: Huatli twists Vito's lance out of his hand.
quote: She caught it in the gap of her shield, twisting the weapon out of his hand.

summary: Dinosaurs, including Pantlaza, swarm Vito.
quote: A flying dinosaur barreled into him, sending him tumbling to the ground.

summary: Huatli kills Vito with his own lance through the heart.
quote: The lance slid through the vampire's plate armor, piercing his vile heart and pinning him to the ground.

summary: Vito dies asking Aclazotz why he forsook him.
quote: why have you forsaken me?

summary: Huatli promises Inti she will return after every vampire in the Core is eradicated.
quote: promising Inti that she would return when every vampire in the Core was eradicated.

summary: Malcolm recalls that Vraska reportedly died in the invasion.
quote: She'd died in the invasion, or so he'd heard.

summary: Quint and Abuelo restore Abuela as an Echo, who warns that the Mycotyrant nears.
quote: Everyone, this is Abuela.

summary: The gardeners arrive and summon Echoes anchored to heirloom objects.
quote: Spirits burst into existence, anchored to the items.

summary: Akal sends the gardeners to preserve the land while the Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil.
quote: While our Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil, you must preserve the land for their return.

summary: Amalia offers to help by using her map magic on the land.
quote: I can change the land with my map.

summary: Amalia carves a fissure in front of the Mycotyrant's army.
quote: a deep crevice lay in the path of the army, encircling them so retreat would be difficult.

summary: The mycoids bridge the fissure with their own bodies.
quote: soon a thick bridge spanned the crevice.

summary: Echoes destroy mycoids by entering them as a counter-infection.
quote: It dissolved into blue smoke as if consumed by invisible fire.

summary: Gardeners burn mycoids with waves of pink light.
quote: Every fungus the light touched burst into flames.

summary: Breeches pulls out a flowery tube weapon he got in High and Dry.
quote: From his pack, he retrieved the weapon he'd acquired in High and Dry as payment for a debt.

summary: Breeches fires a molten fireball that fells a titan and sends the colony into disarray.
quote: Every fungal creature around it shrieked in unison, some collapsing like puppets whose strings had been cut.

summary: The casing around the sun shifts apart and light shines through again.
quote: As the dust cleared, the casing around the sun shifted apart slowly, almost imperceptibly.

summary: Wayta spots a temple of Aclazotz revealed in a sheared mountain face.
quote: Pillars of a great temple rose from the sheared mountain face.

summary: Anim sends the Thousand Moons to destroy the cosmium eaters.
quote: My Moons, come. We will root out the disease of cosmium eaters and end them as well.

summary: Kellan beheads a vampire while Amalia looks away.
quote: bringing his sword together like scissors, Kellan took off her head.

summary: The Thousand Moons find the temple empty and Aclazotz gone.
quote: Aclazotz is gone

summary: A captured cosmium eater says Aclazotz is free and will end the Fifth Age.
quote: He gathers his children, and soon he will end the Fifth Age and begin a new age of blood.

summary: The eater calls Amalia a traitor for abandoning Aclazotz.
quote: Traitor. We saw you run when you were called.

summary: Amalia grieves Bartolomé's death and Vito's rightness about their god.
quote: Bartolomé died to protect her and Kellan, but his sacrifice was in vain.

summary: Amalia tells Kellan she feels she has been living a lie about her faith.
quote: I feel as if I've been living a lie.

summary: The second Sun Empire delegation reaches Oteclan to find Chimil restored while pyres burn.
quote: The second Sun Empire delegation reached Oteclan a week after the battle, to find Chimil restored to her previous glory even as pyres of the dead burned.

summary: Caparocti is appointed the emperor's voice in negotiations.
quote: Caparocti sat at Steward Akal's left hand, having been appointed the emperor's voice in the proceedings.

summary: Quint casts an eavesdropping spell so Wayta can hear the talks.
quote: Pulling a scroll from his pack, Quint cleared his throat.

summary: Huatli and Caparocti argue over invading Torrezon and Huatli warns him off.
quote: And yet your title was stolen for you by your cousin Inti rather than granted by the late emperor.

summary: The Oltec decide they cannot ignore the surface any longer.
quote: You stand ready to see the surface for yourself

summary: Huatli gives Inti's cosmium-pommeled sword to Wayta, saying his Echo is in the gem.
quote: He's an Echo now. His spirit is here, in the gem.

summary: Huatli announces an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.
quote: I've received an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.

summary: Malcolm and Breeches climb out of the caverns and head for Sunray Bay.
quote: Climbing back out of the caverns had almost been worse than going in.

summary: Sunray Bay is found deserted and marked by spores.
quote: Sunray Bay was as deserted as Downtown, with the same signs of the Mycotyrant's handiwork

summary: Malcolm decides to warn High and Dry.
quote: We need to get to High and Dry

summary: Kellan and Amalia find an Omenpath.
quote: That's it. An Omenpath.

summary: Amalia sends word of Aclazotz's threat home through the Queen's Bay Company.
quote: she had sent word to her family and Queen Miralda through the remaining Queen's Bay Company members of the oncoming storm Aclazotz might bring.

summary: Amalia chooses to leave her world with Kellan and they leap through the Omenpath.
quote: Without another word, they leaped through the Omenpath, and everything changed.

summary: Quint explores Colony's End, a huge metal ruin.
quote: The place the Oltec called Colony's End jutted from the side of a mountain

summary: Quint recalls the Oltec story of colonizers whose vessels caged Chimil.
quote: Their stories described giants whose great, dark vessels appeared in the sky, blotting out the light of Chimil and then caging her within a metal prison.

summary: Quint finds coin bas-reliefs at the entrance to the ruin.
quote: bas-reliefs depicting the same coin motifs he'd discovered elsewhere.

summary: Quint finds a room of shattered tanks and one intact tank.
quote: this one held a long row of massive tanks, their glass fronts shattered

summary: Quint's touch lights up the intact tank, revealing a huge creature.
quote: With a deep clang, the tank lit up.

summary: The creature in the tank flexes its hand into a fist.
quote: The creature's fingers twitched.

summary: The Mycotyrant's surviving colony infects vampires camped in a jungle temple.
quote: One of them struck a swollen fungal sac with its blade, releasing a cloud of spores that settled on its skin like flies.

summary: The colony's hosts reach High and Dry aboard a ship, hiding behind dark lenses.
quote: A new body stood on the deck of a ship—such useful things, ships—and watched as it approached High and Dry.

summary: Aclazotz, in the hold of a ship bound for Torrezon, plans to conquer it and later destroy Chimil.
quote: Soon the ship would reach Torrezon, a land of sheep awaiting their promised shepherd to lead them to eternal life.

summary: Aclazotz singles out Vona de Iedo as the vampire he wants at his right wing.
quote: One vampire he craved above all others: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.

summary: Saheeli stands alone on a beach on Ixalan's northern coast, mourning the loss of planeswalking.
quote: Saheeli stood on the white sand of some lonely strand of Ixalan's northern coast.

summary: Saheeli tries to planeswalk and finds nothing.
quote: She tried. Nothing.

summary: Huatli trains playfully with her new quetzacama companion Pantlaza in the surf.
quote: She turned to see Huatli and Pantlaza

summary: Huatli shares her own grief at the loss of her spark.
quote: With my spark, I felt whole

summary: Saheeli theorizes their sparks were moved, not destroyed.
quote: Our sparks were moved. Not destroyed

summary: Huatli proposes they explore Ixalan together the slow way.

quote: Someone's compromised the evidence locker!

summary: The evidence room lies in ruins as Anzrag breaks free.
quote: The room containing the evidence locker lay in ruins, the walls completely shattered by the force of whatever had been released.

summary: Anzrag emerges from the dust and smashes an agent flat.

summary: Kellan identifies the creature as the Gruul harvest god Anzrag.
quote: The Gruul call him Anzrag

summary: Several agents are killed or injured as Anzrag rampages and Kaya leaps onto him.
quote: At least four people were down, two buried under chunks of masonry, one flattened by the god, and one sliced nearly in two by her claws.

summary: Kaya stabs Anzrag's nose while Kellan slashes his forelegs.
quote: Kaya struck him square in the middle of the tendril starburst, daggers biting deep.

summary: Ezrim challenges Anzrag while Kaya plans to use an evidence capsule.
quote: Ezrim was standing in the open space between the agent desks and the evidence pen

summary: Kaya phases through Anzrag's blow and traps him in the capsule.
quote: The capsule chimed, an incongruously pleasant sound, before expanding into a massive bubble, trapping Anzrag inside.

summary: Ezrim orders agents to fetch Yarus, whom he blames for the breakout.
quote: Find Yarus and bring him back here. I know he had something to do with this.

summary: Agrus Kos tells Kaya he must investigate alone, because it is too dangerous for a living person.
quote: this is too dangerous for a living person

summary: Proft leads Etrata down into Golgari territory, explaining that Korozda's rise reshaped the warrens.
quote: When Korozda rose to the surface, it changed the shape of the warrens below.

summary: Proft and Etrata meet Izoni in the ruins of an old guildhall.
quote: I would never have found you if you hadn't allowed it, Izoni

summary: Izoni analyzes the powder and says it is natural and biological but unknown on Ravnica.
quote: This is natural. Biological, at the very least.

summary: Izoni says the Swarm hides because of something not of Ravnica, and Proft fears the invaders have changed tactics.
quote: We may not have won as decisively as we all want to believe.

summary: Proft chases a hooded figure and is struck unconscious.
quote: fell as something slammed into the side of his head with force enough to take the rest of the world away.

summary: Agrus Kos descends to Rakdos's lava pit and finds the demon asleep under dust and moss.
quote: Rakdos lay curled at the burning center of the lava, eyes closed, seeming oddly peaceful.

summary: Judith captures Agrus Kos in a crystal skull.
quote: Judith stepped out of the shadows, a crystal skull in her hands, smirking at the place where he had been.

summary: Judith reveals she is planting clues to frame Rakdos and take over the guild.
quote: All I need to do is throw enough clues in front of those amateur crime-chasers, and this ends with me at center stage.

summary: In Proft's mind palace a hooded figure rifles through his files.
quote: A figure in a long, hooded cloak was rummaging through one of his drawers, looking at the files inside.

summary: The hooded figure says Ravnica is only a waypoint and takes a folder.
quote: Ravnica is a waypoint, not the destination.

summary: Etrata strikes Proft awake after he fell into a trance.
quote: I hit you when you wouldn't wake up

summary: Aurelia storms in and declares the Boros Legion at war with the Rakdos Cult.
quote: The Boros Legion marches to war.

summary: Delney delivers a note telling Kaya to meet at Karlov Cathedral alone.
quote: Meet at Karlov Cathedral. Come alone.

summary: Kaya arrives at Karlov Cathedral, prepared for Teysa's funeral.
quote: Kaya's carriage let her off in front of a cathedral dressed to the nines

summary: Proft and Etrata reveal they summoned Kaya.
quote: It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.

summary: Proft tells Kaya the killers are controlled by an outside force.
quote: The killers are being controlled by an outside force.

summary: Kaya confesses she found a Phyrexian-script note on Teysa's body.
quote: A note, in her own hand, but not her own language. It was written in Phyrexian.

summary: Proft announces he knows who is responsible and asks Kaya to arrange a gathering.
quote: I know who's responsible for this

summary: Kaya greets Judith, who arrives at Vitu-Ghazi in a Rakdos coach.
quote: The door swung open, and Judith stepped out

summary: Judith says Rakdos is preparing for war against the rest of Ravnica.
quote: His Viciousness is somewhat too preoccupied preparing for war against the rest of Ravnica

summary: Ezrim lands carrying Yarus, who was summoned as the Gruul speaker.
quote: Ezrim came gliding in for a landing

summary: Ezrim and Yarus confirm that Yarus did not free Anzrag, and Yarus thanks the Agency for sparing the god.
quote: Yarus didn't release Anzrag from the evidence capsule

summary: Ral, Vannifar and Krenko arrive; Kaya shows Krenko to Trostani's sanctum.
quote: Vannifar was the last of the guild leaders to arrive, shortly after Ral

summary: Aurelia confronts Kaya at the gathering with Massacre Girl chained beside her.
quote: Aurelia was the first to move, rising with a flurry of feathers from the leather armchair she'd been occupying

summary: Proft steps out of a shadow clapping, and Etrata reveals herself.
quote: Detective Proft stepping out of a shadow that couldn't possibly have concealed him for this long

summary: Proft argues the Guildpact exempts Etrata from consequences for her escape.
quote: I believe you'll find the Guildpact exempts her from any consequence for that action.

summary: Proft declares that the killer is in the room.
quote: our killer is here with us, in this very room.

summary: The guild leaders consent to the interviews, with Kaya consenting for the Orzhov and Izoni for the Golgari.
quote: The Golgari approve.

summary: Proft takes Kaya aside and a strange white root grows from the wallpaper into a bruise-colored flower.
quote: The movement proved to be a white, wormlike root, uncurling from the pattern in the wallpaper, spiraling into a thicker base.

summary: Proft traps the flower in an evidence jar as it emits yellow-gray pollen.
quote: Proft clamped a clear glass evidence jar over the flower just as it began to emit a puff of yellow-gray dust.

summary: Proft sets the jar before the assembled leaders to begin his presentation.
quote: He held up his jar, turning so that everyone would have a chance to see

summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

summary: Proft explains that loss of memory is the connecting thread.
quote: The loss of memory is the connecting thread.

summary: Proft calls out Judith for trying to throw blame on Rakdos.
quote: You've been trying, desperately, to throw blame on your own parun at every step along the way.

summary: Proft recounts Izoni's analysis of the powder.
quote: Izoni of the Golgari examined it on my behalf

summary: Proft says the flower is not Phyrexian and that his announced interviews were a ruse to bait the killer.
quote: This flower is not Phyrexian in origin.

summary: Proft reveals the killer must be a member of the Selesnya Conclave.
quote: This is a creation of the Conclave. Our killer is a member of the Selesnya.

summary: Proft explains that Vitu-Ghazi's roots could deliver the flowers anywhere in the city.
quote: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi spread throughout the city.

summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

summary: Lavinia agrees Proft and Etrata committed no crime.
quote: It'll take months to clear the paperwork, and I'm not happy about it, but yes, we're agreed

summary: Tolsimir falsely confesses to the killings.
quote: I sent my most faithful to confront the Agency lackeys after they came here to consult the Guildpact.

summary: Proft dismisses Tolsimir's confession, noting he lacked the ability to create the plant.
quote: Noble of you to try to take the burden of blame onto yourself, but you didn't do this

summary: Proft names Trostani as the mastermind behind all the killings.
quote: Trostani did this, all of it. She's been behind it all along.

summary: The room is stunned by Proft's accusation that Trostani is the killer and Ezrim asks Kaya if she knew.
quote: Ezrim looked to Kaya.

summary: Tolsimir insists Trostani cannot have done it because she cannot leave the healing tree.
quote: she can't leave Vitu-Ghazi while the tree is healing!

summary: Proft argues that Ravnica has been blaming Phyrexia for crimes it was capable of itself.
quote: It's become easy, in the aftermath of war, to blame everything on the Phyrexians.

summary: Oba breaks her calm and admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it.
quote: Because they deserved it

summary: Oba justifies the killings by claiming to be the heart of Ravnica betrayed by its guilds.
quote: We are the green and growing heart of this plane, and without us, there would be no Ravnica, no city, no guilds!

summary: Oba says she took the corruption of Realmbreaker into herself during the invasion.
quote: I fought the corruption of Realmbreaker alone.

summary: Oba accuses Krenko of hoarding and price-gouging during the invasion.
quote: was hoarding resources

summary: Oba accuses Zegana of experimenting with Phyrexian oil on ordinary creatures.
quote: Zegana was fascinated by the Phyrexian oil.

summary: Oba claims Teysa was in league with the Phyrexians.
quote: Teysa Karlov was in league with the Phyrexians, communicating with them in secret.

summary: Vannifar reveals Zegana was seeking a cure for phyresis with her consent.
quote: She was seeking a cure for phyresis, the spreading taint of Phyrexia

summary: Etrata reveals Teysa secretly spied on the Phyrexians for the resistance, working with House Dimir.
quote: She was working with House Dimir the whole time

summary: Krenko admits goblins died to get the supplies and he profited.
quote: Goblins died getting those supplies from behind enemy lines.

summary: Oba says she sent an assassin after Krenko and Kylox was in the way.
quote: I sent that assassin after the goblin, and your inventor was standing in his path.

summary: Oba declares she may need to kill everyone tempted by the invaders.
quote: Maybe cleansing Ravnica from the stains of the invasion means killing every soul who was tempted

summary: Oba says she has been killing for weeks and is not finished.
quote: I've been killing for weeks

summary: Aurelia attempts to arrest Oba, who points out her sisters cannot be held responsible.
quote: I formally place you, Oba of Selesnya, under arrest.

summary: Oba shakes the room and knocks Aurelia and Proft down.
quote: The room shook, not hard, but hard enough to drop Aurelia back to her seat and Detective Proft to the floor.

summary: Oba incapacitates her sisters Cim and Ses.
quote: Her sisters went limp, sagging on their single trunk like wilted flowers

summary: Oba separates from her sisters, ending Trostani as a unified being.
quote: Farther and farther from them she pulled herself, until she was, while still attached to the tree itself, an entirely independent entity, Trostani no longer.

summary: Thorny vines burst through the walls to seize the guild leaders.
quote: Thorny vines burst through the walls, grabbing for the assembled Ravnican leadership.

summary: Oba bats aside Ral's lightning and slams him into a bookshelf.
quote: a massive branch snapped across the room, slamming into Ral's chest and knocking him into the nearest bookshelf.

summary: Massacre Girl slips her chain and disappears.
quote: all at once, the assassin was nowhere to be found.

summary: Izoni withers the vines binding her with a vial of poison.
quote: She sprinkled its contents on the vines and watched dispassionately as they withered and dropped away.

summary: Tolsimir intercepts Yarus's charge and is impaled on the rafter.
quote: Tolsimir heard the sound and leapt for Yarus, knocking him away from Oba and driving the rafter straight through his own chest.

summary: Yarus defies Oba and Etrata takes the root spear meant for him.
quote: The spear smashed through the left side of her chest, shattering muscle and bone.

summary: Kaya decides Oba must die and Proft kneels by Etrata.
quote: after what Oba had admitted, she'd known the dryad had to die.

summary: Oba hoists Kaya and Kellan into the air as the ceiling opens.
quote: Above them, the ceiling opened like an iris, branches pulling apart to reveal an oblong section of sky.

summary: Judith breaks free and flees the collapsing hall.
quote: Judith broke free of a loop of root and fled for one of those openings

summary: Oba throws Kaya and Kellan, separating them and sending Kellan spinning into the sky.
quote: The force of the throw separated her from Kellan, leaving him spinning away into the sky.

summary: Kaya realizes Oba is drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself.
quote: She was drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya, ripping strength from the very plane and using it against the people she had designated her enemies.

summary: Kellan is saved from the fall by gold-rimmed fae magic.
quote: pure, gold-rimmed fae magic of the same kind his hilts produced now enveloped him.

summary: Massacre Girl intercepts the fleeing Judith and attacks her.
quote: This is for leaving me to the wolves

summary: Dragged through the air by a vine, Kaya reaches for her spark and calls on the Blind Eternities to help her resist the Ravnican Worldsoul.
quote: Kaya called the Blind Eternities, asking them not for an exit but for an escape

summary: Kaya slips through the vine, lands on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi and draws her daggers, while Oba howls in fury.
quote: Oba howled fury and disbelief as Kaya, still semi-solid, landed lightly on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi

summary: Kaya surveys the room: Krenko is almost absorbed into the wall and the guild leaders are entangled, including Ral, while Proft kneels by Etrata.
quote: The guild leaders had been entangled and subdued, even Ral

summary: Oba demands to know why Kaya will not die, and Kaya mocks her as she cuts down branches.

quote: Something wrapped around her waist, jerking her to a stop.

quote: A series of roots ripped through what was left of the floor and wrapped around her ankles.

summary: Kaya addresses the Worldsoul directly, arguing that a Ravnica that takes sides is no Ravnica and that Oba wants to turn it into something it is not, as the Phyrexians did.
quote: And I say a Ravnica that chooses one side over another is no Ravnica at all.

summary: Oba recoils, but Kaya remembers that this face of Trostani is responsible for Teysa's death.
quote: But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death

summary: Kaya pleads with Ravnica, the roots pass through her, and she races across the room to Oba.
quote: This time when she tried to phase, the roots passed right through her.

summary: Kaya seizes one of Oba's ghost branches with necromantic energy and uses it to confine her.

summary: Oba is bound and the room goes still; Ses and Cim put Oba to sleep.
quote: Each of them pressed a hand to her temple, and she went limp.

summary: Kaya chooses not to kill the captive Oba, as it would be an execution.
quote: She couldn't do it. No matter how much she wanted to, she couldn't.

summary: Kaya looks at the far end of the ward and finds no one there, and Ral and Kaya laugh in relief.
quote: They laughed not because they were amused, but because they were alive

summary: Etrata reveals she was playing dead and proposes becoming Proft's assistant, as House Dimir is all but gone.
quote: If you take one of us home, you have to keep us.

summary: Kaya frees the guild leaders; Aurelia drags Krenko off to be arrested.

summary: Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister, and that a rotten branch must be removed.
quote: Oba remains one-third of us; we have no way to sever her.

summary: Cim says Trostani will go into communion with Mat'Selesnya to learn whether she wants them to remain, and Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave.

summary: Ses promises the Guildpact will remain available to any who need it.
quote: Vitu-Ghazi is not fallen.

summary: Kaya leaves and finds Kellan unharmed outside, then cries for the first time since finding Teysa dead.
quote: In front of a very startled Kellan, she allowed herself to cry.

summary: Three days later Teysa's funeral is held at Karlov Cathedral, and her ghost sits beside Kaya.
quote: Three days later, Kaya sat in a pew at Karlov Cathedral

summary: Teysa's ghost tells Kaya she keeps leading the Syndicate in death and that it was she who helped in the fight at Vitu-Ghazi.
quote: Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate?

summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

summary: Kaya embraces her friend Teysa, who hugs her back.
quote: I thought I'd lost you,

summary: Kaya tells Kellan she is leaving in the morning to help Tyvar hunt a dire bear, and learns Judith is still missing and Proft has hired Etrata.
quote: I'm heading out in the morning,

quote: Proft's footsteps echoed as he walked into the chamber currently occupied by Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind and Living Guildpact.

summary: Proft asks how Niv-Mizzet could fail to notice Trostani's use of Ravnica to kill, and the dragon says he was otherwise occupied.
quote: "I was otherwise occupied," said Niv-Mizzet, somewhat stiffly.

summary: Proft raises Kylox's project, and reasons that Niv-Mizzet stood back because he was working on something larger than a few murders.
quote: the only reason you would stand back was because you were working on something bigger.

summary: Proft reveals he decoded Kylox's cryptex and knows about the Omenpath Project.
quote: I know about the Omenpath Project.

summary: Proft explains that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet says they are natural to Kaldheim.
quote: A phenomenon natural to the plane of Kaldheim.

summary: Niv-Mizzet explains the Omenpaths are his responsibility as Living Guildpact, as they could be used to exploit security gaps or smuggle goods.
quote: As Living Guildpact, they're my responsibility.

summary: Proft deduces that Niv-Mizzet plans to make Ravnica the hub of the connected Multiverse, and Niv-Mizzet confirms it.
quote: "Yes," said Niv-Mizzet simply.

summary: Proft offers his and Etrata's services to Niv-Mizzet, who is surprised and admits the deductive skills would be welcome.
quote: Your deductive skills would not be unwelcome,

quote: In his outstretched fist was a burlap sack.

summary: Archie sets off across the desert in a carriage with two Sterling guards, expecting bandits.
quote: His employer would never have provided two Sterling Company guards unless the job carried risks.

summary: A wall of fire stops the carriage and the Hellspurs kill the Sterling guards.
quote: Nearly a dozen holes appeared across the side of the carriage, and the Sterling guards fell immediately.

summary: Akul splits the carriage, takes the sack and declares the last key his, but finds only coal and flies into a rage.
quote: "Finally. The last key is mine."

summary: Archie dies in the burning sand while the real key gets farther away from Akul.
quote: For all he cared about punctuality, he never expected to be so early to his own death.

quote: A lockbox sat inside, untouched.

summary: Annie deduces that the Hellspurs left the money because they were after something bigger.
quote: But they left the money behind—which meant they were after something else.

summary: Annie brings the lockbox to Mr. Towning and they split the cash fifty-fifty.
quote: Annie watched him divide the cash into two equal parts.

summary: Oko, disguised as a city man, approaches Annie on her porch and she sees through his illusion with her golden eye.
quote: My name is Oko—and your ability to see through illusions is exactly why I've been looking for you.

summary: Oko offers Annie revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul, and she refuses.
quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

summary: Oko leaves a saloon matchbook and hints that the Hellspurs could easily find her town.
quote: If it was this easy for me to find you, imagine how easy it will be if the Hellspurs ever decide to come looking.

summary: Annie realises her old ghosts have followed her to the only place she cares about.
quote: her old ghosts had followed her to the only place left in the world that she truly cared about.

summary: Kellan works at the half-built relay tower in Omenport and reflects on the Omenpath that brought him from Eldraine.
quote: It was hard to believe it had only been a few weeks since he'd stepped through the portal.

summary: A technician's fault sends lightning through the relay tower and a worker falls from the scaffolding.
quote: From the height of the tower, the man fell.

summary: Kellan flies up on golden dust and catches the falling worker midair.
quote: Golden dust burst from his feet as he flew toward the man and wrapped his arms around him midair

summary: Ral dismisses the accident and walks away without looking at the fallen worker.
quote: He marched away without another glance toward the fallen worker.

summary: Kellan tells the worker that Ezrim told him his father was on this plane and that he is looking for him.
quote: My last boss, Ezrim—he told me my dad was on this plane.

quote: Mr. Zarek thinks someone with your skillset should be on his security detail instead of working out here in the heat.

summary: Kellan hopes someone in Prosperity can tell him about Oko and resolves to meet his father.
quote: The odds of at least someone in the city having information about Oko were bound to be high.

summary: Elnor demands to know where the money went, and Yuma retorts.
quote: "Where did the money go, Yuma?"

quote: We would leave the Riveteers, where we'd all spent our youth.

summary: In flashback, the squat's owner impounds their gear, so the crew turns to crime to pay the back rent.
quote: So, obviously, it would have to be crime, the main industry in New Capenna.

summary: In flashback, the crew blows safes and robs trains while Elnor charms guards and clerks.
quote: we blew safes and teased open vaults, we muscled our way through trains on rickety bridges.

quote: We borrowed the money to buy it.

summary: Yuma runs off down the Omenpaths, abandoning his friends and taking the money.
quote: Just ran off down the Omenpaths, not knowing where I was going.

summary: Yuma throws a bottle at the snake demon and stuns it, then gets his thunder bow working.
quote: the bottle shattered against the creature, making its jet of fire blue for a second.

summary: Elnor says she has been hunting Yuma for a year and he says the money is gone.
quote: The money's gone. I spent it.

quote: Heat exhaustion comes up on you unawares is what I've learned since then.

quote: Low ground turned out to be a dry riverbed, cool water under the sand. So, I lived.

summary: Yuma reveals the money is the bar itself, which he runs with his staff as a collective.
quote: "Fine. I lied. It's not gone. You're standing in it."

summary: Elnor snaps her fingers and the fight resumes, with both of them missing and bottles being vaporized.
quote: She snapped her fingers; the snake came to attention.

summary: Yuma runs for the mezzanine and Elnor sets the staircase on fire behind him.
quote: she aimed calm as you please and set the stairs on fire behind me.

summary: Yuma blocks a jet of flame with his forearm, which is badly burned, while Kirri watches from a hole in the wall.
quote: I raised my forearm instinctively against the jet of flame, felt the fire hit it, and screamed in pain.

summary: Yuma recalls the train heist and realizes that Elnor now fights like Shadress, meaning Shadress is dead.
quote: She was fighting like Shadress .

summary: Yuma shatters the bar mirror with his thunder bow and fights Elnor hand to hand, throwing the snake demon off her.
quote: I fired my thunder bow at the long mirror behind the bar.

summary: A sudden desert rain puts out the fires, and Yuma pins Elnor, choosing not to kill her.
quote: And then I knelt on her sternum, grabbed her wrists, and it was done.

summary: Yuma tells Elnor the past is dead and that Thunder Junction is a place to invent yourself.
quote: "The past is dead," I said. "It's over."

summary: Kirri makes vines grow through the burnt saloon, filling the holes with red flowers.
quote: Kirri just invented them.

summary: Elnor concedes, retrieves her snake and leaves without looking back.
quote: She walked out without looking back.

summary: Unable to sleep after Oko's threat to her town, Annie digs up her buried thunder rifle.
quote: pulled the lid back to reveal her thunder rifle.

summary: Annie summons Fortune and rides to Rustwood following Oko's matchbook.
quote: Annie took Oko's matchbook from her pocket and looked at the black lettering once more.

summary: Annie meets Breeches, Malcolm and Tinybones at the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko is waiting behind the bar.
quote: "Care for a drink?" Oko's voice sounded from behind the bar.

summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.

summary: Annie agrees to join the crew, but only as far as stopping Akul.

summary: Oko announces the crew will rob Maag Taranau, a vault Annie thought a myth.
quote: "We're going to rob Maag Taranau," he said at last.

summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

summary: Oko explains that Bertram Graywater holds the key and that the courier Akul chased was a decoy.
quote: he had Akul halfway across the desert chasing a decoy courier

summary: Oko says the first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters, where two team members are imprisoned and the key is held; Rakdos arrives.
quote: Our first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters,

summary: Disguised as a courier, Oko enters Sterling Company headquarters carrying a box with Tinybones inside.
quote: The moment he stepped over the threshold, Oko surveyed the room.

summary: Eriette dissolves a vent grate with Breeches's potion and charms the prison guards while Annie slips past.
quote: Eriette stepped forward and whispered a spell under her breath

summary: Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells and Eriette frees them.
quote: Kaervek was on one side of the room; Satoru Umezawa was on the other.

summary: Tinybones emerges from the box in Graywater's office and Umezawa finds Oko there.
quote: Tinybones burst from the lid, partially disassembled.

summary: Umezawa and Oko open a hidden safe behind the portrait and take the sixth key.
quote: The sixth key.

summary: Oko, leaving, meets Ral Zarek and Kellan on the road and senses Kellan's fae magic; his illusion collapses.
quote: Oko stiffened, and his illusion faded away without warning

summary: Oko and Tinybones knock out Ral's guard and flee, Oko taking eagle form.
quote: He shapeshifted into a large eagle

summary: Kellan tells Oko he thinks Oko is his father, and that his mother is Alyse.
quote: "I think you're my father."

summary: Surrounded by Sterling guards, Oko is saved when Kellan throws the guards back with golden vine-shaped magic.
quote: Confusion swirled through Oko's mind until he realized the magic was coming from Kellan.

summary: Vraska appears and Ral stops, stunned to see her alive; Rakdos knocks Ral aside.
quote: Rakdos swung a boulder-size fist into the lightning mage and sent him skidding off into the dust.

summary: Oko decides Kellan should join them, announcing that he is his son, over Vraska's objection.

quote: She'd been dreaming of the Night Owl.

summary: Helga tells Mabel, Clem and Oliver about Maha's attack and the destruction of Pondside, but Oliver doubts her.
quote: Your imagination seems a touch overactive, which is to be expected of an artistic temperament.

summary: Oliver reassures the guests that Calamity Beasts do not trouble Valley, while Helga recalls the history of weavers and Lily of the Valley.
quote: The unpredictable ones, the Blight Snake and the Drought Cat and so on, don't intrude on the affairs of us little folk in Valley.

summary: Mabel tells Helga that she believes her visions, and decides someone must travel to Pondside.
quote: "Someone must travel to Pondside," Mabel said.

summary: Mabel retrieves her family's fang-sword from the attic and its sigils glow for the first time.
quote: The sigils on the blade briefly gave off a faint reddish light

summary: At the lively birthday party Helga appears in the doorway and Oliver gives his speech praising Mabel.
quote: "Neighbors—nay, friends," Oliver began

summary: Mabel publicly defends Helga, announces she will go to Pondside, and reveals the fang-sword, which sheens with flame.
quote: a faint sheen of flame rippled along the carved tooth from hilt to tip.

summary: Finneas, Hugs, Gev, Zoraline and Helga volunteer to accompany Mabel to Pondside.
quote: "You must take me, too,"

summary: Mabel says goodbye to her children and Clem before leaving at first light.
quote: "You are my sweet and brave little mouselings, and I will love you from spring to winter and back again."

summary: The party departs Goodhill for Pondside amid fanfare.
quote: the party departed for Pondside.

summary: On the road Gev tells a tall tale of the Striped Rapscallions, which Mabel says is his way of coping.
quote: the stories are Gev's way of coping.

summary: The party reaches the ruins of Pondside and Hugs and Mabel read tracks showing the villagers went south toward Haymeadow.
quote: Haymeadow, likely. It's closer than Goodhill.

summary: Two squirrelfolk necromancers are found looting the wreckage and mention Cruelclaw and the owl's earlier attack.
quote: Helga's skin crawled. The last one? So, her dream-vision was true?

summary: The necromancers raise skeletons and the party fights them.
quote: dozens of gleaming eyes surrounded the Goodhill delegation.

summary: Helga makes water steps so Mabel can reach the birds, but loses control of the spell; Mabel still kills the skeleton.
quote: With a sound like a bubble popping, the stairs fell to splatter the soil.

summary: The necromancers flee toward the Long River, and the party decides to follow them to Three Tree City.
quote: "We follow the squirrelfolk," she said. "To Three Tree."

summary: Helga packs keepsakes from her grandparents' damaged home before leaving.
quote: Why did she take her grandfather's wand, set his wide-brimmed hat on her own head?

summary: Otterfolk carry the party by boat to Three Tree City's Docklands.
quote: They arrived at the Docklands beneath the drooping tendrils of the willow

summary: Mabel meets Ral Zarek, an otterfolk hunting Jace Beleren, who grabs Helga after seeing her drawing.
quote: "Ral," he replied. "Ral Zarek. I'm looking for someone named Jace Beleren."

summary: Helga describes her vision of Jace with a green and black lizardfolk and a hard-to-see creature, and Ral decides to keep her in sight.
quote: Right now, you're my only link to Beleren, so I'm not letting you out of my sight.

summary: The river surges and the Flood Gar, a Calamity Beast, attacks the Docklands.
quote: "The Flood Gar!" Helga screamed.

summary: A great wave sweeps the party into the Long River where Hugs keeps everyone afloat.
quote: Mabel sucked in a deep breath and clung to Hugs

summary: The current slows and the party washes ashore in a marshy cave, where hooded ratfolk surround them and tell them to leave.
quote: "Outsiders," a ratfolk hissed. "You are not welcome here.

summary: The party is surrounded by ratfolk in a cavern, but elder Coffey calls them guests and invites them in.
quote: "The River brought them to us. We must offer them hospitality."

summary: Coffey explains they are lorekeepers who preserve Bloomburrow's history.
quote: We preserve the history of Bloomburrow and Valley within it.

summary: Coffey shows an image of Cruelclaw, a scarred weaselfolk mercenary leading a band through the swamp, the Night Owl in his wake.
quote: He led his band through the swamp, pilfering what supplies he pleased, the Night Owl wreaking havoc in his wake.

summary: Coffey reveals that Cruelclaw stole a Calamity Beast egg, which may give him power over the beasts.
quote: Our scouts reported that he had in his possession a Calamity Beast egg.

summary: Mabel resolves to find whoever commands Cruelclaw and return the egg to its place.
quote: "Then we return the egg to its rightful place."

summary: Ral pledges to keep the group alive as long as Helga is his link to Jace.
quote: so long as Helga is my only link to Beleren, I'll be sure to keep you all alive.

summary: Helga attempts an augury with a basin of water, and after calming her mind sketches Fountainport's fountain, divining Cruelclaw's destination.
quote: "They've gone to Fountainport," Helga whispered.

summary: The party leaves the ratfolk village; Tucker warns of a strange dangerous creature near the shortcut.
quote: I'm told it's not a Calamity Beast, but it's very like one.

summary: On the dandelion shortcut, Ral tells Mabel he misses his husband Tomik.
quote: "I miss my husband, too."

summary: A vast shadow passes and a storm gathers, revealing a four-winged lightning-wreathed dragon-hawk.
quote: A giant creature hovered in the air, purple lightning crackling across its body.

summary: Ral identifies the creature as an animal-shifted dragon from another plane.
quote: "It's a dragon," Ral whispered back.

summary: Zoraline sneezes awake and the dragon-hawk dives at the party.
quote: It swooped toward the party, who alternately ducked or scattered.

summary: Finneas shoots a copper-wire arrow, Zoraline disorients the creature, and Ral channels a storm of lightning into it.
quote: The wild, natural energy tore from the clouds, striking the head of the dragon-hawk

summary: The dragon-hawk retreats into the clouds and the party shelters under a boulder with Helga's water barrier.
quote: The falling drops solidified into a thin barrier perpendicular to the rock

summary: Mabel leads the group onward to Fountainport.
quote: "On we go, then," Mabel said

summary: Helga leads her companions up through Fountainport to seek an audience with King Glarb, her former master.
quote: In theory, we ask his aides for an audience.

summary: Helga recounts how she was dismissed after accidentally hitting King Glarb with his own water whip and staff.
quote: He spent days recovering from the concussion. And the staff broke.

summary: The party is admitted to the throne room and tells King Glarb about the attacks and Cruelclaw's theft.
quote: A weaselfolk called Cruelclaw stole a Calamity Beast egg

summary: Helga pulls aside a screen and reveals the Calamity Beast egg, which King Glarb says he paid Cruelclaw to bring.
quote: "I paid Cruelclaw extremely well to bring it here."

summary: King Glarb reveals his plan to control the Calamity Beast within the egg as a champion for Valley.
quote: with the right weaving, I can control the Calamity Beast within that egg.

summary: King Glarb binds the party and orders Cruelclaw's Direshades to kill them, mocking Helga as a failure.
quote: "Direshades, take them," Cruelclaw ordered.

summary: Helga, encouraged by Mabel, uses a water-step spell to send Cruelclaw sliding into the king, breaking the bonds.
quote: With a jerk of her chin, she sent him sliding toward King Glarb

summary: A battle breaks out in the throne room between the party and the Direshades.
quote: Every enemy who sought to strike her found only empty air as her magic obscured her movements.

summary: Mabel fights Cruelclaw, her sword bursts into flame, and she disarms him and spares his life.
quote: "Leave with your life," Mabel said.

summary: King Glarb freezes Helga in ice and Mabel melts it, and the king rises on a water platform as a storm gathers.
quote: jammed her flaming blade into the frozen block.

summary: The Storm Hawk dives at King Glarb, who escapes by portal.
quote: From between streaks of electricity, the Storm Hawk emerged with a deafening roar.

summary: Mabel climbs Helga's water steps to the stone lily and challenges the Storm Hawk, but Maha, the Night Owl, strikes it first.
quote: struck by a new foe: Maha, the Night Owl, trailing a curtain of darkness.

summary: Maha drives off the Storm Hawk, taking all remnants of foul weather with it.
quote: The Night Owl's talons closed on the Storm Hawk's tail feathers, wrenching one free.

summary: Mabel carries the egg to the Night Owl and returns it, calming the Calamity Beast.
quote: The Night Owl gingerly took the egg.

summary: King Glarb leaves Fountainport and Cruelclaw escapes, while the party heads home.
quote: King Glarb not only fled the immediate area, he left Fountainport entirely, his whereabouts unknown.

summary: The returning heroes are welcomed with a parade in Goodhill, and Oliver gives another speech.
quote: treating their arrival as an impromptu parade.

summary: Helga decides to stay in Goodhill as a hedgewitch and is called a hero.
quote: I thought maybe I could … stay here? As a hedgewitch

summary: Helga speaks a prophecy that the kings in the dark will return and the mage in blue will bring about the end.
quote: "The kings in the dark will return," she intoned. "The mage in blue will bring about the end."

summary: Mabel gives Ral two holly-leaf buttons for him and his husband, and Ral vanishes in lightning.
quote: Ral vanished in an explosion of lightning sparks that lit the evening

summary: In a flashback many years ago, a family arrives at an old house; the door swings open of its own accord to welcome them.
quote: the door swung open of its own accord, as if to welcome them home

summary: In the flashback, Marina notices the basement door standing ajar and senses that something patient waits below.
quote: That door stood ajar, revealing a thin slice of stairs descending into the darkness.

summary: Now, Kaito sneaks through Otawara past the Soratami drones to steal an iron scroll.
quote: Pressing himself flat against an alley wall, Kaito Shizuki watched a drone soar by

summary: Kaito knocks out a guard at the changing of the guard and picks the lock of the treasure room.
quote: Kaito moved behind the guard and hit him on the back of the head with the pommel of his sword.

summary: Kaito finds the scroll protected by a spider kami's spirit web and asks Himoto to unweave it.
quote: A spider kami hung above the scroll in a delicate spirit web

summary: The white-haired Wanderer appears behind Kaito and blocks his blade with her own.
quote: The white-haired woman standing behind him offered a slight smile, her sword still lifted to prevent him from completing a stroke.

summary: The Wanderer tells Kaito she needs his help because Nashi is in trouble.
quote: I came because I need your help. Nashi's in trouble.

summary: Kaito, with the scroll in hand, tells the Wanderer he will return it to Genku, Tamiyo's widower, by morning.
quote: Genku will have his lost wife's scroll back in the library come morning.

summary: The Wanderer reveals Nashi has been missing for three months.
quote: Three months.

summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

summary: The Wanderer says she traced the door's echo through the Omenpaths to Ravnica, where Niv-Mizzet guards it.
quote: I found it on Ravnica, being guarded by Niv-Mizzet.

summary: On Kaldheim, Tyvar fights a lone wolf and knocks it back with a stone-fisted punch.
quote: The wolf, which was easily twice his size, leapt, and Tyvar swung a mighty left hook at the soft underside of its jaw

summary: Kaito finds Tyvar and recruits him for the rescue; Tyvar eagerly agrees.
quote: When do we leave?

summary: Tyvar vouches for Niko Aris, a former planeswalker, as the defensive fighter Kaito needs.
quote: I think I may have just the hero that you need

summary: Niko splits Trygve's thrown axe, and then their own, with two throws.
quote: The first struck the handle of Trygve's axe, splitting it lengthwise.

summary: Niko shows their shard magic, says the invasion did not take it, and agrees to come along.
quote: Can't let the Planeswalkers have all the fun.

summary: Kaito arrives on Ravnica and wonders why he kept his spark when so many others lost theirs; Niko is bitter at their loss.
quote: Kaito stepped out of forever onto the streets of Ravnica

summary: Kaito meets Zimone, a Strixhaven student sent by Niv-Mizzet to wait for him.
quote: I'm Zimone. I'm a student? Quandrix College, at Strixhaven University.

summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals that a girl called Aminatou has already arrived, saying the team will need her help; Niko recognizes the name.
quote: A young girl, younger than Zimone here, who calls herself Aminatou.

summary: Niv-Mizzet admits the necromantic contamination warning is a pretext to clear the area for research.
quote: We just needed to clear the area to conduct our research.

summary: At the door, researchers surround it; Aminatou recoils in fear and warns that it hears them.
quote: Aminatou gasped and recoiled as her eyes locked on the door.

summary: Zimone reports that Nashi's drones recorded a house with distorted space on the other side.
quote: Just a house, perfectly normal, if in need of a good cleaning service.

summary: Aminatou explains her fateshifters, which rewind a fatal choice once, and says anyone refusing them will not come back.
quote: When you make a choice that would lead to your certain death, everyone nearby who holds a token will see the outcome

summary: Aminatou hands out the fateshifter tokens, giving the Wanderer a second.
quote: She handed them around the members of the team, giving the Wanderer a second.

summary: The Wanderer asks Aminatou to mind Yoshimaru while the team goes in.
quote: Will you mind Yoshimaru for me?

summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

summary: The narrator greets new arrivals in the parlor and invites them to sit, promising only a moment's rest.
quote: You're safe here, for the moment.

summary: The narrator explains that Duskmourn is both the world and the House.
quote: The House is the world, the world is the House, and the word for both is Duskmourn

summary: Flashback: the people of the plane, discontent with scarce magic, learned to summon hungry creatures from the void.
quote: The people of what became Duskmourn learned the art of summoning creatures from the lifeless void, beings of hunger and raw strength.

summary: Flashback: a creature too great to control was bound in an ordinary house, and someone accepted its contract, freeing it to feed.
quote: when it offered them a contract, they accepted. They paid its price, and it was finally free to feed.

summary: The House swallows the rest of the world until only Duskmourn and survivors in its walls remain.
quote: The House was a bloated corpse swallowing the rest of the world

summary: Something changes and the House learns to open new doors in new places, reaching out to feed on other worlds.
quote: all at once, the House could open new doors, in new places.

summary: The narrator reveals the guests are trapped by the chairs they sat in willingly, and that the House will take its first bites of them.
quote: if I can convince people not to fight it long enough for it to take the first few bites, it lets me keep my little space

summary: The narrator bids farewell, staying behind as the House feeds on the guests.
quote: As long as I can keep feeding my dining hall, it won't feel the need to feed on me.

summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
quote: The door's gone

summary: Zimone realizes the room is not the one Nashi's drone recorded, so the House rearranges itself.
quote: This isn't the same room that it recorded.

summary: Kaito reads the air in the parlor and concludes someone was recently there.
quote: I don't know if Nashi was here recently, but someone was

summary: The Wanderer finds a family photo with the adults' faces scratched out and the daughter smiling.
quote: The faces of the adults had been scratched out, reduced to white scabs on the paper

summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

summary: The Wanderer refuses Kaito's idea of scouting the rooftops, insisting the group stay visible to one another.
quote: You were the one who realized we had to stay ever visible to one another.

summary: The Wanderer says the House feels like a shell encasing all that remained of the plane, and decides they should return to where the door vanished.
quote: This feels like a shell surrounding everything there is of what once was, and I fear it has no limits.

summary: A voice cries for help and Tyvar runs toward it; Zimone chases him.
quote: Tyvar's thin leash on his own heroic urges snapped, and he took off running

summary: Zimone races after Tyvar through the doorway as something shatters beside her head and the ballroom disappears.
quote: Something shattered on the doorway next to her head as she ran through

summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an empty hall with no one in danger and conclude the House is playing tricks.
quote: On the other side of the door was an empty hall.

summary: The doorway behind Tyvar and Zimone becomes a solid wall papered with moths, separating them from the others.
quote: where the doorway back to the ballroom should have been, was a wall

summary: Kaito and Niko realize the doorway moved and skewed Niko's aim, so the trap was deliberate.
quote: The doorway moved as Tyvar passed through it.

summary: Kaito steps toward the doorway and the floor opens into a toothed mouth; he falls into blackness as the Wanderer fails to catch him.
quote: The floor he stepped onto opened like the mouth of a lamprey

summary: Niko holds the Wanderer back from jumping after Kaito, and the hole disappears.
quote: The Wanderer tensed as if to jump after him, only to stop when Niko grabbed her wrist.

summary: Tyvar and Zimone discover their hallway has turned into a towering library when they stopped looking.
quote: They were no longer in a hallway.

summary: Tyvar turns his skin to wood and punches through the wall, finding a stairway beyond.
quote: Tyvar's skin rippled, taking on the hardwood sheen of the floor beneath his feet

summary: Zimone ties a fractal thread to Tyvar and stays in the library to study the books while he climbs the stairs.
quote: I'll keep the other one, and hopefully that means we won't lose each other.

summary: Tyvar climbs a stairwell lined with portraits of people distorted into monstrous shapes.
quote: The walls of the stairwell were decorated with painted portraits of ordinary people

summary: Tyvar's climb leads back into the same library, where Zimone waits.
quote: He was back in the library.

summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
quote: I was sorry to kill her.

summary: Niko and the Wanderer enter a freezing meat locker with hanging carcasses.
quote: heavy iron chains hanging from the ceiling, the hooks at their ends driven into massive cuts of meat

summary: A stranger yanks Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass, just before a masked figure appears.
quote: yanked them hard behind the nearest hanging, flensed behemoth

summary: A tall razorkin with a cleaver stalks through the carcasses toward them.
quote: a figure came stalking through the carcasses, tall and wiry.

summary: Winter lures the razorkin into a beartrap by rattling a chain and leads Niko and the Wanderer out.
quote: only to step into a beartrap that had been concealed by the fog on the floor.

summary: Winter explains razorkin from the Floodpits track sound and that fighting one head-on would lose.
quote: The ones you find in the Floodpits aren't used to hearing sounds not echoed through water.

summary: Winter tells them he has lived in the House most of his life and that the House is the whole world.
quote: The House is the world, and the world is the House, and once it has hold of you, there's nowhere else to go.

summary: Dawn sits on the carnival's border wall throwing stones at snapping roses, dreaming of leaving to join the Benefactors.
quote: Dawn sat on the rough stone wall that marked the border between the carnival's safety and the treacherous roses to the west

summary: Dawn sees the foragers returning and runs to meet them.
quote: Delight washed through her and she jumped down

summary: Dawn notes Rill's wounded arm, Sunset's limp and City's unharmed state, which she finds suspicious.
quote: it wasn't right for two members of a raiding team to come back injured when the third looked completely fine

summary: Rill describes an ambush in a cold room and Sunset reveals the attackers were wickerfolk, which the detectors were not keyed for.
quote: Our detectors weren't keyed for wickerfolk.

summary: Sunset reports another group of strangers with glimmers, and the narration recounts the great shaking and the new doors appearing.
quote: Strange doors had begun to appear outside the safe zones.

summary: City, urging the others to hurry, tells Dawn that things have changed and that Duskmourn can now hunt.
quote: And now, Duskmourn can do what we've been doing all along.

summary: City reveals a tabard with a moth's wings and invites Dawn to join the Cult of Valgavoth, serving the Devouring Father.
quote: There's still a place for those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father, among the Cult of Valgavoth.

summary: A massive razorkin kicks down the fence and an army of monsters pours into the carnival; Dawn flees.
quote: A massive razorkin was kicking down the fence, what looked like an entire army of Duskmourn's monsters following close behind.

summary: Dawn runs as the carnival falls behind her.
quote: Dawn ran, and the carnival fell, screaming, behind her.

summary: Winter stops Niko and the Wanderer from stepping on the moths woven into the carpet.
quote: Don't step on any of the moths!

summary: Winter explains that the door they came through was a lure and that Duskmourn now holds them.
quote: But when you tried to turn around and go, the door wasn't there anymore.

summary: Niko instinctively reaches for their spark and finds only void.
quote: they found nothing where that tiny flicker of the Blind Eternities should have been, only void

summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

summary: The Wanderer draws her sword on Winter and warns him not to taunt them.
quote: Her sword, which had been belted at her hip, was suddenly in her hands, the blade only inches from Winter's face.

summary: Winter explains that the House splits groups to isolate and frighten them.
quote: That's Duskmourn, splitting you from your friends

summary: Winter reveals that razorkin are rebuilt survivors the House beguiles into slaughterhouse skins.
quote: Duskmourn repairs and rebuilds the people it takes, the same way an upholsterer might re-cover a couch.

summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

summary: Winter explains that everyone in Duskmourn has a glimmer; Niko asks where theirs is.
quote: Everyone in Duskmourn has one.

summary: The glimmer leads the group through a doorway on a safe path.
quote: the glimmer began to swim through the air to a doorway on the far wall.

summary: Kaito falls through the floor with Himoto clinging to him.
quote: Himoto's claws dug into his shoulder as she anchored herself, refusing to be separated from him

summary: Kaito lands on a forest floor beneath the ballroom, unhurt despite the fall.
quote: his descent ended in a hard impact with what felt like a forest floor.

summary: A dragon appears overhead and burns the dying forest.
quote: The shadow swooped by again, this time accompanied by a brilliant burst of flame

summary: The dragon's fire engulfs Kaito, and he finds himself on a burned plain beside a burning city, in what feels like a staged performance.
quote: it was a performance being put on for Kaito's benefit—or for the House's.

summary: Dozens of dragons circle a burning city in the vision.
quote: Dragons wheeled through the sky overhead, dozens of them, their attention fixed on a burning city.

summary: The vision tears like paper and Kaito stands in a basement with a dying candle light.
quote: he appeared to be standing in an underground room with rough stone walls and a staircase in one corner

summary: Kaito senses someone approaching and punches Jace in the face.
quote: he whirled, driving his right fist square into the face of the slender, dark-haired man who'd been walking up behind him.

summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

summary: A groaning sound fills the basement and Kaito and Jace stand back to back, agreeing to fight later.
quote: Jace and Kaito both stiffened, instinctively falling into position back to back

summary: Zimone and Tyvar remain in the library as Zimone researches.
quote: The library had remained a library, to Zimone's delight and Tyvar's disappointment.

summary: Zimone discovers the house was built by an architect who lived there with her family and has had many owners.
quote: the original architect lived here with her family, a long, long time ago

summary: Zimone reports the library focuses on occultism and entropy-based magic that may explain the House.
quote: mostly it's occultism and the kind of magic that makes Professor Vess recommend you rethink your academic goals.

summary: A ripping sound sounds nearby and the bookshelves begin to warp as a creature emerges.
quote: warping into strange, asymmetrical shapes

summary: A six-eyed, clay-skinned creature leaps from the twisting hole and attacks Tyvar.
quote: It slammed into Tyvar's chest, claws digging deep into bare shoulders as it twisted to rip his throat out.

summary: Tyvar throws a marble bust at the creature's head to draw it from Zimone.
quote: He grabbed the closest of them, feeling the structure of the stone bleeding into his skin, and flung the bust as hard as he could at the creature's head.

summary: Tyvar says he has been working on his legend since his spark blew out.
quote: I've been working on my legend since mine blew out.

summary: Tyvar stomps through the creature's sternum, killing it.
quote: driving his foot through the creature's sternum

summary: The creature pulls itself back together and rises again.
quote: The creature was pulling itself back together

summary: Tyvar and Zimone flee into the shadows of the library.
quote: together they turned and fled deeper into the library

summary: In a nightmare memory, Dawn flees the burning carnival as survivors die behind her.
quote: Dawn ran, and the carnival that was the only home she had ever known burned behind her

summary: In the dream, City looms from the woods, saying the Devouring Father is still hungry.
quote: The Devouring Father is still hungry

summary: Dawn wakes screaming in the attic encampment, annoying the guards.
quote: Dawn woke up screaming, kicking off the thin blanket

summary: Dawn recalls how she found an unguarded tunnel to the attic and warned its leads before monsters attacked the carnival's doors.
quote: Finding an unguarded tunnel to the attic encampment had been sheer luck

summary: Survivors her age treat Dawn with suspicion because her escape was convenient.
quote: most of the survivors her own age treated her with suspicion

summary: The House has turned hostile, attacking or erasing every settlement in recent weeks.
quote: Every settlement and gathering place they still had contact with had been attacked in the last weeks

summary: Dawn builds a shock box from a kitchen device and a battery in her workshop.
quote: Prying the bottom off her metal rectangle, which she was already beginning to think of as a shock box

summary: Dawn activates her shock wand and thinks of Rill, who she fears is dead or transformed.
quote: Rill was never going to see.

summary: A bang and total silence tell Dawn that the attic's occupants have been killed.
quote: There was a certain quality to the absolute silence that descended on a room whose occupants had been killed.

summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

summary: Dawn emerges to find few bodies, with skins taken by razorkin, and takes a machete.
quote: There were very few bodies.

summary: Dawn travels through the Mutemoors toward the Floodpits to seek the Benefactors.
quote: She had heard rumors the Benefactors would be found there.

summary: A glitch ghost reaches for Dawn from a shard of glass; her shock wand shatters it as the battery dies.
quote: She aimed her shock wand at it and pressed the button that should increase the voltage

summary: The ghost shatters just as the wand's battery expires, leaving Dawn defenseless.
quote: the ghost shattering into a million specks of light even as the battery crackled and expired

summary: Survivors pull Dawn into a disused theater and welcome her to the Benefactors.
quote: We heard you'd been looking for us.

summary: The Benefactors take her wand to install fresh batteries and Dawn feels safe, though City's words echo.
quote: She was safe here.

summary: The glimmer of Kyodai leads Winter, Niko and the Wanderer through the House, ignored by its horrors.
quote: The gleaming golden shadow of Kyodai led them onward

summary: Winter explains that glitch ghosts enter the House through reflective surfaces.
quote: They use reflective surfaces to enter the House.

summary: A glitch ghost drags itself from a mirror toward Niko.
quote: a shuddering entity began to drag itself from the mirror frame

quote: A wave of his hands sends the armored toughs charging straight at her.

summary: Chandra's fireball passes through an illusion of Jace.
quote: An illusion. Of course.

summary: Chandra sees that the golden wall trapped racers including the Aether Rangers.
quote: The Aether Rangers aren't the only ones who got caught in the trap, either.

summary: Jace casts a spell of misty white that turns the wrecked racers' eyes white and makes them attack Chandra.
quote: Spirals of magic flash around Jace; a net of misty white surrounds the racers still pulling themselves from the wrecks.

summary: Racers charge Chandra as one, including Captain Howler and Redshift.
quote: As one, they charge.

summary: Vraska orders her group to apprehend Chandra hidden in a wreck.
