quote: The pyromancer's in there. Apprehend her.

summary: Guarded by her father, Sita plans to use her last aether canister to cross the finish line.
quote: Most important of all, she still has one canister left.

summary: Guards seize Pia and put a blade to her throat as Chandra is dragged away.
quote: The guards grab Pia by the hair, put a blade to her throat

summary: Sita injects aether instead of racing to the Aetherspark.
quote: Canister meets port; aether meets bloodstream.

summary: Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia.
quote: Sita throws off the hands keeping her in place, rushes past her hapless father, and dives straight for Pia Nalaar.

summary: Chandra, Pia and Sita fight together as Team Avishkar.
quote: Engine, wheels, and transmission. Chandra, Pia, and Sita.

summary: Daretti sends drones to scout and Loot wakes from Jace's control.
quote: Even Loot's woken up

summary: Vin broadcasts live from behind a statue as the fight rages.
quote: It's your in- vin -cible pal Vin, reporting live from the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

summary: Jace unleashes a punishing mind attack on Chandra and the others.
quote: Whatever magic Jace is using against her is nasty stuff

summary: Jace picks up the little creature from Chandra's crumpled form.
quote: He watches as Jace picks up something from Chandra's crumpled form—a little creature of some kind.

summary: An archangel shields Vin from the dragon's fire.
quote: Hovering before Vin is an angel.

summary: Nissa arrives riding vines toward the stadium to reach Chandra.
quote: Nissa surfs through the streets toward the Ghirapur Stadium.

summary: Nissa sees Elspeth fighting the dragon.
quote: Elspeth's got the dragon handled.

summary: Nissa finds Chandra, Pia and Sita collapsed.
quote: Crumpled before the remnants of a great ship: Chandra, Pia, and that other girl she'd seen on the broadcast.

summary: Nissa sees Jace scoop up the limp creature.
quote: She turns to see Jace scooping up a limp, small creature.

summary: Jace calls Vraska away, leaving with Loot.
quote: We're leaving, Vraska,

summary: Nissa begs them to stay but a magical fog covers their escape.
quote: But by then, a haze of magical fog overtakes the clearing, and Nissa knows it's no use.

summary: Winter, with a broken leg, tries to cross the undefended finish line on foot.
quote: The rules don't say anything about crossing the finish line on foot.

summary: Basri shields civilians with sand that turns to glass in the dragon's heat.
quote: Basri Ket conjured waves of sand to shield the fleeing civilians

summary: Zahur and Basri realize they have crossed the finish line first, and Zahur declares the Aetherspark's blessing.
quote: For life, for death, for Amonkhet.

summary: A door appears and Winter is dragged back to hell as the Amonkheti win.
quote: But they will make no mention of the man so close to victory dragged with awful finality back to hell.

summary: Elspeth heals Chandra's injuries with concentrated light.
quote: Concentrated light illuminates Chandra's forehead, her back, her ribs

summary: Elspeth warns that a storm of primordial magic is leaving dragons on planes that never knew them.
quote: A raging storm of primordial magic has been flowing between worlds, leaving dragons in its wake.

summary: Elspeth blesses Chandra and Nissa and vanishes in a flash.
quote: And many blessings on your relationship.

summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

summary: Chandra hugs Sita and introduces Nissa.
quote: You really saved me and mom out there!

summary: The Champions receive the Aetherspark together as a team.
quote: When they receive the Aetherspark, it is as a team—no one person's hand touches it before any other.

summary: On a cliff overlooking the steppes of Tarkir, a man in blue and a woman stand while a sleeping, restless creature is held in his arms.
quote: A creature is asleep in his arms.

summary: Mehtma leads her seven charges, including Enti and Gohl, into the Kin-Tree chamber to be accepted into House Fenzala as adults.
quote: Today the Kin-Tree will accept you into our house with the full honors and responsibilities of an adult.

summary: Mehtma, resentful of teaching during the siege, watches Cemil on duty in the chamber and recalls wanting to serve Khan Felothar.
quote: Mehtma was ready to make a name for herself, to see Abzan in all its glory, to serve Khan Felothar.

summary: Vauti brings Mehtma's rationed coffee but no cream, because the militia has blockaded the stables.
quote: Our stables have been blockaded by the militia.

summary: Mehtma confronts Jurjis, who is requisitioning her cows as unreported and claims there is no permit on file.
quote: I am requisitioning these unreported cows.

summary: Mehtma learns that Sultai necromancy reached the arena district and that Jurjis controls all supply through his office.
quote: Last night, Sultai necromancy reached all the way into the arena district,

summary: A Sultai artillery barrage punches through the city's ceiling, killing the clerks and wrecking the old marketplace.
quote: All three clerks were dead, one scarcely more than a smear of blood and flesh where the artillery stone had made its initial impact.

summary: Mehtma and Vauti rally onlookers to lift a fallen beam and Mehtma crawls beneath it to reach three trapped youths including Gohl.
quote: The beam precariously balanced above her, she shimmied in,

summary: Mehtma drags one youth out just before Vauti lets the beam drop, and tells Gohl to take charge of the others.
quote: Vauti bugled, and the beam dropped with a heavy thud.

summary: Mehtma glimpses her cows being led by Cemil and chases him to the east gate, finding the guard posts empty and the gate ajar.
quote: Her cows, in the distance, passing through one of those spears of sunlight, being led by Cemil .

summary: Cemil flees toward the outer gate and Mehtma races up to the top of the wall to cut him off.
quote: Cemil dropped the cows' lead and bolted into the darkness, up the enclosed ramp, toward the outer gate.

summary: On the ramparts Cemil attacks Mehtma with a Sultai sickle and she overpowers and disarms him.
quote: She swept a foot against the back of his knee, brought him sprawling down, and wrenched the blade out of his hands.

summary: Cemil says krumar will never be seen as truly Abzan and that he was never House Fenzala but Sultai.
quote: "I was never House Fenzala," he said. "I am Sultai."

summary: Cemil reveals the deal he made with Jurjis and flings himself off the battlements into the Sultai fog, dragging Mehtma until he lets go and falls.
quote: he let go of her wrist and fell into the mist.

summary: Mehtma realizes the cow ruse was a distraction so that Cemil's passphrase could get House Agach into the Kin-Tree chamber.
quote: Which Cemil, assistant to the warden, had. The betrayal was unthinkable.

summary: Mehtma finds the sanctum open and Jurjis kneeling by the body of young Enti.
quote: The body was young Enti, the little loxodon who always had a question.

summary: Jurjis declares that he will take a cutting of the Kin-Tree because his house has been refused one, and the two fight.
quote: But my house has been refused a Kin-Tree for too long.

summary: Jurjis wounds Mehtma and, axe raised, threatens to chop down the Kin-Tree.
quote: I was only going to take a cutting, but now I'll let you see me chop it down,

summary: Enti's ancestor-spirit steps out of the Kin-Tree in golden armor and lends Mehtma strength.
quote: A glowing gold figure stepped out of the tree, a loxodon in gleaming armor,

summary: Mehtma drives Jurjis back and kills him with Cemil's Sultai sickle.
quote: Jurjis collapsed face down, dead.

summary: Enti's spirit vanishes and a single bud opens into a sun-bright flower in the Kin-Tree.
quote: Within the canopy, a single bud had opened into a delicate sun-bright flower.

summary: Mehtma and Councilor Dvujin search Jurjis's office and find the letters to the khan never sent.
quote: These were never sent.

summary: Mehtma persuades Dvujin to appoint her captain of logistics in exchange for burying Jurjis's corruption.
quote: Appoint me captain of logistics, and I'll make Jurjis's corruption and collusion with the Sultai

summary: Now addressed as Captain, Mehtma drinks her coffee with cream.
quote: "As you requested, Captain."

summary: Narset watches a masked traveling troupe prepare in a crowded tavern near Dirgur Lake Monastery.
quote: She sat just close enough to be able to hear the two giggling to one another in a halfway familiar dialect.

summary: The troupe opens its show, and a performer is suddenly wearing a mask of Ojutai that Narset sees in her nightmares.
quote: Recognition jolted through Narset.

summary: The performer appears in a death-mask version of Narset's face as the hero of the story, and a Temur patron objects that Narset had to be persuaded.
quote: wore Narset's face, or at least the version someone would engrave onto a death mask

summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
quote: snake-headed Silumgar, Atarka with her crown of antlers, spined Kolaghan, Dromoka shining like the sun, and of course, feathered Ojutai

summary: Narset remembers her years as Ojutai's favored student and admits that in saving Tarkir she lost her dragon.
quote: In saving Tarkir, Narset lost her dragon.

summary: A Sultai noble tells the Mardu engineer how a hungry Mardu boy killed her for two days of rice.
quote: He killed me for two days' worth of rice.

summary: The performers change masks to portray the five rebellion leaders, each clan's hero.
quote: they were masked again, this time in the images of Eshki Dragonclaw and Alniul, the Twice Whisperer

summary: The crowd roars and Narset has a panic response, calming herself by counting.
quote: After a few moments, the panic eased its grip, enough that Narset could breathe again.

summary: The performers conjure a diorama of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon and narrate the discovery of the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset recalls the desperate gamble.
quote: It'd been a gamble; they had no idea what the ritual would do.

summary: Illusory spirit dragons fly overhead as Narset reflects on each clan's dragon and on her lack of love for Shiko.
quote: But she didn't love Shiko, no, not with those wings of hers, like so many scrolls unfurling through the air

summary: Narset stops the quarrel and tells how the dragons were unformed and she first leapt onto one, binding herself to Shiko; they rode into battle and drove the dragonlords into the storm.
quote: I was the first to leap onto one.

summary: Narset warns the crowd that the dragonstorms have grown worse, reshaping the land and spawning wild dragons.
quote: They've become strong enough to reshape the very land.

summary: A breathless man bursts in seeking the waymaster and announces that a winged woman with glowing eyes has arrived.
quote: She has wings , my khan. And glowing eyes.

summary: Narset names the visitor as Elspeth and fears something terrible has happened.
quote: Her name is Elspeth,

summary: Elspeth arrives on the Jeskai skyship Storm Crane and a small child asks if she is a dragon, frightening her mother.
quote: And you have four other limbs

summary: Narset greets Elspeth, who explains that dragonstorms have begun appearing across the Multiverse and asks how Tarkir kept them at bay.
quote: Dragonstorms have begun appearing throughout the Multiverse.

summary: Narset reflects on Ajani, Tamiyo and her lost spark, and Elspeth recalls the cost of bringing Ajani and Nissa back.
quote: It cost everything to bring him and Nissa back.

summary: Narset shows a map of how Tarkir's dragonstorms have become more potent, with reports of scales growing on the steppes and new, hungrier dragons.
quote: So much so, they've begun to reshape Tarkir itself,

summary: Narset theorizes that Ugin's departure unleashed the stronger storms, since he served as a metaphysical ballast.
quote: It has something to do with Ugin's departure, I am sure of it.

summary: Narset refuses to modify the ritual and confesses that it may have destabilized Tarkir's balance and caused a chain reaction.
quote: it may have destabilized the delicate balance in Tarkir, resulting in a chain reaction.

summary: Bells ring and Narset announces that a wild dragon is inside the school.
quote: There's a wild dragon inside the school !

summary: Narset and Elspeth find the dragon, which has gored through the hull and is closing on six trapped youths behind a girl's barrier.
quote: it had gored its way up through the ship's hull, chewed its way through wood and metal.

summary: Elspeth dives into the dragon's mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children.
quote: Elspeth dove headfirst into the open maw, sword held out like a beacon.

summary: The wounded dragon flees to the deck and then off the ship while skyriders engage it.
quote: It began to writhe back, struggling to escape its attackers

summary: Elspeth says she will respect Narset's decision, and Narset promises one in the morning.
quote: I'll give you my decision in the morning.

summary: After the damage count, Narset gives Elspeth a guest room and Elspeth says Ajani spoke kindly of her.
quote: Ajani said very kind things about you.

summary: Taigam warns that Elspeth is an omen and that her arrival may have provoked the attack, and urges Narset to send her away.
quote: Send her away, Narset. As far away from the Jeskai as it is possible,

summary: Narset tells Elspeth the Jeskai cannot help, then reveals she will go herself.
quote: But I can.

summary: Asham meditates and practices a dragon-inspired flame form on an obsidian outcrop, but no flames come.
quote: But no flames manifested.

summary: Asham relives his humiliating defeat by a Temur fighter, ended in a single strike.
quote: The fight, all over in a single strike!

summary: Asham tumbles into the lake and is greeted by his old friend Ru.
quote: "Ru!" Asham gave a powerful kick

summary: Asham and Ru play-fight on the lake surface until Ru pulls Asham under.
quote: a pair of hands emerged from the surface of the lake and grasped Asham around the ankles, pulling him down.

summary: Asham confesses that he lost to the Temur wanderer and believes he let the monastery down.
quote: I let the whole monastery down.

summary: Asham and Ru argue about Ru having refused the monastery's call, then Asham reveals he wants to learn the final form and win a rematch.
quote: You're conflating opportunity with destiny, Asham.

summary: Ru tells Asham a loss is not dishonor, then offers to learn the form from him by sparring.
quote: Show me this form.

summary: Ai Wen, leaving the mountain happily, eats persimmons and is halted by a monk demanding a rematch.
quote: I am Asham of the Cori Mountain Monastery. And I have tracked you down to demand a rematch.

summary: Ai Wen refuses the rematch, saying their earlier bout was not a match, and throws Asham off the path into bushes.
quote: sent Asham sprawling down the cliffside.

summary: Asham conjures dragonfire for the first time and attacks Ai Wen.
quote: Asham standing, hands ablaze and held out in a talon pose.

summary: Ai Wen defeats Asham, breaking his ribs, and says their first bout was no fair match between an elder and a disciple.
quote: a fight between an elder and a disciple is no fair match.

summary: Ai Wen praises Asham's pride and breakthrough, and Asham passes out as Ru approaches.
quote: I leave you in good hands.

summary: Asham wakes in his village home, tended by Ru, who told the monastery he fell down the mountain.
quote: I told the monastery you, uh, fell down the mountain,

summary: Asham admits that joining the monastery was a way of running away and resolves to visit the other monasteries to broaden his training.
quote: To expand my training.

summary: Ru kisses Asham and promises to be there when he returns.
quote: And I'll be here when you return,

summary: Wild dragons tear apart a wounded dragon and it crashes into the grass.
quote: And down went the hunted behemoth, crashing shoulder first into a tract of tall grass

summary: Ajani kills a gazelle with his axe and reflects on his guilt over what he did while enslaved to Elesh Norn.
quote: Ajani struck, and he struck true: his axe cleaved through the gazelle's neck

summary: Ajani carries the gazelle home, and something stirs in the dust behind him.
quote: Behind him, something in the dust woke.

summary: Nur visits Ajani's hut, teasing him as a hero, and brings food.
quote: I was given a shameful amount of food and thought I would share it with you.

summary: Nur calms an ancestral maelstrom of spirits that gather behind Ajani.
quote: Nur's work proved uncannily effective.

summary: Over a meal, Nur urges Ajani to accept Abzan help and warns he is dying slowly of spirit.
quote: This isn't living. This is just a death deferred.

summary: Ajani recalls attacking Jaya on the Mana Rig and answers Nur that his isolation might be punishment.
quote: Ajani would never forget Jaya's face as she plummeted from the Mana Rig

summary: Narset sneaks away from the monastery with Elspeth on a young dragon eager to join the quest.
quote: And so Narset saddled the young dragon

summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

summary: A mysterious voice calls them to a temple as a dragonstorm gathers overhead; Narset sends her dragon away.
quote: Above, a storm began to gather, serrated clouds giving way to the suggestion of eyes, bared teeth.

summary: Sarkhan emerges at the Crucible, saying he is looking for hope in the dragonstorm and that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.
quote: All of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.

summary: Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.
quote: The blast sent Sarkhan crashing to the ground ten feet away, panting and boneless and stunned.

summary: Elspeth sheathes her sword and warns Sarkhan she will kill him if he attacks again.
quote: If you attack us again, I'll kill you.

summary: Wounded and humiliated, Sarkhan limps back to his hut in Mardu territory, mourning his lost power.
quote: He walked for hours from the Crucible to the cold fields of Mardu territory.

summary: Taigam introduces himself to Sarkhan, claiming to have something he wants.
quote: My name is Taigam,

summary: Nishang, rotting from a wasting disease, rants in a tavern against the new Sultai order that makes sibsig an honor.
quote: They made being a sib an honor now and gave all our captives rest.

summary: The barkeep expels Nishang after his diseased arm grabs him and ends up thrown into the fire.
quote: "Get out," screamed the barkeep, "and don't you ever come back!"

summary: A glowing purple carp appears to Nishang on his houseboat, and he loses an eye as it binds his boat to it.
quote: That purple light extended to the boat, pulling it in close and binding it to the fish.

summary: Nishang's body falls apart in the swamp and he dies.
quote: He felt his head fall forward, the skin tear, the tendons snap

summary: Nishang awakens as an undead sibsig and meets what appears to be Titsui, who says Sidisi saved them both.
quote: I was wounded, mortally, but I was saved by the only one who may have loved our master more than us: Sidisi.

summary: Titsui explains the plan: Nishang will attend Dauna's ceremony for the newly undead carrying poisons from Sidisi in his new arm.
quote: Poisons gathered by Sidisi during her tenure of service to our master

summary: Sidisi appears and Nishang swears to serve, offering a piece of his soul to seal the pact.
quote: I will give anything and everything to bring back all that we've lost. I swear to serve.

summary: In Kheru City a woman crowns Nishang with a garland and kisses him, but his hot metal hand burns her and he apologizes.
quote: clutching the back of her arm, where Nishang's metallic fingers had brushed her, burned her.

summary: In an alley, Nishang doubts Titsui's story and learns that his friend was killed by a Sultai priest; the figure is revealed to be a rakshasa.
quote: revealing the monstrous form of a rakshasa beneath.

summary: Nishang helps a boy to his feet and realizes sibsig can feel and are like the living, but the rakshasa takes control of his body.
quote: The rakshasa was controlling him, totally and completely.

summary: Controlled by the rakshasa, Nishang marches with the sibsig into Kheru Temple, where Teval and Dauna preside.
quote: harkened the entrance of Teval, the spirit dragon, and judge of the Sultai

summary: Dauna addresses the sibsig and invites them to be anointed in the pool.
quote: join me as we anoint you into this glorious future!

summary: Nishang enters the pool and the poison from his arm spreads, killing hundreds of sibsig.
quote: the poison expanded, turning what was once tender blue a violent orchid.

summary: Dauna impales Nishang with a chained blade and hoists him from the water as the sibsig dissolve.
quote: a blade that had been shot through him and was now lodged in place.

summary: Nishang pleads that he has changed, but part of his soul remains in Silumgar's grip.
quote: But part of his soul would always be in the grip of Silumgar.

summary: Sarkhan, desperate to regain his draconic form, hunts a young dragon for its heart under Taigam's direction.
quote: This is how you fly with a dragon's wings once more,

summary: Sarkhan spears the dragon and Taigam binds it with blue fire to pin it down.
quote: The blade sank through the dragon's cheek and then deeper

summary: Sarkhan cuts out the dragon's heart, chants with Taigam, senses the spell's corruption, and bites into the heart.
quote: he bit down into the organ.

summary: Abzan outriders arrest Narset and Elspeth near the stormplains and take them to Arashin for questioning.
quote: Incarceration by the Abzan was not part of Narset's plan.

summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

summary: Ajani prepares to lead Abzan riders in a gazelle hunt, unsettled by the herd and Nur's words.
quote: Much to his chagrin, Nur had gotten into his head with that last conversation.

summary: A wave of magic panics the herd and the Abzan dragons throw their riders as a huge red dragon rises with a flight of smaller ones.
quote: a dragon of improbable size: red-scaled, triumphant, roaring as dozens of its smaller brethren rose to join it.

summary: Ajani recognizes the giant dragon as Sarkhan in his transformed dragon form.
quote: It was Sarkhan in his dragon form.

summary: Khan Felothar receives Narset and Elspeth before the Council of Houses and insists on lengthy hospitality, delaying their mission.
quote: We have all the time in the world.

summary: House heads squabble about trade and the waymaster's intrusion while Narset explains they are seeking a temple promised by a voice at the Crucible.
quote: we were told by a voice in the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon that there was a temple we needed to find in the dragonstorms.

summary: Ajani bursts into the chamber to report that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.
quote: Sarkhan Vol has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.

summary: Elspeth and Ajani are reunited and speak of Melira's sacrifice and the past he cannot leave.
quote: She died saving me,

summary: Felothar asks to hear more and Ajani begins to tell his tale.
quote: And Ajani told his tale.

summary: Paala dreams of the night her family's caravan was attacked and her mother fled with her and the baby Refia.
quote: Paala only running, running, running from a danger she didn't understand

summary: Paala wakes in the manul tent on the night before the Lightning Proving, teasing with Refia.
quote: Paala woke with a gasp, sitting bolt upright in the bedding, sending pillows and kittens flying.

summary: Paala remembers how a Mardu hunting party found her family and took them in, and how her mother came to tend their manul kittens.
quote: a Mardu hunting party that had been tasked with scouting and following the storm had stumbled across the three of them

summary: Paala tells her mother she must complete the Lightning Proving to prove she belongs among the Mardu.
quote: I'm doing this. I'm of age now

summary: Refia brings Paala a yearling manul for the trial and urges her to catch a big bolt.
quote: Put them all to shame.

summary: The captain begins the proving and Altan accuses Paala of shaming the rite.
quote: You shame the proving by your participation.

summary: Altan ambushes Paala with a knife in the foothills but his falcon falls in a rockslide and pins his leg.
quote: they both went tumbling down the rise.

summary: Paala frees Altan from the rocks, saying it is the Mardu thing to do, and agrees to take him to the summit.
quote: It's the Mardu thing to do.

summary: An archer shoots at Paala, and Paala charges, takes her bow and quiver and sends her away.
quote: A hard yank, and it came free.

summary: Paala finds a viper nest and marks it with arrows to warn other candidates.
quote: marking the spot for whoever followed her.

summary: At the summit Emina throws stones at Paala, insisting she can never be Mardu.
quote: You'll never be Mardu,

summary: Lightning strikes and in a vision of viper-headed lightning Paala offers her hand and seizes a bolt.
quote: pulling the snake—seizing the lightning—from the storm.

summary: Paala wakes tied to her saddle as Emina, Altan and the archer lead her back toward the band.
quote: Her hands were tied to the pommel of her saddle

summary: Emina and the elders affirm that Paala reached the lightning first and was kind to her peers.
quote: Paala was the first to reach the summit,

summary: Paala takes the name Paala, clan's aid, and claims her manul as Lightning.
quote: I will be Paala, clan's aid, and here's where I belong.

summary: Ajani asks Felothar to release Narset and Elspeth without waiting for consensus so they can try to quell the dragonstorms.
quote: they need to go on their way to see if there is a way to quell the dragonstorms.

summary: Felothar frees the three and announces evacuation and fortification of Arashin.
quote: You three are free to go.

summary: Narset warns that Sarkhan could bring thousands of dragons against Arashin, and the council doubts her.
quote: It will be thousands of dragons.

summary: Nur arrives and confirms that hundreds of dragons are already in Sarkhan's army.
quote: My scouts report there are already hundreds of dragons in Sarkhan's army.

summary: Felothar declares the Abzan will focus on preparation and dismisses the visitors, providing them with supplies.
quote: You will be provisioned with whatever you might need.

summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

summary: Elspeth tells Ajani he was forgiven before their fight began, and Narset invites him to help stop the dragonstorms.
quote: You were forgiven before our fight even began.

summary: Ajani refuses to join them and walks away.
quote: And he was gone before Elspeth or Narset could say another word

summary: Narset and Elspeth step into the dragonstorm, shielded by blue light, and walk toward a bright light amid forming dragons.
quote: Narset stepped into the storm and Elspeth followed.

summary: The storm falls silent and they find a massive ancient temple that Narset does not recognize from any records.
quote: There is a temple in the heart of the storms,

summary: Narset and Elspeth find an Omenpath in a subterranean antechamber and step through.
quote: Nothing to do but step through, then,

summary: Elspeth sees endless water while Narset sees stairs, and they realize this Meditation Realm is a distraction hiding something.
quote: The Meditation Realm. I've been here before.

summary: Narset hears a weeping voice whispering a name, and Jace Beleren appears.
quote: Jace Beleren stood on a rime of white sand

summary: Jace reveals he escaped compleation by force of will, and Narset theorizes how.
quote: I was on my way to that, yes. But I am not anymore.

summary: Jace introduces Loot, a creature whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and Narset questions whether Loot consented to this state.
quote: He is a map of everything .

summary: Jace evades Elspeth's question, saying he did what he needed to.
quote: What I needed to.

summary: Ureni sees blue threads binding the sleeping Temur and standing vigil over a camp of the dead.
quote: Azure wraps around the people of the Temur as they sleep, leaping from one family to the next, binding wrists and throats and tongues.

summary: Eshki wrestles a camp champion at a festival and pins him.
quote: Before he knows what's happened to him, she's got him pinned.

summary: Alniul arrives with a hunter carrying a stag with glowing blue eyes and asks to speak to Ureni.
quote: We need to speak to Ureni.

summary: Eshki and Alniul visit Ureni, who tells them it cannot give guidance and that they have two weeks.
quote: Two weeks.

summary: Alniul climbs alone beyond a sacred boundary to speak with the spirits and returns weakened, naming Rainveil.
quote: Rainveil,

summary: Eshki and Alniul travel toward Rainveil Forest, tending to the dead and quelling those who would abandon the sick.
quote: We do not leave our clan behind,

summary: They find a whole camp dead around a burned-out fire, and Eshki weeps that night and remembers their names.
quote: But, that night, she lets herself weep, and she remembers their names.

summary: They enter silent Rainveil Forest and follow blue streams to a glowing lake where Surrak lies wounded.
quote: Surrak is paler than Eshki has ever seen him.

summary: Surrak, bound to the cursed ground, tells Eshki to leave him and argues that the weak should be left behind.
quote: Everything has to die.

summary: Alniul stops Eshki and Surrak from fighting with walls of frost and gets Surrak to agree to help.
quote: both Eshki and Alniul hear the painful rattle of it.

summary: Alniul begins the ritual song with Eshki and Surrak at their sides, summoning snow visions of spirits.
quote: they begin to sing.

summary: The spirits of those who died in the forest voice their sins of survival, and Alniul asks Eshki whether she welcomes them.
quote: do you welcome those who have transgressed in the name of survival?

summary: Eshki remembers how she wounded Surrak with ice and recognizes she cast aside the spirits too.
quote: When she drove the ice into Surrak's chest, she told herself she'd done it for the sake of progress.

summary: Eshki welcomes everyone to the fire and brings Surrak into the song, and a reindeer wanders into the clearing at dawn.
quote: And as dawn breaks on Rainveil Forest, a reindeer wanders into the clearing.

summary: Months later, Eshki, Alniul and Surrak share a meal and Surrak vows to take back his clan someday.
quote: I will take back my clan from you one day.

summary: In a flashback, Vraska urges Jace to stop using Loot's mind, saying Loot keeps trying to hide from him.
quote: He keeps trying to hide from you.

summary: In the flashback, Jace admits he reaches into Loot's mind, Vraska compares it to what he did to Chandra, and they argue over whether the cost is worth it.
quote: You hurt her, Jace. You hurt her badly.

summary: Vraska begs Jace to let the dead rest, and Jace refuses, insisting he must fix everything.
quote: I know what I have to do.

summary: In a later flashback, Jace pursues Loot into a dragonstorm and puts him under with magic against his will.
quote: wrapping him in an unbroken blue light

summary: In the present, Jace says they are trapped in the Meditation Realm, and Narset tells her companions to empty their minds so the realm stops fighting.
quote: It's our thoughts that are trapping us in this shifting space.

summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

summary: Ugin explains that he has made the realm a prison for his brother, to be kept until Bolas dies millennia from now.
quote: So, I have made this our prison

summary: Narset asks Ugin for help against the dragonstorms and he says he cannot.
quote: I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do.

summary: Bolas learns his name from Elspeth's argument and begins to remember.
quote: Is that my name?

summary: Jace, who has already shifted to an illusory double, seizes the gem between Ugin's horns and an explosion of light follows.
quote: Jace closed his hands over the gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns

summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

summary: Narset rescues the terrified Loot as Elspeth fights Jace.
quote: I've got you,

summary: Jace explains the realm is a hub of reality that he can mold by will, to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did.
quote: This place is a substrate to all of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will.

summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
quote: It was Vraska herself.

summary: Jace, wielding the stolen power, shows glimpses of lost futures, but the strain breaks him and the realm begins to unmake itself.
quote: revealing a nothingness that ate at the eye

summary: Jace shatters like glass as emptiness rolls over him, and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

summary: Narset carries Loot as they flee.
quote: Narset, a wailing Loot in her arms, did as she was told.

summary: Sarkhan, bound to the dragons by the ritual, resolves to destroy the temple that rivals his control.
quote: And the first thing he needed to do was destroy the temple.

summary: Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the Meditation Realm burns away.
quote: Bolas and Ugin winking out of existence, eaten by the nothing, dead now, perhaps.

summary: Elspeth carries Narset and Loot through the Omenpath into the temple, where Vraska takes Loot.
quote: they were on the other side: outside the temple, Elspeth in the air, Vraska somehow beside her, arms held out for Loot.

summary: Narset climbs out and sees the sky black with dragons, and Elspeth names Sarkhan.
quote: "He's here."

summary: Vraska escapes with Loot under a camouflage spell as Narset and Elspeth decide to stand against Sarkhan.
quote: Tarkir is my home.

summary: Elspeth challenges Sarkhan in the air and says she is not afraid of him.
quote: I am not afraid of you.

summary: Narset fights the dragon flock, redirecting their momentum, and recovers her inner center.
quote: Narset found what she had lost: her center

summary: Ajani, riding with Felothar, sees Narset in danger and decides to leap from his dragon.
quote: he really could just choose to do something.

summary: Ajani lands and beheads a creature about to bite Narset, and the Abzan dragons descend upon Sarkhan's flock.
quote: the dragons of the Abzan clan rose from the storm and descended upon Sarkhan's flock.

summary: Elspeth plunges toward Sarkhan's open mouth as her last stand.
quote: Elspeth pulled her wings close to her back, plummeting through the sky like a stone

summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

summary: Sarkhan, stung with shame, vows to bathe the Multiverse in fire and goes after Elspeth.
quote: I want to bathe the Multiverse in fire for what it has done to me.

summary: Ajani catches the falling Elspeth and says he came to fight with her in the present.
quote: To fight with you in the present.

summary: Abzan dragons suffer mounting casualties, and Narset, Ajani and Elspeth plan to blind Sarkhan.
quote: If each of us goes for one of his eyes, we might be able to blind him

summary: Ugin arrives and the wild dragons flee.
quote: The wild dragons simply fled, shrieking their terror

summary: Ugin burns Sarkhan with ghostfire and Sarkhan dives away through the storm.
quote: Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

summary: Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
quote: Nicol Bolas, I am afraid, is free.

summary: A narrator voice asks the reader to make choices that keep the story going, including leaving the Metalman unable to retrieve it.
quote: I need you to prevent the Metalman from retrieving me.

summary: The Monoists kill Sothera into a supervoid rather than let it explode into a supernova.
quote: So, they killed the star.

summary: Mirri weftwalks away from Sami and vanishes, and Sami is determined to find her.
quote: Mirri weftwalked—and vanished.

summary: Sami and Tannuk aboard the Seriema perform main engine cutoff after their flight plan is rejected by Pinnacle.
quote: The flight computer stills the main engine.

summary: Sami decides to land at the deserted Sigma's Reach and take it for all it's worth, to save it from abandonment.
quote: they are going to land at the deserted colony and take it for all it's worth.

summary: The Seriema braking through Sigma's atmosphere detects a Sunstar palestar warship, which flies off after something else.
quote: The palestar's taking off toward the other side of Sigma, chasing something else.

summary: Sami suspects the Metalman's request is a job rather than a favor, and he sent them to find an artifact.
quote: No. He said artifact .

summary: The Seriema approaches Sigma's Reach from the east at sunset of Sothera's black hole.
quote: Sothera is now a supervoid, a black hole sun.

summary: Sami and Tannuk find Sigma's Reach brightly lit with a welcome sign even though the Metalman said it was empty.
quote: WELCOME TO SIGMA'S REACH—POPULATION 13,879 PLUS FRIENDS AND FAMILY

summary: Scans show the colony hot, with elevated carbon dioxide and a fission plant but no living thing.
quote: No. Not one living thing.

summary: Despite his awful feeling, Tannuk does not ask Sami to abort, and they begin to land.
quote: Let's take a look. And then decide how much we can steal.

summary: Pinnacle, drawn by the Kav's furious emigration, comes to Sothera, builds the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
quote: We came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost—an eternity column designated Infinite Guideline —and opened the system to the rest of the connected Edge.

summary: The Monoists capture Sothera's collapse and turn it inward into a supervoid, making it their thousandth.
quote: Sothera is that thousandth supervoid.

summary: The Kav begin an exodus from Kavaron after centuries of mining that destabilized their world.
quote: Decades have passed since Exodus Day, when the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface.

summary: The Monoists settle Anuki and rename it Susur Secundi.
quote: It has been decades since the Monoists settled Anuki and renamed it Susur Secundi

summary: The Palatinate sends Sunstar Free Company knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights to drive the Monoists out and deploy one of their javelins

summary: Farakatolar's squad flies out to investigate a drifted fragment of Kavaron possibly a memorial vault, passing the glowing ruin of their world.
quote: Here, in this incandescent catastrophe, is the reason for all her missions.

summary: They find a twenty-kilometer white structure unlike any memorial vault, and the scope cannot image it.
quote: The ship slows and the white edge of a structure emerges from the darkness.

summary: Haronar lands on the structure and the squad drills through the wall, then cuts into the next chamber.
quote: The wall, though, doesn't crumble beneath Rakoro's blade. It peels back and curls up like skin.

summary: The squad finds the glowing blue orb on a pedestal, but the wall reseals itself behind them.
quote: but the hole itself is gone.

summary: The artifact vanishes from the room and the radio from Haronar degrades.
quote: But it's clearly gone, not even a mark where the pedestal was.

summary: The walls turn opalescent and the squad finds doorways and a corridor, then encounters an oily humanoid that touches Takoluk.
quote: "It touched me!"

summary: Takoluk's skull is found smashed in with no visible attacker, and a voice vibrates in their heads.
quote: But his skull has been smashed in.

summary: Dornnuk, driven by stimulants, tears off his armor and scales and runs off down the corridors.
quote: he screams and runs down the corridor, scraps of armor and skin flying.

summary: Farakatolar and Rakoro find a vast spherical chamber with the artifact on a platform at its center.
quote: on a small floating platform at the center of the massive space: the artifact.

summary: A swarm of millions of tiny things floods in, swallows Rakoro and condenses to a point before disappearing.
quote: Rakoro swings her axe uselessly, covered and drowning in the tiny things.

summary: Farakatolar reaches the artifact and loses contact with Haronar, who is praying.
quote: it's the desperate mumblings of a prayer.

summary: A voice declares escape incorrect and that from the many there must be one Vaar; Farakatolar realizes the orb is a node of the Vaar's knowledge.
quote: The Vaar. It is an old myth.

summary: Farakatolar reaches into the node, is pierced and grips the object inside as she is crushed to death.
quote: Until there's nothing left.

summary: Sami and Tan land at Sigma's Reach and find a colony still in its wrap but with lights on and a dinner smell.
quote: Someone got here before us.

summary: Sami spies into a house and finds a freshly served dinner and a house that welcomes them, though the Choprights never arrived.
quote: The Choprights aren't here to receive guests right now.

summary: Sami finds hundreds of warm, used empty slipsuits strewn on the avenue.
quote: There are … slipsuits. Empty slipsuits. Everywhere.

summary: Sami suspects the Metalman sent them to limit his losses, but Tan insists on staying with Sami and reports a cat-like sound near the mining sheds.
quote: Captain, I think it's a cat.

summary: Tan questions the colony viy about evidence of people and it gives mechanical excuses for each sign.
quote: They were not. There are no people here.

summary: Sami runs toward the mining face and sees glazed impressions of bodies in the clay, which the viy dismisses as lightning fulgurites.
quote: Baked into the clay. Glazed impressions of bodies, twisting in anguish.

summary: Sami enters a processing shed and falls into the QA cyst where a stone moves in the inspection pool.
quote: "QUALITY ASSURANCE CYST ZERO-ONE."

summary: Sami tries to catch the stone in a hotcell as it whispers choosing one.
quote: bounces happily toward the hotcell.

summary: A burnt Tannuk carrying a melted suit of armor appears, and in the struggle Sami's gauntlet hits the cask and the stone knocks against Sami, who falls into the pool.
quote: falling into their own dead and staring eyes

summary: Sami wakes aboard the Seriema under fusion thrust with fuzzy memory, and Tan says Sami fell ill and he loaded the cask aboard.
quote: I found you in the QA cyst attached to one of the mining sheds.

summary: Tan notes moxite's value has been sliding everywhere in Sothera though the mine never opened, and they head for Kavaron.
quote: Like someone opened a new moxite mine here.

summary: In a dream, Alpharael falls into Sothera after his sister Raphaella and begs her to turn back.
quote: Of course we're sure, Alph. We were always going to do this.

summary: Raphaella is torn apart on the horizon, and Alpharael realizes there is no Next Eternity, only hell.
quote: There is no Next Eternity. There is only hell.

summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

summary: Alpharael wakes from the nightmare and a steward tells him his sister's inevitor completed its transit, proving that inevitors can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.
quote: Her flight has proven that an infalling inevitor can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.

summary: Alpharael says he wants to die and asks to join the next assault on the Dawnsire.
quote: Tell them I want to go in with the next wave,

summary: Alpharael parties with miners the night before the raid, unable to grieve his sister.
quote: Alpharael tries to get messed up enough to break down sobbing, but he can't.

summary: A rahu blesses the strike cadre and gives Alpharael a sekhar bead.
quote: The rahu gives Alpharael a microvoid trapped in a bead.

summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
quote: We hit it at thirty kilometers a second.

summary: On the Candela, Haliya wraps Vondam in his himsary banners before battle and he tells her they go to the Dawnsire where there may be combat.
quote: We are going over to the Dawnsire today,

summary: Haliya recites the Litany of Dawn with Vondam and asks for breakfast with her friends.
quote: If it is where you want to be when you face death, Squire? Then there is time for nothing else.

summary: Haliya's bind discusses the expected Monoist suicide attack.
quote: So, they need an unreasonable way, a way that makes no sense: throw people at the problem and hope one of them manages something.

summary: CoroNet orders squires to report as phorocast predicts imminent enemy action.
quote: REPORT TO YOUR KNIGHTS. PHOROCAST PREDICTS IMMINENT ENEMY ACTION.

summary: Vondam and Haliya go to the Dawnsire's bridge and meet Captain Slats, an Astelli, who phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle.
quote: I phorocast that you die in the battle.

summary: Haliya blurts that the prophecy might be an enemy trick, uttering the blasphemy anstruth.
quote: "Anstruth, Syr," she says.

summary: The bridge darkens red as phorocast detects an imminent impact, and Slats orders collision alarms and the deployment of knights.
quote: Garrison to repel boarders, number-two basilica!

summary: Vondam closes his helmet and tells Haliya to look to the Sum, then goes to face the attack.
quote: Look to the Sum, Squire.

summary: Velmenon tells Geldan that Solidbodies will trade her to someone else if she does not take another job.
quote: There's nothing else you can do for us, Geldan. It's this or trading you in for something from someone else.

summary: Velmenon explains that Solidbodies is behind its rival the Uthros Combine and offers Geldan freedom from her debt if she gets into the Uthros facility.
quote: If you can get in, you will be free.

summary: Geldan agrees to the job and learns the plan: wear Velmenon's sensor vests, evade sentries, find the nonexistent installation and reach the doors near the core.
quote: Find the installation there—the one that doesn't exist.

summary: Geldan has traded her own ship for two Monoist pressure suits and now flies an ugly old Kav mining vessel.
quote: Geldan is still raw after trading in her own ship, a saucy, nimble thing, a place built to her own tastes

summary: Geldan and Rezint set out from the salvage yard, blending in with drifting ships.
quote: They start from the salvage yard near where the ship has been parked, following the stream of unmoored ships out, trying to blend in with them, directionless detritus.

summary: Rezint proposes skirting a storm to mask them from the sentries and Geldan accepts.
quote: "I'm convinced," Geldan says.

summary: A gust damages the plasma torches and the ship begins steering itself into the storm.
quote: a strong gust hits the ship with a violent cracking noise.

summary: Geldan loses control of the ship and the two ride out the storm strapped into their seats.
quote: I've lost wire and hydraulics, can't steer this anymore.

summary: Rezint reveals that the Solidbodies gear includes modules that seem to measure the wearers, which unsettles him.
quote: I think a few of them are measuring us.

summary: Geldan schemes to wear the vests but then sell the data to a competitor, noting the contract did not forbid it.
quote: But there was nothing in the contract about exclusivity.

summary: The damaged ship slips past the sentries disguised as storm debris.
quote: They make it through.

summary: Out of the storm the ship is badly damaged but is drawing closer to the core, and Geldan sends Rezint to check the lifeboat.
quote: the crack in the screen on the right side of the cockpit could succumb to the pressure at any time

summary: Geldan and Rezint put on Velmenon's monitoring gear and the Monoist suits, and Geldan feels the suit's power and the cell it represents.
quote: Until they get Solidbodies Research their data, Geldan and Rezint will never be free.

summary: The two abandon the mining ship and launch in the lifeboat.
quote: They pile in and launch.

summary: Geldan and Rezint dodge the ring sentries by following a large sleek monster.
quote: They dodge another set of sentries by following on the tail of a monster.

summary: They land on the research base at the core, where the crushing pressure presses on Geldan despite her suit.
quote: Geldan feels pressure bear down on her like the palm of a giant hand, inexorable and grinding and cruel.

summary: Three Illvoi on hovering chairs pass beneath the hidden pair, and one waves a tentacle without raising an alarm.
quote: Three Illvoi ride by, each perched delicately on their hovering chairs.

summary: An Illvoi researcher opens a wall terminal; Rezint glimpses it before the researcher leaves.
quote: an Illvoi comes out from the side passage they're about to move to and taps something in the wall.

summary: Rising winds hurl sharp rock at their suits, forcing them to break into the tunnels for cover.
quote: It takes her a few minutes to realize that it's small pieces of rock, something sharp and very hard, hitting the metal of her suit.

summary: Geldan smashes a way into one of the ornate tunnels and they squeeze inside.
quote: Breaking into one of the ornate tunnels is just as satisfying as Geldan imagined it would be.

summary: Geldan takes the Illvoi worker's stool, and Rezint reports what he read on the terminal.
quote: casually swiping the stool left by the Illvoi worker as she does.

summary: Rezint reports that the terminal text included words for big and for deity or ending.
quote: I saw the word for big, not that that's much help.

summary: Geldan and Rezint walk the tunnels toward the center, drawn on by a growing pull, and cross unopposed into the internal tunnels.
quote: At some point, they reach the boundary between the external passageways and the internal tunnels.

summary: They reach the unguarded doors, which look like a toxic-metal disposal unit.
quote: They round the corner, and there they are: the doors.

summary: Rezint warns that the terminal said world-eater and urges Geldan to turn back.
quote: Whatever that is, Geldan, it's not something you can pluck out of a room and bring home for your trophy shelf.

summary: Geldan and Rezint argue over whether to go through the doors.
quote: We ought to respect that by trying to get back out.

summary: Geldan crushes the stool she carried, realizing it is not enough to free her.
quote: Slowly, Geldan squeezes her fist, giant in the pressure suit, around the stool and watches it crumble.

summary: Geldan apologizes to Rezint and disconnects the Solidbodies gear, deciding to keep anything she finds for herself.
quote: She's given them everything she owes them.

summary: The door opens at her touch and Geldan looks through into the core.
quote: The door opens easily at her touch, like it's been waiting for her.

summary: Geldan sees the corpse of a titan embedded in the core and falls to her knees before it.
quote: The corpse of a titan.

summary: Geldan surrenders to the titan's pull, resolving to let it remake her.
quote: She will be the clay.

summary: An alarm wails behind her as Rezint shouts in her headset; Geldan hopes he escapes and stays.
quote: Rezint's voice is in her headset, shouting something.

summary: Inside an inevitor, Alpharael learns the names of his fellow boarders, all Monoists bound for paradise.
quote: After he finishes screaming, Alpharael learns a few names.

summary: Alpharael insists his sister Raphaella, chosen for the Plummet, is no heretic.
quote: "My sister's not a heretic," Alpharael protests.

summary: The Monoists recite the prayer of gravity together.
quote: "This is the grace of gravity," someone says.

summary: The inevitor strikes the Dawnsire and deploys a cherazad that suspends most of the impact.
quote: As it strikes the Dawnsire , the inevitor deploys a cyst of altered space, a tactical event horizon: a cherazad.

summary: Anti-armor mines hit Zagachoir and ricochet inside his armor and body.
quote: Every cnidomine in the compartment hits Zagachoir.

summary: The boarding party leaps for the inner hull toward the Sunstar defenders.
quote: Everyone casts their center of mass forward.

summary: Zagachoir, spinning and bleeding, asks Alpharael to help him take sekhar.
quote: "I want to take sekhar now."

summary: Alpharael crushes Zagachoir's singularity bead housing, sending him into the Next Eternity.
quote: Alpharael crushes the singularity bead's housing and kicks free.

summary: Zagachoir collapses into a violet pinprick that falls out through the hull.
quote: Zagachoir collapses into a violet pinprick, eaten by the uncaged void.

summary: A Sunstar foot soldier blinds Nagashua with a bladiator flash and kills her.
quote: He thrusts the bladiator through her heart.

summary: The Monoist boarders overwhelm the Sunstar defenders in a short fight.
quote: Then, it is over. Alpharael barely got to swing his axe.

summary: A puzzler takes sekhar and the resulting microvoid pierces the inner hull, letting the boarders open a hatch.
quote: One of the puzzlers bellows, "Praise HIM !" and takes sekhar.

summary: Behind the hatch the boarders find a Sunstar basilica and someone begins burning it.
quote: It's a basilica, a house of the Sunstar faith.

summary: Purael orders the mission to continue, with the puzzle club going downship to find the blasphemy mechanisms.
quote: Puzzle club downship.

summary: Alpharael volunteers to go with Simma to kill a Solar Knight and is shot.
quote: "I'm coming with you!" Alpharael says.

summary: Squire Haliya follows Syr Vondam down the Dawnsire's spine, convinced she will die.
quote: They plunge down the Dawnsire 's spine.

summary: Haliya fears for Vondam, who is prophesied to die, and resolves to die before him.
quote: Vondam is prophesied to die.

summary: Vondam, Walker and Quinidad learn from a phonon survey that Sunstar garrison troops are fighting the boarders near the basilica.
quote: A company of the garrison has engaged boarders just abeam of the basilica.

summary: Vondam and Walker fire their bladiators through the deck to strike the Monoists below, with Haliya cleaning Vondam's beamline.
quote: The two knights plunge their bladiators into the deck and fire .

summary: The Monoists below pulse gravity waves at the deck, shaking it apart.
quote: The deck whines under their boots.

summary: The deck collapses under Haliya.
quote: The deck goes out from under her.

summary: As she falls, Haliya broadcasts all her power to protect Vondam.
quote: She throws her arms out to her knight and broadcasts every bit of power she can.

summary: Haliya blasts her way out of a flooded bathhouse tank with a bladiator steam jet.
quote: The steam jet cuts through the soft wall of the water tank, and the boiling water blasts her out like a cork into the bathhouse floor.

summary: Haliya fires at a Monoist fanatic gliding toward her.
quote: Haliya snaps her bladiator up and fires.

summary: Beams cut through the ceiling at Alpharael, but a thrown jar of aeromuck saves him from being killed.
quote: Two beams through the ceiling skewer Alpharael.

summary: Simma pulls on space and drops a collapsing structure on the enemy, buying minutes.
quote: Far above her, something rumbles and comes down like an avalanche.

summary: Alpharael bellows a challenge to the Sunstar defenders as bait for Simma's plan.
quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, and against me, your armor is—cracked leather!

summary: In the bathhouse Alpharael is shot by a seemingly dead Summist, who is Haliya.
quote: The dead Summist shoots him.

summary: Alpharael's tidal attack backfires and hits his own armor.
quote: He has shot himself in the face.

summary: A Monoist fanatic seizes Haliya's helmet and concusses her at ninety-five gravities.
quote: The concussion blanks her.

summary: Alpharael, thinking of his lost sister, pins Haliya and attacks her head.
quote: So Alpharael bears down on the fallen Summist and rattles her brain in her skull like a bruised pomegranate.

summary: Haliya's blade splits Alpharael open and his armor fails, and a Sunstar knight's beam throws him into a corner.
quote: The Summist's blade splits him open.

summary: Vondam arrives, drives Alpharael off Haliya, and orders a concussion drill.
quote: Haliya! Concussion drill!

summary: Vondam accepts Alpharael's challenge, naming himself of the Sunstar Free Company.
quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

summary: Simma pounces from the steam to slap a mine on Vondam's helm.
quote: Old Simma pounces.

summary: Vondam blasts Simma off course with a pulse of sunfire.
quote: The knight twists the pulse of sunfire down a magnetic field and blasts Simma askew.

summary: Vondam kills the main enemy, apparently Simma, and Haliya fights to hold Alpharael back.
quote: Vondam has killed the main enemy.

summary: Vondam offers the now unarmored Alpharael mercy, urging him to choose life.
quote: Come, then! Choose life!

summary: Alpharael throws away his singularity bead, giving up his sekhar to kill his foe.
quote: He has thrown away his sekhar.

summary: The newborn microvoid passes through Syr Vondam's head.
quote: Along the way, it goes directly through Syr Vondam's head .

summary: Alpharael has chosen life over immortality and cannot escape.
quote: Alpharael chose to live.

summary: Alpharael watches in disbelief as Vondam topples and decides to flee.
quote: Alpharael stares in giddy disbelief as Syr Vondam, Solar Knight of the Free Company, topples like a drunk.

summary: Fleeing, Alpharael runs into another Solar Knight, who captures him with a microwave field.
quote: He slams face-first into another Solar Knight.

summary: Alpharael meets Captain Slats, an Astelli, inside a light.
quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

summary: Slats tells Alpharael he foresaw him killing his friend and asks why.
quote: You struck dead a man who was my friend. I foresaw this. I want to know why.

summary: Slats sentences Alpharael to live.
quote: I sentence you to live.

summary: Slats directs Alpharael to a flight deck and a Hopelight warmaker, saying the Dawnsire is turning on Susur Secundi.
quote: You will find a Hopelight warmaker waiting for you.

summary: Alpharael scrambles to the flight deck with one hand.
quote: It takes him two of his remaining minutes to scramble down a spiraling emergency ramp to a flight deck.

summary: A warmaker admits Alpharael and he forces an emergency launch despite the daycode problem.
quote: "Captain's compliments," the fighter says.

summary: The warmaker drops down the Dawnsire's flight rail while Alpharael is vitrified by hardlight.
quote: A hardlight field seizes every atom in Alpharael's body and converts him, very briefly, into a uniform crystal.

summary: Haliya despairs over Vondam's apparent death and her failure to save him.
quote: The Haliya who wasn't quick, or strong, or sure enough to save her knight, the Haliya who allowed a pathetic fallen foe to throw his suicide through Vondam's skull .

summary: Vondam is revealed alive, with a pinhead hole through his head.
quote: He shows Haliya the hole in his helmet, then the hole in his face, just to the left of his nose.

summary: Slats says Vondam died but was not dead.
quote: You died, but you were not dead.

summary: Haliya reveals that Captain Slats let Alpharael escape in a Hopelight.
quote: "Captain Slats let him."

summary: Slats announces retaliation against Susur Secundi after the three inevitors are defeated.
quote: By my authority as coronal of this ship, I have ordered retaliation against Susur Secundi.

summary: Vondam suspects the event of his survival was engineered and that he is an anstruth.
quote: I am also an anstruth.

summary: Vondam concludes some force wants Alpharael alive.
quote: I'm saying that something wants that Monoist alive.

summary: Vondam vows that he and Haliya will pursue Alpharael once healed.
quote: But once we're fit again, we're going after him.

summary: The narrator explains the horizon javelin at the Dawnsire's heart.
quote: The mechanism that undoes a supervoid into a star is in fact called a horizon javelin.

summary: Nacha fires a laser pulse train across two hundred lightseconds at Susur Secundi.
quote: Nacha fires.

summary: Nacho maps the defenses from Nacha's shot and then hits the monastery being built above Susur Secundi.
quote: The monastery in construction above Susur Secundi jets violet plasma and lurches in its orbit.

summary: Alpharael's warmaker burns away from the Dawnsire, unremarked by anyone.
quote: And if any of those eyes take note of the Hopelight warmaker burning furiously away from the Dawnsire , headed anywhere but home—they do not say.

summary: The Seriema narrowly avoids a tumbling kilometer-wide piece of a shattered planet.
quote: A thousand-gigaton piece of a shattered planet, seven kilometers across and tumbling, flashes past the Seriema at nine kilometers per second.

summary: The Seriema flies through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask for their prize.
quote: The Seriema plunges stern first through the Mordraine Ring, toward Kavaron That Is and a stasis cask to hold their prize.

summary: A Kavaron Memorial Navy controller warns the Seriema it is off track.
quote: You are off track.

summary: The controller writes them off as wake criminals, leaving them beyond help.
quote: Marking you beyond help. Worst of luck, robbers. Out.

summary: Tan notices a Sunstar Hopelight warmaker following them down.
quote: Just so you know, there's a fighter following us.

summary: A Free Company palestar fires lasers at the Hopelight, trying to shoot down its own fighter.
quote: The palestar is firing lasers at the Hopelight.

summary: Sami blows up a rock with a beacon to clear a path while Tan flies through the debris.
quote: I'm gonna blow that chunk into its buddy. You ready?

summary: The Seriema and the Hopelight lose sight of each other as the Seriema reenters Kavaron's atmosphere.
quote: They lose track of the Hopelight behind them as they make reentry.

summary: Tan detects a Kavaron Memorial Navy team in the area, probably heading for the same cache.
quote: No. There's someone else down there.

summary: The Hopelight fires its fusion engine in the atmosphere, blowtorches Tan's cache site and crashes into the rock.
quote: The Hopelight descends on its plume of disaster, blowtorches the cache site with its suicidal engine burn, and splatters into the rock.

summary: Sami lands the Seriema on a basalt plain, and they set out for the cache.
quote: Sami sets the Seriema down on a plain of flood basalt

summary: Sami decides to investigate the crashed Hopelight despite Tan's fear of the KMN.
quote: "We should take a look," Sami settles on.

summary: Sami promises Tan they will not let the Kav hurt him.
quote: I won't let them hurt you. I promise.

summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

summary: Sami introduces themself to Alpharael and promises to get him out alive.
quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

summary: Armed Kav of the Memorial Navy surround the crash site.
quote: The crater rim is lined with armed Kav.

summary: The subedar accuses Tannuk of violating his exile.
quote: you have violated the terms of your exile.

summary: A narrator reveals that Sami's rescue attempt was a deliberate drastic intervention against Pinnacle.
quote: Pinnacle must be disrupted.

summary: Sami removes their helmet and invents a cover story as an agent of the Monastery of the True Faith.
quote: We serve the Monastery of the True Faith at Susur Secundi, which you call Anuki.

summary: Alpharael plays along, claiming the Free Company plans to destroy Sothera.
quote: The Sunstar Free Company plans to destroy Sothera

summary: The subedar offers to escort them to Taro-duend if they prove they are Monoists.
quote: Prove you're with the Monoists, and we will escort you to the strike town at Taro-duend.

summary: Sami gambles that the Metalman's artifact on the Seriema can pass for a damaged singularity bead.
quote: "The proof is in the cache," Sami says, gambling wildly.

summary: The subedar laughs and agrees to fetch a stasis cask and take them all to Taro-duend.
quote: We'll get you a stasis cask for your singularity and take you all to Taro-duend.

summary: The subedar makes Tannuk call an old coin flip; the coin lands point facing her.
quote: More chance than you gave your victims, Tannuk.

summary: The Kav retrieve the cask from the cache and Alpharael from the Hopelight, putting him in the cask.
quote: The Kav pull the stasis cask out of Tan's old cache and Alpharael out of the downed Hopelight.

summary: The Kav load the stasis cask into the Seriema's cargo bay next to the hotcell holding the Metalman's artifact.
quote: The Kav haul the stasis cask up into the cargo bay and park it next to the hotcell containing the weird rock from Sigma.

summary: A Kav opens the hotcell and sees the artifact, which looks like a spitball.
quote: The Metalman's artifact lies there, in the dark, in a wasp's nest of congealed shear starch.

summary: Alpharael enters the hotcell to move the supposed bead.
quote: "I want to live," Alpharael says and stumbles into the hotcell.

summary: Alpharael emerges holding the stone, which glistens and begins to lift him upward.
quote: Alpharael emerges. He's holding the weird stone in his hand.

summary: The subedar orders her troops to kill Sami's group.
quote: Enough. Kill them.

summary: Alpharael floats in panic, crying out to Raphaella, Zagachoir and Slats and begging not to be sent back.
quote: I can't go back. I want to live! Don't send me back!

summary: The Kav groan in anguish as their bodies twist inside their armor.
quote: The subedar groans. All the Kav groan.

summary: Alpharael's voice changes and he speaks a prayer to INEVITA.
quote: INEVITA! Begin in me thy ending!

summary: A voice speaking through Alpharael says it is not a god and has limits.
quote: I am not a god, though I was fashioned for the use of one. I have limits.

summary: The voice says it needs a wielder who offers a library of moments to alter.
quote: I need a wielder who offers me a library of moments to alter.

summary: Sami broadcasts a mayday to Taro-duend reporting twenty-four Kav soldiers with lethal radiation trauma.
quote: Twenty-four KMN aboard with lethal radiation trauma.

summary: It is explained that Alpharael's Hopelight irradiated the Kav Memorial team when it crashed.
quote: When Alpharael's Hopelight came down, it irradiated the entire Kav Memorial team with its fusion engine.

summary: The dying Kav staggered into the Seriema's cargo bay and begged for rescue.
quote: They had just enough strength left to stagger into the Seriema 's cargo bay and beg for rescue.

summary: Sami denies to Taro-duend that the Seriema fired a fusion drive.
quote: It wasn't us.

summary: Recalling earlier events, Sami notes that Alpharael had a fit when put in the stasis cask with the stone.
quote: when Sami put the bleeding Monoist in the stasis cask with the rock, the Monoist had a fit.

summary: Sami discovers a perfect hole in Alpharael's right palm under the medical sleeve.
quote: they discovered a mystery: a perfect hole in his right palm.

summary: Tannuk argues that Alpharael's fusion burn was a disaster, not evil, and cannot be punished.
quote: You can't avenge a disaster. You can't punish a disaster.

summary: In a flashback, as lead daunt Tannuk commanded the Guns of Kavaron to fire on a bolide aimed at Summotank.
quote: He commanded the Guns of Kavaron to fire on a bolide headed for the city of Summotank, where four million Kav dwell on the drainage lake of great shattersprings.

summary: Tannuk braked the bolide so it fell on mountain villages, killing twenty-five thousand Kav, which the Kav see as murder by engineered misfortune.
quote: Tannuk killed twenty-five thousand Kav.

summary: Sami lands in a slag pool at Taro-duend and the pool is drained as Kav rescue crews rush the ship.
quote: The moment that Sami cuts thrust, someone opens the sluicegate and drains the slag pool.

summary: Ambulances take the comatose Kav away.
quote: The Trample ambulances take them away.

summary: Sami tells the coach a story of rescuing the soldiers while the coach repeats Sami's words, and offers engine telemetry as proof of innocence.
quote: I'm going to tell the truth.

summary: Tannuk passes as a stroke-addled man to the political postilion, claiming a mining accident at Sigma's Reach.
quote: Mining accident. No air. Had to breathe liquid.

summary: The postilion unwittingly reveals that Kav believe Sigma's Reach has miners and exports moxite.
quote: They'd want Kav labor, wouldn't they?

summary: Sami and Tannuk puzzle that the Sigma mine never opened yet moxite prices fell.
quote: That mine never opened.

summary: Tannuk volunteers to fetch fuel while Sami investigates Sigma's Reach.
quote: So, Tan goes out to buy fuel and reaction mass for the Seriema .

summary: Sami goes to ask the political postilion what he knows about Sigma's Reach.
quote: And Sami, mouse-small in the crowds of Kav, goes to find the political postilion and ask him what he knows about Sigma's Reach.

summary: The postilion asks Sami where their addled man Gorodoro is.
quote: Where is your addled man? Gorodoro?

summary: The postilion sees through Sami's act and asks if they are a liar.
quote: Are you a liar, Captain Sami?

summary: The postilion says he saw the hotcell cask stamped for Sigma's Reach.
quote: I saw the hotcell cask. It had a destination stamp, Sigma's Reach.

summary: The postilion reveals that cheap moxite from Sigma's Reach ruined his moxite futures.
quote: And instead it plummeted! Undercut by cheap, clean moxite from Sigma's Reach!

summary: Sami tells the postilion that Sigma's Reach never opened, shocking him.
quote: Sigma's Reach never opened.

summary: Sami asks about Mirri, showing a picture.
quote: Sami produces a picture of Mirri.

summary: A Sunstar Free Company ship arrives at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies.
quote: It's the Sunstar Free Company. They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.

summary: The postilion refuses to hand over Sami and decides to obstruct justice.
quote: This is a harbor for scum!

summary: Haliya, aboard the Sundog, stares guiltily at the hole in Vondam's skull and thinks of Alpharael.
quote: Haliya catches herself staring at the hole in Syr Vondam's skull again.

summary: Vondam and Haliya left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.
quote: They left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.

summary: Vondam says they are going to find and kill Alpharael, not for revenge.
quote: All he will say is that they are going to find and kill Alpharael.

summary: Vondam orders the Sundog to repeat its demand that Taro-duend hand over the spy and to launch Hopelights for surveillance.
quote: Give them another chance to hand over the spy. Launch the Hopelights.

summary: Vondam gives Haliya a quartz crystal containing the anathalmanac.
quote: He gives her a quartz memory crystal.

summary: Vondam explains his belief that an anathema object in Sothera is calling for a wielder and threatens the Sunstar mission.
quote: I believe one such object is in Sothera.

summary: Vondam says the object manipulated Slats's vision, Vondam's death and survival to draw Alpharael to it.
quote: The object manipulated everything.

summary: Haliya reads protocol seven, radiant resignation, requiring destruction of everything the object touches.
quote: 7. Radiant resignation. Destroy yourself, all those about you, and the Object, by the most immediate and violent means available.

summary: Vondam declares that his judgment cannot be trusted and Haliya is now effectively the knight.
quote: In a sense, Haliya, you are now the knight and I the squire.

summary: Vondam asks Haliya whether she could order the destruction of all Taro-duend if needed.
quote: Can you destroy it all?

summary: Haliya refuses to help kill a settlement of innocents.
quote: I won't do it. I'm not going to kill a settlement full of defenseless innocents.

summary: Haliya proposes to go down to Taro-duend herself to find and kill Alpharael.
quote: You don't go down there. I do.

summary: Haliya persuades Vondam to let her go in his place by invoking a knight's trust.
quote: He would give her a chance to be worthy of his trust.

summary: Alpharael dreams of his past and his twin Raphaella being chosen for the Plummet, while a voice speaks to him.
quote: One twin cast into the singularity. One twin turned away.

summary: The voice reveals Alpharael has already used it, changing the Hopelight's past so the Kav arrived as walking corpses.
quote: Alpharael's used me already, to get rid of the Kav.

summary: The voice tells Alpharael why he was meant to wield it.
quote: Do you understand, Alpharael, why you were meant to wield me?

summary: Alpharael wakes strapped in a bunk on the Seriema.
quote: "I live," he croaks.

summary: Alpharael discovers a transparent hole through his right hand.
quote: A hole right through his hand, palm to dorsum.

summary: Alpharael sees Sunstar Free Company knights and photophoroi landing at Taro-duend to search for him.
quote: And from that ship rains an armored rain: the tiny figures of Solar Knights descending on spikes of plasma.

summary: Alpharael finds Sami's note saying they are out for fuel and he is locked in.
quote: Gone out for fuel—back soon.

summary: Alpharael unlocks his cabin hatch by threading a finger through the hole in his hand.
quote: He drives his left index finger through the hole in his right hand.

summary: Alpharael goes to the cargo bay and restarts the stasis cask to retrieve what is inside.
quote: He rubs at the hole in his hand as the cask whirs up to real time.

summary: The Free Company sweeps Taro-duend with drones and infantry.
quote: The Free Company is everywhere.

summary: The Kav of Taro-duend resist the Free Company by sabotage and obstruction.
quote: In an act of aggressive, unilateral solidarity, the Kav are raising thirteen kinds of hell.

summary: Tannuk hides Sami under his poncho as they move through the chaos.
quote: You could not ask for a better first mate or a worse fugitive than Tannuk.

summary: Sami concludes the stone is making them lucky enough to avoid detection.
quote: It's the rock, Tannuk. The rock is lucky.

summary: A Free Company officer fires a microwave weapon on the crowd.
quote: One of the Free Company officers fires up a microwave weapon.

summary: Sami speculates that a similar past rewrite emptied Sigma's Reach of its people.
quote: Maybe there were people there, before we showed up.

summary: Sami refuses to give up the stone because the Metalman is their hope of finding Mirri.
quote: then he wouldn't fix our ship. And then who'd look for Mirri?

summary: Haliya makes her first combat descent to Taro-duend alone.
quote: A team of photophoroi from the Moratorio Cosmogrand help her make her first combat descent.

summary: Haliya builds a triple-jointed pendulum to shield herself from the object by tying her actions to scripture.
quote: 3. Pendulum, encoding faith. Fashion from gleanings a triple-jointed pendulum. Dangle it from thy armor.

summary: In the third cave she checks, Haliya finds the Seriema.
quote: In the third cave she checks, she finds a ship called the Seriema

summary: Haliya plants charges on the Seriema before going in.
quote: Plant a charge under the Seriema 's folded airfoil.

summary: Alpharael tries to wish on the stone for rescue but nothing happens.
quote: Bring Captain Sami back here safely. Get us off this planet and away from the Sunstar knights.

summary: Haliya enters the cargo bay and Alpharael tries to banish her with the stone.
quote: Alpharael brandishes the rock at her and shouts, "Vanish!"

summary: Haliya stuns Alpharael with her bladiator.
quote: The bright figure shoots him.

summary: Haliya puts a dead-man bomb in Alpharael's mouth to protect herself from the object's influence.
quote: That's a bomb," she says. "If it doesn't get my passcode every ten seconds, it'll blow up.

summary: Haliya asks Alpharael to use the object to change the past so she was the one he killed, sparing Vondam.
quote: I need you to change things so that I was the one you killed

summary: The Free Company search at Taro-duend collapses under Kav resistance.
quote: The Free Company search is falling apart.

summary: A Hopelight pilot destroys half the airport while firing at a laser source.
quote: I blew up half the airport .

summary: Haliya urges Alpharael to change the past.
quote: "Do it," she urges him.

summary: Haliya tells Vondam she has Alpharael and offers to be the one the object changed.
quote: I can be the one it changed. You can be yourself again.

summary: Vondam orders Haliya to kill Alpharael and return with the object.
quote: Haliya, I am ordering you to kill him and return with the object.

summary: Haliya tells Vondam to proceed with protocol seven and fire on her, the object and the Kav.
quote: You have to fire. Destroy me, the object, and the Kav.

summary: Vondam orders Haliya to get out and move to the slag field for extraction.
quote: Move to the slag field for extraction.

summary: As a human and a Kav, apparently Sami and Tannuk, reach the Seriema's ramp, Haliya shoots the human through the heart.
quote: She lases the human through the heart.

summary: Haliya kills the grieving Kav, apparently Tannuk, with her bladiator.
quote: It takes a surprisingly long fraction of a second for her bladiator to burn through the Kav's throat and kill it, too.
