summary: Alpharael jabs himself with a jet injector and the injection passes through the hole in his hand and into Haliya, paralyzing her.
quote: Only the injection has gone through his hand, through her armor, and into her .

summary: Kadrik recounts gnawing off his left hind leg shortly after hatching and getting a fungal replacement foot.
quote: I got a little too excited and ended up gnawing off the end of my left hind leg

summary: Kadrik explains his mission to retrieve the last unhatched pods and that failing it means being reprocessed.
quote: My ongoing mission is to retrieve the last few unhatched pods scattered across the muddy plains.

summary: Gobbler repeatedly eats the pods Kadrik finds.
quote: She chases me away and—you won't believe this—gobbles up my find.

summary: Kadrik cuts off comms and deserts toward the tundra.
quote: I'm cutting off comms, spitting out my tracker, and deserting.

summary: On the fifth day Kadrik finds a Kav stasis pod camouflaged on the tundra.
quote: I nearly miss the stasis pod

summary: Kadrik sees that the pod holds a living human.
quote: Inside is not a Kav. It's a human.

summary: Kadrik decides to bring the human back to the enclave.
quote: I hitch the stasis pod to my sledge and turn back toward the enclave.

summary: Gobbler throws Kadrik's sledge and attacks the pod.
quote: I'm knocked out of my sledge as it flies backward and crashes on its side in an explosion of dirt.

summary: Kadrik flees and leaves the human to Gobbler.
quote: I scramble over, shove my sledge upright, and scramble on.

summary: Guilt-ridden, Kadrik turns back to rescue the human.
quote: With a snarl, I swing the sledge back around.

summary: Kadrik jams his staff and energy pack into Gobbler's jaws and the blast stuns her.
quote: I rip off my energy pack.

summary: The explosion destroys Kadrik's foot, which regrows from mycelial tissue.
quote: The whole world flashes green as pain engulfs my left hind leg.

summary: Kadrik reaches the enclave, where Zoritt hits him and tells him the recycling threat was a joke.
quote: What I don't expect, when we finally reach the enclave, is for Zoritt to knock me over the head with xir fist.

summary: Zoritt says it was a joke that they would recycle him.
quote: That was a joke, you idiot!

summary: Zoritt and the scientists move the human into a biocradle, and Kadrik takes the cylinder clutched in the human's hand.
quote: There's a cylindrical thing clenched in one hand, and I swipe it before Zoritt banishes me and Pabkoh outside.

summary: Kadrik eats the cylinder, thinking it a snack.
quote: I pop it in my mouth and crunch down.

summary: Kadrik meets the awakened human, who introduces himself as Noz.
quote: I-I'm Noz

summary: Kadrik exaggerates that he fought off five megafauna with bare hands.
quote: Had to fight off five megafauna with bare hands.

summary: Noz says he is from Pinnacle's programming division and was captured by the Kav.
quote: We were on a team-building exercise when the Kav took us captive.

summary: Noz tells them he was in stasis for three years.
quote: Three years, I know.

summary: Noz warns that the Kav are biding their time with a new warship.
quote: We were taken by a brand-new warship and held on a station retrofitted for battle.

summary: Noz insists on leaving to reach his family and report to Pinnacle.
quote: But I have a daughter.

summary: Noz asks for his pencil and learns Kadrik ate it.
quote: Oh, your snack. I ate it. Sorry.

summary: Noz encourages Kadrik to be the first Eumidian artist.
quote: Maybe you can be the first to change that.

summary: Noz thanks Kadrik and invites him to visit Guideline before leaving.
quote: Maybe you can even visit me on Guideline.

summary: After Noz leaves, Kadrik begins to draw a pair of tusks in the dirt with the stick.
quote: Then I crouch down, digging one end of the stick into the soft dirt, and begin to draw a pair of tusks.

summary: Reen arrives at Infinite Guideline seeking a ship with a drive and a codebook for her pilgrimage.
quote: And her obligate pilgrimage will take her even farther—that is, if she ever finds a half-decent ship with a drive and a codebook.

summary: A malfunctioning scavenger mechan tries to eat Reen's oversized suitcase and she throws it aside.
quote: a malfunctioning scavenger mechan trying to eat her oversized suitcase, drawn to its metal-rich contents.

summary: A Kav captain refuses to take Reen to Point Prime directly.
quote: "Point Prime from here?" he demands.

summary: Reen finds that captains fear the route to Point Prime and begins to doubt her pilgrimage.
quote: Point Prime is far, yes. But distance is the least of the captains' concerns.

summary: The mechan captain Too Much Happiness reveals it is also going to Point Prime.
quote: "What serendipity," it says.

summary: Reen books passage with Too Much Happiness.
quote: She puts in her offer. The transfer and contract blink through.

summary: Reen sees that her fellow passengers are three Sunstar Free Company men-at-arms.
quote: There are three of them: three men-at-arms belonging to the Sunstar Free Company, pride and blade of the Celestial Palatinate.

summary: The soldiers fail to recognize Reen and walk past.
quote: She reminds the men-at-arms of nothing, and they stride past her without stopping.

summary: Reen recites a Monoist chant in her cabin and is startled when Too Much Happiness speaks through her mirror.
quote: compact me to zero and let me be still.

summary: The ship enters the eternity column and travels through unreality.
quote: Then the eternity column activates, flinging them through unreality

summary: In memory, Reen recalls Joska and the Palatinate lander that her squad targeted.
quote: If she keeps her eyes shut, she sees, inevitably, the target: a Palatinate lander bobbing just offshore.

summary: Reen tattoos a supervoid mark on her arm as a ledger of her kills.
quote: The tiny black tattoo, a stylized and simplified supervoid, is nearly finished.

summary: Reen sees the striations on the engine pod are from a greatwurm attack in the Wurmwall.
quote: The striations make a new and terrifying sense

summary: Too Much Happiness says it was compelled into the Wurmwall and met a stranger there.
quote: I think I met a stranger there, and things have been far stranger since.

summary: Reen suspects a Palatinate hack and agrees to inspect the memory cores.
quote: If the Palatinate really is using the Wurmwall as a staging ground and seeks to conceal its activities …

summary: Reen finds an alien fractal shadow growing inside the ship's core code.
quote: A fractal shadow of Too Much Happiness's core systems that seems to wink out of existence each time she peers too closely at it.

summary: Reen realizes the ancient alien presence might make the Palatinate's horizon javelin look trivial.
quote: She realizes she's stumbled onto something that, if weaponized, might make the Palatinate's horizon javelin look trivial by comparison.

summary: A Sunstar soldier catches Reen at the memory cores with a bladiator at her neck.
quote: The others didn't believe me. But I can always sniff out your kind.

summary: Too Much Happiness warns that the peace is ending and cuts the lights.
quote: I have received word that the negotiated peace is ending. A great atrocity was uncovered.

summary: Reen stabs the soldier in the eye with a pneumatic needle in the dark and flees.
quote: drives her pneumatic needle into something yielding and aqueous.

summary: Reen sprints through the dark to the cargo hold with three soldiers in pursuit.
quote: Monoists revere the dark; Reen has spent half her life in lightless tunnels

summary: Reen locks herself in her suitcase while her armor assembles and the soldiers cut through the door.
quote: It splits open at the same time the cargo door hisses shut.

summary: The soldiers breach the cargo hold.
quote: The sheared metal of the door topples forward, discharging another shower of sparks. The men-at-arms step through.

summary: Reen surrenders to rage, activates her gravity gauntlets and emerges from the suitcase to fight.
quote: Reen activates her gravity gauntlets and emerges.

summary: After the fight, the maintenance mechans and Reen send the dead soldiers out an airlock.
quote: A moving wave of maintenance mechans conducted the soldiers to the airlock; Reen helped push their shattered corpses through.

summary: Too Much Happiness connects Reen's tattoos to the Joska atrocity that ended the peace.
quote: The atrocity that ended the negotiated peace occurred on the moon called Joska.

summary: Reen says she will condense and be still as they approach Point Prime.
quote: "I'll condense," she says.

summary: The Seriema's cargo ramp has been lowered by someone who found the ship, and Sami runs for it.
quote: Someone has found the Seriema , and the prow cargo ramp is down, opening the long jut of the number-one cargo bay to boarding.

summary: Sami finds Alpharael huddled at the feet of the frozen Sunstar armor, holding the stone and the injector.
quote: a suit of golden armor standing, frozen, over Alpharael, who is huddled wretchedly around its ankles

summary: Alpharael says the armored woman killed Sami, though she didn't.
quote: "She killed you," Alpharael says.

summary: Vondam announces to all units that they are going to protocol seven and have two minutes.
quote: We are going to protocol seven. You have two minutes.

summary: Sami resolves to try escaping despite near-zero odds.
quote: Our chances of flying out of here with a palestar and Hopelights overhead are zero.

summary: Tannuk reveals he has pulled the subedar armor's Guns codes.
quote: And the encryption's no match for Pinnacle breakers. I pulled them already.

summary: Sami lifts the Seriema out of the cave and over the slag field.
quote: Sami gooses the ship up on a pulse of thrust.

summary: A Hopelight lasers off the Seriema's main drive nozzle.
quote: The main drive! They took out the mag nozzle!

summary: Haliya appears in the cockpit and offers herself as a hostage.
quote: "Looking for a hostage?" Haliya says.

summary: In a flashback, Haliya's armor frees her from the paralytic, and she shocks Alpharael's hands and makes him put the stone in stasis.
quote: She fries his left hand, too, so he drops the object.

summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

summary: The Sundog lasers every heat source in Taro-duend as it recovers its soldiers.
quote: The Sundog is killing everything in Taro-duend with its lasers.

summary: The Sundog sets houses on fire after the fleeing Kav gather inside.
quote: The Sundog lets them gather, then sets the houses on fire.

summary: Haliya radios Vondam, claiming she has the object and urging him to stop killing the Kav.
quote: Syr Vondam. Syr Vondam, this is Squire Haliya.

summary: Vondam tells Haliya to kill the crew and force the ship down.
quote: We'll keep pace until you can kill the crew and force it down.

summary: Haliya urges Vondam to order her death as protocol seven requires.
quote: We traded places. Now you must order mine!

summary: Vondam refuses to destroy the ship, wanting the object retrieved in stasis.
quote: We'll retrieve the object and return it to Candela in stasis.

summary: The Sundog ignites its main fusion engine over Taro-duend, killing survivors with radiation and fire.
quote: The palestar has ignited its main fusion engine.

summary: Sami refuses Alpharael's offer to use the stone to undo the atrocity.
quote: It didn't work on Sigma, and it won't work here.

summary: Haliya begs Vondam to kill her too if the object is worth so much.
quote: Syr, kill me. If this object is worth so much.

summary: Sami takes Vondam's silence as permission to escape.
quote: May I take this as your permission to make my escape?

summary: Tannuk finds a stratosat balloon and uses the subedar's codes to request the Guns' radar.
quote: Forty kilometers above the southern horizon is an armored stratosat balloon.

summary: The Sundog lasers the stratosat after realizing what Tannuk is doing.
quote: A laser flicks out and kills the stratosat.

summary: The Guns of Kavaron fire on the pursuing Hopelight.
quote: The Guns of Kavaron fire.

summary: The Hopelight Flare Three is hit by the Guns, loses its tail and ejects its crew.
quote: The Hopelight, callsign Flare Three , flashes up white.

summary: The Sundog jams the radar, so the Guns miss their second shot.
quote: The Guns stab down again. But this time, they miss.

summary: The Seriema lunges up into space.
quote: The Seriema lunges up into space.

summary: The Guns' boost beams push the Seriema's mirrored sail out across the Mordraine Ring into interplanetary space.
quote: And when their beams converge on the Seriema 's sail, carefully diffused to avoid melting right through it, they push the little ship.

summary: The Kavaron Memorial Navy swarms Kavaron That Is searching for the authors of the atrocity.
quote: But by now, every ship in the Kavaron Memorial Navy is swarming out over Kavaron That Is, looking for the authors of the atrocity captured on the Seriema 's cameras.

summary: Sami declares Alpharael and Haliya guests under mallowmass to stop them fighting.
quote: Captain Sami declares that all their new passengers are guests under the protection of mallowmass.

summary: Haliya reflects that she can never be a Sunstar knight after the atrocity and her desertion.
quote: She will never be a Sunstar knight of the Free Company.

summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

summary: Haliya argues that the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bear responsibility for the dead Kav.
quote: He's not responsible for the dead Kav at Taro-duend, either. We are.

summary: Haliya concludes that Vondam obeyed the Sum but that the massacre was nonetheless wrong.
quote: But it was wrong. I know it.

summary: Haliya decides the object must be destroyed, and Sami objects.
quote: We need to destroy the object. It poisons everything.

summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
quote: I look for my cat.

summary: Sami explains that Mirri weftwalked on Uthros and vanished.
quote: She weftwalked.

summary: Haliya offers to help look for the cat.
quote: I'll help you look for the cat,

summary: Sami insists the stone will be given to the Metalman rather than destroyed.
quote: We're giving it to the Metalman.

summary: Sami tells them the Metalman is a wizard.
quote: I told you. He's a wizard .

summary: Haliya takes a defensive position and resolves to stop Alpharael from taking the ship or using the Endstone.
quote: Her goal is to prevent Alpharael from taking the ship or using the object.

summary: Haliya rejects destroying the rock because it would violate mallowmass.
quote: But that would violate mallowmass.

summary: Haliya summons Alpharael to meet with her.
quote: Eventually, the Summist calls Alpharael to meet with her.

summary: Haliya proposes a détente with Alpharael.
quote: "We must reach an accord," she says.

summary: Haliya says the Sum told her to kill everyone aboard and herself, but she did not.
quote: Only the Sum says that I was supposed to kill everyone on this ship, including myself.

summary: Haliya calls Alpharael an apostate and offers to take up his case.
quote: "So, you're an apostate," she says happily.

summary: Haliya says she will argue that Slats rightly granted Alpharael mercy.
quote: I'll beg your pardon, and that means I have no duty to kill you.

summary: Haliya takes off her helmet and says the Free Company's armor is no longer hers.
quote: Haliya takes her helmet off, moving so sharply that Alpharael flinches away.

summary: Alpharael gives Haliya a bottle of cleaning solute.
quote: I got you a present, by the way.

summary: Sami announces over the intercom that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret.
quote: The Metalman's here. Come out and present yourselves, or he'll present you.

summary: Tezzeret enters the Seriema from his black engineless ship.
quote: He pushes into the Seriema with the calm of a prybar.

summary: Tezzeret questions Haliya about her armor.
quote: "You wear a wealth of metal," he says.

summary: Tezzeret is delighted that Alpharael fled his creed to live.
quote: I wanted to live a little longer.

summary: Tezzeret studies Tannuk, remarking on Llanowar and the power he is afraid of.
quote: So far from Llanowar … such power in the form.

summary: Tezzeret greets Sami as the protector of strays and asks for his prize.
quote: Sami, the generous. Sami, the charitable. Sami, the protector of strays.

summary: Sami tells Tezzeret the stone changes the past, as with the vanished miners of Sigma.
quote: Change the past to suit its purposes.

summary: Tezzeret laughs at Haliya's objection to counterfeit memories.
quote: Listen to her! Counterfeit memories, an atrocity.

summary: Tezzeret says he will see the stone now.
quote: You're keeping it in your hold. I'll see it now.

summary: Haliya says she cannot let Tezzeret take the object.
quote: "I can't let you take the object," Haliya says.

summary: Tezzeret says he arranged events so the stone would choose him as its conduit.
quote: I have arranged all this so it will choose me as its conduit.

summary: Tezzeret calls the stone the Endstone, as Alpharael's people name it.
quote: It's what your people call it. Isn't it, boy? The stone from the end.

summary: Tezzeret declares he will never serve again and wants nothing from the Endstone.
quote: I won't flee to a better world. I'll stand and face whoever would rule me.

summary: Tezzeret says the Endstone was made and buried and he will follow it to its maker.
quote: I must know who made it.

summary: Tezzeret explains he has made himself the shortest path to ground for the Endstone, like lightning.
quote: I have made myself the shortest path for the Endstone to reach its maker.

summary: Tezzeret silently forces Haliya's armor to close on her.
quote: her armor ripples like porridge and closes on her.

summary: Tezzeret releases Haliya, who drifts limp, and moves to consult the Endstone.
quote: Haliya drifts away spinning, limbs limp.

summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

summary: Tezzeret reads the crystal's result as Uthros and says he will alert Mm'menon.
quote: Uthros. The stone wants to go to Uthros.

summary: Mantis learns that six thousand died on Kavaron.
quote: Six thousand dead on Kavaron.

summary: Mantis reflects that the Free Company violated its agreement with Pinnacle and that Pinnacle stays neutral.
quote: The Free Company has violated the terms of its agreement with Pinnacle.

summary: Mantis tells Checkmate that Pinnacle can only deny passage through the eternity column.
quote: We have no power to arrest or pursue the guilty.

summary: Mantis deduces that a Monoist warship is within Pinnacle's controlled space.
quote: There is a Monoist warship inside our controlled space,

summary: Vondam, in Pinnacle custody, is questioned by Mantis.
quote: He surrendered his ship to the Kav, without contest, on the condition that he be delivered directly to Infinite Guideline and Pinnacle custody.

summary: Vondam warns that both sides will blockade the eternity column.
quote: That they must blockade the eternity column and prevent any ship from escaping Sothera.

summary: Vondam tells Mantis an artifact is present in Sothera that the enemy cannot obtain.
quote: We have discovered that there is an artifact present in Sothera which we cannot permit the enemy to obtain.

summary: Mantis resigns as director of Infinite Guideline and Checkmate inherits the post.
quote: I resign my post as director of the Infinite Guideline effective immediately.

summary: Vondam describes an unstable double stalemate as both fleets move toward Infinite Guideline.
quote: We are in an unstable double stalemate.

summary: Mantis asks whether Vondam would destroy the station to stop the artifact, and he says yes.
quote: Would you destroy this station and the eternity column, trapping yourself in Sothera, in order to prevent the artifact from escaping?

summary: Vondam predicts his former student will come to Infinite Guideline to steal an eternity drive.
quote: Infinite Guideline has an eternity column, and it is the only place in the system with eternity drive ferries that can lift her ship into warp.

summary: A Free Company search radar sweeps toward the drifting Seriema.
quote: Search radar howls across the dark.

summary: The Free Company radar is abruptly jammed by an unseen attacker.
quote: The Free Company radar abruptly shuts off.

summary: Fleets from both sides accelerate toward Infinite Guideline.
quote: Dozens of fusion-drive flames are accelerating toward Infinite Guideline and the eternity column.

summary: Tannuk admits he is lying to Sami to protect them, but it is too late.
quote: "It's that kind of lie," Tannuk says.

summary: Sami reveals their real plan is to ask Pinnacle, the Free Company and the Monoists for help.
quote: Sami's plan is to ask for help.

summary: Sami promises to return for Mirri.
quote: I won't be leaving Mirri behind. I'll come back for her.

summary: Alpharael says he wants to use the stone so his sister never took the Plummet.
quote: I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.

summary: An Illvoi ship arrives beside the Seriema.
quote: A ship appears beside them.

summary: The Illvoi extend a superfluid helium bubble around the Seriema.
quote: they snug their ship up close and extend their helium bubble around Sami's ship.

summary: Illvoi mechans cool the Seriema and begin repairing its fusion drive.
quote: Then the mechans swarm over the Seriema 's stern to repair the fusion drive.

summary: Mm'menon introduces themself and asks to come aboard.
quote: I am Mm'menon. May I come aboard your home?

summary: Mm'menon explains they were expelled from the Uthros Combine and deduced a causality manipulator.
quote: I was thrown out of the Uthros Combine

summary: Mm'menon says the Endstone is one of many anomalies in Sothera.
quote: "The Endstone is one of many anomalies," Mm'menon says.

summary: Tezzeret plans to sell the Endstone to its maker, using Mm'menon's ship to boost the Seriema to Infinite Guideline.
quote: We will take the Endstone there, and I will sell it to its maker in exchange for a glimpse of their power.

summary: Tezzeret says he will not be changed by any hand but his own.
quote: I will not be changed by any hand except my own.

summary: Tezzeret assigns Mm'menon to provide stealthy speed.
quote: Your role, Mm'menon, is to provide us with stealthy speed.

summary: Tezzeret admits he is saving his own ship in case he must abandon the others.
quote: You're saving it in case you need to abandon the rest of us to die.

summary: Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let Tezzeret harm Haliya, invoking mallowmass.
quote: "I will detonate this ship if I have to," Sami says.

summary: Tezzeret tells Sami nothing is sacred, only useful, and challenges Sami to prove guest right is useful.
quote: Nothing's sacred. Only useful.

summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

summary: Haliya agrees to send the message, saying she will carry out her duty to report to Vondam and beg pardon for Alpharael.
quote: All I can do is carry out my next duty. To return to Vondam, make my report, and beg pardon for Alpharael.

summary: Haliya says she will not become someone who kills innocents in their homes.
quote: I don't want to be someone who kills innocents in their homes.

summary: Alpharael says he will go where the stone goes because it has kept him alive.
quote: I want to live. The stone's kept me alive.

summary: Tannuk says he goes only because he has no choice and fears the rock.
quote: "I'm going 'cause I have no choice," he says.

summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
quote: Go back and make a better choice.

summary: Ghan weftwalks into the abandoned Cail Station and feels the wrongness within.
quote: The moment Ghan's seam-ripper parted space, cutting a radiant blue line from the void into the station's dark, debris-strewn arcade, he felt the change.

summary: Ghan finds a scabbed wound in the Weft itself that no seam-ripper could make.
quote: Ghan also made out a second wound overlaid on the first: not in the infrastructure of the station, but in the Weft itself.

summary: Ghan contacts Jadnis for help searching the station's records.
quote: Jadnis. It's me.

summary: Jadnis tells Ghan of similar damage on Andenstalay that killed two.
quote: Two people died; no local leads on the causative agent.

summary: Ghan weftwalks to Andenstalay.
quote: At a touch, the Weft parted to let him step through into a higher lamella, out across the superstructure of reality.

summary: Ghan senses that elevator technician Kesori Umberlin is the source of the contamination.
quote: And the surge of nausea that struck Ghan meant she was the source of the contamination.

summary: Kesori refuses to talk and flees from Ghan.
quote: "No," she said, and bolted.

summary: Ghan chases Kesori through the city by microstepping through the Weft.
quote: A split second later, he dropped out of a shining slit in the air, a scant few meters in front of Kesori.

summary: Ghan mistimes a cut and falls from a monorail platform, but Kesori catches him.
quote: And then he was swinging, not falling.

summary: Kesori activates the artifact and uses it to tear a passage out of Andenstalay, wounding the Weft and wrecking the monorail.
quote: A strange singularity churned out of artifact and wrapped itself around her.

summary: The rebound snaps the monorail sideways and passengers are hurt.
quote: The rebound snapped the monorail sideways.

summary: Ghan realizes Kesori now holds a stolen Drix means of piercing space and time.
quote: And now Kesori Umberlin was the one being in the universe who held a way to pierce through space and time.

summary: Ghan lands in Jadnis's office on Pellerife to research the name Errit.
quote: When Ghan tumbled out into Jadnis's office on Pellerife, he landed so hard

summary: The archives reveal the botched Cail Station evacuation that left Errit dead.
quote: the botched evacuation of Cail Station that had prioritized the retrieval of expensive, specialized mining equipment over the lives of its residents.

summary: Ghan vows to hunt Oscillus Cail after destroying the artifact.
quote: I'm going to track down Oscillus Cail and the rest, and I'm going to …

summary: Jadnis tells Ghan his job is Eldrazi and not everybody else.
quote: Your job is dealing with Eldrazi. And mine is dealing with everybody else.

summary: Ghan's hunt-ache and Kesori's files point him toward the world Ssata.
quote: pointed him toward the world called Ssata.

summary: Ghan cuts into Kesori's bare apartment on Ssata and finds her diminished.
quote: With his best judgment, he angled his seam-ripper and sliced through into an ugly, unfurnished one-room apartment.

summary: Kesori reveals she can jump only a few weeks in time with the artifact.
quote: I've only ever managed to jump a few weeks.

summary: Kesori says the artifact called to her as if it knew she needed it.
quote: It … called me. As if it knew I needed it.

summary: Kesori says she will bring Errit back to the apartment.
quote: I took her away—but I can bring her back here.

summary: Kesori uses the artifact and blows a hole in the wall and tears the Weft.
quote: Kesori had blown a hole through the external wall, and a wavering tear in the Weft shimmered through the morning-hazy air of the city.

summary: Ghan kicks the artifact from Kesori, who is left limp as a broken toy, dead after the artifact finishes its work.
quote: Whatever it had already taken from her, it had finished its work: she lay like a child's broken toy.

summary: The ceiling collapses and pins Ghan beneath rubble.
quote: He looked up in time to see the ceiling above him shear in half.

summary: Pinned, Ghan finds the artifact and resolves to use it.
quote: Instead of purchase, his fingers found the artifact.

summary: Ghan tears the Weft-wound open and forces himself through it.
quote: He ripped the Weft-wound wide open and forced himself through.

summary: Ghan, in the Weft, resists the artifact's attempt to open a window to a best-forgotten past.
quote: Not much control. But enough to force closed that sickening window to a best-forgotten past.

summary: Ghan glimpses a young Kesori and Errit in the past.
quote: Kesori and Errit. Young and hungry and happy.

summary: Ghan is tempted to reach back to the day Sorothir died but chooses not to.
quote: But he didn't break, even though everything in him longed to.

summary: Ghan travels back to Andenstalay weeks earlier and warns Kesori not to go through with her plan.
quote: You don't have to go it alone. But Errit wouldn't want you to do this.

summary: Once Kesori lets go of the artifact, Ghan flees back through the rites.
quote: The moment she let go of the artifact, Ghan bawled out the rites.

summary: Ghan returns to his own present and finds the apartment's destruction overlaid on an intact original.
quote: He lost track of how long it took to claw his way back to his own present, where he pawed at the weft-wound until he fell through.

summary: Ghan cuts the artifact in half with his seam-ripper, destroying it.
quote: Half of the artifact dropped to the floor with a clatter of finality.

summary: Jadnis reveals that Kesori is alive and her assistant, and gives Ghan a new target, the Kav Tannuk.
quote: There's a protobeing emerging, a Kav called Tannuk.

summary: Ghan accepts the new hunt, resolved that dealing with the Eldrazi is his job.
quote: I've been told by a reputable source that dealing with the Eldrazi is my job. So, yes. I'm on it.

summary: Alpharael identifies a mass leech called a myzoformine approaching the Seriema.
quote: A mass leech. Sometimes they just point you out for investigation. Sometimes they kill you.

summary: The Seriema falls toward Infinite Guideline at fifty kilometers a second.
quote: They are falling toward the Infinite Guideline , glittering all alone in the dark, at a handsome fifty kilometers a second.

summary: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company bid with speed to reach Infinite Guideline.
quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

summary: Haliya reluctantly aligns her Sunstar frequency-hopper so the Seriema can listen to Free Company traffic.
quote: It takes some verbal fencing before Haliya is willing to align her Sunstar Company frequency-hopper with the Seriema 's receiver.

summary: The crew watches a distant space battle in which a ship is hit.
quote: Someone was hit, and died, or lived.

summary: Pinnacle lases the shadow shields of palestars braking too close, and the Monoists kill them.
quote: A pair of Sunstar patrol ships try to brake too close to Guideline, and Pinnacle shows its teeth

summary: Sami sends a recorded message to Infinite Guideline offering information and requesting guidance.
quote: We are inbound. We offer gifts of information and request your guidance.

summary: Alpharael broadcasts to the Monoists that he carries a thing sent by INEVITA and asks help reaching the warp.
quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, kamu-shiku, chosen by the singularity.

summary: Haliya agonizes over broadcasting and reveals she planted two bombs on the ship.
quote: I have two bombs on the ship,

summary: Alpharael persuades Haliya to keep her word and make the broadcast.
quote: Maybe you aren't cut out to be a Sunstar knight, Haliya. Maybe you aren't cut out to be certain of everything.

summary: Tannuk reveals the crew had already found and thrown out Haliya's bombs.
quote: We found them while the Illvoi were refitting the fusion engine and threw them out.

summary: Haliya broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command and offers the artifact on Infinite Guideline.
quote: I have detached myself from Syr Vondam's command and placed myself on errantry.

summary: The fighting continues around but does not touch the Seriema.
quote: But the fighting does not touch the Seriema.

summary: Sami declines to ask for mallowmass so that Infinite Guideline is not put at risk.
quote: We are under other protection.

summary: Sami says their plan with Pinnacle is to tell the whole truth.
quote: So, I'm going to tell them the truth. All of it.

summary: Sami reveals they were kitchen help on the Wurm Speaker, which went to the voices in the Wurmwall and mostly did not return.
quote: I was kitchen help. Not a lot of people came back.

summary: The Seriema reaches Infinite Guideline.
quote: They make it to Infinite Guideline .

summary: A ceasefire lets both sides crowd toward Infinite Guideline to receive the Endstone and destroy pursuers.
quote: Under cover of a ceasefire—to retrieve survivors, make repairs, and limp away—both sides crowd in toward Infinite Guideline, waiting to receive the Endstone from the Seriema and destroy its pursuers.

summary: Pinnacle places the Seriema under tacit arrest.
quote: The Seriema is under tacit arrest.

summary: Sami meets Checkmate Mantis on the dock.
quote: "You must be Checkmate Mantis," Sami says

summary: Sami tells Mantis the whole story of the artifact unearthed at Sigma.
quote: I have come into possession of an artifact unearthed from the clay of Sigma.

summary: Tannuk presents a memory crystal with the Seriema's full recording of Kavaron.
quote: Tannuk takes a knee and presents, in an outstretched claw, a quartz memory crystal.

summary: Mantis reveals Vondam came to confess and warn Pinnacle about the battle over the Endstone.
quote: Syr Vondam came to us to confess his crimes and warn us to evacuate Infinite Guideline .

summary: Mantis says the artifact should be given to the Drix.
quote: I mean the Drix.

summary: Mantis reveals that a Drix named Barrow arrived two days ago.
quote: A Drix seamed in two days ago.

summary: Mantis admits Vondam persuaded her lethal force might be justified but she has not used it.
quote: Checkmate Mantis draws a long, low drone from her legs. "Yes."

summary: The dock loses power and light as an unseen attack pierces it.
quote: The lights go out. The air pumps stop. The dock plunges into darkness.

summary: Sonar shows the dock has been holed in many places by tiny punctures.
quote: The dock has been holed in several places.

summary: Mantis identifies potential matter being pumped into the station.
quote: "Potential matter," Checkmate Mantis says.

summary: Haliya and Alpharael, drifting toward the tug quay in armor, find the warp ferries are gone.
quote: I don't want to declare defeat too soon. But the ferries are gone.

summary: Infinite Guideline springs leaks and loses its aurorae as Monoist mechans dock at punctures.
quote: Infinite Guideline has just sprung leaks. A lot of leaks.

summary: Solar Knights launch lightbridge boarding craft at Guideline.
quote: The Solar Knights are making a play for Guideline.

summary: Haliya spots a many-limbed shape headed for the dock where the Seriema is moored.
quote: It has a lot of limbs.

summary: A looping, topologically strange alien enters the dock through a hole.
quote: It is beautiful. It is a loop. It has no inside or outside.

summary: Mantis orders self-defense and the mechans shred the alien, which recovers.
quote: "Sanctioned self-defense!" Mantis orders, and the mechans open fire.

summary: The alien licks a war mechan clean, graphing its components into chalky lattice.
quote: It licks the mechan clean.

summary: Haliya and Alpharael crash into the tug quay and enter the station.
quote: They crash into the tug quay and stick.

summary: Alpharael recites random numbers hoping the Endstone will make his guess a correct ferry code, and it is rejected.
quote: You thought you'd guess randomly, then, in the future, you'd get the Endstone and make your guess correct!

summary: Haliya insists on returning to the Free Company to report and beg Alpharael's pardon.
quote: I'm going to make my report and beg your pardon.

summary: Vondam appears on the control deck and says he acted in accordance with the Sum except when he let Haliya go out of love.
quote: I did act in accordance with the Sum. Except when I let you go. I did that out of love.

summary: Vondam, helmet open and bladiators ready, stands between them and the airlock.
quote: He is here. Standing on the far side of the control deck. Between them and the airlock.

summary: Vondam calls on Haliya to come home and take the Endstone.
quote: Come home, Haliya.

summary: Mantis's last war mechan carries Sami, Tannuk and Mantis up the docking arm away from an eld.
quote: The last surviving war mechan has seized all three of them and now boosts them up the spinal shaft of Infinite Guideline's number-three docking arm, away from the Seriema and the alien.

summary: A second eld erupts into their path.
quote: Another alien erupts into their path.

summary: Mantis sacrifices her mechan to divert an eld and hurls Sami and Tannuk to an old ship hulk with a reactor.
quote: And before either of them can protest, the mechan hurls Sami and Tannuk at the ship hulk.

summary: Pinnacle's Tactical Corps personnel independently decide to release their violence delegates.
quote: Release the violence delegates.

summary: Pinnacle's mechan swarms target the radiators of the faiths' warships.
quote: Their target is the most vulnerable part of any warship—the radiators.

summary: Cataline burns through the Thinner's miracho Yamno, killing his armor.
quote: Modest Cataline burns him through and through, hot spot to cold exit, and the beam kills his armor in one blow.

summary: The Thinner grips the tapped-out Cataline in his tides.
quote: Then the Thinner, fate's armorer, grips the tapped-out Cataline in his tides.

summary: Cataline's squire Isidor is flensed by the tides.
quote: now he's scraped flat by the tides—flensed of his outer parts.

summary: The hunger from space feeds on both Sunstar and Pinnacle forces but never on Monoists.
quote: But it does not feed on Monoists.

summary: Vondam tells Haliya he should have killed her when she begged him to and urges her to live with failure.
quote: I should've killed you when you begged me to.

summary: Vondam cuts the boots off Alpharael's armor.
quote: Alpharael tries to move and Vondam, without looking, cuts the bulky, elevated boots of his suit off.

summary: Vondam pleads with Haliya to return to the faith.
quote: "Come back," he pleads.

summary: Haliya refuses to return home with the stone as a hero and explains the Sum must account for her revolt.
quote: I will not go home with the stone and be a hero.

summary: Haliya drives Vondam off Alpharael with her bladiator.
quote: She thrusts her long-handled bladiator from the hip and drives Syr Vondam off.

summary: Vondam formally degrades Haliya and bars her from knighthood.
quote: by my authority as a knight of the company, I hereby degrade you.

summary: Haliya is cast out of the Free Company and chooses to believe her choice was right.
quote: He has cast her out of the Free Company.

summary: An eld goes after Mantis and her combat mechan.
quote: The monster goes after Checkmate Mantis and her combat mechan.

summary: The eld has eaten Mantis's war mechan, which Sami sees as a graph of its components.
quote: It is a graph of the war mechan's components, spread in three dimensions. The thing has eaten it.

summary: Sami opens a stasis cask and finds their lost cat Mirri.
quote: "Mirri?" Sami gasps.

summary: Sami realizes Mirri weftwalked into a stasis cask on a similar ship and was frozen in time.
quote: She weftwalked away from the Seriema when she was startled and went to a ship that looked almost like the Seriema and landed in a stasis cask.

summary: Mirri yowls and weftwalks away from the approaching eld.
quote: Mirri yowls and vanishes. Weftwalks away.

summary: Sami and Tannuk electrocute the eld by shorting a power cable down its mouth.
quote: A spectacular buzz. A flash of fire. Power arcs through the thing's matter.

summary: The second eld hits Tannuk from the side.
quote: The second creature hits him from the side.

summary: Haliya and Vondam fight a sparring-style duel on the control deck.
quote: "Tally-ho," Vondam says, mildly.

summary: Vondam says protocol dictated the slaughter, convincing Haliya that the fault lies in the Sum.
quote: I had to. Protocol dictated it.

summary: Haliya concludes the fault is not in Vondam or herself but in the Sum.
quote: The fault is not in him, or in her. It is in the Sum.

summary: Haliya embraces Vondam and, using the hole in Alpharael's hand, jabs her thumb into the back of his neck.
quote: Haliya embraces him and jabs her right thumb into the hole in Alpharael's hand.

summary: Haliya pops apart Vondam's vertebrae.
quote: She digs her thumb into his vertebrae and pops them apart.

summary: Barrow's staff burns the eld attacking Tannuk and destroys it.
quote: The new flesh is burning .

summary: The Drix introduces itself as Tumulus, or Barrow, a sentinel at the cofferdam.
quote: I am called Tumulus, or Barrow. I am a sentinel at the cofferdam.

summary: Barrow says it saved Mantis and now must hunt.
quote: I have saved the beautiful insect and delivered her to her post.

summary: Barrow unseams space and vanishes.
quote: Barrow is gone.

summary: Tannuk calms Sami's panic and Sami decides what to do next.
quote: I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.

summary: Haliya cuts Vondam's nerve interface, leaving him helpless.
quote: But his squire reaches through the hole in her enemy's hand and cuts her knight's nerve interface away.

summary: Haliya makes her report to Vondam and asks pardon for Alpharael.
quote: I have made my report,

summary: Vondam demands that Haliya kill him but she cannot do what the Sum asks.
quote: She cannot do what the Sum asks.

summary: Haliya places herself on errantry, still a Summist but cast out of the Free Company.
quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

summary: A Monoist gravkill paladin has taken the Seriema.
quote: The worshippers of INEVITA have taken the Seriema.

summary: Sami stabs the Monoist armor in the chest.
quote: They stab the Monoist right in the chest.

summary: The paladin says the Monoists will aid the Endstone if it goes through the eternity column.
quote: The Endstone has come here, to the eternity column. If it wishes to go through the eternity column, then it will, and we will aid it.

summary: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball of alabile, apparently killed by Tezzeret.
quote: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball, like crushed foil.

summary: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under warship scrutiny.
quote: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under the terrifying scrutiny of warships.

summary: Haliya says she cannot believe Alpharael guessed the ferry code.
quote: I still can't believe you guessed that code,

summary: Alpharael realizes a cherazad has frozen the battle.
quote: "Tactical event horizon," he realizes.

summary: Sami opens the stasis cask and Mirri trots out beside the Endstone.
quote: A cat trots out of the dark.

summary: Alpharael drops the crystal on the map and it settles at the edge of the rag and the system.
quote: It bounces twice and settles on the very edge of the reading rag, and the solar system, too.

summary: Tezzeret says they will warp until the stone says it has reached its goal.
quote: We will see what god or monster made this thing.

summary: Sami learns the warp ferry is in a cherazad and the fleet will kill them as they prepare to warp.
quote: We can't leave the bubble! The Free Company fleet will kill us the moment we prepare to warp.

summary: Solar Knights board from the dock.
quote: "Solar Knights outside!" Haliya calls.

summary: Sami jerks the Seriema free and drives at Infinite Guideline to force a game of chicken.
quote: With a drumbeat of thruster fire, they jerk the Seriema free of the mooring.

summary: The eternity column opens, letting the Seriema into warp.
quote: Key meets lock. Eternity opens.

summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

summary: Sami realizes the Endstone is steering them toward the Wurmwall.
quote: They're headed toward the edge of Sothera—the Wurmwall.

summary: The Endstone changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret.
quote: The stone has lost its glistening facets. It is now a gleamingly black ovoid.

summary: Tezzeret explains he sent the most disposable of his workers to Sigma so the stone could choose them.
quote: I chose the most desperate, disposable pawns in my employ.

summary: Tannuk recounts that he met Sami on the wreck of the Wurm Speaker after leaving Kavaron.
quote: That's where I met Captain Sami.

summary: Tezzeret says they are heading to the place that killed the Wurm Speaker.
quote: They are saying we are going to the place that killed it.

summary: The Seriema's engine dies and a silence falls over the ship.
quote: "The engine!" Tannuk says. "The engine's out!"

summary: A beautiful creature steps out of a split in the cosmos into the galley.
quote: A beautiful, beautiful creature steps through.

summary: The Endstone falls into the visitor's hand after Alpharael drops it.
quote: The Endstone falls into its hand.

summary: The visitor says Alpharael is touched by the core and he collapses unconscious.
quote: Touched by the core. Blessed …

summary: Haliya's bladiator cuts two of the visitor's fingers and the visitor crushes her throat.
quote: Haliya's blade goes through two of its fingers.

summary: The visitor declares itself the last thing.
quote: "I am the last thing," the beautiful android says.

summary: The visitor tells Sami the serpent needs a hero and to find it if they can.
quote: But the serpent needs a hero. Find me if you can.

summary: The visitor vanishes, taking the Endstone with it.
quote: But stars and nebulae close before it, and it is gone. Just gone. The Endstone with it.

summary: Tezzeret keeps the severed fingers, inhales their violet light and remarks that Sami has something like a Planeswalker.
quote: So. You do have something like a Planeswalker.

summary: Sami holds Mirri, relieved that one thing is all right.
quote: Mirri is still here.

summary: Following the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.

summary: Tezzeret works to found a criminal consortium in the Edge.
quote: all while aiming to lay the foundations of a criminal consortium.

summary: After bad luck including Mirri's disappearance, Sami lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.
quote: After a run of bad luck (including the disappearance of their beloved cat, Mirri), they lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.

summary: Tannuk was dishonorably discharged from the KMN for redirecting a falling chunk of the debris belt.
quote: He was dishonorably discharged after redirecting a falling chunk of the Kavaron debris belt to minimize collateral damage, a crime among the disaster-prone remnants of the Kav homeworld.

summary: Exiled Tannuk joined Sami's crew and is now its last remaining member.
quote: Exiled from his people, Tannuk joined Sami and found the young captain to be as passionate about their crew as Tannuk was about his people.

summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

summary: Haliya pledged her bladiator to Syr Vondam's service.
quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

summary: Alpharael has strange dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid.
quote: He has been plagued by strange dreams ever since his sister embraced eternity and dove into the supervoid.

summary: Mm'menon, expelled from the Uthros Combine, lent services to Tezzeret to stay in-system.
quote: After being expelled from the Combine, Mm'menon lent their services to Tezzeret to stay in-system

summary: Xu-Ifit's wife is frozen by time dilation after plunging into the supervoid.
quote: Ten years ago, Xu-Ifit's wife made the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid but was caught in a sudden gravitational anomaly, leaving her frozen in place by time dilation.

summary: Xu-Ifit experiments on Monoist acolytes to perfect a way to save her wife.
quote: she experiments on Monoist acolytes, testing their survivability through dangerous missions before sending them to take the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid.

summary: Abandoned on a moon, Dyadrine grafts local flora onto itself.
quote: After years of analysis, the mechan determined that local flora contained sufficient structural integrity from which to graft repairs onto themself.

summary: Kav colonists turn to Evendo for mining after wrecking Kavaron.
quote: Kav colonizers, having all but destroyed their homeworld of Kavaron, have turned their attention toward Evendo as a place to mine for natural resources.

summary: Szarel commits to the Evendo terrasymbiosis knowing he will not see it finished.
quote: Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion, but he has committed his life to advancing the cause.

summary: Kilo self-actualizes and takes a mechan body aboard the Inspirit in the Garden of Apeiron.
quote: Kilo has fully self-actualized, naming itself and moving the primary sliver of its consciousness to a single mechan body aboard its host vessel.

summary: Thendar is fired and deposited back on Kavaron That Is for skimming ore.
quote: Swiftly fired from his position and deposited back on Kavaron That Is

summary: Kav scrappers send Val's ship crashing onto an unexplored jungle world.
quote: Val has transmitted this message daily ever since a fateful run-in with Kav scrappers sent her ship hurtling to the surface of an unexplored jungle world.

summary: Axavar severs his contract as a Drix Eldrazi hunter.
quote: So Axavar severed his contract and his fate.

summary: Vv'viza takes over leadership of the Uthros Combine after Mm'menon's flight.
quote: Vv'viza eagerly stepped up to fill the void of leadership left in their absence.

summary: The Weftwinder emerges and makes its home within the Chaos Wall.
quote: Able to burrow beyond the tangible, to hollow the Weft as one might bore tunnels through earth, the Weftwinder has found its home within the Chaos Wall.

summary: Oona is defeated and destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling leaves the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
quote: the queen and mother of all faeries, Oona, had been defeated and destroyed, and her control over the cycle of day and night had ended.

summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul

summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds herself to Rhys with a death pact.
quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys with a death pact.

summary: Pockets of Lorwyn sprout across Shadowmoor, splitting villages and throwing the plane into turmoil.
quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness.

summary: Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament as the aspects merge.
quote: two great beings awoke from the firmament above the plane: Eirdu, the incarnation of the sun, and Isilu, the incarnation of the moon.

summary: Eclipsed realms begin to appear, as tales emerge of places caught between light and darkness.
quote: These areas came to be known as eclipsed realms.

summary: The Phyrexian invasion destroys the plane's power balance and nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose networks of power are turned to Phyrexian use.
quote: The Phyrexian invasion destroyed the fragile power balance of the plane

summary: Untainted Lorwyn elves ally with the other species and make a stand at Lys Alana.
quote: they were finally able to gain ground and make a stand at Lys Alana.

summary: Shadowmoor boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders, riding cavalry into enemy lines at great cost.
quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within.

summary: Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the Phyrexian invaders, then shut themselves in their homes.
quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders.

summary: The Hound of Bristlebane skewers a Dominus with a spear along a branch of the Invasion Tree.
quote: singlehandedly drove a spear through the body of a Dominus, skewering it from neck to knee

summary: Lorwyn merrow flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine when the Phyrexians attack the water.
quote: Many were forced to flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine.

summary: Shadowmoor merrow escape to the Dark Meanders to wait out the invasion and adapt to their new environment.
quote: they escaped to the Dark Meanders, tunnels deep under the plane, hoping to wait out the invasion beneath the water.

summary: Many flamekin disappear underground and hibernate; around half later return as rimekin.
quote: with around half of them having returned as rimekin, their hibernation causing a change in forms.

summary: Elvish authority in Lorwyn collapses as the invasion destroys the infrastructure of the power imbalance, letting other species reclaim sovereignty.
quote: This vacuum allowed the other species on the plane to gain ground, clawing back ancestral lands and reclaiming sovereignty.

summary: Dina announces the class has reached the Harrier's Wood for sample collection.
quote: We have reached the Harrier's Wood.

summary: Tamira explains that underclassmen may only now visit remote sites because the Oriq have been driven back.
quote: Now that the Oriq are effectively gone, we can reopen more remote locations for scholarship.

summary: Dina shows the students a snarlflower and sets them to gather six to ten unblemished blossoms each.
quote: you are each expected to gather no fewer than six and no more than ten unblemished snarlflower blossoms

summary: Kirol sneaks up on Abigale and startles her, and the two banter about signing and swearing.
quote: jumping at the sight of the figure behind her, making a hoarse squawking sound at the same time.

summary: Sanar tumbles out of the brush having lost his flowers, and Tamira gives him some of hers.
quote: That's why I've been gathering extra: you can have a few of mine,

summary: Sanar spots a small blue insect-like faerie in the trees; it laughs and flies off, and he chases it, taking Tamira's basket.
quote: He leapt to his feet and ran after the fleeing creature—taking Tam's sample basket with him.

summary: All four students trip over a tree root and tumble into a hole ringed with snarlflowers, falling into prismatic light.
quote: all four students rolled and tumbled through the leafy debris on the ground, straight into a large hole in the middle of the otherwise unremarkable clearing.

summary: The faerie giggles and dives into the hole after the students.
quote: giggling wildly, then dove after the students, disappearing into whatever waited on the other side.

summary: The students land in an unfamiliar meadow of spiral-patterned flowers and floating stones and realize from the single sun that they are not on Arcavios.
quote: "Not on Arcavios," said Tam.

summary: Abigale stops Tamira from touching a stone and refuses to leave the others to fly up for help.
quote: I'm not leaving you here.

summary: The students discover a free-standing dolmen gate dividing the sunlit meadow from darkness and decide to go through to find help.
quote: They stepped through the dolmen gate, and the darkness swallowed them all.

summary: Sanar conjures a glowing yellow light to illuminate the cave, earning Tamira's approval.
quote: a steadily glowing yellow ball appeared in the air in front of him.

summary: Kirol studies cave paintings of incarnations of the sun and moon trading places.
quote: Incarnations of the sun and moon, trading places,

summary: The students find the sleeping moon-headed creature from the paintings at the center of a silver-lit chamber.
quote: And there, at the center of the circle, was the moon-headed creature from the cave paintings.

summary: Sanar, drawn by the creature's autumnal presence, crosses into the circle and touches its neck.
quote: He pressed his palm against the cool, smooth neck of the creature

summary: The creature wakes and roars, terrifying the students.
quote: Its eyes opened, lambent as two smaller moons, devoid of iris or pupil but patterned with the pits and craters of an actual moon.

summary: Kirol yanks Sanar away from the creature and they flee as it stomps and sends a wave of near-solid darkness through the tunnel.
quote: Kirol darted forward, grabbing Sanar by the elbow, and yanked the smaller student away from the beast.

summary: The darkness floods the meadow, turning day to night and transforming the landscape.
quote: the sky overhead erupted in stars, the sun becoming a thin eclipse ring of fire in the distance while the moon sprang to sudden, total fullness.

summary: The blue faerie is transformed by the darkness into a green, gold-flecked, vaguely regal creature and flies off following the dark.
quote: Most striking of all, the blue bled out of its carapace, replaced by gleaming, gold-flecked green.

summary: The darkness pours out of the dolmen gate, followed by distant screams.
quote: All that remained was the dark flowing out of the dolmen gate, and the distant sound of screams.

summary: The students flee the darkness and the roaring beast; Sanar bolts first and Abigale escapes into the air.
quote: Sanar was the first to turn and bolt.

summary: The moon-headed beast emerges from the dolmen gate and plods away, followed by darkness, and Tam staggers out in its wake.
quote: the head of the beast emerged through the dolmen gate, the moon at its crown growing brighter as soon as it was in the open air.

summary: The four students regroup and run from the spreading night toward patches of daylight.
quote: the four students ran for the remains of the day as hard and as fast as they had ever run for anything.

summary: A stout archer waves the students toward her across patches of darkness and leads them into an ash forest.
quote: Follow me,

summary: Brigid asks the students who they are and winces when Abigale's telepathy enters her mind, since they are not part of the thoughtweft.
quote: You're not part of the thoughtweft. You're not meant to be there.

summary: Brigid introduces herself, explains that people tumble into Lorwyn since the metal invasion, and identifies the beast as Isilu.
quote: My name is Brigid Baeli, hero of Kinsbaile, and I'm pleased to welcome you to Lorwyn.

summary: Brigid says Isilu should be sleeping, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in their territories.
quote: It's supposed to be sleeping right now, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in our territories.

summary: The spreading darkness washes over and erases the Omenpath, and Abigale flies up to confirm it is gone.
quote: it washed over the iridescent triangle, seemingly wiping it away.

summary: Tam asks Brigid for a place to go and Brigid agrees to take them somewhere.
quote: I think I do, yes,

summary: The blue faerie slips through the briar hedge into Glen Elendra, reverts to a blue Lorwyn faerie in the light and sneaks into Maralen's flock.
quote: a small blue Lorwyn faerie stood where the green faerie had been

summary: The faerie drops a sprig of foxglove on the sleeping Maralen's pillow.
quote: dropping its sprig of foxglove onto the pillow of the figure sleeping there.

summary: Maralen wakes from a terrible dream, sensing something is very wrong.
quote: With a gasp, Maralen awoke and sat upright in her bed

summary: Camey reports that the faerie Aherin is missing and that someone is using his bed, making the flock seem to number thirty-five.
quote: But now there are thirty- four of us, and Aherin is missing

summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

summary: Maralen briefly sees a third figure of living flower petals in her mirror and hears ghostly laughter, which Rhys cannot hear.
quote: it looked like there was a third person in the room with them, smaller, made entirely of living flower petals and glaring at her with unending menace.

summary: Maralen flees to the courtyard to find comfort with Eirdu.
quote: Hello, old friend,

summary: As Eirdu leaves, patches of Shadowmoor open in the courtyard, and the blue faerie transforms back to green and follows Maralen.
quote: letting its transformation repeat in reverse, blue becoming green, smoothness becoming jagged and ornate.

summary: Ajani arrives at Liliana's office at Strixhaven; she guesses someone has died.
quote: Who died?

summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace has died.
quote: It was such a small word.

summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
quote: So Bolas escaped.

summary: Liliana's teacup shatters as she absorbs the news.
quote: Her teacup shattered as it hit the floor.

summary: Dina bursts in to report that four students are missing after following a flying creature down an Omenpath.
quote: We think they fell down an Omenpath, but it closed before we could go after them.

summary: Ajani offers to try to find the missing students and goes with Dina to the site.
quote: I can certainly try,

summary: Dina leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood to search for the four missing students.
quote: led the two out of the building where Liliana's office was located and across the fields toward the Harrier's Wood.

summary: Liliana calls up black fog and concludes the students are not dead.
quote: Like Jace, they aren't dead,

summary: Ajani finds a blue stitched flower petal and recognizes it as coming from a plane where denizens tailor with flowers, which Liliana identifies as Lorwyn.
quote: You're hinting at Lorwyn,

summary: Ajani refuses to take Liliana along and plans to reach the students through a stable Omenpath between Lorwyn and Shandalar.
quote: I can't take you with me.

summary: Ajani glows and vanishes to go after the students, and Liliana takes Dina back to campus.
quote: On the second step, he was gone.

summary: Brigid leads the students toward Goldmeadow, saying not just anyone could get them there.
quote: But not just anyone could get you to Goldmeadow

summary: The students arrive at Goldmeadow and Brigid takes them into the meeting hall, saying her mangled thoughtweft connection makes the locals nervous.
quote: I make the locals a bit nervous, what with my connection to the thoughtweft all mangled up and half-severed.

summary: The students explain how they arrived; Brigid identifies the creature as a faerie and says she is a close friend of Queen Maralen.
quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

summary: The blue faerie reappears in the meeting hall and laughs until alarm bells drown it out, then flies away.
quote: the little blue faerie from before, which had flown in through a window and was now hovering in front of him.

summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow and the darkness transforms the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.
quote: Everywhere the darkness touched, the city was transformed.

summary: Brigid tells the students to flee and explains how to reach Glen Elendra, warning them not to listen to anyone who begs them to turn around.
quote: When I step through this door, you run, you understand me?

summary: The students flee through a village torn between day and night as the shadows swallow the sunlit defenders.
quote: bit by bit, the archers were falling, transforming into moon-eyed fighters from the other side.

summary: Night-side figures pull Brigid into the darkness, transforming her, and she fights alongside them against her former allies.
quote: when she opened her eyes again, they were full moon-bright, filled with a light that had nothing to do with the day.

summary: The students escape Goldmeadow and reason that the night side is frightened, not evil.
quote: I don't think the night is bad here, just different

summary: Abigale flies Sanar, Kirol and Tam across the Wanderwine one at a time.
quote: They spread their arms, and Abigale grasped them, taking to the air.

summary: The group reaches the Gilt-Leaf Wood, where Kirol lags behind and is seized by a silent hunter.
quote: a silent hunter rose out of the bushes behind Kirol and grabbed them, pulling them out of sight before they could make a sound.

summary: Lluwen holds a knife to Kirol and demands to know what they know about why Isilu walks.
quote: I know you know why Isilu walks. I want to know what you know.

summary: Lluwen takes Kirol prisoner to bring before High Perfect Morcant, and leads them deeper into the forest.
quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.

summary: Lluwen marches Kirol through the forest while they argue about hiking shoes and hooves.
quote: That's because you don't have feet,

summary: Lluwen brings Kirol to Lys Alana, a gilded city of boardwalks and towers.
quote: Come along. I'm taking you to High Perfect Morcant now.

summary: Lluwen presents Kirol to Morcant, claiming they know something of why Isilu walks out of sync.
quote: I've found a stranger in the forest who knows something of Isilu and why he walks out of sync with his promised time.

summary: Kirol recounts how the students woke Isilu; Morcant says Isilu should not have awakened for about six months.
quote: Isilu shouldn't have awoken until a good six months from now.

summary: Morcant explains her view of Eirdu and Isilu and sees Isilu's vulnerability as a chance to end the night forever and raise the Gilt-Leaf Empire again.
quote: If they could end the night forever, and welcome endless day in its place.

summary: Morcant muses about killing the night with dawnglow mixed with summer dreams, horrifying Lluwen.
quote: With the weapons of the night, of course.

summary: Morcant refuses to let Kirol leave, declaring that she needs them.
quote: We need you. You're not going anywhere.

summary: Sanar, Tam and Abigale realize Kirol is missing; Abigale resolves to find them and storms off alone.
quote: I'm going to go find them. You can wait here if you like.

summary: A beast with branch antlers emerges and flings Sanar into the trees.
quote: the motion causing one of its antlers to catch him in the chest and fling him away into the trees.

summary: Abigale stumbles into the tributary and is swept toward the Wanderwine.
quote: As she stumbled, her foot hit the top of the sloping bank that led down to the water, and she fell.

summary: Abigale conjures bubbles of air to breathe underwater.
quote: Her hands moved, and bubbles began to form around them, answering her call.

summary: Fish-people armed with spears surround Abigale; their leader signs to her and invites her to come see something.
quote: We have something you must see

summary: The merrow tow Abigale into the depths of the Wanderwine.
quote: they began to swim toward the Wanderwine proper, towing Abigale along with them.

summary: Tam and Sanar decide to find the waterfall instead of chasing Abigale, and Tam steps through the water.
quote: She stepped forward.

summary: Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and realizes her independence may be unraveling.
quote: These were the petals of Oona's flesh, and they couldn't be here, unless—

summary: Maralen sees Oona's gaze in the mirror and hears laughter.
quote: she met the terrible gaze of Oona and pushed herself away from the mirror so hard

summary: Faeries bring Tam and Sanar to Maralen, and Tam says Brigid sent them.
quote: I'm a gorgon. My name is Tam—Brigid sent us.

summary: Maralen tells the students Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her.
quote: Oona is returning, and this time, I don't know if I can stop her.

summary: Rhys bursts in with the blue faerie and attacks Maralen with a dagger to keep his promise.
quote: The elf drew a dagger from his belt and lunged.

summary: Rhys slips on flower petals and tumbles out a window.
quote: Rhys took two wild, stumbling steps and tumbled out of a nearby window.

summary: Maralen explains the death pact and flees with Tam, Sanar and the blue faerie before Rhys returns.
quote: But I'm not ready to die, and if we can settle Isilu and restore the cycle, I may not have to.

summary: Maralen, Sanar and Tam escape the palace by blowing the bud off a giant stem with Sanar's improvised explosive and sliding down it.
quote: The bud exploded, sending sticky chunks flying in all directions.

summary: Maralen finds a hidden coracle and the trio drifts toward the Wanderwine; Maralen explains Oona was her creator and she must prove she is not her.
quote: But I'm still myself.

summary: Maralen explains she keeps Rhys alive by magic through their binding promise.
quote: As long as he's bound to me, my magic keeps him alive.

summary: The coracle reaches the Stinkdrinker Warren, where Ashling pulls Maralen ashore.
quote: A four-fingered hand made of what looked like flexible black glass caught her wrist and tugged her onto solid ground.

summary: Maralen tells Ashling their story, and Ashling reveals the elves and Morcant plan to kill the night beast with poisons.
quote: They're concocting a plan to kill the creature.

summary: Maralen rejects ending the night forever, saying eternal day is Oona's way, and Ashling agrees to help stop the elves.
quote: Eternal day is Oona's way, not my own.

summary: The blue-and-green faerie eavesdrops on the conversation and flies off.
quote: It flicked back and forth between blue and green

summary: Ajani arrives near the dolmen gate, fights a Shadowmoor serpent and finds the students' footprints leading away.
quote: until he finally had no choice but to strike it down.

summary: Ajani fights a boar and senses how out of sync and unhappy the plane is.
quote: Beasts of Shadowmoor and beasts of Lorwyn, both driven to attack by the sudden change of day into night.

summary: Maralen, Tam, Sanar and Ashling set out down the Wanderwine in a boggart-crewed boat, and Maralen tells of Oona's great aurora.
quote: she managed to capture the auroras that naturally flare between night and day and braid them into a single great aurora

summary: Maralen reveals she was made by Oona as a weapon-avatar and slipped into the skin of Maralen of the Mornsong.
quote: I was to be her avatar, a part of her, carrying her consciousness ahead of my own.

summary: Maralen tells of her older brother, Oona's first avatar, who defied her, befriended a giant he called father, and vanished after Oona had the giant killed.
quote: The first was my brother.

summary: Shadowmoor claims the Wanderwine and the boggarts refuse to go farther, forcing the group to walk.
quote: Shadowmoor had taken the Wanderwine.

summary: Morcant and Lluwen force Kirol, bound, toward a grove claimed by Isilu to gather dawnglove.
quote: You're going to go inside and gather them for us.

summary: Kirol finds the dawnglove flowers and is chased by cinders but escapes with a sprig.
quote: they burst through the veil of rainbows with the dawnglove in their hand

summary: Morcant orders Kirol back for more dawnglove; Kirol and Lluwen refuse.
quote: They don't deserve to die that way.

summary: Ajani bursts in, drives back the cinders and defies Morcant, then takes Kirol away.
quote: My name is Ajani, and we are leaving.

summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.
quote: Lluwen had an instant to make up his mind.

summary: Ashling steps into Shadowmoor and becomes rimekin, retaining her memory.
quote: By night, I'm what we call 'rimekin,'

summary: The transformed kithkin of Goldmeadow led by Brigid surround and herd the party.
quote: the transformed Brigid at the front of their pack.

summary: Isilu approaches with a small green faerie flitting before it, and Maralen recognizes it as her brother.
quote: My brother,

summary: A line of elf torches appears while Isilu closes in, and the kithkin ready to fight.
quote: And all the while, Isilu came closer, the living night descending on the drowning dregs of day.

summary: Elves advance on Maralen's party as the kithkin form a united wall and Isilu draws near with the faerie.
quote: The night-touched kithkin continued to ready their weapons and adjust their positions

summary: Maralen greets the faerie as her brother, but it flits back to Isilu.
quote: You came home!

summary: Isilu lowers its head to Ashling and begins circling the party protectively against the elves.
quote: It's protecting us,

summary: Maralen explains that her brother was made a shapeshifter and the blue faerie was his Lorwyn self.
quote: The blue faerie that accompanied us was his Lorwyn self, and unfamiliar to me.

summary: Ashling reveals the elf torches hold captive sunlight elementals.
quote: Chained and captive and carried into night.

summary: The elves charge and join battle with the kithkin.
quote: Then, with a peal of silvered bells, they surged forward and joined the battle.

summary: Kithkin arrows knock reliquaries from elves, freeing the sunlight elementals and transforming the elves into their Shadowmoor selves.
quote: gasped and changed, flesh and bone melting smoothly into their Shadowmoor selves.

summary: Sanar hits an elf archer with a rock and defiantly tells the elves to back off.
quote: We just want to go home

summary: A disarmed elf becomes a Shadowmoor elf and defects, prompting Brigid and the kithkin to charge.
quote: Brigid seemed to take her defection as a cue

summary: Tam is shot in the abdomen with an arrow and falls.
quote: an arrow protruding from her abdomen.

summary: Rhys approaches Maralen with a poisoned dagger, calling her Oona.
quote: I made your heir a promise. I made my friend a promise. This ends now.

summary: Rhys cuts Maralen's arm; she bleeds petals and collapses, and Rhys is stunned that she did not fight back.
quote: the wound bled petals in place of blood

summary: The faerie drops to the ground, grows into a tall winged man and confronts Rhys, declaring Oona dead and Maralen his sister.
quote: Oona is dead. Maralen was my sister

summary: Sanar deduces the man is Maralen's brother, whom Oona made and threw away, while treating Tam's wound.
quote: You're Maralen's brother, the one who left before she was Maralen.

summary: Oko recounts leaving Oona and mistaking Maralen for Oona reborn, and Rhys learns the poison has sealed her fate.
quote: His knife was coated in moonglow.

summary: Touched by an elf's sunlit reliquary, Oko turns into his Lorwyn self and transforms the elf into an elk.
quote: The elk that stood in his place looked bewildered

summary: Oko turns more elves into rabbits to protect Sanar and tells Rhys that raising arms against day is raising them against night.
quote: She serves Lorwyn, and I serve Shadowmoor.

summary: Ajani leaps over the elf line carrying Kirol and joins the group.
quote: The figure became clear as a white-furred leonin, carrying Kirol cradled close against his chest.

summary: Oko reveals that Liliana knows him as Oko and that he was Oona's first attempt at an heir.
quote: She knows me as Oko. I was Oona's first attempt at an heir.

summary: Kirol explains that dawnglove may counter moonglow, and Oko flies off to find Morcant.
quote: Don't let my sister die before I return,

summary: Ajani heals Tam's wound by removing the arrow with glowing fingers.
quote: His fingers glowed white as he eased the arrow out of her flesh, and the injury began to knit up under his touch.

summary: Kirol and Sanar slip away to find the dawnglove and find Morcant holding a vial of dawnglow.
quote: It was no true surprise when they got there to find Perfect Morcant

summary: Lluwen headbutts Morcant, steals her vial and throws it to Sanar.
quote: He leaned over to pluck the vial from her hand.

summary: Morcant transforms to her Shadowmoor self and bows apologetically to Isilu as the students flee with Lluwen to reach Maralen.
quote: We're going to see the queen,

summary: Eirdu's belling cry halts the battle as Eirdu arrives and Oko drops from the air.
quote: A golden glow appeared on the horizon, growing brighter and brighter before rising like the sun, and Eirdu appeared.

summary: Kirol spots Abigale alive, flying beside Eirdu.
quote: But she's alive !

summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen race back with the vial of dawnglow rather than greet Eirdu.
quote: We can do both,

summary: Oko takes the vial of dawnglow from Kirol and flies off with it.
quote: Oko barely seemed to move as he snatched it away.

summary: Oko demands Ajani save his sister and tells him the magic of the plane is fed by story and that only saving the queen will save Tam.
quote: The magic of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor is fed by story,

summary: Oko vows not to fail his sister and drips dawnglow into Maralen's mouth.
quote: What a cruel world, to force one such as I to play the hero,

summary: Maralen revives, swallowing the dawnglow under her own power as the wound's petals turn to golden sap and then ordinary blood.
