quote: This time Maralen swallowed under her own power, and her eyes fluttered open

summary: Oko tells Rhys that Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him, since Rhys thought he was destroying a tyrant.
quote: You thought you were destroying a tyrant, and that, at least, I can respect.

summary: Oko gives the remaining dawnglow to Ajani for Tam's wound.
quote: He took the vial, tipping its contents out over Tam's wound

summary: Isilu and Eirdu answer each other's calls and, instead of fighting, wrestle in play; Maralen declares the balance is here.
quote: Then Isilu returned the bow and pounced.

summary: Eirdu breathes on Tam, flaring the dawnglow in her wound, and she wakes and embraces Sanar.
quote: and she sat up, coughing, only to fall down again as Sanar flung himself at her

summary: Abigale explains that the merrow guarded the sleeping Eirdu and that it followed her back to the battlefield to fix the imbalance.
quote: The merfolk realized it was moving to fix the imbalances

summary: The elementals' dance ends; Isilu heads back toward its cavern as the night recedes and transformed kithkin and elves return to their Lorwyn selves.
quote: As the ribbons of night unwound, the transformed kithkin returned to their original states.

summary: Maralen thanks Oko for returning and tells everyone the night elemental awoke because the strangers' dreams hurt it.
quote: The night elemental awoke because your strange dreams hurt it.

summary: Maralen forgives Rhys, but realizes his old promise is gone and he is no longer bound to her magic.
quote: Your old one—I can't feel it anymore. You're no longer bound to my magic.

summary: Rhys thanks Eirdu and Maralen, then dissolves into flower petals and dies.
quote: His body came apart in flower petals, dawnglove and moonglove and apple blossom

summary: Oko declines to stay and rule, but Maralen offers him a home in Glen Elendra.
quote: But I love my freedom too much to be confined.

summary: Lluwen slips away to follow Ajani and the students, fearing Morcant, and asks to come along.
quote: But I helped one of the students, and if I stay here, they will kill me.

summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

summary: Liliana scolds Tam and says she will not ask Ajani for another favor, calling Oko a bastard.
quote: Encounters with that bastard Oko rarely end that well for anyone but him.

summary: A white-clad woman with Liliana's own face arrives at Liliana's office and asks her to close the door for a conversation.
quote: Maybe close the door, dear. We need to have a conversation.

summary: Auntie Grub begins telling the young boggarts the tale of four friends who raided a giant's lair.
quote: Today's tale is the story of four enterprising boggarts and how they raided a giant's lair

summary: Ygril's group finds the pass to Bre's lair has gone into Shadowmoor and decides instead to raid Boeb's lair.
quote: the lair belonged to Boeb of Clan Boldwyr.

summary: Ygril persuades the others by promising fame greater than Horp's, and sends Lugg and Flib to scout.
quote: We'll be the first boggarts to successfully rob Boeb.

summary: The boggarts approach Boeb's territory on Marrja and discover seven dead boggarts hanging from a tree.
quote: just up ahead were seven dead boggarts hanging from the low branch of a tree.

summary: Ygril hears Boeb snoring and explains giants' name sleep, so the boggarts enter the lair.
quote: a giant's slumber was something called name sleep, triggered only by a sudden change such as trauma or abundance.

summary: The boggarts find the sleeping Boeb looks genial rather than terrible.
quote: Boeb the Terrible did not look quite so terrible.

summary: The boggarts loot the lair, ferrying treasures away on Marrja, while Ygril secretly stuffs her pouch with potions.
quote: The friends had agreed to evenly share the loot, but Ygril wanted the choicest potions for herself.

summary: Flib climbs onto Boeb's chest with an eternalisk scale and begins hacking at its string with his axe.
quote: Flib, as if reading her mind, produced his axe and began to hack at the rope.

summary: Boeb's cloudgoat arrives bleating, startling Flib, whose axe falls into Boeb's flesh and wakes him.
quote: to bury itself, just as Ygril had feared, firmly in Boeb's flesh.

summary: Boeb wakes and crushes Flib, and Ygril falls into a copper bucket of old milk and is trapped.
quote: He twitched, slapped his chest, and crushed poor Flib.

summary: Boeb rages at the thieves; Lugg and Naance flee on Marrja.
quote: Filthy boggart thieves!

summary: Boeb threatens to dismember and hang the hidden Ygril, but she stays quiet in the bucket.
quote: Then Boeb will pluck your arms from their joints and suck the marrow from them.

summary: Boeb's sorrow is revealed: his father's death sent him into name sleep, and the scale was his father's gift.
quote: He had lost his father, and he was so overcome by grief that he had fallen into name sleep.

summary: Boeb milks the cloudgoat into the bucket, nearly drowning Ygril, and then puts the bucket over the fire to boil.
quote: There came the unmistakable crackle of flames as Boeb settled the bucket over the furnace.

summary: Scalded, Ygril drinks a green potion and grows into a giant, wrecking the cave.
quote: Ygril realized then that she was a giant.

summary: Boeb and giant Ygril brawl; he hurls standing stones and begins choking her as the potion wears off.
quote: Worse, the potion was spent, and she was starting to shrink to her normal size.

summary: Lugg and Naance return on Marrja, who rakes Boeb's face and tears out his eyes while Ygril pins him.
quote: to sink her talons into his eyes and tear them out.

summary: The boggarts escape with their loot and celebrate Flib back in their burrow.
quote: They celebrated Flib—who died foolishly, yes, but in service of something greater.

summary: Kellan gives Amalia flowers called meadowsweet from Lorwyn and mentions dreaming of them.
quote: Would you believe I dreamt of these a couple of nights ago?

summary: Three treefolk, Morecote, Erewaker and Sigric, travel across Lorwyn to plant a yew sapling for a new Rising.
quote: We have a sacred duty to the yew trees.

summary: Three faeries taunt Morecote, calling him a failure, and challenge him to a duel.
quote: If you duel all of us at once and win, we'll tell you something.

summary: Morecote accepts and clears a field for the duel with the faeries.
quote: Come and test my mettle, then.

summary: Morecote crushes Meadowsweet in his grip while the other two faeries poison Sigric.
quote: Blood spills upon the white Meadowsweet and upon the bark of the ash tree.

summary: The faeries flee, remarking that yew grows best within a corpse.
quote: Yew grows best within a corpse.

summary: Kellan wakes from a dream of a rotting elder tree that screams like a human and writes down a woman's voice.
quote: And as the tree fell to the ground, it screamed .

summary: Sigric, weakened by poison, tells them they must pass a sleeping giant to reach the veil and rambles about Colfenor.
quote: It cannot grow where the sun warms its leaves.

summary: They spot Forget-Me-Not and Baby's Breath hovering near the giant's head, harrying her awake.
quote: All Erewaker can do is watch in horror as they harry the giant.

summary: Morecote tears the sapling from Sigric, hands it to Erewaker and stays to face the awakened giant.
quote: Morecote tears the sapling straight from Sigric's bark.

summary: The giant demands who woke her, seeking a new walking stick.
quote: So, which one of you will be my new walking stick?

summary: Sigric gives Erewaker a sheet of his bark to plant with the sapling and conjures vines to cover her escape as he and Morecote face the giant.
quote: with the last of his might he calls a wall of vines between them.

summary: Kellan awakens on the third night and finds forget-me-nots blooming from his tongue.
quote: Forget-me-nots bloom from his tongue.

summary: Erewaker crosses into Shadowmoor alone with the sapling, mocked by the faeries, and reaches the clearing with dawnglove.
quote: Dawnglove ahead. Her journey nearly to its end.

summary: Erewaker performs the Rising ritual in the clearing while the faeries heckle her.
quote: Once she walks round the clearing. Twice.

summary: The ritual seems to fail, and the faeries urge Erewaker to cast aside her relic.
quote: Is cast aside your relic.

summary: Erewaker lays down her relic and the sapling takes its first breath.
quote: The sapling takes their first breath.

summary: The faeries attack the relic and sapling, and an explosion of magic covers the clearing in dawnglove.
quote: Dawnglove grows like moss to cover all that it might.

summary: Erewaker realizes the faeries herded the treefolk to this grove and dies as roots pierce her, her sap falling on the mound.
quote: but they'd been herded, like dogs, to this grove the whole while. To death.

summary: Forget-Me-Not announces the Deffroad Clique's work is done as she dies fulfilling her purpose.
quote: What a delight it has been to be the Deffroad Clique,

summary: Kellan coughs up a black flower while Amalia reads the dream journal, and later sees a woman's face in the mirror.
quote: A woman's face where his should be, surrounded by black flowers, eyes flashing and smiling.

summary: Cerys enters her late uncle Gethin's decayed house and finds the Reliquary of Twilight broken.
quote: The Reliquary of Twilight hadn't been used much in her uncle's final months

summary: Cerys finds an unsent letter and a parcel of balsam salve addressed to Rhain Breckon.
quote: The tag was addressed to a "Mr. Rhain Breckon."

summary: Cerys writes to Rhain to tell him of Gethin's death and sends the letter and parcel by enchanted paper wing toward the aurora.
quote: Not left, toward the city of Caer Flur, but right —toward the aurora.

summary: Rhain and Cerys trade rude letters, with Rhain calling Gethin a coward.
quote: Your uncle is a coward.

summary: Cerys softens, picks nightphlox for Rhain and sends him a salve recipe; Rhain thanks her.
quote: Vanity was in Rhain's nature; helping was in hers.

summary: Rhain tells Cerys he met Gethin the day the aurora shifted, when a boggart attacked him and Gethin rescued him.
quote: I would never have made it out if Gethin hadn't been there.

summary: Rhain, calcifying and hiding from the elves of Lys Alana, decides not to ask Cerys for dawnglove and instead asks to keep corresponding.
quote: Very soon, the mark would calcify his heart, and he would die.

summary: Cerys finds a hidden stem of dawnglove and an unsent letter that shows Gethin almost gave it to Rhain.
quote: This is what Rhain had asked Uncle Gethin for , she realized

summary: Cerys asks Rhain if he is dying and he answers that he is.
quote: Not an hour passed before a reply settled on the desk in front of her.

summary: Rhain writes his final letter confessing his feelings for Cerys and collapses.
quote: You, Cerys, are the very best part of my day.

summary: Cerys crosses the aurora and feeds Rhain dawnglove, reviving him.
quote: You fed me dawnglove. You crossed the aurora.

summary: Cerys's broken reliquary fails, and she turns on Rhain with cruel words as the Morningtide changes her.
quote: No wonder you were afraid of being cast out,

summary: Rhain carries the calcifying Cerys toward the border, but she turns to stone from the waist down as they enter the aurora.
quote: Cerys was stone from the waist down.

summary: Cerys tells Rhain his scars are beautiful, and Rhain, calcifying beside her, refuses to leave.
quote: For what it's worth, I think your scars are beautiful.

summary: Rhain and Cerys turn to stone in each other's arms in the eclipsed realm.
quote: as Rhain and Cerys turned to stone in each other's arms.

summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge after the downfall of Oona.
quote: They emerged after the downfall of Oona

summary: Maralen, originally an avatar of Oona, becomes steward of the plane from Glen Elendra.
quote: Originally an avatar of Oona, Maralen is now the steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu

summary: Maralen grants Rhys immortality on condition that he poison her if Oona's power corrupts her.
quote: she granted Rhys immortality on the condition that he must poison her should any hint arise that Oona's power is corrupting her.

summary: Oko, Oona's first avatar, rebels and leaves the plane after he sparked.
quote: Oko was quick to leave the plane after he sparked and has been causing turmoil across the Multiverse ever since.

summary: Brigid and Sygg are part of the group that brought down Oona; Brigid once sailed as a pirate under Sygg.
quote: A principled member of the group responsible for Oona's downfall

summary: Ashling departs the Blessed Nation at the start of the Pendulum Year to reconcile her two selves and discover the fourth path.
quote: At the beginning of the Pendulum Year, she departed the Blessed Nation

summary: A secret cutting of Colfenor's sapling is saved by Rhys and awakened by a special Rising as Ferrafor, the last yew treefolk.
quote: Awoken by a special version of the Rising, her first moments were of death and pain.

summary: The Mass of Mysteries is born when Oona is struck down.
quote: a curious new entity was born—the Mass of Mysteries.

summary: The Reaper loses much of its domain over the scarecrows as the aspects merge.
quote: But with the planar merging of aspects, it lost much of its domain and control over the scarecrows of Shadowmoor.

summary: Jilesa and Esmun go to interview the new instructor Professor Zarek for a puff piece in the Star.
quote: Reporter from the Strixhaven Star , here for the interview.

summary: In his office Jilesa casts a hidden interrogation spell on Zarek, who breaks it and instead offers her a secret project.
quote: Professor Zarek smoothed his hair with one hand, then snapped his fingers above his head.

summary: Zarek reveals he is searching for a Blood Age tome about the birth of the elder dragons and that Ravnica's leylines may be destabilized by him.
quote: I think the leylines of Ravnica may have been destabilized by … well, me.

summary: Jilesa suggests asking the Codex Vocifera, and the three go to find it.
quote: Don't just sit there, you two. We've got a codex to catch.

summary: They corner the Codex in the Void, which says the book's page is redacted and it cannot tell them its location.
quote: The page containing that information is redacted.

summary: Jilesa performs a lumimancy ritual with Esmun and Zarek's power to undo the redaction, and the Codex reveals the tome is in the Vaults of Turrau.
quote: The tome was taken from the Mystical Archive to the Vaults of Turrau

summary: Zarek learns the vault passcode and sets off alone, but Jilesa insists on joining and he relents.
quote: Your skills would be very useful. Are you sure you're up to the challenge?

summary: The three travel by transport spell to the mountains below Hookiver and find a clearing of skeletons before the vault doors.
quote: massive doors led into the sheer side of a cliff, covered in spiraling blue sigils

summary: Jilesa tries the maze and is ported back, and they deduce it drains and teleports intruders.
quote: One drains us, the other ports us out.

summary: Jilesa summons inklings to run the maze while Esmun maps their path, with Zarek lending power.
quote: The maze's energy-sapping eventually dispelled the inklings, until only one remained.

summary: Skeletons rise as they cross the maze; Esmun burns one away with a flash canvas and Zarek deals with the rest.
quote: the skeleton itself burned away, leaving nothing but ashes and a whiff of sulfur.

summary: Zarek speaks the passcode and the vault doors open.
quote: Slowly, silently, the doors cracked open just enough to allow them to slip inside.

summary: Jilesa's truth-spell leads them to the smoky-glass tome and Zarek takes it.
quote: He didn't hesitate to take the tome, opening it carefully.

summary: The stone constructs activate and demand the stolen item be returned.
quote: Return the stolen item or be destroyed.

summary: Zarek reveals he manipulated them, takes the book and teleports away, leaving the students to the constructs.
quote: Your combination of skill and spiteful ambition was invaluable, as I'd expected

summary: Jilesa realizes she was used and prepares to run with Esmun as the constructs close in.
quote: This had all been a plot to steal that book?

summary: Two demi-planes, Ezroi and Karudis, are theorized to have merged, knotting contrasting mana types into the five dichotomies.
quote: two demi-planes, Ezroi and Karudis, merged as a result of an unknown cosmic event.

summary: The Dawning Age ends as younger humanoid species rise and bring war.
quote: The Dawning Age ended when younger species of humanoid creatures rose to prominence and brought with them a time of war.

summary: The Blood Age ends when five elder dragons found Strixhaven University.
quote: It was only when five mighty elder dragons came together and founded Strixhaven University that the Blood Age finally came to an end

summary: Each Founder Dragon consolidates the study of two mana colors into a college, and mages become the most powerful force.
quote: Each dragon consolidated the study of its two mana colors into a magical college

summary: The Phyrexian Invasion damages Strixhaven and kills many faculty.
quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion, much of the university campus was damaged or destroyed, and a significant number of faculty lost their lives.

summary: Strixhaven welcomes its first off-plane students the year after the invasion.
quote: The inaugural class of off-plane students was welcomed at Strixhaven the year after the invasion

summary: Strixhaven establishes the Path Ward to oversee Omenpaths and vet visitors.
quote: the university has established the Path Ward, a committee to oversee the Omenpaths.

summary: Shadrix Silverquill founds the Forum of Amity to strengthen the peace formed at the end of the Blood Age.
quote: the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.

summary: Archaics become erratic and rampage across the plane, and Jadzi seeks the cause.
quote: Currently, many of the normally gentle archaics have become erratic and incensed.

summary: Abigale opens the friends' shared scribing-board correspondence from the Forum of Amity.
quote: They're coming through to you in my very own handwriting.

summary: Sanar writes a twenty-six page letter about Spectacle Summit; Tam asks everyone to keep letters to a page or two.
quote: Can we please keep letters to a page or two?

summary: Kirol reports that the Fields of Strife are haunted by warriors re-enacting wars and that students must carry a mundane memento.
quote: The place is haunted by all kinds of old warriors who are stuck re-enacting old wars

summary: Kirol uses a war cry to dissolve a restless spirit that attacked while he carried a caryatid to Camp Herrian.
quote: I guess it was pretty good—they dissolved back into the currents.

summary: Lluwen writes about feeling isolated among Arcavian elves and plans to join the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.
quote: There's a Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave in the works right now.

summary: Abigale recalls Professor Fel's poisonous-flora class, which made her drop it.
quote: I dropped out of the class that day.

summary: Tam recounts meeting Fel at night and decides he is worth working with; she offers to accompany Lluwen.
quote: Lluwen, if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

summary: Lluwen describes his admission interview with Fel, who stamps his form anyway.
quote: But he stamped my form anyway.

summary: Ajani becomes Kirol's advisor for the Pranticle Peak expedition.
quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!

summary: Ajani tells Kirol that trauma awakens a planeswalker's spark and that he lost his brother Jazal.
quote: I lost my brother, Jazal.

summary: Lluwen and Tam arrive at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greet the students.
quote: Oracle Jadzi was the one who greeted all of us when we arrived at Jawdocks Landing.

summary: Tam and Lluwen talk for hours with Jadzi until Fel scolds them for wasting the oracle's time.
quote: We spent a few hours talking, just the three of us

summary: Lluwen discovers a society of lumarets with a map in Toadstool Copse.
quote: The creature had friends.

summary: Fel dismisses Lluwen's discovery of the lumarets as not worth studying and threatens community service.
quote: They aren't in any of the records because they aren't worth studying,

summary: Tam consoles Lluwen and tells him of a frightening encounter with the same spirit, who threw a spear at her group.
quote: He hurled a spectral spear at me.

summary: Ajani slashes the spear and destroys the spirit with his axe, then tells his charge to be more careful.
quote: He slashed the spear in two, and in the same motion brought the flat of his axe down on the spirit's head.

summary: Fel quizzes his students on what they hear; Lluwen, stung by yesterday's rebuke, wants to give a right answer.
quote: I want to give the right answer

summary: Ivarin taunts Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan, and Lluwen retaliates by slashing his chest with a knife.
quote: He dragged the knife across Ivarin's chest.

summary: Fel pins Lluwen's coat to a tree with a thorn and orders him to control himself or find another home.
quote: You will learn to control yourself, or you will learn to find another home,

summary: Lluwen realizes the titan's bones are hollow and falls through into the dark.
quote: Lluwen fell into the dark.

summary: Lluwen wakes in the titan's hollow to find six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic and chanting.
quote: six enormous figures, each with too many limbs undulating in time, sat gathered around a thick snarl of magic—archaics.

summary: The archaics notice Lluwen sketching and stop, and he flees up a vine while their chant grows louder.
quote: Lluwen didn't need to be told twice.

summary: Fel hauls Lluwen out and asks if he has anything to impress him; Lluwen is too afraid to tell him what he saw.
quote: I hope you have something to impress me.

summary: Tam tells Lluwen that archaics were once oracles and suggests speaking with Jadzi.
quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

summary: Lluwen overhears Fel and Jadzi argue over Fel's scheme involving students and an oath he swore.
quote: No, I swore an oath of devotion, Jadzi.

summary: Jadzi tells Fel that Professor Vess is missing and that another incident after Kasmina's could cause a stir.
quote: No one knows where she is,

summary: Lluwen decides not to tell Fel about the archaics and returns to his room.
quote: No. He couldn't tell Fel.

summary: Lluwen admits to Tam that he did not tell Jadzi about the archaics; Tam hugs him.
quote: You aren't a coward.

summary: The ground shakes and a massive creature wreathed in star arches looms over the camp, and Tam freezes.
quote: A massive figure blocked the gold of the moon.

summary: The giant creature stands and walks away, leaving the camp in chaos.
quote: it walked away.

summary: Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.
quote: His eyes burning, Fel asked the two of them if they had seen Oracle Jadzi.

summary: Kirol sees the Code Oona message and sets out to help, but runs into Ajani.
quote: When the five of them had come up with the phrase

summary: Kirol tells Ajani an archaic carried Jadzi away and Fel is acting strangely; Ajani offers a compromise.
quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

summary: Kirol requisitions a horse and leaves before Ajani returns.
quote: From atop a requisitioned horse, Kirol grinned back at the camp.

summary: Kirol, Abigale and Sanar reunite at the chaotic Titan's Grave dig site to search for Lluwen.
quote: Abigale couldn't hear what was going on around her, but she had a pretty good feeling that Kirol was right about that.

summary: Ajani catches Kirol and joins the group to help find their friends.
quote: You might have been clever enough to sneak away, but I was clever enough to know how to find you.

summary: Dina tries to calm the students at the camp as Sanar spots a green smoke signal from Lluwen.
quote: That's Lluwen's signal! It must be!

summary: Masked figures ambush the group with a wave of concussive magic as they follow the smoke.
quote: It was the last thing he managed to say before the whole group got hit with a wave of concussive magic.

summary: Ajani wakes bound and finds Chandra Nalaar surrounded by cloaked, mask-wearing figures.
quote: Chandra Nalaar stood surrounded on all sides by cloaked figures in masks

summary: Chandra says she must make sure Ajani has not been compromised, and Lluwen reveals the masked figures are Oriq.
quote: They're the Oriq.

summary: Chandra explains that the Shattered refused to attack the school and shattered their masks, and she took them under her wing.
quote: None of the people here attacked the school, Ajani. They all refused.

summary: Chandra tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.
quote: Jace is alive,

summary: Ajani insists Jace is dead and unmade, upsetting Chandra.
quote: He didn't just die; his essence was unmade .

summary: Chandra says Jace is manipulating archaics as the giant archaic appears overhead.
quote: Manipulating archaics!

summary: Ajani tackles Chandra as she prepares to blast the archaic, and Lluwen spots Jadzi in its palm.
quote: Ajani bowled her over and took them both to the ground.

summary: Chandra orders the Shattered to keep Ajani's students busy; walls of fire rise and Ajani breaks his bonds.
quote: The Shattered blazed into action.

summary: Ajani and Chandra fight, and he pins her in a hold to stop her attacking.
quote: He slipped one arm under her chin and the other hand behind her head.

summary: Chandra hurls her gathered fire over their heads and burns the giant archaic, which screams in pain.
quote: And before he could stop her, Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

summary: The wounded archaic looks down at Ajani and Chandra and tears the ground asunder.
quote: Then it brought its hand down and tore the ground asunder.

summary: Tam wakes beneath the earth after the archaic's attack; Kirol is hurling boughs off trapped students and Sanar and Abigale are helping.
quote: That bulky frame hurling boughs off the trapped students could only be Kirol.

summary: Lluwen tells Tam they are in Titan's Grave, deeper than any records go.
quote: "In Titan's Grave. Deeper than we have any records of going, if we can trust the Shattered."

summary: Tam asks Suki to join the group, and the Shattered come over to share what they know.
quote: "Come join us," said Tam.

summary: Abigale reports at least two dozen ways out of the chamber.
quote: But there are at least two dozen ways out of here, maybe more.

summary: Lluwen volunteers to scout a path out, and Suki insists he take someone with him; Kirol claims the job.
quote: "It's best if you have someone with you.

summary: Lluwen is moved that Kirol would talk to their family for him; Kirol is stung when Lluwen changes the subject.
quote: "Well, yeah. But I would for you."

summary: Lluwen finds the lumarets and believes they will lead the way out.
quote: "I think I found our way out of here."

summary: Back at camp Tam frets over being left behind while Sanar and Suki build a metronome clock.
quote: Sanar and Suki were working on a metronome-based clock.

summary: Fetching water, Tam sees a man in white in the reflection until Lluwen's shout breaks the moment.
quote: It was a man in white.

summary: Lluwen leads the group through the tunnels behind the lumarets, growing proud.
quote: The young elf strode proud down the twisting, impossible hallways.

summary: A strange feeling of dread spreads through the group and tempers flare; Lluwen snaps at Tam and Kirol.
quote: "You're the one who brought up the tension.

summary: The lumarets flee and the tunnel begins to shake as a daemogoth reveals itself.
quote: "I thought I'd have longer for you to ripen."

summary: The tunnel turns against the students and roots seize Lluwen, threatening to drag him into the earth while his friends pull him back.
quote: Vines wrapped around Lluwen's ankles and threatened to pull him into the earth.

summary: Kirol promises not to leave Lluwen behind.
quote: "I'm not going to leave you behind, Lulu!"

summary: Professor Fel arrives, and the daemogoth greets him by name and asks about a deal.
quote: "Dellian. Have you returned to make that deal with me?"

summary: Fel's magic floods the pit with flowers and fungi that grow through the daemogoth and burst its skull, killing it.
quote: The daemogoth screamed in the moment before glorious life sprang from its head, bursting its skull.

summary: Lluwen asks Fel whether he made a deal with the daemogoth, and Fel dismisses it.
quote: "With that provincial bogeyman? Ridiculous. It has nothing to offer me."

summary: Fel says he has been trying to find a way to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, from Jadzi.
quote: You wanted to try and find some way to go back and save the woman you loved."

summary: Fel says the last he saw of the huge archaic it was carrying Jadzi nearby, and leads the group toward the exit.
quote: The last we saw of that huge archaic, it was carrying Jadzi not far from here.

summary: Lluwen tells Fel he saw archaics gathered around a snarl, and Fel says there are no snarls in Titan's Grave and asks to be taken there.
quote: "There are no snarls in Titan's Grave. There never have been,"

summary: Elsewhere in the tunnels, Chandra and Ajani argue; she tells Ajani she believes Jace plans to use the huge archaic.
quote: "I think it's the archaic. The big one."

summary: Chandra asks Ajani to help her find and kill the huge archaic before Jace can use it, and he agrees to support her.
quote: "I'll support you, Chandra.

summary: Chandra and Ajani walk silently through the tunnels below Titan's Grave.
quote: Two Planeswalkers trudged through the tunnels below Titan's Grave. Neither of them said a word.

summary: Chandra stumbles in a vision and Ajani catches her by the cloak, then pulls back his hand mid-pat.
quote: Ajani caught her by the hood of her cloak.

summary: Ajani wonders whether Chandra's visions might be Ashiok's work and descends behind her.
quote: It could be Ashiok planting these images in her head.

summary: They hear the archaic wail and Jadzi's voice from ahead.
quote: They heard the archaic before they saw it.

summary: They find Jadzi healing the wounded archaic in the titan's skull, opposite a snarl-like swirl of energy.
quote: Jadzi kneeled in its palm, still, working a complex healing spell across its flesh.

summary: Chandra holds back from striking the wounded archaic.
quote: It would be so easy. So why did she hesitate?

summary: Jadzi, already aware of them, calls out the girl sneaking up on them.
quote: There's a girl who thinks she can sneak up on us,

summary: Jadzi explains that archaics are oracles flung back in time after death, and that this archaic is the last.
quote: Archaics are oracles, like I am.

summary: Jadzi warns that something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself.
quote: "Something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself."

summary: Chandra insists the culprit is Jace.
quote: "It's Jace! I'm telling you, it's Jace."

summary: Jadzi explains the archaics flicker in and out of existence as Arcavios's future is meddled with.
quote: They've been flickering in and out of existence.

summary: Jadzi urges Chandra not to kill the archaic, saying that would treat the symptom and not the disease.
quote: Snuffing out an archaic is treating the symptom, not the disease.

summary: Chandra says Jace is no longer her friend and Ajani argues they cannot turn their backs on him; she rebukes him.
quote: I get to decide who my friends are, Ajani,

summary: The archaic wails and a wave of wrongness hits all three, giving Ajani glimpses of another life before it passes.
quote: The dizziness lingered.

summary: Jadzi says the swirl is some kind of nexus at the core of the problem.
quote: this is at the core of it."

summary: A tendril of the nexus touches Ajani's wrist and for a blink he feels his brother beside him.
quote: A tendril of it wrapped around his wrist, and for the space of a blink he felt his brother standing next to him.

summary: Ajani asks Chandra to work together, and she agrees while privately knowing it is a lie.
quote: It hurt so bad to lie to him.

summary: The three of them breathe in time and work to untangle the nexus's threads; Chandra collapses in pain.
quote: A howl left her as her knees threatened to give out from under her.

summary: Chandra decides to use their distraction to attack the archaic and pools fire into her right hand.
quote: Chandra pooled it all into her right hand.

summary: Ajani strikes Chandra's forearm with the flat of his axe, sending her fireball wide.
quote: he brought the flat of his axe down on her forearm with crushing certainty.

summary: Chandra declares she will go through Ajani if she must, and Ajani plants himself between her and the archaic, and they begin to fight.
quote: "I will stand here as long as I am able. Fire can only burn my flesh."

summary: Ajani bats away a fireball with his axe as he and Chandra fight in the chamber.
quote: A fireball soared at him.

summary: Ajani catches Chandra's fist and hurls her into a bone wall, then finds he is proud when she stands up.
quote: he hurled her across the chamber.

summary: Tam leads the group's friends into the caverns, and Sanar smells burning.
quote: "Does anyone else smell burning?"

summary: Suki calls out that her teacher is in trouble and runs ahead, with Tam following.
quote: "Shatter Prime's in trouble."

summary: Chandra, dizzy, hurls a fireball at Ajani, who tanks another jet meant for the archaic.
quote: he was just in time to tank another jet of fire meant for the archaic.

summary: Ajani's axe bites Chandra's shoulder and she cauterizes the wound.
quote: Metal bit into her shoulder.

summary: Chandra drives a lance of fire into Ajani's thigh, and he tells her to stop hurting her friend.
quote: She drove a lance of fire into the leonin's thigh.

summary: The students feel reality tremble as they run toward the fight.
quote: Reality was a rippling tapestry being torn apart and rewoven right before their eyes.

summary: Ajani repeatedly throws Chandra away, and each time she gets back up.
quote: But every time he rebuffed her efforts, she got back up.

summary: Chandra heats Ajani's axe until he drops it, and pins him to the ground, ready to punch.
quote: The axe clattered to the ground between them.

summary: Ajani covers Chandra's hand and says they have been through enough; Chandra gives up and the battle is won.
quote: And he knew that—for whatever it was worth—the battle was won.

summary: The group is thrown through shifting environments as reality ripples around the archaic.
quote: Kirol spit up sea water.

summary: The students arrive to find Chandra and Ajani injured and leaning on one another.
quote: Next to her—with her arm slung across his shoulders like a wounded soldier—was Ajani Goldmane.

summary: A reality-wave freezes Chandra and Ajani mid-stride, and amber from the archaic's spell encases Fel.
quote: to thicken into amber around him, enveloping the professor before he could react.

summary: Jadzi tells the students to get to safety while she calms the archaic.
quote: I need to calm the archaic!"

summary: Tam pushes Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.
quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.

summary: Tam tells her friends that she was made to do this and that they made her happy, then steps into the pit.
quote: "I was made to do this."

summary: The nexus snaps shut after Tam jumps in, leaving the friends shocked.
quote: Lluwen stared at the not-snarl as it snapped shut.

summary: Reality destabilizes and the air starts to fail; Suki is brought low.
quote: Reality wasn't stable around this panicking god-like being.

summary: Lluwen spots Jadzi's incomplete chain spell on the archaic and urges everyone to finish it.
quote: "Everyone! We have to finish the spell!"

summary: Lluwen's plea reaches Kirol, who throws Fel aside and rallies everyone to follow Lluwen.
quote: "All right!" they said. "Let's go! Everybody follow Lluwen!"

summary: Lluwen speaks to the archaic, and the lumarets mirror his movements, lending power to the spell.
quote: They were mirroring him.

summary: Gold light of unity encases the archaic and settles reality; Chandra and Ajani move again.
quote: They were encasing it.

summary: Fel, freed from the amber, credits Lluwen for soothing the archaic.
quote: young Lluwen has found a way to soothe it."

summary: In a place that is not quite Strixhaven, Tam stands over the sleeping Jadzi and is comforted by a man in white, who promises she will meet others like her.
quote: "You've found the others?" she asked him.

summary: A building collapses on Eula's cleanup crew and she shields them with a dome of misty light.
quote: Eula Blue, unwilling cleanup worker and self-trained shield mage, throws her hands over her head, a dome of pale, misty light forming around them

summary: The foreman asks Eula whether she has thought about his offer of a Riveteer apprenticeship; she stalls, saying she is discussing it with her parents.
quote: "Blue," says the foreman brusquely. "You think about my offer?"

summary: Eula takes the shift-change whistle as her chance to run from the foreman.
quote: The whistle blows, signaling shift change.

summary: Eula reflects that the Riveteer apprenticeship could secure her family but cost her own future.
quote: And all she has to give up is her own future.

summary: Eula's father hands her a letter that has arrived for her, opened, by omenpath courier.
quote: "Eula," says her father, lowering the letter. "This came for you."

summary: Eula learns the letter is an invitation to Strixhaven on Arcavios with tuition and supplies covered and an omenpath ticket.
quote: "A place called Strixhaven, on a plane called Arcavios. They teach wizards there."

summary: Eula's father questions whether she still wants to be a Broker and she lies that she does.
quote: "Yes, sir," she lies.

summary: Eula's father tells her to go to Strixhaven, learn everything and bring it back to New Capenna and to the Family.
quote: You'll learn everything they have to teach you, and everything they don't intend to teach you

summary: Eula's mother tells her she leaves tomorrow and they begin to pack.
quote: "You leave tomorrow," her mother says

summary: At sunrise, Rootha, shaken by a night terror, sees Dean Nassari on the ridge and tries to flee.
quote: Dean Nassari stands precariously on a slender jut of rock.

summary: Rootha slips from the ridge as the edge gives way, and a thread of magic yanks her to safety.
quote: A single thread of magic loops around my wrists and yanks me up.

summary: Rootha meets Glass, who saved her, as he channels magic into a whale for his capstone project.
quote: "Glassyk. Call me Glass."

summary: Rootha returns to camp and tells Kahri about her fall; Kahri says everyone knows Glass is a savant.
quote: "Everyone knows him! He's a savant!

summary: Rootha reveals the Living Flame, which she has finished and shown to no one, and is pulled into a memory of the Biblioplex.
quote: I call it the Living Flame, and it's the greatest thing I've ever made.

summary: At the gallery, Rootha meets Lux and Justice, who learn she is a Champion who helped drive off the Phyrexians; she flees.
quote: She was one of the five students who performed the invocation to drive the Phyrexians from campus.

summary: Rootha bumps into Kahri and Dean Nassari appears, but does not look at Rootha.
quote: Nassari stands right there and doesn't look at me once.

summary: The rogue elemental whale appears and floods the gallery with water.
quote: An enormous cerulean whale, turned black in the dying evening light, swollen with magic and careening out of control across the summit.

summary: Rootha recognizes Glass inside the whale; Nassari concludes he has lost control.
quote: "He's lost control of it."

summary: Nassari's flames cut off the whale's limbs, but they grow back, and the boiling water endangers the crowd.
quote: a jet of flame escapes Nassari's palm

summary: Flashback to the Biblioplex invocation, where the Phyrexian Nassari taunts Rootha and she loses concentration.
quote: "You're a burden. You cling.

summary: Flashback: Quint shores up the casting, saving the others, and later becomes a planeswalker.
quote: The only reason any of us survive is because of Quint, a quiet boy from Lorehold.

summary: Rootha summons the Living Flame to lend Nassari more force, and takes Nassari's offered hand.
quote: I take Dean Nassari's hand, and the world around us turns to fire.

summary: Their combined flames destroy the elemental whale in the Night of Flame, and nobody is seriously hurt.
quote: Shockingly, beyond a few burns and scrapes, no one was hurt that night.

summary: Nassari apologizes for neglecting Rootha and what they said in the Biblioplex, and offers to be her advisor.
quote: You aren't looking for an advisor still, are you?

summary: Rootha helps Nassari to their feet, accepting the reconciliation.
quote: This time, I reach out a hand and pull them to theirs.

summary: Quint returns to Arcavios by planeswalking onto the Strixhaven quad and heads for the Lorehold campus.
quote: In a flash of warm, radiant light and the sound of rustling paper, a loxodon appeared.

summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus's secretary that reports of his death were exaggerated and asks to see the dean.
quote: "Reports of my death or vaporization have been highly exaggerated

summary: Quint explains his search for a coin motif spanning planes, and Dean Tullus listens.
quote: the strange coin motif he had encountered there

summary: Quint reveals the Coin Empire vanished overnight and may have left something behind on Arcavios.
quote: Functionally overnight, they were gone.

summary: Quint persuades Dean Tullus to hire him as a temporary teaching assistant so he can join the Fields of Strife excursion.
quote: "No. I'm suggesting you hire me as a temporary teaching assistant.

summary: At the Fields of Strife base camp, Quint decides to commune with the dead of the Blood Age and steps through the protective wards.
quote: then turned and stepped intentionally through the protection wards.

summary: Quint relives a dead general's last memories and is warned by Tullus about losing himself in the fields.
quote: "If you're not careful, we can lose you to the fields,"

summary: Quint steps over the forbidden boundary line into the territory of the deep shades.
quote: Deliberately, not looking back, Quint stepped over the line.

summary: A warlord's memory overwhelms Quint; he grasps the Blind Eternities to pull free of the ghost.
quote: Firmly grasping the Blind Eternities, he pulled himself forward, through the ghost and into the open space beyond.

summary: Quint falls through a crust of stone into a sinkhole.
quote: sending him toppling down into the dark.

summary: Quint discovers a cache of Blood Age artifacts in the hidden chamber and takes a ceramic knife as proof.
quote: And he'd simply … fallen into a major historical find. Again.

summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus of the discovery, and she assigns the geomancer Mica to go with him.
quote: Take Mica with you.

summary: Quint and Mica return to the cache and find objects moved and some missing.
quote: Someone had been here.

summary: Quint discovers Stella Lee packing the artifacts to take through an Omenpath for sale on New Capenna.
quote: I've got a buyer for old Arcavios artifacts over on New Capenna

summary: Quint summons ghostly echoes against Stella, who fights them off with a whip and escapes through the Omenpath.
quote: Stella Lee, moving fast now, leapt into the Omenpath and was gone

summary: Mica uncovers fossil footprints matching the creature from Colony's End and a mosaic of a tentacled horror, showing the Coin Empire reached Arcavios.
quote: The Coin Empire had definitely reached Arcavios.

summary: Zimone, struggling after graduation, sits in her bedroom with letters piled by her bed, including one from Tyvar inviting her on an adventure.
quote: Zimone stares at them, counting four letters in the stack.

summary: Zimone lifts the glamour on her bedroom to reveal her illusory map of the Multiverse and refuses to leave the house.
quote: An immense illusory map overtakes the entirety of the tiny space.

summary: Zimone notices a shadow above Arcavios in her model that does not look like Duskmourn's spread.
quote: A shadow.

summary: A letter arrives from Niv-Mizzet's office offering Zimone an apprenticeship and demanding a reply within twenty-four hours.
quote: The Omenpath Project awaits your response to the offer of apprenticeship.

summary: Zimone decides to split herself so she can do both the apprenticeship and her research.
quote: But what if … what if she could do both?

summary: After hours of failing at a duplication spell, Zimone accidentally divides herself and creates the Apprentice.
quote: Her double, dressed in white, wisps of blue magic still encircling her like morning fog, blinks back in surprise.

summary: Flashback: after Duskmourn Zimone returns to Strixhaven with Niko and Tyvar to report to Dean Nev.
quote: After Duskmourn, Zimone returned to Strixhaven.

summary: Flashback: Dean Nev says the Firemind does not recommend further study of Duskmourn's spread, and Zimone panics.
quote: the Firemind does not recommend pursuing study at the moment.

summary: The Apprentice returns from her first weeks of work, and with rent short, Zimone creates a second double, the Overachiever.
quote: Zimone seizes the feeling and pulls with her magic

summary: Zimone's two doubles irritate her, and she tracks the shadow, learning it is a solid thing mirrored above Arcavios that is not a second Duskmourn.
quote: Because the shadow in her model isn't a shadow.

summary: Zimone makes a third double, Friend Zimone, for company, who proves insufferable but proposes duplicating the model.
quote: Zimone emerges with bags under her eyes and a duplicate in a red sweater behind her.

summary: Zimone, with Friend Zimone's help, realizes someone is duplicating the Multiverse.
quote: "Someone is duplicating the Multiverse."

summary: Zimone panics when her flat grows warm and the window is found closed, then Dina knocks on the door.
quote: She half-gasps, half-sobs, and bruises her knuckles diving over the bed to open it again.

summary: Zimone rants about Friend Zimone to Dina, who gently points out that the double is Zimone herself.
quote: "Hey. That's you."

summary: Zimone realizes she cannot be everything, and decides to just be herself for a while.
quote: "I can't be everything. I think I need to just be me for a while."

summary: Zimone reintegrates her doubles and resigns from the extra jobs.
quote: Their forms turn to vapor, the vapor disappears

summary: Zimone shows Dina her model, and they trace the duplicate's caster by spell, which points to Chandra Nalaar.
quote: "Oh, damn, she's famous," she says, pointing at the image. "Chandra Nalaar.

summary: Zimone closes her window and agrees to take Dina's offer of a place to stay.
quote: She walks to the window and closes it.

summary: After a tea ceremony ends on a bitter note, Killian steps up as a second for a ritual duel at the Forum.
quote: the ceremony ended on a bitter note, and at the Forum of Amity, there was but one recourse for bitterness.

summary: Killian faces a young leonin opponent and sees his desperate amber stare.
quote: His amber eyes tracked Killian with an intensity that gave Killian pause

summary: Killian counters the leonin's strikes, then deliberately drops his guard and takes a blow to the chest.
quote: Killian shut his mouth and braced for impact.

summary: Killian wakes with a concussion and meets Crown, and the healer Verdis, who teases Crown.
quote: "Crown," the leonin said gruffly.

summary: Killian explains that the duels vent feeling, but no one leaves satisfied and no one can let things go anymore.
quote: Like no one knows how to let things go anymore."

summary: Commotion in the Presiding Chamber draws Killian, reminding him of his father fleeing the invasion.
quote: the last glimpse of his father's back before—

summary: The mediator Embrose Lu arrives amid the feuding Silkmeadow and Kathorr delegations.
quote: Here stood Silverquill's own shadow dean, Embrose Lu.

summary: Killian learns Crown and Verdis were tutored together, and Verdis fostered with Crown's kin.
quote: "We were tutored together, when we were kids."

summary: Over dinner, Embrose says he heard Killian lost a duel; Killian does not tell him he did it on purpose and instead mentions his father's new publication.
quote: "I picked up your new publication."

summary: At the Naming Tithe, Crown and Verdis name themselves and each other, but the conciliators' words turn jagged and Embrose plunges the hall into darkness.
quote: Their words never met the water.

summary: Embrose scolds the conciliators as infants and bullies and tells them they must live beside each other.
quote: You must live in this scarred world, as we all must, and you must live beside each other."

summary: After the ritual, Embrose tells Killian the conciliators must now prove themselves and he will trouble himself no longer.
quote: It's time for the conciliators to prove themselves worthy of their peoples' trust."

summary: Killian follows Crown and Verdis and overhears them planning a binding duel.
quote: "It needs to be binding."

summary: Crown and Verdis draw sigils for a duel on the terms of rights, water and all, which Killian realizes is forbidden.
quote: Instead, Doco read the emblems for "rights" and "water" and "all."

summary: Killian offers to bear witness, and weaves a sigil of togetherness, shared and communion between theirs, turning the duel into a ritual of communion.
quote: The emblems he layered onto his sigil were not negations, nor modifiers, but expansions

summary: The next morning Crown and Verdis duel in a celebration, Crown witnessing.
quote: that they had agreed to meet on terms forged in the name of resolution.

summary: Killian shows Embrose his draft of an addendum to the Naming Tithe, and Embrose is moved to try to express his appreciation.
quote: "What I don't know," said Embrose, "is if I've ever properly expressed what I appreciate about you."

summary: Killian offers his father a hand, and Embrose takes it to join in the ritual.
quote: "Yes," he said. "I think I'd like to see myself."

summary: Dina's Witherbloom students examine a dead giant bird on the path while Basil does not want to watch.
quote: "Sampling the blood now," said Morphia

summary: Dina tells her students Mertyn's revenant will appear that night and not to go with him to the lake alone.
quote: "Don't go with him to the lake, alone."

summary: Mertyn's revenant knocks and Lorenin answers; Mertyn invites him to the lake, and Lorenin refuses and closes the door.
quote: "Good night," said Lorenin, and closed the door.

summary: The next night Mertyn visits Morphia, embraces her and whispers an invitation, and she throws him off.
quote: They held each other tightly, then Mertyn whispered something into her ear

summary: By the lake the next morning, Dina tells Basil that grief eats you up no matter what and does not end, it only declines.
quote: Grief eats you up no matter what."

summary: Basil takes the Devotion's skull to the lake, gently places it back in the water, and says he no longer wants to be a mage before walking away alone.

quote: Rootha has delayed her graduation, unable to finish the thesis she has lingered on for years.

summary: Kirol decides exploring and preserving history is more important after the invasion's losses.
quote: after the losses of the Phyrexian Invasion, they felt that exploring and preserving history was more important than ever

summary: Lluwen betrays his superiors in Lorwyn to help Strixhaven students and then joins them as a student.

quote: He's been investigating the remnants of the Fomori, mysterious multiversal colonizers lost to time.

summary: Augusta prepares a ritual so she can be summoned after her death and returns as a spirit after dying in the invasion.
quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

summary: Zimone graduates from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.
quote: graduated from Quandrix and has begun a new fellowship on Ravnica

summary: Zimone summons Primo, then refuses to unsummon him after returning from Duskmourn.
quote: she found herself unwilling to unsummon him

summary: Moseo is nearly compleated, excises the Phyrexian influence and is left as a skeleton.
quote: was nearly compleated during the Phyrexian Invasion

summary: Moseo replaces the deceased Valentin as dean of the vein.
quote: Moseo willingly stepped up to replace the deceased Valentin as the new dean of the vein.

summary: Blex is killed in the invasion and, soon after, a lookalike, Blech, appears.
quote: Finally, Blex was retrieved in the most tragic way possible: as a victim of the Phyrexian Invasion.

summary: Dellian Fel is found dead in his lab and rises from the grave thirteen months later with a planeswalker's spark.
quote: he rose from the grave

summary: Dina survives the Brittleblight alone, and later fails to restore her glade.
quote: She was the sole survivor of a dryad glade hit by the Brittleblight

summary: A student frees Gorma into Titan's Grave instead of consuming her, and she develops a huge appetite.
quote: the student couldn't do it, instead setting her free into the wilds of Titan's Grave

summary: The rebels attack the mobile garrison at dusk, with Felothar leading the charge.
quote: The rebels fall upon the mobile garrison at dusk, sweeping in from the desert with the sun at their backs.

summary: Felothar defeats and spares an unarmed young man who yields.
quote: Terror in his eyes, the boy does so. She leaves him be.

summary: Felothar kills two honor guards outside a tent, after they call her a traitor.
quote: He's talented, well-trained, but injured and now alone. Felothar makes short work of him.

quote: "Fair enough," the girl pants. "My name is Vasi."

quote: "Instead, I'll make you an offer. I'll train you."

quote: I swear by Dromoka's love that I will not attempt to escape until we've dueled.

quote: She pivots and knocks the blade from Vasi's hand, then puts the flat of her blade to the girl's neck.

summary: Vasi mentions her ward-sister, then angrily changes the subject.
quote: "My ward-sister always said the terrain makes the battle."

quote: Anafenza proved that to be a lie when she discovered and bonded with one.

summary: Felothar reveals her chosen family and how the ancestors shaped her, and Vasi tells of her ward-sister Bara.
quote: But one, Bara, we were … like sisters.

summary: Vasi asks whether the rebels can truly stand against Dromoka, and Felothar admits she has doubts but will walk her path.
quote: "My path is set," Felothar says at last, "and I will walk it.

summary: Vasi confronts Felothar after learning she plans to lead an attack and refuses to tell her.
quote: "You swore to me!" Vasi's words echo through the cavern.

summary: Vasi leaves the camp while Felothar attends the war council.
quote: Only later does she realize what her apprentice was truly asking for, and by that time, Vasi is already gone.

summary: Felothar finds Vasi on a mountain path and they fight in the dark.
quote: "So did you," she says and lunges forward.

summary: Vasi summons two ancestor spirits from the sand and defeats Felothar, but spares her.
quote: the sand beside her shifts, coalescing into two figures clad in ancient Abzan armor, semi-transparent in the starlight.

summary: Vasi explains that she offered her blood to the Kin-Tree and was told where to find her ward-sister Bara.
quote: "Looking for Bara, my ward-sister," Vasi says.

summary: Felothar gives Vasi Heartsblood and Vasi goes with her spirit escort to find Bara.

summary: Felothar heads back to the rebel encampment as the camp prepares to depart for battle against Dromoka's forces.
quote: she does know that her family is stronger than Dromoka imagines.

quote: Jace Beleren, Planeswalker and mind-mage, is attempting to rewrite reality with his own vision for existence.

summary: Honest Jace, in a memory-prison, recounts the experiment born from trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion to build a Multiverse without monsters.
quote: An experiment ignited by our trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion of the entire Multiverse

summary: The original plan fails and Jace is unmade in the Meditation Realm, but pieces linger and rebuild him with the need to build a better Multiverse.
quote: When our original plan failed, Jace was unmade in the Meditation Realm.

summary: Jace's most stubborn self carves away the parts of himself that disagree, starting with the honest piece.
quote: He's even gone so far as to carve out the parts of himself that disagree with what he's done.

summary: Only the Theorist remains, erasing memories and puppeteering enemies without regard for free will.
quote: Now, the Theorist is all that remains

summary: The Theorist calculates probabilities and excises persons or events from planes' histories to build the Echoverse.
quote: the Theorist calculates probabilities and works to excise elements (a person, an event) from a plane's history.

summary: The Theorist plans to lay the Echoverse over the existing Multiverse by studying the creation of Arcavios.
quote: The only way to give it stability is to lay its skin atop the bones of the existing Multiverse.

summary: Harmonious mana on the Theorist's Arcavios creates five elder sphinxes and unified schools.
quote: harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes and inspiring schools that held unified perspectives.

summary: The Theorist takes up residence in Hexhaven's bell tower, warping the campus into the tower.
quote: He took up residence in the central bell tower

summary: His magic leaves a wasteland, the Eradia, around the tower.
quote: the Theorist's reality-bending magic left a wasteland surrounding it for nearly a hundred miles

summary: The sphinxes found Hexhaven Academy atop the leyline confluence to teach and protect the people of Arcavios.
quote: Hexhaven Academy was built on top of the large leyline confluence from which the sphinxes had emerged.

summary: Uldaros Theorix builds Hexhaven's original fortress to keep the campus from mage hunters.
quote: The elder sphinx Uldaros Theorix used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven

summary: Champions of different schools fail the accension trial in memorable ways.
quote: Every school has a story of a promising cadet who failed their accension trial.

summary: The Theorist interrupts the guide, silencing the narrator and ordering the reader to forget.
quote: You will forget what you have heard.

summary: Tam is made and wakes to find an exhausted man who tells her that her name is Tamira but who she is is up to her.
quote: "Your name is Tamira, but who you are is up to you."

summary: He tells her she is a person in progress.
quote: "In progress. Yeah. You're a person in progress."

summary: Tam returns to Hexhaven after kidnapping Jadzi from Strixhaven, feeling empty rather than victorious.
quote: On paper, she returned from Strixhaven victorious, her mission complete, her captured oracle in hand.

summary: Tam sees a vision of Abigale accusing her of lying and leaving.
quote: You left , signs Abigale. You lied, and you left.

summary: Tam sees a vision of Lluwen telling her she is just parts.
quote: "You're just parts ."

summary: Tam asks Professor Opal about friendship, and Opal tells her not to feel guilty for acts of service to her maker.
quote: Do not feel guilty for acts of service.

summary: Tam bursts into the sanctum to find the Theorist fighting a masked boy, who wounds him; the Theorist hurls the boy through a portal.
quote: the Theorist summons a portal—a great round one, rimmed with metal—and hurls the boy into it.

summary: The Theorist explains that excising aberrations stabilizes the Multiverse spell, and that now he is wholly one thing.
quote: "Yes. Now that I am wholly one thing, I know exactly who I am."

summary: The Theorist reveals he plans to overwrite the existing Multiverse by laying the Echoverse over it.
quote: "Correct. We need to overwrite the existing Multiverse to make this one stable."

summary: He reveals that Jadzi must die so he can follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse.
quote: "Oh, yes. It's the only way for the phenomenon to be observed.

summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind and reassures her, and she finds a textbook with Jace Beleren's name in it.
quote: JACE BELEREN is scrawled in a child's hand in the upper-left corner.

summary: Tam visits Jadzi's cell and apologizes, and Jadzi tells her she will find what she is looking for.
quote: "You'll get what you're looking for."

summary: Vess, imprisoned in a hexed cell, taunts Tam about betraying her friends and knowing where Jace puts his shame.
quote: "I know you, Beleren! I know where you put your shame!"

summary: Flashback: Tam found the Theorist's earlier self lost in a vision of Phyrexia's attack on Vryn.
quote: She knows without doubt that this was Vryn under Phyrexian attack

summary: Flashback: the Theorist carves the first aberration out of his mind and kicks it through a portal.
quote: Tam's maker suddenly ripped open a portal and kicked him through with full force.

summary: Tam telepathically tells the Theorist that he used her to bring Jadzi to her death, and he admits he carved away the part that knew why he made her.
quote: I'm not sure. I carved the one that knew away.

summary: Tam climbs to the roof in the night, doubts herself, and reminds herself she is in progress.
quote: I'm in progress , she reminds herself.

summary: Tam, lonely in her hexed dormitory, writes a letter of apology and warning to Abigale and burns it.
quote: The letter ignites quickly, quietly, and burns easily in the waste bin.

summary: In her cell, Liliana fails to kill a mouse and cannot use her necromancy.
quote: "Die," she wills, but the intruder merely pauses to clean his whiskers.

summary: Professor Opal, Liliana's double, taunts her about being overwritten and offers to save her; Liliana's heart seizes.
quote: "Do you wonder what it will be like? Me overwriting you?"

summary: Opal calls off the heart attack and says Liliana will fade away like cottonwood fluff, and Liliana refuses to give up her pain.
quote: "My pain is mine ."

summary: Tam visits Liliana, who asks if Jace is her father or boyfriend, and Tam takes her to see the orrery.
quote: Tam unlocks the bars, walks to the wood and stone sphere, and holds up a hand.

summary: Tam shows Liliana the orrery copy and asks what overwriting will mean; Liliana explains it will suffocate the original Multiverse.
quote: "It won't tear them apart, but layering one Multiverse on another will smother the souls of everyone in the original.

summary: Liliana tells Tam that she has the best parts of Jace and asks her to tell Jace not to keep a woman in a dungeon.
quote: "From what I can tell, the best parts of himself."

summary: Tam passes Chandra in the tower and sees Lluwen's vision resentfully remark about half people.
quote: Why do these half people get to win when the real ones have to die?"

summary: Tam confronts the Theorist with her feelings; he silences her with a command and then hugs her.
quote: The Theorist flinches, lip curling like he slugged back a bitter liquor.

summary: The Theorist tells Tam to purge herself of doubt as he does.
quote: "Then purge yourself of doubt," he says

summary: The Theorist sends Tam to Innistrad through an Omenpath to record its planar data.
quote: "Go to Innistrad. I need its planar dimensions, including extraplanetary bodies.

summary: The Theorist goes to Jadzi's cell intending to kill her himself.
quote: Jadzi, the oracle, awaits with a straight back and a combative glare.

summary: He dives into Jadzi's mind and drowns in countless possible futures.
quote: The Theorist's eyes burn bright. He dives into the oracle's mind and crashes into an absolute mess.

summary: Jadzi sees his future and the Theorist lowers his hand, failing to kill her.
quote: The Theorist sees in Jadzi's mind a single image—himself, dropping his hand—and she sees him see it in turn.

summary: Jadzi taunts him and he storms out.

quote: Mostly what plagues her is guilt. She turned away from him.

summary: Chandra and Ajani arrive at the flat and tell them that Jace is alive.
quote: "Jace is alive," Chandra says, and in three words, Vraska's entire world falls apart.

summary: Chandra and Ajani explain that a gorgon working for Jace kidnapped an oracle, and Vraska deduces he needs knowledge of how planes fuse.
quote: "There was knowledge he did not possess, specifically about the fusion of planes."

summary: Vraska agrees to help reach Jace, and Ranna entrusts her with a wrapped package for him.
quote: "Yes." Vraska nods, wincing.

summary: Loot draws maps for Vraska, and she sends Chandra and Ajani to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.
quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

summary: Chandra and Ajani find Garruk's lodge on Muraganda, guarded by tripwires, and he leads them in.
quote: This tower of muscles can only be Garruk Wildspeaker.

summary: Chandra explains that Jace's plan would overwrite the Multiverse, and Garruk says illusions don't smell real to him.
quote: "They don't smell real."

summary: Garruk agrees to help in exchange for information about wards, seals and magical containment.
quote: "I need people who understand wards, seals, magical containment.

summary: The Theorist visits the Guildpact for counsel and has him check his proofs, which show the overlay is collapsing.

summary: The Theorist reveals that he stores the Multiverse map in the Theorix cadets.
quote: "No, in the cadets."

summary: The Guildpact calls the Theorist a machine that can't even kill one oracle and warns he intends to overwrite their home; the Theorist puts him to sleep.
quote: The Theorist flicks a hand, and the Guildpact collapses to the rubble with a sick thud, dead asleep.

summary: Vraska, traveling to Strixhaven by Omenpath, camps in a swamp and dreams of General Beleren.
quote: She is in the center of an alder-lined war room.

summary: In the dream, General Beleren says he is the part that frightens her, kisses her cheek and says he can be both a good man and a monster.
quote: His lips graze her cheek. "I can be both ."

summary: Vraska wakes and realizes Jace is both good and monstrous, and that she may have made a mistake.
quote: He is both , she realizes with mournful shame, with defiant fierceness.

summary: Tam measures Innistrad's dimensions and discovers she can briefly freeze a rat with her gaze without petrifying it.
quote: The rat does not move, but does not turn to stone.

summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

summary: Tam has her first beer, and Moiren tells her that suffering is the only constant and the church teaches death is rest.
quote: "The church teaches that death is the rest we are rewarded in the end.

summary: Three vampires attack the inn; Moiren fights them and Tam freezes them with her gaze so Moiren can behead them.
quote: Tam stares , and all three vampires freeze in place.

summary: Moiren tells Tam she is worth saving.
quote: "You're worth saving, Miss Tam."

summary: At night Tam reaches out telepathically, and the monster in the moon yanks her mind into a psychic prison.
quote: Something hears her and yanks her up.

summary: The monster speaks through an emaciated puppet woman, saying it eats time and hungers for her knowledge.
quote: I have eaten time , says the woman

summary: Tam braids the puppet's hair to appease it, and learns it eats planes.
quote: "You eat planes."

summary: The monster demands to be shown where Tam's Multiverse is and offers to rid her of it; Tam escapes.
quote: Run! Tam can't help the scream she lets out

summary: Vraska enters the Echoverse through a mage-ring and finds details made for her, like the leaves matching her eyes.
quote: the yellow in the tree leaves is the exact same shade as her eyes

quote: "Stand aside and permit me my revenge," Garruk says with deadly calm. "The witch cursed me."

summary: The four climb the tower and meet a woman in white who embraces Chandra and says she came willingly.
quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra expose the woman as not Liliana, and Vraska punches her unconscious.
quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

summary: The false Liliana heals herself, reveals she will tell the Theorist and runs off.
quote: "Now, if you'll excuse me, the Theorist needs to know you're here, and uncooperative,"

summary: The allies chase through looping halls and burst into Opal's office, where hours have passed and they are injured with lost memories.
quote: When did I get in a fight ?

summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

summary: Vraska and her allies burst into the sanctum and Garruk, Chandra and Ajani collapse asleep at the Theorist's snap while Vraska stays standing.
quote: The four of them burst into his sanctum, and half a second later, three hit the floor.

summary: Vraska asks the Theorist to stop and gives him the horseshoe from his mother, which he drops, recalling the illusion of his childhood horse Pewter.
quote: how in the dark of night the child that was Jace snuck down and created a copy of Pewter to love with his whole heart.

summary: The Theorist insists he cannot be stopped, and Vraska asks how many will die.
quote: "How many will die, Jace?"

summary: Vraska tells him he is a killer who will murder billions, and he wipes her memory and sends the four out.
quote: her memory of the last few minutes is resting in the Theorist's hand.

summary: On the second attempt the Theorist freezes the group and shares a memory of how he rebuilt himself after dying.
quote: It is the day after he died. He is now they, and they have shattered.

summary: In the memory, Jace shapes a body from the Meditation Realm, imitating Ugin, and pours his fractured selves into it.
quote: shaping a body from the inherent power of this place and pouring his fractured selves inside.

summary: Jace creates a pocket plane and uses a mirror spell to make a person, Tam, from a wisp of himself.
quote: A person, or rather a person-shaped miasma of blue, emerges.

summary: The Theorist cannot remember why he made Tam, saying only that she is important and must be protected, and wipes their memories again.
quote: I made a person, but this part of me does not remember why. She must be protected.

summary: On the third attempt Vraska says he will not convince them, and the Theorist realizes he can command them instead.
quote: "I don't need to convince you, " he commands, dark and gentle.

summary: He orders the others to stop each other, and they fight until he calls it off.
quote: "Stop the others from stopping me."

summary: The Theorist disables Chandra's decision-making, ruins Garruk's muscles and steals Ajani's language.
quote: The Theorist reaches inside Ajani's mind and snatches away an entire language.

summary: Vraska tells him she hates what he has become, and he sends her to sleep and wipes their minds, leaving only the knowledge that he cannot be defeated.
quote: I cannot be defeated by you.

summary: Vraska realizes they only fought the Theorist, the worst part of Jace.
quote: "That's not Jace," Vraska concludes with a sick roil of her guts. "It's just what's left."

summary: Vraska sees Tam in a hallway and recognizes who she is.
quote: "Vraska," she says. "I know your name."

summary: Tam warns Vraska that the Theorist can only be beaten by a telepath and says the tower is made of his memories; she tells her to rescue Jadzi.
quote: "It isn't worth it to fight him directly. You need to rescue Jadzi before he can use her."

summary: Tam heals the injured allies, restoring Garruk's muscles and Ajani's speech.
quote: Her eyes light up with blue, and after a long minute, both Chandra and Garruk relax.

summary: Vraska realizes Jace knows he is going to die.
quote: Jace knows he is going to die.

summary: Tam goes to the Theorist and asks where the Echoverse versions of her friends are; he says they were skipped or removed.
quote: "They're not here. The process of creation is autonomous. Some things are likely to be skipped. Or removed. It's bound to happen."

summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind, learns she met Emrakul, and says Emrakul will be eliminated by the overwrite; Tam pushes back angrily.
quote: But he saw enough. "You spoke to Emrakul."

summary: The Theorist commands Tam to stop, but she counters his command and says she will no longer help.
quote: "This experiment has gone too far," she announces. "I won't help you anymore!"

summary: The Theorist releases another aberration, the Nihilist, who tells Tam she cannot win.
quote: A thud. Lungs drawing air. A second man lies on the floor.

summary: The Nihilist says the experiment is tearing the original Multiverse and that their death will mean nothing; he tells Tam to ask for help, and the Theorist kicks him through a portal.
quote: "Aberration!" snarls the Theorist, and a half-second later he flashes a portal into existence and kicks the Nihilist through it.

summary: Tam resolves to help stop her maker.
quote: Her mentor must be stopped, and she must aid in his downfall.

summary: Chandra tells Vraska she wants her friend Jace back so she can kick his ass, and breaks into tears.
quote: I want my friend back so I can kick his ass!

summary: Chandra's cryomancer double appears and attacks the group with ice, and the allies jump out the window into the courtyard.
quote: "Dad says hi," says her double

summary: Doubles of Ajani, Garruk and Vraska arrive, and Vraska guides Chandra in a blind fight.
quote: "It's my double! It takes a few seconds for petrification to charge.

summary: Echoverse Vraska animates a statue of the Theorist that crushes Vraska and Chandra.
quote: It is Jace as the Theorist, twice as tall as the real one

summary: The Theorist asks Vraska to give up, but she spits in his face and demands Beleren back, and he throws them into a portal.
quote: Vraska feels herself being hoisted up then thrown through the portal into a vast and empty space.

summary: In her dormitory, Tam reflects on what she wants and resolves to betray the worst part of her maker in honor of the best parts.
quote: I have to betray the worst part of him in honor of the best parts.

summary: The allies fall into the tower's memory traps and find a marble plain with a well.
quote: It's an infinite plane of marble, endless and bare, with what looks like a well at the center of it.

summary: Chandra asks if Jace would have done this had she been nicer, and Vraska tells her she isn't that special.
quote: "You're not that special, Chandra."

summary: In a lecture hall they find the number of beings in the Multiverse on a chalkboard and meet the Detective, an aberration of Jace.
quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

summary: The Detective explains that the body is connected to the illusion and proposes that killing the body will stall the overlay, and that they need the Soldier.
quote: We'll need to find him. Then we'll have a chance to finish the task and eliminate the body.

summary: The Detective apologizes to Vraska, saying he loved all of them, and Vraska embraces him, saying we are who we choose to be.
quote: "You are no monster," she says with gritted teeth. "We are who we choose to be."

summary: The Detective says he chooses to be the man who kills his own ambition, and Vraska kisses him.
quote: "I choose to be the man who kills his own ambition."

summary: Vraska realizes that for the spell to slow, Jace's body must die.
quote: Vraska, lip trembling, finishes her conclusion. "You need to die."

summary: The Detective tells Vraska the Theorist must be stopped and that he must die; Vraska objects.
quote: The Theorist must be stopped , he says in her mind. I must die.

summary: The Detective explains that the spell destroying a Multiverse depends on their body being alive, so removing it is the only way.
quote: "Because the spell that is about to annihilate an entire Multiverse is contingent on our body being alive," says the Detective.

summary: Vraska tearfully shares her grief about losing him and the fear of forgetting; the Detective says she would betray him only if she never changed.
quote: Then you'd kill me a third time."

summary: The Detective asks the others to find the rest of his parts and hold them in their minds until they can be unified with the Theorist's body.
quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

summary: Garruk volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head, while Chandra refuses.
quote: "I will," Garruk grunts.

summary: Chandra rages against the plan and compares it to Gideon's death, but the Detective calls his death atonement; Chandra hugs him and they trade farewells.
quote: "It's not like what Gideon did. It's atonement."

summary: Ajani pledges support and the Detective vanishes into Vraska's mind in a blue light.
